Hetupaccayo

Root condition.

1. Hetuṃ [T 3.0001][M 3.0001][V 3.0001] dhammaṃ paṭicca hetu dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – alobhaṃ paṭicca adoso amoho, adosaṃ paṭicca alobho amoho, amohaṃ paṭicca alobho adoso, lobhaṃ paṭicca [V 3.0002] moho, mohaṃ paṭicca lobho, dosaṃ paṭicca moho, mohaṃ paṭicca doso; paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe…. (1)

1. A root phenomenon, dependent on a root phenomenon, arises by root condition: dependent on non-greed, non-hatred and non-delusion arise; dependent on non-hatred, non-greed and non-delusion arise; dependent on non-delusion, non-greed and non-hatred arise; dependent on greed, delusion arises; dependent on delusion, greed arises; dependent on hatred, delusion arises; dependent on delusion, hatred arises; at the moment of rebirth-linking…and so on. (1)

Hetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca nahetu dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – hetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca sampayuttakā khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ; paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe…. (2)

A non-root phenomenon, dependent on a root phenomenon, arises by root condition: dependent on a root phenomenon, associated aggregates and mind-originated material form arise; at the moment of rebirth-linking…and so on. (2)

Hetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca hetu ca nahetu ca dhammā uppajjanti hetupaccayā – alobhaṃ paṭicca adoso amoho sampayuttakā ca khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ (cakkaṃ). Lobhaṃ paṭicca moho sampayuttakā ca khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ…pe… paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe…. (3)

Dependent on a root phenomenon, both root and non-root phenomena arise by root condition: dependent on non-greed, non-hatred, non-delusion, associated aggregates, and mind-originated material form arise (cycle). Dependent on greed, delusion, associated aggregates, and mind-originated material form arise…and so on…at the moment of rebirth-linking…and so on. (3)

2. Nahetuṃ [M 3.0002] dhammaṃ [T 3.0002] paṭicca nahetu dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – nahetuṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca tayo khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ…pe… dve khandhe paṭicca dve khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ; paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe… khandhe paṭicca vatthu, vatthuṃ paṭicca khandhā; ekaṃ mahābhūtaṃ…pe…. (1)

2. Dependent on a non-root phenomenon, a non-root phenomenon arises by root condition: dependent on one non-root aggregate, three aggregates and mind-originated material form arise…and so on…dependent on two aggregates, two aggregates and mind-originated material form arise; at the moment of rebirth-linking…and so on…dependent on the aggregates, the base arises; dependent on the base, the aggregates arise; dependent on one great element…and so on. (1)

Nahetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca hetu dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – nahetū khandhe paṭicca hetū; paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe… vatthuṃ paṭicca hetū. (2)

A root phenomenon, dependent on a non-root phenomenon, arises by root condition: dependent on non-root aggregates, roots arise; at the moment of rebirth-linking…and so on…dependent on the base, roots arise. (2)

Nahetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca hetu ca nahetu ca dhammā uppajjanti hetupaccayā – nahetuṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca tayo khandhā hetu ca cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ…pe… dve khandhe paṭicca dve khandhā hetu ca cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ; paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe… paṭisandhikkhaṇe vatthuṃ paṭicca hetū sampayuttakā ca khandhā. (3)

Dependent on a non-root phenomenon, both root and non-root phenomena arise by root condition: dependent on one non-root aggregate, three aggregates, roots, and mind-originated material form arise…and so on…dependent on two aggregates, two aggregates, roots, and mind-originated material form arise; at the moment of rebirth-linking…and so on…at the moment of rebirth-linking, dependent on the base, roots and associated aggregates arise. (3)

3. Hetuñca nahetuñca dhammaṃ paṭicca hetu dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – alobhañca sampayuttake ca khandhe paṭicca adoso amoho (cakkaṃ). Lobhañca sampayuttake ca khandhe paṭicca moho, dosañca sampayuttake ca khandhe paṭicca moho…pe… paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe… alobhañca vatthuñca paṭicca adoso amoho…pe…. (1)

3. Dependent on both a root phenomenon and a non-root phenomenon, a root phenomenon arises by root condition: dependent on non-greed and the associated aggregates, non-hatred and non-delusion arise (cycle). Dependent on greed and the associated aggregates, delusion arises; dependent on hatred and the associated aggregates, delusion arises…and so on…at the moment of rebirth-linking…and so on…dependent on non-greed and the base, non-hatred and non-delusion arise…and so on. (1)

Hetuñca [V 3.0003] nahetuñca dhammaṃ paṭicca nahetu dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – nahetuṃ ekaṃ khandhañca hetuñca paṭicca tayo khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ…pe… dve khandhe ca hetuñca paṭicca dve khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ; paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe… paṭisandhikkhaṇe vatthuñca hetuñca paṭicca sampayuttakā khandhā. (2)

Dependent on both a root phenomenon and a non-root phenomenon, a non-root phenomenon arises by root condition: dependent on one non-root aggregate and a root, three aggregates and mind-originated material form arise…and so on…dependent on two non-root aggregates and a root, two aggregates and mind-originated material form arise; at the moment of rebirth-linking…and so on…at the moment of rebirth-linking, dependent on the base and a root, associated aggregates arise. (2)

Hetuñca nahetuñca dhammaṃ paṭicca hetu ca nahetu ca dhammā uppajjanti [T 3.0003] hetupaccayā – nahetuṃ ekaṃ khandhañca alobhañca paṭicca tayo khandhā adoso amoho ca cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ…pe… dve khandhe ca alobhañca paṭicca dve khandhā adoso amoho ca cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ (cakkaṃ). Nahetuṃ ekaṃ khandhañca lobhañca paṭicca tayo khandhā moho ca cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ…pe… dve khandhe…pe… paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe… vatthuñca alobhañca paṭicca adoso amoho sampayuttakā ca khandhā. (3)

Dependent on both a root phenomenon and a non-root phenomenon, both root and non-root phenomena arise by root condition: dependent on one non-root aggregate and non-greed, three aggregates, non-hatred, non-delusion, and mind-originated material form arise…and so on…dependent on two non-root aggregates and non-greed, two aggregates, non-hatred, non-delusion, and mind-originated material form arise (cycle). Dependent on one non-root aggregate and greed, three aggregates, delusion, and mind-originated material form arise…and so on…dependent on two non-root aggregates…and so on…at the moment of rebirth-linking…and so on…dependent on the base and non-greed, non-hatred, non-delusion, and the associated aggregates arise. (3)

Ārammaṇapaccayādi

Object condition, and so on.

4. Hetuṃ [M 3.0003] dhammaṃ paṭicca hetu dhammo uppajjati ārammaṇapaccayā (rūpaṃ chaḍḍetvā arūpeyeva nava pañhā)… adhipatipaccayā (paṭisandhi natthi, paripuṇṇaṃ) ekaṃ mahābhūtaṃ paṭicca…pe… mahābhūte paṭicca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ upādārūpaṃ… (imaṃ nānaṃ) anantarapaccayā… samanantarapaccayā… sahajātapaccayā (sabbe mahābhūtā yāva asaññasattā)… aññamaññapaccayā… nissayapaccayā… upanissayapaccayā… purejātapaccayā… āsevanapaccayā (dvīsupi paṭisandhi natthi)… kammapaccayā… vipākapaccayā (saṃkhittaṃ)… avigatapaccayā.

4. A root phenomenon, dependent on a root phenomenon, arises by object condition (excluding material form, in the immaterial realm only there are nine questions)… by dominance condition (rebirth-linking is absent, complete)… dependent on one great element…and so on… dependent on the great elements, mind-originated material form and derived material form… (this diversity)… by proximity condition… by contiguity condition… by co-nascence condition (all great elements up to the non-percipient beings)… by mutuality condition… by dependence condition… by decisive support condition… by pre-nascence condition… by repetition condition (rebirth-linking is absent in both)… by kamma condition… by result condition (abbreviated)… by presence condition.

5. Hetuyā nava, ārammaṇe nava (sabbattha nava), avigate nava (evaṃ gaṇetabbaṃ).

5. Nine by root condition, nine by object condition (nine in all cases), nine by presence condition (thus it should be reckoned).

Anulomaṃ.

Direct Order.

1. The Chapter on Differentiation

Nahetupaccayo

Non-root condition.

6. Nahetuṃ [V 3.0004] dhammaṃ paṭicca nahetu dhammo uppajjati nahetupaccayā – ahetukaṃ nahetuṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca tayo khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañca [T 3.0004] rūpaṃ…pe… dve khandhe…pe… ahetukapaṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe… khandhe paṭicca vatthu, vatthuṃ paṭicca khandhā; ekaṃ mahābhūtaṃ…pe… bāhiraṃ… āhārasamuṭṭhānaṃ… utusamuṭṭhānaṃ… asaññasattānaṃ…pe….(1)

6. Dependent on a non-root phenomenon, a non-root phenomenon arises by non-root condition: dependent on one rootless, non-root aggregate, three aggregates and mind-originated material form arise…and so on…dependent on two aggregates…and so on…at the moment of rootless rebirth-linking…and so on…dependent on the aggregates, the base arises; dependent on the base, the aggregates arise; dependent on one great element…and so on…external…nutriment-originated…temperature-originated…of the non-percipient beings…and so on. (1)

Nahetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca hetu dhammo uppajjati nahetupaccayā – vicikicchāsahagate uddhaccasahagate khandhe paṭicca vicikicchāsahagato uddhaccasahagato moho. (2)

A root phenomenon arises dependent on a non-root phenomenon, not by way of root condition—dependent on the aggregates accompanied by doubt and by restlessness, delusion accompanied by doubt and by restlessness arises. (2)

Naārammaṇapaccayādi

Not by way of object condition, and so on.

7. Hetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca nahetu dhammo uppajjati naārammaṇapaccayā – hetuṃ paṭicca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ; paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe…. (1)

7. Dependent on a root phenomenon, a non-root phenomenon arises, not by way of object condition—dependent on a root, mind-originated matter arises; at the moment of rebirth-linking… and so on…. (1)

Nahetuṃ [M 3.0004] dhammaṃ paṭicca nahetu dhammo uppajjati naārammaṇapaccayā – nahetū khandhe paṭicca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ; paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe… sabbe mahābhūtā…pe…. (1)

Dependent on a non-root phenomenon, a non-root phenomenon arises, not by way of object condition—dependent on the non-root aggregates, mind-originated matter arises; at the moment of rebirth-linking… and so on… all the great elements… and so on…. (1)

Hetuñca nahetuñca dhammaṃ paṭicca nahetu dhammo uppajjati naārammaṇapaccayā – hetuñca nahetuñca khandhe paṭicca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ; paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe… naadhipatipaccayā… (paripuṇṇaṃ) naanantarapaccayā… nasamanantarapaccayā… naaññamaññapaccayā… naupanissayapaccayā.

Dependent on a root phenomenon and a non-root phenomenon, a non-root phenomenon arises, not by way of object condition—dependent on root aggregates and non-root aggregates, mind-originated matter arises; at the moment of rebirth-linking… and so on… not by way of dominance condition… (complete) not by way of proximity condition… not by way of contiguity condition… not by way of mutuality condition… not by way of decisive support condition.

Napurejātapaccayo

Not by way of pre-nascence condition.

8. Hetuṃ [V 3.0005] dhammaṃ paṭicca hetu dhammo uppajjati napurejātapaccayā – arūpe alobhaṃ paṭicca adoso amoho (cakkaṃ). Lobhaṃ paṭicca moho, mohaṃ paṭicca lobho; paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe…. (1)

8. Dependent on a root phenomenon, a root phenomenon arises, not by way of pre-nascence condition—in the immaterial sphere, dependent on non-greed, non-hatred and non-delusion arise (a cycle). Dependent on greed, delusion; dependent on delusion, greed; at the moment of rebirth-linking… and so on…. (1)

Hetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca nahetu dhammo uppajjati napurejātapaccayā – arūpe hetuṃ paṭicca sampayuttakā khandhā, hetuṃ paṭicca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ [T 3.0005] rūpaṃ; paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe…. (2)

Dependent on a root phenomenon, a non-root phenomenon arises, not by way of pre-nascence condition—in the immaterial sphere, dependent on a root, associated aggregates arise; dependent on a root, mind-originated matter arises; at the moment of rebirth-linking… and so on…. (2)

Hetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca hetu ca nahetu ca dhammā uppajjanti napurejātapaccayā – arūpe alobhaṃ paṭicca adoso amoho sampayuttakā ca khandhā (cakkaṃ). Lobhaṃ paṭicca moho sampayuttakā ca khandhā (cakkaṃ); paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe…. (3)

Dependent on a root phenomenon, both root and non-root phenomena arise, not by way of pre-nascence condition—in the immaterial sphere, dependent on non-greed, non-hatred, non-delusion, and associated aggregates arise (a cycle). Dependent on greed, delusion and associated aggregates arise (a cycle); at the moment of rebirth-linking… and so on…. (3)

9. Nahetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca nahetu dhammo uppajjati napurejātapaccayā – arūpe nahetuṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca tayo khandhā…pe… nahetū khandhe paṭicca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ; paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe… ekaṃ mahābhūtaṃ…pe…. (1)

9. Dependent on a non-root phenomenon, a non-root phenomenon arises, not by way of pre-nascence condition—in the immaterial sphere, dependent on one non-root aggregate, three aggregates arise… and so on… dependent on non-root aggregates, mind-originated matter arises; at the moment of rebirth-linking… and so on… one great element… and so on…. (1)

Nahetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca hetu dhammo uppajjati napurejātapaccayā – arūpe nahetū khandhe paṭicca hetū; paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe…. (2)

Dependent on a non-root phenomenon, a root phenomenon arises, not by way of pre-nascence condition—in the immaterial sphere, dependent on non-root aggregates, roots arise; at the moment of rebirth-linking… and so on…. (2)

Nahetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca hetu ca nahetu ca dhammā uppajjanti napurejātapaccayā – arūpe nahetuṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca tayo khandhā hetu ca…pe… dve khandhe…pe… paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe…. (3)

Dependent on a non-root phenomenon, both root and non-root phenomena arise, not by way of pre-nascence condition—in the immaterial sphere, dependent on one non-root aggregate, three aggregates and roots arise… and so on… two aggregates… and so on… at the moment of rebirth-linking… and so on…. (3)

10. Hetuñca nahetuñca dhammaṃ paṭicca hetu dhammo uppajjati napurejātapaccayā – arūpe alobhañca sampayuttake ca khandhe paṭicca adoso amoho [M 3.0005] (cakkaṃ). Arūpe lobhañca sampayuttake ca khandhe paṭicca moho (cakkaṃ); paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe…. (1)

10. Dependent on a root and a non-root phenomenon, a root phenomenon arises, not by way of pre-nascence condition—in the immaterial sphere, dependent on non-greed and associated aggregates, non-hatred and non-delusion arise (a cycle). In the immaterial sphere, dependent on greed and associated aggregates, delusion arises (a cycle); at the moment of rebirth-linking… and so on…. (1)

Hetuñca [V 3.0006] nahetuñca dhammaṃ paṭicca nahetu dhammo uppajjati napurejātapaccayā – arūpe nahetuṃ ekaṃ khandhañca hetuñca paṭicca tayo khandhā…pe… dve khandhe…pe… nahetū khandhe ca hetuñca paṭicca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ, hetuñca mahābhūte ca paṭicca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ[T 3.0006]; paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe…. (2)

Dependent on a root and a non-root phenomenon, a non-root phenomenon arises, not by way of pre-nascence condition—in the immaterial sphere, dependent on one non-root aggregate and a root, three aggregates arise… and so on… two aggregates… and so on… dependent on non-root aggregates and a root, mind-originated matter arises; dependent on a root and the great elements, mind-originated matter arises; at the moment of rebirth-linking… and so on…. (2)

Hetuñca nahetuñca dhammaṃ paṭicca hetu ca nahetu ca dhammā uppajjanti napurejātapaccayā – arūpe nahetuṃ ekaṃ khandhañca alobhañca paṭicca tayo khandhā adoso amoho ca…pe… dve khandhe…pe… (cakkaṃ). Nahetuṃ ekaṃ khandhañca lobhañca paṭicca tayo khandhā moho ca (cakkaṃ); paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe…. (3)

Dependent on a root and a non-root phenomenon, both root and non-root phenomena arise, not by way of pre-nascence condition—in the immaterial sphere, dependent on one non-root aggregate and non-greed, three aggregates, non-hatred, and non-delusion arise… and so on… two aggregates… and so on… (a cycle). Dependent on one non-root aggregate and greed, three aggregates and delusion arise (a cycle); at the moment of rebirth-linking… and so on…. (3)

Napacchājātapaccayādi

Not by way of post-nascence condition, and so on.

11. Hetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca hetu dhammo uppajjati napacchājātapaccayā… naāsevanapaccayā.

11. Dependent on a root phenomenon, a root phenomenon arises, not by way of post-nascence condition… not by way of repetition condition.

Nakammapaccayādi

Not by way of kamma condition, and so on.

12. Hetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca nahetu dhammo uppajjati nakammapaccayā – hetuṃ paṭicca sampayuttakā cetanā. (1)

12. Dependent on a root phenomenon, a non-root phenomenon arises, not by way of kamma condition—dependent on a root, associated volition arises. (1)

Nahetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca nahetu dhammo uppajjati nakammapaccayā – nahetū khandhe paṭicca sampayuttakā cetanā… bāhiraṃ… āhārasamuṭṭhānaṃ… utusamuṭṭhānaṃ…pe…. (1)

Dependent on a non-root phenomenon, a non-root phenomenon arises, not by way of kamma condition—dependent on non-root aggregates, associated volition arises… external… nutriment-originated… temperature-originated… and so on…. (1)

Hetuñca nahetuñca dhammaṃ paṭicca nahetu dhammo uppajjati nakammapaccayā – hetuñca sampayuttake ca khandhe paṭicca sampayuttakā cetanā. (1)

Dependent on a root and a non-root phenomenon, a non-root phenomenon arises, not by way of kamma condition—dependent on a root and associated aggregates, associated volition arises. (1)

Hetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca hetu dhammo uppajjati navipākapaccayā… nava.

Dependent on a root phenomenon, a root phenomenon arises, not by way of resultant condition… nine.

Naāhārapaccayādi

Not by way of nutriment condition, and so on.

13. Nahetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca nahetu dhammo uppajjati naāhārapaccayā – bāhiraṃ… utusamuṭṭhānaṃ… asaññasattānaṃ…pe… naindriyapaccayā [T 3.0007] – bāhiraṃ… āhārasamuṭṭhānaṃ [M 3.0006]… utusamuṭṭhānaṃ…pe… asaññasattānaṃ mahābhūte paṭicca rūpajīvitindriyaṃ, najhānapaccayā – pañcaviññāṇaṃ [V 3.0007] …pe… bāhiraṃ… āhārasamuṭṭhānaṃ… utusamuṭṭhānaṃ… asaññasattānaṃ…pe… namaggapaccayā – ahetukaṃ nahetuṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca…pe… bāhiraṃ… āhārasamuṭṭhānaṃ… utusamuṭṭhānaṃ… asaññasattānaṃ…pe… nasampayuttapaccayā… navippayuttapaccayā… (napurejātasadisaṃ, arūpapañhāyeva) nonatthipaccayā… novigatapaccayā.

13. Dependent on a non-root phenomenon, a non-root phenomenon arises, not by way of nutriment condition—external… temperature-originated… for non-percipient beings… and so on… not by way of faculty condition—external… nutriment-originated… temperature-originated… and so on… for non-percipient beings, dependent on the great elements, the material life faculty arises; not by way of jhāna condition—the five consciousnesses… and so on… external… nutriment-originated… temperature-originated… for non-percipient beings… and so on… not by way of path condition—dependent on one rootless, non-root aggregate… and so on… external… nutriment-originated… temperature-originated… for non-percipient beings… and so on… not by way of association condition… not by way of dissociation condition… (similar to not-by-way-of-pre-nascence, only the formless questions) not by way of absence condition… not by way of disappearance condition.

Suddhaṃ

Pure.

14. Nahetuyā dve, naārammaṇe tīṇi, naadhipatiyā nava, naanantare tīṇi, nasamanantare tīṇi, naaññamaññe tīṇi, naupanissaye tīṇi, napurejāte nava, napacchājāte nava, naāsevane nava, nakamme tīṇi, navipāke nava, naāhāre ekaṃ, naindriye ekaṃ, najhāne ekaṃ, namagge ekaṃ, nasampayutte tīṇi, navippayutte nava, nonatthiyā tīṇi, novigate tīṇi (evaṃ gaṇetabbaṃ).

14. Non-root: two; non-object: three; non-dominance: nine; non-immediacy: three; non-contiguity: three; non-mutuality: three; non-decisive support: three; non-prenascence: nine; non-postnascence: nine; non-repetition: nine; non-kamma: three; non-result: nine; non-nutriment: one; non-faculty: one; non-jhāna: one; non-path: one; non-association: three; non-dissociation: nine; non-absence: three; non-disappearance: three (thus it should be counted).

Paccanīyaṃ.

Negative.

3. Paccayānulomapaccanīyaṃ

3. Positive-Negative Conditional Relations.

Hetudukaṃ

The Root Dyad.

15. Hetupaccayā naārammaṇe tīṇi, naadhipatiyā nava, naanantare tīṇi…pe… naupanissaye tīṇi, napurejāte nava, napacchājāte nava, naāsevane nava, nakamme tīṇi, navipāke nava, nasampayutte tīṇi, navippayutte [T 3.0008] nava, nonatthiyā tīṇi, novigate tīṇi.

15. By root condition: non-object condition, three; non-dominance condition, nine; non-immediacy condition, three... and so on... non-decisive support condition, three; non-prenascence condition, nine; non-postnascence condition, nine; non-repetition condition, nine; non-kamma condition, three; non-result condition, nine; non-association condition, three; non-dissociation condition, nine; non-absence condition, three; non-disappearance condition, three.

Anulomapaccanīyaṃ.

Positive-Negative.

4. Paccayapaccanīyānulomaṃ

4. Negative-Positive Conditional Relations.

Nahetudukaṃ

The Non-Root Dyad.

16. Nahetupaccayā [M 3.0007][V 3.0008] ārammaṇe dve, anantare dve…pe… kamme dve, vipāke ekaṃ, āhāre dve, indriye dve, jhāne dve, magge ekaṃ, sampayutte dve…pe… avigate dve.

16. By non-root condition: object, two; immediacy, two... and so on... kamma, two; result, one; nutriment, two; faculty, two; jhāna, two; path, one; association, two... and so on... non-disappearance, two.

Paccanīyānulomaṃ.

Negative-Positive.

2-6 Sahajāta-paccaya-nissaya-saṃsaṭṭha-sampayuttavāro

2-6 The Section on Conascence, Condition, Support, Intermingling, and Association.

(Sahajātavāropi paccayavāropi nissayavāropi paṭiccavārasadisāyeva pañhā. Mahābhūtesu niṭṭhitesu “vatthuṃ paccayā”ti kātabbā. Pañcāyatanāni anulomepi paccanīyepi yathā labbhanti tathā kātabbā. Saṃsaṭṭhavāropi sampayuttavāropi paripuṇṇo. Rūpaṃ natthi, arūpameva.)

(The questions in the Conascence Section, the Condition Section, and the Support Section are just like those of the Dependence Section. When the great primary elements are completed, ‘the base as condition’ should be applied. The five sense-bases should be applied as they are found, both in the positive and negative methods. The sections on Intermingling and Association are complete. There is no materiality; there is only immateriality.)

7. Pañhāvāro

7. Question Section.

1. Paccayānulomaṃ

1. Positive Conditional Relations.

1. Vibhaṅgavāro

1. The Section on Analysis.

Hetupaccayo

Root Condition.

17. Hetu dhammo hetussa dhammassa hetupaccayena paccayo – alobho adosassa amohassa hetupaccayena paccayo (cakkaṃ). Lobho mohassa hetupaccayena paccayo, doso mohassa hetupaccayena paccayo; paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe…. (1)

17. A root state is a condition for a root state by root condition—non-greed is a condition for non-hatred and non-delusion by root condition (wheel). Greed is a condition for delusion by root condition; hatred is a condition for delusion by root condition; at the moment of rebirth-linking... and so on... (1)

Hetu [V 3.0009] dhammo nahetussa dhammassa hetupaccayena paccayo – hetū sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ hetupaccayena paccayo; paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe…. (2)

A root state is a condition for a non-root state by root condition—roots are a condition for the associated aggregates and for mind-originated materiality by root condition; at the moment of rebirth-linking... and so on... (2)

Hetu dhammo hetussa ca nahetussa ca dhammassa hetupaccayena paccayo [T 3.0009] – alobho adosassa amohassa sampayuttakānañca khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ hetupaccayena paccayo (cakkaṃ). Lobho mohassa…pe… paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe…. (3)

A root state is a condition for both a root state and a non-root state by root condition—non-greed is a condition for non-hatred and non-delusion, and for the associated aggregates and mind-originated materiality, by root condition (wheel). Greed is a condition for delusion… and so on… at the moment of rebirth-linking… and so on… (3)

Ārammaṇapaccayo

Object Condition.

18. Hetu [M 3.0008] dhammo hetussa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo – hetuṃ ārabbha hetū uppajjanti. (1)

18. A root state is a condition for a root state by object condition: taking a root as object, roots arise. (1)

Hetu dhammo nahetussa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo – hetuṃ ārabbha nahetū khandhā uppajjanti. (2)

A root state is a condition for a non-root state by object condition: taking a root as object, non-root aggregates arise. (2)

Hetu dhammo hetussa ca nahetussa ca dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo – hetuṃ ārabbha hetū ca sampayuttakā ca khandhā uppajjanti. (3)

A root state is a condition for both a root state and a non-root state by object condition: taking a root as object, roots and associated aggregates arise. (3)

19. Nahetu dhammo nahetussa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo – dānaṃ datvā sīlaṃ…pe… uposathakammaṃ katvā taṃ paccavekkhati, pubbe suciṇṇāni paccavekkhati. Jhānā vuṭṭhahitvā…pe… ariyā maggā vuṭṭhahitvā maggaṃ paccavekkhanti, phalaṃ…pe… nibbānaṃ…pe… nibbānaṃ gotrabhussa, vodānassa, maggassa, phalassa, āvajjanāya ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo. Ariyā nahetū pahīne kilese paccavekkhanti, vikkhambhite kilese paccavekkhanti, pubbe samudāciṇṇe kilese jānanti, cakkhuṃ…pe… vatthuṃ, nahetū khandhe aniccato…pe… domanassaṃ uppajjati; dibbena cakkhunā rūpaṃ passati, dibbāya sotadhātuyā saddaṃ suṇāti, cetopariyañāṇena nahetucittasamaṅgissa cittaṃ jānāti. Ākāsānañcāyatanaṃ ākāsānañcāyatanakiriyaṃ (syā.) evamuparipi tīsu ṭhānesu viññāṇañcāyatanassa…pe… ākiñcaññāyatanaṃ [T 3.0010] nevasaññānāsaññāyatanassa…pe… rūpāyatanaṃ cakkhuviññāṇassa…pe… phoṭṭhabbāyatanaṃ kāyaviññāṇassa [V 3.0010] …pe… nahetū khandhā iddhividhañāṇassa, cetopariyañāṇassa, pubbenivāsānussatiñāṇassa, yathākammūpagañāṇassa, anāgataṃsañāṇassa, āvajjanāya ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo. (1)

19. A non-root state is a condition for another non-root state by object condition—having given a gift, observed virtue... and performed the Uposatha act, one reviews it; one reviews past good deeds. Having emerged from jhāna… having emerged from the noble path, the noble ones review the path, the fruit… Nibbāna… Nibbāna is a condition by object condition for change-of-lineage, for purification, for the path, for the fruit, and for adverting. The noble ones review the abandoned defilements, review the suppressed defilements, and know the previously practiced defilements. The eye… the base… the non-root aggregates as impermanent… grief arises; with the divine eye, one sees form; with the divine ear-element, one hears sound; with the knowledge of others’ minds, one knows the mind of one endowed with non-root consciousness. The base of infinite space is a condition for the base of infinite consciousness… the base of nothingness for the base of neither-perception-nor-non-perception… the form base for eye-consciousness… the tangible base for body-consciousness… the non-root aggregates are a condition by object condition for the knowledge of psychic powers, knowledge of others’ minds, knowledge of recollection of past lives, knowledge of the passing away and reappearance of beings according to their kamma, knowledge of the future, and for adverting. (1)

Nahetu dhammo hetussa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo – dānaṃ datvā (paṭhamagamanaṃyeva, āvajjanā natthi. Rūpāyatanaṃ cakkhuviññāṇassa…pe… phoṭṭhabbāyatanaṃ kāyaviññāṇassāti idaṃ natthi). (2)

A non-root state is a condition for a root state by object condition—having given a gift (this is only the first part; there is no adverting. The part beginning ‘the form base for eye-consciousness… the tangible base for body-consciousness’ does not apply here). (2)

Nahetu dhammo hetussa ca nahetussa ca dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo – dānaṃ datvā sīlaṃ…pe… uposathakammaṃ katvā taṃ paccavekkhati, taṃ [M 3.0009] ārabbha hetū ca sampayuttakā ca khandhā uppajjanti (tattha tattha ṭhitena imaṃ kātabbaṃ dutiyagamanasadisaṃ). (3)

A non-root state is a condition for both a root state and a non-root state by object condition—having given a gift, observed virtue… performed the Uposatha act, one reviews it. Taking that as object, roots and associated aggregates arise (this should be applied in the respective cases, similar to the second part). (3)

20. Hetu ca nahetu ca dhammā hetussa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo – hetuñca sampayuttake ca khandhe ārabbha hetū uppajjanti. (1)

20. Root and non-root states are a condition for a root state by object condition—taking roots and associated aggregates as object, roots arise. (1)

Hetu ca nahetu ca dhammā nahetussa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo – hetuñca sampayuttake ca khandhe ārabbha nahetū khandhā uppajjanti. (2)

Root and non-root states are a condition for a non-root state by object condition—taking roots and associated aggregates as object, non-root aggregates arise. (2)

Hetu ca nahetu ca dhammā hetussa ca nahetussa ca dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo – hetuñca sampayuttake ca khandhe ārabbha hetū ca sampayuttakā ca khandhā uppajjanti. (3)

Root and non-root states are a condition for a root state and for a non-root state by way of object condition—with roots and associated aggregates as object, roots and associated aggregates arise. (3)

Adhipatipaccayo

Dominance Condition

21. Hetu dhammo hetussa dhammassa adhipatipaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇādhipati, sahajātādhipati. Ārammaṇādhipati – hetuṃ garuṃ katvā hetū [T 3.0011] uppajjanti. Sahajātādhipati – hetu adhipati sampayuttakānaṃ hetūnaṃ adhipatipaccayena paccayo. (1)

21. A root state is a condition for a root state by way of dominance condition—that is, object-dominance and conascence-dominance. As object-dominance: regarding a root as important, roots arise. As conascence-dominance: a dominant root is a condition for associated roots by way of dominance condition. (1)

Hetu dhammo nahetussa dhammassa adhipatipaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇādhipati, sahajātādhipati[V 3.0011]. Ārammaṇādhipati – hetuṃ garuṃ katvā nahetū khandhā uppajjanti. Sahajātādhipati – hetu adhipati sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ adhipatipaccayena paccayo. (2)

A root state is a condition for a non-root state by way of dominance condition—that is, object-dominance and conascence-dominance. As object-dominance: regarding a root as important, non-root aggregates arise. As conascence-dominance: a dominant root is a condition for associated aggregates and for consciousness-originated matter by way of dominance condition. (2)

Hetu dhammo hetussa ca nahetussa ca dhammassa adhipatipaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇādhipati, sahajātādhipati. Ārammaṇādhipati – hetuṃ garuṃ katvā hetū ca sampayuttakā ca khandhā uppajjanti. Sahajātādhipati – hetu adhipati sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ hetūnañca cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ adhipatipaccayena paccayo. (3)

A root state is a condition for a root state and for a non-root state by way of dominance condition—that is, object-dominance and conascence-dominance. As object-dominance: regarding a root as important, roots and associated aggregates arise. As conascence-dominance: a dominant root is a condition for associated aggregates, for roots, and for consciousness-originated matter by way of dominance condition. (3)

22. Nahetu dhammo nahetussa dhammassa adhipatipaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇādhipati, sahajātādhipati. Ārammaṇādhipati – dānaṃ datvā (vitthāretabbaṃ yāva. Nahetū khandhā). Sahajātādhipati – nahetu adhipati sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ adhipatipaccayena paccayo. (1)

22. A non-root state is a condition for a non-root state by way of dominance condition—that is, object-dominance and conascence-dominance. As object-dominance: having given a gift (to be elaborated up to... non-root aggregates). As conascence-dominance: a dominant non-root state is a condition for associated aggregates and for consciousness-originated matter by way of dominance condition. (1)

Nahetu [M 3.0010] dhammo hetussa dhammassa adhipatipaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇādhipati, sahajātādhipati. Ārammaṇādhipati – dānaṃ datvā (saṃkhittaṃ. Yāva vatthu nahetū ca khandhā tāva kātabbaṃ). Sahajātādhipati nahetu adhipati sampayuttakānaṃ hetūnaṃ adhipatipaccayena paccayo. (2)

A non-root state is a condition for a root state by way of dominance condition—that is, object-dominance and conascence-dominance. As object-dominance: having given a gift (in brief; to be done up to... the base and non-root aggregates). As conascence-dominance: a dominant non-root state is a condition for associated roots by way of dominance condition. (2)

Nahetu dhammo hetussa ca nahetussa ca dhammassa adhipatipaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇādhipati, sahajātādhipati[T 3.0012]. Ārammaṇādhipati – dānaṃ datvā sīlaṃ…pe… uposathakammaṃ katvā taṃ garuṃ katvā paccavekkhati, taṃ garuṃ katvā nahetū khandhā ca hetū ca uppajjanti, pubbe suciṇṇāni (yāva vatthu nahetū khandhā, ca tāva kātabbaṃ). Sahajātādhipati – nahetu adhipati sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ hetūnañca cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ adhipatipaccayena paccayo. (3)

A non-root state is a condition for a root state and for a non-root state by way of dominance condition—that is, object-dominance and conascence-dominance. As object-dominance: having given a gift, observed moral precepts... etc... performed the Uposatha observance, one reflects on it, regarding it as important; regarding it as important, non-root aggregates and roots arise. Also, deeds well-done previously (to be done up to... the base and non-root aggregates). As conascence-dominance: a dominant non-root state is a condition for associated aggregates, for roots, and for consciousness-originated matter by way of dominance condition. (3)

23. Hetu ca nahetu ca dhammā hetussa dhammassa adhipatipaccayena paccayo. Ārammaṇādhipati – hetuñca sampayuttake ca khandhe garuṃ katvā hetū uppajjanti. (1)

23. Root and non-root states are a condition for a root state by way of dominance condition. As object-dominance: regarding the root and associated aggregates as important, roots arise. (1)

Hetu [V 3.0012] ca nahetu ca dhammā nahetussa dhammassa adhipatipaccayena paccayo. Ārammaṇādhipati – hetuñca sampayuttake ca khandhe garuṃ katvā nahetū khandhā uppajjanti. (2)

Root and non-root states are a condition for a non-root state by way of dominance condition. As object-dominance: regarding the root and associated aggregates as important, non-root aggregates arise. (2)

Hetu ca nahetu ca dhammā hetussa ca nahetussa ca dhammassa adhipatipaccayena paccayo. Ārammaṇādhipati – hetuñca sampayuttake ca khandhe garuṃ katvā hetū ca sampayuttakā ca khandhā uppajjanti. (3)

Root and non-root states are a condition for a root state and for a non-root state by way of dominance condition. As object-dominance: regarding the root and associated aggregates as important, roots and associated aggregates arise. (3)

Anantarapaccayo

Contiguity Condition

24. Hetu dhammo hetussa dhammassa anantarapaccayena paccayo – purimā purimā hetū pacchimānaṃ pacchimānaṃ hetūnaṃ anantarapaccayena paccayo. (1)

24. A root state is a condition for a root state by way of contiguity condition: preceding roots are a condition for succeeding roots by way of contiguity condition. (1)

Hetu dhammo nahetussa dhammassa anantarapaccayena paccayo – purimā purimā hetū pacchimānaṃ pacchimānaṃ nahetūnaṃ khandhānaṃ anantarapaccayena paccayo. (2)

A root state is a condition for a non-root state by way of contiguity condition: preceding roots are a condition for succeeding non-root aggregates by way of contiguity condition. (2)

Hetu dhammo hetussa ca nahetussa ca dhammassa anantarapaccayena paccayo – purimā purimā hetū pacchimānaṃ pacchimānaṃ hetūnaṃ sampayuttakānañca khandhānaṃ anantarapaccayena paccayo. (3)

A root state is a condition for a root state and for a non-root state by way of contiguity condition: preceding roots are a condition for succeeding roots and associated aggregates by way of contiguity condition. (3)

25. Nahetu [M 3.0011] dhammo [T 3.0013] nahetussa dhammassa anantarapaccayena paccayo – purimā purimā nahetū khandhā pacchimānaṃ pacchimānaṃ nahetūnaṃ khandhānaṃ anantarapaccayena paccayo; anulomaṃ gotrabhussa (saṃkhittaṃ) nevasaññānāsaññāyatanaṃ phalasamāpattiyā anantarapaccayena paccayo. (1)

25. A non-root state is a condition for a non-root state by way of contiguity condition: preceding non-root aggregates are a condition for succeeding non-root aggregates by way of contiguity condition; conformity is a condition for change-of-lineage (in brief); the base of neither-perception-nor-non-perception is a condition for the attainment of fruition by way of contiguity condition. (1)

Nahetu dhammo hetussa dhammassa anantarapaccayena paccayo…pe…. (2)

A non-root state is a condition for a root state by way of contiguity condition... etc. (2)

Nahetu dhammo hetussa ca nahetussa ca dhammassa anantarapaccayena paccayo (nahetumūlakaṃ tīṇipi ekasadisaṃ). (3)

A non-root state is a condition for a root state and for a non-root state by way of contiguity condition (the three sections rooted in non-root are similar). (3)

26. Hetū ca nahetū ca dhammā hetussa dhammassa anantarapaccayena paccayo – purimā purimā [V 3.0013] hetū ca sampayuttakā ca khandhā pacchimānaṃ pacchimānaṃ hetūnaṃ anantarapaccayena paccayo. (1)

26. Root and non-root states are a condition for a root state by way of contiguity condition: preceding roots and associated aggregates are a condition for succeeding roots by way of contiguity condition. (1)

Hetū ca nahetū ca dhammā nahetussa dhammassa anantarapaccayena paccayo – purimā purimā hetū ca sampayuttakā ca khandhā pacchimānaṃ pacchimānaṃ nahetūnaṃ khandhānaṃ anantarapaccayena paccayo. (2)

Root and non-root states are a condition for a non-root state by way of contiguity condition: preceding roots and associated aggregates are a condition for succeeding non-root aggregates by way of contiguity condition. (2)

Hetū ca nahetū ca dhammā hetussa ca nahetussa ca dhammassa anantarapaccayena paccayo – purimā purimā hetū ca sampayuttakā ca khandhā pacchimānaṃ pacchimānaṃ hetūnaṃ sampayuttakānañca khandhānaṃ anantarapaccayena paccayo. (3)

Both causal and non-causal states are a condition for both causal and non-causal states by way of the contiguity condition—the preceding causal roots and associated aggregates are a condition for the succeeding causal roots and associated aggregates by way of the contiguity condition. (3)

Samanantarapaccayādi

Immediacy Condition, etc.

27. Hetu dhammo hetussa dhammassa samanantarapaccayena paccayo (anantarasadisaṃ.)… Sahajātapaccayena paccayo… aññamaññapaccayena paccayo (ime dvepi paṭiccasadisā. Nissayapaccayo paccayavāre nissayapaccayasadiso.)

27. The causal state is a condition for the causal state by way of the immediacy condition (similar to contiguity)... by way of the co-nascence condition... by way of the mutuality condition (these two are similar to the dependent origination section; the support condition is similar to the support condition in the condition chapter).

Upanissayapaccayo

Decisive Support Condition

28. Hetu dhammo hetussa dhammassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇūpanissayo[T 3.0014], anantarūpanissayo, pakatūpanissayo…pe…. Pakatūpanissayo – hetū hetūnaṃ upanissayapaccayena paccayo. (1)

28. The causal state is a condition for the causal state by way of the decisive support condition: object decisive support, contiguity decisive support, natural decisive support, etc. Natural decisive support: causal roots are a condition for causal roots by way of the decisive support condition. (1)

Hetu dhammo nahetussa dhammassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇūpanissayo, anantarūpanissayo, pakatūpanissayo…pe…. Pakatūpanissayo – hetū nahetūnaṃ khandhānaṃ upanissayapaccayena paccayo. (2)

The causal state is a condition for the non-causal state by way of the decisive support condition: object decisive support, contiguity decisive support, natural decisive support, etc. Natural decisive support: causal roots are a condition for non-causal aggregates by way of the decisive support condition. (2)

Hetu [M 3.0012] dhammo hetussa ca nahetussa ca dhammassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇūpanissayo[V 3.0014], anantarūpanissayo, pakatūpanissayo…pe…. Pakatūpanissayo – hetū hetūnaṃ sampayuttakānañca khandhānaṃ upanissayapaccayena paccayo. (3)

The causal state is a condition for both causal and non-causal states by way of the decisive support condition: object decisive support, contiguity decisive support, natural decisive support, etc. Natural decisive support: causal roots are a condition for causal roots and for associated aggregates by way of the decisive support condition. (3)

29. Nahetu dhammo nahetussa dhammassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇūpanissayo, anantarūpanissayo, pakatūpanissayo…pe… pakatūpanissayo – saddhaṃ upanissāya dānaṃ deti…pe… samāpattiṃ uppādeti…pe… diṭṭhiṃ gaṇhāti; sīlaṃ…pe… senāsanaṃ upanissāya dānaṃ deti…pe… saṅghaṃ bhindati; saddhā…pe… senāsanaṃ saddhāya…pe… phalasamāpattiyā upanissayapaccayena paccayo. (1)

29. The non-causal state is a condition for the non-causal state by way of the decisive support condition: object decisive support, contiguity decisive support, natural decisive support, etc. Natural decisive support: relying on faith, one gives alms, etc., generates an attainment, etc., adopts a view; relying on virtue, etc., lodging, one gives alms, etc., splits the Saṅgha; faith, etc., lodging are conditions for faith, etc., fruition-attainment by way of the decisive support condition. (1)

Nahetu dhammo hetussa dhammassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇūpanissayo, anantarūpanissayo, pakatūpanissayo…pe… pakatūpanissayo – saddhaṃ…pe… senāsanaṃ upanissāya dānaṃ deti…pe… saṅghaṃ bhindati; saddhā…pe… senāsanaṃ saddhāya…pe… patthanāya maggassa phalasamāpattiyā upanissayapaccayena paccayo. (2)

The non-causal state is a condition for the causal state by way of the decisive support condition: object decisive support, contiguity decisive support, natural decisive support, etc. Natural decisive support: relying on faith, etc., lodging, one gives alms, etc., splits the Saṅgha; faith, etc., lodging are conditions for faith, etc., aspiration, the path, and fruition-attainment by way of the decisive support condition. (2)

Nahetu dhammo hetussa ca nahetussa ca dhammassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇūpanissayo[T 3.0015], anantarūpanissayo, pakatūpanissayo…pe… pakatūpanissayo (dutiyaupanissayasadisaṃ). (3)

The non-causal state is a condition for both a causal and a non-causal state by way of the decisive support condition: object decisive support, contiguity decisive support, natural decisive support, etc. Natural decisive support (similar to the second decisive support section). (3)

30. Hetū ca nahetū ca dhammā hetussa dhammassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇūpanissayo, anantarūpanissayo, pakatūpanissayo…pe…. Pakatūpanissayo – hetū ca sampayuttakā ca khandhā hetūnaṃ upanissayapaccayena paccayo. (1)

30. Both causal and non-causal states are a condition for the causal state by way of the decisive support condition: object decisive support, contiguity decisive support, natural decisive support, etc. Natural decisive support: causal roots and associated aggregates are a condition for causal roots by way of the decisive support condition. (1)

Hetū ca nahetū ca dhammā nahetussa dhammassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇūpanissayo, anantarūpanissayo, pakatūpanissayo…pe…. Pakatūpanissayo – hetū ca sampayuttakā ca khandhā nahetūnaṃ khandhānaṃ upanissayapaccayena paccayo. (2)

Both causal and non-causal states are a condition for the non-causal state by way of the decisive support condition: object decisive support, contiguity decisive support, natural decisive support, etc. Natural decisive support: causal roots and associated aggregates are a condition for non-causal aggregates by way of the decisive support condition. (2)

Hetū ca nahetū ca dhammā hetussa ca nahetussa ca dhammassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇūpanissayo, anantarūpanissayo, pakatūpanissayo [M 3.0013] …pe…. Pakatūpanissayo [V 3.0015] – hetū ca sampayuttakā ca khandhā hetūnañca sampayuttakānañca khandhānaṃ upanissayapaccayena paccayo. (3)

Both causal and non-causal states are a condition for both causal and non-causal states by way of the decisive support condition: object decisive support, contiguity decisive support, natural decisive support, etc. Natural decisive support: causal roots and associated aggregates are a condition for causal roots and associated aggregates by way of the decisive support condition. (3)

Purejātapaccayo

Prenascence Condition

31. Nahetu dhammo nahetussa dhammassa purejātapaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇapurejātaṃ, vatthupurejātaṃ. Ārammaṇapurejātaṃ – cakkhuṃ…pe… vatthuṃ aniccato…pe… domanassaṃ uppajjati; dibbena cakkhunā rūpaṃ passati, dibbāya sotadhātuyā saddaṃ suṇāti, rūpāyatanaṃ cakkhuviññāṇassa…pe… phoṭṭhabbāyatanaṃ kāyaviññāṇassa…pe…. Vatthupurejātaṃ – cakkhāyatanaṃ…pe… kāyāyatanaṃ…pe… [T 3.0016] vatthu nahetūnaṃ khandhānaṃ purejātapaccayena paccayo. (1)

31. A non-causal state is a condition for a non-causal state by way of the prenascence condition—object-prenascence, base-prenascence. Object-prenascence: the eye… etc.… the base as impermanent… etc.… grief arises; with the divine eye one sees forms, with the divine ear element one hears sounds; the form base is a condition for eye-consciousness… etc.… the tangible base is a condition for body-consciousness… etc. Base-prenascence: the eye base… etc.… the body base… etc.… the base is a condition for the non-causal aggregates by way of the prenascence condition. (1)

Nahetu dhammo hetussa dhammassa purejātapaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇapurejātaṃ, vatthupurejātaṃ. Ārammaṇapurejātaṃ – cakkhuṃ…pe… vatthuṃ aniccato…pe… domanassaṃ uppajjati; dibbena cakkhunā rūpaṃ passati, dibbāya sotadhātuyā saddaṃ suṇāti. Vatthupurejātaṃ – vatthu hetūnaṃ purejātapaccayena paccayo. (2)

A non-causal state is a condition for a causal state by way of the prenascence condition—object-prenascence, base-prenascence. Object-prenascence: the eye… etc.… the base as impermanent… etc.… grief arises; with the divine eye one sees forms, with the divine ear element one hears sounds. Base-prenascence: the base is a condition for the causal roots by way of the prenascence condition. (2)

Nahetu dhammo hetussa ca nahetussa ca dhammassa purejātapaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇapurejātaṃ, vatthupurejātaṃ. Ārammaṇapurejātaṃ – cakkhuṃ…pe… vatthuṃ aniccato…pe… domanassaṃ uppajjati. Vatthupurejātaṃ – vatthu hetūnaṃ sampayuttakānañca khandhānaṃ purejātapaccayena paccayo. (3)

A non-causal state is a condition for both a causal and a non-causal state by way of the prenascence condition—object-prenascence, base-prenascence. Object-prenascence: the eye… etc.… the base as impermanent… etc.… grief arises. Base-prenascence: the base is a condition for the causal roots and the associated aggregates by way of the prenascence condition. (3)

Pacchājātapaccayādi

Postnascence Condition, etc.

32. Hetu dhammo nahetussa dhammassa pacchājātapaccayena paccayo – pacchājātā hetū purejātassa imassa kāyassa pacchājātapaccayena paccayo. (1)

32. A causal state is a condition for a non-causal state by way of the postnascence condition—postnascent causal roots are a condition for this prenascent body by way of the postnascence condition. (1)

Nahetu dhammo nahetussa dhammassa pacchājātapaccayena paccayo – pacchājātā nahetū khandhā purejātassa imassa kāyassa pacchājātapaccayena paccayo. (1)

A non-causal state is a condition for a non-causal state by way of the postnascence condition—postnascent non-causal aggregates are a condition for this prenascent body by way of the postnascence condition. (1)

Hetū ca nahetū ca dhammā nahetussa dhammassa pacchājātapaccayena paccayo – pacchājātā hetū ca sampayuttakā ca khandhā purejātassa imassa kāyassa pacchājātapaccayena paccayo. (1)

Root and non-root phenomena are a condition for a non-root phenomenon by way of post-nascence condition—post-nascent roots and associated aggregates are a condition for this pre-nascent body by way of post-nascence condition. (1)

Hetu [M 3.0014][V 3.0016] dhammo hetussa dhammassa āsevanapaccayena paccayo (anantarasadisaṃ)[T 3.0017].

A root phenomenon is a condition for a root phenomenon by way of repetition condition (similar to the contiguity condition).

Kammapaccayo

Kamma Condition

33. Nahetu dhammo nahetussa dhammassa kammapaccayena paccayo – sahajātā, nānākkhaṇikā. Sahajātā – nahetu cetanā sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ kammapaccayena paccayo; paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe…. Nānākkhaṇikā – nahetu cetanā vipākānaṃ khandhānaṃ kaṭattā ca rūpānaṃ kammapaccayena paccayo. (1)

33. A non-root phenomenon is a condition for a non-root phenomenon by way of kamma condition—conascent, and different-moment. Conascent: non-root volition is a condition for the associated aggregates and mind-originated material phenomena by way of kamma condition; at the moment of rebirth-linking…etc. Different-moment: non-root volition is a condition for the resultant aggregates and kamma-produced material phenomena by way of kamma condition. (1)

Nahetu dhammo hetussa dhammassa kammapaccayena paccayo – sahajātā, nānākkhaṇikā. Sahajātā – nahetu cetanā sampayuttakānaṃ hetūnaṃ kammapaccayena paccayo; paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe…. Nānākkhaṇikā – nahetu cetanā vipākānaṃ hetūnaṃ kammapaccayena paccayo. (2)

A non-root phenomenon is a condition for a root phenomenon by way of kamma condition—conascent, and different-moment. Conascent: non-root volition is a condition for the associated roots by way of kamma condition; at the moment of rebirth-linking…etc. Different-moment: non-root volition is a condition for the resultant roots by way of kamma condition. (2)

Nahetu dhammo hetussa ca nahetussa ca dhammassa kammapaccayena paccayo – sahajātā, nānākkhaṇikā. Sahajātā – nahetu cetanā sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ hetūnaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ kammapaccayena paccayo; paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe…. Nānākkhaṇikā – nahetu cetanā vipākānaṃ khandhānaṃ hetūnaṃ kaṭattā ca rūpānaṃ kammapaccayena paccayo. (3)

A non-root phenomenon is a condition for both a root and a non-root phenomenon by way of kamma condition—conascent, and different-moment. Conascent: non-root volition is a condition for the associated aggregates, roots, and mind-originated material phenomena by way of kamma condition; at the moment of rebirth-linking…etc. Different-moment: non-root volition is a condition for the resultant aggregates, roots, and kamma-produced material phenomena by way of kamma condition. (3)

Vipākapaccayo

Resultance Condition

34. Hetu dhammo hetussa dhammassa vipākapaccayena paccayo – vipāko alobho adosassa amohassa vipākapaccayena paccayo (paṭiccavārasadisaṃ. Vipākavibhaṅge nava pañhā).

34. A root phenomenon is a condition for a root phenomenon by way of resultance condition—resultant non-greed is a condition for non-hatred and non-delusion by way of resultance condition. (Similar to the Paṭicca section. In the analysis of resultance, there are nine questions.)

Āhārapaccayo

Nutriment Condition

35. Nahetu dhammo nahetussa dhammassa āhārapaccayena paccayo – nahetū āhārā sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ āhārapaccayena paccayo; paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe… kabaḷīkāro āhāro imassa kāyassa [T 3.0018] āhārapaccayena paccayo. (1)

35. A non-root phenomenon is a condition for a non-root phenomenon by way of nutriment condition—non-root nutriments are a condition for the associated aggregates and mind-originated material phenomena by way of nutriment condition; at the moment of rebirth-linking…etc.…physical nutriment is a condition for this body by way of nutriment condition. (1)

Nahetu [V 3.0017] dhammo hetussa dhammassa āhārapaccayena paccayo – nahetū āhārā sampayuttakānaṃ hetūnaṃ āhārapaccayena paccayo; paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe…. (2)

A non-root phenomenon is a condition for a root phenomenon by way of nutriment condition—non-root nutriments are a condition for the associated roots by way of nutriment condition; at the moment of rebirth-linking…etc. (2)

Nahetu [M 3.0015] dhammo hetussa ca nahetussa ca dhammassa āhārapaccayena paccayo – nahetū āhārā sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ hetūnaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ āhārapaccayena paccayo; paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe…. (3)

A non-root phenomenon is a condition for both a root and a non-root phenomenon by way of nutriment condition—non-root nutriments are a condition for the associated aggregates, roots, and mind-originated material phenomena by way of nutriment condition; at the moment of rebirth-linking…etc. (3)

Indriyapaccayo

Faculty Condition

36. Hetu dhammo hetussa dhammassa indriyapaccayena paccayo…pe… (hetumūlake tīṇi).

36. A root phenomenon is a condition for a root phenomenon by way of faculty condition… and so on (three with root as foundation).

Nahetu dhammo nahetussa dhammassa indriyapaccayena paccayo – nahetū indriyā sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ indriyapaccayena paccayo; paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe… cakkhundriyaṃ cakkhuviññāṇassa…pe… kāyindriyaṃ kāyaviññāṇassa…pe… rūpajīvitindriyaṃ kaṭattārūpānaṃ indriyapaccayena paccayo (evaṃ indriyapaccayā vitthāretabbā. Nava).

A non-root phenomenon is a condition for a non-root phenomenon by way of faculty condition—non-root faculties are a condition for associated aggregates and for mind-originated material phenomena by way of faculty condition; at the moment of rebirth-linking… the eye faculty is a condition for eye-consciousness… the body faculty is a condition for body-consciousness… the material life faculty is a condition for kamma-produced material phenomena by way of faculty condition (thus the faculty condition should be elaborated. Nine).

Jhānapaccayādi

Jhāna Condition, etc.

37. Nahetu dhammo nahetussa dhammassa jhānapaccayena paccayo… tīṇi.

37. A non-root phenomenon is a condition for a non-root phenomenon by way of jhāna condition… three.

Hetu dhammo hetussa dhammassa maggapaccayena paccayo… sampayuttapaccayena paccayo. (Imesu dvīsu nava.)

A root phenomenon is a condition for a root phenomenon by way of path condition… by way of association condition. (In these two, nine.)

Vippayuttapaccayo

Dissociation Condition

38. Hetu dhammo nahetussa dhammassa vippayuttapaccayena paccayo – sahajātaṃ, pacchājātaṃ. Sahajātā – hetū cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ vippayuttapaccayena paccayo; paṭisandhikkhaṇe hetū kaṭattārūpānaṃ vippayuttapaccayena paccayo. Hetū vatthussa vippayuttapaccayena paccayo[T 3.0019]. Pacchājātā – hetū purejātassa imassa kāyassa vippayuttapaccayena paccayo. (1)

38. A root phenomenon is a condition for a non-root phenomenon by way of dissociation condition: conascence, postnascence. By conascence, roots are a condition for mind-originated material phenomena by way of dissociation condition; at the moment of rebirth-linking, roots are a condition for kamma-produced material phenomena by way of dissociation condition. Roots are a condition for the base by way of dissociation condition. By postnascence, roots are a condition for this pre-arisen body by way of dissociation condition. (1)

Nahetu [V 3.0018] dhammo nahetussa dhammassa vippayuttapaccayena paccayo – sahajātaṃ, purejātaṃ, pacchājātaṃ. Sahajātā – nahetū khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ vippayuttapaccayena paccayo; paṭisandhikkhaṇe nahetū khandhā kaṭattārūpānaṃ vippayuttapaccayena paccayo. Khandhā vatthussa…pe… vatthu khandhānaṃ vippayuttapaccayena paccayo. Purejātaṃ – cakkhāyatanaṃ cakkhuviññāṇassa…pe… kāyāyatanaṃ kāyaviññāṇassa, vatthu nahetūnaṃ khandhānaṃ vippayuttapaccayena paccayo[M 3.0016]. Pacchājātā – nahetū khandhā purejātassa imassa kāyassa vippayuttapaccayena paccayo. (1)

A non-root phenomenon is a condition for a non-root phenomenon by way of dissociation condition—conascence, prenascence, postnascence. By conascence, non-root aggregates are a condition for mind-originated material phenomena by way of dissociation condition; at the moment of rebirth-linking, non-root aggregates are a condition for kamma-produced material phenomena by way of dissociation condition. Aggregates are a condition for the base… and so on… the base is a condition for aggregates by way of dissociation condition. By prenascence, the eye base is a condition for eye-consciousness… and so on… the body base for body-consciousness, the base is a condition for non-root aggregates by way of dissociation condition. By postnascence, non-root aggregates are a condition for this pre-arisen body by way of dissociation condition. (1)

Nahetu dhammo hetussa dhammassa vippayuttapaccayena paccayo – sahajātaṃ, purejātaṃ. Sahajātaṃ – paṭisandhikkhaṇe vatthu hetūnaṃ vippayuttapaccayena paccayo. Purejātaṃ – vatthu hetūnaṃ vippayuttapaccayena paccayo. (2)

A non-root phenomenon is a condition for a root phenomenon by way of dissociation condition—conascence, prenascence. By conascence, at the moment of rebirth-linking, the base is a condition for roots by way of dissociation condition. By prenascence, the base is a condition for roots by way of dissociation condition. (2)

Nahetu dhammo hetussa ca nahetussa ca dhammassa vippayuttapaccayena paccayo – sahajātaṃ, purejātaṃ. Sahajātaṃ – paṭisandhikkhaṇe vatthu hetūnaṃ sampayuttakānañca khandhānaṃ vippayuttapaccayena paccayo. Purejātaṃ – vatthu hetūnaṃ sampayuttakānañca khandhānaṃ vippayuttapaccayena paccayo. (3)

A non-root phenomenon is a condition for both a root and a non-root phenomenon by way of dissociation condition—conascence, prenascence. By conascence, at the moment of rebirth-linking, the base is a condition for roots and associated aggregates by way of dissociation condition. By prenascence, the base is a condition for roots and associated aggregates by way of dissociation condition. (3)

Hetū ca nahetū ca dhammā nahetussa dhammassa vippayuttapaccayena paccayo – sahajātaṃ, pacchājātaṃ. Sahajātā – hetū ca sampayuttakā ca khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ vippayuttapaccayena paccayo; paṭisandhikkhaṇe hetū [T 3.0020] ca sampayuttakā ca khandhā kaṭattārūpānaṃ vippayuttapaccayena paccayo. Pacchājātā – hetū ca sampayuttakā ca khandhā purejātassa imassa kāyassa vippayuttapaccayena paccayo. (1)

Root and non-root states are a condition for a non-root state by way of dissociation condition—conascence, postnascence. By conascence, roots and associated aggregates are a condition for mind-originated material phenomena by way of dissociation condition; at the moment of rebirth-linking, roots and associated aggregates are a condition for kamma-produced material phenomena by way of dissociation condition. By postnascence, roots and associated aggregates are a condition for this pre-arisen body by way of dissociation condition. (1)

Atthipaccayādi

Presence condition, and so on.

39. Hetu dhammo hetussa dhammassa atthipaccayena paccayo – alobho adosassa amohassa atthipaccayena paccayo (cakkaṃ). Lobho mohassa atthipaccayena paccayo (cakkaṃ); paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe…. (1)

39. A root state is a condition for a root state by way of presence condition—non-greed is a condition for non-hatred and non-delusion by way of presence condition (as in the cycle). Greed is a condition for delusion by way of presence condition (as in the cycle); at the moment of rebirth-linking… and so on. (1)

Hetu dhammo nahetussa dhammassa atthipaccayena paccayo – sahajātaṃ, pacchājātaṃ. Sahajātā [V 3.0019] – hetū sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo; paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe…. Pacchājātā – hetū purejātassa imassa kāyassa atthipaccayena paccayo. (2)

A root state is a condition for a non-root state by way of presence condition—conascence, postnascence. By conascence, roots are a condition for associated aggregates and mind-originated material phenomena by way of presence condition; at the moment of rebirth-linking… and so on. By postnascence, roots are a condition for this pre-arisen body by way of presence condition. (2)

Hetu dhammo hetussa ca nahetussa ca dhammassa atthipaccayena paccayo – alobho adosassa amohassa sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo (cakkaṃ). Lobho mohassa sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo (cakkaṃ); paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe…. (3)

A root state is a condition for a root state and a non-root state by way of presence condition—non-greed is a condition for non-hatred, non-delusion, associated aggregates, and mind-originated material phenomena by way of presence condition (as in the cycle). Greed is a condition for delusion, associated aggregates, and mind-originated material phenomena by way of presence condition (as in the cycle); at the moment of rebirth-linking… and so on. (3)

40. Nahetu [M 3.0017] dhammo nahetussa dhammassa atthipaccayena paccayo – sahajātaṃ, purejātaṃ, pacchājātaṃ, āhāraṃ, indriyaṃ. Sahajāto – nahetu eko khandho tiṇṇannaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo…pe… dve khandhā…pe… paṭisandhikkhaṇe nahetu eko khandho [T 3.0021] tiṇṇannaṃ khandhānaṃ kaṭattā ca rūpānaṃ…pe… khandhā vatthussa atthipaccayena paccayo; vatthu khandhānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo; ekaṃ mahābhūtaṃ…pe… bāhiraṃ… āhārasamuṭṭhānaṃ… utusamuṭṭhānaṃ… asaññasattānaṃ…pe…. Purejātaṃ – cakkhuṃ…pe… vatthuṃ…pe… dibbena cakkhunā rūpaṃ passati, dibbāya sotadhātuyā saddaṃ suṇāti, rūpāyatanaṃ cakkhuviññāṇassa…pe… phoṭṭhabbāyatanaṃ kāyaviññāṇassa, cakkhāyatanaṃ cakkhuviññāṇassa…pe… kāyāyatanaṃ kāyaviññāṇassa, vatthu nahetūnaṃ khandhānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo. Pacchājātā – nahetū khandhā purejātassa imassa kāyassa atthipaccayena paccayo. Kabaḷīkāro āhāro imassa kāyassa atthipaccayena paccayo. Rūpajīvitindriyaṃ kaṭattārūpānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo. (1)

40. A non-root state is a condition for a non-root state by way of presence condition—conascence, prenascence, postnascence, nutriment, faculty. By conascence, one non-root aggregate is a condition for the other three aggregates and for mind-originated material phenomena by way of presence condition… and so on… two aggregates… and so on… at the moment of rebirth-linking, one non-root aggregate is a condition for the other three aggregates and for kamma-produced material phenomena… and so on… aggregates are a condition for the base by way of presence condition; the base is a condition for the aggregates by way of presence condition; one great element… and so on… external… nutriment-originated… temperature-originated… for non-percipient beings… and so on. By prenascence, the eye… and so on… the base… and so on… with the divine eye one sees a form, with the divine ear element one hears a sound, the form base is a condition for eye-consciousness… and so on… the tangible base for body-consciousness, the eye base for eye-consciousness… and so on… the body base for body-consciousness, the base is a condition for non-root aggregates by way of presence condition. By postnascence, non-root aggregates are a condition for this pre-arisen body by way of presence condition. Edible food is a condition for this body by way of presence condition. The material life faculty is a condition for kamma-produced material phenomena by way of presence condition. (1)

Nahetu dhammo hetussa dhammassa atthipaccayena paccayo – sahajātaṃ, purejātaṃ. Sahajātā – nahetū khandhā sampayuttakānaṃ hetūnaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo. Paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe… vatthu hetūnaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo. Purejātaṃ – cakkhuṃ…pe… vatthuṃ aniccato…pe… domanassaṃ uppajjati; dibbena cakkhunā rūpaṃ passati, dibbāya sotadhātuyā saddaṃ suṇāti; vatthu hetūnaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo. (2)

A non-root state is a condition for a root state by way of presence condition—conascence, prenascence. By conascence, non-root aggregates are a condition for associated roots by way of presence condition. At the moment of rebirth-linking… and so on… the base is a condition for roots by way of presence condition. By prenascence, the eye… and so on… the base as impermanent… and so on… sorrow arises; with the divine eye one sees a form, with the divine ear element one hears a sound; the base is a condition for roots by way of presence condition. (2)

Nahetu dhammo hetussa ca nahetussa ca dhammassa atthipaccayena paccayo – sahajātaṃ, purejātaṃ. Sahajāto – nahetu eko khandho tiṇṇannaṃ khandhānaṃ hetūnaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ [T 3.0022] atthipaccayena [V 3.0020] paccayo; paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe… vatthu hetūnaṃ sampayuttakānañca khandhānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo. Purejātaṃ – cakkhuṃ…pe… vatthuṃ aniccato…pe… domanassaṃ uppajjati; dibbena cakkhunā rūpaṃ passati, dibbāya sotadhātuyā saddaṃ suṇāti; vatthu hetūnaṃ sampayuttakānañca khandhānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo. (3)

A non-root state is a condition for a root state and a non-root state by way of presence condition—conascence, prenascence. By conascence, one non-root aggregate is a condition for the three aggregates, for the roots, and for mind-originated material phenomena by way of presence condition; at the moment of rebirth-linking… and so on… the base is a condition for the roots and for the associated aggregates by way of presence condition. By prenascence, the eye… and so on… the base as impermanent… and so on… sorrow arises; with the divine eye one sees a form, with the divine ear element one hears a sound; the base is a condition for the roots and for the associated aggregates by way of presence condition. (3)

41. Hetu ca nahetu ca dhammā hetussa dhammassa atthipaccayena paccayo – sahajātaṃ, purejātaṃ. Sahajāto – alobho ca sampayuttakā ca khandhā adosassa amohassa atthipaccayena paccayo (cakkaṃ)[M 3.0018]. Lobho ca sampayuttakā ca khandhā mohassa atthipaccayena paccayo (cakkaṃ); paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe… alobho ca vatthu ca adosassa amohassa atthipaccayena paccayo (cakkaṃ). (1)

41. Root and non-root states are a condition for a root state by way of presence condition—conascence, prenascence. By conascence, non-greed and associated aggregates are a condition for non-hatred and non-delusion by way of presence condition (as in the cycle). Greed and associated aggregates are a condition for delusion by way of presence condition (as in the cycle); at the moment of rebirth-linking… and so on… non-greed and the base are a condition for non-hatred and non-delusion by way of presence condition (as in the cycle). (1)

Hetu ca nahetu ca dhammā nahetussa dhammassa atthipaccayena paccayo – sahajātaṃ, pacchājātaṃ, āhāraṃ, indriyaṃ. Sahajāto – nahetu eko khandho ca hetū ca tiṇṇannaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo…pe… dve khandhā…pe… paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe… paṭisandhikkhaṇe hetū ca vatthu ca nahetūnaṃ khandhānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo. Sahajātā – hetū ca mahābhūtā ca cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo. Pacchājātā – hetū ca kabaḷīkāro āhāro ca imassa kāyassa atthipaccayena paccayo. Pacchājātā – hetū ca rūpajīvitindriyañca kaṭattārūpānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo. (2)

Root and non-root states are a condition for a non-root state by way of presence condition—conascence, postnascence, nutriment, faculty. By conascence, one non-root aggregate and the roots are a condition for the three aggregates and for mind-originated material phenomena by way of presence condition… and so on… two aggregates… and so on… at the moment of rebirth-linking… and so on… at the moment of rebirth-linking, the roots and the base are a condition for non-root aggregates by way of presence condition. By conascence, the roots and the great elements are a condition for mind-originated material phenomena by way of presence condition. By postnascence, the roots and edible food are a condition for this body by way of presence condition. By postnascence, the roots and the material life faculty are a condition for kamma-produced material phenomena by way of presence condition. (2)

Hetu ca nahetu ca dhammā hetussa [T 3.0023] ca nahetussa ca dhammassa atthipaccayena paccayo – sahajātaṃ, purejātaṃ. Sahajāto – nahetu eko khandho ca alobho ca tiṇṇannaṃ khandhānaṃ adosassa amohassa cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo (cakkaṃ). Nahetu eko khandho ca lobho ca tiṇṇannaṃ khandhānaṃ mohassa cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo (cakkaṃ); paṭisandhikkhaṇe nahetu eko khandho ca alobho ca (cakkaṃ). Paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe… alobho ca vatthu ca adosassa amohassa sampayuttakānañca khandhānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo, lobho ca vatthu ca mohassa sampayuttakānañca khandhānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo….

Root and non-root phenomena are a condition for a root phenomenon and for a non-root phenomenon by way of presence condition—conascence, prenascence. By conascence, one non-root aggregate and non-greed are a condition for the three aggregates, for non-hatred, for non-delusion, and for mind-originated material phenomena by way of presence condition (as in the cycle). One non-root aggregate and greed are a condition for the three aggregates, for delusion, and for mind-originated material phenomena by way of presence condition (as in the cycle); at the moment of rebirth-linking, one non-root aggregate and non-greed (as in the cycle). At the moment of rebirth-linking… and so on… non-greed and the base are a condition for non-hatred, for non-delusion, and for the associated aggregates by way of presence condition; greed and the base are a condition for delusion and for the associated aggregates by way of presence condition….

Natthipaccayena paccayo… vigatapaccayena paccayo… avigatapaccayena paccayo. (3)

by way of absence condition… by way of disappearance condition… by way of non-disappearance condition. (3)

By way of non-root condition: by way of object condition, nine; by way of predominance condition, nine; by way of proximity condition, nine; by way of immediate proximity condition, nine; by way of co-nascence condition, three; by way of mutuality condition, three; by way of dependence condition, three; by way of decisive support condition, nine; by way of pre-nascence condition, three; by way of post-nascence condition, three; by way of repetition condition, nine; by way of kamma condition, three; by way of result condition, three; by way of nutriment condition, three; by way of faculty condition, three; by way of jhāna condition, three; by way of path condition, three; by way of association condition, three; by way of dissociation condition, three; by way of presence condition, three; by way of absence condition, nine; by way of disappearance condition, nine; by way of non-disappearance condition, three (thus should it be reckoned).

49. Sahetukaṃ [T 3.0026][M 3.0021][V 3.0024] dhammaṃ paṭicca sahetuko dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – sahetukaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca tayo khandhā…pe… dve khandhe…pe… paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe…. (1)

49. A phenomenon with roots arises dependent on a phenomenon with roots by way of root condition—dependent on one aggregate with roots, three aggregates…pe… two aggregates…pe… at the moment of rebirth-linking…pe…. (1)

Sahetukaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca ahetuko dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – sahetuke khandhe paṭicca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ; paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe…. (2)

A rootless phenomenon arises dependent on a phenomenon with roots by way of root condition—dependent on the aggregates with roots, mind-produced materiality arises; at the moment of rebirth-linking…pe…. (2)

Sahetukaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca sahetuko ca ahetuko ca dhammā uppajjanti hetupaccayā – sahetukaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca tayo khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ…pe… dve khandhe…pe… paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe…. (3)

50. A rootless phenomenon arises dependent on a rootless phenomenon by way of root condition—dependent on delusion accompanied by doubt and restlessness, mind-produced materiality arises; dependent on one great element, three great elements…pe… dependent on the great elements, mind-produced materiality, kamma-born materiality, and derived materiality arise. (1)

Ahetukaṃ [V 3.0025] dhammaṃ paṭicca sahetuko dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – vicikicchāsahagataṃ uddhaccasahagataṃ mohaṃ paṭicca sampayuttakā khandhā; paṭisandhikkhaṇe vatthuṃ paṭicca sahetukā khandhā. (2)

A phenomenon with roots arises dependent on a rootless phenomenon by way of root condition—dependent on delusion accompanied by doubt and restlessness, associated aggregates arise; at the moment of rebirth-linking, dependent on the physical base, aggregates with roots arise. (2)

Ahetukaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca sahetuko ca ahetuko ca dhammā uppajjanti hetupaccayā – vicikicchāsahagataṃ uddhaccasahagataṃ mohaṃ paṭicca sampayuttakā khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ; paṭisandhikkhaṇe vatthuṃ paṭicca [T 3.0027] sahetukā khandhā, mahābhūte paṭicca kaṭattārūpaṃ. (3)

Phenomena with roots and without roots arise dependent on a phenomenon without roots by way of root condition—dependent on delusion accompanied by doubt and restlessness, the associated aggregates and mind-produced materiality arise; at the moment of rebirth-linking, dependent on the physical base, aggregates with roots arise; dependent on the great elements, kamma-born materiality arises. (3)

51. Sahetukañca ahetukañca dhammaṃ paṭicca sahetuko dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – vicikicchāsahagataṃ uddhaccasahagataṃ ekaṃ khandhañca mohañca paṭicca tayo khandhā…pe… dve khandhe…pe… paṭisandhikkhaṇe sahetukaṃ ekaṃ khandhañca vatthuñca paṭicca tayo khandhā…pe… dve khandhe…pe…. (1)

51. A phenomenon with roots arises dependent on a phenomenon with roots and a phenomenon without roots by way of root condition—dependent on one aggregate accompanied by doubt and restlessness, and on delusion, three aggregates…pe… two aggregates…pe…; at the moment of rebirth-linking, dependent on one aggregate with roots and the physical base, three aggregates…pe… two aggregates…pe…. A rootless phenomenon arises dependent on a phenomenon with roots and a phenomenon without roots by way of root condition—dependent on aggregates with roots and the great elements, mind-produced materiality arises; dependent on aggregates accompanied by doubt and restlessness, and on delusion, mind-produced materiality arises; at the moment of rebirth-linking…pe…. (2)

Sahetukañca ahetukañca dhammaṃ paṭicca sahetuko ca ahetuko ca dhammā uppajjanti hetupaccayā – vicikicchāsahagataṃ uddhaccasahagataṃ ekaṃ khandhañca mohañca paṭicca tayo khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ…pe… dve khandhe…pe… paṭisandhikkhaṇe sahetukaṃ ekaṃ khandhañca vatthuñca paṭicca tayo khandhā…pe… dve khandhe…pe… sahetuke khandhe ca mahābhūte ca paṭicca kaṭattārūpaṃ. (3)

Phenomena with roots and without roots arise dependent on a phenomenon with roots and a phenomenon without roots by way of root condition—dependent on one aggregate accompanied by doubt and restlessness, and on delusion, three aggregates and mind-produced materiality…pe… two aggregates…pe…; at the moment of rebirth-linking, dependent on one aggregate with roots and the physical base, three aggregates…pe… two aggregates…pe…; dependent on aggregates with roots and the great elements, kamma-born materiality arises. A phenomenon with roots arises dependent on a phenomenon with roots and a phenomenon without roots by way of object condition—dependent on one aggregate accompanied by doubt and restlessness, and on delusion, three aggregates…pe… two aggregates…pe…; at the moment of rebirth-linking, dependent on one aggregate with roots and the physical base, three aggregates…pe… two aggregates…pe….
