Sahetukaṃ [V 3.0027] dhammaṃ paṭicca sahetuko ca ahetuko ca dhammā uppajjanti adhipatipaccayā – sahetukaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca tayo khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ…pe… dve khandhe…pe…. (3)

Phenomena with roots and without roots arise dependent on a phenomenon with roots by way of dominance condition—dependent on one aggregate with roots, three aggregates and mind-produced materiality…pe… two aggregates…pe…. (3)

55. Ahetukaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca ahetuko dhammo uppajjati adhipatipaccayā – ekaṃ mahābhūtaṃ…pe… mahābhūte paṭicca [T 3.0029] cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ upādārūpaṃ. (1)

55. A rootless phenomenon arises dependent on a rootless phenomenon by way of dominance condition—dependent on one great element…pe… dependent on the great elements, mind-produced materiality and derived materiality arise. (1)

Sahetukañca ahetukañca dhammaṃ paṭicca ahetuko dhammo uppajjati adhipatipaccayā – sahetuke khandhe ca mahābhūte ca paṭicca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ. (1)

Conditioned by a rooted phenomenon and a rootless phenomenon, a rootless phenomenon arises by dominance condition. Conditioned by the rooted aggregates and the great elements, mind-originated materiality arises. (1)

Anantarapaccayādi

Proximity Condition, etc.

56. Sahetukaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca sahetuko dhammo uppajjati anantarapaccayā… samanantarapaccayā… sahajātapaccayā – sahetukaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca tayo khandhā…pe… paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe…. (1)

56. Conditioned by a rooted phenomenon, a rooted phenomenon arises by proximity condition, by contiguity condition, by co-nascence condition. Conditioned by one rooted aggregate, three aggregates, etc.; at the moment of rebirth-linking, etc. (1)

Sahetukaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca ahetuko dhammo uppajjati sahajātapaccayā – sahetuke khandhe paṭicca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ, vicikicchāsahagate uddhaccasahagate khandhe paṭicca vicikicchāsahagato uddhaccasahagato moho cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ; paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe…. (2)

Conditioned by a rooted phenomenon, a rootless phenomenon arises by co-nascence condition. Conditioned by rooted aggregates, mind-originated materiality arises; conditioned by aggregates accompanied by doubt and restlessness, delusion accompanied by doubt and restlessness and mind-originated materiality arise; at the moment of rebirth-linking, etc. (2)

Sahetukaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca sahetuko ca ahetuko ca dhammā uppajjanti sahajātapaccayā – sahetukaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca tayo khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ, dve khandhe…pe… vicikicchāsahagataṃ uddhaccasahagataṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca tayo khandhā moho ca cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ…pe… dve khandhe…pe… paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe…. (3)

Conditioned by a rooted phenomenon, both rooted and rootless phenomena arise by co-nascence condition. Conditioned by one rooted aggregate, three aggregates and mind-originated materiality; conditioned by two aggregates, etc.; conditioned by one aggregate accompanied by doubt and restlessness, three aggregates, delusion, and mind-originated materiality; conditioned by two aggregates, etc.; at the moment of rebirth-linking, etc. (3)

57. Ahetukaṃ [M 3.0024] dhammaṃ paṭicca ahetuko dhammo uppajjati sahajātapaccayā – ahetukaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca tayo khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ…pe… dve khandhe…pe… vicikicchāsahagataṃ uddhaccasahagataṃ mohaṃ paṭicca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ; paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe… khandhe [V 3.0028] paṭicca vatthu, vatthuṃ paṭicca khandhā; ekaṃ mahābhūtaṃ…pe… bāhiraṃ… āhārasamuṭṭhānaṃ… utusamuṭṭhānaṃ… asaññasattānaṃ [T 3.0030] ekaṃ mahābhūtaṃ…pe…. (1)

57. Conditioned by a rootless phenomenon, a rootless phenomenon arises by co-nascence condition. Conditioned by one rootless aggregate, three aggregates and mind-originated materiality; by two aggregates, etc.; conditioned by delusion accompanied by doubt and restlessness, mind-originated materiality arises; at the moment of rebirth-linking, etc.; conditioned by the aggregates, the physical base arises; conditioned by the physical base, the aggregates arise; conditioned by one great element, etc.; external materiality; nutriment-originated materiality; temperature-originated materiality; for non-percipient beings, conditioned by one great element, etc. (1)

Ahetukaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca sahetuko dhammo uppajjati sahajātapaccayā (ime pañca pañhā hetusadisā, ninnānaṃ). (2)

Conditioned by a rootless phenomenon, a rooted phenomenon arises by co-nascence condition. (These five questions are similar to the root condition, but with distinctions.) (2)

Aññamaññapaccayo

Mutual Condition

58. Sahetukaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca sahetuko dhammo uppajjati aññamaññapaccayā – sahetukaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca tayo khandhā…pe… paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe…. (1)

58. Conditioned by a rooted phenomenon, a rooted phenomenon arises by mutual condition. Conditioned by one rooted aggregate, three aggregates, etc.; at the moment of rebirth-linking, etc. (1)

Sahetukaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca ahetuko dhammo uppajjati aññamaññapaccayā – vicikicchāsahagate uddhaccasahagate khandhe paṭicca vicikicchāsahagato uddhaccasahagato moho; paṭisandhikkhaṇe sahetuke khandhe paṭicca vatthu. (2)

Conditioned by a rooted phenomenon, a rootless phenomenon arises by mutual condition. Conditioned by the aggregates accompanied by doubt and restlessness, the delusion accompanied by doubt and restlessness arises; at the moment of rebirth-linking, conditioned by the rooted aggregates, the physical base arises. (2)

Sahetukaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca sahetuko ca ahetuko ca dhammā uppajjanti aññamaññapaccayā – vicikicchāsahagataṃ uddhaccasahagataṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca tayo khandhā moho ca…pe… dve khandhe…pe… paṭisandhikkhaṇe sahetukaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca tayo khandhā vatthu ca…pe… dve khandhe…pe…. (3)

Conditioned by a rooted phenomenon, both rooted and rootless phenomena arise by mutual condition. Conditioned by one aggregate accompanied by doubt and restlessness, three aggregates and delusion arise, etc.; conditioned by two aggregates, etc. At the moment of rebirth-linking, conditioned by one rooted aggregate, three aggregates and the physical base arise, etc.; conditioned by two aggregates, etc. (3)

59. Ahetukaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca ahetuko dhammo uppajjati aññamaññapaccayā – ahetukaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca tayo khandhā…pe… dve khandhe…pe… paṭisandhikkhaṇe ahetukaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca tayo khandhā vatthu ca…pe… dve khandhe…pe… (saṃkhittaṃ, yāva asaññasattā). (1)

59. Conditioned by a rootless phenomenon, a rootless phenomenon arises by mutual condition. Conditioned by one rootless aggregate, three aggregates arise, etc.; conditioned by two aggregates, etc. At the moment of rebirth-linking, conditioned by one rootless aggregate, three aggregates and the physical base arise, etc.; conditioned by two aggregates, etc. (Abbreviated, up to non-percipient beings). (1)

Ahetukaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca sahetuko dhammo uppajjati aññamaññapaccayā – vicikicchāsahagataṃ uddhaccasahagataṃ mohaṃ paṭicca sampayuttakā khandhā; paṭisandhikkhaṇe vatthuṃ paṭicca sahetukā khandhā. (2)

Conditioned by a rootless phenomenon, a rooted phenomenon arises by mutual condition. Conditioned by the delusion accompanied by doubt and restlessness, the associated aggregates arise; at the moment of rebirth-linking, conditioned by the physical base, the rooted aggregates arise. (2)

Sahetukañca [V 3.0029] ahetukañca dhammaṃ paṭicca [T 3.0031] sahetuko dhammo uppajjati aññamaññapaccayā – vicikicchāsahagataṃ uddhaccasahagataṃ ekaṃ khandhañca mohañca paṭicca [M 3.0025] tayo khandhā…pe… dve khandhe…pe… paṭisandhikkhaṇe sahetukaṃ ekaṃ khandhañca vatthuñca paṭicca tayo khandhā…pe… dve khandhe…pe…. (1)

Conditioned by a rooted phenomenon and a rootless phenomenon, a rooted phenomenon arises by mutual condition. Conditioned by one aggregate accompanied by doubt and restlessness and delusion, three aggregates arise, etc.; conditioned by two aggregates, etc. At the moment of rebirth-linking, conditioned by one rooted aggregate and the physical base, three aggregates arise, etc.; conditioned by two aggregates, etc. (1)

Nissayapaccayādi

Dependence Condition, etc.

60. Sahetukaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca sahetuko dhammo uppajjati nissayapaccayā… upanissayapaccayā… purejātapaccayā… āsevanapaccayā… kammapaccayā… vipākapaccayā… āhārapaccayā… indriyapaccayā… jhānapaccayā… maggapaccayā… (jhānampi maggampi sahajātapaccayasadisā, bāhirā mahābhūtā natthi ) sampayuttapaccayā… vippayuttapaccayā… atthipaccayā… natthipaccayā… vigatapaccayā… avigatapaccayā.

60. Conditioned by a rooted phenomenon, a rooted phenomenon arises by dependence condition, by decisive support condition, by prenascence condition, by repetition condition, by kamma condition, by result condition, by nutriment condition, by faculty condition, by jhāna condition, by path condition (jhāna and path are similar to the co-nascence condition; external great elements are not present), by association condition, by dissociation condition, by presence condition, by absence condition, by disappearance condition, by non-disappearance condition.

1. Paccayānulomaṃ

1. The Progression of Conditions

2. Saṅkhyāvāro

2. Enumeration Chapter

Suddhaṃ

Pure

61. Hetuyā nava, ārammaṇe cha, adhipatiyā pañca, anantare cha, samanantare cha, sahajāte nava, aññamaññe cha, nissaye nava, upanissaye cha, purejāte cha, āsevane cha, kamme nava, vipāke nava, āhāre nava, indriye nava, jhāne nava, magge nava, sampayutte cha, vippayutte nava, atthiyā nava, natthiyā cha, vigate cha, avigate nava (evaṃ gaṇetabbaṃ).

61. By root condition, nine; by object condition, six; by dominance condition, five; by proximity condition, six; by contiguity condition, six; by co-nascence condition, nine; by mutual condition, six; by dependence condition, nine; by decisive support condition, six; by prenascence condition, six; by repetition condition, six; by kamma condition, nine; by result condition, nine; by nutriment condition, nine; by faculty condition, nine; by jhāna condition, nine; by path condition, nine; by association condition, six; by dissociation condition, nine; by presence condition, nine; by absence condition, six; by disappearance condition, six; by non-disappearance condition, nine (thus it should be counted).

Anulomaṃ.

Progression

2. Paccayapaccanīyaṃ

2. Conditions and their Negations

1. Vibhaṅgavāro

1. The Chapter on Differentiation

Nahetupaccayo

Non-Root Condition

62. Sahetukaṃ [V 3.0030] dhammaṃ paṭicca ahetuko dhammo uppajjati nahetupaccayā – vicikicchāsahagate uddhaccasahagate khandhe paṭicca vicikicchāsahagato [T 3.0032] uddhaccasahagato moho. (1)

62. Conditioned by a rooted phenomenon, a rootless phenomenon arises by non-root condition. Conditioned by the aggregates accompanied by doubt and restlessness, the delusion accompanied by doubt and restlessness arises. (1)

Ahetukaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca ahetuko dhammo uppajjati nahetupaccayā – ahetukaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca tayo khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ…pe… dve khandhe…pe… paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe…. (1) (Sabbaṃ yāva asaññasattā tāva kātabbaṃ.)

A rootless state conditions a rootless state by way of non-root condition—one rootless aggregate conditions three aggregates and mind-originated materiality… etc.; two aggregates… etc.; at the moment of relinking… etc. (1) (All should be done up to the non-percipient beings.)

Naārammaṇapaccayādi

Non-object condition, etc.

63. Sahetukaṃ [M 3.0026] dhammaṃ paṭicca ahetuko dhammo uppajjati naārammaṇapaccayā – sahetuke khandhe paṭicca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ; paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe…. (1)

63. A rooted state conditions a rootless state by way of non-object condition—rooted aggregates condition mind-originated materiality; at the moment of relinking… etc. (1)

Ahetukaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca ahetuko dhammo uppajjati naārammaṇapaccayā – ahetuke khandhe paṭicca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ, vicikicchāsahagataṃ uddhaccasahagataṃ mohaṃ paṭicca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ; paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe… khandhe paṭicca vatthu; ekaṃ mahābhūtaṃ…pe… asaññasattānaṃ ekaṃ…pe…. (1)

A rootless state conditions a rootless state by way of non-object condition—rootless aggregates condition mind-originated materiality; delusion accompanied by doubt and restlessness conditions mind-originated materiality; at the moment of relinking… etc.; aggregates condition the base; one great primary element… etc.; for the non-percipient beings, one… etc. (1)

Sahetukañca ahetukañca dhammaṃ paṭicca ahetuko dhammo uppajjati naārammaṇapaccayā – sahetuke khandhe ca mahābhūte ca paṭicca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ, vicikicchāsahagate uddhaccasahagate khandhe ca mohañca paṭicca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ; paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe…. (1)

A rooted state and a rootless state condition a rootless state by way of non-object condition—rooted aggregates and the great primary elements condition mind-originated materiality; the aggregates accompanied by doubt and restlessness, and delusion, condition mind-originated materiality; at the moment of relinking… etc. (1)

Sahetukaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca sahetuko dhammo uppajjati naadhipatipaccayā… (anulomasahajātasadisā) [V 3.0031] naanantarapaccayā… nasamanantarapaccayā… naaññamaññapaccayā… naupanissayapaccayā… napurejātapaccayā – arūpe sahetukaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ…pe… paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe…. (1)

A rooted state conditions a rooted state, not by way of non-dominance condition… (similar to the forward order of co-nascence) not by way of non-contiguity condition… not by way of non-immediate proximity condition… not by way of non-mutual condition… not by way of non-decisive support condition… not by way of non-prenascence condition—in the immaterial realm, one rooted aggregate… etc.; at the moment of relinking… etc. (1)

64. Sahetukaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca ahetuko dhammo uppajjati napurejātapaccayā – arūpe vicikicchāsahagate uddhaccasahagate khandhe paṭicca vicikicchāsahagato uddhaccasahagato moho, sahetuke khandhe paṭicca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ; paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe…. (2)

64. A rooted state conditions a rootless state, not by way of non-prenascence condition—in the immaterial realm, the aggregates accompanied by doubt and restlessness condition the delusion accompanied by doubt and restlessness; rooted aggregates condition mind-originated materiality; at the moment of relinking… etc. (2)

Sahetukaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca sahetuko ca ahetuko ca dhammā uppajjanti napurejātapaccayā – arūpe vicikicchāsahagataṃ uddhaccasahagataṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca tayo khandhā moho ca…pe… dve khandhe…pe… paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe…. (3)

A rooted state conditions rooted states and rootless states, not by way of non-prenascence condition—in the immaterial realm, one aggregate accompanied by doubt and restlessness conditions three aggregates and delusion… etc.; two aggregates… etc.; at the moment of relinking… etc. (3)

Ahetukaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca ahetuko dhammo uppajjati [T 3.0033] napurejātapaccayā – arūpe ahetukaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ…pe… dve khandhe…pe… ahetuke khandhe paṭicca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ, vicikicchāsahagataṃ uddhaccasahagataṃ mohaṃ paṭicca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ; paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe… (yāva asaññasattā tāva vitthāro). (1)

A rootless state conditions a rootless state, not by way of non-prenascence condition—in the immaterial realm, one rootless aggregate… etc.; two aggregates… etc.; rootless aggregates condition mind-originated materiality; delusion accompanied by doubt and restlessness conditions mind-originated materiality; at the moment of relinking… etc. (the detailed exposition extends up to the non-percipient beings). (1)

Ahetukaṃ [M 3.0027] dhammaṃ paṭicca sahetuko dhammo uppajjati napurejātapaccayā – arūpe vicikicchāsahagataṃ uddhaccasahagataṃ mohaṃ paṭicca sampayuttakā khandhā; paṭisandhikkhaṇe vatthuṃ paṭicca sahetukā khandhā. (2)

A rootless state conditions a rooted state, not by way of non-prenascence condition—in the immaterial realm, delusion accompanied by doubt and restlessness conditions the associated aggregates; at the moment of relinking, the base conditions the rooted aggregates. (2)

Ahetukaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca sahetuko ca ahetuko ca dhammā uppajjanti napurejātapaccayā – paṭisandhikkhaṇe vatthuṃ paṭicca sahetukā khandhā, mahābhūte paṭicca kaṭattārūpaṃ. (3)

A rootless state conditions rooted states and rootless states, not by way of non-prenascence condition—at the moment of relinking, the base conditions the rooted aggregates; the great primary elements condition kamma-originated materiality. (3)

65. Sahetukañca ahetukañca dhammaṃ paṭicca sahetuko dhammo uppajjati napurejātapaccayā – arūpe vicikicchāsahagataṃ uddhaccasahagataṃ ekaṃ khandhañca mohañca paṭicca tayo [V 3.0032] khandhā…pe… dve khandhe…pe… paṭisandhikkhaṇe sahetukaṃ ekaṃ khandhañca vatthuñca paṭicca tayo khandhā…pe… dve [T 3.0034] khandhe…pe…. (1)

65. A rooted state and a rootless state condition a rooted state, not by way of non-prenascence condition—in the immaterial realm, one aggregate accompanied by doubt and restlessness and delusion condition three aggregates… etc.; two aggregates… etc.; at the moment of relinking, one rooted aggregate and the base condition three aggregates… etc.; two aggregates… etc. (1)

Sahetukañca ahetukañca dhammaṃ paṭicca ahetuko dhammo uppajjati napurejātapaccayā – sahetuke khandhe ca mahābhūte ca paṭicca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ, vicikicchāsahagate uddhaccasahagate khandhe ca mohañca paṭicca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ; paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe…. (2)

A rooted state and a rootless state condition a rootless state, not by way of non-prenascence condition—rooted aggregates and the great primary elements condition mind-originated materiality; the aggregates accompanied by doubt and restlessness, and delusion, condition mind-originated materiality; at the moment of relinking… etc. (2)

Sahetukañca ahetukañca dhammaṃ paṭicca sahetuko ca ahetuko ca dhammā uppajjanti napurejātapaccayā – paṭisandhikkhaṇe sahetukaṃ ekaṃ khandhañca vatthuñca paṭicca tayo khandhā…pe… dve khandhe…pe… sahetuke khandhe ca mahābhūte ca paṭicca kaṭattārūpaṃ. (3)

A rooted state and a rootless state condition rooted states and rootless states, not by way of non-prenascence condition—at the moment of relinking, one rooted aggregate and the base condition three aggregates… etc.; two aggregates… etc.; rooted aggregates and the great primary elements condition kamma-originated materiality. (3)

Napacchājātapaccayādi

Not by way of postnascence condition, etc.

66. Sahetukaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca sahetuko dhammo uppajjati napacchājātapaccayā… naāsevanapaccayā… nakammapaccayā – sahetuke khandhe paṭicca sahetukā cetanā. (1)

66. Dependent on a rooted state, a rooted state arises not by way of postnascence condition… not by way of repetition condition… not by way of kamma condition—dependent on rooted aggregates, rooted volition arises. (1)

Ahetukaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca ahetuko dhammo uppajjati nakammapaccayā – ahetuke khandhe paṭicca ahetukā cetanā… bāhiraṃ… āhārasamuṭṭhānaṃ… utusamuṭṭhānaṃ…pe…. (1)

Dependent on a rootless state, a rootless state arises not by way of kamma condition—dependent on rootless aggregates, rootless volition arises… external… nutriment-originated… temperature-originated… etc. (1)

Ahetukaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca sahetuko dhammo uppajjati nakammapaccayā – vicikicchāsahagataṃ uddhaccasahagataṃ mohaṃ paṭicca sampayuttakā cetanā. (2)

Dependent on a rootless state, a rooted state arises not by way of kamma condition—dependent on delusion accompanied by doubt and restlessness, associated volition arises. (2)

Sahetukañca [M 3.0028] ahetukañca dhammaṃ paṭicca sahetuko dhammo uppajjati nakammapaccayā – vicikicchāsahagate uddhaccasahagate khandhe ca mohañca paṭicca sampayuttakā cetanā… navipākapaccayā (paṭisandhi natthi).

Dependent on a rooted state and a rootless state, a rooted state arises not by way of kamma condition—dependent on the aggregates accompanied by doubt and restlessness and on delusion, associated volition arises… not by way of result condition (there is no relinking).

Naāhārapaccayādi

Not by way of nutriment condition, etc.

67. Ahetukaṃ [T 3.0035][V 3.0033] dhammaṃ paṭicca ahetuko dhammo uppajjati naāhārapaccayā… naindriyapaccayā… najhānapaccayā… namaggapaccayā… nasampayuttapaccayā.

67. Dependent on a rootless state, a rootless state arises not by way of nutriment condition… not by way of faculty condition… not by way of jhāna condition… not by way of path condition… not by way of association condition.

Navippayuttapaccayādi

Not by way of dissociation condition, etc.

68. Sahetukaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca sahetuko dhammo uppajjati navippayuttapaccayā – arūpe sahetukaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ…pe…. (1)

68. Dependent on a rooted phenomenon, a rooted phenomenon arises not by way of dissociation condition—in the immaterial sphere, one rooted aggregate … and so on. (1)

Sahetukaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca ahetuko dhammo uppajjati navippayuttapaccayā – arūpe vicikicchāsahagate uddhaccasahagate khandhe paṭicca vicikicchāsahagato uddhaccasahagato moho. (2)

Dependent on a rooted phenomenon, a rootless phenomenon arises not by way of dissociation condition—in the immaterial sphere, dependent on aggregates accompanied by doubt and restlessness, delusion accompanied by doubt and restlessness arises. (2)

Sahetukaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca sahetuko ca ahetuko ca dhammā uppajjanti navippayuttapaccayā – arūpe vicikicchāsahagataṃ uddhaccasahagataṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca tayo khandhā moho ca…pe… dve khandhe…pe…. (3)

Dependent on a rooted phenomenon, a rooted phenomenon and a rootless phenomenon arise not by way of dissociation condition—in the immaterial sphere, dependent on one aggregate accompanied by doubt and restlessness, three aggregates and delusion arise … and so on … two aggregates … and so on. (3)

Ahetukaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca ahetuko dhammo uppajjati navippayuttapaccayā – arūpe ahetukaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca tayo khandhā, dve khandhe…pe…. (1)

Dependent on a rootless phenomenon, a rootless phenomenon arises not by way of dissociation condition—in the immaterial sphere, dependent on one rootless aggregate, three aggregates arise, two aggregates … and so on. (1)

Ahetukaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca sahetuko dhammo uppajjati navippayuttapaccayā – arūpe vicikicchāsahagataṃ uddhaccasahagataṃ mohaṃ paṭicca sampayuttakā khandhā. (2)

Dependent on a rootless phenomenon, a rooted phenomenon arises not by way of dissociation condition—in the immaterial sphere, dependent on delusion accompanied by doubt and restlessness, associated aggregates arise. (2)

Sahetukañca ahetukañca dhammaṃ paṭicca sahetuko dhammo uppajjati navippayuttapaccayā – arūpe vicikicchāsahagataṃ uddhaccasahagataṃ ekaṃ khandhañca mohañca paṭicca tayo khandhā…pe… dve khandhe…pe… nonatthipaccayā… novigatapaccayā. (1)

Dependent on a rooted phenomenon and a rootless phenomenon, a rooted phenomenon arises not by way of dissociation condition—in the immaterial sphere, dependent on one aggregate accompanied by doubt and restlessness and on delusion, three aggregates arise … and so on … two aggregates … and so on … not by way of absence condition … not by way of disappearance condition. (1)

69. Not by root condition, two; not by object condition, three; not by dominance condition, nine; not by contiguity condition, three; not by immediate contiguity condition, three; not by mutuality condition, three; not by decisive support condition, three; not by prenascence condition, nine; not by postnascence condition, nine; not by repetition condition, nine; not by kamma condition, four; not by result condition, nine; not by nutriment condition, one; not by faculty condition, one; not by jhāna condition, one; not by path condition, one; not by association condition, three; not by dissociation condition, six; not by absence condition, three; not by disappearance condition, three (thus it should be counted).

Root Condition

72. Sahetukaṃ [M 3.0030] dhammaṃ paccayā sahetuko dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā (sahetukamūlakaṃ paṭiccavārasadisaṃ).

72. A rooted phenomenon is a condition for a rooted phenomenon to arise by way of root condition (the rooted-base is similar to the Dependence Section).

Ahetukaṃ dhammaṃ paccayā ahetuko [T 3.0037] dhammo…pe… (paṭiccavārasadisaṃyeva). (1)

A rootless phenomenon is a condition for a rootless phenomenon … and so on … (just like the Dependence Section). (1)

Ahetukaṃ [V 3.0036] dhammaṃ paccayā sahetuko dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – vatthuṃ paccayā sahetukā khandhā, vicikicchāsahagataṃ uddhaccasahagataṃ mohaṃ paccayā sampayuttakā khandhā; paṭisandhikkhaṇe vatthuṃ paccayā sahetukā khandhā. (2)

A rootless phenomenon is a condition for a rooted phenomenon to arise by way of root condition—the physical basis is a condition for the rooted aggregates; delusion accompanied by doubt and restlessness is a condition for the associated aggregates; at the moment of rebirth-linking, the physical basis is a condition for the rooted aggregates. (2)

Ahetukaṃ dhammaṃ paccayā sahetuko ca ahetuko ca dhammā uppajjanti hetupaccayā – vatthuṃ paccayā sahetukā khandhā, mahābhūte paccayā cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ, vicikicchāsahagataṃ uddhaccasahagataṃ mohaṃ paccayā sampayuttakā khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ; paṭisandhikkhaṇe vatthuṃ…pe…. (3)

A rootless phenomenon is a condition for a rooted phenomenon and a rootless phenomenon to arise by way of root condition—the physical basis is a condition for the rooted aggregates; the great primary elements are a condition for consciousness-originated matter; delusion accompanied by doubt and restlessness is a condition for the associated aggregates and consciousness-originated matter; at the moment of rebirth-linking, the physical basis … and so on. (3)

73. Sahetukañca ahetukañca dhammaṃ paccayā sahetuko dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – sahetukaṃ ekaṃ khandhañca vatthuñca paccayā tayo khandhā…pe… dve khandhe…pe… vicikicchāsahagataṃ uddhaccasahagataṃ ekaṃ khandhañca mohañca paccayā tayo khandhā…pe… dve khandhe…pe… paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe…. (1)

73. A rooted phenomenon and a rootless phenomenon are a condition for a rooted phenomenon to arise by way of root condition—one rooted aggregate and the physical basis are a condition for three aggregates … and so on … two aggregates … and so on; one aggregate accompanied by doubt and restlessness and delusion are a condition for three aggregates … and so on … two aggregates … and so on; at the moment of rebirth-linking … and so on. (1)

Sahetukañca ahetukañca dhammaṃ paccayā ahetuko dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – sahetuke khandhe ca mahābhūte ca paccayā cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ, vicikicchāsahagate uddhaccasahagate khandhe ca mohañca paccayā cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ; paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe…. (2)

A rooted phenomenon and a rootless phenomenon are a condition for a rootless phenomenon to arise by way of root condition—rooted aggregates and the great primary elements are a condition for consciousness-originated matter; aggregates accompanied by doubt and restlessness and delusion are a condition for consciousness-originated matter; at the moment of rebirth-linking … and so on. (2)

Sahetukañca ahetukañca dhammaṃ paccayā sahetuko ca ahetuko ca dhammā uppajjanti hetupaccayā – sahetukaṃ ekaṃ khandhañca vatthuñca paccayā tayo khandhā…pe… dve khandhe…pe… sahetuke khandhe ca mahābhūte ca paccayā cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ, vicikicchāsahagataṃ uddhaccasahagataṃ ekaṃ khandhañca mohañca [M 3.0031] paccayā tayo [T 3.0038] khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ…pe… dve khandhe…pe… paṭisandhikkhaṇe sahetukaṃ ekaṃ khandhañca vatthuñca paccayā tayo khandhā…pe… dve khandhe…pe… sahetuke khandhe ca mahābhūte ca paccayā kaṭattārūpaṃ. (3)

A rooted phenomenon and a rootless phenomenon are a condition for a rooted phenomenon and a rootless phenomenon to arise by way of root condition—one rooted aggregate and the physical basis are a condition for three aggregates … and so on … two aggregates … and so on; rooted aggregates and the great primary elements are a condition for consciousness-originated matter; one aggregate accompanied by doubt and restlessness and delusion are a condition for three aggregates and consciousness-originated matter … and so on … two aggregates … and so on; at the moment of rebirth-linking, one rooted aggregate and the physical basis are a condition for three aggregates … and so on … two aggregates … and so on; rooted aggregates and the great primary elements are a condition for kamma-born matter. (3)

Ārammaṇapaccayo

Object Condition

74. Sahetukaṃ [V 3.0037] dhammaṃ paccayā sahetuko dhammo uppajjati ārammaṇapaccayā – sahetukaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paccayā tayo khandhā…pe… paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe…. (1)

74. A rooted phenomenon is a condition for a rooted phenomenon to arise by way of object condition—one rooted aggregate is a condition for three aggregates…pe… at the moment of rebirth-linking…pe…. (1)

Sahetukaṃ dhammaṃ paccayā ahetuko dhammo uppajjati ārammaṇapaccayā – vicikicchāsahagate uddhaccasahagate khandhe paccayā vicikicchāsahagato uddhaccasahagato moho. (2)

A rooted phenomenon is a condition for a rootless phenomenon to arise by way of object condition—aggregates associated with doubt and restlessness are a condition for delusion associated with doubt and restlessness. (2)

Sahetukaṃ dhammaṃ paccayā sahetuko ca ahetuko ca dhammā uppajjanti ārammaṇapaccayā – vicikicchāsahagataṃ uddhaccasahagataṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paccayā tayo khandhā moho ca…pe… dve khandhe…pe…. (3)

A rooted phenomenon is a condition for rooted and rootless phenomena to arise by way of object condition—one aggregate associated with doubt and restlessness is a condition for three aggregates and delusion…pe… two aggregates…pe…. (3)

75. Ahetukaṃ dhammaṃ paccayā ahetuko dhammo uppajjati ārammaṇapaccayā – ahetukaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ…pe… dve khandhe…pe… paṭisandhikkhaṇe vatthuṃ paccayā khandhā, cakkhāyatanaṃ paccayā cakkhuviññāṇaṃ…pe… kāyāyatanaṃ paccayā kāyaviññāṇaṃ, vatthuṃ paccayā ahetukā khandhā. (1)

75. A rootless phenomenon is a condition for a rootless phenomenon to arise by way of object condition—one rootless aggregate…pe… two aggregates…pe… at the moment of rebirth-linking, the base is a condition for the aggregates, the eye-base is a condition for eye-consciousness…pe… the body-base is a condition for body-consciousness, the base is a condition for the rootless aggregates. (1)

Ahetukaṃ dhammaṃ paccayā sahetuko dhammo uppajjati ārammaṇapaccayā – vatthuṃ paccayā sahetukā khandhā, vicikicchāsahagataṃ uddhaccasahagataṃ mohaṃ paccayā sampayuttakā khandhā; paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe…. (2)

A rootless phenomenon is a condition for a rooted phenomenon to arise by way of object condition—the base is a condition for the rooted aggregates; delusion associated with doubt and restlessness is a condition for the associated aggregates; at the moment of rebirth-linking…pe…. (2)

Ahetukaṃ dhammaṃ paccayā sahetuko ca ahetuko ca dhammā uppajjanti ārammaṇapaccayā – vatthuṃ paccayā vicikicchāsahagatā uddhaccasahagatā khandhā moho ca. (3)

A rootless phenomenon is a condition for rooted and rootless phenomena to arise by way of object condition—the base is a condition for the aggregates associated with doubt and restlessness, and delusion. (3)

76. Sahetukañca ahetukañca dhammaṃ [T 3.0039] paccayā sahetuko dhammo uppajjati ārammaṇapaccayā – sahetukaṃ ekaṃ khandhañca vatthuñca paccayā tayo khandhā…pe… vicikicchāsahagataṃ uddhaccasahagataṃ ekaṃ khandhañca mohañca paccayā tayo khandhā…pe… dve khandhe…pe… paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe…. (1)

76. A rooted phenomenon and a rootless phenomenon are a condition for a rooted phenomenon to arise by way of object condition—one rooted aggregate and the base are a condition for three aggregates…pe… one aggregate associated with doubt and restlessness and delusion are a condition for three aggregates…pe… two aggregates…pe… at the moment of rebirth-linking…pe…. (1)

Sahetukañca [M 3.0032][V 3.0038] ahetukañca dhammaṃ paccayā ahetuko dhammo uppajjati ārammaṇapaccayā – vicikicchāsahagate uddhaccasahagate khandhe ca vatthuñca paccayā vicikicchāsahagato uddhaccasahagato moho. (2)

A rooted phenomenon and a rootless phenomenon are a condition for a rootless phenomenon to arise by way of object condition—aggregates associated with doubt and restlessness and the base are a condition for delusion associated with doubt and restlessness. (2)

Sahetukañca ahetukañca dhammaṃ paccayā sahetuko ca ahetuko ca dhammā uppajjanti ārammaṇapaccayā – vicikicchāsahagataṃ uddhaccasahagataṃ ekaṃ khandhañca vatthuñca paccayā tayo khandhā moho ca…pe… dve khandhe…pe…. (3)

A rooted phenomenon and a rootless phenomenon are a condition for rooted and rootless phenomena to arise by way of object condition—one aggregate associated with doubt and restlessness and the base are a condition for three aggregates and delusion…pe… two aggregates…pe…. (3)

A rootless phenomenon is a condition for a rootless phenomenon to arise by way of conascence condition—one rootless aggregate is a condition for three aggregates and consciousness-originated matter…pe… two aggregates…pe… at the moment of rebirth-linking…pe… (up to non-percipient beings), the eye-base is a condition for eye-consciousness…pe… the body-base is a condition for body-consciousness, the base is a condition for the rootless aggregates. (1)

Ahetukaṃ [T 3.0040] dhammaṃ paccayā sahetuko dhammo uppajjati sahajātapaccayā – vatthuṃ paccayā sahetukā khandhā, vicikicchāsahagataṃ uddhaccasahagataṃ mohaṃ paccayā sampayuttakā khandhā; paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe…. (2)

A rootless phenomenon is a condition for a rooted phenomenon to arise by way of conascence condition—the base is a condition for the rooted aggregates; delusion associated with doubt and restlessness is a condition for the associated aggregates; at the moment of rebirth-linking…pe…. (2)

Ahetukaṃ dhammaṃ paccayā sahetuko ca ahetuko ca dhammā uppajjanti sahajātapaccayā – vatthuṃ paccayā sahetukā khandhā, mahābhūte paccayā cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ, vicikicchāsahagataṃ uddhaccasahagataṃ [V 3.0039] mohaṃ paccayā sampayuttakā khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ; paṭisandhikkhaṇe vatthuṃ…pe…. (3)

A rootless phenomenon is a condition for rooted and rootless phenomena to arise by way of conascence condition—the base is a condition for the rooted aggregates; the great primary elements are a condition for consciousness-originated matter; delusion associated with doubt and restlessness is a condition for the associated aggregates and consciousness-originated matter; at the moment of rebirth-linking, the base…pe…. (3)

79. Sahetukañca [M 3.0033] ahetukañca dhammaṃ paccayā sahetuko dhammo uppajjati sahajātapaccayā – sahetukaṃ ekaṃ khandhañca vatthuñca paccayā tayo khandhā…pe… dve khandhe…pe… vicikicchāsahagataṃ uddhaccasahagataṃ ekaṃ khandhañca mohañca paccayā tayo khandhā…pe… dve khandhe…pe… paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe…. (1)

79. A rooted phenomenon and a rootless phenomenon are a condition for a rooted phenomenon to arise by way of conascence condition—one rooted aggregate and the base are a condition for three aggregates…pe… two aggregates…pe… one aggregate associated with doubt and restlessness and delusion are a condition for three aggregates…pe… two aggregates…pe… at the moment of rebirth-linking…pe…. (1)

Sahetukañca ahetukañca dhammaṃ paccayā ahetuko dhammo uppajjati sahajātapaccayā – sahetuke khandhe ca mahābhūte ca paccayā cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ, vicikicchāsahagate uddhaccasahagate khandhe ca mohañca paccayā cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ; paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe… vicikicchāsahagate uddhaccasahagate khandhe ca vatthuñca paccayā vicikicchāsahagato uddhaccasahagato moho. (2)

A rooted and a rootless phenomenon are a condition for a rootless phenomenon by way of conascence condition: rooted aggregates and the great elements are a condition for mind-originated matter; aggregates associated with doubt and restlessness and delusion are a condition for mind-originated matter; at the moment of rebirth-linking…pe… aggregates associated with doubt and restlessness and the base are a condition for delusion associated with doubt and restlessness. (2)

Sahetukañca ahetukañca dhammaṃ paccayā sahetuko ca ahetuko ca dhammā uppajjanti sahajātapaccayā – sahetukaṃ ekaṃ khandhañca vatthuñca paccayā tayo khandhā…pe… dve khandhe…pe… sahetuke khandhe ca mahābhūte ca paccayā cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ, vicikicchāsahagataṃ uddhaccasahagataṃ ekaṃ khandhañca [T 3.0041] vatthuñca paccayā tayo khandhā…pe… dve khandhe…pe… sahetuke khandhe ca mahābhūte ca paccayā cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ. Vicikicchāsahagataṃ uddhaccasahagataṃ ekaṃ khandhañca mohañca paccayā tayo khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ…pe… dve khandhe…pe… vicikicchāsahagataṃ uddhaccasahagataṃ ekaṃ khandhañca vatthuñca paccayā tayo khandhā moho ca…pe… paṭisandhikkhaṇe sahetukaṃ ekaṃ khandhañca vatthuñca paccayā tayo khandhā…pe… dve khandhe…pe… sahetuke khandhe ca mahābhūte ca paccayā kaṭattārūpaṃ. (3)

A rooted and a rootless phenomenon are a condition for rooted and rootless phenomena by way of conascence condition: one rooted aggregate and the base are a condition for three aggregates…pe… two aggregates…pe…; rooted aggregates and the great elements are a condition for mind-originated matter; one aggregate associated with doubt and restlessness and the base are a condition for three aggregates…pe… two aggregates…pe…; rooted aggregates and the great elements are a condition for mind-originated matter. One aggregate associated with doubt and restlessness and delusion are a condition for three aggregates and mind-originated matter…pe… two aggregates…pe…; one aggregate associated with doubt and restlessness and the base are a condition for three aggregates and delusion…pe… At the moment of rebirth-linking, one rooted aggregate and the base are a condition for three aggregates…pe… two aggregates…pe…; rooted aggregates and the great elements are a condition for kamma-born matter. 84. Hetupaccayā naārammaṇe tīṇi, naadhipatiyā nava, naanantare tīṇi, nasamanantare tīṇi, naaññamaññe tīṇi, naupanissaye tīṇi, napurejāte [M 3.0035] nava, napacchājāte nava, naāsevane nava, nakamme tīṇi, navipāke nava, nasampayutte tīṇi, navippayutte tīṇi, nonatthiyā tīṇi, novigate tīṇi (evaṃ gaṇetabbaṃ).

84. By root condition, and not by object condition, three; not by dominance condition, nine; not by proximity condition, three; not by contiguity condition, three; not by mutuality condition, three; not by decisive support condition, three; not by prenascence condition, nine; not by postnascence condition, nine; not by repetition condition, nine; not by kamma condition, three; not by result condition, nine; not by association condition, three; not by dissociation condition, three; not by disappearance condition, three; not by disappearance condition, three (thus it should be reckoned).

Anulomapaccanīyaṃ.

85. Not by root condition, but by object condition, three; by proximity condition, three … by path condition, three; by association condition, three … by non-disappearance condition, three (thus it should be reckoned).

86. Sahetukaṃ [T 3.0043] dhammaṃ saṃsaṭṭho sahetuko dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – sahetukaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ saṃsaṭṭhā tayo khandhā…pe… dve khandhe…pe… paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe…. (1)

86. Associated with a rooted phenomenon, a rooted phenomenon arises by way of root condition: associated with one rooted aggregate, three aggregates arise… two aggregates… at the moment of rebirth-linking… (1)

Ahetukaṃ dhammaṃ saṃsaṭṭho sahetuko dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – vicikicchāsahagataṃ uddhaccasahagataṃ mohaṃ saṃsaṭṭhā vicikicchāsahagatā uddhaccasahagatā khandhā. (1)

Associated with a rootless phenomenon, a rooted phenomenon arises by way of root condition: associated with delusion accompanied by doubt and restlessness, the aggregates accompanied by doubt and restlessness arise. (1)

Sahetukañca ahetukañca dhammaṃ saṃsaṭṭho sahetuko dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – vicikicchāsahagataṃ uddhaccasahagataṃ ekaṃ khandhañca mohañca saṃsaṭṭhā tayo khandhā…pe… dve khandhe…pe…. (1)

Associated with a rooted and a rootless phenomenon, a rooted phenomenon arises by way of root condition: associated with one aggregate accompanied by doubt and restlessness and with delusion, three aggregates arise… two aggregates… (1)

Ārammaṇapaccayo

Object Condition

87. Sahetukaṃ [M 3.0036][V 3.0043] dhammaṃ saṃsaṭṭho sahetuko dhammo uppajjati ārammaṇapaccayā – sahetukaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ saṃsaṭṭhā tayo khandhā…pe… dve khandhe…pe… paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe…. (1)

87. Associated with a rooted phenomenon, a rooted phenomenon arises by way of object condition: associated with one rooted aggregate, three aggregates arise… two aggregates… at the moment of rebirth-linking… (1)

Sahetukaṃ dhammaṃ saṃsaṭṭho ahetuko dhammo uppajjati ārammaṇapaccayā – vicikicchāsahagate uddhaccasahagate khandhe saṃsaṭṭho vicikicchāsahagato uddhaccasahagato moho. (2)

Associated with a rooted phenomenon, a rootless phenomenon arises by way of object condition: associated with the aggregates accompanied by doubt and restlessness, delusion accompanied by doubt and restlessness arises. (2)

Sahetukaṃ dhammaṃ saṃsaṭṭho sahetuko ca ahetuko ca dhammā uppajjanti ārammaṇapaccayā – vicikicchāsahagataṃ uddhaccasahagataṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ saṃsaṭṭhā tayo khandhā moho ca…pe… dve khandhe…pe…. (3)

Associated with a rooted phenomenon, rooted and rootless phenomena arise by way of object condition: associated with one aggregate accompanied by doubt and restlessness, three aggregates and delusion arise… two aggregates… (3)

88. Ahetukaṃ dhammaṃ saṃsaṭṭho ahetuko dhammo uppajjati ārammaṇapaccayā – ahetukaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ saṃsaṭṭhā tayo khandhā…pe… dve khandhe…pe… paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe…. (1)

88. Associated with a rootless phenomenon, a rootless phenomenon arises by way of object condition: associated with one rootless aggregate, three aggregates arise… two aggregates… at the moment of rebirth-linking… (1)

Ahetukaṃ dhammaṃ saṃsaṭṭho sahetuko dhammo uppajjati ārammaṇapaccayā – vicikicchāsahagataṃ uddhaccasahagataṃ mohaṃ saṃsaṭṭhā vicikicchāsahagatā uddhaccasahagatā khandhā. (2)

Associated with a rootless phenomenon, a rooted phenomenon arises by way of object condition: associated with delusion accompanied by doubt and restlessness, the aggregates accompanied by doubt and restlessness arise. (2)

Sahetukañca ahetukañca dhammaṃ saṃsaṭṭho sahetuko dhammo uppajjati ārammaṇapaccayā – vicikicchāsahagataṃ [T 3.0044] uddhaccasahagataṃ ekaṃ khandhañca mohañca saṃsaṭṭhā tayo khandhā…pe… dve khandhe…pe…. (1)

Dominance Condition

89. Sahetukaṃ dhammaṃ saṃsaṭṭho sahetuko dhammo uppajjati adhipatipaccayā – sahetukaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ saṃsaṭṭhā tayo khandhā…pe… dve khandhe…pe…. (1)

89. Associated with a rooted phenomenon, a rooted phenomenon arises by way of dominance condition: associated with one rooted aggregate, three aggregates arise… two aggregates… (1)

Anantarapaccayādi

Contiguity Condition, etc.

90. Sahetukaṃ [V 3.0044] dhammaṃ saṃsaṭṭho sahetuko dhammo uppajjati anantarapaccayā… samanantarapaccayā… sahajātapaccayā…pe… vipākapaccayā – vipākaṃ sahetukaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ saṃsaṭṭhā tayo khandhā…pe… dve khandhe…pe… paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe….

90. Associated with a rooted phenomenon, a rooted phenomenon arises by way of contiguity condition… immediate contiguity condition… conascence condition… and so on… by way of result condition: associated with one rooted resultant aggregate, three aggregates arise… two aggregates… at the moment of rebirth-linking….

Ahetukaṃ [M 3.0037] dhammaṃ saṃsaṭṭho ahetuko dhammo uppajjati vipākapaccayā – vipākaṃ ahetukaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ saṃsaṭṭhā tayo khandhā…pe… dve khandhe…pe… paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe… jhānapaccayā…pe… avigatapaccayā.

Associated with a rootless phenomenon, a rootless phenomenon arises by way of result condition: associated with one rootless resultant aggregate, three aggregates arise… two aggregates… at the moment of rebirth-linking… and so on… by way of jhāna condition… and so on… by way of non-disappearance condition.
