(3)

Ārammaṇapaccayo

Object Condition.

35. Sanidassano [V 3.0116] dhammo anidassanassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo – sanidassanaṃ rūpaṃ aniccato…pe… domanassaṃ uppajjati; dibbena cakkhunā rūpaṃ passati, rūpāyatanaṃ cakkhuviññāṇassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo; sanidassanā khandhā iddhividhañāṇassa, pubbenivāsānussatiñāṇassa, anāgataṃsañāṇassa, āvajjanāya ārammaṇapaccayena [T 3.0112] paccayo. (1)

35. A manifest phenomenon is a condition for a non-manifest phenomenon by way of Object Condition: regarding manifest material form as impermanent... sorrow arises; with the divine eye, one sees form—the form base is a condition for eye-consciousness by way of Object Condition; manifest aggregates are a condition for the knowledge of psychic powers, the knowledge of the recollection of past lives, the knowledge of future events, and for adverting by way of Object Condition. (1)

Anidassano dhammo anidassanassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo – dānaṃ datvā sīlaṃ…pe… uposathakammaṃ katvā taṃ paccavekkhati, pubbe suciṇṇāni paccavekkhati, jhānā vuṭṭhahitvā…pe… ariyā maggā vuṭṭhahitvā maggaṃ paccavekkhanti, phalaṃ [M 3.0097] paccavekkhanti, nibbānaṃ paccavekkhanti; nibbānaṃ gotrabhussa, vodānassa, maggassa, phalassa, āvajjanāya ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo; ariyā pahīne kilese paccavekkhanti, vikkhambhite kilese…pe… pubbe…pe… cakkhuṃ…pe… kāyaṃ… sadde…pe… vatthuṃ anidassane khandhe aniccato…pe… domanassaṃ uppajjati; dibbāya sotadhātuyā saddaṃ suṇāti, cetopariyañāṇena anidassanacittasamaṅgissa cittaṃ jānāti, ākāsānañcāyatanaṃ viññāṇañcāyatanassa…pe… ākiñcaññāyatanaṃ nevasaññānāsaññāyatanassa…pe… saddāyatanaṃ sotaviññāṇassa…pe… phoṭṭhabbāyatanaṃ kāyaviññāṇassa…pe… anidassanā khandhā iddhividhañāṇassa, cetopariyañāṇassa, pubbenivāsānussatiñāṇassa, yathākammūpagañāṇassa, anāgataṃsañāṇassa, āvajjanāya ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo. (1)

A non-manifest phenomenon is a condition for a non-manifest phenomenon by way of Object Condition: having given alms, observed virtue... having performed the Uposatha observance, one reflects upon it; one reflects upon past good conduct; having emerged from jhāna... having emerged from the noble path, the noble ones reflect upon the path, reflect upon the fruition, reflect upon Nibbāna; Nibbāna is a condition by way of Object Condition for change-of-lineage, for purification, for the path, for fruition, and for adverting; the noble ones reflect upon the abandoned defilements, the suppressed defilements... previously... the eye... the body... sounds... the base... the non-manifest aggregates as impermanent... sorrow arises; with the divine ear-element, one hears sounds; with the knowledge of others' minds, one knows the mind of one endowed with a non-manifest mind; the base of the infinity of space is a condition for the base of the infinity of consciousness... the base of nothingness is a condition for the base of neither-perception-nor-non-perception... the sound base is a condition for ear-consciousness... the tangible base is a condition for body-consciousness... the non-manifest aggregates are a condition for the knowledge of psychic powers, the knowledge of others' minds, the knowledge of past lives, the knowledge of the destiny of beings according to their kamma, the knowledge of future events, and for adverting by way of Object Condition. (1)

Adhipatipaccayo

Dominance Condition.

36. Sanidassano dhammo anidassanassa dhammassa adhipatipaccayena paccayo. Ārammaṇādhipati – sanidassanaṃ rūpaṃ garuṃ katvā assādeti abhinandati, taṃ garuṃ katvā rāgo uppajjati, diṭṭhi uppajjati. (1)

36. A manifest phenomenon is a condition for a non-manifest phenomenon by way of Dominance Condition. Object Dominance: regarding a manifest form as important, one savors and welcomes it; regarding it as important, lust arises, wrong view arises. (1)

Anidassano dhammo anidassanassa dhammassa adhipatipaccayena paccayo [T 3.0113] – ārammaṇādhipati, sahajātādhipati. Ārammaṇādhipati – dānaṃ datvā sīlaṃ…pe… uposathakammaṃ katvā [V 3.0117] taṃ garuṃ katvā paccavekkhati, pubbe suciṇṇāni…pe… jhānā vuṭṭhahitvā…pe… ariyā maggā vuṭṭhahitvā maggaṃ garuṃ katvā paccavekkhanti, phalaṃ garuṃ katvā paccavekkhanti, nibbānaṃ garuṃ katvā paccavekkhanti; nibbānaṃ gotrabhussa, vodānassa, maggassa, phalassa adhipatipaccayena paccayo; cakkhuṃ…pe… vatthuṃ anidassane khandhe garuṃ katvā assādeti abhinandati, taṃ garuṃ katvā rāgo uppajjati, diṭṭhi uppajjati. Sahajātādhipati – anidassanādhipati sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ anidassanānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ adhipatipaccayena paccayo. (1)

A non-manifest phenomenon is a condition for a non-manifest phenomenon by way of Dominance Condition: Object Dominance and Co-nascence Dominance. Object Dominance: having given alms, having observed morality… having performed the Uposatha observance, one reflects on that, respecting it; having previously practiced well… having emerged from jhāna… having emerged from the noble path, the noble ones reflect, respecting the path; they reflect, respecting the fruit; they reflect, respecting Nibbāna. Nibbāna is a condition by way of Dominance Condition for change-of-lineage, purification, the path, and the fruit. The eye… the base—one savors and welcomes the non-manifest aggregates, respecting them; respecting that, lust arises, wrong view arises. Co-nascence Dominance: a non-manifest dominant phenomenon is a condition by way of Dominance Condition for the associated non-manifest aggregates and for non-manifest mind-originated material forms. (1)

Anidassano dhammo sanidassanassa dhammassa adhipatipaccayena paccayo. Sahajātādhipati – anidassanādhipati sanidassanānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ adhipatipaccayena paccayo. (2)

A non-manifest phenomenon is a condition for a manifest phenomenon by way of Dominance Condition. Co-nascence Dominance: a non-manifest dominant phenomenon is a condition by way of Dominance Condition for manifest mind-originated material forms. (2)

Anidassano dhammo sanidassanassa ca anidassanassa ca dhammassa adhipatipaccayena paccayo. Sahajātādhipati – anidassanādhipati sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ [M 3.0098] sanidassanānañca anidassanānañca cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ adhipatipaccayena paccayo. (3)

A non-manifest phenomenon is a condition for manifest and non-manifest phenomena by way of Dominance Condition. Co-nascence Dominance: a non-manifest dominant phenomenon is a condition by way of Dominance Condition for the associated aggregates and for manifest and non-manifest mind-originated material forms. (3)

Anantarapaccayo

Contiguity Condition.

37. Anidassano dhammo anidassanassa dhammassa anantarapaccayena paccayo – purimā purimā anidassanā khandhā pacchimānaṃ pacchimānaṃ anidassanānaṃ khandhānaṃ anantarapaccayena paccayo; anulomaṃ gotrabhussa…pe… gotrabhu maggassa…pe… nevasaññānāsaññāyatanaṃ phalasamāpattiyā anantarapaccayena paccayo. (1)

37. A non-manifest phenomenon is a condition for a non-manifest phenomenon by way of Contiguity Condition—the preceding non-manifest aggregates are a condition for the succeeding non-manifest aggregates by way of Contiguity Condition; adaptation for change-of-lineage... change-of-lineage for the path... the base of neither perception nor non-perception is a condition for fruition-attainment by way of Contiguity Condition. (1)

Samanantarapaccayādi

Proximity Condition, etc.

38. Anidassano [T 3.0114] dhammo anidassanassa dhammassa samanantarapaccayena paccayo… sahajātapaccayena paccayo… tīṇi… aññamaññapaccayena paccayo… ekaṃ… nissayapaccayena paccayo… tīṇi.

38. A non-manifest phenomenon is a condition for a non-manifest phenomenon by way of Proximity Condition... Co-nascence Condition... three... Mutuality Condition... one... Support Condition... three.

Upanissayapaccayo

Decisive Support Condition

39. Sanidassano [V 3.0118] dhammo anidassanassa dhammassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇūpanissayo, pakatūpanissayo…pe…. Pakatūpanissayo – vaṇṇasampadaṃ patthayamāno dānaṃ…pe… sīlaṃ…pe… uposathakammaṃ karoti, vaṇṇasampadā saddhāya…pe… patthanāya… kāyikassa sukhassa, kāyikassa dukkhassa, maggassa, phalasamāpattiyā upanissayapaccayena paccayo. (1)

39. A manifest phenomenon is a condition for a non-manifest phenomenon by way of Decisive Support Condition—Object Decisive Support, Natural Decisive Support... Natural Decisive Support—one desiring beauty performs acts of giving... morality... the Uposatha observance; beauty is a condition for faith... aspiration... bodily pleasure, bodily pain, the path, and fruition-attainment by way of Decisive Support Condition. (1)

Anidassano dhammo anidassanassa dhammassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇūpanissayo, anantarūpanissayo, pakatūpanissayo…pe…. Pakatūpanissayo – saddhaṃ upanissāya dānaṃ deti…pe… samāpattiṃ uppādeti, mānaṃ jappeti, diṭṭhiṃ gaṇhāti; sīlaṃ…pe… senāsanaṃ upanissāya dānaṃ deti…pe… saṅghaṃ bhindati; saddhā…pe… senāsanaṃ saddhāya…pe… phalasamāpattiyā upanissayapaccayena paccayo. (1)

A non-manifest phenomenon is a condition for a non-manifest phenomenon by way of Decisive Support Condition—Object Decisive Support, Contiguous Decisive Support, and Natural Decisive Support… Natural Decisive Support—relying on faith, one gives alms… develops meditative absorption, generates conceit, grasps a view; relying on morality… lodging, one gives alms… splits the Sangha; faith… lodging are a condition for faith… fruition-attainment by way of Decisive Support Condition. (1)

Purejātapaccayo

Pre-nascence Condition

40. Sanidassano dhammo anidassanassa dhammassa purejātapaccayena paccayo – sanidassanaṃ rūpaṃ aniccato…pe… domanassaṃ uppajjati; dibbena cakkhunā [M 3.0099] rūpaṃ passati, rūpāyatanaṃ cakkhuviññāṇassa purejātapaccayena paccayo. (1)

40. A manifest phenomenon is a condition for a non-manifest phenomenon by way of Pre-nascence Condition—contemplating manifest form as impermanent… sorrow arises; with the divine eye, one sees form; the visible-object base is a condition for eye-consciousness by way of Pre-nascence Condition. (1)

Anidassano dhammo anidassanassa dhammassa purejātapaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇapurejātaṃ, vatthupurejātaṃ. Ārammaṇapurejātaṃ – cakkhuṃ…pe… vatthuṃ aniccato…pe… domanassaṃ [T 3.0115] uppajjati, dibbāya sotadhātuyā saddaṃ suṇāti, saddāyatanaṃ sotaviññāṇassa…pe… phoṭṭhabbāyatanaṃ kāyaviññāṇassa purejātapaccayena paccayo. Vatthupurejātaṃ – cakkhāyatanaṃ cakkhuviññāṇassa…pe… kāyāyatanaṃ kāyaviññāṇassa…pe… vatthu anidassanānaṃ khandhānaṃ purejātapaccayena paccayo. (1)

A non-manifest phenomenon is a condition for a non-manifest phenomenon by way of Pre-nascence Condition: Object Pre-nascence and Base Pre-nascence. Object Pre-nascence: contemplating the eye... the base as impermanent... sorrow arises; with the divine ear-element, one hears a sound; the sound-base is a condition for ear-consciousness... the tangible-object base is a condition for body-consciousness by way of Pre-nascence Condition. Base Pre-nascence: the eye-base is a condition for eye-consciousness... the body-base is a condition for body-consciousness... the base is a condition for the non-manifest aggregates by way of Pre-nascence Condition. (1)

Sanidassano ca anidassano ca dhammā anidassanassa dhammassa purejātapaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇapurejātaṃ, vatthupurejātaṃ. Rūpāyatanañca vatthu ca anidassanānaṃ khandhānaṃ purejātapaccayena [V 3.0119] paccayo; rūpāyatanañca cakkhāyatanañca cakkhuviññāṇassa purejātapaccayena paccayo. (1)

Manifest and non-manifest phenomena are conditions for a non-manifest phenomenon by way of Pre-nascence Condition—Object Pre-nascence and Base Pre-nascence. The visible-object base and the base are conditions for the non-manifest aggregates by way of Pre-nascence Condition; the visible-object base and the eye-base are conditions for eye-consciousness by way of Pre-nascence Condition. (1)

Pacchājātapaccayo

Post-nascence Condition

41. Anidassano dhammo anidassanassa dhammassa pacchājātapaccayena paccayo – pacchājātā anidassanā khandhā purejātassa imassa anidassanassa kāyassa pacchājātapaccayena paccayo. (1)

41. A non-manifest phenomenon is a condition for a non-manifest phenomenon by way of Post-nascence Condition—the subsequently arisen non-manifest aggregates are a condition for this previously arisen non-manifest body by way of Post-nascence Condition. (1)

Anidassano dhammo sanidassanassa dhammassa pacchājātapaccayena paccayo – pacchājātā anidassanā khandhā purejātassa imassa sanidassanassa kāyassa pacchājātapaccayena paccayo. (2)

A non-manifest phenomenon is a condition for a manifest phenomenon by way of Post-nascence Condition—the subsequently arisen non-manifest aggregates are a condition for this previously arisen manifest body by way of Post-nascence Condition. (2)

Anidassano dhammo sanidassanassa ca anidassanassa ca dhammassa pacchājātapaccayena paccayo – pacchājātā anidassanā khandhā purejātassa imassa sanidassanassa ca anidassanassa ca kāyassa pacchājātapaccayena paccayo. (3)

A non-manifest phenomenon is a condition for manifest and non-manifest phenomena by way of Post-nascence Condition—the subsequently arisen non-manifest aggregates are a condition for this previously arisen manifest and non-manifest body by way of Post-nascence Condition. (3)

Āsevanapaccayo

Repetition Condition

42. Anidassano dhammo anidassanassa dhammassa āsevanapaccayena paccayo – purimā purimā anidassanā khandhā pacchimānaṃ pacchimānaṃ anidassanānaṃ khandhānaṃ…pe… anulomaṃ gotrabhussa… anulomaṃ vodānassa… gotrabhu maggassa… vodānaṃ maggassa āsevanapaccayena paccayo. (1)

42. A non-manifest phenomenon is a condition for a non-manifest phenomenon by way of Repetition Condition—the preceding non-manifest aggregates are a condition for the succeeding non-manifest aggregates... adaptation for change-of-lineage... adaptation for purification... change-of-lineage for the path... purification for the path by way of Repetition Condition. (1)

Kammapaccayo

Kamma Condition

43. Anidassano [T 3.0116][M 3.0100] dhammo anidassanassa dhammassa kammapaccayena paccayo – sahajātā, nānākkhaṇikā. Sahajātā – anidassanā cetanā sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ anidassanānañca cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ kammapaccayena paccayo; paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe…. Nānākkhaṇikā – anidassanā [V 3.0120] cetanā vipākānaṃ khandhānaṃ anidassanānañca kaṭattārūpānaṃ kammapaccayena paccayo. (1)

43. A non-manifest phenomenon is a condition for a non-manifest phenomenon by way of Kamma Condition—co-nascently and at a different moment. Co-nascently: non-manifest volition is a condition for the associated aggregates and for non-manifest mind-originated material phenomena by way of Kamma Condition; at the moment of rebirth-linking... At a different moment: non-manifest volition is a condition for the resultant aggregates and for non-manifest kamma-originated material phenomena by way of Kamma Condition. (1)

Anidassano dhammo sanidassanassa dhammassa kammapaccayena paccayo – sahajātā, nānākkhaṇikā (vitthāretabbaṃ). (2)

A non-manifest phenomenon is a condition for a manifest phenomenon by way of Kamma Condition—co-nascently and at a different moment (to be elaborated). (2)

Anidassano dhammo sanidassanassa ca anidassanassa ca dhammassa kammapaccayena paccayo – sahajātā, nānākkhaṇikā (vitthāretabbaṃ). (3)

A non-manifest phenomenon is a condition for a manifest phenomenon and for a non-manifest phenomenon by way of Kamma Condition—co-nascently and at a different moment (to be elaborated). (3)

Vipākapaccayādi

Resultant Condition, etc.

44. Anidassano dhammo anidassanassa dhammassa vipākapaccayena paccayo… tīṇi… āhārapaccayena paccayo… tīṇi (tīsupi kabaḷīkāro āhāro kātabbo)… indriyapaccayena paccayo… tīṇi (tīsupi rūpajīvitindriyaṃ)… jhānapaccayena paccayo… tīṇi… maggapaccayena paccayo… tīṇi… sampayuttapaccayena paccayo… ekaṃ.

44. A non-manifest phenomenon is a condition for a non-manifest phenomenon by way of Resultant Condition… three… by way of Nutriment Condition… three (in all three, physical nutriment is to be taken)… by way of Faculty Condition… three (in all three, the material life faculty)… by way of Jhāna Condition… three… by way of Path Condition… three… by way of Association Condition… one.

Vippayuttapaccayo

Dissociation Condition

45. Anidassano dhammo anidassanassa dhammassa vippayuttapaccayena paccayo – sahajātaṃ, purejātaṃ, pacchājātaṃ. Sahajātā – anidassanā khandhā anidassanānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ vippayuttapaccayena paccayo; paṭisandhikkhaṇe anidassanā khandhā anidassanānaṃ kaṭattārūpānaṃ vippayuttapaccayena paccayo; khandhā vatthussa vippayuttapaccayena paccayo, vatthu khandhānaṃ vippayuttapaccayena paccayo[T 3.0117]. Purejātaṃ – cakkhāyatanaṃ cakkhuviññāṇassa…pe… kāyāyatanaṃ kāyaviññāṇassa…pe… vatthu anidassanānaṃ khandhānaṃ vippayuttapaccayena paccayo. Pacchājātā – anidassanā khandhā purejātassa imassa anidassanassa kāyassa vippayuttapaccayena paccayo. (1)

45. A non-manifest phenomenon is a condition for a non-manifest phenomenon by way of dissociation condition—by co-nascence, pre-nascence, and post-nascence. By co-nascence—non-manifest aggregates are a condition for non-manifest mind-produced material phenomena by way of dissociation condition; at the moment of rebirth-linking, non-manifest aggregates are a condition for non-manifest kamma-originated material phenomena by way of dissociation condition; aggregates are a condition for the physical base by way of dissociation condition, and the physical base is a condition for the aggregates by way of dissociation condition. By pre-nascence—the eye-base is a condition for eye-consciousness, and so on; the body-base is a condition for body-consciousness, and so on; the physical base is a condition for non-manifest aggregates by way of dissociation condition. By post-nascence—non-manifest aggregates are a condition for this pre-nascent non-manifest body by way of dissociation condition. (1)

Anidassano dhammo sanidassanassa dhammassa vippayuttapaccayena paccayo – sahajātaṃ, pacchājātaṃ. Sahajātā – anidassanā khandhā sanidassanānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ [M 3.0101] rūpānaṃ vippayuttapaccayena [V 3.0121] paccayo; paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe…. Pacchājātā – anidassanā khandhā purejātassa imassa sanidassanassa kāyassa vippayuttapaccayena paccayo. (2)

A non-manifest phenomenon is a condition for a manifest phenomenon by way of dissociation condition—by co-nascence and post-nascence. By co-nascence—non-manifest aggregates are a condition for manifest mind-produced material phenomena by way of dissociation condition; at the moment of rebirth-linking, and so on. By post-nascence—non-manifest aggregates are a condition for this pre-nascent manifest body by way of dissociation condition. (2)

Anidassano dhammo sanidassanassa ca anidassanassa ca dhammassa vippayuttapaccayena paccayo – sahajātaṃ, pacchājātaṃ. Sahajātā – anidassanā khandhā sanidassanānañca anidassanānañca cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ vippayuttapaccayena paccayo; paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe…. Pacchājātā – anidassanā khandhā purejātassa imassa sanidassanassa ca anidassanassa ca kāyassa vippayuttapaccayena paccayo. (3)

A non-manifest phenomenon is a condition for a manifest and a non-manifest phenomenon by way of dissociation condition—by co-nascence and post-nascence. By co-nascence—non-manifest aggregates are a condition for manifest and non-manifest mind-produced material phenomena by way of dissociation condition; at the moment of rebirth-linking, and so on. By post-nascence—non-manifest aggregates are a condition for this pre-nascent manifest and non-manifest body by way of dissociation condition. (3)

Atthipaccayādi

The Presence Condition, and so on.

46. Sanidassano dhammo anidassanassa dhammassa atthipaccayena paccayo – sanidassanaṃ rūpaṃ aniccato…pe… domanassaṃ uppajjati, dibbena cakkhunā rūpaṃ passati, rūpāyatanaṃ cakkhuviññāṇassa atthipaccayena paccayo. (1)

46. A manifest phenomenon is a condition for a non-manifest phenomenon by way of presence condition—when manifest form is regarded as impermanent… and so on… sorrow arises; with the divine eye one sees form; the form-base is a condition for eye-consciousness by way of presence condition. (1)

Anidassano dhammo anidassanassa dhammassa atthipaccayena paccayo – sahajātaṃ, purejātaṃ, pacchājātaṃ, āhāraṃ, indriyaṃ. Sahajāto – anidassano [T 3.0118] eko khandho tiṇṇannaṃ khandhānaṃ anidassanānañca cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo…pe… dve khandhe…pe… (saṃkhittaṃ. Yāva asaññasattā). Purejātaṃ – cakkhuṃ…pe… vatthuṃ aniccato…pe… domanassaṃ uppajjati, dibbāya sotadhātuyā saddaṃ suṇāti, saddāyatanaṃ sotaviññāṇassa…pe… phoṭṭhabbāyatanaṃ kāyaviññāṇassa…pe… cakkhāyatanaṃ cakkhuviññāṇassa…pe… kāyāyatanaṃ kāyaviññāṇassa…pe… vatthu anidassanānaṃ khandhānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo. Pacchājātā – anidassanā khandhā purejātassa imassa anidassanassa kāyassa atthipaccayena paccayo; kabaḷīkāro āhāro imassa anidassanassa kāyassa atthipaccayena paccayo; rūpajīvitindriyaṃ anidassanānaṃ kaṭattārūpānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo. (1)

A non-manifest phenomenon is a condition for a non-manifest phenomenon by way of presence condition: by co-nascence, pre-nascence, post-nascence, nutriment, and faculty. By co-nascence: one non-manifest aggregate is a condition for the other three non-manifest aggregates and for non-manifest mind-produced material phenomena by way of presence condition… and so on… two aggregates… and so on… (in brief, up to non-percipient beings). By pre-nascence: the eye… and so on… the physical base is regarded as impermanent… and so on… sorrow arises; with the divine ear-element one hears a sound; the sound-base is a condition for ear-consciousness… and so on… the tangible-base is a condition for body-consciousness… and so on… the eye-base is a condition for eye-consciousness… and so on… the body-base is a condition for body-consciousness… and so on… the physical base is a condition for the non-manifest aggregates by way of presence condition. By post-nascence: the non-manifest aggregates are a condition for this pre-nascent non-manifest body by way of presence condition; edible food is a condition for this non-manifest body by way of presence condition; the material life-faculty is a condition for non-manifest kamma-produced material phenomena by way of presence condition. (1)

Anidassano dhammo sanidassanassa dhammassa atthipaccayena paccayo – sahajātaṃ, pacchājātaṃ, āhāraṃ, indriyaṃ. Sahajātā – anidassanā khandhā sanidassanānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ [V 3.0122] atthipaccayena paccayo; paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe… mahābhūtā sanidassanānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ kaṭattārūpānaṃ [M 3.0102] upādārūpānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo…pe… bāhirā… āhārasamuṭṭhānā… utusamuṭṭhānā… asaññasattānaṃ mahābhūtā sanidassanānaṃ kaṭattārūpānaṃ, upādārūpānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo. Pacchājātā – anidassanā khandhā purejātassa imassa sanidassanassa kāyassa atthipaccayena paccayo; kabaḷīkāro āhāro imassa sanidassanassa kāyassa atthipaccayena paccayo; rūpajīvitindriyaṃ sanidassanānaṃ [T 3.0119] kaṭattārūpānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo. (2)

A non-manifest phenomenon is a condition for a manifest phenomenon by way of presence condition: by co-nascence, post-nascence, nutriment, and faculty. By co-nascence: the non-manifest aggregates are a condition for manifest mind-produced material phenomena by way of presence condition; at the moment of rebirth-linking… and so on… the great elements are a condition for manifest mind-produced material phenomena, kamma-produced material phenomena, and derived material phenomena by way of presence condition… and so on… external… nutriment-produced… temperature-produced… for non-percipient beings, the great elements are a condition for manifest kamma-produced material phenomena and derived material phenomena by way of presence condition. By post-nascence: the non-manifest aggregates are a condition for this pre-nascent manifest body by way of presence condition; edible food is a condition for this manifest body by way of presence condition; the material life-faculty is a condition for manifest kamma-produced material phenomena by way of presence condition. (2)

Anidassano dhammo sanidassanassa ca anidassanassa ca dhammassa atthipaccayena paccayo – sahajātaṃ, pacchājātaṃ, āhāraṃ, indriyaṃ. Sahajāto – anidassano eko khandho tiṇṇannaṃ khandhānaṃ sanidassanānañca anidassanānañca cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo…pe… dve khandhā…pe… paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe… mahābhūtā sanidassanānañca anidassanānañca cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ, kaṭattārūpānaṃ, upādārūpānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo; bāhirā… āhārasamuṭṭhānā… utusamuṭṭhānā… asaññasattānaṃ mahābhūtā sanidassanānañca anidassanānañca kaṭattārūpānaṃ upādārūpānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo. (3)

A non-manifest phenomenon is a condition for a manifest and a non-manifest phenomenon by way of presence condition: by co-nascence, post-nascence, nutriment, and faculty. By co-nascence: one non-manifest aggregate is a condition for the other three aggregates and for manifest and non-manifest mind-produced material phenomena by way of presence condition… and so on… two aggregates… and so on… at the moment of rebirth-linking… and so on… the great elements are a condition for manifest and non-manifest mind-produced material phenomena, kamma-produced material phenomena, and derived material phenomena by way of presence condition; external… nutriment-produced… temperature-produced… for non-percipient beings, the great elements are a condition for manifest and non-manifest kamma-produced material phenomena and derived material phenomena by way of presence condition. (3)

47. Sanidassano ca anidassano ca dhammā anidassanassa dhammassa atthipaccayena paccayo. Purejātaṃ – rūpāyatanañca vatthu ca anidassanānaṃ khandhānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo; rūpāyatanañca cakkhāyatanañca cakkhuviññāṇassa atthipaccayena paccayo.

47. Manifest and non-manifest phenomena are a condition for a non-manifest phenomenon by way of presence condition. By pre-nascence: the form-base and the physical base are a condition for the non-manifest aggregates by way of presence condition; the form-base and the eye-base are a condition for eye-consciousness by way of presence condition.

Natthipaccayena paccayo… vigatapaccayena paccayo… avigatapaccayena paccayo.

By absence condition… by disappearance condition… by non-disappearance condition.

1. Paccayānulomaṃ

1. The Affirmative of Conditions.

2. Saṅkhyāvāro

2. The Enumeration Section.

Suddhaṃ

Pure.

48. Hetuyā tīṇi, ārammaṇe dve, adhipatiyā cattāri, anantare ekaṃ, samanantare ekaṃ[V 3.0123], sahajāte tīṇi, aññamaññe ekaṃ, nissaye tīṇi, upanissaye dve, purejāte tīṇi, pacchājāte tīṇi, āsevane ekaṃ, kamme tīṇi, vipāke tīṇi, āhāre tīṇi, indriye [M 3.0103] tīṇi, jhāne tīṇi, magge tīṇi, sampayutte [T 3.0120] ekaṃ, vippayutte tīṇi, atthiyā pañca, natthiyā ekaṃ, vigate ekaṃ, avigate pañca (evaṃ gaṇetabbaṃ).

48. By root condition, three; by object condition, two; by dominance condition, four; by contiguity condition, one; by proximity condition, one; by co-nascence condition, three; by mutuality condition, one; by support condition, three; by decisive support condition, two; by pre-nascence condition, three; by post-nascence condition, three; by repetition condition, one; by kamma condition, three; by result condition, three; by nutriment condition, three; by faculty condition, three; by jhāna condition, three; by path condition, three; by association condition, one; by dissociation condition, three; by presence condition, five; by absence condition, one; by disappearance condition, one; by non-disappearance condition, five (thus should be counted).

Anulomaṃ.

The Affirmative.

Paccanīyuddhāro

The Negative Section.

49. Sanidassano dhammo anidassanassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo… upanissayapaccayena paccayo. (1)

49. A visible phenomenon is a condition for an invisible phenomenon by way of object condition… by way of decisive support condition. (1)

Anidassano dhammo anidassanassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo… sahajātapaccayena paccayo… upanissayapaccayena paccayo… purejātapaccayena paccayo… pacchājātapaccayena paccayo… kammapaccayena paccayo… āhārapaccayena paccayo… indriyapaccayena paccayo. (1)

An invisible phenomenon is a condition for an invisible phenomenon by way of object condition… by way of co-nascence condition… by way of decisive support condition… by way of pre-nascence condition… by way of post-nascence condition… by way of kamma condition… by way of nutriment condition… by way of faculty condition. (1)

Anidassano dhammo sanidassanassa dhammassa sahajātapaccayena paccayo… pacchājātapaccayena paccayo… kammapaccayena paccayo… āhārapaccayena paccayo… indriyapaccayena paccayo. (2)

An invisible phenomenon is a condition for a visible phenomenon by way of co-nascence condition… by way of post-nascence condition… by way of kamma condition… by way of nutriment condition… by way of faculty condition. (2)

Anidassano dhammo sanidassanassa ca anidassanassa ca dhammassa sahajātapaccayena paccayo… pacchājātapaccayena paccayo… kammapaccayena paccayo… āhārapaccayena paccayo… indriyapaccayena paccayo. (3)

An invisible phenomenon is a condition for both visible and invisible phenomena by way of co-nascence condition… by way of post-nascence condition… by way of kamma condition… by way of nutriment condition… by way of faculty condition. (3)

Sanidassano ca anidassano ca dhammā anidassanassa dhammassa purejātapaccayena paccayo. (1)

Both visible and invisible phenomena are a condition for an invisible phenomenon by way of pre-nascence condition. (1)

2. The Negation of Conditions.

2. Saṅkhyāvāro

2. The Enumeration Section.

Suddhaṃ

The Pure.

50. Nahetuyā [V 3.0124] pañca, naārammaṇe cattāri, naadhipatiyā pañca, naanantare pañca, nasamanantare pañca, nasahajāte pañca, naaññamaññe pañca, nanissaye cattāri, naupanissaye pañca, napurejāte [T 3.0121] cattāri, napacchājāte pañca (sabbattha pañca), nasampayutte pañca, navippayutte cattāri, noatthiyā cattāri, nonatthiyā pañca, novigate pañca, noavigate cattāri.

50. Not by way of root condition, five; not by way of object condition, four; not by way of dominance condition, five; not by way of contiguity condition, five; not by way of proximity condition, five; not by way of co-nascence condition, five; not by way of mutuality condition, five; not by way of support condition, four; not by way of decisive support condition, five; not by way of pre-nascence condition, four; not by way of post-nascence condition, five (five everywhere); not by way of association condition, five; not by way of dissociation condition, four; not by way of presence condition, four; not by way of absence condition, five; not by way of disappearance condition, five; not by way of non-disappearance condition, four.

Paccanīyaṃ.

The Negative.

3. Paccayānulomapaccanīyaṃ

3. The Affirmative-Negative of Conditions.

Hetudukaṃ

The Root Dyad.

51. Hetupaccayā [M 3.0104] naārammaṇe tīṇi, naadhipatiyā tīṇi, naanantare tīṇi, nasamanantare tīṇi, naaññamaññe tīṇi, naupanissaye tīṇi…pe… nasampayutte tīṇi, navippayutte ekaṃ, nonatthiyā tīṇi, novigate tīṇi.

51. By way of root condition: not by way of object condition, three; not by way of dominance condition, three; not by way of contiguity condition, three; not by way of proximity condition, three; not by way of mutuality condition, three; not by way of decisive support condition, three…and so on…not by way of association condition, three; not by way of dissociation condition, one; not by way of absence condition, three; not by way of disappearance condition, three.

Anulomapaccanīyaṃ.

The Affirmative-Negative.

4. Paccayapaccanīyānulomaṃ

4. The Negative-Affirmative of Conditions.

Nahetudukaṃ

The Non-Root Dyad.

52. Nahetupaccayā [V 3.0125] ārammaṇe dve, adhipatiyā cattāri, anantare ekaṃ, samanantare ekaṃ, sahajāte tīṇi, aññamaññe ekaṃ, nissaye tīṇi, upanissaye dve, purejāte tīṇi, pacchājāte tīṇi, āsevane ekaṃ, kamme tīṇi…pe… magge tīṇi, sampayutte ekaṃ, vippayutte tīṇi, atthiyā pañca, natthiyā ekaṃ, vigate ekaṃ, avigate pañca.

52. By way of non-root condition: by way of object condition, two; by way of dominance condition, four; by way of contiguity condition, one; by way of proximity condition, one; by way of co-nascence condition, three; by way of mutuality condition, one; by way of support condition, three; by way of decisive support condition, two; by way of pre-nascence condition, three; by way of post-nascence condition, three; by way of repetition condition, one; by way of kamma condition, three…and so on…by way of path condition, three; by way of association condition, one; by way of dissociation condition, three; by way of presence condition, five; by way of absence condition, one; by way of disappearance condition, one; by way of non-disappearance condition, five.

Paccanīyānulomaṃ.

The Negative-Affirmative.

Sanidassanadukaṃ niṭṭhitaṃ.

The Visible Dyad is concluded.

Hetupaccayo

Root Condition

53. Sappaṭighaṃ [T 3.0122][V 3.0126] dhammaṃ paṭicca sappaṭigho dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – sappaṭighaṃ ekaṃ mahābhūtaṃ paṭicca dve mahābhūtā, dve mahābhūte paṭicca ekaṃ mahābhūtaṃ[M 3.0105], sappaṭighe mahābhūte paṭicca sappaṭighaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ, kaṭattārūpaṃ, upādārūpaṃ, phoṭṭhabbāyatanaṃ paṭicca cakkhāyatanaṃ…pe… rasāyatanaṃ. (1)

53. A phenomenon with resistance arises dependent on a phenomenon with resistance by way of root condition: dependent on one great element with resistance, two great elements; dependent on two great elements, one great element; dependent on great elements with resistance, mind-produced form with resistance, kamma-produced form, derived form; dependent on the tangible base, the eye-base…and so on…the taste-base. (1)

Sappaṭighaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca appaṭigho dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – sappaṭighe mahābhūte paṭicca āpodhātu, sappaṭighe mahābhūte paṭicca appaṭighaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ, kaṭattārūpaṃ, upādārūpaṃ, phoṭṭhabbāyatanaṃ paṭicca āpodhātu itthindriyaṃ…pe… kabaḷīkāro āhāro. (2)

A phenomenon without resistance arises dependent on a phenomenon with resistance by way of root condition: the water element arises dependent on great elements with resistance; mind-produced form without resistance, kamma-produced form, derived form arise dependent on great elements with resistance; the water element, the femininity faculty arise dependent on the tangible base…and so on…edible food. (2)

Sappaṭighaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca sappaṭigho ca appaṭigho ca dhammā uppajjanti hetupaccayā – sappaṭighaṃ ekaṃ mahābhūtaṃ paṭicca dve mahābhūtā āpodhātu ca, dve mahābhūte…pe… sappaṭighe mahābhūte paṭicca sappaṭighañca appaṭighañca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ, kaṭattārūpaṃ, upādārūpaṃ, phoṭṭhabbāyatanaṃ [V 3.0127] paṭicca cakkhāyatanaṃ…pe… rasāyatanaṃ āpodhātu itthindriyaṃ…pe… kabaḷīkāro āhāro. (3)

Phenomena with resistance and without resistance arise dependent on a phenomenon with resistance by way of root condition: dependent on one great element with resistance, two great elements and the water element arise; dependent on two great elements…and so on…dependent on great elements with resistance, mind-produced form with resistance and without resistance, kamma-produced form, derived form arise; dependent on the tangible base, the eye-base…and so on…the taste-base, the water element, the femininity faculty…and so on…edible food. (3)

54. Appaṭighaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca appaṭigho dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – appaṭighaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca tayo khandhā appaṭighaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ…pe… dve khandhe…pe… paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe… khandhe paṭicca vatthu, vatthuṃ paṭicca khandhā[T 3.0123], āpodhātuṃ paṭicca appaṭighaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ, kaṭattārūpaṃ, upādārūpaṃ, āpodhātuṃ paṭicca itthindriyaṃ…pe… kabaḷīkāro āhāro. (1)

54. A phenomenon without resistance arises dependent on a phenomenon without resistance by way of root condition: dependent on one aggregate without resistance, three aggregates arise, and mind-produced form without resistance…and so on…dependent on two aggregates…and so on…at the moment of rebirth-linking…and so on…dependent on aggregates, the physical basis; dependent on the physical basis, aggregates; mind-produced form without resistance, kamma-produced form, derived form arise dependent on the water element; the femininity faculty…and so on…edible food arise dependent on the water element. (1)

Appaṭighaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca sappaṭigho dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – appaṭighe khandhe paṭicca sappaṭighaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ; paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe… āpodhātuṃ paṭicca sappaṭighā mahābhūtā, āpodhātuṃ paṭicca sappaṭighaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ, kaṭattārūpaṃ, upādārūpaṃ, āpodhātuṃ paṭicca cakkhāyatanaṃ…pe… phoṭṭhabbāyatanaṃ. (2)

A phenomenon with resistance arises dependent on a phenomenon without resistance by way of root condition: mind-produced form with resistance arises dependent on aggregates without resistance; at the moment of rebirth-linking…and so on…great elements with resistance arise dependent on the water element; mind-produced form with resistance, kamma-produced form, derived form arise dependent on the water element; the eye-base…and so on…the tangible base arise dependent on the water element. (2)

Appaṭighaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca sappaṭigho ca appaṭigho ca dhammā uppajjanti hetupaccayā – appaṭighaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca tayo khandhā sappaṭighañca appaṭighañca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ…pe… dve khandhe…pe… paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe… āpodhātuṃ paṭicca sappaṭighañca appaṭighañca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ, kaṭattārūpaṃ, upādārūpaṃ, āpodhātuṃ paṭicca cakkhāyatanaṃ…pe… phoṭṭhabbāyatanaṃ, itthindriyaṃ…pe… kabaḷīkāro āhāro. (3)

Phenomena with resistance and without resistance arise dependent on a phenomenon without resistance by way of root condition: dependent on one aggregate without resistance, three aggregates arise, and mind-produced form with resistance and without resistance…and so on…dependent on two aggregates…and so on…at the moment of rebirth-linking…and so on…mind-produced form with resistance and without resistance, kamma-produced form, derived form arise dependent on the water element; the eye-base…and so on…the tangible base, the femininity faculty…and so on…edible food arise dependent on the water element. (3)

55. Sappaṭighañca [M 3.0106] appaṭighañca dhammaṃ paṭicca sappaṭigho dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – appaṭighe khandhe ca mahābhūte ca paṭicca sappaṭighaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ; paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe… sappaṭighaṃ ekaṃ mahābhūtañca āpodhātuñca paṭicca dve mahābhūtā…pe… sappaṭighe mahābhūte ca āpodhātuñca paṭicca sappaṭighaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ, kaṭattārūpaṃ, upādārūpaṃ, phoṭṭhabbāyatanañca āpodhātuñca paṭicca cakkhāyatanaṃ…pe…. (1)

55. A phenomenon with resistance arises dependent on phenomena with resistance and without resistance by way of root condition: mind-produced form with resistance arises dependent on aggregates without resistance and great elements; at the moment of rebirth-linking…and so on…dependent on one great element with resistance and the water element, two great elements arise…and so on…mind-produced form with resistance, kamma-produced form, derived form arise dependent on great elements with resistance and the water element; the eye-base arises dependent on the tangible base and the water element…and so on. (1)

Sappaṭighañca appaṭighañca dhammaṃ paṭicca appaṭigho dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – appaṭighe khandhe ca mahābhūte [T 3.0124] ca paṭicca appaṭighaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ; paṭisandhikkhaṇe appaṭighe [V 3.0128] khandhe ca mahābhūte ca paṭicca appaṭighaṃ kaṭattārūpaṃ, phoṭṭhabbāyatanañca āpodhātuñca paṭicca appaṭighaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ, kaṭattārūpaṃ, upādārūpaṃ, phoṭṭhabbāyatanañca āpodhātuñca paṭicca itthindriyaṃ…pe… kabaḷīkāro āhāro. (2)

A phenomenon without resistance arises dependent on phenomena with resistance and without resistance by way of root condition: mind-produced form without resistance arises dependent on aggregates without resistance and great elements; at the moment of rebirth-linking, kamma-produced form without resistance arises dependent on aggregates without resistance and great elements; mind-produced form without resistance, kamma-produced form, derived form arise dependent on the tangible base and the water element; the femininity faculty…and so on…edible food arise dependent on the tangible base and the water element. (2)

Sappaṭighañca appaṭighañca dhammaṃ paṭicca sappaṭigho ca appaṭigho ca dhammā uppajjanti hetupaccayā – appaṭighe khandhe ca mahābhūte ca paṭicca sappaṭighañca appaṭighañca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ; paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe… appaṭighe khandhe ca mahābhūte ca paṭicca sappaṭighañca appaṭighañca kaṭattārūpaṃ, phoṭṭhabbāyatanañca āpodhātuñca paṭicca sappaṭighañca appaṭighañca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ, kaṭattārūpaṃ, upādārūpaṃ, phoṭṭhabbāyatanañca āpodhātuñca paṭicca cakkhāyatanaṃ…pe… rasāyatanaṃ, itthindriyaṃ…pe… kabaḷīkāro āhāro. (3)

Phenomena with resistance and without resistance arise dependent on phenomena with resistance and without resistance by way of root condition: mind-produced form with resistance and without resistance arises dependent on aggregates without resistance and great elements; at the moment of rebirth-linking…and so on…kamma-produced form with resistance and without resistance arises dependent on aggregates without resistance and great elements; mind-produced form with resistance and without resistance, kamma-produced form, derived form arise dependent on the tangible base and the water element; the eye-base…and so on…the taste-base, the femininity faculty…and so on…edible food arise dependent on the tangible base and the water element. (3)

Ārammaṇapaccayo

Object Condition

56. Appaṭighaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca appaṭigho dhammo uppajjati ārammaṇapaccayā – appaṭighaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca tayo khandhā…pe… dve khandhe…pe… paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe… vatthuṃ paṭicca khandhā.

56. Dependent on a phenomenon without resistance, a phenomenon without resistance arises by way of Object Condition. Dependent on one aggregate without resistance, three aggregates… dependent on two aggregates… at the moment of rebirth-linking… dependent on the physical basis, the aggregates.

Adhipatipaccayādi

Dominance Condition, etc.

57. Sappaṭighaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca appaṭigho dhammo uppajjati adhipatipaccayā (paṭisandhi vajjetabbā, kaṭattārūpā ca)… anantarapaccayā… samanantarapaccayā… sahajātapaccayā (sabbe mahābhūtā kātabbā)… aññamaññapaccayā – sappaṭighaṃ ekaṃ mahābhūtaṃ paṭicca dve mahābhūtā, dve mahābhūte…pe…. (1)

57. Dependent on a phenomenon with resistance, a phenomenon without resistance arises by way of Dominance Condition (rebirth-linking and kamma-produced matter should be excluded)… by way of Immediately Proximate Condition… by way of Contiguity Condition… by way of Co-nascence Condition (all great elements should be included)… by way of Mutuality Condition. Dependent on one great element with resistance, two great elements; dependent on two great elements… (1)

Sappaṭighaṃ [M 3.0107] dhammaṃ paṭicca [T 3.0125] appaṭigho dhammo uppajjati aññamaññapaccayā – sappaṭighe mahābhūte paṭicca āpodhātu…pe…. (2)

Dependent on a resistive phenomenon, a non-resistive phenomenon arises by way of Mutuality Condition. Dependent on resistive great elements, the water element… (2)

Sappaṭighaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca sappaṭigho ca appaṭigho ca dhammā uppajjanti aññamaññapaccayā [V 3.0129] – sappaṭighaṃ ekaṃ mahābhūtaṃ paṭicca dve mahābhūtā āpodhātu ca, dve mahābhūte…pe…. (3)

Dependent on a resistive phenomenon, both resistive and non-resistive phenomena arise by way of Mutuality Condition. Dependent on one resistive great element, two great elements and the water element; dependent on two great elements… (3)

58. Appaṭighaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca appaṭigho dhammo uppajjati aññamaññapaccayā – appaṭighaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca tayo khandhā…pe… dve khandhe…pe… paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe… khandhe paṭicca vatthu, vatthuṃ paṭicca khandhā. (1)

58. Dependent on a non-resistive phenomenon, a non-resistive phenomenon arises by way of Mutuality Condition. Dependent on one non-resistive aggregate, three aggregates… dependent on two aggregates… at the moment of rebirth-linking… dependent on the aggregates, the physical base; dependent on the physical base, the aggregates. (1)

Appaṭighaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca sappaṭigho dhammo uppajjati aññamaññapaccayā – āpodhātuṃ paṭicca sappaṭighā mahābhūtā (ime ajjhattikabāhirā mahābhūtā kātabbā). (2)

Dependent on a non-resistive phenomenon, a resistive phenomenon arises by way of Mutuality Condition. Dependent on the water element, resistive great elements (these should be understood as internal and external great elements). (2)

Sappaṭighañca appaṭighañca dhammaṃ paṭicca sappaṭigho dhammo uppajjati aññamaññapaccayā – sappaṭighaṃ ekaṃ mahābhūtañca āpodhātuñca paṭicca dve mahābhūtā…pe… nissayapaccayā…pe… avigatapaccayā.

Dependent on resistive and non-resistive phenomena, a resistive phenomenon arises by way of Mutuality Condition. Dependent on one resistive great element and the water element, two great elements… by way of Support Condition… by way of Non-Disappearance Condition.

(1)

Dependent on a non-resistive phenomenon, a non-resistive phenomenon arises by way of Non-Root Condition. Dependent on one rootless non-resistive aggregate, three aggregates and non-resistive mind-produced matter… dependent on two aggregates… at the moment of rootless rebirth-linking… dependent on the aggregates, the physical base; dependent on the physical base, the aggregates; dependent on the water element, non-resistive mind-produced matter, kamma-produced matter, derived matter; dependent on the water element, the femininity faculty… edible food… external… food-originated… temperature-originated… for non-percipient beings… dependent on the water element, non-resistive kamma-produced matter, derived matter; dependent on the aggregates accompanied by doubt and restlessness, the delusion accompanied by doubt and restlessness. (1)

(Appaṭighamūlakaṃ itarepi dve pañhā kātabbā. Ghaṭanepi tīṇi pañhā kātabbā. Ajjhattikā bāhirā mahābhūtā sabbe jānitvā kātabbā.)

61. Dependent on a resistive phenomenon, a resistive phenomenon arises by way of Non-Object Condition (all in brief)… by way of Non-Disappearance Condition.

Appaṭighaṃ [M 3.0110] dhammaṃ paccayā appaṭigho dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – appaṭighaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paccayā tayo khandhā appaṭighaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ…pe… dve khandhe…pe… paṭisandhikkhaṇe [T 3.0128] …pe… āpodhātuṃ paccayā appaṭighaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ, kaṭattārūpaṃ, upādārūpaṃ, āpodhātuṃ paccayā itthindriyaṃ…pe… kabaḷīkāro āhāro, vatthuṃ paccayā appaṭighā khandhā. (1)

66. Conditioned by an impact phenomenon, a non-impact phenomenon arises by way of object condition—conditioned by the eye base, eye-consciousness arises… and so on… conditioned by the body base, body-consciousness arises. (1)

Appaṭighaṃ dhammaṃ paccayā appaṭigho dhammo uppajjati ārammaṇapaccayā – appaṭighaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ [V 3.0133] paccayā tayo khandhā…pe… dve khandhe…pe… paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe… vatthuṃ paccayā appaṭighā khandhā. (1)

Conditioned by a non-impact phenomenon, a non-impact phenomenon arises by way of object condition—conditioned by one non-impact aggregate, three aggregates arise… and so on… two aggregates… and so on… at the moment of relinking… and so on… conditioned by the base, non-impact aggregates arise. (1)

Sappaṭighañca appaṭighañca dhammaṃ paccayā appaṭigho dhammo uppajjati ārammaṇapaccayā – cakkhuviññāṇasahagataṃ ekaṃ khandhañca cakkhāyatanañca paccayā tayo khandhā…pe… kāyaviññāṇasahagataṃ ekaṃ khandhañca kāyāyatanañca paccayā tayo khandhā…pe… adhipatipaccayā… (saṃkhittaṃ) avigatapaccayā.

Conditioned by an impact phenomenon and a non-impact phenomenon, a non-impact phenomenon arises by way of object condition—conditioned by one aggregate associated with eye-consciousness and the eye base, three aggregates arise… and so on… conditioned by one aggregate associated with body-consciousness and the body base, three aggregates arise… and so on… by dominance condition… (abbreviated) by non-disappearance condition.
