Hetupaccayo

Root Condition

68. Appaṭigho [M 3.0111][V 3.0134] dhammo appaṭighassa dhammassa hetupaccayena paccayo – appaṭighā hetū sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ appaṭighānañca cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ hetupaccayena paccayo; paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe…. (1)

68. A non-impact phenomenon is a condition for a non-impact phenomenon by way of root condition—non-impact roots are a condition for the associated aggregates and for non-impact mind-originated matter by way of root condition; at the moment of relinking… and so on… (1)

Appaṭigho dhammo sappaṭighassa dhammassa hetupaccayena paccayo – appaṭighā hetū sappaṭighānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ hetupaccayena paccayo; paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe…. (2)

A non-impact phenomenon is a condition for an impact phenomenon by way of root condition—non-impact roots are a condition for impact mind-originated matter by way of root condition; at the moment of relinking… and so on… (2)

Appaṭigho dhammo sappaṭighassa ca appaṭighassa ca dhammassa hetupaccayena paccayo – appaṭighā hetū sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ sappaṭighānañca appaṭighānañca cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ hetupaccayena paccayo; paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe…. (3)

A non-impact phenomenon is a condition for both an impact phenomenon and a non-impact phenomenon by way of root condition—non-impact roots are a condition for associated aggregates and for impact and non-impact mind-originated matter by way of root condition; at the moment of relinking… and so on… (3)

Ārammaṇapaccayo

Object Condition

69. Sappaṭigho dhammo appaṭighassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo – cakkhuṃ…pe… phoṭṭhabbe aniccato…pe… domanassaṃ uppajjati; dibbena cakkhunā rūpaṃ passati, dibbāya sotadhātuyā saddaṃ suṇāti. Rūpāyatanaṃ cakkhuviññāṇassa…pe… phoṭṭhabbāyatanaṃ kāyaviññāṇassa…pe… sappaṭighā khandhā iddhividhañāṇassa, pubbenivāsānussatiñāṇassa, anāgataṃsañāṇassa, āvajjanāya ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo. (1)

69. A phenomenon with impact is a condition for a phenomenon without impact by way of object condition—having considered the eye… and so on… the tangible as impermanent… and so on… sorrow arises; with the divine eye, one sees forms; with the divine ear element, one hears sounds. The form base is a condition for eye-consciousness… and so on… the tangible base is a condition for body-consciousness… and so on… aggregates with impact are a condition for the knowledge of psychic powers, the knowledge of recollection of past lives, the knowledge of the future, and for adverting, by way of object condition. (1)

Appaṭigho dhammo appaṭighassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo – dānaṃ…pe… sīlaṃ…pe… uposathakammaṃ katvā taṃ [T 3.0130] paccavekkhati, pubbe suciṇṇāni paccavekkhati, jhānā vuṭṭhahitvā [V 3.0135] jhānaṃ paccavekkhati, ariyā maggā vuṭṭhahitvā maggaṃ paccavekkhanti, phalaṃ paccavekkhanti, nibbānaṃ paccavekkhanti; nibbānaṃ gotrabhussa, vodānassa, maggassa, phalassa, āvajjanāya ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo; ariyā pahīne kilese paccavekkhanti, vikkhambhite kilese paccavekkhanti, pubbe samudāciṇṇe kilese jānanti; vatthuṃ…pe… itthindriyaṃ… purisindriyaṃ… jīvitindriyaṃ… āpodhātuṃ, kabaḷīkāraṃ āhāraṃ aniccato…pe… domanassaṃ uppajjati; cetopariyañāṇena appaṭighacittasamaṅgissa cittaṃ jānāti, ākāsānañcāyatanaṃ [M 3.0112] viññāṇañcāyatanassa…pe… ākiñcaññāyatanaṃ nevasaññānāsaññāyatanassa…pe… appaṭighā khandhā iddhividhañāṇassa, cetopariyañāṇassa, pubbenivāsānussatiñāṇassa yathākammūpagañāṇassa, anāgataṃsañāṇassa, āvajjanāya ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo. (1)

A phenomenon without impact is a condition for a phenomenon without impact by way of object condition—having given a gift… and so on… observed moral conduct… and so on… undertaken the Uposatha observance, one reflects upon it; one reflects upon past good deeds; emerging from jhāna, one reflects upon the jhāna; the noble ones, having emerged from the path, reflect upon the path; they reflect upon the fruit; they reflect upon Nibbāna; Nibbāna is a condition for change-of-lineage, for purification, for the path, for the fruit, and for adverting, by way of object condition; the noble ones reflect upon the abandoned defilements, they reflect upon the suppressed defilements, they know the defilements previously accumulated; having considered the physical base… and so on… the female faculty… the male faculty… the life faculty… the water element, and physical nutriment as impermanent… and so on… sorrow arises; with the knowledge of others’ minds, one knows the mind of one endowed with a mind without impact; the base of the infinitude of space is a condition for the base of the infinitude of consciousness… and so on… the base of nothingness is a condition for the base of neither perception nor non-perception… and so on… aggregates without impact are a condition for the knowledge of psychic powers, the knowledge of others’ minds, the knowledge of recollection of past lives, the knowledge of the passing away and rebirth of beings, the knowledge of the future, and for adverting, by way of object condition. (1)

Adhipatipaccayo

Dominance Condition

70. Sappaṭigho dhammo appaṭighassa dhammassa adhipatipaccayena paccayo. Ārammaṇādhipati – cakkhuṃ…pe… phoṭṭhabbe garuṃ katvā assādeti abhinandati, taṃ garuṃ katvā rāgo uppajjati, diṭṭhi uppajjati. (1)

70. A phenomenon with impact is a condition for a phenomenon without impact by way of dominance condition. Object-dominance: having esteemed the eye… and so on… the tangible, one savors and delights in it; having esteemed it, lust arises, wrong view arises. (1)

Appaṭigho dhammo appaṭighassa dhammassa adhipatipaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇādhipati, sahajātādhipati. Ārammaṇādhipati – dānaṃ…pe… sīlaṃ…pe… uposathakammaṃ katvā taṃ garuṃ katvā paccavekkhati, pubbe suciṇṇāni garuṃ katvā paccavekkhati, jhānā vuṭṭhahitvā jhānaṃ garuṃ katvā paccavekkhati, ariyā maggā vuṭṭhahitvā maggaṃ [T 3.0131] garuṃ katvā paccavekkhanti, phalaṃ garuṃ katvā paccavekkhanti, nibbānaṃ garuṃ katvā paccavekkhanti; nibbānaṃ gotrabhussa, vodānassa, maggassa, phalassa adhipatipaccayena paccayo; vatthuṃ…pe… itthindriyaṃ… purisindriyaṃ… jīvitindriyaṃ… āpodhātuṃ, kabaḷīkāraṃ āhāraṃ garuṃ katvā assādeti abhinandati, taṃ garuṃ katvā rāgo uppajjati, diṭṭhi uppajjati. Sahajātādhipati – appaṭighādhipati sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ appaṭighānañca cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ adhipatipaccayena paccayo. (1)

A phenomenon without impact is a condition for a phenomenon without impact by way of dominance condition: object-dominance and co-arisen dominance. Object-dominance: having given a gift… and so on… observed moral conduct… and so on… undertaken the Uposatha observance, esteeming it, one reflects on it; esteeming previously performed good deeds, one reflects on them; having emerged from jhāna, esteeming the jhāna, one reflects on it; the noble ones, having emerged from the path, esteeming the path, reflect on it; esteeming the fruit, they reflect on it; esteeming Nibbāna, they reflect on it. Nibbāna is a condition for change-of-lineage, for purification, for the path, and for the fruit, by way of dominance condition. Having esteemed the physical base… and so on… the female faculty… the male faculty… the life faculty… the water element, and physical nutriment, one savors and delights in it; having esteemed it, lust arises, wrong view arises. Co-arisen dominance: a dominant factor without impact is a condition for its associated aggregates and for mind-originated matter without impact by way of dominance condition. (1)

Appaṭigho [V 3.0136] dhammo sappaṭighassa dhammassa adhipatipaccayena paccayo. Sahajātādhipati – appaṭighādhipati sappaṭighānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ adhipatipaccayena paccayo. (1)

A phenomenon without impact is a condition for a phenomenon with impact by way of dominance condition. Co-arisen dominance: a dominant factor without impact is a condition for mind-originated matter with impact by way of dominance condition. (1)

Appaṭigho dhammo sappaṭighassa ca appaṭighassa ca dhammassa adhipatipaccayena paccayo. Sahajātādhipati – appaṭighādhipati sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ sappaṭighānañca appaṭighānañca cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ adhipatipaccayena paccayo. (3)

A phenomenon without impact is a condition for a phenomenon with impact and a phenomenon without impact by way of dominance condition. Co-arisen dominance: a dominant factor without impact is a condition for its associated aggregates and for mind-originated matter with and without impact by way of dominance condition. (3)

Anantarapaccayo

Proximity Condition

71. Appaṭigho dhammo appaṭighassa dhammassa anantarapaccayena paccayo – purimā purimā appaṭighā khandhā…pe… phalasamāpattiyā anantarapaccayena paccayo.

71. A phenomenon without impact is a condition for a phenomenon without impact by way of proximity condition—the preceding, preceding aggregates without impact… are a condition for the attainment of fruition by way of proximity condition.

Samanantarapaccayo

Contiguity Condition

72. Appaṭigho [M 3.0113] dhammo appaṭighassa dhammassa samanantarapaccayena paccayo…pe….

72. A phenomenon without impact is a condition for a phenomenon without impact by way of contiguity condition… and so on….

Sahajātapaccayādi

Co-arisen Condition, etc.

73. Sappaṭigho dhammo sappaṭighassa dhammassa sahajātapaccayena paccayo… nava… aññamaññapaccayena paccayo… cha… nissayapaccayena paccayo… nava.

73. A phenomenon with impact is a condition for a phenomenon with impact by way of co-arisen condition… nine… by way of mutuality condition… six… by way of support condition… nine.

Upanissayapaccayo

Decisive Support Condition

74. Sappaṭigho [T 3.0132] dhammo appaṭighassa dhammassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇūpanissayo, pakatūpanissayo…pe…. Pakatūpanissayo – utuṃ, senāsanaṃ upanissāya dānaṃ deti…pe… saṅghaṃ bhindati; utu, senāsanaṃ saddhāya…pe… phalasamāpattiyā upanissayapaccayena paccayo. (1)

74. A phenomenon with impact is a condition for a phenomenon without impact by way of decisive support condition: object decisive support and natural decisive support… and so on…. Natural decisive support: depending on the weather or lodging, one gives a gift… and so on… splits the Saṅgha; weather and lodging are a condition for faith… and so on… for the attainment of fruition by way of decisive support condition. (1)

Appaṭigho dhammo appaṭighassa dhammassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇūpanissayo[V 3.0137], anantarūpanissayo, pakatūpanissayo…pe…. Pakatūpanissayo – saddhaṃ upanissāya dānaṃ deti…pe… diṭṭhiṃ gaṇhāti; sīlaṃ…pe… kāyikaṃ sukhaṃ, kāyikaṃ dukkhaṃ, bhojanaṃ upanissāya dānaṃ deti…pe… saṅghaṃ bhindati; saddhā…pe… bhojanaṃ saddhāya…pe… phalasamāpattiyā upanissayapaccayena paccayo. (1)

A phenomenon without impact is a condition for a phenomenon without impact by way of decisive support condition—object decisive support, proximity decisive support, and natural decisive support… and so on…. Natural decisive support: depending on faith, one gives a gift… and so on… grasps a wrong view; depending on moral conduct… and so on… bodily pleasure, bodily pain, or food, one gives a gift… and so on… splits the Saṅgha; faith… and so on… food are a condition for faith… and so on… for the attainment of fruition by way of decisive support condition. (1)

Purejātapaccayo

Prenascence Condition

75. Sappaṭigho dhammo appaṭighassa dhammassa purejātapaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇapurejātaṃ, vatthupurejātaṃ. Ārammaṇapurejātaṃ – cakkhuṃ…pe… phoṭṭhabbe aniccato…pe… domanassaṃ uppajjati; dibbena cakkhunā rūpaṃ passati, dibbāya sotadhātuyā saddaṃ suṇāti, rūpāyatanaṃ cakkhuviññāṇassa…pe… phoṭṭhabbāyatanaṃ kāyaviññāṇassa purejātapaccayena paccayo. Vatthupurejātaṃ – cakkhāyatanaṃ cakkhuviññāṇassa…pe… kāyāyatanaṃ kāyaviññāṇassa purejātapaccayena paccayo. (1)

75. A phenomenon with impact is a condition for a phenomenon without impact by way of the prenascent condition—object prenascent, base prenascent. Object prenascent: regarding the eye... the tangible as impermanent... sorrow arises; with the divine eye one sees forms, with the divine ear element one hears sounds; the visible form base is a condition for eye-consciousness... the tangible base is a condition for body-consciousness by way of the prenascent condition. Base prenascent: the eye base is a condition for eye-consciousness... the body base is a condition for body-consciousness by way of the prenascent condition. (1)

Appaṭigho dhammo appaṭighassa dhammassa purejātapaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇapurejātaṃ, vatthupurejātaṃ. Ārammaṇapurejātaṃ – vatthuṃ…pe… itthindriyaṃ, purisindriyaṃ[T 3.0133], jīvitindriyaṃ, āpodhātuṃ, kabaḷīkāraṃ āhāraṃ aniccato [M 3.0114]…pe… domanassaṃ uppajjati. Vatthupurejātaṃ – vatthu appaṭighānaṃ khandhānaṃ purejātapaccayena paccayo. (1)

A phenomenon without impact is a condition for a phenomenon without impact by way of the prenascent condition—object prenascent, base prenascent. Object prenascent: regarding the base... the female faculty, male faculty, life faculty, water element, physical food as impermanent... sorrow arises. Base prenascent: the base is a condition for the aggregates without impact by way of the prenascent condition. (1)

Sappaṭigho ca appaṭigho ca dhammā appaṭighassa dhammassa purejātapaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇapurejātaṃ, vatthupurejātaṃ. Cakkhāyatanañca vatthu ca…pe… phoṭṭhabbāyatanañca vatthu ca appaṭighānaṃ khandhānaṃ purejātapaccayena paccayo. (1)

Both phenomena with impact and phenomena without impact are conditions for a phenomenon without impact by way of the prenascent condition—object prenascent, base prenascent. The eye base and the base... the tangible base and the base are conditions for the aggregates without impact by way of the prenascent condition. (1)

Pacchājātapaccayo

Postnascent Condition

76. Appaṭigho dhammo appaṭighassa dhammassa pacchājātapaccayena paccayo – pacchājātā appaṭighā khandhā purejātassa imassa appaṭighassa kāyassa pacchājātapaccayena paccayo. (Mūlaṃ kātabbaṃ) pacchājātā appaṭighā khandhā purejātassa imassa sappaṭighassa kāyassa pacchājātapaccayena paccayo. (Mūlaṃ kātabbaṃ) pacchājātā appaṭighā khandhā purejātassa imassa [V 3.0138] sappaṭighassa ca appaṭighassa ca kāyassa pacchājātapaccayena paccayo (dvinnampi mūlā kātabbā). (3)

76. A phenomenon without impact is a condition for a phenomenon without impact by way of the postnascent condition—subsequent aggregates without impact are a condition for this pre-arisen body without impact by way of the postnascent condition. (The root passage should be supplied.) Subsequent aggregates without impact are a condition for this pre-arisen body with impact by way of the postnascent condition. (The root passage should be supplied.) Subsequent aggregates without impact are a condition for this pre-arisen body with impact and without impact by way of the postnascent condition. (The root passages for both should be supplied.) (3)

Āsevanapaccayo

Repetition Condition

77. Appaṭigho dhammo appaṭighassa dhammassa āsevanapaccayena paccayo – purimā purimā appaṭighā khandhā…pe… vodānaṃ maggassa āsevanapaccayena paccayo. (1)

77. A phenomenon without impact is a condition for a phenomenon without impact by way of the repetition condition—preceding aggregates without impact…and so on… purification is a condition for the path by way of the repetition condition. (1)

Kammapaccayo

Kamma-condition

78. Appaṭigho dhammo appaṭighassa dhammassa kammapaccayena paccayo – sahajātā, nānākkhaṇikā. Sahajātā – appaṭighā cetanā sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ appaṭighānañca cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ kammapaccayena paccayo; paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe…. Nānākkhaṇikā – appaṭighā cetanā vipākānaṃ khandhānaṃ [T 3.0134] appaṭighānañca kaṭattārūpānaṃ kammapaccayena paccayo. (1)

78. A phenomenon without impact is a condition for a phenomenon without impact by way of kamma-condition—conascent, at a different moment. Conascent: volition without impact is a condition for the associated aggregates and for the mind-originated material phenomena without impact by way of kamma-condition; at the moment of rebirth-linking…and so on…. At a different moment: volition without impact is a condition for the resultant aggregates and for the kamma-produced material phenomena without impact by way of kamma-condition. (1)

Appaṭigho dhammo sappaṭighassa dhammassa kammapaccayena paccayo – sahajātā, nānākkhaṇikā. Sahajātā – appaṭighā cetanā sappaṭighānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ kammapaccayena paccayo; paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe…. Nānākkhaṇikā – appaṭighā cetanā sappaṭighānaṃ kaṭattārūpānaṃ kammapaccayena paccayo. (2)

A phenomenon without impact is a condition for a phenomenon with impact by way of kamma-condition—conascent, at a different moment. Conascent: volition without impact is a condition for the mind-originated material phenomena with impact by way of kamma-condition; at the moment of rebirth-linking…and so on…. At a different moment: volition without impact is a condition for the kamma-produced material phenomena with impact by way of kamma-condition. (2)

Appaṭigho [M 3.0115] dhammo sappaṭighassa ca appaṭighassa ca dhammassa kammapaccayena paccayo – sahajātā, nānākkhaṇikā. Sahajātā – appaṭighā cetanā sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ sappaṭighānañca appaṭighānañca cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ kammapaccayena paccayo; paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe…. Nānākkhaṇikā – appaṭighā cetanā vipākānaṃ khandhānaṃ sappaṭighānañca appaṭighānañca kaṭattārūpānaṃ kammapaccayena paccayo. (3)

A phenomenon without impact is a condition for both phenomena with impact and without impact by way of kamma-condition—conascent, at a different moment. Conascent: volition without impact is a condition for the associated aggregates and for mind-originated material phenomena with impact and without impact by way of kamma-condition; at the moment of rebirth-linking…and so on. At a different moment: volition without impact is a condition for the resultant aggregates and for kamma-produced material phenomena with impact and without impact by way of kamma-condition. (3)

Vipākapaccayo

Result-condition

79. Appaṭigho [V 3.0139] dhammo appaṭighassa dhammassa vipākapaccayena paccayo – vipāko appaṭigho…pe… tīṇi.

79. A phenomenon without impact is a condition for a phenomenon without impact by way of result-condition—a resultant phenomenon without impact…and so on… three (cases).

Āhārapaccayo

Nutriment-condition

80. Appaṭigho dhammo appaṭighassa dhammassa āhārapaccayena paccayo – appaṭighā āhārā sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ appaṭighānañca cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ āhārapaccayena paccayo; paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe… kabaḷīkāro āhāro imassa appaṭighassa kāyassa āhārapaccayena paccayo (avasesā dvepi pañhā kātabbā, paṭisandhi kabaḷīkāro āhāro dvīsupi kātabbo agge). (3)

80. A phenomenon without impact is a condition for a phenomenon without impact by way of nutriment-condition—nutriments without impact are a condition for the associated aggregates and for mind-originated material phenomena without impact by way of nutriment-condition; at the moment of rebirth-linking…and so on… physical food is a condition for this body without impact by way of nutriment-condition (the remaining two questions should be supplied; physical food at rebirth-linking should be supplied in both cases, with priority). (3)

Indriyapaccayādi

Faculty-condition, etc.

81. Sappaṭigho dhammo appaṭighassa dhammassa indriyapaccayena paccayo – cakkhundriyaṃ cakkhuviññāṇassa…pe… kāyindriyaṃ kāyaviññāṇassa indriyapaccayena paccayo. (1)

81. A phenomenon with impact is a condition for a phenomenon without impact by way of faculty-condition—the eye-faculty is a condition for eye-consciousness…and so on… the body-faculty is a condition for body-consciousness by way of faculty-condition. (1)

Appaṭigho dhammo appaṭighassa dhammassa indriyapaccayena paccayo… tīṇi (tīsupi jīvitindriyaṃ agge kātabbaṃ)[T 3.0135]. (3)

A phenomenon without impact is a condition for a phenomenon without impact by way of the faculty-condition… three (in all three, the life-faculty should be supplied as foremost). (3)

Sappaṭigho ca appaṭigho ca dhammā appaṭighassa dhammassa indriyapaccayena paccayo – cakkhundriyañca cakkhuviññāṇañca cakkhuviññāṇasahagatānaṃ khandhānaṃ indriyapaccayena paccayo…pe… kāyindriyañca kāyaviññāṇañca kāyaviññāṇasahagatānaṃ khandhānaṃ indriyapaccayena paccayo… jhānapaccayena paccayo… tīṇi… maggapaccayena paccayo… tīṇi… sampayuttapaccayena paccayo… ekaṃ.

Both phenomena with impact and without impact are conditions for a phenomenon without impact by way of the faculty-condition—the eye-faculty and eye-consciousness are conditions for the aggregates conjoined with eye-consciousness by way of the faculty-condition…and so on… the body-faculty and body-consciousness are conditions for the aggregates conjoined with body-consciousness by way of the faculty-condition… by way of the jhāna-condition… three… by way of the path-condition… three… by way of the association-condition… one.

Vippayuttapaccayo

Dissociation-condition

82. Sappaṭigho [M 3.0116][V 3.0140] dhammo appaṭighassa dhammassa vippayuttapaccayena paccayo. Purejātaṃ – cakkhāyatanaṃ cakkhuviññāṇassa…pe… kāyāyatanaṃ kāyaviññāṇassa vippayuttapaccayena paccayo. (1)

82. A phenomenon with impact is a condition for a phenomenon without impact by way of the dissociation-condition. Pre-arisen—the eye-base is a condition for eye-consciousness…and so on… the body-base is a condition for body-consciousness by way of the dissociation-condition. (1)

Appaṭigho dhammo appaṭighassa dhammassa vippayuttapaccayena paccayo – sahajātaṃ, purejātaṃ, pacchājātaṃ. Sahajātā – appaṭighā khandhā appaṭighānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ vippayuttapaccayena paccayo; paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe… khandhā vatthussa vippayuttapaccayena paccayo, vatthu khandhānaṃ vippayuttapaccayena paccayo. Purejātaṃ – vatthu appaṭighānaṃ khandhānaṃ vippayuttapaccayena paccayo. Pacchājātā – appaṭighā khandhā purejātassa imassa appaṭighassa kāyassa vippayuttapaccayena paccayo. (1)

A non-resistive phenomenon is a condition for a non-resistive phenomenon by way of dissociation-condition—conascent, pre-arisen, post-arisen. Conascent—non-resistive aggregates are a condition for non-resistive mind-originated material phenomena by way of dissociation-condition; at the moment of rebirth-linking…pe… the aggregates are a condition for the physical base by way of dissociation-condition, and the physical base is a condition for the aggregates by way of dissociation-condition. Pre-arisen—the physical base is a condition for non-resistive aggregates by way of dissociation-condition. Post-arisen—non-resistive aggregates are a condition for this pre-arisen non-resistive body by way of dissociation-condition. (1)

Appaṭigho dhammo sappaṭighassa dhammassa vippayuttapaccayena paccayo – sahajātaṃ, pacchājātaṃ. Sahajātā – appaṭighā khandhā sappaṭighānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ vippayuttapaccayena paccayo; paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe…. Pacchājātā – appaṭighā khandhā purejātassa imassa sappaṭighassa kāyassa vippayuttapaccayena paccayo. (2)

A non-resistive phenomenon is a condition for a resistive phenomenon by way of dissociation-condition—conascent, post-arisen. Conascent—non-resistive aggregates are a condition for resistive mind-originated material phenomena by way of dissociation-condition; at the moment of rebirth-linking…pe…. Post-arisen—non-resistive aggregates are a condition for this pre-arisen resistive body by way of dissociation-condition. (2)

Appaṭigho dhammo sappaṭighassa ca appaṭighassa ca dhammassa vippayuttapaccayena paccayo – sahajātaṃ, pacchājātaṃ. Sahajātā – appaṭighā khandhā sappaṭighānañca appaṭighānañca cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ vippayuttapaccayena paccayo; paṭisandhikkhaṇe [T 3.0136] …pe…. Pacchājātā – appaṭighā khandhā purejātassa imassa sappaṭighassa ca appaṭighassa ca kāyassa vippayuttapaccayena paccayo. (3)

A non-resistive phenomenon is a condition for both resistive and non-resistive phenomena by way of dissociation-condition—conascent, post-arisen. Conascent—non-resistive aggregates are a condition for both resistive and non-resistive mind-originated material phenomena by way of dissociation-condition; at the moment of rebirth-linking…pe…. Post-arisen—non-resistive aggregates are a condition for this pre-arisen resistive and non-resistive body by way of dissociation-condition. (3)

Atthipaccayo

Presence Condition

83. Sappaṭigho dhammo sappaṭighassa dhammassa atthipaccayena paccayo… ekaṃ (paṭiccasadisā paṭhamapañhā). (1)

83. A resistive phenomenon is a condition for a resistive phenomenon by way of the presence condition… one (similar to the first question on conditionality). (1)

Sappaṭigho [V 3.0141] dhammo appaṭighassa dhammassa atthipaccayena paccayo sahajātaṃ, purejātaṃ. Sahajātā – sappaṭighā mahābhūtā āpodhātuyā atthipaccayena paccayo, sappaṭighā mahābhūtā appaṭighānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ kaṭattārūpānaṃ upādārūpānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo; phoṭṭhabbāyatanaṃ itthindriyassa…pe… kabaḷīkārassa āhārassa atthipaccayena paccayo[M 3.0117]; bāhiraṃ… āhārasamuṭṭhānaṃ… utusamuṭṭhānaṃ… asaññasattānaṃ…pe…. Purejātaṃ – cakkhuṃ…pe… phoṭṭhabbe aniccato…pe… domanassaṃ uppajjati; dibbena cakkhunā rūpaṃ passati, dibbāya sotadhātuyā saddaṃ suṇāti, rūpāyatanañca cakkhāyatanañca cakkhuviññāṇassa…pe… phoṭṭhabbāyatanañca kāyāyatanañca kāyaviññāṇassa atthipaccayena paccayo[T 3.0137]. (2)

A resistive phenomenon is a condition for a non-resistive phenomenon by way of the presence condition—conascent, pre-arisen. Conascent—resistive great elements are a condition for the water element by way of the presence condition; resistive great elements are a condition for non-resistive mind-originated material phenomena, karma-produced material phenomena, and derived material phenomena by way of the presence condition; the tangible base is a condition for the femininity faculty…pe… for morsel food by way of the presence condition; external… food-originated… temperature-originated… for non-percipient beings…pe…. Pre-arisen—the eye…pe… the tangible being regarded as impermanent…pe… sorrow arises; with the divine eye, one sees forms; with the divine ear element, one hears sounds; the visible-form base and the eye base are conditions for eye-consciousness…pe… the tangible base and the body base are conditions for body-consciousness by way of the presence condition. (2)

Sappaṭigho dhammo sappaṭighassa ca appaṭighassa ca dhammassa atthipaccayena paccayo – sappaṭighaṃ ekaṃ mahābhūtaṃ dvinnaṃ mahābhūtānaṃ āpodhātuyā ca atthipaccayena paccayo…pe… (paṭiccasadisaṃ yāva asaññasattā). (3)

A resistive phenomenon is a condition for both resistive and non-resistive phenomena by way of the presence condition—one resistive great element is a condition for two great elements and for the water element by way of the presence condition…pe… (similar to the Paṭicca section, up to non-percipient beings). (3)

84. Appaṭigho dhammo appaṭighassa dhammassa atthipaccayena paccayo – sahajātaṃ, purejātaṃ, pacchājātaṃ, āhāraṃ, indriyaṃ. Sahajāto – appaṭigho eko khandho tiṇṇannaṃ khandhānaṃ…pe… (yāva asaññasattā). Purejātaṃ – vatthuṃ…pe… itthindriyaṃ… purisindriyaṃ… jīvitindriyaṃ… āpodhātuṃ… kabaḷīkāraṃ āhāraṃ aniccato…pe… domanassaṃ uppajjati; vatthu appaṭighānaṃ khandhānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo. Pacchājātā – appaṭighā khandhā purejātassa imassa appaṭighassa kāyassa atthipaccayena paccayo; kabaḷīkāro āhāro imassa appaṭighassa kāyassa atthipaccayena paccayo; rūpajīvitindriyaṃ appaṭighānaṃ kaṭattārūpānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo. (1)

84. A non-resistive phenomenon is a condition for a non-resistive phenomenon by way of the presence condition—conascent, pre-arisen, post-arisen, nutriment, and faculty. Conascent—one non-resistive aggregate is a condition for the other three aggregates…pe… (up to non-percipient beings). Pre-arisen—the base…pe… the femininity faculty… the masculinity faculty… the life faculty… the water element… morsel food being regarded as impermanent…pe… sorrow arises; the base is a condition for the non-resistive aggregates by way of the presence condition. Post-arisen—the non-resistive aggregates are a condition for this pre-arisen non-resistive body by way of the presence condition; morsel food is a condition for this non-resistive body by way of the presence condition; the material life faculty is a condition for the non-resistive karma-produced material phenomena by way of the presence condition. (1)

Appaṭigho dhammo sappaṭighassa dhammassa atthipaccayena paccayo – sahajātaṃ, pacchājātaṃ, āhāraṃ, indriyaṃ. Sahajātā – appaṭighā khandhā sappaṭighānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo; paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe… āpodhātu sappaṭighānaṃ mahābhūtānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo; āpodhātu sappaṭighānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ kaṭattārūpānaṃ upādārūpānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo; āpodhātu cakkhāyatanassa…pe… phoṭṭhabbāyatanassa atthipaccayena [V 3.0142] paccayo; bāhiraṃ, āhārasamuṭṭhānaṃ, utusamuṭṭhānaṃ, asaññasattānaṃ…pe…. Pacchājātā – appaṭighā [T 3.0138] khandhā purejātassa imassa sappaṭighassa kāyassa atthipaccayena paccayo; kabaḷīkāro āhāro imassa sappaṭighassa kāyassa atthipaccayena paccayo; rūpajīvitindriyaṃ sappaṭighānaṃ kaṭattārūpānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo. (2)

A non-resistive phenomenon is a condition for a resistive phenomenon by way of the presence condition—conascent, post-arisen, nutriment, and faculty. Conascent—non-resistive aggregates are a condition for resistive mind-originated material phenomena by way of the presence condition; at the moment of rebirth-linking…pe… the water element is a condition for the resistive great elements by way of the presence condition; the water element is a condition for resistive mind-originated material phenomena, karma-produced material phenomena, and derived material phenomena by way of the presence condition; the water element is a condition for the eye base…pe… the tangible base by way of the presence condition; external, food-originated, temperature-originated, for non-percipient beings…pe…. Post-arisen—non-resistive aggregates are a condition for this pre-arisen resistive body by way of the presence condition; morsel food is a condition for this resistive body by way of the presence condition; the material life faculty is a condition for resistive karma-produced material phenomena by way of the presence condition. (2)

Appaṭigho dhammo sappaṭighassa ca appaṭighassa ca dhammassa atthipaccayena paccayo – sahajātaṃ, pacchājātaṃ, āhāraṃ, indriyaṃ. Sahajāto – appaṭigho [M 3.0118] eko khandho tiṇṇannaṃ khandhānaṃ sappaṭighānañca appaṭighānañca…pe… (paṭiccasadisaṃ yāva asaññasattā). Pacchājātā – appaṭighā khandhā purejātassa imassa sappaṭighassa ca appaṭighassa ca kāyassa atthipaccayena paccayo; kabaḷīkāro āhāro imassa sappaṭighassa ca appaṭighassa ca kāyassa atthipaccayena paccayo; rūpajīvitindriyaṃ sappaṭighānañca appaṭighānañca kaṭattārūpānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo. (3)

A non-resistant phenomenon is a condition for a resistant phenomenon and for a non-resistant phenomenon by way of presence condition: co-nascence, post-nascence, nutriment, and faculty. Co-nascence: one non-resistant aggregate is a condition for the other three aggregates, and for both resistant and non-resistant phenomena…pe… (similar to the Paṭicca section, up to the non-percipient beings). Post-nascence: the non-resistant aggregates are a condition for this pre-existent body, which is both resistant and non-resistant, by way of presence condition; edible food is a condition for this body, which is both resistant and non-resistant, by way of presence condition; the material life faculty is a condition for karma-produced material phenomena, which are both resistant and non-resistant, by way of presence condition. (3)

85. Sappaṭigho ca appaṭigho ca dhammā sappaṭighassa dhammassa atthipaccayena paccayo (paṭiccasadisaṃ yāva asaññasattā). (1)

85. Resistant and non-resistant phenomena are a condition for a resistant phenomenon by way of presence condition (similar to the Paṭicca section, up to the non-percipient beings). (1)

Sappaṭigho ca appaṭigho ca dhammā appaṭighassa dhammassa atthipaccayena paccayo – sahajātaṃ, purejātaṃ. Sahajātā – appaṭighā khandhā ca mahābhūtā ca appaṭighānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ…pe… (paṭiccasadisaṃ yāva asaññasattā). Sahajāto – cakkhuviññāṇasahagato eko khandho ca cakkhāyatanañca tiṇṇannaṃ khandhānaṃ…pe… dve khandhā ca…pe… kāyaviññāṇasahagato eko khandho ca kāyāyatanañca tiṇṇannaṃ khandhānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo…pe… dve [T 3.0139] khandhā ca…pe…. (2)

Resistant and non-resistant phenomena are a condition for a non-resistant phenomenon by way of presence condition: co-nascence and pre-nascence. Co-nascence: the non-resistant aggregates and the great elements are a condition for non-resistant mind-produced material phenomena…pe… (similar to the Paṭicca section, up to the non-percipient beings). Co-nascence: one aggregate associated with eye-consciousness and the eye base are a condition for the three aggregates…pe… two aggregates…pe… one aggregate associated with body-consciousness and the body base are a condition for the three aggregates by way of presence condition…pe… two aggregates…pe…. (2)

Sappaṭigho ca appaṭigho ca dhammā sappaṭighassa ca appaṭighassa ca dhammassa atthipaccayena paccayo (paṭiccasadisaṃ). (3)

Resistant and non-resistant phenomena are a condition for a resistant phenomenon and for a non-resistant phenomenon by way of presence condition (similar to the Paṭicca section). (3)

102. Rūpiṃ dhammaṃ paccayā arūpī dhammo uppajjati ārammaṇapaccayā – cakkhāyatanaṃ paccayā cakkhuviññāṇaṃ…pe… kāyāyatanaṃ paccayā kāyaviññāṇaṃ, vatthuṃ paccayā arūpino khandhā; paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe…. (1)

102. An immaterial phenomenon arises in dependence on a material phenomenon by way of object condition: in dependence on the eye base, eye-consciousness arises…pe… in dependence on the body base, body-consciousness arises; in dependence on the physical base, the immaterial aggregates arise; at the moment of rebirth-linking…pe…. (1)

Arūpiṃ dhammaṃ paccayā arūpī dhammo uppajjati ārammaṇapaccayā – arūpiṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ…pe… dve khandhe…pe…. (2)

An immaterial phenomenon arises in dependence on an immaterial phenomenon by way of object condition: in dependence on one immaterial aggregate…pe… in dependence on two aggregates…pe…. (2)

Rūpiñca arūpiñca dhammaṃ paccayā arūpī dhammo uppajjati ārammaṇapaccayā – cakkhuviññāṇasahagataṃ ekaṃ khandhañca cakkhāyatanañca paccayā tayo khandhā…pe… dve khandhe [V 3.0151] …pe… kāyaviññāṇasahagataṃ…pe… arūpiṃ ekaṃ khandhañca vatthuñca paccayā tayo khandhā…pe… dve khandhe…pe… (saṃkhittaṃ). (3)

An immaterial phenomenon arises in dependence on a material and an immaterial phenomenon by way of object condition: in dependence on one aggregate associated with eye-consciousness and the eye base, three aggregates arise…pe… two aggregates…pe… in dependence on one aggregate associated with body-consciousness…pe… in dependence on one immaterial aggregate and the physical base, three aggregates arise…pe… two aggregates…pe… (in brief). (3)

1. Paccayānulomaṃ

1. The Positive of Conditions

2. Saṅkhyāvāro

2. The Enumeration Section

Suddhaṃ

The Pure

103. Hetuyā nava, ārammaṇe tīṇi, adhipatiyā nava, anantare tīṇi, samanantare tīṇi, sahajāte nava, aññamaññe cha, nissaye [T 3.0145] nava, upanissaye tīṇi, purejāte tīṇi, āsevane tīṇi, kamme nava…pe… magge nava, sampayutte tīṇi, vippayutte nava, atthiyā nava, natthiyā tīṇi, vigate tīṇi, avigate nava.

103. By way of root condition, nine; by way of object condition, three; by way of dominance condition, nine; by way of contiguity condition, three; by way of immediacy condition, three; by way of co-nascence condition, nine; by way of mutuality condition, six; by way of dependence condition, nine; by way of strong dependence condition, three; by way of prenascence condition, three; by way of repetition condition, three; by way of kamma condition, nine…pe… by way of path condition, nine; by way of association condition, three; by way of dissociation condition, nine; by way of presence condition, nine; by way of absence condition, three; by way of disappearance condition, three; by way of non-disappearance condition, nine.

Anulomaṃ.

The Positive.

2. Paccayapaccanīyaṃ

2. The Negative of Conditions

1. Vibhaṅgavāro

1. The Analysis Section

Nahetupaccayo

Non-Root Condition

104. Rūpiṃ [M 3.0125] dhammaṃ paccayā rūpī dhammo uppajjati nahetupaccayā – ekaṃ mahābhūtaṃ…pe… asaññasattānaṃ ekaṃ mahābhūtaṃ…pe…. (1)

104. A material phenomenon arises conditioned by a material phenomenon by way of non-root condition: one great element… for non-percipient beings, one great element…. (1)

Rūpiṃ dhammaṃ paccayā arūpī dhammo uppajjati nahetupaccayā – cakkhāyatanaṃ paccayā cakkhuviññāṇaṃ…pe… kāyāyatanaṃ paccayā kāyaviññāṇaṃ, vatthuṃ paccayā ahetukā arūpino [V 3.0152] khandhā; ahetukapaṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe… vatthuṃ paccayā vicikicchāsahagato uddhaccasahagato moho. (2)

An immaterial phenomenon arises conditioned by a material phenomenon by way of non-root condition: the eye-base conditions eye-consciousness… the body-base conditions body-consciousness; the physical base conditions rootless immaterial aggregates; at the moment of rootless rebirth-linking… the physical base conditions doubt-accompanied, restlessness-accompanied delusion. (2)

Rūpiṃ dhammaṃ paccayā rūpī ca arūpī ca dhammā uppajjanti nahetupaccayā (pavattipaṭisandhi kātabbā). (3)

Both material and immaterial phenomena arise conditioned by a material phenomenon by way of non-root condition (the course of existence and rebirth-linking should be applied). (3)

105. Arūpiṃ dhammaṃ paccayā arūpī dhammo uppajjati nahetupaccayā – ahetukaṃ arūpiṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ…pe… paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe… vicikicchāsahagate uddhaccasahagate khandhe paccayā vicikicchāsahagato uddhaccasahagato moho. (1)

105. An immaterial phenomenon arises conditioned by an immaterial phenomenon by way of non-root condition: one rootless immaterial aggregate… at the moment of rebirth-linking… the aggregates accompanied by doubt and restlessness condition doubt-accompanied, restlessness-accompanied delusion. (1)

Arūpiṃ dhammaṃ paccayā rūpī dhammo uppajjati nahetupaccayā – ahetuke arūpino khandhe paccayā cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ; paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe…. (2)

A material phenomenon arises conditioned by an immaterial phenomenon by way of non-root condition: rootless immaterial aggregates condition mind-originated materiality; at the moment of rebirth-linking…. (2)

Arūpiṃ dhammaṃ paccayā rūpī ca arūpī ca dhammā uppajjanti nahetupaccayā – ahetukaṃ arūpiṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paccayā tayo khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ…pe… dve khandhe…pe… paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe…. (3)

Both material and immaterial phenomena arise conditioned by an immaterial phenomenon by way of non-root condition: one rootless immaterial aggregate conditions three aggregates and mind-originated materiality… two aggregates… at the moment of rebirth-linking…. (3)

106. Rūpiñca arūpiñca dhammaṃ paccayā rūpī dhammo uppajjati nahetupaccayā – ahetuke arūpino khandhe [T 3.0146] ca mahābhūte ca paccayā cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ; paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe…. (1)

106. A material phenomenon arises conditioned by a material and an immaterial phenomenon by way of non-root condition: rootless immaterial aggregates and great elements condition mind-originated materiality; at the moment of rebirth-linking…. (1)

Rūpiñca arūpiñca dhammaṃ paccayā arūpī dhammo uppajjati nahetupaccayā – cakkhuviññāṇasahagataṃ ekaṃ khandhañca cakkhāyatanañca paccayā tayo khandhā…pe… dve khandhe…pe… kāyaviññāṇasahagataṃ…pe… arūpiṃ ekaṃ khandhañca vatthuñca paccayā tayo khandhā…pe… dve khandhe…pe… paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe… vicikicchāsahagate uddhaccasahagate khandhe ca vatthuñca paccayā vicikicchāsahagato uddhaccasahagato moho. (2)

An immaterial phenomenon arises conditioned by a material and an immaterial phenomenon by way of non-root condition: one aggregate associated with eye-consciousness and the eye-base condition three aggregates… two aggregates… one immaterial aggregate and the physical base condition three aggregates… two aggregates… at the moment of rebirth-linking… the aggregates accompanied by doubt and restlessness, and the physical base condition doubt-accompanied, restlessness-accompanied delusion. (2)

Rūpiñca [M 3.0126] arūpiñca dhammaṃ paccayā rūpī ca arūpī ca dhammā uppajjanti nahetupaccayā [V 3.0153] – ahetukaṃ arūpiṃ ekaṃ khandhañca vatthuñca paccayā tayo khandhā…pe… dve khandhe…pe… arūpino khandhe ca mahābhūte ca paccayā cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ; paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe…. (3)

Both material and immaterial phenomena arise conditioned by a material and an immaterial phenomenon by way of non-root condition: one rootless immaterial aggregate and the physical base condition three aggregates… two aggregates… immaterial aggregates and the great elements condition mind-originated materiality; at the moment of rebirth-linking…. (3)

2. The Section on Enumeration

Suddhaṃ

The Simple Method

107. Nahetuyā nava, naārammaṇe tīṇi, naadhipatiyā nava, naanantare tīṇi, nasamanantare tīṇi, naaññamaññe tīṇi, naupanissaye tīṇi, napurejāte nava, napacchājāte nava, naāsevane nava, nakamme cattāri, navipāke nava, naāhāre ekaṃ, naindriye ekaṃ, najhāne cattāri, namagge nava, nasampayutte tīṇi, navippayutte dve, nonatthiyā tīṇi, novigate tīṇi.

107. By way of non-root condition, nine; by way of non-object condition, three; by way of non-dominance condition, nine; by way of non-contiguity condition, three; by way of non-immediate contiguity condition, three; by way of non-mutuality condition, three; by way of non-strong dependence condition, three; by way of non-pre-nascence condition, nine; by way of non-post-nascence condition, nine; by way of non-repetition condition, nine; by way of non-kamma condition, four; by way of non-resultant condition, nine; by way of non-nutriment condition, one; by way of non-faculty condition, one; by way of non-jhāna condition, four; by way of non-path condition, nine; by way of non-association condition, three; by way of non-dissociation condition, two; by way of non-absence condition, three; by way of non-disappearance condition, three.

Paccanīyaṃ.

The Negative Section.

3. Paccayānulomapaccanīyaṃ

3. Positive-Negative Conditional Relations

Hetudukaṃ

The Root Dyad

108. Hetupaccayā naārammaṇe tīṇi (saṃkhittaṃ, sabbe kātabbā), nakamme tīṇi, navipāke nava, nasampayutte tīṇi, navippayutte [T 3.0147] ekaṃ, nonatthiyā tīṇi, novigate tīṇi.

108. By way of root condition, non-object: three (abbreviated, all should be done); non-kamma: three; non-resultant: nine; non-association: three; non-dissociation: one; non-absence: three; non-disappearance: three.

Anulomapaccanīyaṃ.

The Positive-Negative Section.

4. Paccayapaccanīyānulomaṃ

4. Negative-Positive Conditional Relations

Nahetudukaṃ

The Non-Root Dyad

109. Nahetupaccayā [V 3.0154] ārammaṇe tīṇi (sabbe kātabbā)…pe… jhāne nava, magge tīṇi…pe… avigate nava.

109. By way of non-root condition, object: three (all should be done)… jhāna: nine; path: three… non-disappearance: nine.

Paccanīyānulomaṃ.

The Negative-Positive Section.

110. Arūpiṃ [M 3.0127] dhammaṃ saṃsaṭṭho arūpī dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – arūpiṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ saṃsaṭṭhā tayo khandhā…pe… dve khandhe…pe… paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe….

110. An immaterial phenomenon arises associated with an immaterial phenomenon by way of root condition: one immaterial aggregate is associated with three aggregates… two aggregates… at the moment of rebirth-linking….

Hetuyā ekaṃ…pe… avigate ekaṃ. (Evaṃ paccanīyādīni gaṇanāpi sampayuttavārepi sabbe kātabbā. Ekoyeva pañho).

By way of root condition, one… by way of non-disappearance, one. (Similarly, the enumerations for the negative and other methods should all be done in the associated section as well. There is only one question.)

1. Paccayānulomaṃ

1. Conditional Progression

1. Vibhaṅgavāro

1. Analysis Section

Hetupaccayo

Root Condition

111. Arūpī [V 3.0155] dhammo arūpissa dhammassa hetupaccayena paccayo – arūpī hetū sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ hetupaccayena paccayo; paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe…. (1)

111. An immaterial phenomenon is a condition for an immaterial phenomenon by way of root condition: immaterial roots are a condition for the associated aggregates by way of root condition; at the moment of rebirth-linking [...]. (1)

Arūpī dhammo rūpissa dhammassa hetupaccayena paccayo – arūpī hetū cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ hetupaccayena paccayo; paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe…. (2)

An immaterial phenomenon is a condition for a material phenomenon by way of root condition: immaterial roots are a condition for mind-originated material phenomena by way of root condition; at the moment of rebirth-linking [...]. (2)

Arūpī dhammo rūpissa ca arūpissa ca dhammassa hetupaccayena paccayo – arūpī hetū sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ [T 3.0148] hetupaccayena paccayo; paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe…. (3)

An immaterial phenomenon is a condition for both material and immaterial phenomena by way of root condition: immaterial roots are a condition for the associated aggregates and mind-originated material phenomena by way of root condition; at the moment of rebirth-linking [...]. (3)

Ārammaṇapaccayo

Object Condition

112. Rūpī dhammo arūpissa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo – cakkhuṃ…pe… vatthuṃ… itthindriyaṃ… purisindriyaṃ… jīvitindriyaṃ… āpodhātuṃ… kabaḷīkāraṃ āhāraṃ aniccato…pe… domanassaṃ uppajjati, dibbena cakkhunā rūpaṃ passati, dibbāya sotadhātuyā saddaṃ suṇāti. Rūpāyatanaṃ cakkhuviññāṇassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo…pe… phoṭṭhabbāyatanaṃ kāyaviññāṇassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo; rūpino khandhā iddhividhañāṇassa, pubbenivāsānussatiñāṇassa[V 3.0156], anāgataṃsañāṇassa, āvajjanāya ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo. (1)

112. A material phenomenon is a condition for an immaterial phenomenon by way of object condition: the eye [...]; the base [...]; the femininity faculty [...]; the masculinity faculty [...]; the life faculty [...]; the water element [...]; edible food as impermanent [...], sorrow arises; with the divine eye, one sees forms; with the divine ear element, one hears sounds. The visible form base is a condition for eye-consciousness by way of object condition [...]; the tangible base is a condition for body-consciousness by way of object condition; the material aggregates are a condition for the knowledge of psychic power, the recollection of past lives, the knowledge of the future, and advertence by way of object condition. (1)

113. Arūpī [M 3.0128] dhammo arūpissa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo – dānaṃ…pe… sīlaṃ…pe… uposathakammaṃ katvā taṃ paccavekkhati, pubbe suciṇṇāni paccavekkhati, jhānā…pe… ariyā maggā vuṭṭhahitvā maggaṃ paccavekkhanti, phalaṃ paccavekkhanti, nibbānaṃ paccavekkhanti; nibbānaṃ gotrabhussa, vodānassa, maggassa, phalassa, āvajjanāya ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo; ariyā pahīne kilese…pe… vikkhambhite kilese…pe… pubbe…pe… arūpino khandhe aniccato…pe… domanassaṃ uppajjati, cetopariyañāṇena arūpicittasamaṅgissa cittaṃ jānāti, ākāsānañcāyatanaṃ…pe… nevasaññānāsaññāyatanassa…pe… arūpino khandhā iddhividhañāṇassa, cetopariyañāṇassa, pubbenivāsānussatiñāṇassa, yathākammūpagañāṇassa, anāgataṃsañāṇassa, āvajjanāya ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo. (1)

113. An immaterial phenomenon is a condition for an immaterial phenomenon by way of object condition: generosity [...]; morality [...]; having performed the observance day, one reviews it; one reviews past good deeds; the jhānas [...]; having emerged from the noble paths, they review the path, review the fruit, review Nibbāna; Nibbāna is a condition for the change-of-lineage, purification, the path, the fruit, and advertence by way of object condition; the noble ones review the abandoned defilements [...]; the suppressed defilements [...]; previously [...]; the immaterial aggregates as impermanent [...], sorrow arises; with mind-penetrating knowledge, one knows the mind of one endowed with immaterial consciousness; the base of infinite space [...]; the base of neither-perception-nor-non-perception [...]; the immaterial aggregates are a condition for the knowledge of psychic power, mind-penetrating knowledge, recollection of past lives, knowledge of the passing away and arising of beings due to kamma, knowledge of the future, and advertence by way of object condition. (1)

Adhipatipaccayo

Dominance Condition

114. Rūpī [T 3.0149] dhammo arūpissa dhammassa adhipatipaccayena paccayo. Ārammaṇādhipati – cakkhuṃ…pe… kabaḷīkāraṃ āhāraṃ garuṃ katvā assādeti abhinandati, taṃ garuṃ katvā rāgo uppajjati, diṭṭhi uppajjati. (1)

114. A material phenomenon is a condition for an immaterial phenomenon by way of dominance condition. Object-dominance: regarding the eye [...]; regarding edible food as important, one savors and rejoices in it; regarding that as important, lust arises, wrong view arises. (1)

Arūpī dhammo arūpissa dhammassa adhipatipaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇādhipati, sahajātādhipati. Ārammaṇādhipati – dānaṃ…pe… (saṃkhittaṃ) nibbānaṃ maggassa, phalassa adhipatipaccayena paccayo; arūpino khandhe garuṃ katvā assādeti…pe… rāgo uppajjati, diṭṭhi uppajjati. Sahajātādhipati – arūpī adhipati sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ adhipatipaccayena paccayo. (1)

An immaterial phenomenon is a condition for an immaterial phenomenon by way of dominance condition: object-dominance, co-nascent dominance. Object-dominance: generosity [...] (abbreviated); Nibbāna is a condition for the path and the fruit by way of dominance condition; regarding the immaterial aggregates as important, one savors them [...]; lust arises, wrong view arises. Co-nascent dominance: an immaterial dominant factor is a condition for the associated aggregates by way of dominance condition. (1)

Arūpī dhammo rūpissa dhammassa adhipatipaccayena paccayo. Sahajātādhipati – arūpī adhipati cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ adhipatipaccayena paccayo. (2)

An immaterial phenomenon is a condition for a material phenomenon by way of dominance condition. Co-nascent dominance: an immaterial dominant factor is a condition for mind-originated material phenomena by way of dominance condition. (2)

Arūpī [V 3.0157] dhammo rūpissa ca arūpissa ca dhammassa adhipatipaccayena paccayo. Sahajātādhipati – arūpī adhipati sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ adhipatipaccayena paccayo. (3)

An immaterial phenomenon is a condition for both material and immaterial phenomena by way of dominance condition. Co-nascent dominance: an immaterial dominant factor is a condition for the associated aggregates and mind-originated material phenomena by way of dominance condition. (3)

Anantarapaccayādi

Immediately Proximate Condition, etc.

115. Arūpī [M 3.0129] dhammo arūpissa dhammassa anantarapaccayena paccayo – purimā purimā arūpino khandhā pacchimānaṃ pacchimānaṃ arūpīnaṃ khandhānaṃ…pe… phalasamāpattiyā anantarapaccayena paccayo, samanantarapaccayena paccayo.

115. An immaterial phenomenon is a condition for an immaterial phenomenon by way of immediately proximate condition: preceding immaterial aggregates are a condition for succeeding immaterial aggregates [...]; it is a condition for the attainment of fruition by way of immediately proximate condition and by way of conjoint proximate condition.

(Sahajātapaccaye satta, iha ghaṭanā natthi. Aññamaññapaccaye cha, nissayapaccaye satta pañhā, iha ghaṭanā natthi).

(In the co-nascent condition, seven—here there is no occurrence. In the mutuality condition, six; in the dependence condition, seven questions—here there is no occurrence.)

Upanissayapaccayo

Decisive-support Condition

116. Rūpī [T 3.0150] dhammo arūpissa dhammassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇūpanissayo, pakatūpanissayo…pe…. Pakatūpanissayo – utuṃ… bhojanaṃ… senāsanaṃ upanissāya dānaṃ deti…pe… saṅghaṃ bhindati, utu… bhojanaṃ… senāsanaṃ saddhāya…pe… phalasamāpattiyā upanissayapaccayena paccayo. (1)

116. A material phenomenon is a condition for an immaterial phenomenon by way of decisive-support condition: object decisive-support, natural decisive-support… Natural decisive-support: by depending on the season… food… lodging, one gives alms… or splits the Saṅgha. The season… food… lodging is a condition for faith… for the attainment of fruition by way of decisive-support condition. (1)

Arūpī dhammo arūpissa dhammassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇūpanissayo, anantarūpanissayo, pakatūpanissayo…pe…. Pakatūpanissayo – saddhaṃ upanissāya dānaṃ deti, sīlaṃ…pe… kāyikaṃ dukkhaṃ upanissāya dānaṃ deti…pe… saṅghaṃ bhindati, saddhā…pe… kāyikaṃ dukkhaṃ… saddhāya…pe… phalasamāpattiyā upanissayapaccayena paccayo. (1)

An immaterial phenomenon is a condition for an immaterial phenomenon by way of decisive-support condition: object decisive-support, proximity decisive-support, natural decisive-support… Natural decisive-support: by depending on faith, one gives alms; by depending on virtue… or bodily suffering, one gives alms… or splits the Saṅgha. Faith… bodily suffering… is a condition for faith… for the attainment of fruition by way of decisive-support condition. (1)

Purejātapaccayo

Pre-nascence Condition

117. Rūpī dhammo arūpissa dhammassa purejātapaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇapurejātaṃ, vatthupurejātaṃ. Ārammaṇapurejātaṃ – cakkhuṃ…pe… vatthuṃ…pe… kabaḷīkāraṃ āhāraṃ aniccato [V 3.0158] …pe… domanassaṃ uppajjati. Dibbena cakkhunā rūpaṃ passati, dibbāya sotadhātuyā saddaṃ suṇāti. Rūpāyatanaṃ cakkhuviññāṇassa…pe… phoṭṭhabbāyatanaṃ kāyaviññāṇassa…pe…. Vatthupurejātaṃ – cakkhāyatanaṃ cakkhuviññāṇassa…pe… kāyāyatanaṃ kāyaviññāṇassa…pe… vatthu arūpīnaṃ khandhānaṃ purejātapaccayena paccayo. (1)

117. A material phenomenon is a condition for an immaterial phenomenon by way of the pre-nascence condition—object pre-nascence, base pre-nascence. Object pre-nascence: the eye… the base… edible food, (perceiving it) as impermanent… sorrow arises. With the divine eye, one sees forms; with the divine ear-element, one hears sounds. The visible-form base is a condition for eye-consciousness… the tangible-object base is a condition for body-consciousness… Base pre-nascence: the eye-base is a condition for eye-consciousness… the body-base is a condition for body-consciousness… The base is a condition for the immaterial aggregates by way of the pre-nascence condition. (1)

Pacchājātapaccayo

Post-nascence Condition

118. Arūpī [M 3.0130] dhammo rūpissa dhammassa pacchājātapaccayena paccayo – pacchājātā arūpino khandhā purejātassa imassa kāyassa pacchājātapaccayena paccayo. (1)

118. An immaterial phenomenon is a condition for a material phenomenon by way of the post-nascence condition—the post-nascent immaterial aggregates are a condition for this pre-arisen body by way of the post-nascence condition. (1)

Āsevanapaccayo

Repetition Condition

119. Arūpī [T 3.0151] dhammo arūpissa dhammassa āsevanapaccayena paccayo – purimā purimā arūpino khandhā pacchimānaṃ pacchimānaṃ arūpīnaṃ khandhānaṃ āsevanapaccayena paccayo.

119. An immaterial phenomenon is a condition for an immaterial phenomenon by way of the repetition condition: the preceding immaterial aggregates are a condition for the succeeding immaterial aggregates by way of the repetition condition.

Kammapaccayo

Kamma-condition

120. Arūpī dhammo arūpissa dhammassa kammapaccayena paccayo – sahajātā, nānākkhaṇikā. Sahajātā – arūpī cetanā sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ kammapaccayena paccayo; paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe…. Nānākkhaṇikā – arūpī cetanā vipākānaṃ khandhānaṃ kammapaccayena paccayo. (1)

120. An immaterial phenomenon is a condition for an immaterial phenomenon by way of the kamma-condition: conascent and different-moment. Conascent: immaterial volition is a condition for the associated aggregates by way of the kamma-condition; at the moment of rebirth-linking… Different-moment: immaterial volition is a condition for the resultant aggregates by way of the kamma-condition. (1)

Arūpī dhammo rūpissa dhammassa kammapaccayena paccayo – sahajātā, nānākkhaṇikā. Sahajātā – arūpī cetanā cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ kammapaccayena paccayo; paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe…. Nānākkhaṇikā – arūpī cetanā kaṭattārūpānaṃ kammapaccayena paccayo. (2)

An immaterial phenomenon is a condition for a material phenomenon by way of the kamma-condition: conascent and different-moment. Conascent: immaterial volition is a condition for mind-originated materiality by way of the kamma-condition; at the moment of rebirth-linking… Different-moment: immaterial volition is a condition for kamma-produced materiality by way of the kamma-condition. (2)

Arūpī dhammo rūpissa ca arūpissa ca dhammassa kammapaccayena paccayo – sahajātā, nānākkhaṇikā. Sahajātā – arūpī cetanā sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ kammapaccayena [V 3.0159] paccayo; paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe…. Nānākkhaṇikā – arūpī cetanā vipākānaṃ khandhānaṃ kaṭattā ca rūpānaṃ kammapaccayena paccayo. (3)

An immaterial phenomenon is a condition for both a material and an immaterial phenomenon by way of the kamma-condition—conascent and different-moment. Conascent: immaterial volition is a condition for the associated aggregates and mind-originated materiality by way of the kamma-condition; at the moment of rebirth-linking… Different-moment: immaterial volition is a condition for the resultant aggregates and kamma-produced materiality by way of the kamma-condition. (3)

Vipākāhārapaccayā

Result and Nutriment Conditions

121. Arūpī dhammo arūpissa dhammassa vipākapaccayena paccayo… tīṇi.

121. An immaterial phenomenon is a condition for an immaterial phenomenon by way of the result-condition… three.

Rūpī dhammo rūpissa dhammassa āhārapaccayena paccayo – kabaḷīkāro āhāro imassa kāyassa āhārapaccayena paccayo. (1)

A material phenomenon is a condition for a material phenomenon by way of the nutriment-condition. Edible food is a condition for this body by way of the nutriment-condition. (1)

Arūpī dhammo arūpissa dhammassa āhārapaccayena paccayo… tīṇi.

An immaterial phenomenon is a condition for an immaterial phenomenon by way of the nutriment-condition… three.

Indriyapaccayo

Faculty-condition

122. Rūpī [M 3.0131] dhammo rūpissa dhammassa indriyapaccayena paccayo – rūpajīvitindriyaṃ [T 3.0152] kaṭattārūpānaṃ indriyapaccayena paccayo. (1)

122. A material phenomenon is a condition for a material phenomenon by way of the faculty-condition—the material life-faculty is a condition for kamma-produced materiality by way of the faculty-condition. (1)

Rūpī dhammo arūpissa dhammassa indriyapaccayena paccayo – cakkhundriyaṃ…pe… kāyindriyaṃ kāyaviññāṇassa indriyapaccayena paccayo. (2)

A material phenomenon is a condition for an immaterial phenomenon by way of the faculty-condition—the eye-faculty… the body-faculty is a condition for body-consciousness by way of the faculty-condition. (2)

Arūpī dhammo arūpissa dhammassa indriyapaccayena paccayo… tīṇi.

An immaterial phenomenon is a condition for an immaterial phenomenon by way of the faculty-condition… three.

Rūpī ca arūpī ca dhammā arūpissa dhammassa indriyapaccayena paccayo – cakkhundriyañca cakkhuviññāṇañca cakkhuviññāṇasahagatānaṃ khandhānaṃ indriyapaccayena paccayo…pe… kāyindriyañca…pe….

Both a material and an immaterial phenomenon are a condition for an immaterial phenomenon by way of the faculty-condition. The eye-faculty and eye-consciousness are a condition for the aggregates associated with eye-consciousness by way of the faculty-condition… the body-faculty…

Jhānapaccayādi

Jhāna-condition, and so on

123. Arūpī [V 3.0160] dhammo arūpissa dhammassa jhānapaccayena paccayo… tīṇi… maggapaccayena paccayo… tīṇi… sampayuttapaccayena paccayo… ekaṃ.

123. An immaterial phenomenon is a condition for an immaterial phenomenon by way of the jhāna-condition… three… by way of the path-condition… three… by way of the association-condition… one.

Vippayuttapaccayo

Dissociation-condition

124. Rūpī dhammo arūpissa dhammassa vippayuttapaccayena paccayo – sahajātaṃ, purejātaṃ. Sahajātaṃ – paṭisandhikkhaṇe vatthu arūpīnaṃ khandhānaṃ vippayuttapaccayena paccayo. Purejātaṃ – cakkhāyatanaṃ cakkhuviññāṇassa…pe… kāyāyatanaṃ kāyaviññāṇassa…pe… vatthu arūpīnaṃ khandhānaṃ vippayuttapaccayena paccayo. (1)

124. A material phenomenon is a condition for an immaterial phenomenon by way of the dissociation-condition—conascent and pre-nascent. Conascent: at the moment of rebirth-linking, the physical base is a condition for the immaterial aggregates by way of the dissociation-condition. Pre-nascent: the eye-base is a condition for eye-consciousness… the body-base is a condition for body-consciousness… the physical base is a condition for the immaterial aggregates by way of the dissociation-condition. (1)

Arūpī dhammo rūpissa dhammassa vippayuttapaccayena paccayo – sahajātaṃ, pacchājātaṃ. Sahajātā – arūpino khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ vippayuttapaccayena paccayo; paṭisandhikkhaṇe arūpino khandhā kaṭattārūpānaṃ vippayuttapaccayena paccayo; arūpino khandhā vatthussa vippayuttapaccayena paccayo. Pacchājātā – arūpino khandhā purejātassa imassa kāyassa vippayuttapaccayena paccayo. (1)

An immaterial phenomenon is a condition for a material phenomenon by way of the dissociation-condition—conascent and post-nascent. Conascent: the immaterial aggregates are a condition for mind-originated materiality by way of the dissociation-condition; at the moment of rebirth-linking, the immaterial aggregates are a condition for kamma-produced materiality by way of the dissociation-condition; the immaterial aggregates are a condition for the physical base by way of the dissociation-condition. Post-nascent: the immaterial aggregates are a condition for this pre-arisen body by way of the dissociation-condition. (1)

Atthipaccayādi

Presence-condition, and so on

125. Rūpī [T 3.0153][M 3.0132] dhammo rūpissa dhammassa atthipaccayena paccayo – sahajātaṃ, āhāraṃ, indriyaṃ. Sahajātaṃ – ekaṃ mahābhūtaṃ…pe… (yāva asaññasattā), kabaḷīkāro āhāro imassa kāyassa atthipaccayena paccayo; rūpajīvitindriyaṃ kaṭattārūpānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo. (1)

125. A material phenomenon is a condition for a material phenomenon by way of the presence-condition—conascent, nutriment, and faculty. Conascent: one great primary element… (up to the non-percipient beings); edible food is a condition for this body by way of the presence-condition; the material life-faculty is a condition for kamma-produced materiality by way of the presence-condition. (1)

Rūpī dhammo arūpissa dhammassa atthipaccayena paccayo – sahajātaṃ, purejātaṃ. Sahajātaṃ – paṭisandhikkhaṇe vatthu arūpīnaṃ khandhānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo. Purejātaṃ – cakkhuṃ…pe… kabaḷīkāraṃ āhāraṃ aniccato…pe… domanassaṃ uppajjati; dibbena cakkhunā rūpaṃ passati, dibbāya sotadhātuyā saddaṃ suṇāti. Rūpāyatanaṃ cakkhuviññāṇassa…pe… phoṭṭhabbāyatanaṃ kāyaviññāṇassa…pe… cakkhāyatanaṃ cakkhuviññāṇassa [V 3.0161] …pe… kāyāyatanaṃ kāyaviññāṇassa…pe… vatthu arūpīnaṃ khandhānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo. (2)

A material phenomenon is a condition for a non-material phenomenon by way of presence condition—co-nascence and pre-nascence. Co-nascence—at the moment of rebirth-linking, the physical base is a condition for the non-material aggregates by way of presence condition. Pre-nascence—the eye...(etc.)... physical nutriment, because of impermanence...(etc.)... sorrow arises; with the divine eye one sees forms, with the divine ear element one hears sounds. The form-base is a condition for eye-consciousness...(etc.)... the tangible-base is a condition for body-consciousness...(etc.)... the eye-base is a condition for eye-consciousness...(etc.)... the body-base is a condition for body-consciousness...(etc.)... the physical base is a condition for the non-material aggregates by way of presence condition. (2)

126. Arūpī dhammo arūpissa dhammassa atthipaccayena paccayo – arūpī eko khandho tiṇṇannaṃ khandhānaṃ…pe… dve khandhā…pe… paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe…. (1)

126. A non-material phenomenon is a condition for a non-material phenomenon by way of presence condition: one non-material aggregate is a condition for the other three aggregates...(etc.)... two aggregates...(etc.)... at the moment of rebirth-linking...(etc.). (1)

Arūpī dhammo rūpissa dhammassa atthipaccayena paccayo – sahajātaṃ, pacchājātaṃ. Sahajātā – arūpino khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo; paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe… pacchājātā – arūpino khandhā purejātassa imassa kāyassa atthipaccayena paccayo. (2)

A non-material phenomenon is a condition for a material phenomenon by way of presence condition: co-nascence and post-nascence. Co-nascence—non-material aggregates are a condition for mind-originated materiality by way of presence condition; at the moment of rebirth-linking...(etc.). Post-nascence—non-material aggregates are a condition for this pre-arisen body by way of presence condition. (2)

Arūpī dhammo rūpissa ca arūpissa ca dhammassa atthipaccayena paccayo – arūpī eko khandho tiṇṇannaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo…pe… dve khandhā…pe… paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe…. (3)

A non-material phenomenon is a condition for both a material and a non-material phenomenon by way of presence condition—one non-material aggregate is a condition for the other three aggregates and for mind-originated materiality by way of presence condition...(etc.)... two aggregates...(etc.)... at the moment of rebirth-linking...(etc.). (3)

127. Rūpī ca arūpī ca dhammā rūpissa dhammassa [T 3.0154] atthipaccayena paccayo – sahajātaṃ, pacchājātaṃ, āhāraṃ, indriyaṃ. Sahajātā – arūpī khandhā ca mahābhūtā ca cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo; paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe…. Pacchājātā – arūpino khandhā ca kabaḷīkāro āhāro ca imassa kāyassa atthipaccayena paccayo. Pacchājātā – arūpino khandhā ca rūpajīvitindriyañca kaṭattārūpānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo. (1)

127. Both material and non-material phenomena are a condition for a material phenomenon by way of presence condition—co-nascence, post-nascence, nutriment, and faculty. Co-nascence—non-material aggregates and the great primary elements are a condition for mind-originated materiality by way of presence condition; at the moment of rebirth-linking...(etc.). Post-nascence—non-material aggregates and physical nutriment are a condition for this body by way of presence condition. Post-nascence—non-material aggregates and the material life faculty are a condition for kamma-originated materiality by way of presence condition. (1)

Rūpī [M 3.0133] ca arūpī ca dhammā arūpissa dhammassa atthipaccayena paccayo – sahajātaṃ, purejātaṃ. Sahajāto – cakkhuviññāṇasahagato eko khandho ca cakkhāyatanañca tiṇṇannaṃ khandhānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo…pe… dve khandhā ca…pe… kāyaviññāṇasahagato…pe… arūpī eko khandho ca vatthu ca tiṇṇannaṃ khandhānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo…pe… dve khandhā ca…pe… paṭisandhikkhaṇe arūpī eko khandho ca vatthu ca tiṇṇannaṃ khandhānaṃ…pe… dve khandhā ca…pe…. (2)

Both material and non-material phenomena are a condition for a non-material phenomenon by way of presence condition—co-nascence and pre-nascence. Co-nascence—one aggregate co-arisen with eye-consciousness and the eye-base are a condition for the other three aggregates by way of presence condition...(etc.)... two aggregates...(etc.)... one aggregate co-arisen with body-consciousness...(etc.)... one non-material aggregate and the heart-base are a condition for the other three aggregates by way of presence condition...(etc.)... two aggregates...(etc.)... at the moment of rebirth-linking, one non-material aggregate and the heart-base are a condition for the other three aggregates...(etc.)... two aggregates...(etc.). (2)

Natthipaccayena [V 3.0162] paccayo… vigatapaccayena paccayo… avigatapaccayena paccayo.

By way of absence condition... By way of disappearance condition... By way of non-disappearance condition.

1. Paccayānulomaṃ

1. The Progression of Conditions.

2. Saṅkhyāvāro

2. The Chapter on Enumeration.

Suddhaṃ

Pure.

128. Hetuyā tīṇi, ārammaṇe dve, adhipatiyā cattāri, anantare ekaṃ, samanantare ekaṃ, sahajāte satta, aññamaññe cha, nissaye satta, upanissaye dve, purejāte ekaṃ, pacchājāte ekaṃ āsevane ekaṃ, kamme tīṇi, vipāke tīṇi, āhāre cattāri, indriye cha, jhāne tīṇi, magge tīṇi, sampayutte ekaṃ, vippayutte dve, atthiyā satta, natthiyā ekaṃ[T 3.0155], vigate ekaṃ, avigate satta.

128. By way of Root Condition, three; by way of Object Condition, two; by way of Dominance Condition, four; by way of Contiguity Condition, one; by way of Immediate Contiguity Condition, one; by way of Co-nascence Condition, seven; by way of Reciprocity Condition, six; by way of Dependence Condition, seven; by way of Decisive Support Condition, two; by way of Pre-nascence Condition, one; by way of Post-nascence Condition, one; by way of Habitual Recurrence Condition, one; by way of Kamma Condition, three; by way of Result Condition, three; by way of Nutriment Condition, four; by way of Faculty Condition, six; by way of Jhāna Condition, three; by way of Path Condition, three; by way of Association Condition, one; by way of Dissociation Condition, two; by way of Presence Condition, seven; by way of Absence Condition, one; by way of Disappearance Condition, one; by way of Non-disappearance Condition, seven.

Anulomaṃ.

The Progression.

Paccanīyuddhāro

The Section on Negation.

129. Rūpī dhammo rūpissa dhammassa sahajātapaccayena paccayo… āhārapaccayena paccayo… indriyapaccayena paccayo. (1)

129. A material phenomenon is a condition for a material phenomenon by way of Co-nascence Condition… by way of Nutriment Condition… by way of Faculty Condition. (1)

Rūpī dhammo arūpissa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo… sahajātapaccayena paccayo… upanissayapaccayena paccayo… purejātapaccayena paccayo. (2)

A material phenomenon is a condition for a non-material phenomenon by way of Object Condition… by way of Co-nascence Condition… by way of Decisive Support Condition… by way of Pre-nascence Condition. (2)

Arūpī dhammo arūpissa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo… sahajātapaccayena paccayo… upanissayapaccayena paccayo… kammapaccayena paccayo. (1)

A non-material phenomenon is a condition for a non-material phenomenon by way of Object Condition… by way of Co-nascence Condition… by way of Decisive Support Condition… by way of Kamma Condition. (1)

Arūpī [M 3.0134][V 3.0163] dhammo rūpissa dhammassa sahajātapaccayena paccayo… pacchājātapaccayena paccayo… kammapaccayena paccayo. (2)

A non-material phenomenon is a condition for a material phenomenon by way of Co-nascence Condition… by way of Post-nascence Condition… by way of Kamma Condition. (2)

Arūpī dhammo rūpissa ca arūpissa ca dhammassa sahajātapaccayena paccayo… kammapaccayena paccayo. (3)

A non-material phenomenon is a condition for both material and non-material phenomena by way of Co-nascence Condition… by way of Kamma Condition. (3)

Rūpī ca arūpī ca dhammā rūpissa dhammassa sahajātaṃ, pacchājātaṃ, āhāraṃ, indriyaṃ. (1)

Both material and non-material phenomena are conditions for a material phenomenon by way of Co-nascence, Post-nascence, Nutriment, and Faculty. (1)

Rūpī ca arūpī ca dhammā arūpissa dhammassa sahajātaṃ, purejātaṃ. (2)

Both material and non-material phenomena are conditions for a non-material phenomenon by way of Co-nascence and Pre-nascence. (2)

2. Paccayapaccanīyaṃ

2. The Negation of Conditions.

2. Saṅkhyāvāro

2. The Chapter on Enumeration.

Suddhaṃ

Pure.

130. Nahetuyā satta, naārammaṇe satta, naadhipatiyā satta, naanantare satta, nasamanantare satta, nasahajāte cha, naaññamaññe cha, nanissaye cha, naupanissaye satta, napurejāte satta [T 3.0156] …pe… namagge satta, nasampayutte cha, navippayutte pañca, noatthiyā cattāri, nonatthiyā satta, novigate satta, noavigate cattāri.

130. Not by way of Root Condition, seven; not by way of Object Condition, seven; not by way of Dominance Condition, seven; not by way of Contiguity Condition, seven; not by way of Immediate Contiguity Condition, seven; not by way of Co-nascence Condition, six; not by way of Reciprocity Condition, six; not by way of Dependence Condition, six; not by way of Decisive Support Condition, seven; not by way of Pre-nascence Condition, seven… not by way of Path Condition, seven; not by way of Association Condition, six; not by way of Dissociation Condition, five; not by way of Presence Condition, four; not by way of Absence Condition, seven; not by way of Disappearance Condition, seven; not by way of Non-disappearance Condition, four.

Paccanīyaṃ.

The Negation.

3. Paccayānulomapaccanīyaṃ

3. The Progression-Negation of Conditions.

Hetudukaṃ

The Dyad of Roots.

131. Hetupaccayā naārammaṇe tīṇi, naadhipatiyā tīṇi, naanantare tīṇi, nasamanantare [V 3.0164] tīṇi, naaññamaññe ekaṃ, naupanissaye tīṇi (sabbattha tīṇi), nasampayutte ekaṃ, navippayutte ekaṃ, nonatthiyā tīṇi, novigate tīṇi.

131. By way of Root Condition, not by way of Object Condition, three; not by way of Dominance Condition, three; not by way of Contiguity Condition, three; not by way of Immediate Contiguity Condition, three; not by way of Reciprocity Condition, one; not by way of Decisive Support Condition, three (everywhere three); not by way of Association Condition, one; not by way of Dissociation Condition, one; not by way of Absence Condition, three; not by way of Disappearance Condition, three.

Anulomapaccanīyaṃ.

The Progression-Negation.

4. Paccayapaccanīyānulomaṃ

4. The Negation-Progression of Conditions.

Nahetudukaṃ

The Dyad of Non-Roots.

132. Nahetupaccayā [M 3.0135] ārammaṇe dve, adhipatiyā cattāri (anulomamātikā kātabbā), avigate satta.

132. Not by way of Root Condition: by way of Object Condition, two; by way of Dominance Condition, four (the progression matrix should be made); by way of Non-disappearance Condition, seven.

Paccanīyānulomaṃ.

The Negation-Progression.

Rūpīdukaṃ niṭṭhitaṃ.

The Dyad of Materiality is concluded.

12. Lokiyadukaṃ

12. The Dyad of the Mundane.

1. The Section on Analysis.

Hetupaccayo

The Root Condition.

133. Lokiyaṃ [V 3.0165] dhammaṃ paṭicca lokiyo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – lokiyaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca tayo khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ…pe… dve khandhe…pe… paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe… khandhe paṭicca vatthu, vatthuṃ paṭicca khandhā, ekaṃ mahābhūtaṃ…pe… mahābhūte paṭicca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ [T 3.0157] rūpaṃ, kaṭattārūpaṃ, upādārūpaṃ. (1)

133. Dependent on a mundane phenomenon, a mundane phenomenon arises by way of Root Condition. Dependent on one mundane aggregate, three aggregates and mind-originated materiality arise… dependent on two aggregates… at the moment of rebirth-linking… dependent on the aggregates, the base; dependent on the base, the aggregates; dependent on one great element… dependent on the great elements, mind-originated materiality, kamma-originated materiality, and derived materiality arise. (1)

134. Lokuttaraṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca lokuttaro dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – lokuttaraṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca tayo khandhā…pe… dve khandhe…pe…. (1)

134. Dependent on a supramundane phenomenon, a supramundane phenomenon arises by way of Root Condition. Dependent on one supramundane aggregate, three aggregates arise… dependent on two aggregates…. (1)

Lokuttaraṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca lokiyo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – lokuttare khandhe paṭicca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ. (2)

Dependent on a supramundane phenomenon, a mundane phenomenon arises by way of Root Condition. Dependent on the supramundane aggregates, mind-originated materiality arises. (2)

Lokuttaraṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca lokiyo ca lokuttaro ca dhammā uppajjanti hetupaccayā – lokuttaraṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca tayo khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ…pe… dve khandhe…pe…. (3)

Dependent on a supramundane phenomenon, mundane and supramundane phenomena arise by way of Root Condition. Dependent on one supramundane aggregate, three aggregates and mind-originated materiality arise… dependent on two aggregates…. (3)

Lokiyañca lokuttarañca dhammaṃ paṭicca lokiyo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – lokuttare khandhe ca mahābhūte ca paṭicca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ (saṃkhittaṃ). (1)

Dependent on mundane and supramundane phenomena, a mundane phenomenon arises by way of Root Condition. Dependent on the supramundane aggregates and the great elements, mind-originated materiality arises (abbreviated). (1)

1. The Progression of Conditions.

Suddhaṃ

Pure.

135. Hetuyā [M 3.0136][V 3.0166] pañca, ārammaṇe dve, adhipatiyā pañca, anantare dve, samanantare dve, sahajāte pañca, aññamaññe dve, nissaye pañca, upanissaye dve, purejāte dve, āsevane dve, kamme pañca, vipāke pañca, āhāre pañca, indriye pañca, jhāne pañca, magge pañca, sampayutte dve, vippayutte pañca, atthiyā pañca, natthiyā dve, vigate dve, avigate pañca.

135. By way of Root Condition, five; by way of Object Condition, two; by way of Dominance Condition, five; by way of Contiguity Condition, two; by way of Immediate Contiguity Condition, two; by way of Co-nascence Condition, five; by way of Reciprocity Condition, two; by way of Dependence Condition, five; by way of Decisive Support Condition, two; by way of Pre-nascence Condition, two; by way of Habitual Recurrence Condition, two; by way of Kamma Condition, five; by way of Result Condition, five; by way of Nutriment Condition, five; by way of Faculty Condition, five; by way of Jhāna Condition, five; by way of Path Condition, five; by way of Association Condition, two; by way of Dissociation Condition, five; by way of Presence Condition, five; by way of Absence Condition, two; by way of Disappearance Condition, two; by way of Non-disappearance Condition, five.

Anulomaṃ.

The Progression.

136. 136. Dependent on a mundane phenomenon, a mundane phenomenon arises by way of non-root condition—dependent on one rootless mundane aggregate, three aggregates and mind-originated materiality arise… two aggregates… at the moment of rootless rebirth-linking… (up to non-percipient beings)… dependent on the aggregates accompanied by doubt and restlessness, doubt-accompanied and restlessness-accompanied delusion arises (abbreviated).

137. Nahetuyā [V 3.0167] ekaṃ, naārammaṇe tīṇi, naadhipatiyā dve, naanantare tīṇi, nasamanantare tīṇi, naaññamaññe tīṇi, naupanissaye tīṇi, napurejāte cattāri, napacchājāte pañca, naāsevane pañca (naāsevanamūlake lokuttare suddhake vipākoti niyāmetabbaṃ, avasesā pakatikāyeva), nakamme dve, navipāke pañca, naāhāre ekaṃ, naindriye ekaṃ, najhāne ekaṃ, namagge ekaṃ, nasampayutte tīṇi, navippayutte dve, nonatthiyā tīṇi, novigate tīṇi.

137. By way of non-root condition, one; by way of non-object condition, three; by way of non-dominance condition, two; by way of non-contiguity condition, three; by way of non-immediate contiguity condition, three; by way of non-reciprocity condition, three; by way of non-decisive support condition, three; by way of non-prenascence condition, four; by way of non-postnascence condition, five; by way of non-habitual recurrence condition, five (in the case of non-habitual recurrence, it should be understood as the pure supramundane resultant; the remainder are as usual); by way of non-kamma condition, two; by way of non-result condition, five; by way of non-nutriment condition, one; by way of non-faculty condition, one; by way of non-jhāna condition, one; by way of non-path condition, one; by way of non-association condition, three; by way of non-dissociation condition, two; by way of non-absence condition, three; by way of non-disappearance condition, three.

Paccanīyaṃ.

138. Hetupaccayā [M 3.0137] naārammaṇe tīṇi, naadhipatiyā dve (naanantarapadādī paccanīyasadisā)…pe… navipāke pañca, nasampayutte tīṇi, navippayutte dve, nonatthiyā tīṇi, novigate tīṇi.

138. By root condition: in relation to non-object condition, three; in relation to non-predominance condition, two (the terms beginning with non-contiguity are similar to the negative section)… in relation to non-resultant condition, five; in relation to non-association condition, three; in relation to non-dissociation condition, two; in relation to non-absence condition, three; in relation to non-disappearance condition, three.
