Hetupaccayo

Root Condition.

140. Lokiyaṃ [T 3.0159] dhammaṃ paccayā lokiyo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – lokiyaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paccayā…pe… ekaṃ mahābhūtaṃ…pe… mahābhūte paccayā cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ, kaṭattārūpaṃ, upādārūpaṃ, vatthuṃ paccayā lokiyā khandhā. (1)

140. A mundane phenomenon arises in dependence on a mundane phenomenon by root condition—in dependence on one mundane aggregate... one great primary element... in dependence on the great primary elements, mind-originated materiality, kamma-produced materiality, and derived materiality arise; in dependence on the physical base, mundane aggregates arise. (1)

Lokiyaṃ dhammaṃ paccayā lokuttaro dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – vatthuṃ paccayā lokuttarā khandhā. (2)

A supramundane phenomenon arises in dependence on a mundane phenomenon by root condition—in dependence on the physical base, supramundane aggregates arise. (2)

Lokiyaṃ [M 3.0138][V 3.0169] dhammaṃ paccayā lokiyo ca lokuttaro ca dhammā uppajjanti hetupaccayā – vatthuṃ paccayā lokuttarā khandhā, mahābhūte paccayā cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ. (3)

Both mundane and supramundane phenomena arise in dependence on a mundane phenomenon by root condition—in dependence on the physical base, supramundane aggregates arise, and in dependence on the great primary elements, mind-originated materiality arises. (3)

141. Lokuttaraṃ dhammaṃ paccayā lokuttaro dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā… tīṇi.

141. A supramundane phenomenon arises in dependence on a supramundane phenomenon by root condition… three.

Lokiyañca lokuttarañca dhammaṃ paccayā lokiyo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – lokuttare khandhe ca mahābhūte ca paccayā cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ. (1)

A mundane phenomenon arises in dependence on a mundane and a supramundane phenomenon by root condition—in dependence on the supramundane aggregates and the great primary elements, mind-originated materiality arises. (1)

Lokiyañca lokuttarañca dhammaṃ paccayā lokuttaro dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – lokuttaraṃ ekaṃ khandhañca vatthuñca paccayā tayo khandhā…pe… dve khandhe…pe…. (2)

A supramundane phenomenon arises in dependence on a mundane and a supramundane phenomenon by root condition—in dependence on one supramundane aggregate and the physical base, three aggregates arise… two aggregates… (2)

Lokiyañca lokuttarañca dhammaṃ paccayā lokiyo ca lokuttaro ca dhammā uppajjanti hetupaccayā – lokuttaraṃ ekaṃ khandhañca vatthuñca paccayā tayo khandhā…pe… dve khandhe…pe… lokuttare khandhe ca mahābhūte ca paccayā cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ (saṃkhittaṃ). (3)

Both mundane and supramundane phenomena arise in dependence on a mundane and a supramundane phenomenon by root condition—in dependence on one supramundane aggregate and the physical base, three aggregates arise… two aggregates… and in dependence on the supramundane aggregates and the great primary elements, mind-originated materiality arises (in brief). (3)

Pure.

142. Hetuyā nava, ārammaṇe cattāri, adhipatiyā nava, anantare [T 3.0160] cattāri, samanantare cattāri, sahajāte nava, aññamaññe cattāri, nissaye nava, upanissaye cattāri, purejāte cattāri, āsevane cattāri, kamme nava, vipāke nava…pe… magge nava, sampayutte cattāri, vippayutte nava, atthiyā nava, natthiyā cattāri, vigate cattāri, avigate nava.

142. In relation to root condition, nine; in relation to object condition, four; in relation to predominance condition, nine; in relation to contiguity condition, four; in relation to immediate proximity condition, four; in relation to co-nascence condition, nine; in relation to mutuality condition, four; in relation to support condition, nine; in relation to decisive support condition, four; in relation to pre-nascence condition, four; in relation to repetition condition, four; in relation to kamma condition, nine; in relation to resultant condition, nine… in relation to path condition, nine; in relation to association condition, four; in relation to dissociation condition, nine; in relation to presence condition, nine; in relation to absence condition, four; in relation to disappearance condition, four; in relation to non-disappearance condition, nine.

143. Lokiyaṃ [M 3.0139][V 3.0170] dhammaṃ paccayā lokiyo dhammo uppajjati nahetupaccayā – ahetukaṃ lokiyaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ…pe… (yāva asaññasattā) cakkhāyatanaṃ paccayā cakkhuviññāṇaṃ…pe… kāyāyatanaṃ paccayā kāyaviññāṇaṃ, vatthuṃ paccayā ahetukā lokiyā khandhā, vicikicchāsahagate uddhaccasahagate khandhe ca vatthuñca paccayā vicikicchāsahagato uddhaccasahagato moho (saṃkhittaṃ).

143. A mundane phenomenon arises in dependence on a mundane phenomenon by non-root condition—one rootless mundane aggregate… (up to non-percipient beings); in dependence on the eye-base, eye-consciousness arises… in dependence on the body-base, body-consciousness arises; in dependence on the physical base, the rootless mundane aggregates arise; and in dependence on the doubt-accompanied and restlessness-accompanied aggregates and the physical base, doubt-accompanied and restlessness-accompanied delusion arises (in brief).

The Pure

144. 144. By non-root condition, one; by non-object condition, three; by non-dominance condition, four; by non-contiguity condition, three… by non-proximate support condition, three; by non-prenascence condition, four; by non-postnascence condition, nine; by non-repetition condition, nine (the supramundane, the immaterial, and the resultant should be specified); by non-kamma condition, four; by non-result condition, nine; by non-nutriment condition, one; by non-faculty condition, one; by non-jhāna condition, one; by non-path condition, one; by non-association condition, three; by non-dissociation condition, two; by non-absence condition, three; by non-disappearance condition, three.

Paccanīyaṃ.

145. By root condition, by non-object condition, three; by non-dominance condition, four; by non-contiguity condition, three (non-proximity and so on are similar to the Negation); by non-result condition, nine; by non-association condition, three; by non-dissociation condition, two; by non-absence condition, three; by non-disappearance condition, three.

147. Lokiyaṃ [V 3.0172] dhammaṃ saṃsaṭṭho lokiyo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – lokiyaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ saṃsaṭṭhā tayo khandhā…pe… dve khandhe…pe… paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe…. (1)

147. Associated with a mundane phenomenon, a mundane phenomenon arises by root condition: associated with one mundane aggregate are three aggregates… with two aggregates… at the moment of rebirth-linking… (1)

Lokuttaraṃ dhammaṃ saṃsaṭṭho lokuttaro dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – lokuttaraṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ saṃsaṭṭhā tayo khandhā…pe… dve khandhe…pe…. (1)

1. Paccayānulomaṃ

1. The Concordance of Conditions

1. Vibhaṅgavāro

1. The Section on Analysis

Hetupaccayo

The Root Condition.

148. Lokiyo dhammo lokiyassa dhammassa hetupaccayena paccayo – lokiyā hetū sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ hetupaccayena paccayo; paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe…. (1)

148. A mundane phenomenon is a condition for a mundane phenomenon by way of root condition: mundane roots are a condition for the associated aggregates and for mind-originated material form by way of root condition; at the moment of rebirth-linking… (1)

Lokuttaro [M 3.0141][V 3.0173] dhammo lokuttarassa dhammassa hetupaccayena paccayo… tīṇi.

A supramundane phenomenon is a condition for a supramundane phenomenon by way of root condition… three.

Ārammaṇapaccayo

The Object Condition.

149. Lokiyo [T 3.0162] dhammo lokiyassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo – dānaṃ…pe… sīlaṃ…pe… uposathakammaṃ katvā taṃ paccavekkhati, pubbe suciṇṇāni paccavekkhati, jhānā…pe… ariyā gotrabhuṃ paccavekkhanti, vodānaṃ paccavekkhanti, pahīne kilese paccavekkhanti, vikkhambhite kilese…pe… pubbe samudāciṇṇe kilese jānanti; cakkhuṃ…pe… vatthuṃ lokiye khandhe aniccato…pe… domanassaṃ uppajjati; dibbena cakkhunā rūpaṃ passati, dibbāya sotadhātuyā saddaṃ suṇāti. Cetopariyañāṇena lokiyacittasamaṅgissa cittaṃ jānāti, ākāsānañcāyatanaṃ viññāṇañcāyatanassa…pe… ākiñcaññāyatanaṃ nevasaññānāsaññāyatanassa…pe… rūpāyatanaṃ cakkhuviññāṇassa…pe… phoṭṭhabbāyatanaṃ kāyaviññāṇassa, lokiyā khandhā iddhividhañāṇassa, cetopariyañāṇassa, pubbenivāsānussatiñāṇassa, yathākammūpagañāṇassa, anāgataṃsañāṇassa, āvajjanāya ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo. (1)

149. A mundane phenomenon is a condition for a mundane phenomenon by way of object condition: having performed an act of generosity… morality… observance of the Uposatha, one reflects upon it; one reflects upon past good deeds; the jhānas… the noble ones reflect on change-of-lineage, reflect on purification, reflect on the abandoned defilements, reflect on the suppressed defilements… they know previously accumulated defilements; the eye… the base… sorrow arises regarding the mundane aggregates as impermanent… with the divine eye one sees forms, with the divine ear-element one hears sounds. Through mind-penetrating knowledge, one knows the mind of one endowed with mundane consciousness; the base of infinite space is a condition for the base of infinite consciousness… the base of nothingness is a condition for the base of neither-perception-nor-non-perception… the visible object is a condition for eye-consciousness… the tangible object is a condition for body-consciousness; the mundane aggregates are a condition for the knowledge of psychic powers, mind-penetrating knowledge, knowledge of past lives, knowledge of the destiny of beings according to their actions, knowledge of the future, and adverting, by way of object condition. (1)

150. Lokuttaro dhammo lokuttarassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo – nibbānaṃ maggassa, phalassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo. (1)

150. A supramundane phenomenon is a condition for a supramundane phenomenon by way of object condition: Nibbāna is a condition for the path and the fruit by way of object condition. (1)

Lokuttaro dhammo lokiyassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo – ariyā maggā vuṭṭhahitvā maggaṃ paccavekkhanti, phalaṃ paccavekkhanti, nibbānaṃ paccavekkhanti; nibbānaṃ gotrabhussa, vodānassa, āvajjanāya ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo; ariyā cetopariyañāṇena lokuttaracittasamaṅgissa cittaṃ jānanti, lokuttarā khandhā cetopariyañāṇassa, pubbenivāsānussatiñāṇassa[T 3.0163], anāgataṃsañāṇassa, āvajjanāya ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo. (2)

A supramundane phenomenon is a condition for a mundane phenomenon by way of object condition: the noble ones, having emerged from the path, review the path, review the fruition, review Nibbāna; Nibbāna is a condition for the change-of-lineage, for purification, and for adverting, by way of object condition; the noble ones know the mind of one endowed with supramundane consciousness through mind-penetrating knowledge; the supramundane aggregates are a condition for mind-penetrating knowledge, for knowledge of past lives, for knowledge of the future, and for adverting, by way of object condition. (2)

Adhipatipaccayo

Dominance Condition

151. Lokiyo dhammo lokiyassa dhammassa adhipatipaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇādhipati, sahajātādhipati. Ārammaṇādhipati – dānaṃ datvā sīlaṃ…pe… uposathakammaṃ [V 3.0174] …pe… pubbe…pe… jhānā…pe… sekkhā gotrabhuṃ garuṃ katvā paccavekkhanti, vodānaṃ garuṃ katvā paccavekkhanti; cakkhuṃ…pe… vatthuṃ [M 3.0142] lokiye khandhe garuṃ katvā assādeti abhinandati, taṃ garuṃ katvā rāgo uppajjati, diṭṭhi uppajjati. Sahajātādhipati – lokiyādhipati sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ adhipatipaccayena paccayo. (1)

151. A mundane phenomenon is a condition for a mundane phenomenon by way of dominance condition: object-dominance, co-nascence dominance. Object-dominance: Having given alms, observed precepts… performed the Uposatha… previously… the jhānas… the learners reflect on the change-of-lineage, holding it in esteem; they reflect on purification, holding it in esteem. One enjoys and delights in the eye… the base… the mundane aggregates, holding them in esteem. Holding that in esteem, lust arises, wrong view arises. Co-nascence dominance: The mundane dominant state is a condition for the associated aggregates and for the mind-originated material form by way of dominance condition. (1)

152. Lokuttaro dhammo lokuttarassa dhammassa adhipatipaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇādhipati, sahajātādhipati. Ārammaṇādhipati – nibbānaṃ maggassa, phalassa adhipatipaccayena paccayo. Sahajātādhipati – lokuttarādhipati sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ adhipatipaccayena paccayo. (1)

152. A supramundane phenomenon is a condition for a supramundane phenomenon by way of dominance condition: object-dominance, co-nascence dominance. Object-dominance: Nibbāna is a condition for the path and the fruit by way of dominance condition. Co-nascence dominance: The supramundane dominant state is a condition for the associated aggregates by way of dominance condition. (1)

Lokuttaro dhammo lokiyassa dhammassa adhipatipaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇādhipati, sahajātādhipati. Ārammaṇādhipati – ariyā maggā vuṭṭhahitvā maggaṃ garuṃ katvā paccavekkhanti, phalaṃ garuṃ katvā paccavekkhanti, nibbānaṃ garuṃ katvā paccavekkhanti; nibbānaṃ gotrabhussa, vodānassa adhipatipaccayena paccayo. Sahajātādhipati – lokuttarādhipati cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ adhipatipaccayena paccayo. (2)

A supramundane phenomenon is a condition for a mundane phenomenon by way of dominance condition: object-dominance, co-nascence dominance. Object-dominance: The noble ones, having emerged from the path, review the path, holding it in esteem; review the fruition, holding it in esteem; review Nibbāna, holding it in esteem; Nibbāna is a condition for the change-of-lineage and for purification by way of dominance condition. Co-nascence dominance: The supramundane dominant state is a condition for mind-originated material form by way of dominance condition. (2)

Lokuttaro dhammo lokiyassa ca lokuttarassa ca dhammassa adhipatipaccayena paccayo. Sahajātādhipati [T 3.0164] – lokuttarādhipati sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ adhipatipaccayena paccayo. (3)

A supramundane phenomenon is a condition for both a mundane phenomenon and a supramundane phenomenon by way of dominance condition. Co-nascence dominance: The supramundane dominant state is a condition for the associated aggregates and for the mind-originated material form by way of dominance condition. (3)

Anantarapaccayo

Immediate Condition

153. Lokiyo dhammo lokiyassa dhammassa anantarapaccayena paccayo – purimā purimā lokiyā khandhā pacchimānaṃ pacchimānaṃ lokiyānaṃ khandhānaṃ…pe… anulomaṃ gotrabhussa… anulomaṃ vodānassa anantarapaccayena paccayo. (1)

153. A mundane phenomenon is a condition for a mundane phenomenon by way of the immediate condition. Preceding mundane aggregates are a condition for subsequent mundane aggregates... adaptation for change-of-lineage... adaptation for purification by way of the immediate condition. (1)

Lokiyo dhammo lokuttarassa dhammassa anantarapaccayena paccayo – gotrabhu maggassa… vodānaṃ [V 3.0175] maggassa… anulomaṃ phalasamāpattiyā… nirodhā vuṭṭhahantassa nevasaññānāsaññāyatanaṃ phalasamāpattiyā anantarapaccayena paccayo. (2)

A mundane phenomenon is a condition for a supramundane phenomenon by way of the immediate condition. Change-of-lineage is a condition for the path... purification is a condition for the path... adaptation is a condition for fruition attainment... for one emerging from cessation, the base of neither-perception-nor-non-perception is a condition for fruition attainment by way of the immediate condition. (2)

154. Lokuttaro dhammo lokuttarassa dhammassa anantarapaccayena paccayo – purimā purimā lokuttarā khandhā pacchimānaṃ pacchimānaṃ lokuttarānaṃ khandhānaṃ [M 3.0143] anantarapaccayena paccayo; maggo phalassa, phalaṃ phalassa anantarapaccayena paccayo. (1)

154. A supramundane phenomenon is a condition for a supramundane phenomenon by way of the immediate condition. Preceding supramundane aggregates are a condition for subsequent supramundane aggregates by way of the immediate condition; the path is a condition for the fruit, the fruit is a condition for the fruit by way of the immediate condition. (1)

Lokuttaro dhammo lokiyassa dhammassa anantarapaccayena paccayo – phalaṃ vuṭṭhānassa anantarapaccayena paccayo. (2)

A supramundane phenomenon is a condition for a mundane phenomenon by way of the immediate condition. Fruition is a condition for emergence by way of the immediate condition. (2)

Samanantarapaccayādi

Contiguity Condition, etc.

155. Lokiyo dhammo lokiyassa dhammassa samanantarapaccayena paccayo… sahajātapaccayena paccayo (pañca pañhā, ghaṭanā natthi) aññamaññapaccayena paccayo… dve… nissayapaccayena paccayo.

155. A mundane phenomenon is a condition for a mundane phenomenon by way of the contiguity condition... by way of the co-nascence condition (five questions, no combination)... by way of the reciprocal condition... two... by way of the support condition.

Upanissayapaccayo

Decisive Support Condition

156. Lokiyo dhammo lokiyassa dhammassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇūpanissayo, anantarūpanissayo, pakatūpanissayo…pe…. Pakatūpanissayo – lokiyaṃ saddhaṃ upanissāya dānaṃ deti…pe… vipassanaṃ [T 3.0165] uppādeti, abhiññaṃ uppādeti, samāpattiṃ uppādeti, mānaṃ jappeti, diṭṭhiṃ gaṇhāti; lokiyaṃ sīlaṃ…pe… senāsanaṃ upanissāya dānaṃ deti…pe… saṅghaṃ bhindati; lokiyā saddhā…pe… senāsanaṃ lokiyāya saddhāya…pe… kāyikassa dukkhassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo; kusalākusalaṃ kammaṃ vipākassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo. (1)

156. A mundane phenomenon is a condition for a mundane phenomenon by way of the decisive support condition: object decisive support, immediate decisive support, natural decisive support... Natural decisive support: Relying on mundane faith, one gives alms... develops insight, gives rise to supernormal knowledge, gives rise to attainment, indulges in conceit, grasps wrong views; relying on mundane virtue... relying on a dwelling place, one gives alms... splits the Sangha; mundane faith... dwelling place is a condition for mundane faith... for bodily suffering by way of the decisive support condition; wholesome and unwholesome kamma is a condition for its result by way of the decisive support condition. (1)

Lokiyo dhammo lokuttarasa dhammassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo – anantarūpanissayo, pakatūpanissayo…pe…. Pakatūpanissayo – paṭhamassa maggassa parikammaṃ paṭhamassa maggassa upanissayapaccayena [V 3.0176] paccayo…pe… catutthassa maggassa parikammaṃ catutthassa maggassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo. (2)

A mundane phenomenon is a condition for a supramundane phenomenon by way of the decisive support condition: immediate decisive support, natural decisive support, etc. Natural decisive support: the preliminary work for the first path is a condition for the first path by way of decisive support condition… the preliminary work for the fourth path is a condition for the fourth path by way of decisive support condition. (2)

157. Lokuttaro dhammo lokuttarassa dhammassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇūpanissayo, anantarūpanissayo, pakatūpanissayo…pe…. Pakatūpanissayo – paṭhamo maggo dutiyassa maggassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo…pe… tatiyo maggo catutthassa maggassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo. (1)

157. A supramundane phenomenon is a condition for a supramundane phenomenon by way of decisive support condition: object decisive support, proximity decisive support, natural decisive support... Natural decisive support: the first path is a condition for the second path by way of decisive support condition... the third path is a condition for the fourth path by way of decisive support condition. (1)

Lokuttaro [M 3.0144] dhammo lokiyassa dhammassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇūpanissayo, anantarūpanissayo, pakatūpanissayo…pe…. Pakatūpanissayo – ariyā maggaṃ upanissāya anuppannaṃ samāpattiṃ uppādenti, uppannaṃ samāpajjanti, saṅkhāre aniccato dukkhato anattato vipassanti, ariyānaṃ maggo…pe… ṭhānāṭhānakosallassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo; phalasamāpatti kāyikassa sukhassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo. (2)

A supramundane phenomenon is a condition for a mundane phenomenon by way of decisive support condition: object decisive support, proximity decisive support, natural decisive support... Natural decisive support: the noble ones, relying on the path, give rise to unattained attainments, enter into attained ones, and contemplate formations as impermanent, suffering, and non-self; the path of the noble ones... is a condition for skill in what is possible and impossible by way of decisive support condition; the fruition attainment is a condition for bodily pleasure by way of decisive support condition. (2)

Purejātapaccayo

Pre-nascence Condition

158. Lokiyo [T 3.0166] dhammo lokiyassa dhammassa purejātapaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇapurejātaṃ, vatthupurejātaṃ. Ārammaṇapurejātaṃ – cakkhuṃ…pe… vatthuṃ aniccato dukkhato anattato…pe… domanassaṃ uppajjati; dibbena cakkhunā rūpaṃ passati, dibbāya sotadhātuyā saddaṃ suṇāti. Rūpāyatanaṃ cakkhuviññāṇassa…pe… phoṭṭhabbāyatanaṃ kāyaviññāṇassa purejātapaccayena paccayo. Vatthupurejātaṃ – cakkhāyatanaṃ cakkhuviññāṇassa…pe… kāyāyatanaṃ kāyaviññāṇassa…pe… vatthu lokiyānaṃ khandhānaṃ purejātapaccayena paccayo. (1)

158. A mundane phenomenon is a condition for a mundane phenomenon by way of pre-nascence condition: object pre-nascence, base pre-nascence. Object pre-nascence: one contemplates the eye... the base as impermanent, suffering, and non-self... sorrow arises; with the divine eye, one sees forms; with the divine ear element, one hears sounds. The form base is a condition for eye-consciousness... the tangible base is a condition for body-consciousness by way of pre-nascence condition. Base pre-nascence: the eye base is a condition for eye-consciousness... the body base is a condition for body-consciousness... the base is a condition for the mundane aggregates by way of pre-nascence condition. (1)

Lokiyo dhammo lokuttarassa dhammassa purejātapaccayena paccayo. Vatthupurejātaṃ – vatthu lokuttarānaṃ khandhānaṃ purejātapaccayena paccayo. (2)

A mundane phenomenon is a condition for a supramundane phenomenon by way of pre-nascence condition. Base pre-nascence: The base is a condition for the supramundane aggregates by way of pre-nascence condition. (2)

Pacchājātapaccayo

Post-nascence Condition

159. Lokiyo [V 3.0177] dhammo lokiyassa dhammassa pacchājātapaccayena paccayo – pacchājātā lokiyā khandhā purejātassa imassa kāyassa pacchājātapaccayena paccayo. (1)

159. A mundane phenomenon is a condition for a mundane phenomenon by way of post-nascence condition. Post-nascent mundane aggregates are a condition for this pre-nascent body by way of post-nascence condition. (1)

Lokuttaro dhammo lokiyassa dhammassa pacchājātapaccayena paccayo – pacchājātā lokuttarā khandhā purejātassa imassa kāyassa pacchājātapaccayena paccayo. (1)

A supramundane phenomenon is a condition for a mundane phenomenon by way of post-nascence condition. Post-nascent supramundane aggregates are a condition for this pre-nascent body by way of post-nascence condition. (1)

Āsevanapaccayo

Repetition Condition

160. Lokiyo [T 3.0167][M 3.0145] dhammo lokiyassa dhammassa āsevanapaccayena paccayo – purimā purimā lokiyā khandhā pacchimānaṃ pacchimānaṃ lokiyānaṃ khandhānaṃ āsevanapaccayena paccayo; anulomaṃ gotrabhussa… anulomaṃ vodānassa āsevanapaccayena paccayo. (1)

160. A mundane phenomenon is a condition for a mundane phenomenon by way of repetition condition. Preceding mundane aggregates are a condition for succeeding mundane aggregates by way of repetition condition; adaptation is a condition for change-of-lineage… adaptation is a condition for purification by way of repetition condition. (1)

Lokiyo dhammo lokuttarassa dhammassa āsevanapaccayena paccayo – gotrabhu maggassa… vodānaṃ maggassa āsevanapaccayena paccayo. (2)

A mundane phenomenon is a condition for a supramundane phenomenon by way of repetition condition. Change-of-lineage is a condition for the path… purification is a condition for the path by way of repetition condition. (2)

Kammapaccayo

Kamma Condition

161. Lokiyo dhammo lokiyassa dhammassa kammapaccayena paccayo – sahajātā, nānākkhaṇikā. Sahajātā – lokiyā cetanā sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ kammapaccayena paccayo; paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe…. Nānākkhaṇikā – lokiyā cetanā vipākānaṃ khandhānaṃ kaṭattā ca rūpānaṃ kammapaccayena paccayo. (1)

161. A mundane phenomenon is a condition for a mundane phenomenon by way of kamma condition: conascent, asynchronous. Conascent: mundane volition is a condition for associated aggregates and for mind-originated material phenomena by way of kamma condition; at the moment of rebirth-linking... Asynchronous: mundane volition is a condition for resultant aggregates and for kamma-originated material phenomena by way of kamma condition. (1)

Lokuttaro dhammo lokuttarassa dhammassa kammapaccayena paccayo – sahajātā, nānākkhaṇikā. Sahajātā – lokuttarā cetanā sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ kammapaccayena paccayo. Nānākkhaṇikā – lokuttarā cetanā vipākānaṃ khandhānaṃ kammapaccayena paccayo. (1)

A supramundane phenomenon is a condition for a supramundane phenomenon by way of kamma condition: conascent, asynchronous. Conascent: supramundane volition is a condition for associated aggregates by way of kamma condition. Asynchronous: supramundane volition is a condition for resultant aggregates by way of kamma condition. (1)

Lokuttaro [V 3.0178] dhammo lokiyassa dhammassa kammapaccayena paccayo – lokuttarā cetanā cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ kammapaccayena paccayo. (2)

A supramundane phenomenon is a condition for a mundane phenomenon by way of kamma condition. Supramundane volition is a condition for mind-originated material phenomena by way of kamma condition. (2)

Lokuttaro dhammo lokiyassa ca lokuttarassa ca dhammassa kammapaccayena paccayo – lokuttarā cetanā sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ kammapaccayena paccayo. (3)

A supramundane phenomenon is a condition for mundane and supramundane phenomena by way of kamma condition. Supramundane volition is a condition for the associated aggregates and for mind-originated material phenomena by way of kamma condition. (3)

Vipākapaccayo

Result Condition

162. Lokiyo dhammo lokiyassa dhammassa vipākapaccayena paccayo – vipāko lokiyo eko khandho tiṇṇannaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ vipākapaccayena paccayo…pe… dve khandhā…pe… paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe…. (1)

162. A mundane phenomenon is a condition for a mundane phenomenon by way of result condition. A single mundane resultant aggregate is a condition for the three aggregates and for mind-originated material phenomena by way of result condition... two aggregates... at the moment of rebirth-linking... (1)

Lokuttaro [M 3.0146] dhammo lokuttarassa dhammassa vipākapaccayena paccayo… tīṇi.

A supramundane phenomenon is a condition for a supramundane phenomenon by way of result condition… three.

Āhārapaccayo

Nutriment Condition

163. Lokiyo dhammo lokiyassa dhammassa āhārapaccayena paccayo – lokiyā āhārā sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañca [T 3.0168] rūpānaṃ āhārapaccayena paccayo; paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe… kabaḷīkāro āhāro imassa kāyassa āhārapaccayena paccayo. (1)

163. A mundane phenomenon is a condition for a mundane phenomenon by way of nutriment condition. Mundane nutriments are a condition for the associated aggregates and for mind-originated material phenomena by way of nutriment condition; at the moment of rebirth-linking... physical nutriment is a condition for this body by way of nutriment condition. (1)

Lokuttaro dhammo lokuttarassa dhammassa āhārapaccayena paccayo… tīṇi.

A supramundane phenomenon is a condition for a supramundane phenomenon by way of nutriment condition… three.

Indriyapaccayo

Faculty Condition

164. Lokiyo dhammo lokiyassa dhammassa indriyapaccayena paccayo (paṭisandhi kātabbā); cakkhundriyaṃ cakkhuviññāṇassa…pe… kāyindriyaṃ kāyaviññāṇassa indriyapaccayena paccayo; rūpajīvitindriyaṃ kaṭattārūpānaṃ indriyapaccayena paccayo. (1)

164. A mundane phenomenon is a condition for a mundane phenomenon by way of faculty condition (rebirth-linking is to be stated); the eye faculty is a condition for eye-consciousness... the body faculty is a condition for body-consciousness by way of faculty condition; the material life-faculty is a condition for kamma-originated material phenomena by way of faculty condition. (1)

Lokuttaro dhammo lokuttarassa dhammassa indriyapaccayena paccayo… tīṇi.

A supramundane phenomenon is a condition for a supramundane phenomenon by way of faculty condition… three.

Jhānapaccayādi

Jhāna Condition, etc.

165. Lokiyo [V 3.0179] dhammo lokiyassa dhammassa jhānapaccayena paccayo… ekaṃ, lokuttaro dhammo…pe… tīṇi… maggapaccayena paccayo, lokiye ekaṃ, lokuttare tīṇi.

165. A mundane phenomenon is a condition for a mundane phenomenon by way of jhāna condition... one. A supramundane phenomenon... three. By way of path condition: in the mundane, one; in the supramundane, three.

Lokiyo dhammo lokiyassa dhammassa sampayuttapaccayena paccayo… ekaṃ, lokuttaro dhammo…pe… ekaṃ.

A mundane phenomenon is a condition for a mundane phenomenon by way of association condition… one. A supramundane phenomenon… and so on… one.

Vippayuttapaccayo

Dissociation Condition

166. Lokiyo dhammo lokiyassa dhammassa vippayuttapaccayena paccayo – sahajātaṃ, purejātaṃ, pacchājātaṃ. Sahajātā – lokiyā khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ vippayuttapaccayena paccayo; paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe… khandhā vatthussa vippayuttapaccayena paccayo; vatthu khandhānaṃ vippayuttapaccayena paccayo. Purejātaṃ – cakkhāyatanaṃ cakkhuviññāṇassa…pe… kāyāyatanaṃ [M 3.0147] kāyaviññāṇassa…pe… vatthu lokiyānaṃ khandhānaṃ vippayuttapaccayena paccayo. Pacchājātā – lokiyā khandhā purejātassa imassa kāyassa vippayuttapaccayena paccayo. (1)

166. A mundane phenomenon is a condition for a mundane phenomenon by way of dissociation condition—co-nascent, pre-nascent, and post-nascent. Co-nascent—mundane aggregates are a condition for mind-originated material phenomena by way of dissociation condition; at the moment of rebirth-linking… and so on… aggregates are a condition for the base by way of dissociation condition; the base is a condition for the aggregates by way of dissociation condition. Pre-nascent—the eye-base is a condition for eye-consciousness… and so on… the body-base is a condition for body-consciousness… and so on… the base is a condition for mundane aggregates by way of dissociation condition. Post-nascent—mundane aggregates are a condition for this pre-nascent body by way of dissociation condition. (1)

Lokiyo [T 3.0169] dhammo lokuttarassa dhammassa vippayuttapaccayena paccayo. Purejātaṃ – vatthu lokuttarānaṃ khandhānaṃ vippayuttapaccayena paccayo. (2)

A mundane phenomenon is a condition for a supramundane phenomenon by way of dissociation condition. Pre-nascent—the base is a condition for supramundane aggregates by way of dissociation condition. (2)

Lokuttaro dhammo lokiyassa dhammassa vippayuttapaccayena paccayo – sahajātaṃ, pacchājātaṃ. Sahajātā – lokuttarā khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ vippayuttapaccayena paccayo. Pacchājātā – lokuttarā khandhā purejātassa imassa kāyassa vippayuttapaccayena paccayo. (1)

A supramundane phenomenon is a condition for a mundane phenomenon by way of dissociation condition—co-nascent and post-nascent. Co-nascent—supramundane aggregates are a condition for mind-originated material phenomena by way of dissociation condition. Post-nascent—supramundane aggregates are a condition for this pre-nascent body by way of dissociation condition. (1)

Atthipaccayādi

Presence Condition, and so on

167. Lokiyo dhammo lokiyassa dhammassa atthipaccayena paccayo – sahajātaṃ, purejātaṃ, pacchājātaṃ, āhāraṃ, indriyaṃ. Sahajāto – lokiyo eko khandho tiṇṇannaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ…pe… (yāva asaññasattā). Purejātaṃ – cakkhuṃ…pe… vatthuṃ [V 3.0180] …pe… (purejātasadisaṃ). Vatthu lokiyānaṃ khandhānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo. Pacchājātā – lokiyā khandhā purejātassa imassa kāyassa atthipaccayena paccayo; kabaḷīkāro āhāro imassa kāyassa atthipaccayena paccayo; rūpajīvitindriyaṃ kaṭattārūpānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo. (1)

167. A mundane phenomenon is a condition for a mundane phenomenon by way of presence condition—co-nascent, pre-nascent, post-nascent, nutriment, and faculty. Co-nascent—one mundane aggregate is a condition for three aggregates and mind-originated material phenomena… (up to non-percipient beings). Pre-nascent—the eye… the base… (similar to pre-nascent). The base is a condition for mundane aggregates by way of presence condition. Post-nascent—mundane aggregates are a condition for this pre-nascent body by way of presence condition; physical nutriment is a condition for this body by way of presence condition; the material life faculty is a condition for kamma-originated material phenomena by way of presence condition. (1)

Lokiyo dhammo lokuttarassa dhammassa atthipaccayena paccayo. Purejātaṃ – vatthu lokuttarānaṃ khandhānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo. (2)

A mundane phenomenon is a condition for a supramundane phenomenon by way of presence condition. Pre-nascent—the base is a condition for supramundane aggregates by way of presence condition. (2)

168. Lokuttaro dhammo lokuttarassa dhammassa atthipaccayena paccayo – lokuttaro eko khandho tiṇṇannaṃ khandhānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo…pe… dve khandhā…pe…. (1)

168. A supramundane phenomenon is a condition for a supramundane phenomenon by way of presence condition—one supramundane aggregate is a condition for three aggregates by way of presence condition… and so on… two aggregates… and so on…. (1)

Lokuttaro dhammo lokiyassa dhammassa atthipaccayena paccayo – sahajātaṃ, pacchājātaṃ. Sahajātā [T 3.0170] – lokuttarā khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo. Pacchājātā – lokuttarā khandhā purejātassa imassa kāyassa atthipaccayena paccayo. (2)

A supramundane phenomenon is a condition for a mundane phenomenon by way of presence condition—co-nascent, post-nascent. Co-nascent—supramundane aggregates are a condition for mind-originated material phenomena by way of presence condition. Post-nascent—supramundane aggregates are a condition for this pre-nascent body by way of presence condition. (2)

Lokuttaro [M 3.0148] dhammo lokiyassa ca lokuttarassa ca dhammassa atthipaccayena paccayo – lokuttaro eko khandho tiṇṇannaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo…pe… dve khandhā…pe…. (3)

A supramundane phenomenon is a condition for both mundane and supramundane phenomena by way of presence condition—one supramundane aggregate is a condition for three aggregates and mind-originated material phenomena by way of presence condition… and so on… two aggregates… and so on…. (3)

169. Lokiyo ca lokuttaro ca dhammā lokiyassa dhammassa atthipaccayena paccayo – sahajātaṃ, pacchājātaṃ, āhāraṃ, indriyaṃ. Sahajātā – lokuttarā khandhā ca mahābhūtā ca cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo. Pacchājātā – lokuttarā khandhā ca kabaḷīkāro āhāro ca imassa kāyassa atthipaccayena paccayo. Pacchājātā – lokuttarā khandhā ca rūpajīvitindriyañca kaṭattārūpānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo. (1)

169. Mundane and supramundane phenomena are conditions for a mundane phenomenon by way of presence condition—co-nascent, post-nascent, nutriment, and faculty. Co-nascent—supramundane aggregates and the great elements are conditions for mind-originated material phenomena by way of presence condition. Post-nascent—supramundane aggregates and physical nutriment are conditions for this body by way of presence condition. Post-nascent—supramundane aggregates and the material life faculty are conditions for kamma-originated material phenomena by way of presence condition. (1)

Lokiyo ca lokuttaro ca dhammā lokuttarassa dhammassa atthipaccayena paccayo – sahajātaṃ, purejātaṃ. Sahajāto – lokuttaro eko khandho ca vatthu ca tiṇṇannaṃ khandhānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo…pe… dve khandhā ca…pe…. (2)

Mundane and supramundane phenomena are conditions for a supramundane phenomenon by way of presence condition—co-nascent and pre-nascent. Co-nascent—one supramundane aggregate and the base are conditions for three aggregates by way of presence condition… and so on… two aggregates and the base… and so on…. (2)

Natthipaccayena [V 3.0181] paccayo… vigatapaccayena paccayo… avigatapaccayena paccayo. (2)

By way of absence condition… by way of disappearance condition… by way of non-disappearance condition. (2)

1. Paccayānulomaṃ

1. The Progression of Conditions

2. Saṅkhyāvāro

2. The Enumeration Chapter

Suddhaṃ

Pure

170. Hetuyā cattāri, ārammaṇe tīṇi, adhipatiyā cattāri, anantare cattāri, samanantare cattāri, sahajāte pañca, aññamaññe dve, nissaye satta, upanissaye cattāri, purejāte dve, pacchājāte [T 3.0171] dve, āsevane dve, kamme cattāri, vipāke cattāri, āhāre cattāri, indriye cattāri, jhāne cattāri, magge cattāri, sampayutte dve, vippayutte tīṇi, atthiyā satta, natthiyā cattāri, vigate cattāri, avigate satta.

170. By root condition, four; by object condition, three; by predominance condition, four; by contiguity condition, four; by immediate proximity condition, four; by co-nascence condition, five; by reciprocity condition, two; by dependence condition, seven; by decisive support condition, four; by pre-nascence condition, two; by post-nascence condition, two; by repetition condition, two; by kamma condition, four; by result condition, four; by nutriment condition, four; by faculty condition, four; by jhāna condition, four; by path condition, four; by association condition, two; by dissociation condition, three; by presence condition, seven; by absence condition, four; by disappearance condition, four; by non-disappearance condition, seven.

Anulomaṃ.

The Direct Order

The Negative Section

171. Lokiyo dhammo lokiyassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo… sahajātapaccayena paccayo… upanissayapaccayena paccayo… purejātapaccayena [M 3.0149] paccayo… pacchājātapaccayena paccayo… kammapaccayena paccayo… āhārapaccayena paccayo… indriyapaccayena paccayo. (1)

171. A mundane phenomenon is a condition for a mundane phenomenon by way of object condition… by way of co-nascence condition… by way of decisive support condition… by way of pre-nascence condition… by way of post-nascence condition… by way of kamma condition… by way of nutriment condition… by way of faculty condition. (1)

Lokiyo dhammo lokuttarassa dhammassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo… purejātapaccayena paccayo. (2)

A mundane phenomenon is a condition for a supramundane phenomenon by way of decisive support condition… by way of pre-nascence condition. (2)

172. Lokuttaro dhammo lokuttarassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo… sahajātapaccayena paccayo… upanissayapaccayena paccayo. (1)

172. A supramundane phenomenon is a condition for a supramundane phenomenon by way of object condition… by way of co-nascence condition… by way of decisive support condition. (1)

Lokuttaro [V 3.0182] dhammo lokiyassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo… sahajātapaccayena paccayo… upanissayapaccayena paccayo… pacchājātapaccayena paccayo. (2)

A supramundane phenomenon is a condition for a mundane phenomenon by way of object condition… by way of co-nascence condition… by way of decisive support condition… by way of post-nascence condition. (2)

Lokuttaro dhammo lokiyassa ca lokuttarassa ca dhammassa sahajātapaccayena paccayo. (3)

A supramundane phenomenon is a condition for both mundane and supramundane phenomena by way of co-nascence condition. (3)

Lokiyo ca lokuttaro ca dhammā lokiyassa dhammassa sahajātaṃ… pacchājātaṃ… āhāraṃ… indriyaṃ. (1)

Mundane and supramundane phenomena are conditions for a mundane phenomenon by way of co-nascence… post-nascence… nutriment… faculty. (1)

Lokiyo ca lokuttaro ca dhammā lokuttarassa dhammassa [T 3.0172] sahajātaṃ… purejātaṃ. (2)

Mundane and supramundane phenomena are conditions for a supramundane phenomenon by way of co-nascence… pre-nascence. (2)

176. Kenaci [T 3.0173][V 3.0184] viññeyyaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca kenaci viññeyyo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – kenaci viññeyyaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca tayo khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ…pe… dve khandhe…pe… paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe… khandhe paṭicca vatthu, vatthuṃ paṭicca khandhā, ekaṃ mahābhūtaṃ paṭicca tayo mahābhūtā…pe… mahābhūte paṭicca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ kaṭattārūpaṃ upādārūpaṃ. (1)

176. A phenomenon knowable by some arises dependent on a phenomenon knowable by some by way of root condition—dependent on one aggregate knowable by some, three aggregates and mind-originated materiality arise… two aggregates… at the moment of rebirth-linking… dependent on aggregates, the base; dependent on the base, aggregates; dependent on one great element, three great elements… dependent on the great elements, mind-originated materiality, kamma-originated materiality, and derived materiality arise. (1)

Kenaci viññeyyaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca kenaci naviññeyyo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – kenaci viññeyyaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca kenaci naviññeyyā tayo [M 3.0151] khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ…pe… dve khandhe…pe… paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe… khandhe paṭicca vatthu, vatthuṃ paṭicca khandhā, ekaṃ mahābhūtaṃ…pe… mahābhūte paṭicca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ kaṭattārūpaṃ upādārūpaṃ. (2)

A phenomenon unknowable by some arises dependent on a phenomenon knowable by some by way of root condition—dependent on one aggregate knowable by some, three aggregates unknowable by some and mind-originated materiality arise… two aggregates… at the moment of rebirth-linking… dependent on aggregates, the base; dependent on the base, aggregates; dependent on one great element… dependent on the great elements, mind-originated materiality, kamma-originated materiality, and derived materiality arise. (2)

Kenaci viññeyyaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca kenaci viññeyyo ca kenaci naviññeyyo ca dhammā uppajjanti [V 3.0185] hetupaccayā – kenaci viññeyyaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca kenaci viññeyyā ca kenaci naviññeyyā ca tayo khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ…pe… dve khandhe…pe… paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe… khandhe paṭicca vatthu, vatthuṃ paṭicca khandhā, ekaṃ mahābhūtaṃ…pe… mahābhūte paṭicca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ kaṭattārūpaṃ upādārūpaṃ. (3)

Phenomena that are knowable by some and unknowable by some arise dependent on a phenomenon knowable by some by way of root condition—dependent on one aggregate knowable by some, three aggregates that are knowable by some and unknowable by some, and mind-originated materiality arise… two aggregates… at the moment of rebirth-linking… dependent on aggregates, the base; dependent on the base, aggregates; dependent on one great element… dependent on the great elements, mind-originated materiality, kamma-originated materiality, and derived materiality arise. (3)

177. Kenaci naviññeyyaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca kenaci naviññeyyo dhammo [T 3.0174] uppajjati hetupaccayā – kenaci naviññeyyaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca kenaci naviññeyyā tayo khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ…pe… dve khandhe…pe… paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe… khandhe paṭicca vatthu, vatthuṃ paṭicca khandhā, ekaṃ mahābhūtaṃ…pe… mahābhūte paṭicca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ kaṭattārūpaṃ upādārūpaṃ. (1)

177. A phenomenon unknowable by some arises dependent on a phenomenon unknowable by some by way of root condition—dependent on one aggregate unknowable by some, three aggregates unknowable by some and mind-originated materiality arise… two aggregates… at the moment of rebirth-linking… dependent on aggregates, the base; dependent on the base, aggregates; dependent on one great element… dependent on the great elements, mind-originated materiality, kamma-originated materiality, and derived materiality arise. (1)

Kenaci naviññeyyaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca kenaci viññeyyo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – kenaci naviññeyyaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca kenaci viññeyyā tayo khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ…pe… dve khandhe…pe… paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe… khandhe paṭicca vatthu, vatthuṃ paṭicca khandhā, ekaṃ mahābhūtaṃ…pe… mahābhūte paṭicca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ kaṭattārūpaṃ upādārūpaṃ. (2)

A phenomenon knowable by some arises dependent on a phenomenon unknowable by some by way of root condition—dependent on one aggregate unknowable by some, three aggregates knowable by some and mind-originated materiality arise… two aggregates… at the moment of rebirth-linking… dependent on aggregates, the base; dependent on the base, aggregates; dependent on one great element… dependent on the great elements, mind-originated materiality, kamma-originated materiality, and derived materiality arise. (2)

Kenaci naviññeyyaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca kenaci viññeyyo ca kenaci naviññeyyo ca dhammā uppajjanti hetupaccayā – kenaci naviññeyyaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca kenaci viññeyyā ca kenaci naviññeyyā ca tayo khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ…pe… dve khandhe…pe… paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe… khandhe paṭicca vatthu, vatthuṃ paṭicca khandhā, ekaṃ mahābhūtaṃ…pe… mahābhūte paṭicca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ kaṭattārūpaṃ upādārūpaṃ. (3)

Phenomena that are knowable by some and unknowable by some arise dependent on a phenomenon unknowable by some by way of root condition—dependent on one aggregate unknowable by some, three aggregates that are knowable by some and unknowable by some, and mind-originated materiality arise… two aggregates… at the moment of rebirth-linking… dependent on aggregates, the base; dependent on the base, aggregates; dependent on one great element… dependent on the great elements, mind-originated materiality, kamma-originated materiality, and derived materiality arise. (3)

178. Kenaci viññeyyañca kenaci naviññeyyañca dhammaṃ paṭicca kenaci viññeyyo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – kenaci viññeyyañca kenaci naviññeyyañca ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca kenaci viññeyyā tayo khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ…pe… dve khandhe…pe… paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe… khandhe paṭicca vatthu, vatthuṃ paṭicca khandhā[M 3.0152], ekaṃ mahābhūtaṃ [T 3.0175] …pe… mahābhūte paṭicca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ kaṭattārūpaṃ upādārūpaṃ. (1)

178. A phenomenon knowable by some arises dependent on a phenomenon that is knowable by some and unknowable by some by way of root condition—dependent on one aggregate that is knowable by some and unknowable by some, three aggregates knowable by some and mind-originated materiality arise… two aggregates… at the moment of rebirth-linking… dependent on aggregates, the base; dependent on the base, aggregates; dependent on one great element… dependent on the great elements, mind-originated materiality, kamma-originated materiality, and derived materiality arise. (1)

Kenaci [V 3.0186] viññeyyañca kenaci naviññeyyañca dhammaṃ paṭicca kenaci naviññeyyo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – kenaci viññeyyañca kenaci naviññeyyañca ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca kenaci naviññeyyā tayo khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ…pe… dve khandhe…pe… paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe… khandhe paṭicca vatthu, vatthuṃ paṭicca khandhā, ekaṃ mahābhūtaṃ…pe… mahābhūte paṭicca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ kaṭattārūpaṃ upādārūpaṃ. (2)

A phenomenon unknowable by some arises dependent on a phenomenon knowable by some and unknowable by some by way of the root condition—dependent on one aggregate that is knowable by some and unknowable by some, three aggregates that are unknowable by some and mind-originated materiality arise…pe… two aggregates…pe… at the moment of rebirth-linking…pe… dependent on the aggregates, the base; dependent on the base, the aggregates; dependent on one great element…pe… dependent on the great elements, mind-originated materiality, kamma-born materiality, and derived materiality. (2)

Kenaci viññeyyañca kenaci naviññeyyañca dhammaṃ paṭicca kenaci viññeyyo ca kenaci naviññeyyo ca dhammā uppajjanti hetupaccayā – kenaci viññeyyañca kenaci naviññeyyañca ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca kenaci viññeyyā ca kenaci naviññeyyā ca tayo khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ…pe… dve khandhe…pe… paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe… khandhe paṭicca vatthu, vatthuṃ paṭicca khandhā, ekaṃ mahābhūtaṃ…pe… mahābhūte paṭicca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ kaṭattārūpaṃ upādārūpaṃ (saṃkhittaṃ). (3)

Phenomena that are knowable by some and unknowable by some arise dependent on a phenomenon knowable by some and unknowable by some by way of the root condition—dependent on one aggregate that is knowable by some and unknowable by some, three aggregates that are knowable by some and unknowable by some and mind-originated materiality arise…pe… two aggregates…pe… at the moment of rebirth-linking…pe… dependent on the aggregates, the base; dependent on the base, the aggregates; dependent on one great element…pe… dependent on the great elements, mind-originated materiality, kamma-born materiality, and derived materiality (abbreviated). (3)

Hetupaccayo

The Root Condition

1. Āsavaṃ [M 3.0154][V 3.0188] dhammaṃ paṭicca āsavo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – kāmāsavaṃ paṭicca diṭṭhāsavo avijjāsavo, diṭṭhāsavaṃ paṭicca [T 3.0177] kāmāsavo avijjāsavo, avijjāsavaṃ paṭicca kāmāsavo diṭṭhāsavo, bhavāsavaṃ paṭicca avijjāsavo, diṭṭhāsavaṃ paṭicca avijjāsavo (ekekampi cakkaṃ kātabbaṃ). (1)

1. A phenomenon that is a taint arises dependent on a phenomenon that is a taint by way of the root condition—dependent on the taint of sensual desire, the taint of views and the taint of ignorance arise; dependent on the taint of views, the taint of sensual desire and the taint of ignorance arise; dependent on the taint of ignorance, the taint of sensual desire and the taint of views arise; dependent on the taint of existence, the taint of ignorance arises; dependent on the taint of views, the taint of ignorance arises. (Each cycle should be made.) (1)

Āsavaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca noāsavo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – āsavaṃ paṭicca āsavasampayuttakā khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ. (2)

A phenomenon that is not a taint arises dependent on a phenomenon that is a taint by way of the root condition: dependent on a taint, the aggregates associated with taints and mind-originated materiality arise. (2)

Āsavaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca āsavo ca noāsavo ca dhammā uppajjanti hetupaccayā – kāmāsavaṃ paṭicca diṭṭhāsavo avijjāsavo sampayuttakā ca khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ (cakkaṃ). (3)

Phenomena that are taints and phenomena that are not taints arise dependent on a phenomenon that is a taint by way of the root condition: dependent on the taint of sensual desire, the taint of views, the taint of ignorance, the associated aggregates, and mind-originated materiality arise (the cycle). (3)

2. Noāsavaṃ [V 3.0189] dhammaṃ paṭicca noāsavo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – noāsavaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca tayo khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ…pe… dve khandhe…pe… paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe… khandhe paṭicca vatthu, vatthuṃ paṭicca khandhā, ekaṃ mahābhūtaṃ…pe… mahābhūte paṭicca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ kaṭattārūpaṃ upādārūpaṃ. (1)

2. A phenomenon that is not a taint arises dependent on a phenomenon that is not a taint by way of the root condition: dependent on one aggregate that is not a taint, three aggregates and mind-originated materiality arise…pe… dependent on two aggregates…pe… at the moment of rebirth-linking…pe… dependent on the aggregates, the base; dependent on the base, the aggregates; dependent on one great element…pe… dependent on the great elements, mind-originated materiality, kamma-born materiality, and derived materiality arise. (1)

Noāsavaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca āsavo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – noāsave khandhe paṭicca āsavā. (2)

A phenomenon that is a taint arises dependent on a phenomenon that is not a taint by way of root condition: dependent on aggregates that are not taints, taints arise. (2)

Noāsavaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca āsavo ca noāsavo ca dhammā uppajjanti hetupaccayā – noāsavaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca tayo khandhā āsavā ca cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ…pe… dve khandhe…pe…. (3)

Phenomena that are taints and phenomena that are not taints arise dependent on a phenomenon that is not a taint by way of root condition: dependent on one aggregate that is not a taint, three aggregates, the taints, and mind-produced materiality arise...etc.... dependent on two aggregates...etc.... (3)

3. Āsavañca noāsavañca dhammaṃ paṭicca āsavo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – kāmāsavañca sampayuttake ca khandhe paṭicca diṭṭhāsavo avijjāsavo (cakkaṃ bandhitabbaṃ). (1)

3. A phenomenon that is a taint arises dependent on a phenomenon that is a taint and a phenomenon that is not a taint by way of root condition: dependent on the taint of sensual desire and the associated aggregates, the taint of views and the taint of ignorance arise (the cycle should be constructed). (1)

Āsavañca [M 3.0155] noāsavañca dhammaṃ paṭicca noāsavo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – noāsavaṃ ekaṃ khandhañca [T 3.0178] āsave ca paṭicca tayo khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ…pe… dve khandhe…pe…. (2)

A phenomenon that is not a taint arises dependent on a phenomenon that is a taint and a phenomenon that is not a taint by way of root condition: dependent on one aggregate that is not a taint and the taints, three aggregates and mind-produced materiality arise...etc.... dependent on two aggregates...etc.... (2)

Āsavañca noāsavañca dhammaṃ paṭicca āsavo ca noāsavo ca dhammā uppajjanti hetupaccayā – noāsavaṃ ekaṃ khandhañca kāmāsavañca paṭicca tayo khandhā diṭṭhāsavo avijjāsavo cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ…pe… dve khandhe ca…pe… (cakkaṃ. Saṃkhittaṃ). (3)

Phenomena that are taints and phenomena that are not taints arise dependent on a phenomenon that is a taint and a phenomenon that is not a taint by way of root condition: dependent on one aggregate that is not a taint and the taint of sensual desire, three aggregates, the taint of views, the taint of ignorance, and mind-produced materiality arise...etc.... dependent on two aggregates...etc.... (The Cycle. Abbreviated). (3)

5. Noāsavaṃ [V 3.0190] dhammaṃ paṭicca noāsavo dhammo uppajjati nahetupaccayā – ahetukaṃ noāsavaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca tayo khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ…pe… dve khandhe…pe… ahetukapaṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe… khandhe paṭicca vatthu, vatthuṃ paṭicca khandhā, ekaṃ mahābhūtaṃ…pe… (yāva asaññasattā). (1)

5. A phenomenon that is not a taint arises dependent on a phenomenon that is not a taint by way of non-root condition: dependent on one rootless aggregate that is not a taint, three aggregates and mind-produced materiality arise...etc.... dependent on two aggregates...etc.... at the moment of rebirth-linking without roots...etc.... dependent on the aggregates, the physical base arises; dependent on the physical base, the aggregates arise; dependent on one great element...etc.... (up to non-percipient beings). (1)

Noāsavaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca āsavo dhammo uppajjati nahetupaccayā – vicikicchāsahagate uddhaccasahagate khandhe paṭicca vicikicchāsahagato uddhaccasahagato moho. (2)

A phenomenon that is a taint arises dependent on a phenomenon that is not a taint by way of non-root condition: dependent on aggregates concomitant with doubt and aggregates concomitant with restlessness, delusion concomitant with doubt and delusion concomitant with restlessness arises. (2)

Naārammaṇapaccayo

Non-Object Condition

6. Āsavaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca noāsavo dhammo uppajjati naārammaṇapaccayā – āsave paṭicca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ. (1)

6. A not-tainted phenomenon arises dependent on a tainted phenomenon by way of non-object condition: dependent on the taints, mind-produced materiality arises. (1)

Noāsavaṃ [M 3.0156] dhammaṃ paṭicca noāsavo dhammo uppajjati naārammaṇapaccayā – noāsave khandhe paṭicca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ; paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe… khandhe paṭicca vatthu, ekaṃ mahābhūtaṃ…pe… (yāva asaññasattā)[T 3.0179]. (1)

A not-tainted phenomenon arises dependent on a not-tainted phenomenon by way of non-object condition: dependent on not-tainted aggregates, mind-produced materiality arises; at the moment of rebirth-linking…etc.… dependent on the aggregates, the physical base arises; dependent on one great element…etc.… (up to non-percipient beings). (1)

Āsavañca noāsavañca dhammaṃ paṭicca noāsavo dhammo uppajjati naārammaṇapaccayā – āsave ca sampayuttake ca khandhe paṭicca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ (saṃkhittaṃ). (1)

A not-tainted phenomenon arises dependent on a tainted phenomenon and a not-tainted phenomenon by way of non-object condition: dependent on the taints and associated aggregates, mind-produced materiality arises (Abbreviated). (1)

10. Āsavaṃ [T 3.0180] dhammaṃ paccayā āsavo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā (āsavamūlakaṃ tīṇi, paṭiccasadisā).

10. A tainted phenomenon conditions a tainted phenomenon by way of root condition (three cases rooted in taints, similar to the Conditional Relations Section).

Noāsavaṃ dhammaṃ paccayā noāsavo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – noāsavaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paccayā tayo khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ…pe… dve khandhe…pe… paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe… khandhe paccayā vatthu, vatthuṃ paccayā khandhā, mahābhūte paccayā cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ kaṭattārūpaṃ upādārūpaṃ, vatthuṃ paccayā noāsavā khandhā. (1)

An untainted phenomenon conditions an untainted phenomenon by way of root condition: one untainted aggregate conditions three aggregates and mind-produced materiality…and so on…two aggregates…and so on…at the moment of relinking…and so on…aggregates condition the basis, the basis conditions aggregates, primary elements condition mind-produced materiality, kamma-produced materiality, and derived materiality, the basis conditions untainted aggregates. (1)

Noāsavaṃ [V 3.0193] dhammaṃ paccayā āsavo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – noāsave khandhe paccayā āsavā, vatthuṃ paccayā āsavā. (2)

An untainted phenomenon conditions a tainted phenomenon by way of root condition: untainted aggregates condition taints, the basis conditions taints. (2)

Noāsavaṃ dhammaṃ paccayā āsavo ca noāsavo ca dhammā uppajjanti hetupaccayā – noāsavaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paccayā tayo khandhā āsavā ca cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ…pe… dve khandhe…pe… vatthuṃ paccayā āsavā sampayuttakā ca khandhā. (3)

An untainted phenomenon conditions tainted and untainted phenomena by way of root condition: one untainted aggregate conditions three aggregates, taints, and mind-produced materiality…and so on…two aggregates…and so on…the basis conditions taints and associated aggregates. (3)

11. Āsavañca noāsavañca dhammaṃ paccayā āsavo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – kāmāsavañca sampayuttake ca khandhe paccayā diṭṭhāsavo avijjāsavo [M 3.0158] (cakkaṃ). Kāmāsavañca vatthuñca paccayā diṭṭhāsavo avijjāsavo (cakkaṃ). (1)

11. A tainted phenomenon and an untainted phenomenon condition a tainted phenomenon by way of root condition: the taint of sensual desire and associated aggregates condition the taint of wrong view and the taint of ignorance (a cycle). The taint of sensual desire and the basis condition the taint of wrong view and the taint of ignorance (a cycle). (1)

Āsavañca noāsavañca dhammaṃ paccayā noāsavo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – noāsavaṃ ekaṃ khandhañca āsave ca paccayā tayo khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ…pe… dve khandhe…pe… āsavañca vatthuñca paccayā [T 3.0181] noāsavā khandhā. (2)

A tainted phenomenon and an untainted phenomenon condition an untainted phenomenon by way of root condition: one untainted aggregate and the taints condition the three aggregates and mind-produced materiality…and so on…two aggregates…and so on…the taints and the basis condition the untainted aggregates. (2)

Āsavañca noāsavañca dhammaṃ paccayā āsavo ca noāsavo ca dhammā uppajjanti hetupaccayā – noāsavaṃ ekaṃ khandhañca kāmāsavañca paccayā tayo khandhā diṭṭhāsavo avijjāsavo cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ…pe… dve khandhe…pe… (cakkaṃ). Kāmāsavañca vatthuñca paccayā diṭṭhāsavo avijjāsavo sampayuttakā ca khandhā (cakkaṃ. Saṃkhittaṃ). (3)

A tainted phenomenon and an untainted phenomenon condition tainted and untainted phenomena by way of root condition: one untainted aggregate and the taint of sensual desire condition three aggregates, the taint of wrong view, the taint of ignorance, and mind-produced materiality…and so on…two aggregates…and so on…(a cycle). The taint of sensual desire and the basis condition the taint of wrong view, the taint of ignorance, and associated aggregates (a cycle, in brief). (3)

15. A tainted phenomenon, concomitant with a tainted phenomenon, arises by way of root condition—concomitant with the taint of sensual desire are the taint of wrong view and the taint of ignorance (a cycle. Abbreviated).
