Hetupaccayo

Root Condition

66. Āsavasampayuttaṃ [V 3.0219] dhammaṃ paccayā āsavasampayutto dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā… tīṇi (paṭiccavārasadiso).

66. A state associated with the taints conditions a state associated with the taints to arise by way of root condition: … three (similar to the Dependent Origination Section).

Āsavavippayuttaṃ dhammaṃ paccayā āsavavippayutto dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – āsavavippayuttaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paccayā tayo khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ…pe… dve khandhe…pe… domanassasahagataṃ vicikicchāsahagataṃ uddhaccasahagataṃ mohaṃ paccayā cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ; paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe… khandhe paccayā vatthu, vatthuṃ paccayā khandhā, ekaṃ mahābhūtaṃ…pe… mahābhūte paccayā cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ[M 3.0180], kaṭattārūpaṃ, upādārūpaṃ. Vatthuṃ paccayā āsavavippayuttā khandhā, vatthuṃ paccayā domanassasahagato moho. (1)

A state dissociated from the taints conditions a state dissociated from the taints to arise by way of root condition: one aggregate dissociated from the taints conditions three aggregates and mind-originated materiality; … two aggregates; … grief-accompanied, doubt-accompanied, and restlessness-accompanied delusion conditions mind-originated materiality; at the moment of rebirth-linking; … aggregates condition the physical base; the physical base conditions the aggregates; one great primary element; … the great primary elements condition mind-originated materiality, kamma-produced materiality, and derived materiality. The physical base conditions aggregates dissociated from the taints; the physical base conditions grief-accompanied delusion. (1)

Āsavavippayuttaṃ dhammaṃ paccayā āsavasampayutto dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – vatthuṃ paccayā āsavasampayuttakā khandhā, domanassasahagataṃ vicikicchāsahagataṃ uddhaccasahagataṃ mohaṃ paccayā sampayuttakā khandhā. (2)

A state dissociated from the taints conditions a state associated with the taints to arise by way of root condition: the physical base conditions aggregates associated with the taints; grief-accompanied, doubt-accompanied, and restlessness-accompanied delusion conditions associated aggregates. (2)

Āsavavippayuttaṃ dhammaṃ paccayā āsavasampayutto ca āsavavippayutto ca dhammā uppajjanti hetupaccayā – vatthuṃ paccayā āsavasampayuttakā khandhā, mahābhūte paccayā cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ[T 3.0207], domanassasahagataṃ vicikicchāsahagataṃ uddhaccasahagataṃ mohaṃ paccayā sampayuttakā khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ, vatthuṃ paccayā domanassasahagatā khandhā ca moho ca. (3)

A state dissociated from the taints conditions states both associated with and dissociated from the taints to arise by way of root condition: the physical base conditions aggregates associated with the taints; the great primary elements condition mind-originated materiality; grief-accompanied, doubt-accompanied, and restlessness-accompanied delusion conditions associated aggregates and mind-originated materiality; the physical base conditions grief-accompanied aggregates and delusion. (3)

67. Āsavasampayuttañca āsavavippayuttañca dhammaṃ paccayā āsavasampayutto dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – āsavasampayuttaṃ ekaṃ khandhañca vatthuñca paccayā tayo khandhā…pe… dve [V 3.0220] khandhe ca…pe… domanassasahagataṃ vicikicchāsahagataṃ uddhaccasahagataṃ ekaṃ khandhañca mohañca paccayā tayo khandhā…pe… dve khandhe ca…pe…. (1)

67. States associated with taints and dissociated from taints condition a state associated with the taints to arise by way of root condition: one aggregate associated with the taints and the physical base condition three aggregates; … two aggregates; … one aggregate accompanied by grief, doubt, and restlessness, and delusion condition three aggregates; … two aggregates; …. (1)

Āsavasampayuttañca āsavavippayuttañca dhammaṃ paccayā āsavavippayutto dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – āsavasampayutte khandhe ca mahābhūte ca paccayā cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ, domanassasahagate vicikicchāsahagate uddhaccasahagate khandhe ca mohañca paccayā cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ, domanassasahagate khandhe ca vatthuñca paccayā domanassasahagato moho. (2)

States associated with taints and dissociated from taints condition a state dissociated from the taints to arise by way of root condition: aggregates associated with the taints and the great primary elements condition mind-originated materiality; aggregates accompanied by grief, doubt, and restlessness, and delusion condition mind-originated materiality; aggregates accompanied by grief and the physical base condition grief-accompanied delusion. (2)

Āsavasampayuttañca āsavavippayuttañca dhammaṃ paccayā āsavasampayutto ca āsavavippayutto ca dhammā uppajjanti hetupaccayā – āsavasampayuttaṃ ekaṃ khandhañca vatthuñca paccayā tayo khandhā…pe… dve khandhe…pe… āsavasampayutte khandhe ca mahābhūte ca paccayā cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ, domanassasahagataṃ vicikicchāsahagataṃ uddhaccasahagataṃ ekaṃ khandhañca mohañca paccayā tayo khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ…pe… dve khandhe…pe… domanassasahagataṃ ekaṃ khandhañca vatthuñca paccayā tayo khandhā moho [T 3.0208] ca…pe… dve khandhe…pe…. (3)

States associated with taints and dissociated from taints condition states associated with taints and dissociated from taints to arise by way of root condition: one aggregate associated with the taints and the physical base condition three aggregates; … two aggregates; … aggregates associated with the taints and the great primary elements condition mind-originated materiality; one aggregate accompanied by grief, doubt, and restlessness, and delusion condition three aggregates and mind-originated materiality; … two aggregates; … one aggregate accompanied by grief and the physical base condition three aggregates and delusion; … two aggregates; …. (3)

Ārammaṇapaccayādi

Object Condition, etc.

68. Āsavasampayuttaṃ [M 3.0181] dhammaṃ paccayā āsavasampayutto dhammo uppajjati ārammaṇapaccayā… tīṇi (paṭiccavārasadisā).

68. A state associated with the taints conditions a state associated with the taints to arise by way of object condition: … three (similar to the Dependent Origination Section).

Āsavavippayuttaṃ dhammaṃ paccayā āsavavippayutto dhammo uppajjati ārammaṇapaccayā – āsavavippayuttaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paccayā tayo khandhā…pe… dve khandhe…pe… paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe… vatthuṃ paccayā khandhā, cakkhāyatanaṃ paccayā cakkhuviññāṇaṃ…pe… kāyāyatanaṃ paccayā kāyaviññāṇaṃ, vatthuṃ paccayā āsavavippayuttā khandhā, vatthuṃ paccayā domanassasahagato vicikicchāsahagato uddhaccasahagato moho. (1)

A state dissociated from the taints conditions a state dissociated from the taints to arise by way of object condition: one aggregate dissociated from the taints conditions three aggregates; … two aggregates; … at the moment of rebirth-linking; … the physical base conditions the aggregates; the eye-base conditions eye-consciousness; … the body-base conditions body-consciousness; the physical base conditions aggregates dissociated from the taints; the physical base conditions grief-accompanied, doubt-accompanied, and restlessness-accompanied delusion. (1)

Āsavavippayuttaṃ dhammaṃ paccayā āsavasampayutto dhammo uppajjati ārammaṇapaccayā – vatthuṃ [V 3.0221] paccayā āsavasampayuttakā khandhā, domanassasahagataṃ vicikicchāsahagataṃ uddhaccasahagataṃ mohaṃ paccayā sampayuttakā khandhā. (2)

A state dissociated from the taints conditions a state associated with the taints to arise by way of object condition: the physical base conditions aggregates associated with the taints; grief-accompanied, doubt-accompanied, and restlessness-accompanied delusion conditions associated aggregates. (2)

Āsavavippayuttaṃ dhammaṃ paccayā āsavasampayutto ca āsavavippayutto ca dhammā uppajjanti ārammaṇapaccayā – vatthuṃ paccayā domanassasahagatā vicikicchāsahagatā uddhaccasahagatā khandhā moho ca. (3)

A state dissociated from the taints conditions states both associated with and dissociated from the taints to arise by way of object condition: the physical base conditions aggregates accompanied by grief, doubt, and restlessness, and delusion. (3)

69. Āsavasampayuttañca āsavavippayuttañca dhammaṃ paccayā āsavasampayutto dhammo uppajjati ārammaṇapaccayā – āsavasampayuttaṃ ekaṃ khandhañca vatthuñca paccayā tayo khandhā…pe… dve khandhe…pe…. (1)

69. States associated with taints and dissociated from taints condition a state associated with the taints to arise by way of object condition: one aggregate associated with the taints and the physical base condition three aggregates; … two aggregates; …. (1)

Āsavasampayuttañca āsavavippayuttañca dhammaṃ paccayā āsavavippayutto dhammo uppajjati [T 3.0209] ārammaṇapaccayā – domanassasahagate vicikicchāsahagate uddhaccasahagate khandhe ca vatthuñca paccayā domanassasahagato vicikicchāsahagato uddhaccasahagato moho. (2)

States associated with taints and dissociated from taints condition a state dissociated from the taints to arise by way of object condition: aggregates accompanied by grief, doubt, and restlessness, and the physical base condition grief-accompanied, doubt-accompanied, and restlessness-accompanied delusion. (2)

Āsavasampayuttañca āsavavippayuttañca dhammaṃ paccayā āsavasampayutto ca āsavavippayutto ca dhammā uppajjanti ārammaṇapaccayā – domanassasahagataṃ vicikicchāsahagataṃ uddhaccasahagataṃ ekaṃ khandhañca vatthuñca paccayā tayo khandhā moho ca…pe… dve khandhe…pe… adhipatipaccayā… anantarapaccayā…pe… avigatapaccayā. (3)

A state associated with taints and a state dissociated from taints are a condition for a state associated with taints and a state dissociated from taints to arise by way of object condition: one aggregate accompanied by grief, or doubt, or restlessness, and the physical base are a condition for three aggregates and delusion; … two aggregates; … by way of dominance condition; … by way of contiguity condition; … by way of non-disappearance condition. (3)

Non-root condition

71. Āsavasampayuttaṃ [V 3.0222] dhammaṃ paccayā āsavavippayutto dhammo uppajjati nahetupaccayā – vicikicchāsahagate uddhaccasahagate khandhe paccayā vicikicchāsahagato uddhaccasahagato moho. (1)

71. A state associated with taints is a condition, by way of non-root condition, for a state dissociated from taints to arise: the aggregates accompanied by doubt and restlessness are a condition for delusion accompanied by doubt and restlessness. (1)

Āsavavippayuttaṃ dhammaṃ paccayā āsavavippayutto dhammo uppajjati nahetupaccayā – ahetukaṃ āsavavippayuttaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paccayā tayo khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ…pe… dve khandhe…pe… ahetukapaṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe… (yāva asaññasattā) cakkhāyatanaṃ paccayā cakkhuviññāṇaṃ…pe… kāyāyatanaṃ paccayā kāyaviññāṇaṃ, vatthuṃ paccayā ahetukā āsavavippayuttā khandhā, vatthuṃ paccayā vicikicchāsahagato uddhaccasahagato moho. (1)

A state dissociated from taints is a condition, by way of non-root condition, for a state dissociated from taints to arise: one rootless aggregate dissociated from taints is a condition for the three aggregates and mind-originated material form… and so on… two aggregates… and so on… at the rootless rebirth-linking moment… and so on (up to the non-percipient beings)… the eye-base is a condition for eye-consciousness… and so on… the body-base is a condition for body-consciousness; the physical basis is a condition for rootless aggregates dissociated from taints; the physical basis is a condition for delusion accompanied by doubt and restlessness. (1)

Āsavasampayuttañca [T 3.0210] āsavavippayuttañca dhammaṃ paccayā āsavavippayutto dhammo uppajjati nahetupaccayā – vicikicchāsahagate uddhaccasahagate khandhe ca vatthuñca paccayā vicikicchāsahagato uddhaccasahagato moho. (1) (Saṃkhittaṃ.)

A state associated with taints and a state dissociated from taints are a condition, by way of non-root condition, for a state dissociated from taints to arise: the aggregates accompanied by doubt and restlessness and the physical basis are a condition for delusion accompanied by doubt and restlessness. (1) (Summary.)

Simple

72. Nahetuyā tīṇi, naārammaṇe tīṇi, naadhipatiyā nava, naanantare tīṇi, nasamanantare tīṇi, naaññamaññe tīṇi, naupanissaye tīṇi, napurejāte satta, napacchājāte nava, naāsevane nava, nakamme cattāri[M 3.0183], navipāke nava, naāhāre ekaṃ, naindriye ekaṃ, najhāne [V 3.0223] ekaṃ, namagge ekaṃ, nasampayutte tīṇi, navippayutte cha, nonatthiyā tīṇi, novigate tīṇi (evaṃ itarepi dve gaṇanā kātabbā).

72. Three by way of non-root, three by way of non-object, nine by way of non-dominance, three by way of non-contiguity, three by way of non-immediacy, three by way of non-mutuality, three by way of non-proximate support, seven by way of non-prenascence, nine by way of non-postnascence, nine by way of non-repetition, four by way of non-kamma, nine by way of non-resultant, one by way of non-nutriment, one by way of non-faculty, one by way of non-jhāna, one by way of non-path, three by way of non-association, six by way of non-dissociation, three by way of non-absence, three by way of non-disappearance. (Thus the other two enumerations should be made.)

73. Āsavasampayuttaṃ dhammaṃ saṃsaṭṭho āsavasampayutto dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā (saṃkhittaṃ).

73. A state associated with taints conjoined with another is a condition for a state associated with taints to arise by way of root condition. (Summary.)

Hetuyā cha, ārammaṇe cha, adhipatiyā cha (sabbattha cha), vipāke ekaṃ…pe… avigate cha.

Six by way of root condition, six by way of object condition, six by way of dominance condition (six everywhere), one by way of result condition… and so on… six by way of non-disappearance condition.

Āsavasampayuttaṃ dhammaṃ saṃsaṭṭho āsavavippayutto dhammo uppajjati nahetupaccayā – vicikicchāsahagate uddhaccasahagate khandhe saṃsaṭṭho [T 3.0211] vicikicchāsahagato uddhaccasahagato moho. (1)

A state associated with taints conjoined with another is a condition for a state dissociated from taints to arise by way of non-root condition: delusion accompanied by doubt and restlessness is conjoined with the aggregates accompanied by doubt and restlessness. (1)

Āsavavippayuttaṃ dhammaṃ saṃsaṭṭho āsavavippayutto dhammo uppajjati nahetupaccayā…pe….

A state dissociated from taints conjoined with another is a condition for a state dissociated from taints to arise by way of non-root condition… and so on….

Nahetuyā dve, naadhipatiyā cha, napurejāte cha, napacchājāte cha, naāsevane cha, nakamme cattāri, navipāke cha, najhāne ekaṃ, namagge ekaṃ, navippayutte cha (evaṃ itarepi dve gaṇanā kātabbā).

Two by way of non-root, six by way of non-dominance, six by way of non-prenascence, six by way of non-postnascence, six by way of non-repetition, four by way of non-kamma, six by way of non-resultant, one by way of non-jhāna, one by way of non-path, six by way of non-dissociation. (Similarly, the other two enumerations should be made.)

Hetupaccayo

Root condition

74. Āsavasampayutto [V 3.0224] dhammo āsavasampayuttassa dhammassa hetupaccayena paccayo – āsavasampayuttā hetū sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ hetupaccayena paccayo. (1)

74. A state associated with taints is a condition for a state associated with taints by way of root condition: the roots associated with taints are a condition for the associated aggregates by way of root condition. (1)

Āsavasampayutto [M 3.0184] dhammo āsavavippayuttassa dhammassa hetupaccayena paccayo – āsavasampayuttā hetū cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ hetupaccayena paccayo; doso mohassa cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ hetupaccayena paccayo. (2)

A state associated with taints is a condition for a state dissociated from taints by way of root condition: roots associated with taints are a condition for mind-originated material form by way of root condition; hatred is a condition for delusion and for mind-originated material form by way of root condition. (2)

Āsavasampayutto dhammo āsavasampayuttassa ca āsavavippayuttassa ca dhammassa hetupaccayena paccayo – āsavasampayuttā hetū sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ hetupaccayena paccayo; doso sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ mohassa cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ hetupaccayena paccayo. (3)

A state associated with taints is a condition for a state associated with taints and for a state dissociated from taints by way of root condition: the roots associated with taints are a condition for the associated aggregates and for mind-originated material form by way of root condition; hatred is a condition for the associated aggregates, for delusion, and for mind-originated material form by way of root condition. (3)

75. Āsavavippayutto dhammo āsavavippayuttassa dhammassa hetupaccayena paccayo – āsavavippayuttā [T 3.0212] hetū sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ hetupaccayena paccayo; domanassasahagato vicikicchāsahagato uddhaccasahagato moho cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ hetupaccayena paccayo; paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe…. (1)

75. A state dissociated from taints is a condition for a state dissociated from taints by way of root condition: roots dissociated from taints are a condition for the associated aggregates and for mind-originated material form by way of root condition; delusion accompanied by displeasure, doubt, or restlessness is a condition for mind-originated material form by way of root condition; at the rebirth-linking moment… and so on…. (1)

Āsavavippayutto dhammo āsavasampayuttassa dhammassa hetupaccayena paccayo – domanassasahagato vicikicchāsahagato uddhaccasahagato moho sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ hetupaccayena paccayo. (2)

A state dissociated from taints is a condition for a state associated with taints by way of root condition: delusion accompanied by displeasure, doubt, or restlessness is a condition for the associated aggregates by way of root condition. (2)

Āsavavippayutto [V 3.0225] dhammo āsavasampayuttassa ca āsavavippayuttassa ca dhammassa hetupaccayena paccayo – domanassasahagato vicikicchāsahagato uddhaccasahagato moho sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ hetupaccayena paccayo. (3)

A state dissociated from taints is a condition for a state associated with taints and for a state dissociated from taints by way of root condition: delusion accompanied by displeasure, doubt, or restlessness is a condition for the associated aggregates and for mind-originated material form by way of root condition. (3)

76. Āsavasampayutto ca āsavavippayutto ca dhammā āsavasampayuttassa dhammassa hetupaccayena paccayo – doso ca moho ca āsavasampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ hetupaccayena paccayo. (1)

76. States both associated with and dissociated from taints are a condition for a state associated with taints by way of root condition: hatred and delusion are a condition for the aggregates associated with taints by way of root condition. (1)

Āsavasampayutto ca āsavavippayutto ca dhammā āsavavippayuttassa dhammassa hetupaccayena paccayo – doso ca moho ca cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ hetupaccayena paccayo. (2)

States both associated with and dissociated from taints are a condition for a state dissociated from taints by way of root condition: hatred and delusion are a condition for mind-originated material form by way of root condition. (2)

Āsavasampayutto ca āsavavippayutto ca dhammā āsavasampayuttassa ca āsavavippayuttassa ca dhammassa hetupaccayena paccayo – doso ca moho [M 3.0185] ca sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ hetupaccayena paccayo. (3)

States both associated with and dissociated from taints are a condition for a state associated with taints and for a state dissociated from taints by way of root condition: hatred and delusion are a condition for the associated aggregates and for mind-originated material form by way of root condition. (3)

Ārammaṇapaccayo

Object Condition

77. Āsavasampayutto dhammo āsavasampayuttassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena [T 3.0213] paccayo – āsavasampayutte khandhe ārabbha āsavasampayuttakā khandhā uppajjanti. (1)

77. A taint-associated phenomenon is a condition for a taint-associated phenomenon by way of object condition: taint-associated aggregates arise by taking taint-associated aggregates as object. (1)

Āsavasampayutto dhammo āsavavippayuttassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo – āsavasampayutte khandhe ārabbha āsavavippayuttā khandhā ca moho ca uppajjanti. (2)

A taint-associated phenomenon is a condition for a taint-dissociated phenomenon by way of object condition: taint-dissociated aggregates and delusion arise by taking taint-associated aggregates as object. (2)

Āsavasampayutto dhammo āsavasampayuttassa ca āsavavippayuttassa ca dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo – āsavasampayutte khandhe ārabbha domanassasahagatā vicikicchāsahagatā uddhaccasahagatā khandhā ca moho ca uppajjanti. (3)

A taint-associated phenomenon is a condition for a taint-associated phenomenon and a taint-dissociated phenomenon by way of object condition: aggregates accompanied by displeasure, accompanied by doubt, and accompanied by restlessness, and delusion arise by taking taint-associated aggregates as object. (3)

78. Āsavavippayutto dhammo āsavavippayuttassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo – dānaṃ [V 3.0226] datvā sīlaṃ…pe… uposathakammaṃ katvā taṃ paccavekkhati; pubbe suciṇṇāni…pe… jhānā…pe… ariyā maggaṃ…pe… phalaṃ…pe… nibbānaṃ…pe… nibbānaṃ gotrabhussa, vodānassa, maggassa, phalassa, āvajjanāya ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo; ariyā āsavavippayutte pahīne kilese paccavekkhanti; vikkhambhite…pe… pubbe…pe… cakkhuṃ…pe… vatthuṃ āsavavippayutte khandhe aniccato dukkhato anattato vipassati. (Idha assādanā natthi) dibbena cakkhunā rūpaṃ passati, dibbāya sotadhātuyā saddaṃ suṇāti. Cetopariyañāṇena āsavavippayuttacittasamaṅgissa cittaṃ jānāti, ākāsānañcāyatanaṃ viññāṇañcāyatanassa…pe… ākiñcaññāyatanaṃ nevasaññānāsaññāyatanassa…pe… rūpāyatanaṃ cakkhuviññāṇassa…pe… phoṭṭhabbāyatanaṃ kāyaviññāṇassa…pe… āsavavippayuttā [T 3.0214] khandhā iddhividhañāṇassa, cetopariyañāṇassa, pubbenivāsānussatiñāṇassa, yathākammūpagañāṇassa, anāgataṃsañāṇassa, āvajjanāya mohassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo. (1)

78. A taint-dissociated phenomenon is a condition for a taint-dissociated phenomenon by way of object condition: having given alms, observed virtue…pe… performed the Uposatha observance, one reflects upon it; previously well-practiced deeds…pe… jhānas…pe… the noble ones reflect on the path…pe… the fruit…pe… Nibbāna…pe… Nibbāna is a condition for change-of-lineage consciousness, for cleansing, for the path, for the fruit, and for adverting by way of object condition; the noble ones reflect upon the defilements that have been abandoned; suppressed defilements…pe… previously…pe… the eye…pe… the physical base—one discerns taint-dissociated aggregates as impermanent, suffering, and not-self. (Here, there is no relishing.) With the divine eye, one sees forms; with the divine ear faculty, one hears sounds. With the knowledge of the minds of others, one knows the mind of one endowed with a taint-dissociated mind. The sphere of infinite space is an object condition for the sphere of infinite consciousness…pe… the sphere of nothingness for the sphere of neither perception nor non-perception…pe… the form object for eye-consciousness…pe… the tangible object for body-consciousness…pe… taint-dissociated aggregates are a condition by way of object condition for the knowledge of psychic powers, the knowledge of the minds of others, the knowledge of past lives, the knowledge of how beings fare according to their kamma, the knowledge of the future, for adverting, and for delusion. (1)

Āsavavippayutto [M 3.0186] dhammo āsavasampayuttassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo – dānaṃ datvā sīlaṃ…pe… uposathakammaṃ katvā taṃ assādeti abhinandati, taṃ ārabbha rāgo uppajjati, diṭṭhi…pe… vicikicchā…pe… uddhaccaṃ…pe… domanassaṃ uppajjati; pubbe suciṇṇāni…pe… jhānā vuṭṭhahitvā jhānaṃ…pe… cakkhuṃ…pe… vatthuṃ āsavavippayutte khandhe assādeti abhinandati, taṃ ārabbha rāgo…pe… diṭṭhi… domanassaṃ… vicikicchā… uddhaccaṃ uppajjati. (2)

A taint-dissociated phenomenon is a condition for a taint-associated phenomenon by way of object condition: having given alms, observed virtue…pe… performed the Uposatha observance, one relishes and delights in it; by taking that as object, lust arises, views…pe… doubt…pe… restlessness…pe… displeasure arises; previously well-practiced deeds…pe… emerging from jhāna, one relishes and delights in the jhāna…pe… the eye…pe… the physical base—one relishes and delights in taint-dissociated aggregates; by taking that as object, lust…pe… views… displeasure… doubt… restlessness arises. (2)

Āsavavippayutto dhammo āsavasampayuttassa ca āsavavippayuttassa ca dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo – cakkhuṃ…pe… vatthuṃ āsavavippayutte khandhe ārabbha domanassasahagatā vicikicchāsahagatā uddhaccasahagatā khandhā ca moho ca uppajjanti. (3)

A taint-dissociated phenomenon is a condition for a taint-associated phenomenon and a taint-dissociated phenomenon by way of Object Condition: Taking the eye…pe… the physical base—taint-dissociated aggregates as object, aggregates accompanied by displeasure, doubt, and restlessness, and delusion arise. (3)

79. Āsavasampayutto ca āsavavippayutto ca dhammā āsavasampayuttassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo – domanassasahagate vicikicchāsahagate uddhaccasahagate khandhe ca mohañca ārabbha āsavasampayuttā khandhā uppajjanti. (1)

79. Taint-associated and taint-dissociated phenomena are a condition for a taint-associated phenomenon by way of Object Condition: Taking aggregates accompanied by displeasure, doubt, and restlessness, and delusion as object, taint-associated aggregates arise. (1)

Āsavasampayutto ca āsavavippayutto ca dhammā āsavavippayuttassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena [V 3.0227] paccayo – domanassasahagate vicikicchāsahagate uddhaccasahagate khandhe ca mohañca ārabbha āsavavippayuttā khandhā ca moho [T 3.0215] ca uppajjanti. (2)

Taint-associated and taint-dissociated phenomena are a condition for a taint-dissociated phenomenon by way of Object Condition: Taking aggregates accompanied by displeasure, doubt, and restlessness, and delusion as object, taint-dissociated aggregates and delusion arise. (2)

Āsavasampayutto ca āsavavippayutto ca dhammā āsavasampayuttassa ca āsavavippayuttassa ca dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo – domanassasahagate vicikicchāsahagate uddhaccasahagate khandhe ca mohañca ārabbha domanassasahagatā vicikicchāsahagatā uddhaccasahagatā khandhā ca moho ca uppajjanti. (3)

Taint-associated and taint-dissociated phenomena are a condition for a taint-associated phenomenon and a taint-dissociated phenomenon by way of Object Condition: Taking aggregates accompanied by displeasure, doubt, and restlessness, and delusion as object, aggregates accompanied by displeasure, doubt, and restlessness, and delusion arise. (3)

Adhipatipaccayo

Predominance Condition

80. Āsavasampayutto dhammo āsavasampayuttassa dhammassa adhipatipaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇādhipati, sahajātādhipati. Ārammaṇādhipati – āsavasampayutte khandhe garuṃ katvā āsavasampayuttakā khandhā uppajjanti. Sahajātādhipati – āsavasampayuttādhipati sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ adhipatipaccayena paccayo. (1)

80. A taint-associated phenomenon is a condition for a taint-associated phenomenon by way of Predominance Condition: Object Predominance, Conascence Predominance. Object Predominance: Having made taint-associated aggregates predominant, taint-associated aggregates arise. Conascence Predominance: Taint-associated predominance is a condition for the associated aggregates by way of Predominance Condition. (1)

Āsavasampayutto [M 3.0187] dhammo āsavavippayuttassa dhammassa adhipatipaccayena paccayo. Sahajātādhipati – āsavasampayuttādhipati cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ adhipatipaccayena paccayo; domanassasahagatādhipati mohassa cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ adhipatipaccayena paccayo. (2)

A taint-associated phenomenon is a condition for a taint-dissociated phenomenon by way of Predominance Condition. Conascence Predominance: Taint-associated predominance is a condition for mind-originated materiality by way of Predominance Condition; predominance accompanied by displeasure is a condition for delusion and mind-originated materiality by way of Predominance Condition. (2)

Āsavasampayutto dhammo āsavasampayuttassa ca āsavavippayuttassa ca dhammassa adhipatipaccayena paccayo. Sahajātādhipati – āsavasampayuttādhipati sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ adhipatipaccayena paccayo; domanassasahagatādhipati sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ mohassa ca cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ adhipatipaccayena paccayo. (3)

A taint-associated phenomenon is a condition for a taint-associated phenomenon and a taint-dissociated phenomenon by way of Predominance Condition. Conascence Predominance: Taint-associated predominance is a condition for the associated aggregates and mind-originated materiality by way of Predominance Condition; predominance accompanied by displeasure is a condition for the associated aggregates, delusion, and mind-originated materiality by way of Predominance Condition. (3)

81. Āsavavippayutto dhammo āsavavippayuttassa dhammassa adhipatipaccayena paccayo [T 3.0216] – ārammaṇādhipati, sahajātādhipati. Ārammaṇādhipati – dānaṃ datvā, sīlaṃ…pe… uposathakammaṃ katvā taṃ garuṃ katvā paccavekkhati; pubbe suciṇṇāni…pe… jhānā…pe… ariyā maggā vuṭṭhahitvā maggaṃ…pe… phalaṃ…pe… nibbānaṃ garuṃ katvā paccavekkhanti; nibbānaṃ [V 3.0228] gotrabhussa, vodānassa, maggassa, phalassa adhipatipaccayena paccayo. Sahajātādhipati – āsavavippayuttādhipati sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ adhipatipaccayena paccayo. (1)

81. A taint-dissociated phenomenon is a condition for a taint-dissociated phenomenon by way of Predominance Condition: Object Predominance, Conascence Predominance. Object Predominance: Having given alms, observed virtue…pe… performed the Uposatha observance, one reflects on it, having made it predominant; previously well-practiced deeds…pe… jhānas…pe… having emerged from the noble paths, the noble ones reflect on the path…pe… the fruit…pe… Nibbāna, having made them predominant; Nibbāna is a condition for change-of-lineage, purification, path, and fruit by way of Predominance Condition. Conascence Predominance: Taint-dissociated predominance is a condition for the associated aggregates and mind-originated materiality by way of Predominance Condition. (1)

Āsavavippayutto dhammo āsavasampayuttassa dhammassa adhipatipaccayena paccayo. Ārammaṇādhipati – dānaṃ datvā sīlaṃ…pe… uposathakammaṃ katvā taṃ garuṃ katvā assādeti abhinandati, taṃ garuṃ katvā rāgo uppajjati, diṭṭhi uppajjati, pubbe suciṇṇāni…pe… jhānā…pe… cakkhuṃ…pe… vatthuṃ āsavavippayutte khandhe garuṃ katvā assādeti abhinandati, taṃ garuṃ katvā rāgo uppajjati, diṭṭhi uppajjati. (2)

A taint-dissociated phenomenon is a condition for a taint-associated phenomenon by way of Predominance Condition. Object Predominance: Having given alms, observed virtue…pe… performed the Uposatha observance, one relishes and delights in it, having made it predominant; having made it predominant, lust arises, wrong view arises. Previously well-practiced deeds…pe… jhānas…pe… the eye…pe… the physical base—one relishes and delights in taint-dissociated aggregates, having made them predominant; having made them predominant, lust arises, wrong view arises. (2)

Anantarapaccayo

Proximity Condition

82. Āsavasampayutto dhammo āsavasampayuttassa dhammassa anantarapaccayena paccayo – purimā purimā āsavasampayuttakā khandhā pacchimānaṃ pacchimānaṃ āsavasampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ anantarapaccayena paccayo. (1)

82. A taint-associated phenomenon is a condition for a taint-associated phenomenon by way of Proximity Condition: preceding taint-associated aggregates are a condition for succeeding taint-associated aggregates by way of Proximity Condition. (1)

Āsavasampayutto dhammo āsavavippayuttassa dhammassa anantarapaccayena paccayo – purimā purimā domanassasahagatā vicikicchāsahagatā uddhaccasahagatā [M 3.0188] khandhā pacchimassa pacchimassa domanassasahagatassa vicikicchāsahagatassa uddhaccasahagatassa mohassa anantarapaccayena [T 3.0217] paccayo; āsavasampayuttā khandhā vuṭṭhānassa anantarapaccayena paccayo. (2)

A taint-associated phenomenon is a condition for a taint-dissociated phenomenon by way of Proximity Condition: preceding aggregates accompanied by displeasure, doubt, or restlessness are a condition for succeeding delusion accompanied by displeasure, doubt, or restlessness by way of Proximity Condition; taint-associated aggregates are a condition for emergence by way of Proximity Condition. (2)

Āsavasampayutto dhammo āsavasampayuttassa ca āsavavippayuttassa ca dhammassa anantarapaccayena paccayo – purimā purimā domanassasahagatā vicikicchāsahagatā uddhaccasahagatā khandhā pacchimānaṃ pacchimānaṃ domanassasahagatānaṃ vicikicchāsahagatānaṃ uddhaccasahagatānaṃ khandhānaṃ mohassa ca anantarapaccayena paccayo. (3)

A taint-associated phenomenon is a condition for a taint-associated phenomenon and a taint-dissociated phenomenon by way of Proximity Condition: preceding aggregates accompanied by displeasure, doubt, or restlessness are a condition for succeeding aggregates accompanied by displeasure, doubt, or restlessness, and for delusion by way of Proximity Condition. (3)

83. Āsavavippayutto dhammo āsavavippayuttassa dhammassa anantarapaccayena paccayo – purimo purimo domanassasahagato vicikicchāsahagato uddhaccasahagato moho pacchimassa pacchimassa [V 3.0229] domanassasahagatassa vicikicchāsahagatassa uddhaccasahagatassa mohassa anantarapaccayena paccayo; purimā purimā āsavavippayuttā khandhā pacchimānaṃ pacchimānaṃ āsavavippayuttānaṃ khandhānaṃ anantarapaccayena paccayo; anulomaṃ gotrabhussa…pe… phalasamāpattiyā anantarapaccayena paccayo. (1)

83. A state dissociated from the taints is a condition for a state dissociated from the taints by way of the immediacy condition: preceding delusion accompanied by displeasure, doubt, or restlessness is a condition for succeeding delusion accompanied by displeasure, doubt, or restlessness by way of the immediacy condition; preceding aggregates dissociated from the taints are a condition for succeeding aggregates dissociated from the taints by way of the immediacy condition; adaptation is a condition for change-of-lineage... for attainment of fruition by way of the immediacy condition. (1)

Āsavavippayutto dhammo āsavasampayuttassa dhammassa anantarapaccayena paccayo – purimo purimo domanassasahagato vicikicchāsahagato uddhaccasahagato moho pacchimānaṃ pacchimānaṃ domanassasahagatānaṃ vicikicchāsahagatānaṃ uddhaccasahagatānaṃ khandhānaṃ anantarapaccayena paccayo; āvajjanā āsavasampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ anantarapaccayena paccayo. (2)

A state dissociated from the taints is a condition for a state associated with the taints by way of the immediacy condition: preceding delusion accompanied by displeasure, doubt, or restlessness is a condition for succeeding aggregates accompanied by displeasure, doubt, or restlessness by way of the immediacy condition; advertence is a condition for aggregates associated with the taints by way of the immediacy condition. (2)

Āsavavippayutto dhammo āsavasampayuttassa ca āsavavippayuttassa ca dhammassa anantarapaccayena paccayo – purimo purimo domanassasahagato [T 3.0218] vicikicchāsahagato uddhaccasahagato moho pacchimānaṃ pacchimānaṃ domanassasahagatānaṃ vicikicchāsahagatānaṃ uddhaccasahagatānaṃ khandhānaṃ mohassa ca anantarapaccayena paccayo; āvajjanā domanassasahagatānaṃ vicikicchāsahagatānaṃ uddhaccasahagatānaṃ khandhānaṃ mohassa ca anantarapaccayena paccayo. (3)

A state dissociated from the taints is a condition for a state associated with the taints and for a state dissociated from the taints by way of the immediacy condition: preceding delusion accompanied by displeasure, doubt, or restlessness is a condition for succeeding aggregates accompanied by displeasure, doubt, or restlessness, and for delusion by way of the immediacy condition; advertence is a condition for aggregates accompanied by displeasure, doubt, or restlessness, and for delusion by way of the immediacy condition. (3)

84. Āsavasampayutto [M 3.0189] ca āsavavippayutto ca dhammā āsavasampayuttassa dhammassa anantarapaccayena paccayo – purimā purimā domanassasahagatā vicikicchāsahagatā uddhaccasahagatā khandhā ca moho ca pacchimānaṃ pacchimānaṃ domanassasahagatānaṃ vicikicchāsahagatānaṃ uddhaccasahagatānaṃ khandhānaṃ anantarapaccayena paccayo. (1)

84. A state associated with the taints and a state dissociated from the taints are a condition for a state associated with the taints by way of the immediacy condition: preceding aggregates accompanied by displeasure, doubt, or restlessness, and delusion are a condition for succeeding aggregates accompanied by displeasure, doubt, or restlessness by way of the immediacy condition. (1)

Āsavasampayutto ca āsavavippayutto ca dhammā āsavavippayuttassa dhammassa anantarapaccayena paccayo – purimā purimā domanassasahagatā vicikicchāsahagatā uddhaccasahagatā khandhā ca moho ca pacchimassa pacchimassa domanassasahagatassa vicikicchāsahagatassa uddhaccasahagatassa mohassa anantarapaccayena paccayo; domanassasahagatā vicikicchāsahagatā uddhaccasahagatā khandhā ca moho ca vuṭṭhānassa anantarapaccayena paccayo. (2)

A state associated with the taints and a state dissociated from the taints are a condition for a state dissociated from the taints by way of the immediacy condition: preceding aggregates accompanied by displeasure, doubt, or restlessness, and delusion are a condition for succeeding delusion accompanied by displeasure, doubt, or restlessness by way of the immediacy condition; the aggregates accompanied by displeasure, doubt, or restlessness, and delusion are a condition for emergence by way of the immediacy condition. (2)

Āsavasampayutto [V 3.0230] ca āsavavippayutto ca dhammā āsavasampayuttassa ca āsavavippayuttassa ca dhammassa anantarapaccayena paccayo – purimā purimā domanassasahagatā vicikicchāsahagatā uddhaccasahagatā khandhā ca moho ca pacchimānaṃ pacchimānaṃ domanassasahagatānaṃ vicikicchāsahagatānaṃ uddhaccasahagatānaṃ [T 3.0219] khandhānaṃ mohassa ca anantarapaccayena paccayo. (3)

A state associated with the taints and a state dissociated from the taints are a condition for a state associated with the taints and for a state dissociated from the taints by way of the immediacy condition: preceding aggregates accompanied by displeasure, doubt, or restlessness, and delusion are a condition for succeeding aggregates accompanied by displeasure, doubt, or restlessness, and for delusion by way of the immediacy condition. (3)

Samanantarapaccayādi

Contiguity Condition, etc.

85. Āsavasampayutto dhammo āsavasampayuttassa dhammassa samanantarapaccayena paccayo… sahajātapaccayena paccayo… nava… aññamaññapaccayena paccayo… cha… nissayapaccayena paccayo… nava.

85. A state associated with the taints is a condition for a state associated with the taints by way of the contiguity condition... by way of the co-nascence condition... (nine)... by way of the mutuality condition... (six)... by way of the support condition... (nine).

Upanissayapaccayo

Decisive Support Condition

86. Āsavasampayutto dhammo āsavasampayuttassa dhammassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇūpanissayo, anantarūpanissayo, pakatūpanissayo…pe…. Pakatūpanissayo – āsavasampayuttā khandhā āsavasampayuttānaṃ khandhānaṃ upanissayapaccayena paccayo. (1)

86. A state associated with the taints is a condition for a state associated with the taints by way of the decisive support condition—object decisive support, immediacy decisive support, natural decisive support... and so on. Natural decisive support: The aggregates associated with the taints are a condition for the aggregates associated with the taints by way of the decisive support condition. (1)

Āsavasampayutto dhammo āsavavippayuttassa dhammassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo – anantarūpanissayo, pakatūpanissayo…pe…. Pakatūpanissayo [M 3.0190] – āsavasampayuttā khandhā āsavavippayuttānaṃ khandhānaṃ mohassa ca upanissayapaccayena paccayo. (2)

A state associated with the taints is a condition for a state dissociated from the taints by way of the decisive support condition—immediacy decisive support, natural decisive support... and so on. Natural decisive support: The aggregates associated with the taints are a condition for the aggregates dissociated from the taints and for delusion by way of the decisive support condition. (2)

Āsavasampayutto dhammo āsavasampayuttassa ca āsavavippayuttassa ca dhammassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo – anantarūpanissayo, pakatūpanissayo…pe…. Pakatūpanissayo – āsavasampayuttakā khandhā domanassasahagatānaṃ vicikicchāsahagatānaṃ uddhaccasahagatānaṃ khandhānaṃ mohassa ca upanissayapaccayena paccayo. (3)

A state associated with the taints is a condition for a state associated with the taints and for a state dissociated from the taints by way of the decisive support condition—immediacy decisive support, natural decisive support... and so on. Natural decisive support: The aggregates associated with the taints are a condition for the aggregates accompanied by displeasure, doubt, or restlessness, and for delusion by way of the decisive support condition. (3)

87. Āsavavippayutto dhammo āsavavippayuttassa dhammassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇūpanissayo, anantarūpanissayo, pakatūpanissayo…pe…. Pakatūpanissayo – saddhaṃ upanissāya [V 3.0231] dānaṃ deti…pe… sīlaṃ…pe… paññaṃ… kāyikaṃ sukhaṃ…pe… senāsanaṃ… mohaṃ upanissāya dānaṃ deti…pe… samāpattiṃ [T 3.0220] uppādeti; saddhā…pe… paññā… kāyikaṃ sukhaṃ… kāyikaṃ dukkhaṃ… moho ca saddhāya…pe… mohassa ca upanissayapaccayena paccayo. (1)

87. A state dissociated from the taints is a condition for a state dissociated from the taints by way of the decisive support condition—object decisive support, immediacy decisive support, natural decisive support... and so on. Natural decisive support: Relying on faith, one gives a gift... and so on... virtue... wisdom... bodily pleasure... lodging... Relying on delusion, one gives a gift... and so on... produces an attainment; faith... and so on... wisdom... bodily pleasure... bodily pain... and delusion are a condition for faith... and so on... and for delusion by way of the decisive support condition. (1)

Āsavavippayutto dhammo āsavasampayuttassa dhammassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇūpanissayo, anantarūpanissayo, pakatūpanissayo…pe…. Pakatūpanissayo – saddhaṃ upanissāya mānaṃ jappeti, diṭṭhiṃ gaṇhāti; sīlaṃ…pe… paññaṃ… kāyikaṃ sukhaṃ… kāyikaṃ dukkhaṃ… utuṃ… bhojanaṃ… senāsanaṃ… mohaṃ upanissāya pāṇaṃ hanati…pe… saṅghaṃ bhindati; saddhā…pe… moho ca rāgassa…pe… patthanāya upanissayapaccayena paccayo. (2)

A phenomenon dissociated from the taints is a condition for a phenomenon associated with the taints by way of the decisive support condition—object decisive support, contiguity decisive support, natural decisive support… and so on. Natural decisive support: Relying on faith, one utters boasts, adopts wrong views; virtue… and so on… wisdom… bodily pleasure… bodily pain… season… food… lodging… Relying on delusion, one kills a living being… and so on… splits the Saṅgha; faith… and so on… and delusion are a condition for lust… and so on… and for aspiration by way of the decisive support condition. (2)

Āsavavippayutto dhammo āsavasampayuttassa ca āsavavippayuttassa ca dhammassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo – anantarūpanissayo, pakatūpanissayo…pe…. Pakatūpanissayo – saddhā… sīlaṃ…pe… moho domanassasahagatānaṃ vicikicchāsahagatānaṃ uddhaccasahagatānaṃ khandhānaṃ mohassa ca upanissayapaccayena paccayo. (3)

A phenomenon dissociated from the taints is a condition for a phenomenon associated with the taints and for a phenomenon dissociated from the taints by way of the decisive support condition—contiguity decisive support, natural decisive support… and so on. Natural decisive support: Faith… virtue… and so on… delusion is a condition for the aggregates accompanied by dejection, accompanied by doubt, accompanied by restlessness, and for delusion by way of the decisive support condition. (3)

88. Āsavasampayutto ca āsavavippayutto ca dhammā āsavasampayuttassa dhammassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo – anantarūpanissayo, pakatūpanissayo [M 3.0191] …pe…. Pakatūpanissayo – domanassasahagatā vicikicchāsahagatā uddhaccasahagatā khandhā ca moho ca āsavasampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ upanissayapaccayena paccayo. (Pucchitabbaṃ mūlaṃ) domanassasahagatā vicikicchāsahagatā uddhaccasahagatā khandhā ca moho ca āsavasampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ upanissayapaccayena paccayo. (1)

88. Phenomena associated with the taints and phenomena dissociated from the taints are a condition for a phenomenon associated with the taints by way of the decisive support condition—contiguity decisive support, natural decisive support… and so on. Natural decisive support: The aggregates accompanied by dejection, accompanied by doubt, accompanied by restlessness, and delusion are a condition for the aggregates associated with the taints by way of the decisive support condition. (The root should be asked.) The aggregates accompanied by dejection, accompanied by doubt, accompanied by restlessness, and delusion are a condition for the aggregates associated with the taints by way of the decisive support condition. (1)

Āsavasampayutto [T 3.0221] ca āsavavippayutto ca dhammā āsavasampayuttassa ca āsavavippayuttassa ca dhammassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo – anantarūpanissayo, pakatūpanissayo…pe…. Pakatūpanissayo – domanassasahagatā vicikicchāsahagatā uddhaccasahagatā [V 3.0232] khandhā ca moho ca domanassasahagatānaṃ vicikicchāsahagatānaṃ uddhaccasahagatānaṃ khandhānaṃ mohassa ca upanissayapaccayena paccayo. (2)

Phenomena associated with the taints and phenomena dissociated from the taints are a condition for a phenomenon associated with the taints and for a phenomenon dissociated from the taints by way of the decisive support condition—contiguity decisive support, natural decisive support… and so on. Natural decisive support: The aggregates accompanied by dejection, accompanied by doubt, accompanied by restlessness, and delusion are a condition for the aggregates accompanied by dejection, accompanied by doubt, accompanied by restlessness, and for delusion by way of the decisive support condition. (2)

Purejātapaccayo

Pre-nascence Condition

89. Āsavavippayutto dhammo āsavavippayuttassa dhammassa purejātapaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇapurejātaṃ, vatthupurejātaṃ. Ārammaṇapurejātaṃ – cakkhuṃ…pe… vatthuṃ aniccato dukkhato anattato vipassati; dibbena cakkhunā rūpaṃ passati, dibbāya sotadhātuyā saddaṃ suṇāti. Rūpāyatanaṃ cakkhuviññāṇassa…pe… phoṭṭhabbāyatanaṃ kāyaviññāṇassa purejātapaccayena paccayo. Vatthupurejātaṃ – cakkhāyatanaṃ cakkhuviññāṇassa…pe… kāyāyatanaṃ kāyaviññāṇassa…pe… vatthu āsavavippayuttānaṃ khandhānaṃ mohassa ca purejātapaccayena paccayo. (1)

89. A phenomenon dissociated from the taints is a condition for a phenomenon dissociated from the taints by way of the pre-nascence condition—object pre-nascence, base pre-nascence. Object pre-nascence: The eye… and so on… one discerns the base as impermanent, as suffering, and as non-self; with the divine eye one sees forms, with the divine ear element one hears sounds. The form base is a condition for eye-consciousness… and so on… the tangible base is a condition for body-consciousness by way of the pre-nascence condition. Base pre-nascence: The eye-base is a condition for eye-consciousness… and so on… the body-base is a condition for body-consciousness… and so on… the base is a condition for the aggregates dissociated from the taints and for delusion by way of the pre-nascence condition. (1)

Āsavavippayutto dhammo āsavasampayuttassa dhammassa purejātapaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇapurejātaṃ, vatthupurejātaṃ. Ārammaṇapurejātaṃ – cakkhuṃ…pe… vatthuṃ assādeti abhinandati, taṃ ārabbha rāgo uppajjati…pe… domanassaṃ uppajjati. Vatthupurejātaṃ – vatthu āsavasampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ purejātapaccayena paccayo. (2)

A phenomenon dissociated from the taints is a condition for a phenomenon associated with the taints by way of the pre-nascence condition—object pre-nascence, base pre-nascence. Object pre-nascence: The eye… and so on… one savors and delights in the base; taking that as object, lust arises… and so on… dejection arises. Base pre-nascence: The base is a condition for the aggregates associated with the taints by way of the pre-nascence condition. (2)

Āsavavippayutto dhammo āsavasampayuttassa ca āsavavippayuttassa ca dhammassa purejātapaccayena [T 3.0222] paccayo – ārammaṇapurejātaṃ, vatthupurejātaṃ. Ārammaṇapurejātaṃ – cakkhuṃ…pe… vatthuṃ ārabbha domanassasahagatā vicikicchāsahagatā uddhaccasahagatā khandhā ca moho ca uppajjanti[M 3.0192]. Vatthupurejātaṃ – vatthu domanassasahagatānaṃ vicikicchāsahagatānaṃ uddhaccasahagatānaṃ khandhānaṃ mohassa ca purejātapaccayena paccayo. (3)

A phenomenon dissociated from the taints is a condition for a phenomenon associated with the taints and for a phenomenon dissociated from the taints by way of the pre-nascence condition—object pre-nascence, base pre-nascence. Object pre-nascence: The eye… and so on… taking the base as object, the aggregates accompanied by dejection, accompanied by doubt, accompanied by restlessness, and delusion arise. Base pre-nascence: The base is a condition for the aggregates accompanied by dejection, accompanied by doubt, accompanied by restlessness, and for delusion by way of the pre-nascence condition. (3)

Pacchājātapaccayo

Post-nascence Condition

90. Āsavasampayutto dhammo āsavavippayuttassa dhammassa pacchājātapaccayena paccayo – pacchājātā āsavasampayuttakā khandhā purejātassa imassa kāyassa pacchājātapaccayena paccayo. (1)

90. A phenomenon associated with the taints is a condition for a phenomenon dissociated from the taints by way of the post-nascence condition. Subsequently arisen aggregates associated with the taints are a condition for this pre-arisen body by way of the post-nascence condition. (1)

Āsavavippayutto [V 3.0233] dhammo āsavavippayuttassa dhammassa pacchājātapaccayena paccayo – pacchājātā āsavavippayuttā khandhā ca moho ca purejātassa imassa kāyassa pacchājātapaccayena paccayo. (1)

A phenomenon dissociated from the taints is a condition for a phenomenon dissociated from the taints by way of the post-nascence condition—the subsequently arisen aggregates dissociated from the taints and delusion are a condition for this pre-arisen body by way of the post-nascence condition. (1)

Āsavasampayutto ca āsavavippayutto ca dhammā āsavavippayuttassa dhammassa pacchājātapaccayena paccayo – pacchājātā domanassasahagatā vicikicchāsahagatā uddhaccasahagatā khandhā ca moho ca purejātassa imassa kāyassa pacchājātapaccayena paccayo. (1)

Phenomena associated with the taints and phenomena dissociated from the taints are a condition for a phenomenon dissociated from the taints by way of the post-nascence condition. The subsequently arisen aggregates accompanied by dejection, accompanied by doubt, or accompanied by restlessness, and delusion, are a condition for this pre-arisen body by way of the post-nascence condition. (1)

Āsevanapaccayo

Repetition Condition

91. Āsavasampayutto dhammo āsavasampayuttassa dhammassa āsevanapaccayena paccayo… nava (āvajjanāpi vuṭṭhānampi natthi ).

91. A phenomenon associated with the taints is a condition for a phenomenon associated with the taints by way of the repetition condition… nine (there is neither advertence nor emergence).

Kammapaccayo

Kamma Condition

92. Āsavasampayutto dhammo āsavasampayuttassa dhammassa kammapaccayena paccayo – āsavasampayuttakā cetanā sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ kammapaccayena paccayo. (1)

92. A phenomenon associated with the taints is a condition for a phenomenon associated with the taints by way of the kamma condition. Volition associated with the taints is a condition for the associated aggregates by way of the kamma condition. (1)

Āsavasampayutto dhammo āsavavippayuttassa [T 3.0223] dhammassa kammapaccayena paccayo – sahajātā, nānākkhaṇikā. Sahajātā – āsavasampayuttā cetanā cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ kammapaccayena paccayo; domanassasahagatā vicikicchāsahagatā uddhaccasahagatā cetanā mohassa cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ kammapaccayena paccayo. Nānākkhaṇikā – āsavasampayuttakā cetanā vipākānaṃ khandhānaṃ kaṭattā ca rūpānaṃ kammapaccayena paccayo. (2)

A phenomenon associated with taints is a condition for a phenomenon dissociated from taints by way of kamma-condition—co-nascent and at a different moment. Co-nascent—volition associated with taints is a condition by way of kamma-condition for mind-originated material phenomena; volition accompanied by displeasure, doubt, or restlessness is a condition by way of kamma-condition for delusion and mind-originated material phenomena. At a different moment—volition associated with taints is a condition by way of kamma-condition for resultant aggregates and for kamma-born materiality. (2)

Āsavasampayutto [M 3.0193] dhammo āsavasampayuttassa ca āsavavippayuttassa ca dhammassa kammapaccayena paccayo – āsavasampayuttā cetanā sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ kammapaccayena paccayo; domanassasahagatā vicikicchāsahagatā uddhaccasahagatā cetanā sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ mohassa ca cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ kammapaccayena paccayo. (3)

A phenomenon associated with taints is a condition for a phenomenon associated with taints and for a phenomenon dissociated from taints by way of kamma-condition—volition associated with taints is a condition by way of kamma-condition for associated aggregates and for mind-originated material phenomena; volition accompanied by displeasure, doubt, or restlessness is a condition by way of kamma-condition for associated aggregates, for delusion, and for mind-originated material phenomena. (3)

Āsavavippayutto [V 3.0234] dhammo āsavavippayuttassa dhammassa kammapaccayena paccayo – sahajātā, nānākkhaṇikā. Sahajātā – āsavavippayuttā cetanā sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ kammapaccayena paccayo; paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe…. Nānākkhaṇikā āsavavippayuttā cetanā vipākānaṃ khandhānaṃ kaṭattā ca rūpānaṃ kammapaccayena paccayo. (1)

A phenomenon dissociated from taints is a condition for a phenomenon dissociated from taints by way of kamma-condition: co-nascent and at a different moment. Co-nascent—volition dissociated from taints is a condition by way of kamma-condition for the associated aggregates and for mind-originated material phenomena; at the moment of rebirth-linking…and so on. At a different moment—volition dissociated from taints is a condition by way of kamma-condition for resultant aggregates and for kamma-born materiality. (1)

Vipākapaccayo

Result-Condition

93. Āsavavippayutto dhammo āsavavippayuttassa dhammassa vipākapaccayena paccayo… ekaṃ.

93. A phenomenon dissociated from taints is a condition for a phenomenon dissociated from taints by way of result-condition… one.

Āhārapaccayo

Nutriment-Condition

94. Āsavasampayutto dhammo āsavasampayuttassa dhammassa āhārapaccayena [T 3.0224] paccayo – āsavasampayuttā āhārā sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ āhārapaccayena paccayo. (1)

94. A phenomenon associated with taints is a condition for a phenomenon associated with taints by way of nutriment-condition—nutriments associated with taints are a condition for associated aggregates by way of nutriment-condition. (1)

Āsavasampayutto dhammo āsavavippayuttassa dhammassa āhārapaccayena paccayo – āsavasampayuttā āhārā cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ āhārapaccayena paccayo; domanassasahagatā vicikicchāsahagatā uddhaccasahagatā āhārā mohassa cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ āhārapaccayena paccayo. (2)

A phenomenon associated with taints is a condition for a phenomenon dissociated from taints by way of nutriment-condition—nutriments associated with taints are a condition for mind-originated material phenomena by way of nutriment-condition; nutriments accompanied by displeasure, doubt, or restlessness are a condition for delusion and for mind-originated material phenomena by way of nutriment-condition. (2)

Āsavasampayutto dhammo āsavasampayuttassa ca āsavavippayuttassa ca dhammassa āhārapaccayena paccayo – āsavasampayuttā āhārā sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ āhārapaccayena paccayo; domanassasahagatā vicikicchāsahagatā uddhaccasahagatā āhārā sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ mohassa ca cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ āhārapaccayena paccayo. (3)

A phenomenon associated with taints is a condition for a phenomenon associated with taints and for a phenomenon dissociated from taints by way of nutriment-condition—nutriments associated with taints are a condition for the associated aggregates and for mind-originated material phenomena by way of nutriment-condition; nutriments accompanied by displeasure, doubt, or restlessness are a condition for the associated aggregates, for delusion, and for mind-originated material phenomena by way of nutriment-condition. (3)

95. Āsavavippayutto [M 3.0194] dhammo āsavavippayuttassa dhammassa āhārapaccayena paccayo – āsavavippayuttā āhārā sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ āhārapaccayena paccayo; paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe… kabaḷīkāro āhāro imassa kāyassa āhārapaccayena paccayo. (1)

95. A phenomenon dissociated from taints is a condition for a phenomenon dissociated from taints by way of nutriment-condition—nutriments dissociated from taints are a condition for the associated aggregates and for mind-originated material phenomena by way of nutriment-condition; at the moment of rebirth-linking…and so on. Physical nutriment is a condition for this body by way of nutriment-condition. (1)

Indriyapaccayādi

Faculty-Condition, etc.

96. Āsavasampayutto [V 3.0235] dhammo āsavasampayuttassa dhammassa indriyapaccayena paccayo… cattāri… jhānapaccayena paccayo… cattāri… maggapaccayena paccayo… cattāri… sampayuttapaccayena paccayo… cha.

96. A phenomenon associated with taints is a condition for a phenomenon associated with taints by way of faculty-condition… four… by way of jhāna-condition… four… by way of path-condition… four… by way of association-condition… six.

Vippayuttapaccayo

Dissociation-Condition

97. Āsavasampayutto [T 3.0225] dhammo āsavavippayuttassa dhammassa vippayuttapaccayena paccayo – sahajātaṃ, pacchājātaṃ. Sahajātā – āsavasampayuttā khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ vippayuttapaccayena paccayo. Pacchājātā – āsavasampayuttā khandhā purejātassa imassa kāyassa vippayuttapaccayena paccayo. (1)

97. A phenomenon associated with taints is a condition for a phenomenon dissociated from taints by way of dissociation-condition—co-nascent and post-nascent. Co-nascent—the aggregates associated with taints are a condition for mind-originated material phenomena by way of dissociation-condition. Post-nascent—the aggregates associated with taints are a condition for this pre-arisen body by way of dissociation-condition. (1)

Āsavavippayutto dhammo āsavavippayuttassa dhammassa vippayuttapaccayena paccayo – sahajātaṃ, purejātaṃ, pacchājātaṃ (saṃkhittaṃ. Vitthāretabbaṃ). (1)

A phenomenon dissociated from taints is a condition for a phenomenon dissociated from taints by way of dissociation-condition: co-nascent, pre-nascent, and post-nascent (in brief; to be expanded). (1)

98. Āsavavippayutto dhammo āsavasampayuttassa dhammassa vippayuttapaccayena paccayo. Purejātaṃ – vatthu āsavasampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ vippayuttapaccayena paccayo. (1)

98. A phenomenon dissociated from taints is a condition for a phenomenon associated with taints by way of dissociation-condition. Pre-nascent—the physical base is a condition for the aggregates associated with taints by way of dissociation-condition. (1)

Āsavavippayutto dhammo āsavasampayuttassa ca āsavavippayuttassa ca dhammassa vippayuttapaccayena paccayo. Purejātaṃ – vatthu domanassasahagatānaṃ vicikicchāsahagatānaṃ uddhaccasahagatānaṃ khandhānaṃ mohassa ca vippayuttapaccayena paccayo. (2)

A phenomenon dissociated from taints is a condition for a phenomenon associated with taints and for a phenomenon dissociated from taints by way of dissociation-condition. Pre-nascent—the physical base is a condition for the aggregates accompanied by displeasure, doubt, or restlessness, and for delusion by way of dissociation-condition. (2)

Āsavasampayutto ca āsavavippayutto ca dhammā āsavavippayuttassa dhammassa vippayuttapaccayena paccayo – sahajātaṃ, pacchājātaṃ. Sahajātā – domanassasahagatā vicikicchāsahagatā uddhaccasahagatā khandhā [M 3.0195] ca moho ca cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ vippayuttapaccayena paccayo. Pacchājātā – domanassasahagatā vicikicchāsahagatā uddhaccasahagatā khandhā ca moho ca purejātassa imassa kāyassa vippayuttapaccayena paccayo. (1)

Phenomena both associated with taints and dissociated from taints are a condition for a phenomenon dissociated from taints by way of dissociation-condition—co-nascent and post-nascent. Co-nascent—aggregates accompanied by displeasure, doubt, or restlessness, and delusion are a condition for mind-originated material phenomena by way of dissociation-condition. Post-nascent—aggregates accompanied by displeasure, doubt, or restlessness, and delusion are a condition for this pre-arisen body by way of dissociation-condition. (1)

Atthipaccayo

Presence-Condition

99. Āsavasampayutto [V 3.0236] dhammo āsavasampayuttassa dhammassa atthipaccayena [T 3.0226] paccayo… ekaṃ. (1)

99. A phenomenon associated with taints is a condition for a phenomenon associated with taints by way of presence-condition… one. (1)

Āsavasampayutto dhammo āsavavippayuttassa dhammassa atthipaccayena paccayo – sahajātaṃ, pacchājātaṃ. Sahajātā – āsavasampayuttā khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo; domanassasahagatā vicikicchāsahagatā uddhaccasahagatā khandhā mohassa ca cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo. Pacchājātā – āsavasampayuttā khandhā purejātassa imassa kāyassa atthipaccayena paccayo. (2)

A state associated with taints is a condition by presence for a state dissociated from taints: co-nascence, post-nascence. Co-nascently—the aggregates associated with taints are a condition by presence for mind-originated material phenomena; the aggregates accompanied by displeasure, accompanied by doubt, or accompanied by restlessness are a condition by presence for delusion and for mind-originated material phenomena. Post-nascently—the aggregates associated with taints are a condition by presence for this pre-arisen body. (2)

Āsavasampayutto dhammo āsavasampayuttassa ca āsavavippayuttassa ca dhammassa atthipaccayena paccayo (sahajātasadisaṃ). (3)

A state associated with taints is a condition by presence for a state associated with taints and for a state dissociated from taints (similar to co-nascence). (3)

100. Āsavavippayutto dhammo āsavavippayuttassa dhammassa atthipaccayena paccayo – sahajātaṃ, purejātaṃ, pacchājātaṃ, āhāraṃ, indriyaṃ (saṃkhittaṃ, vitthāretabbaṃ). (1)

100. A state dissociated from taints is a condition by presence for a state dissociated from taints: co-nascence, pre-nascence, post-nascence, nutriment, faculty (in brief, to be expanded). (1)

Āsavavippayutto dhammo āsavasampayuttassa dhammassa atthipaccayena paccayo – sahajātaṃ, purejātaṃ. Sahajāto – domanassasahagato vicikicchāsahagato uddhaccasahagato moho sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo. Purejātaṃ – cakkhuṃ…pe… vatthuṃ assādeti abhinandati, taṃ ārabbha rāgo uppajjati, diṭṭhi uppajjati, vicikicchā uppajjati, uddhaccaṃ uppajjati, domanassaṃ uppajjati, vatthu āsavasampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo. (2)

A state dissociated from taints is a condition by presence for a state associated with taints: co-nascence, pre-nascence. Co-nascently—delusion accompanied by displeasure, doubt, or restlessness is a condition by presence for the associated aggregates. Pre-nascently—the eye…pe… the base is savored and delighted in; taking that as object, lust arises, view arises, doubt arises, restlessness arises, displeasure arises; the base is a condition by presence for the aggregates associated with taints. (2)

Āsavavippayutto dhammo āsavasampayuttassa ca āsavavippayuttassa ca dhammassa atthipaccayena paccayo – sahajātaṃ, purejātaṃ. Sahajāto – domanassasahagato [M 3.0196] vicikicchāsahagato uddhaccasahagato [T 3.0227] moho sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ atthipaccayena [V 3.0237] paccayo. Purejātaṃ – cakkhuṃ…pe… vatthuṃ ārabbha domanassasahagatā vicikicchāsahagatā uddhaccasahagatā khandhā ca moho ca uppajjanti. (3)

A state dissociated from taints is a condition by presence for both a state associated with taints and a state dissociated from taints: co-nascence, pre-nascence. Co-nascently—delusion accompanied by displeasure, doubt, or restlessness is a condition by presence for the associated aggregates and for mind-originated material phenomena. Pre-nascently—taking the eye…pe… the base as object, aggregates accompanied by displeasure, doubt, or restlessness, and delusion arise. (3)

101. Āsavasampayutto ca āsavavippayutto ca dhammā āsavasampayuttassa dhammassa atthipaccayena paccayo – sahajātaṃ, purejātaṃ. Sahajāto – āsavasampayutto eko khandho ca vatthu ca tiṇṇannaṃ khandhānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo…pe… dve khandhā ca…pe… domanassasahagato vicikicchāsahagato uddhaccasahagato eko khandho ca moho ca tiṇṇannaṃ khandhānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo; dve khandhā ca…pe…. (1)

101. Both a state associated with taints and a state dissociated from taints are a condition by presence for a state associated with taints: co-nascence and pre-nascence. Co-nascently—one aggregate associated with taints and the base are a condition by presence for the other three aggregates…pe… two aggregates…pe… one aggregate accompanied by displeasure, doubt, or restlessness, and delusion, is a condition by presence for the other three aggregates; two aggregates…pe…. (1)

Āsavasampayutto ca āsavavippayutto ca dhammā āsavavippayuttassa dhammassa atthipaccayena paccayo – sahajātaṃ, purejātaṃ, pacchājātaṃ, āhāraṃ, indriyaṃ. Sahajātā – āsavasampayuttā khandhā ca mahābhūtā ca cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo; domanassasahagatā vicikicchāsahagatā uddhaccasahagatā khandhā ca moho ca cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo; domanassasahagatā vicikicchāsahagatā uddhaccasahagatā khandhā ca vatthu ca mohassa atthipaccayena paccayo. Pacchājātā – āsavasampayuttā khandhā ca kabaḷīkāro āhāro ca imassa kāyassa atthipaccayena paccayo. Pacchājātā – āsavasampayuttā khandhā ca rūpajīvitindriyañca kaṭattārūpānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo. (2)

Both a state associated with taints and a state dissociated from taints are a condition by presence for a state dissociated from taints: co-nascence, pre-nascence, post-nascence, nutriment, and faculty. Co-nascently—the aggregates associated with taints and the great elements are a condition for mind-originated material phenomena; the aggregates accompanied by displeasure, doubt, or restlessness and delusion are a condition for mind-originated material phenomena; the aggregates accompanied by displeasure, doubt, or restlessness and the base are a condition for delusion. Post-nascently—the aggregates associated with taints and edible food are a condition for this body. Post-nascently—the aggregates associated with taints and the material life faculty are a condition for kamma-born material phenomena. (2)

Āsavasampayutto ca āsavavippayutto [T 3.0228] ca dhammā āsavasampayuttassa ca āsavavippayuttassa ca dhammassa atthipaccayena paccayo – sahajātaṃ, purejātaṃ. Sahajāto – domanassasahagato vicikicchāsahagato uddhaccasahagato eko khandho ca moho ca tiṇṇannaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo…pe… dve khandhā ca…pe…. Sahajāto – domanassasahagato vicikicchāsahagato uddhaccasahagato eko khandho ca vatthu ca tiṇṇannaṃ khandhānaṃ mohassa ca…pe… dve khandhā ca…pe…. (3)

Both a state associated with taints and a state dissociated from taints are a condition by presence for a state associated with taints and for a state dissociated from taints: co-nascence and pre-nascence. Co-nascently—one aggregate accompanied by displeasure, doubt, or restlessness and delusion are a condition for the other three aggregates and for mind-originated material phenomena…pe… two aggregates…pe…. Co-nascently—one aggregate accompanied by displeasure, doubt, or restlessness and the base are a condition for the other three aggregates and for delusion…pe… two aggregates…pe…. (3)

102. By root condition, nine; by object condition, nine; by dominance condition, five; by contiguity condition, nine; by immediate proximity condition, nine; by co-nascence condition, nine; by mutuality condition, six; by dependence condition, nine; by decisive support condition, nine; by pre-nascence condition, three; by post-nascence condition, three; by repetition condition, nine; by kamma condition, four; by result condition, one; by nutriment condition, four; by faculty condition, four; by jhāna condition, four; by path condition, four; by association condition, six; by dissociation condition, five; by presence condition, nine; by absence condition, nine; by disappearance condition, nine; by non-disappearance condition, nine.

Paccanīyuddhāro

The Negative Method

103. Āsavasampayutto dhammo āsavasampayuttassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo… sahajātapaccayena paccayo… upanissayapaccayena paccayo. (1)

103. A state associated with taints is a condition for a state associated with taints by object condition… by co-nascence condition… by decisive support condition. (1)

Āsavasampayutto dhammo āsavavippayuttassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo… sahajātapaccayena paccayo… upanissayapaccayena paccayo… pacchājātapaccayena paccayo… kammapaccayena paccayo. (2)

A state associated with taints is a condition for a state dissociated from taints by object condition… by co-nascence condition… by decisive support condition… by post-nascence condition… by kamma condition. (2)

Āsavasampayutto dhammo āsavasampayuttassa ca āsavavippayuttassa ca dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena [T 3.0229] paccayo… sahajātapaccayena paccayo… upanissayapaccayena paccayo. (3)

A state associated with taints is a condition for a state associated with taints and for a state dissociated from taints by object condition… by co-nascence condition… by decisive support condition. (3)

104. Āsavavippayutto dhammo āsavavippayuttassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo… sahajātapaccayena paccayo… upanissayapaccayena paccayo… purejātapaccayena paccayo… pacchājātapaccayena paccayo… kammapaccayena paccayo… āhārapaccayena paccayo… indriyapaccayena paccayo. (1)

104. A state dissociated from taints is a condition for a state dissociated from taints by object condition... by co-nascence condition... by decisive support condition... by pre-nascence condition... by post-nascence condition... by kamma condition... by nutriment condition... by faculty condition. (1)

Āsavavippayutto [V 3.0239] dhammo āsavasampayuttassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo… sahajātapaccayena paccayo… upanissayapaccayena paccayo… purejātapaccayena paccayo. (2)

A state dissociated from taints is a condition for a state associated with taints by object condition... by co-nascence condition... by decisive support condition... by pre-nascence condition. (2)

Āsavavippayutto [M 3.0198] dhammo āsavasampayuttassa ca āsavavippayuttassa ca dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo… sahajātapaccayena paccayo… upanissayapaccayena paccayo… purejātapaccayena paccayo. (3)

A state dissociated from taints is a condition for a state associated with taints and a state dissociated from taints by object condition... by co-nascence condition... by decisive support condition... by pre-nascence condition. (3)

105. Āsavasampayutto ca āsavavippayutto ca dhammā āsavasampayuttassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo… sahajātapaccayena paccayo… upanissayapaccayena paccayo. (1)

105. States associated with taints and states dissociated from taints are a condition for states associated with taints by object condition... by co-nascence condition... by decisive support condition. (1)

Āsavasampayutto ca āsavavippayutto ca dhammā āsavavippayuttassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo… sahajātapaccayena paccayo… upanissayapaccayena paccayo… pacchājātapaccayena paccayo. (2)

States associated with taints and states dissociated from taints are a condition for states dissociated from taints by object condition... by co-nascence condition... by decisive support condition... by post-nascence condition. (2)

Āsavasampayutto ca āsavavippayutto ca dhammā āsavasampayuttassa ca āsavavippayuttassa ca dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo… sahajātapaccayena paccayo… upanissayapaccayena paccayo. (3)

States associated with taints and states dissociated from taints are a condition for states associated with taints and states dissociated from taints by object condition... by co-nascence condition... by decisive support condition. (3)

Hetupaccayo

The Root Condition

109. Āsavañceva [V 3.0241] sāsavañca dhammaṃ paṭicca āsavo ceva sāsavo ca dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – kāmāsavaṃ paṭicca diṭṭhāsavo avijjāsavo (cakkaṃ bandhitabbaṃ) bhavāsavaṃ paṭicca avijjāsavo (cakkaṃ bandhitabbaṃ) diṭṭhāsavaṃ paṭicca avijjāsavo. (1)

109. Dependent on a state that is both a taint and tainted, a state that is both a taint and tainted arises by root condition: Dependent on the taint of sensual desire, the taint of views and the taint of ignorance arise (the cycle should be connected); dependent on the taint of existence, the taint of ignorance arises (the cycle should be connected); dependent on the taint of views, the taint of ignorance arises. (1)

Āsavañceva sāsavañca dhammaṃ paṭicca sāsavo ceva no ca āsavo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā [T 3.0231] – āsave paṭicca sampayuttakā khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ. (2)

Dependent on a state that is both a taint and tainted, a state that is tainted but not a taint arises by root condition: Dependent on the taints, the associated aggregates and mind-originated materiality arise. (2)

Āsavañceva sāsavañca dhammaṃ paṭicca āsavo ceva sāsavo ca sāsavo ceva no ca āsavo ca dhammā uppajjanti hetupaccayā – kāmāsavaṃ paṭicca diṭṭhāsavo avijjāsavo sampayuttakā khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ, bhavāsavaṃ (cakkaṃ bandhitabbaṃ). (3)

Dependent on a state that is both a taint and tainted, states that are both a taint and tainted, and states that are tainted but not a taint, arise by root condition: Dependent on the taint of sensual desire, the taint of views, the taint of ignorance, the associated aggregates, and mind-originated materiality arise; dependent on the taint of existence (the cycle should be connected). (3)

110. Sāsavañceva no ca āsavaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca sāsavo ceva no ca āsavo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – sāsavañceva no ca āsavaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca tayo khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ…pe… dve khandhe…pe… paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe… khandhe paṭicca vatthu, vatthuṃ paṭicca khandhā, ekaṃ mahābhūtaṃ…pe…. (1)

110. Dependent on a state that is tainted but not a taint, a state that is tainted but not a taint arises by root condition: Dependent on one aggregate that is tainted but not a taint, the three aggregates and mind-originated materiality arise… and so on… dependent on two aggregates… and so on… at the moment of relinking… and so on… dependent on the aggregates, the base; dependent on the base, the aggregates; dependent on one great element… and so on…. (1)

Sāsavañceva [M 3.0200][V 3.0242] no ca āsavaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca āsavo ceva sāsavo ca dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – sāsave ceva no ca āsave khandhe paṭicca āsavā. (2)

Dependent on a state that is tainted but not a taint, a state that is both a taint and tainted arises by root condition: Dependent on the aggregates that are tainted but not taints, the taints arise. (2)

Sāsavañceva no ca āsavaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca āsavo ceva sāsavo ca sāsavo ceva no ca āsavo ca dhammā uppajjanti hetupaccayā – sāsavañceva no ca āsavaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca tayo khandhā āsavā ca cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ…pe… dve khandhe…pe…. (3)

Dependent on a state that is tainted but not a taint, states that are both a taint and tainted, and states that are tainted but not a taint, arise by root condition: Dependent on one aggregate that is tainted but not a taint, the three aggregates, the taints, and mind-originated materiality arise… and so on… dependent on two aggregates… and so on…. (3)

111. Āsavañceva sāsavañca sāsavañceva no ca āsavañca dhammaṃ paṭicca āsavo ceva sāsavo ca dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – kāmāsavañca sampayuttake ca khandhe paṭicca diṭṭhāsavo avijjāsavo (evaṃ cakkaṃ bandhitabbaṃ). (1)

111. Dependent on a state that is both a taint and tainted, and a state that is tainted but not a taint, a state that is both a taint and tainted arises by root condition: Dependent on the taint of sensual desire and the associated aggregates, the taint of views and the taint of ignorance arise (thus the cycle should be connected). (1)

Āsavañceva sāsavañca sāsavañceva no ca āsavañca dhammaṃ paṭicca sāsavo ceva no ca āsavo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – sāsavañceva no ca āsavaṃ ekaṃ khandhañca [T 3.0232] āsave ca paṭicca tayo khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ…pe… dve khandhe ca…pe…. (2)

Dependent on a state that is both a taint and tainted, and a state that is tainted but not a taint, a state that is tainted but not a taint arises by root condition: Dependent on one aggregate that is tainted but not a taint and the taints, three aggregates and mind-originated materiality arise… and so on… two aggregates… and so on…. (2)

Āsavañceva sāsavañca sāsavañceva no ca āsavañca dhammaṃ paṭicca āsavo ceva sāsavo ca sāsavo ceva no ca āsavo ca dhammā uppajjanti hetupaccayā – sāsavañceva no ca āsavaṃ ekaṃ khandhañca kāmāsavañca paṭicca tayo khandhā diṭṭhāsavo avijjāsavo cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ…pe… dve khandhe ca…pe… (cakkaṃ. Saṃkhittaṃ). (3)

Dependent on a state that is both a taint and tainted, and a state that is tainted but not a taint, states that are both a taint and tainted, and states that are tainted but not taints, arise by root condition: Dependent on one aggregate that is tainted but not a taint and the taint of sensual desire, three aggregates, the taint of views, the taint of ignorance, and mind-originated materiality arise… and so on… two aggregates… and so on… (the cycle should be connected. Abbreviated.) (3)
