Anantarapaccayo

Immediate Condition

112. Āsavo [M 3.0201] ceva sāsavo ca dhammo āsavassa ceva sāsavassa ca dhammassa anantarapaccayena paccayo – purimā purimā āsavā pacchimānaṃ pacchimānaṃ āsavānaṃ anantarapaccayena paccayo. (1)

112. A state that is both a taint and tainted is a condition for a state that is both a taint and tainted by way of immediate condition—the preceding taints are a condition for the subsequent taints by way of immediate condition. (1)

Āsavo ceva sāsavo ca dhammo sāsavassa ceva no ca āsavassa dhammassa anantarapaccayena paccayo – purimā purimā āsavā pacchimānaṃ pacchimānaṃ sāsavañceva no ca āsavānaṃ khandhānaṃ anantarapaccayena paccayo; āsavā vuṭṭhānassa anantarapaccayena paccayo. (2)

A state that is both a taint and tainted is a condition for a state that is tainted but not a taint by way of immediate condition—the preceding taints are a condition for the subsequent aggregates that are tainted but not taints by way of immediate condition; the taints are a condition for emergence by way of immediate condition. (2)

Āsavo ceva sāsavo ca dhammo āsavassa [T 3.0233] ceva sāsavassa ca sāsavassa ceva no ca āsavassa ca dhammassa anantarapaccayena paccayo – purimā purimā āsavā pacchimānaṃ pacchimānaṃ āsavānaṃ sampayuttakānañca khandhānaṃ anantarapaccayena paccayo. (3)

A state that is both a taint and tainted is a condition for a state that is both a taint and tainted and for a state that is tainted but not a taint, by way of immediate condition—the preceding taints are a condition for the subsequent taints and their associated aggregates by way of immediate condition. (3)

113. Sāsavo ceva no ca āsavo dhammo sāsavassa ceva no ca āsavassa dhammassa anantarapaccayena paccayo – purimā purimā sāsavā ceva no ca āsavā khandhā pacchimānaṃ pacchimānaṃ sāsavānañceva no ca āsavānaṃ khandhānaṃ anantarapaccayena paccayo; anulomaṃ gotrabhussa, anulomaṃ vodānassa, āvajjanā sāsavānañceva no ca āsavānaṃ khandhānaṃ anantarapaccayena paccayo. (1)

113. A state that is tainted but not a taint is a condition for a state that is tainted but not a taint by way of immediate condition—the preceding aggregates that are tainted but not a taint are a condition for the subsequent aggregates that are tainted but not a taint by way of immediate condition; conformity for change-of-lineage, conformity for purification, and advertence are conditions for the aggregates that are tainted but not a taint by way of immediate condition. (1)

Sāsavo [V 3.0244] ceva no ca āsavo dhammo āsavassa ceva sāsavassa ca dhammassa anantarapaccayena paccayo – purimā purimā sāsavā ceva no ca āsavā khandhā pacchimānaṃ pacchimānaṃ āsavānaṃ anantarapaccayena paccayo; āvajjanā āsavānaṃ anantarapaccayena paccayo. (2)

A state that is tainted but not a taint is a condition for a state that is both a taint and tainted by way of immediate condition—the preceding aggregates that are tainted but not a taint are a condition for the subsequent taints by way of immediate condition; advertence is a condition for the taints by way of immediate condition. (2)

Sāsavo ceva no ca āsavo dhammo āsavassa ceva sāsavassa ca sāsavassa ceva no ca āsavassa ca dhammassa anantarapaccayena paccayo – purimā purimā sāsavā ceva no ca āsavā khandhā pacchimānaṃ pacchimānaṃ āsavānaṃ sampayuttakānañca khandhānaṃ anantarapaccayena paccayo; āvajjanā āsavānaṃ sampayuttakānañca khandhānaṃ anantarapaccayena paccayo. (3)

A state that is tainted but not a taint is a condition for a state that is both a taint and tainted, and for a state that is tainted but not a taint, by way of immediate condition—the preceding aggregates that are tainted but not a taint are a condition for the subsequent taints and their associated aggregates by way of immediate condition; advertence is a condition for the taints and their associated aggregates by way of immediate condition. (3)

114. Āsavo ceva sāsavo ca sāsavo ceva no ca āsavo ca dhammā āsavassa ceva sāsavassa ca dhammassa anantarapaccayena paccayo [M 3.0202] – purimā purimā āsavā ca sampayuttakā ca khandhā pacchimānaṃ pacchimānaṃ āsavānaṃ [T 3.0234] anantarapaccayena paccayo. (1)

114. States that are both a taint and tainted, and states that are tainted but not a taint, are a condition for a state that is both a taint and tainted by way of immediate condition—the preceding taints and their associated aggregates are a condition for the subsequent taints by way of immediate condition. (1)

Āsavo ceva sāsavo ca sāsavo ceva no ca āsavo ca dhammā sāsavassa ceva no ca āsavassa dhammassa anantarapaccayena paccayo – purimā purimā āsavā ca sampayuttakā ca khandhā pacchimānaṃ pacchimānaṃ sāsavānañceva no ca āsavānaṃ khandhānaṃ anantarapaccayena paccayo; āsavā ca sampayuttakā ca khandhā vuṭṭhānassa anantarapaccayena paccayo. (2)

States that are both a taint and tainted, and states that are tainted but not a taint, are a condition for a state that is tainted but not a taint by way of immediate condition—the preceding taints and their associated aggregates are a condition for the subsequent aggregates that are tainted but not a taint by way of immediate condition; the taints and their associated aggregates are a condition for emergence by way of immediate condition. (2)

Āsavo ceva sāsavo ca sāsavo ceva no ca āsavo ca dhammā āsavassa ceva sāsavassa ca sāsavassa ceva no ca āsavassa ca dhammassa anantarapaccayena paccayo – purimā purimā āsavā ca sampayuttakā ca khandhā pacchimānaṃ pacchimānaṃ āsavānaṃ sampayuttakānañca khandhānaṃ anantarapaccayena paccayo (evaṃ sabbaṃ vitthāretabbaṃ). (3)

States that are both a taint and tainted, and states that are tainted but not a taint, are a condition for a state that is both a taint and tainted, and for a state that is tainted but not a taint, by way of immediate condition—the preceding taints and their associated aggregates are a condition for the subsequent taints and their associated aggregates by way of immediate condition (all should be elaborated in this way). (3)

(Āsavadukepi anantaraṃ iminā sadisaṃ kātabbaṃ. Āvajjanāpi vuṭṭhānampi evaṃ samuddiṭṭhaṃ saṃkhittaṃ. Sabbaṃ paripuṇṇaṃ. Āsavadukasadisaṃ kātabbaṃ, ninnānaṃ.)

(In the dyad of taints, the immediate condition should also be done similarly to this. Advertence and emergence are also thus indicated briefly. Everything is complete. It should be done similarly to the dyad of taints, without deficiency.)

Āsavasāsavadukaṃ niṭṭhitaṃ.

The Dyad of Taints and Tainted States is concluded.

Root Condition

115. Āsavañceva [V 3.0245] āsavasampayuttañca dhammaṃ paṭicca āsavo ceva āsavasampayutto ca dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – kāmāsavaṃ paṭicca diṭṭhāsavo avijjāsavo (cakkaṃ bandhitabbaṃ). Bhavāsavaṃ paṭicca avijjāsavo [T 3.0235] (cakkaṃ bandhitabbaṃ). Diṭṭhāsavaṃ paṭicca avijjāsavo. (1)

115. Dependent on a state that is both a taint and taint-associated, a state that is both a taint and taint-associated arises by root condition: Dependent on the taint of sensual desire, the taint of views and the taint of ignorance arise (the cycle should be completed). Dependent on the taint of existence, the taint of ignorance arises (the cycle should be completed). Dependent on the taint of views, the taint of ignorance arises. (1)

Āsavañceva āsavasampayuttañca dhammaṃ paṭicca āsavasampayutto ceva no ca āsavo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – āsave paṭicca sampayuttakā khandhā. (2)

A taint-associated state that is not a taint, dependent on a taint and a taint-associated state, arises by way of root condition. Dependent on the taints, the associated aggregates arise. (2)

Āsavañceva [M 3.0203] āsavasampayuttañca dhammaṃ paṭicca āsavo ceva āsavasampayutto ca āsavasampayutto ceva no ca āsavo ca dhammā uppajjanti hetupaccayā – āsavasampayuttaṃ kāmāsavaṃ paṭicca diṭṭhāsavo avijjāsavo sampayuttakā ca khandhā (sabbaṃ cakkaṃ). (3)

A taint and a taint-associated state, and a taint-associated state that is not a taint, dependent on a taint and a taint-associated state, arise by way of root condition. Dependent on the taint of sensual desire associated with taints, the taint of views, the taint of ignorance, and the associated aggregates arise (the entire cycle). (3)

116. Āsavasampayuttañceva no ca āsavaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca āsavasampayutto ceva no ca [V 3.0246] āsavo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – āsavasampayuttañceva no ca āsavaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca tayo khandhā…pe… dve khandhe…pe…. (1)

116. A taint-associated state that is not a taint, dependent on a taint-associated state that is not a taint, arises by way of root condition. Dependent on one taint-associated aggregate that is not a taint, three aggregates arise... and so on... dependent on two aggregates... and so on. (1)

Āsavasampayuttañceva no ca āsavaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca āsavo ceva āsavasampayutto ca dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – āsavasampayuttañceva no ca āsave khandhe paṭicca āsavā. (2)

A taint and a taint-associated state, dependent on a taint-associated state that is not a taint, arises by way of root condition. Dependent on the taint-associated aggregates that are not taints, the taints arise. (2)

Āsavasampayuttañceva no ca āsavaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca āsavo ceva āsavasampayutto ca āsavasampayutto ceva no ca āsavo ca dhammā uppajjanti hetupaccayā – āsavasampayuttañceva no ca āsavaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca tayo khandhā āsavā ca…pe… dve khandhe…pe…. (3)

A taint and a taint-associated state, and a taint-associated state that is not a taint, dependent on a taint-associated state that is not a taint, arise by way of root condition. Dependent on one taint-associated aggregate that is not a taint, three aggregates and the taints arise... and so on... dependent on two aggregates... and so on. (3)

117. Āsavañceva āsavasampayuttañca āsavasampayuttañceva no ca āsavañca dhammaṃ paṭicca āsavo ceva āsavasampayutto ca dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – kāmāsavañca sampayuttake ca khandhe paṭicca diṭṭhāsavo avijjāsavo (sabbaṃ cakkaṃ). (1)

117. A taint and a taint-associated state, dependent on a taint and a taint-associated state, and a taint-associated state that is not a taint, arises by way of root condition. Dependent on the taint of sensual desire and the associated aggregates, the taint of views and the taint of ignorance arise (the entire cycle). (1)

Āsavañceva [T 3.0236] āsavasampayuttañca āsavasampayuttañceva no ca āsavañca dhammaṃ paṭicca āsavasampayutto ceva no ca āsavo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – āsavasampayuttañceva no ca āsavaṃ ekaṃ khandhañca āsave ca paṭicca tayo khandhā…pe… dve khandhe…pe…. (2)

A taint-associated state that is not a taint, dependent on a taint and a taint-associated state, and a taint-associated state that is not a taint, arises by way of root condition. Dependent on one taint-associated aggregate that is not a taint and the taints, three aggregates arise... and so on... dependent on two aggregates... and so on. (2)

Āsavañceva āsavasampayuttañca āsavasampayuttañceva no ca āsavañca dhammaṃ paṭicca āsavo ceva āsavasampayutto ca āsavasampayutto ceva no ca āsavo ca dhammā uppajjanti hetupaccayā – āsavasampayuttañceva no ca āsavaṃ ekaṃ khandhañca kāmāsavañca paṭicca tayo khandhā diṭṭhāsavo avijjāsavo…pe… dve khandhe…pe…. (3)

A taint and a taint-associated state, and a taint-associated state that is not a taint, dependent on a taint and a taint-associated state, and a taint-associated state that is not a taint, arise by way of root condition. Dependent on one taint-associated aggregate that is not a taint and the taint of sensual desire, three aggregates, the taint of views, and the taint of ignorance arise... and so on... dependent on two aggregates... and so on. (3)

(Cakkaṃ. Evaṃ sabbe paccayā kātabbā.)

(The cycle. Thus, all conditions should be applied.)

122. A state that is both a taint and associated with taints is a condition for a state that is both a taint and associated with taints by way of object condition… three.

Āsavasampayutto ceva no ca āsavo dhammo āsavasampayuttassa ceva no ca āsavassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo – āsavasampayutte ceva no ca āsave khandhe ārabbha āsavasampayuttā ceva no ca āsavā khandhā uppajjanti. (1)

A state associated with taints but not itself a taint is a condition for a state associated with taints but not itself a taint by way of object condition. Taking as object aggregates associated with taints but not themselves taints, aggregates associated with taints but not themselves taints arise. (1)

Āsavasampayutto ceva no ca āsavo dhammo āsavassa ceva āsavasampayuttassa ca dhammassa [V 3.0249] ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo – āsavasampayutte ceva no ca āsave khandhe ārabbha āsavā uppajjanti. (2)

Āsavasampayutto ceva no ca āsavo dhammo āsavassa ceva āsavasampayuttassa ca āsavasampayuttassa ceva no ca āsavassa ca dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo – āsavasampayutte ceva no ca āsave khandhe ārabbha āsavā ca āsavasampayuttakā ca khandhā uppajjanti. (3)

A state associated with taints but not itself a taint is a condition for a state that is both a taint and associated with taints, and for a state associated with taints but not itself a taint, by way of object condition. Taking as object aggregates associated with taints but not themselves taints, taints and aggregates associated with taints arise. (3)

Āsavo ceva āsavasampayutto ca āsavasampayutto ceva no ca āsavo ca dhammā āsavassa ceva āsavasampayuttassa ca dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo [T 3.0238]… tīṇi.

Adhipatipaccayā… (ārammaṇasadisā, garukārammaṇā) anantarapaccayā… (ārammaṇasadisāyeva, purimā purimāti kātabbā.) Samanantarapaccayā… sahajātapaccayā… aññamaññapaccayā… nissayapaccayā… upanissayapaccayā (ārammaṇasadisaṃyeva, vibhajanā natthi… tīṇi. Upanissayaṃ sabbaṃ kātabbaṃ).

Dominance Condition… (similar to object condition, with weighty objects). Immediate Condition… (just like the object condition, the preceding should be treated as preceding). Contiguity Condition… Co-nascence Condition… Mutuality Condition… Support Condition… Decisive Support Condition… (just like the object condition, no division… three. All of Decisive Support should be done).

1. A fetter phenomenon arises dependent on a fetter phenomenon, by root condition: dependent on the fetter of sensual desire, the fetter of views and the fetter of ignorance arise; dependent on the fetter of sensual desire, the fetter of clinging to rules and observances and the fetter of ignorance arise; dependent on the fetter of sensual desire, the fetter of conceit and the fetter of ignorance arise; dependent on the fetter of sensual desire, the fetter of ignorance arises; dependent on the fetter of aversion, the fetter of envy and the fetter of ignorance arise; dependent on the fetter of aversion, the fetter of stinginess and the fetter of ignorance arise; dependent on the fetter of aversion, the fetter of ignorance arises; dependent on the fetter of conceit, the fetter of craving for existence and the fetter of ignorance arise; dependent on the fetter of craving for existence, the fetter of ignorance arises; dependent on the fetter of doubt, the fetter of ignorance arises. (1)

Saññojanaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca nosaññojano dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – saññojane paṭicca sampayuttakā khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañca [T 3.0242] rūpaṃ. (2)

A non-fetter phenomenon arises dependent on a fetter phenomenon, by root condition: dependent on the fetters, the associated aggregates and mind-originated form arise. (2)

Saññojanaṃ [V 3.0255] dhammaṃ paṭicca saññojano ca nosaññojano ca dhammā uppajjanti hetupaccayā – kāmarāgasaññojanaṃ paṭicca diṭṭhisaññojanaṃ avijjāsaññojanaṃ sampayuttakā ca khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ (cakkaṃ bandhitabbaṃ). (3)

Both a fetter and a non-fetter phenomenon arise dependent on a fetter phenomenon, by root condition: dependent on the fetter of sensual desire, the fetter of views, the fetter of ignorance, the associated aggregates, and mind-originated form arise (the cycle should be linked). (3)

2. Nosaññojanaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca nosaññojano dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – nosaññojanaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca tayo khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ…pe… dve khandhe…pe… paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe… khandhe paṭicca vatthu, vatthuṃ paṭicca khandhā, ekaṃ mahābhūtaṃ…pe… mahābhūte paṭicca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ kaṭattārūpaṃ upādārūpaṃ. (1)

2. A non-fetter phenomenon arises dependent on a non-fetter phenomenon, by root condition—dependent on one non-fetter aggregate, three aggregates and mind-originated form arise; …and so on… dependent on two aggregates; …and so on… at the moment of rebirth-linking; …and so on… aggregates dependent on the base, the base dependent on aggregates, one great element; …and so on… dependent on the great elements, mind-originated form, kamma-originated form, and derived form arise. (1)

Nosaññojanaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca saññojano dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – nosaññojane khandhe paṭicca saññojanā. (2)

A fetter phenomenon arises dependent on a non-fetter phenomenon, by root condition—dependent on non-fetter aggregates, fetters arise. (2)

Nosaññojanaṃ [M 3.0210] dhammaṃ paṭicca saññojano ca nosaññojano ca dhammā uppajjanti hetupaccayā – nosaññojanaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca tayo khandhā saññojanā ca cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ…pe… dve khandhe…pe…. (3)

Both fetter and non-fetter phenomena arise dependent on a non-fetter phenomenon, by root condition—dependent on one non-fetter aggregate, three aggregates, fetters, and mind-originated form arise; …and so on… dependent on two aggregates; …and so on. (3)

3. Saññojanañca nosaññojanañca dhammaṃ paṭicca saññojano dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – kāmarāgasaññojanañca sampayuttake ca khandhe paṭicca diṭṭhisaññojanaṃ avijjāsaññojanaṃ (cakkaṃ bandhitabbaṃ). (1)

3. A fetter phenomenon arises dependent on both a fetter and a non-fetter phenomenon, by root condition—dependent on the fetter of sensual desire and the associated aggregates, the fetter of views and the fetter of ignorance arise (the cycle should be linked). (1)

Saññojanañca nosaññojanañca dhammaṃ paṭicca nosaññojano dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – nosaññojanaṃ ekaṃ khandhañca saññojane ca paṭicca tayo khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ…pe… dve khandhe ca…pe…. (2)

A non-fetter phenomenon arises dependent on both a fetter and a non-fetter phenomenon, by root condition—dependent on one non-fetter aggregate and the fetters, three aggregates and mind-originated form arise; …and so on… two aggregates; …and so on. (2)

Saññojanañca nosaññojanañca dhammaṃ paṭicca saññojano [T 3.0243] ca nosaññojano ca dhammā uppajjanti hetupaccayā – nosaññojanaṃ ekaṃ khandhañca kāmarāgasaññojanañca paṭicca tayo khandhā diṭṭhisaññojanaṃ avijjāsaññojanaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ…pe… (cakkaṃ bandhitabbaṃ). (3)

Both fetter and non-fetter phenomena arise dependent on both a fetter and a non-fetter phenomenon, by root condition—dependent on one non-fetter aggregate and the fetter of sensual desire, three aggregates, the fetter of views, the fetter of ignorance, and mind-originated form arise; …and so on… (the cycle should be linked). (3)

(Ārammaṇapaccaye [V 3.0256] rūpaṃ natthi. Adhipatipaccayo hetusadiso, vicikicchāsaññojanaṃ natthi.) Anantarapaccayā…pe… avigatapaccayā.

(In the object condition, form is absent. The dominance condition is similar to the root condition; the fetter of doubt is absent.) By the contiguity condition…and so on… by the non-disappearance condition.

(1)

A non-fetter-phenomenon conditions a non-fetter-phenomenon by way of root condition: one non-fetter aggregate conditions three aggregates and mind-originated materiality…pe… two aggregates…pe… at the moment of rebirth…pe… aggregates condition the base, the base conditions aggregates, one great primary element…pe… the great primary elements condition mind-originated materiality, kamma-produced materiality, derived materiality, the base conditions non-fetter aggregates. (1)

Nosaññojanaṃ [V 3.0259] dhammaṃ paccayā saññojano dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – nosaññojane [T 3.0245] khandhe paccayā saññojanā, vatthuṃ paccayā saññojanā. (2)

A non-fetter-phenomenon conditions a fetter-phenomenon by way of root condition: non-fetter aggregates condition fetters; the base conditions fetters. (2)

Nosaññojanaṃ dhammaṃ paccayā saññojano ca nosaññojano ca dhammā uppajjanti hetupaccayā – nosaññojanaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paccayā tayo khandhā saññojanañca cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ…pe… dve khandhe…pe… vatthuṃ paccayā saññojanā, mahābhūte paccayā cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ, vatthuṃ paccayā saññojanā sampayuttakā ca khandhā. (3)

A non-fetter-phenomenon conditions a fetter-phenomenon and a non-fetter-phenomenon by way of root condition: one non-fetter aggregate conditions three aggregates, fetters, and mind-originated materiality… two aggregates… the base conditions fetters; the great primary elements condition mind-originated materiality; the base conditions fetters and conjoined aggregates. (3)

11. Saññojanañca [M 3.0213] nosaññojanañca dhammaṃ paccayā saññojano dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – kāmarāgasaññojanañca sampayuttake ca khandhe paccayā diṭṭhisaññojanaṃ avijjāsaññojanaṃ, kāmarāgasaññojanañca vatthuñca paccayā diṭṭhisaññojanaṃ avijjāsaññojanaṃ (cakkaṃ) (1)

11. A fetter-phenomenon and a non-fetter-phenomenon condition a fetter-phenomenon by way of root condition: the fetter of sensual desire and its conjoined aggregates condition the fetter of views and the fetter of ignorance; the fetter of sensual desire and the base condition the fetter of views and the fetter of ignorance. (Cycle) (1)

Saññojanañca nosaññojanañca dhammaṃ paccayā nosaññojano dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – nosaññojanaṃ ekaṃ khandhañca saññojane ca paccayā tayo khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ…pe… dve khandhe…pe… (cakkaṃ). Saññojane ca vatthuñca paccayā nosaññojanā khandhā. (2)

A fetter-phenomenon and a non-fetter-phenomenon condition a non-fetter-phenomenon by way of root condition: one non-fetter aggregate and fetters condition three aggregates and mind-originated materiality… two aggregates… (cycle). Fetters and the base condition non-fetter aggregates. (2)

Saññojanañca nosaññojanañca dhammaṃ paccayā saññojano ca nosaññojano ca dhammā uppajjanti hetupaccayā – nosaññojanaṃ ekaṃ khandhañca kāmarāgasaññojanañca paccayā tayo khandhā diṭṭhisaññojanaṃ avijjāsaññojanaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ, dve khandhe…pe… (cakkaṃ). Kāmarāgasaññojanañca vatthuñca paccayā diṭṭhisaññojanaṃ avijjāsaññojanaṃ sampayuttakā ca khandhā (cakkaṃ. Saṃkhittaṃ). (3)

A fetter-phenomenon and a non-fetter-phenomenon condition a fetter-phenomenon and a non-fetter-phenomenon by way of root condition: one non-fetter aggregate and the fetter of sensual desire condition three aggregates, the fetter of views, the fetter of ignorance, and mind-originated materiality; two aggregates… (cycle). The fetter of sensual desire and the base condition the fetter of views, the fetter of ignorance, and conjoined aggregates (cycle. Summarized). (3)

12. Hetuyā [T 3.0246] nava, ārammaṇe nava (sabbattha nava), vipāke ekaṃ…pe… avigate nava.

12. Nine by way of root condition, nine by way of object condition (nine in all cases); one by way of result condition… nine by way of non-disappearance condition.

13. Nahetuyā [V 3.0260] cattāri (yattha yattha vatthu labbhati, tattha tattha ninnetabbaṃ), naārammaṇe tīṇi…pe… novigate tīṇi.

13. Four by way of non-root condition (wherever a base is found, there it should be applied); three by way of non-object condition… three by way of non-disappearance condition.

Object Condition

17. Saññojano dhammo saññojanassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo – saññojane ārabbha saññojanā uppajjanti. (Mūlaṃ kātabbaṃ) saññojane ārabbha nosaññojanā khandhā uppajjanti. (Mūlaṃ kātabbaṃ) saññojane ārabbha saññojanā ca sampayuttakā ca khandhā uppajjanti. (3)

Dependent on fetters, non-fetter aggregates arise. (The root should be done.) Dependent on fetters, both fetters and associated aggregates arise. (3)

18. Nosaññojano dhammo nosaññojanassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo – dānaṃ datvā sīlaṃ…pe… uposathakammaṃ katvā taṃ paccavekkhati, pubbe suciṇṇāni…pe… jhānā…pe… ariyā maggā vuṭṭhahitvā maggaṃ paccavekkhanti, phalaṃ…pe… nibbānaṃ paccavekkhanti, nibbānaṃ gotrabhussa, vodānassa, maggassa, phalassa, āvajjanāya ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo; ariyā nosaññojane pahīne kilese…pe… vikkhambhite kilese…pe… pubbe…pe… cakkhuṃ [M 3.0215]…pe… vatthuṃ nosaññojane khandhe aniccato…pe… domanassaṃ uppajjati; dibbena cakkhunā rūpaṃ passati, dibbāya sotadhātuyā saddaṃ suṇāti, cetopariyañāṇena nosaññojanacittasamaṅgissa cittaṃ jānāti, ākāsānañcāyatanaṃ viññāṇañcāyatanassa…pe… ākiñcaññāyatanaṃ nevasaññānāsaññāyatanassa…pe… rūpāyatanaṃ cakkhuviññāṇassa…pe… phoṭṭhabbāyatanaṃ kāyaviññāṇassa…pe… nosaññojanā khandhā [V 3.0262] iddhividhañāṇassa, cetopariyañāṇassa, pubbenivāsānussatiñāṇassa, yathākammūpagañāṇassa[T 3.0248], anāgataṃsañāṇassa, āvajjanāya ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo. (1)

18. A non-fetter-phenomenon is a condition for a non-fetter-phenomenon by way of object condition: having given alms, observed virtue... performed the Uposatha observance, one reflects upon that; having previously practiced... the jhānas... the noble ones, having arisen from the paths, reflect upon the path, the fruit... they reflect upon Nibbāna; Nibbāna is an object condition for the change-of-lineage, purification, path, fruit, and adverting. The noble ones reflect upon the defilements abandoned... the defilements suppressed... previously... the eye... the base. Regarding the non-fetter aggregates as impermanent... sorrow arises; with the divine eye, one sees forms; with the divine ear-element, one hears sounds; with mind-penetrating knowledge, one knows the mind of one endowed with a mind without fetters. The sphere of infinite space is a condition for the sphere of infinite consciousness... the sphere of nothingness is a condition for the sphere of neither-perception-nor-non-perception... the visible object base is a condition for eye-consciousness... the tangible object base is a condition for body-consciousness... the non-fetter aggregates are an object condition for the knowledge of psychic power, mind-penetrating knowledge, knowledge of past lives, knowledge of the destiny of beings according to their actions, knowledge of the future, and adverting. (1)

Nosaññojano dhammo saññojanassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo – dānaṃ…pe… sīlaṃ…pe… uposathakammaṃ…pe… pubbe…pe… jhānā…pe… cakkhuṃ…pe… vatthuṃ nosaññojane khandhe assādeti abhinandati, taṃ ārabbha rāgo uppajjati…pe… domanassaṃ uppajjati. (2)

A non-fettering phenomenon is a condition for a fettering phenomenon by way of object condition: giving... virtue... observance of the Uposatha... formerly... jhānas... the eye... the base. One delights in and approves of the non-fettering aggregates, and dependent on that, lust arises... sorrow arises. (2)

Nosaññojano dhammo saññojanassa ca nosaññojanassa ca dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo – dānaṃ datvā sīlaṃ…pe… uposathakammaṃ…pe… pubbe…pe… jhānā…pe… cakkhuṃ…pe… vatthuṃ nosaññojane khandhe assādeti abhinandati, taṃ ārabbha saññojanā ca saññojanasampayuttakā ca khandhā uppajjanti. (3)

A non-fettering phenomenon is a condition for a fettering phenomenon and a non-fettering phenomenon by way of object condition: having given alms, observed virtue... performed the Uposatha observance... previously... jhānas... the eye... the base. One delights in and approves of the non-fettering aggregates, and dependent on that, fetters and aggregates associated with fetters arise. (3)

Saññojano ca nosaññojano ca dhammā saññojanassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo… tīṇi (ārabbhayeva kātabbā).

A fettering phenomenon and a non-fettering phenomenon are conditions for a fettering phenomenon by way of object condition... three (to be elaborated only with respect to the object).

Adhipatipaccayo

Dominance Condition

19. Saññojano dhammo saññojanassa dhammassa adhipatipaccayena paccayo. Ārammaṇādhipati – saññojanaṃ garuṃ katvā…pe… tīṇi (garukārammaṇā).

19. A fettering phenomenon is a condition for a fettering phenomenon by way of dominance condition. Object-dominance: Having made a fetter weighty... three (weighty objects).

Nosaññojano dhammo nosaññojanassa dhammassa adhipatipaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇādhipati, sahajātādhipati. Ārammaṇādhipati – dānaṃ datvā sīlaṃ…pe… tīṇi (tiṇṇampi ārammaṇādhipati, sahajātādhipatipi kātabbā, vibhajitabbā tīṇipi).

A non-fettering phenomenon is a condition for a non-fettering phenomenon by way of dominance condition: object-dominance, co-nascence dominance. Object-dominance: having given alms, observed virtue... three (for all three, object-dominance and co-nascence dominance are to be elaborated, and all three are to be analyzed).

Saññojano [M 3.0216] ca nosaññojano ca dhammā saññojanassa dhammassa adhipatipaccayena paccayo. Ārammaṇādhipati – saññojane ca sampayuttake [T 3.0249] ca khandhe garuṃ katvā…pe… tīṇi.

A fettering phenomenon and a non-fettering phenomenon are conditions for a fettering phenomenon by way of dominance condition. Object-dominance: Having made the fetters and the associated aggregates weighty... three.

Anantarapaccayo

Immediate Condition

20. Saññojano [V 3.0263] dhammo saññojanassa dhammassa anantarapaccayena paccayo – purimā purimā saññojanā pacchimānaṃ pacchimānaṃ saññojanānaṃ anantarapaccayena paccayo… tīṇi.

20. A fettering phenomenon is a condition for a fettering phenomenon by way of immediate condition—preceding fettering phenomena are conditions for subsequent fettering phenomena by way of immediate condition… three.

Nosaññojano dhammo nosaññojanassa dhammassa anantarapaccayena paccayo – purimā purimā nosaññojanā khandhā pacchimānaṃ…pe… phalasamāpattiyā anantarapaccayena paccayo. (1)

A non-fettering phenomenon is a condition for a non-fettering phenomenon by way of immediate condition—the preceding non-fettering aggregates are conditions for the succeeding…etc.…attainment of fruition by way of immediate condition. (1)

Nosaññojano dhammo saññojanassa dhammassa anantarapaccayena paccayo – purimā purimā nosaññojanā khandhā pacchimānaṃ pacchimānaṃ saññojanānaṃ anantarapaccayena paccayo; āvajjanā saññojanānaṃ anantarapaccayena paccayo (evaṃ dvepi kātabbā). (3)

A non-fettering phenomenon is a condition for a fettering phenomenon by way of immediate condition—the preceding non-fettering aggregates are conditions for the subsequent fettering phenomena by way of immediate condition; adverting is a condition for the fettering phenomena by way of immediate condition (thus both are to be done). (3)

Saññojano ca nosaññojano ca dhammā saññojanassa dhammassa anantarapaccayena paccayo… tīṇi.

A fettering phenomenon and a non-fettering phenomenon are conditions for a fettering phenomenon by way of immediate condition… three.

Samanantarapaccayādi

Contiguity Condition, etc.

21. Saññojano dhammo saññojanassa dhammassa samanantarapaccayena paccayo… nava… sahajātapaccayena paccayo… nava… aññamaññapaccayena paccayo… nava… nissayapaccayena paccayo… nava.

21. A fettering phenomenon is a condition for a fettering phenomenon by way of contiguity condition… nine… co-nascence condition… nine… mutuality condition… nine… dependence condition… nine.

Upanissayapaccayo

Decisive Support Condition

22. Saññojano dhammo saññojanassa dhammassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇūpanissayo, anantarūpanissayo, pakatūpanissayo…pe…. Pakatūpanissayo – saññojanā saññojanānaṃ upanissayapaccayena paccayo (evaṃ tīṇipi).

22. A fettering phenomenon is a condition for a fettering phenomenon by way of decisive support condition: object decisive support, contiguous decisive support, natural decisive support…etc.… Natural decisive support: fetters are conditions for fetters by way of decisive support condition (thus all three are to be done).

23. Nosaññojano [M 3.0217] dhammo nosaññojanassa dhammassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇūpanissayo, anantarūpanissayo, pakatūpanissayo…pe…. Pakatūpanissayo – saddhaṃ upanissāya [V 3.0264] dānaṃ deti…pe… samāpattiṃ uppādeti[T 3.0250], mānaṃ jappeti, diṭṭhiṃ gaṇhāti; sīlaṃ…pe… paññaṃ, rāgaṃ…pe… patthanaṃ…pe… senāsanaṃ upanissāya dānaṃ deti…pe… saṅghaṃ bhindati; saddhā…pe… senāsanaṃ saddhāya…pe… phalasamāpattiyā upanissayapaccayena paccayo. (1)

23. A non-fettering phenomenon is a condition for a non-fettering phenomenon by way of decisive support condition—object decisive support, contiguous decisive support, natural decisive support…etc.… Natural decisive support—relying on faith, one gives alms…etc.…attains absorption, dwells on conceit, grasps a view; morality…etc.…wisdom, lust…etc.…aspiration…etc.…relying on a dwelling, one gives alms…etc.…splits the Saṅgha; faith…etc.…dwelling are conditions for faith…etc.…attainment of fruition by way of decisive support condition. (1)

Nosaññojano dhammo saññojanassa dhammassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇūpanissayo, anantarūpanissayo, pakatūpanissayo…pe…. Pakatūpanissayo – saddhaṃ upanissāya mānaṃ jappeti, diṭṭhiṃ gaṇhāti; sīlaṃ…pe… senāsanaṃ upanissāya pāṇaṃ hanati…pe… saṅghaṃ bhindati; saddhā…pe… senāsanaṃ rāgassa…pe… patthanāya upanissayapaccayena paccayo. (2)

A non-fettering phenomenon is a condition for a fettering phenomenon by way of decisive support condition—object decisive support, contiguous decisive support, natural decisive support…etc.… Natural decisive support—relying on faith, one dwells on conceit, grasps a view; morality…etc.…relying on a dwelling, one kills living beings…etc.…splits the Saṅgha; faith…etc.…dwelling are conditions for lust…etc.…aspiration by way of decisive support condition. (2)

Nosaññojano dhammo saññojanassa ca nosaññojanassa ca dhammassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇūpanissayo, anantarūpanissayo, pakatūpanissayo…pe…. Pakatūpanissayo – saddhaṃ upanissāya mānaṃ jappeti, diṭṭhiṃ gaṇhāti; sīlaṃ…pe… senāsanaṃ upanissāya pāṇaṃ hanati…pe… saṅghaṃ bhindati; saddhā…pe… senāsanaṃ saññojanānaṃ sampayuttakānañca khandhānaṃ upanissayapaccayena paccayo. (3)

A non-fettering phenomenon is a condition for both a fettering phenomenon and a non-fettering phenomenon by way of decisive support condition—object decisive support, contiguous decisive support, natural decisive support…etc.… Natural decisive support—relying on faith, one dwells on conceit, grasps a view; morality…etc.…relying on a dwelling, one kills living beings…etc.…splits the Saṅgha; faith…etc.…dwelling are conditions for the fetters and the associated aggregates by way of decisive support condition. (3)

Saññojano ca nosaññojano ca dhammā saññojanassa dhammassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo… tīṇi.

A fettering phenomenon and a non-fettering phenomenon are conditions for a fettering phenomenon by way of decisive support condition… three.

Purejātapaccayo

Pre-nascence Condition

24. Nosaññojano dhammo nosaññojanassa dhammassa purejātapaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇapurejātaṃ, vatthupurejātaṃ. Ārammaṇapurejātaṃ – cakkhuṃ…pe… vatthuṃ aniccato…pe… domanassaṃ uppajjati; dibbena [T 3.0251] cakkhunā rūpaṃ passati, dibbāya sotadhātuyā saddaṃ suṇāti, rūpāyatanaṃ cakkhuviññāṇassa…pe… phoṭṭhabbāyatanaṃ kāyaviññāṇassa…pe…. Vatthupurejātaṃ – cakkhāyatanaṃ cakkhuviññāṇassa…pe… kāyāyatanaṃ kāyaviññāṇassa…pe… vatthu nosaññojanānaṃ khandhānaṃ purejātapaccayena paccayo. (1)

24. A non-fettering phenomenon is a condition for a non-fettering phenomenon by way of pre-nascence condition: object pre-nascence, base pre-nascence. Object pre-nascence: the eye…etc.…regarding the object as impermanent…etc.…sorrow arises; with the divine eye, one sees form; with the divine ear element, one hears sound; the form sense-base for eye-consciousness…etc.…the tangible sense-base for body-consciousness…etc.… Base pre-nascence: the eye sense-base for eye-consciousness…etc.…the body sense-base for body-consciousness…etc.…the base is a condition for non-fettering aggregates by way of pre-nascence condition. (1)

Nosaññojano [M 3.0218][V 3.0265] dhammo saññojanassa dhammassa purejātapaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇapurejātaṃ, vatthupurejātaṃ. Ārammaṇapurejātaṃ – cakkhuṃ…pe… vatthuṃ assādeti abhinandati, taṃ ārabbha rāgo uppajjati…pe… domanassaṃ uppajjati. Vatthupurejātaṃ – vatthu saññojanānaṃ purejātapaccayena paccayo. (2)

A non-fetter phenomenon is a condition for a fettering phenomenon by way of pre-nascence condition—object-prenascence, base-prenascence. Object-prenascence—the eye…and so on…one savors and delights in the physical base; taking it as object, lust arises…and so on…displeasure arises. Base-prenascence—the physical base is a condition for the fetters by way of pre-nascence condition. (2)

Nosaññojano dhammo saññojanassa ca nosaññojanassa ca dhammassa purejātapaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇapurejātaṃ, vatthupurejātaṃ. Ārammaṇapurejātaṃ – cakkhuṃ…pe… vatthuṃ assādeti, abhinandati, taṃ ārabbha saññojanā ca sampayuttakā ca khandhā uppajjanti. Vatthupurejātaṃ – vatthu saññojanānaṃ sampayuttakānañca khandhānaṃ purejātapaccayena paccayo. (3)

A non-fetter phenomenon is a condition for both a fettering phenomenon and a non-fettering phenomenon by way of pre-nascence condition—object-prenascence, base-prenascence. Object-prenascence—the eye…and so on…one savors and delights in the physical base; based on that, fetters and the associated aggregates arise. Base-prenascence—the physical base is a condition for the fetters and the associated aggregates by way of pre-nascence condition. (3)

Pacchājātapaccayo

Post-nascence Condition

25. Saññojano dhammo nosaññojanassa dhammassa pacchājātapaccayena paccayo… ekaṃ.

25. A fettering phenomenon is a condition for a non-fettering phenomenon by way of the Post-nascence Condition… one.

Nosaññojano dhammo nosaññojanassa dhammassa pacchājātapaccayena paccayo…pe…. (1)

A non-fettering phenomenon is a condition for a non-fettering phenomenon by way of the Post-nascence Condition…. (1)

Saññojano ca nosaññojano ca dhammā nosaññojanassa dhammassa pacchājātapaccayena paccayo…pe…. (1)

Fettering and non-fettering phenomena are conditions for a non-fettering phenomenon by way of the Post-nascence Condition…. (1)

Āsevanapaccayo

Repetition Condition

26. Saññojano [T 3.0252] dhammo saññojanassa dhammassa āsevanapaccayena paccayo… nava.

26. A fettering phenomenon is a condition for a fettering phenomenon by way of the Repetition Condition… nine.

Kammapaccayādi

Kamma Condition, and so on

27. Nosaññojano dhammo nosaññojanassa dhammassa kammapaccayena paccayo… tīṇi… vipākapaccayena paccayo… ekaṃ… āhārapaccayena paccayo… tīṇi… indriyapaccayena paccayo… tīṇi… jhānapaccayena paccayo… tīṇi… maggapaccayena paccayo… nava… sampayuttapaccayena paccayo… nava.

27. A non-fettering phenomenon is a condition for a non-fettering phenomenon by way of the Kamma Condition… three… by way of the Result Condition… one… by way of the Nutriment Condition… three… by way of the Faculty Condition… three… by way of the Jhāna Condition… three… by way of the Path Condition… nine… by way of the Association Condition… nine.

Vippayuttapaccayo

Dissociation Condition

28. Saññojano [M 3.0219][V 3.0266] dhammo nosaññojanassa dhammassa vippayuttapaccayena paccayo – sahajātaṃ, pacchājātaṃ (vibhajitabbaṃ). (1)

28. A fettering phenomenon is a condition for a non-fettering phenomenon by way of the Dissociation Condition: co-nascence, post-nascence (to be analyzed). (1)

Nosaññojano dhammo nosaññojanassa dhammassa vippayuttapaccayena paccayo – sahajātaṃ, purejātaṃ, pacchājātaṃ (vibhajitabbaṃ). (1)

A non-fettering phenomenon is a condition for a non-fettering phenomenon by way of the Dissociation Condition: co-nascence, pre-nascence, post-nascence (to be analyzed). (1)

Nosaññojano dhammo saññojanassa dhammassa vippayuttapaccayena paccayo. Purejātaṃ – vatthu saññojanānaṃ vippayuttapaccayena paccayo. (2)

A non-fettering phenomenon is a condition for a fettering phenomenon by way of the Dissociation Condition. Pre-nascence: The physical base is a condition for the fetters by way of the Dissociation Condition. (2)

Nosaññojano dhammo saññojanassa ca nosaññojanassa ca dhammassa vippayuttapaccayena paccayo. Purejātaṃ – vatthu saññojanānaṃ sampayuttakānañca khandhānaṃ vippayuttapaccayena paccayo. (3)

A non-fettering phenomenon is a condition for fettering and non-fettering phenomena by way of the Dissociation Condition. Pre-nascence: The physical base is a condition for the fetters and the associated aggregates by way of the Dissociation Condition. (3)

Saññojano ca nosaññojano ca dhammā nosaññojanassa dhammassa vippayuttapaccayena paccayo – sahajātaṃ, pacchājātaṃ (vibhajitabbaṃ). (1)

Fettering and non-fettering phenomena are conditions for a non-fettering phenomenon by way of the Dissociation Condition: co-nascence, post-nascence (to be analyzed). (1)

Atthipaccayo

Presence Condition

29. Saññojano dhammo saññojanassa dhammassa atthipaccayena paccayo… ekaṃ (paṭiccasadisaṃ). (1)

29. A fettering phenomenon is a condition for a fettering phenomenon by way of the Presence Condition… one (similar to dependent origination). (1)

Saññojano dhammo nosaññojanassa dhammassa [T 3.0253] atthipaccayena paccayo – sahajātaṃ, pacchājātaṃ (saṃkhittaṃ). (2)

A fettering phenomenon is a condition for a non-fettering phenomenon by way of the Presence Condition: co-nascence, post-nascence (in brief). (2)

Saññojano dhammo saññojanassa ca nosaññojanassa ca dhammassa atthipaccayena paccayo (paṭiccasadisaṃ). (3)

A fettering phenomenon is a condition for fettering and non-fettering phenomena by way of the Presence Condition (similar to dependent origination). (3)

30. Nosaññojano [V 3.0267] dhammo nosaññojanassa dhammassa atthipaccayena paccayo – sahajātaṃ, purejātaṃ, pacchājātaṃ, āhāraṃ, indriyaṃ (saṃkhittaṃ). (1)

30. A non-fettering phenomenon is a condition for a non-fettering phenomenon by way of the Presence Condition: co-nascence, pre-nascence, post-nascence, nutriment, faculty (in brief). (1)

Nosaññojano dhammo saññojanassa dhammassa atthipaccayena paccayo – sahajātaṃ, purejātaṃ. Sahajātā – nosaññojanā khandhā sampayuttakānaṃ saññojanānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo. Purejātaṃ – cakkhuṃ…pe… vatthuṃ assādeti abhinandati, taṃ ārabbha rāgo uppajjati…pe… domanassaṃ uppajjati, vatthu saññojanānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo. (2)

A non-fettering phenomenon is a condition for a fettering phenomenon by way of the Presence Condition: co-nascence, pre-nascence. Co-nascence: The non-fettering aggregates are a condition for the associated fetters by way of the Presence Condition. Pre-nascence: The eye…and so on…one savors and delights in the physical base; based on that, lust arises…and so on…displeasure arises; the physical base is a condition for the fetters by way of the Presence Condition. (2)

Nosaññojano [M 3.0220] dhammo saññojanassa ca nosaññojanassa ca dhammassa atthipaccayena paccayo – sahajātaṃ, purejātaṃ. Sahajāto – nosaññojano…pe… (saṃkhittaṃ, āsavasadisaṃ). (3)

A non-fettering phenomenon is a condition for fettering and non-fettering phenomena by way of the Presence Condition: co-nascence, pre-nascence. Co-nascence: A non-fettering phenomenon… (in brief, similar to the taints). (3)

31. Saññojano ca nosaññojano ca dhammā saññojanassa dhammassa atthipaccayena paccayo – sahajātaṃ, purejātaṃ (āsavasadisaṃ). (1)

31. Fettering and non-fettering phenomena are conditions for a fettering phenomenon by way of the Presence Condition: co-nascence, pre-nascence (similar to the taints). (1)

Saññojano ca nosaññojano ca dhammā nosaññojanassa dhammassa atthipaccayena paccayo – sahajātaṃ, purejātaṃ, pacchājātaṃ, āhāraṃ, indriyaṃ (vibhajitabbaṃ āsavasadisaṃ). (2)

Fettering and non-fettering phenomena are conditions for a non-fettering phenomenon by way of the Presence Condition: co-nascence, pre-nascence, post-nascence, nutriment, faculty (to be analyzed, similar to the taints). (2)

Saññojano ca nosaññojano ca dhammā saññojanassa ca nosaññojanassa ca dhammassa atthipaccayena paccayo – sahajātaṃ, purejātaṃ (vibhajitabbaṃ āsavasadisaṃ). (3)

Fettering and non-fettering phenomena are conditions for fettering and non-fettering phenomena by way of the Presence Condition: co-nascence, pre-nascence (to be analyzed, similar to the taints). (3)

Suddhaṃ

Pure

32. Hetuyā [T 3.0254] cattāri, ārammaṇe nava, adhipatiyā nava, anantare nava, samanantare nava, sahajāte nava, aññamaññe nava, nissaye nava, upanissaye nava, purejāte tīṇi, pacchājāte [V 3.0268] tīṇi, āsevane nava, kamme tīṇi, vipāke ekaṃ, āhāre tīṇi, indriye tīṇi, jhāne tīṇi, magge nava, sampayutte nava, vippayutte pañca, atthiyā nava, natthiyā nava, vigate nava, avigate nava.

32. By way of the Root Condition, four; by way of the Object Condition, nine; by way of the Predominance Condition, nine; by way of the Contiguity Condition, nine; by way of the Immediate Contiguity Condition, nine; by way of the Co-nascence Condition, nine; by way of the Mutuality Condition, nine; by way of the Support Condition, nine; by way of the Decisive Support Condition, nine; by way of the Pre-nascence Condition, three; by way of the Post-nascence Condition, three; by way of the Repetition Condition, nine; by way of the Kamma Condition, three; by way of the Result Condition, one; by way of the Nutriment Condition, three; by way of the Faculty Condition, three; by way of the Jhāna Condition, three; by way of the Path Condition, nine; by way of the Association Condition, nine; by way of the Dissociation Condition, five; by way of the Presence Condition, nine; by way of the Absence Condition, nine; by way of the Disappearance Condition, nine; by way of the Non-disappearance Condition, nine.

Anulomaṃ.

The Direct Order.

Paccanīyuddhāro

The Section on the Negative

33. Saññojano dhammo saññojanassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo… sahajātapaccayena paccayo… upanissayapaccayena paccayo. (1)

33. A fetter-phenomenon is a condition for a fetter-phenomenon by object condition... by co-nascence condition... by strong support condition. (1)

Saññojano dhammo nosaññojanassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo… sahajātapaccayena paccayo… upanissayapaccayena paccayo… pacchājātapaccayena paccayo. (2)

A fetter-phenomenon is a condition for a non-fetter-phenomenon by object condition... by co-nascence condition... by strong support condition... by post-nascence condition. (2)

Saññojano [M 3.0221] dhammo saññojanassa ca nosaññojanassa ca dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo… sahajātapaccayena paccayo… upanissayapaccayena paccayo. (3)

A fetter-phenomenon is a condition for a fetter-phenomenon and a non-fetter-phenomenon by object condition... by co-nascence condition... by strong support condition. (3)

34. Nosaññojano dhammo nosaññojanassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo… sahajātapaccayena paccayo… upanissayapaccayena paccayo… purejātapaccayena paccayo… pacchājātapaccayena paccayo… kammapaccayena paccayo… āhārapaccayena paccayo… indriyapaccayena paccayo. (1)

34. A non-fetter-phenomenon is a condition for a non-fetter-phenomenon by object condition... by co-nascence condition... by strong support condition... by pre-nascence condition... by post-nascence condition... by kamma condition... by nutriment condition... by faculty condition. (1)

Nosaññojano dhammo saññojanassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo… sahajātapaccayena [T 3.0255] paccayo… upanissayapaccayena paccayo… purejātapaccayena paccayo. (2)

A non-fetter-phenomenon is a condition for a fetter-phenomenon by object condition... by co-nascence condition... by strong support condition... by pre-nascence condition. (2)

Nosaññojano dhammo saññojanassa ca nosaññojanassa ca dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo [V 3.0269]… sahajātapaccayena paccayo… upanissayapaccayena paccayo… purejātapaccayena paccayo. (3)

A non-fetter-phenomenon is a condition for both a fetter-phenomenon and a non-fetter-phenomenon by object condition... by co-nascence condition... by strong support condition... by pre-nascence condition. (3)

35. Saññojano ca nosaññojano ca dhammā saññojanassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo… sahajātapaccayena paccayo… upanissayapaccayena paccayo. (1)

35. A fetter-phenomenon and a non-fetter-phenomenon are conditions for a fetter-phenomenon by object condition... by co-nascence condition... by strong support condition. (1)

Saññojanavippayuttaṃ dhammaṃ paccayā saññojanasampayutto dhammo uppajjati ārammaṇapaccayā – vatthuṃ paccayā saññojanasampayuttakā khandhā, uddhaccasahagataṃ mohaṃ paccayā sampayuttakā khandhā. (2)

Saññojanavippayuttaṃ [V 3.0279] dhammaṃ paccayā saññojanasampayutto ca saññojanavippayutto ca dhammā uppajjanti ārammaṇapaccayā – vatthuṃ paccayā uddhaccasahagatā khandhā ca moho ca. (3)

A state dissociated from fetters conditions a state associated with fetters and a state dissociated from fetters to arise by way of object condition: the base conditions aggregates accompanied by restlessness and delusion. (3)

54. Saññojanasampayuttañca saññojanavippayuttañca dhammaṃ paccayā saññojanasampayutto dhammo uppajjati ārammaṇapaccayā – saññojanasampayuttaṃ ekaṃ khandhañca vatthuñca paccayā tayo khandhā…pe… dve khandhe…pe… uddhaccasahagataṃ ekaṃ khandhañca mohañca paccayā tayo khandhā…pe… dve khandhe…pe…. (1)

54. A state associated with fetters and a state dissociated from fetters condition a state associated with fetters to arise by way of object condition: one aggregate associated with fetters and the base condition the three aggregates…pe… two aggregates…pe…; one aggregate accompanied by restlessness and delusion condition the three aggregates…pe… two aggregates…pe…. (1)

Saññojanasampayuttañca saññojanavippayuttañca dhammaṃ paccayā saññojanavippayutto dhammo uppajjati ārammaṇapaccayā – uddhaccasahagate [T 3.0263] khandhe ca vatthuñca paccayā uddhaccasahagato moho. (2)

A state associated with fetters and a state dissociated from fetters condition a state dissociated from fetters to arise by way of object condition: aggregates accompanied by restlessness and the base condition delusion accompanied by restlessness. (2)

Saññojanasampayuttañca saññojanavippayuttañca dhammaṃ paccayā saññojanasampayutto ca saññojanavippayutto ca dhammā uppajjanti ārammaṇapaccayā – uddhaccasahagataṃ ekaṃ khandhañca vatthuñca paccayā tayo khandhā moho ca…pe… dve khandhe…pe…. (3)

A state associated with fetters and a state dissociated from fetters condition a state associated with fetters and a state dissociated from fetters to arise by way of object condition: one aggregate accompanied by restlessness and the base condition the three aggregates and delusion…pe… two aggregates…pe…. (3)

Predominance Condition, etc.

55. Saññojanasampayuttaṃ dhammaṃ paccayā saññojanasampayutto dhammo uppajjati adhipatipaccayā…pe… avigatapaccayā…pe….

55. A state associated with fetters arises in dependence on a state associated with fetters by way of predominance condition…pe… by way of non-disappearance condition…pe….

57. Saññojanasampayuttaṃ [M 3.0229][V 3.0280] dhammaṃ paccayā saññojanasampayutto dhammo uppajjati nahetupaccayā – vicikicchāsahagate khandhe paccayā vicikicchāsahagato moho. (1)

57. A state associated with fetters arises in dependence on a state associated with fetters by way of not-root condition: aggregates accompanied by doubt are a condition for delusion accompanied by doubt. (1)

Saññojanasampayuttaṃ dhammaṃ paccayā saññojanavippayutto dhammo uppajjati nahetupaccayā – uddhaccasahagate khandhe paccayā uddhaccasahagato moho. (2)

A state dissociated from fetters arises in dependence on a state associated with fetters by way of not-root condition: aggregates accompanied by restlessness are a condition for delusion accompanied by restlessness. (2)

58. Saññojanavippayuttaṃ dhammaṃ paccayā saññojanavippayutto dhammo uppajjati nahetupaccayā – ahetukaṃ saññojanavippayuttaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ…pe… (yāva asaññasattā), cakkhāyatanaṃ paccayā cakkhuviññāṇaṃ…pe… kāyāyatanaṃ paccayā kāyaviññāṇaṃ, vatthuṃ paccayā ahetukā saññojanavippayuttā khandhā ca uddhaccasahagato moho ca. (1)

58. A state dissociated from fetters arises in dependence on a state dissociated from fetters by way of not-root condition: one rootless aggregate dissociated from fetters…pe… (up to non-percipient beings); the eye-base is a condition for eye-consciousness…pe… the body-base is a condition for body-consciousness; the base is a condition for rootless aggregates dissociated from fetters and for delusion accompanied by restlessness. (1)

Saññojanavippayuttaṃ dhammaṃ paccayā saññojanasampayutto dhammo uppajjati nahetupaccayā – vatthuṃ [T 3.0264] paccayā vicikicchāsahagato moho. (2)

A state associated with fetters arises in dependence on a state dissociated from fetters by way of not-root condition: the base is a condition for delusion accompanied by doubt. (2)

59. Saññojanasampayuttañca saññojanavippayuttañca dhammaṃ paccayā saññojanasampayutto dhammo uppajjati nahetupaccayā – vicikicchāsahagate khandhe ca vatthuñca paccayā vicikicchāsahagato moho. (1)

59. A state associated with fetters arises in dependence on a state associated with fetters and a state dissociated from fetters by way of not-root condition: aggregates accompanied by doubt and the base are a condition for delusion accompanied by doubt. (1)

Saññojanasampayuttañca saññojanavippayuttañca dhammaṃ paccayā saññojanavippayutto dhammo uppajjati nahetupaccayā – uddhaccasahagate khandhe ca vatthuñca paccayā uddhaccasahagato moho (saṃkhittaṃ). (2)

A state dissociated from fetters arises in dependence on a state associated with fetters and a state dissociated from fetters by way of not-root condition: aggregates accompanied by restlessness and the base are a condition for delusion accompanied by restlessness (abbreviated). (2)

63. Saññojanasampayuttaṃ [V 3.0282] dhammaṃ saṃsaṭṭho saññojanasampayutto dhammo [T 3.0265] uppajjati hetupaccayā – saññojanasampayuttaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ saṃsaṭṭhā tayo khandhā…pe… dve khandhe…pe….(1)

63. Concomitant with a state associated with fetters, a state associated with fetters arises by way of root condition. Concomitant with one aggregate associated with fetters, three aggregates… two aggregates… (1)

Saññojanavippayuttaṃ dhammaṃ saṃsaṭṭho saññojanavippayutto dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – saññojanavippayuttaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ saṃsaṭṭhā tayo khandhā…pe… dve khandhe…pe… paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe…. (1)

Concomitant with a state dissociated from fetters, a state dissociated from fetters arises by way of root condition. Concomitant with one aggregate dissociated from fetters, three aggregates… two aggregates… at the moment of rebirth-linking… (1)

Saññojanavippayuttaṃ dhammaṃ saṃsaṭṭho saññojanasampayutto dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – uddhaccasahagataṃ mohaṃ saṃsaṭṭhā sampayuttakā khandhā. (2)

A state associated with fetters arises concomitantly with a state dissociated from fetters by way of root condition. For example, concomitant with delusion accompanied by restlessness, the associated aggregates arise. (2)

Saññojanasampayuttañca [M 3.0231] saññojanavippayuttañca dhammaṃ saṃsaṭṭho saññojanasampayutto dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – uddhaccasahagataṃ ekaṃ khandhañca mohañca saṃsaṭṭhā tayo khandhā…pe… dve khandhe…pe…. (1) (Saṃkhittaṃ.)

A state associated with fetters arises concomitantly with both a state associated with fetters and a state dissociated from fetters by way of root condition. For example, concomitant with one aggregate accompanied by restlessness and with delusion, three aggregates arise… with two aggregates… (1) (Abbreviated.)

64. Hetuyā cattāri, ārammaṇe cha, adhipatiyā dve, anantare cha, samanantare cha…pe… avigate cha.

64. By way of root condition, four; by way of object condition, six; by way of predominance condition, two; by way of contiguity condition, six; by way of immediate contiguity condition, six… by way of non-disappearance condition, six.

65. Nahetuyā tīṇi, naadhipatiyā cha, napurejāte cha, napacchājāte cha, naāsevane cha, nakamme cattāri, navipāke cha, najhāne ekaṃ, namagge ekaṃ, navippayutte cha.

65. By way of not-root condition, three; by way of not-predominance condition, six; by way of not-prenascence condition, six; by way of not-postnascence condition, six; by way of not-repetition condition, six; by way of not-kamma condition, four; by way of not-result condition, six; by way of not-jhāna condition, one; by way of not-path condition, one; by way of not-dissociation condition, six.
