Hetupaccayo

The Root Condition

66. Saññojanasampayutto [V 3.0283] dhammo saññojanasampayuttassa dhammassa hetupaccayena paccayo – saññojanasampayuttā hetū sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ hetupaccayena paccayo. (1)

66. A phenomenon associated with fetters is a condition for a phenomenon associated with fetters by way of root condition. Roots associated with fetters are a condition for the associated aggregates by way of root condition. (1)

Saññojanasampayutto dhammo [T 3.0266] saññojanavippayuttassa dhammassa hetupaccayena paccayo – saññojanasampayuttā hetū cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ hetupaccayena paccayo. (2)

A phenomenon associated with fetters is a condition for a phenomenon dissociated from fetters by way of root condition. Roots associated with fetters are a condition for mind-originated material form by way of root condition. (2)

Saññojanasampayutto dhammo saññojanasampayuttassa ca saññojanavippayuttassa ca dhammassa hetupaccayena paccayo – saññojanasampayuttā hetū sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ hetupaccayena paccayo. (3)

A phenomenon associated with fetters is a condition for a phenomenon associated with fetters and for a phenomenon dissociated from fetters by way of root condition. Roots associated with fetters are a condition for the associated aggregates and for mind-originated material form by way of root condition. (3)

67. Saññojanavippayutto dhammo saññojanavippayuttassa dhammassa hetupaccayena paccayo – saññojanavippayuttā hetū sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ hetupaccayena paccayo, uddhaccasahagato moho [M 3.0232] cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ hetupaccayena paccayo; paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe…. (1)

67. A phenomenon dissociated from fetters is a condition for a phenomenon dissociated from fetters by way of root condition. Roots dissociated from fetters are a condition for the associated aggregates and for mind-originated material form by way of root condition. Delusion accompanied by restlessness is a condition for mind-originated material form by way of root condition. At the moment of rebirth-linking… (1)

Saññojanavippayutto dhammo saññojanasampayuttassa dhammassa hetupaccayena paccayo – uddhaccasahagato moho sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ hetupaccayena paccayo. (2)

A phenomenon dissociated from fetters is a condition for a phenomenon associated with fetters by way of root condition. Delusion accompanied by restlessness is a condition for the associated aggregates by way of root condition. (2)

Saññojanavippayutto dhammo saññojanasampayuttassa ca saññojanavippayuttassa ca dhammassa hetupaccayena paccayo – uddhaccasahagato moho sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ hetupaccayena paccayo. (3)

A phenomenon dissociated from fetters is a condition for a phenomenon associated with fetters and for a phenomenon dissociated from fetters by way of root condition. Delusion accompanied by restlessness is a condition for the associated aggregates and for mind-originated material form by way of root condition. (3)

Ārammaṇapaccayo

The Object Condition

68. Saññojanasampayutto [V 3.0284] dhammo saññojanasampayuttassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo – saññojanasampayutte khandhe ārabbha saññojanasampayuttakā khandhā uppajjanti. (Mūlaṃ kātabbaṃ) saññojanasampayutte khandhe ārabbha saññojanavippayuttā khandhā ca moho [T 3.0267] ca uppajjanti. (Mūlaṃ kātabbaṃ) saññojanasampayutte khandhe ārabbha uddhaccasahagatā khandhā ca moho ca uppajjanti. (3)

68. A phenomenon associated with fetters is a condition for a phenomenon associated with fetters by way of object condition. Dependent on aggregates associated with fetters, aggregates associated with fetters arise. (The root should be done.) Dependent on aggregates associated with fetters, aggregates dissociated from fetters and delusion arise. (The root should be done.) Dependent on aggregates associated with fetters, aggregates accompanied by restlessness and delusion arise. (3)

69. Saññojanavippayutto dhammo saññojanavippayuttassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo – dānaṃ datvā sīlaṃ…pe… uposathakammaṃ katvā taṃ paccavekkhati, pubbe suciṇṇāni…pe… jhānā…pe… ariyā maggā vuṭṭhahitvā maggaṃ paccavekkhanti, phalaṃ paccavekkhanti, nibbānaṃ paccavekkhanti, nibbānaṃ gotrabhussa, vodānassa, maggassa, phalassa, āvajjanāya ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo; ariyā saññojanavippayutte pahīne kilese paccavekkhanti, vikkhambhite kilese paccavekkhanti, pubbe samudāciṇṇe kilese jānanti, cakkhuṃ…pe… vatthuṃ saññojanavippayutte khandhe ca mohañca aniccato…pe… vipassati…pe… dibbena cakkhunā rūpaṃ passati, dibbāya sotadhātuyā saddaṃ suṇāti, cetopariyañāṇena saññojanavippayuttacittasamaṅgissa cittaṃ jānāti, ākāsānañcāyatanaṃ viññāṇañcāyatanassa…pe… rūpāyatanaṃ…pe… phoṭṭhabbāyatanaṃ…pe… saññojanavippayuttā khandhā iddhividhañāṇassa, cetopariyañāṇassa, pubbenivāsānussatiñāṇassa, yathākammūpagañāṇassa, anāgataṃsañāṇassa[M 3.0233], āvajjanāya mohassa ca ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo. (1)

69. A phenomenon dissociated from fetters is a condition for a phenomenon dissociated from fetters by way of object condition. Having given alms, observed morality… performed the Uposatha observance, one reflects upon it. Having previously practiced… jhānas… arisen from the noble paths, one reflects upon the path, reflects upon the fruit, reflects upon Nibbāna. Nibbāna is a condition by way of object condition for lineage-consciousness, purification, path, fruit, and advertence. The noble ones reflect upon the abandoned defilements dissociated from fetters, reflect upon the suppressed defilements, and know the previously accumulated defilements. The eye… the base—the aggregates dissociated from fetters and delusion—are seen as impermanent… one discerns… with the divine eye, one sees forms; with the divine ear element, one hears sounds; with mind-penetrating knowledge, one knows the mind of one endowed with a mind dissociated from fetters. The base of boundless space… the base of boundless consciousness… the form base… the tangible base… the aggregates dissociated from fetters are a condition by way of object condition for the knowledge of psychic power, mind-penetrating knowledge, knowledge of past lives, knowledge of the destiny of beings according to their actions, knowledge of the future, and for advertence and delusion. (1)

Saññojanavippayutto dhammo saññojanasampayuttassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo – dānaṃ datvā sīlaṃ…pe… uposathakammaṃ…pe… pubbe suciṇṇāni…pe… jhānā vuṭṭhahitvā [T 3.0268] jhānaṃ…pe… cakkhuṃ…pe… vatthuṃ saññojanavippayutte khandhe ca mohañca assādeti abhinandati, taṃ ārabbha rāgo uppajjati…pe… domanassaṃ uppajjati. (2)

A phenomenon dissociated from fetters is a condition for a phenomenon associated with fetters by way of object condition. Having given alms, observed morality… (and so on) …performed the Uposatha observance… (and so on) …things previously well-done… (and so on) …having arisen from jhāna, one reflects upon the jhāna… (and so on) …the eye… (and so on) …the base—one savors and rejoices in the aggregates dissociated from fetters and in delusion. Dependent on that, lust arises… (and so on) …grief arises. (2)

Saññojanavippayutto dhammo saññojanasampayuttassa ca saññojanavippayuttassa ca dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena [V 3.0285] paccayo – cakkhuṃ…pe… vatthuṃ saññojanavippayutte khandhe ca mohañca ārabbha uddhaccasahagatā khandhā ca moho ca uppajjanti. (3)

A phenomenon dissociated from fetters is a condition for a phenomenon associated with fetters and for a phenomenon dissociated from fetters by way of object condition. The eye… (and so on) …the base—dependent on the aggregates dissociated from fetters and delusion, aggregates accompanied by restlessness and delusion arise. (3)

70. Saññojanasampayutto ca saññojanavippayutto ca dhammā saññojanasampayuttassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo – uddhaccasahagate khandhe ca mohañca ārabbha saññojanasampayuttakā khandhā uppajjanti. (Mūlaṃ kātabbaṃ) uddhaccasahagate khandhe ca mohañca ārabbha saññojanavippayuttā khandhā ca moho ca uppajjanti. (Mūlaṃ kātabbaṃ) uddhaccasahagate khandhe ca mohañca ārabbha uddhaccasahagatā khandhā ca moho ca uppajjanti. (3)

70. Phenomena both associated with fetters and dissociated from fetters are a condition for a phenomenon associated with fetters by way of object condition. Dependent on the aggregates accompanied by restlessness and delusion, aggregates associated with fetters arise. (The root should be done.) Dependent on the aggregates accompanied by restlessness and delusion, aggregates dissociated from fetters and delusion arise. (The root should be done.) Dependent on the aggregates accompanied by restlessness and delusion, aggregates accompanied by restlessness and delusion arise. (3)

Adhipatipaccayo

Dominance Condition

71. Saññojanasampayutto dhammo saññojanasampayuttassa dhammassa adhipatipaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇādhipati, sahajātādhipati. Ārammaṇādhipati – rāgaṃ…pe… diṭṭhiṃ garuṃ katvā assādeti abhinandati, taṃ garuṃ katvā rāgo uppajjati, diṭṭhi uppajjati. Sahajātādhipati – saññojanasampayuttādhipati sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ adhipatipaccayena paccayo. (1)

71. A phenomenon associated with fetters is a condition for a phenomenon associated with fetters by way of the dominance condition—object dominance, conascence dominance. Object dominance: making lust… (and so on) …and wrong view weighty, one savors and delights in it; making that weighty, lust arises, wrong view arises. Conascence dominance: a dominant phenomenon associated with fetters is a condition for its associated aggregates by way of the dominance condition. (1)

Saññojanasampayutto dhammo saññojanavippayuttassa dhammassa adhipatipaccayena paccayo. Sahajātādhipati – saññojanasampayuttādhipati [T 3.0269] cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ adhipatipaccayena paccayo. (2)

A phenomenon associated with fetters is a condition for a phenomenon dissociated from fetters by way of the dominance condition. Conascence dominance: a dominant phenomenon associated with fetters is a condition for mind-originated material phenomena by way of the dominance condition. (2)

Saññojanasampayutto [M 3.0234] dhammo saññojanasampayuttassa ca saññojanavippayuttassa ca dhammassa adhipatipaccayena paccayo. Sahajātādhipati – saññojanasampayuttādhipati sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ adhipatipaccayena paccayo. (3)

A phenomenon associated with fetters is a condition for a phenomenon associated with fetters and a phenomenon dissociated from fetters by way of the dominance condition. Conascence dominance: a dominant phenomenon associated with fetters is a condition for its associated aggregates and mind-originated material phenomena by way of the dominance condition. (3)

72. Saññojanavippayutto dhammo saññojanavippayuttassa dhammassa adhipatipaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇādhipati, sahajātādhipati. Ārammaṇādhipati – dānaṃ datvā sīlaṃ…pe… uposathakammaṃ katvā taṃ garuṃ katvā paccavekkhati, pubbe suciṇṇāni…pe… jhānā…pe… ariyā [V 3.0286] maggā…pe… phalaṃ…pe… nibbānaṃ…pe… nibbānaṃ gotrabhussa, vodānassa, maggassa, phalassa adhipatipaccayena paccayo. Sahajātādhipati – saññojanavippayuttādhipati sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ adhipatipaccayena paccayo. (1)

72. A phenomenon dissociated from fetters is a condition for a phenomenon dissociated from fetters by way of the dominance condition—object dominance, conascence dominance. Object dominance: having given alms, observed morality… (and so on) …performed the Uposatha observance, making it weighty, one reflects upon it; previously well-done deeds… (and so on) …jhānas… (and so on) …noble paths… (and so on) …fruit… (and so on) …Nibbāna… (and so on) …Nibbāna is a condition for change-of-lineage, purification, path, and fruit by way of the dominance condition. Conascence dominance: a dominant phenomenon dissociated from fetters is a condition for its associated aggregates and mind-originated material phenomena by way of the dominance condition. (1)

Saññojanavippayutto dhammo saññojanasampayuttassa dhammassa adhipatipaccayena paccayo. Ārammaṇādhipati – dānaṃ datvā sīlaṃ…pe… uposathakammaṃ katvā taṃ garuṃ katvā assādeti abhinandati, taṃ garuṃ katvā rāgo uppajjati, diṭṭhi uppajjati, pubbe suciṇṇāni…pe… jhānā…pe… cakkhuṃ…pe… vatthuṃ saññojanavippayutte khandhe garuṃ katvā assādeti abhinandati, taṃ garuṃ katvā rāgo uppajjati, diṭṭhi uppajjati. (2)

A phenomenon dissociated from fetters is a condition for a phenomenon associated with fetters by way of the dominance condition. Object dominance: having given alms, observed morality… (and so on) …performed the Uposatha observance, making it weighty, one savors and delights in it; making that weighty, lust arises, wrong view arises. Previously well-done deeds… (and so on) …jhānas… (and so on) …the eye… (and so on) …the base, making aggregates dissociated from fetters weighty, one savors and delights in them; making that weighty, lust arises, wrong view arises. (2)

Anantarapaccayo

Contiguity Condition

73. Saññojanasampayutto dhammo saññojanasampayuttassa dhammassa anantarapaccayena paccayo – purimā purimā saññojanasampayuttā [T 3.0270] khandhā pacchimānaṃ pacchimānaṃ saññojanasampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ anantarapaccayena paccayo. (1)

73. A phenomenon associated with fetters is a condition for a phenomenon associated with fetters by way of the contiguity condition—the preceding, preceding aggregates associated with fetters are a condition for the subsequent, subsequent aggregates associated with fetters by way of the contiguity condition. (1)

Saññojanasampayutto dhammo saññojanavippayuttassa dhammassa anantarapaccayena paccayo – purimā purimā uddhaccasahagatā khandhā pacchimassa pacchimassa uddhaccasahagatassa mohassa anantarapaccayena paccayo; saññojanasampayuttā khandhā vuṭṭhānassa anantarapaccayena paccayo. (2)

A phenomenon associated with fetters is a condition for a phenomenon dissociated from fetters by way of the contiguity condition—the preceding, preceding aggregates accompanied by restlessness are a condition for the subsequent, subsequent delusion accompanied by restlessness by way of the contiguity condition; the aggregates associated with fetters are a condition for emergence by way of the contiguity condition. (2)

Saññojanasampayutto dhammo saññojanasampayuttassa ca saññojanavippayuttassa ca dhammassa anantarapaccayena paccayo – purimā purimā uddhaccasahagatā [M 3.0235] khandhā pacchimānaṃ pacchimānaṃ uddhaccasahagatānaṃ khandhānaṃ mohassa ca anantarapaccayena paccayo. (3)

A phenomenon associated with fetters is a condition for a phenomenon associated with fetters and for a phenomenon dissociated from fetters by way of the contiguity condition—the preceding, preceding aggregates accompanied by restlessness are a condition for the subsequent, subsequent aggregates accompanied by restlessness and for delusion by way of the contiguity condition. (3)

74. Saññojanavippayutto dhammo saññojanavippayuttassa dhammassa anantarapaccayena paccayo – purimo purimo uddhaccasahagato moho pacchimassa pacchimassa uddhaccasahagatassa mohassa anantarapaccayena paccayo; purimā purimā saññojanavippayuttā khandhā pacchimānaṃ…pe… phalasamāpattiyā anantarapaccayena paccayo. (1)

74. A phenomenon dissociated from fetters is a condition for a phenomenon dissociated from fetters by way of the contiguity condition—the preceding, preceding delusion accompanied by restlessness is a condition for the subsequent, subsequent delusion accompanied by restlessness by way of the contiguity condition; the preceding, preceding aggregates dissociated from fetters are a condition for the subsequent, subsequent aggregates dissociated from fetters… (and so on) …and for the attainment of fruition by way of the contiguity condition. (1)

Saññojanavippayutto [V 3.0287] dhammo saññojanasampayuttassa dhammassa anantarapaccayena paccayo – purimo purimo uddhaccasahagato moho pacchimānaṃ pacchimānaṃ uddhaccasahagatānaṃ khandhānaṃ anantarapaccayena paccayo; āvajjanā saññojanasampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ anantarapaccayena paccayo. (2)

A state dissociated from fetters is a condition for a state associated with fetters by way of contiguity condition—the preceding, preceding delusion accompanied by restlessness is a condition for the subsequent, subsequent aggregates accompanied by restlessness by way of contiguity condition; adverting is a condition for the aggregates associated with fetters by way of contiguity condition. (2)

Saññojanavippayutto dhammo saññojanasampayuttassa ca saññojanavippayuttassa ca dhammassa anantarapaccayena [T 3.0271] paccayo – purimo purimo uddhaccasahagato moho pacchimānaṃ pacchimānaṃ uddhaccasahagatānaṃ khandhānaṃ mohassa ca anantarapaccayena paccayo; āvajjanā uddhaccasahagatānaṃ khandhānaṃ mohassa ca anantarapaccayena paccayo. (3)

A state dissociated from fetters is a condition for a state associated with fetters and for a state dissociated from fetters by way of contiguity condition—the preceding, preceding delusion accompanied by restlessness is a condition for the subsequent, subsequent aggregates accompanied by restlessness and for delusion by way of contiguity condition; adverting is a condition for the aggregates accompanied by restlessness and for delusion by way of contiguity condition. (3)

75. Saññojanasampayutto ca saññojanavippayutto ca dhammā saññojanasampayuttassa dhammassa anantarapaccayena paccayo – purimā purimā uddhaccasahagatā khandhā ca moho ca pacchimānaṃ pacchimānaṃ uddhaccasahagatānaṃ khandhānaṃ anantarapaccayena paccayo. (1)

75. A state associated with fetters and a state dissociated from fetters are a condition for a state associated with fetters by way of contiguity condition—the preceding, preceding aggregates accompanied by restlessness and delusion are a condition for the subsequent, subsequent aggregates accompanied by restlessness by way of contiguity condition. (1)

Saññojanasampayutto ca saññojanavippayutto ca dhammā saññojanavippayuttassa dhammassa anantarapaccayena paccayo – purimā purimā uddhaccasahagatā khandhā ca moho ca pacchimassa pacchimassa uddhaccasahagatassa mohassa anantarapaccayena paccayo; uddhaccasahagatā khandhā ca moho ca vuṭṭhānassa anantarapaccayena paccayo. (2)

A state associated with fetters and a state dissociated from fetters are a condition for a state dissociated from fetters by way of contiguity condition—the preceding, preceding aggregates accompanied by restlessness and delusion are a condition for the subsequent, subsequent delusion accompanied by restlessness by way of contiguity condition; the aggregates accompanied by restlessness and delusion are a condition for emergence by way of contiguity condition. (2)

Saññojanasampayutto ca saññojanavippayutto ca dhammā saññojanasampayuttassa ca saññojanavippayuttassa ca dhammassa anantarapaccayena paccayo – purimā purimā uddhaccasahagatā khandhā ca moho ca pacchimānaṃ pacchimānaṃ [M 3.0236] uddhaccasahagatānaṃ khandhānaṃ mohassa ca anantarapaccayena paccayo. (3)

A state associated with fetters and a state dissociated from fetters are a condition for a state associated with fetters and for a state dissociated from fetters by way of contiguity condition—the preceding, preceding aggregates accompanied by restlessness and delusion are a condition for the subsequent, subsequent aggregates accompanied by restlessness and for delusion by way of contiguity condition. (3)

Samanantarapaccayādi

Contiguity Condition, etc.

76. Saññojanasampayutto dhammo saññojanasampayuttassa dhammassa samanantarapaccayena paccayo [V 3.0288]… nava… sahajātapaccayena paccayo… nava… aññamaññapaccayena paccayo… cha… nissayapaccayena paccayo… nava.

76. A state associated with fetters is a condition for a state associated with fetters by way of contiguity condition… nine… by way of co-nascence condition… nine… by way of mutuality condition… six… by way of dependence condition… nine.

Upanissayapaccayo

Decisive Support Condition

77. Saññojanasampayutto [T 3.0272] dhammo saññojanasampayuttassa dhammassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇūpanissayo, anantarūpanissayo, pakatūpanissayo…pe…. Pakatūpanissayo – saññojanasampayuttā khandhā saññojanasampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ upanissayapaccayena paccayo. (1)

77. A state associated with fetters is a condition for a state associated with fetters by way of decisive support condition: object decisive support, contiguity decisive support, natural decisive support… etc. As natural decisive support: the aggregates associated with fetters are a condition for the aggregates associated with fetters by way of decisive support condition. (1)

Saññojanasampayutto dhammo saññojanavippayuttassa dhammassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo – anantarūpanissayo, pakatūpanissayo…pe…. Pakatūpanissayo – saññojanasampayuttā khandhā saññojanavippayuttānaṃ khandhānaṃ mohassa ca upanissayapaccayena paccayo. (2)

A state associated with fetters is a condition for a state dissociated from fetters by way of decisive support condition: contiguity decisive support, natural decisive support… etc. As natural decisive support: the aggregates associated with fetters are a condition for the aggregates dissociated from fetters and for delusion by way of decisive support condition. (2)

Saññojanasampayutto dhammo saññojanasampayuttassa ca saññojanavippayuttassa ca dhammassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo – anantarūpanissayo, pakatūpanissayo…pe…. Pakatūpanissayo – saññojanasampayuttā khandhā uddhaccasahagatānaṃ khandhānaṃ mohassa ca upanissayapaccayena paccayo. (3)

A state associated with fetters is a condition for a state associated with fetters and for a state dissociated from fetters by way of decisive support condition: contiguity decisive support, natural decisive support… etc. As natural decisive support: the aggregates associated with fetters are a condition for the aggregates accompanied by restlessness and for delusion by way of decisive support condition. (3)

78. Saññojanavippayutto dhammo saññojanavippayuttassa dhammassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇūpanissayo, anantarūpanissayo, pakatūpanissayo…pe…. Pakatūpanissayo – saddhaṃ upanissāya dānaṃ deti…pe… samāpattiṃ uppādeti; sīlaṃ…pe… paññaṃ… kāyikaṃ sukhaṃ… kāyikaṃ dukkhaṃ… utuṃ… bhojanaṃ… senāsanaṃ mohaṃ upanissāya dānaṃ deti…pe… samāpattiṃ uppādeti; saddhā…pe… senāsanaṃ moho ca saddhāya…pe… phalasamāpattiyā mohassa ca upanissayapaccayena paccayo. (1)

78. A state dissociated from fetters is a condition for a state dissociated from fetters by way of decisive support condition: object decisive support, contiguity decisive support, natural decisive support… etc. As natural decisive support: relying on faith, one gives a gift… etc… generates an attainment; relying on virtue… etc… wisdom… bodily pleasure… bodily pain… climate… food… lodging… relying on delusion, one gives a gift… etc… generates an attainment; faith… etc… lodging, and delusion are a condition for faith… etc… for the fruition attainment, and for delusion by way of decisive support condition. (1)

Saññojanavippayutto [M 3.0237] dhammo [T 3.0273] saññojanasampayuttassa dhammassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇūpanissayo, anantarūpanissayo, pakatūpanissayo…pe…. Pakatūpanissayo – saddhaṃ upanissāya mānaṃ jappeti, diṭṭhiṃ gaṇhāti; sīlaṃ…pe… paññaṃ… kāyikaṃ sukhaṃ… kāyikaṃ [V 3.0289] dukkhaṃ… utuṃ… bhojanaṃ… senāsanaṃ mohaṃ upanissāya pāṇaṃ hanati…pe… saṅghaṃ bhindati; saddhā…pe… senāsanaṃ moho rāgassa…pe… patthanāya upanissayapaccayena paccayo. (2)

A state dissociated from fetters is a condition for a state associated with fetters by way of decisive support condition: object decisive support, contiguity decisive support, natural decisive support… etc. As natural decisive support: relying on faith, one generates conceit, grasps a view; relying on virtue… etc… wisdom… bodily pleasure… bodily pain… climate… food… lodging… relying on delusion, one kills a living being… etc… splits the Saṅgha; faith… etc… lodging, and delusion are a condition for lust… etc… for aspiration by way of decisive support condition. (2)

Saññojanavippayutto dhammo saññojanasampayuttassa ca saññojanavippayuttassa ca dhammassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo – anantarūpanissayo, pakatūpanissayo…pe…. Pakatūpanissayo – saddhā…pe… paññā… kāyikaṃ sukhaṃ…pe… senāsanaṃ moho ca uddhaccasahagatānaṃ khandhānaṃ mohassa ca upanissayapaccayena paccayo. (3)

A state dissociated from fetters is a condition for a state associated with fetters and for a state dissociated from fetters by way of decisive support condition: contiguity decisive support, natural decisive support… etc. As natural decisive support: faith… etc… wisdom… bodily pleasure… etc… lodging, and delusion are a condition for the aggregates accompanied by restlessness and for delusion by way of decisive support condition. (3)

79. Saññojanasampayutto ca saññojanavippayutto ca dhammā saññojanasampayuttassa dhammassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo – anantarūpanissayo, pakatūpanissayo…pe…. Pakatūpanissayo – uddhaccasahagatā khandhā ca moho ca saññojanasampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ upanissayapaccayena paccayo. (1)

79. A state associated with fetters and a state dissociated from fetters are a condition for a state associated with fetters by way of decisive support condition: contiguity decisive support, natural decisive support… etc. As natural decisive support: the aggregates accompanied by restlessness and delusion are a condition for the aggregates associated with fetters by way of decisive support condition. (1)

Saññojanasampayutto ca saññojanavippayutto ca dhammā saññojanavippayuttassa dhammassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo – anantarūpanissayo, pakatūpanissayo…pe…. Pakatūpanissayo – uddhaccasahagatā khandhā ca moho ca saññojanavippayuttānaṃ khandhānaṃ mohassa ca upanissayapaccayena paccayo. (2)

A state associated with fetters and a state dissociated from fetters are conditions by way of Decisive Support Condition for a state dissociated from fetters—immediately proximate decisive support, natural decisive support…etc. Natural decisive support—the aggregates accompanied by restlessness and delusion are conditions by way of Decisive Support Condition for the aggregates dissociated from fetters and for delusion. (2)

Saññojanasampayutto ca saññojanavippayutto ca dhammā saññojanasampayuttassa [T 3.0274] ca saññojanavippayuttassa ca dhammassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo – anantarūpanissayo, pakatūpanissayo…pe…. Pakatūpanissayo – uddhaccasahagatā khandhā ca moho ca uddhaccasahagatānaṃ khandhānaṃ mohassa ca upanissayapaccayena paccayo. (3)

A state associated with fetters and a state dissociated from fetters are conditions by way of Decisive Support Condition for a state associated with fetters and a state dissociated from fetters—immediately proximate decisive support, natural decisive support…etc. Natural decisive support—the aggregates accompanied by restlessness and delusion are conditions by way of Decisive Support Condition for the aggregates accompanied by restlessness and for delusion. (3)

Purejātapaccayo

Pre-nascence Condition

80. Saññojanavippayutto [M 3.0238] dhammo saññojanavippayuttassa dhammassa purejātapaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇapurejātaṃ, vatthupurejātaṃ. Ārammaṇapurejātaṃ – cakkhuṃ…pe… vatthuṃ aniccato [V 3.0290]…pe… vipassati, dibbena cakkhunā rūpaṃ passati, dibbāya sotadhātuyā saddaṃ suṇāti, rūpāyatanaṃ cakkhuviññāṇassa…pe… phoṭṭhabbāyatanaṃ kāyaviññāṇassa…pe…. Vatthupurejātaṃ – cakkhāyatanaṃ cakkhuviññāṇassa…pe… kāyāyatanaṃ kāyaviññāṇassa…pe… vatthu saññojanavippayuttānaṃ khandhānaṃ mohassa ca purejātapaccayena paccayo. (1)

80. A phenomenon dissociated from fetters is a condition for a phenomenon dissociated from fetters by way of the pre-nascence condition: object pre-nascence, base pre-nascence. Object pre-nascence: one sees the eye... sees the base as impermanent... sees a form with the divine eye, hears a sound with the divine ear element; the form base for eye-consciousness... the tangible base for body-consciousness... Base pre-nascence: the eye base for eye-consciousness... the body base for body-consciousness... the base is a condition by way of the pre-nascence condition for aggregates dissociated from fetters and for delusion. (1)

Saññojanavippayutto dhammo saññojanasampayuttassa dhammassa purejātapaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇapurejātaṃ, vatthupurejātaṃ. Ārammaṇapurejātaṃ – cakkhuṃ…pe… vatthuṃ assādeti abhinandati, taṃ ārabbha rāgo uppajjati…pe… domanassaṃ uppajjati. Vatthupurejātaṃ – vatthu saññojanasampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ purejātapaccayena paccayo. (2)

A phenomenon dissociated from fetters is a condition for a phenomenon associated with fetters by way of the pre-nascence condition: object pre-nascence, base pre-nascence. Object pre-nascence: one savors and delights in the eye... the base, and based on that, lust arises... sorrow arises. Base pre-nascence: the base is a condition for the aggregates associated with fetters by way of the pre-nascence condition. (2)

Saññojanavippayutto dhammo saññojanasampayuttassa ca saññojanavippayuttassa ca dhammassa purejātapaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇapurejātaṃ, vatthupurejātaṃ. Ārammaṇapurejātaṃ – cakkhuṃ…pe… vatthuṃ ārabbha uddhaccasahagatā khandhā ca moho ca uppajjanti. Vatthupurejātaṃ – vatthu uddhaccasahagatānaṃ [T 3.0275] khandhānaṃ mohassa ca purejātapaccayena paccayo. (3)

A phenomenon dissociated from fetters is a condition for a phenomenon associated with fetters and for a phenomenon dissociated from fetters by way of the pre-nascence condition: object pre-nascence, base pre-nascence. Object pre-nascence: depending on the eye... the base, aggregates accompanied by restlessness and delusion arise. Base pre-nascence: the base is a condition by way of the pre-nascence condition for aggregates accompanied by restlessness and for delusion. (3)

Pacchājātapaccayo

Post-nascence Condition

81. Saññojanasampayutto dhammo saññojanavippayuttassa dhammassa pacchājātapaccayena paccayo – pacchājātā saññojanasampayuttā khandhā purejātassa imassa kāyassa pacchājātapaccayena paccayo. (1)

81. A phenomenon associated with fetters is a condition for a phenomenon dissociated from fetters by way of the post-nascence condition—the post-arisen aggregates associated with fetters are a condition for this pre-arisen body by way of the post-nascence condition. (1)

Saññojanavippayutto dhammo saññojanavippayuttassa dhammassa pacchājātapaccayena paccayo – pacchājātā saññojanavippayuttā khandhā ca moho ca purejātassa imassa kāyassa pacchājātapaccayena paccayo. (1)

A phenomenon dissociated from fetters is a condition for a phenomenon dissociated from fetters by way of the post-nascence condition—the post-arisen aggregates dissociated from fetters and delusion are a condition for this pre-arisen body by way of the post-nascence condition. (1)

Saññojanasampayutto [M 3.0239] ca saññojanavippayutto ca dhammā saññojanavippayuttassa dhammassa pacchājātapaccayena paccayo – pacchājātā uddhaccasahagatā khandhā ca moho ca purejātassa imassa kāyassa pacchājātapaccayena paccayo. (1)

A phenomenon associated with fetters and a phenomenon dissociated from fetters are conditions for a phenomenon dissociated from fetters by way of the post-nascence condition—the post-arisen aggregates accompanied by restlessness and delusion are conditions for this pre-arisen body by way of the post-nascence condition. (1)

Āsevanapaccayo

Habituation Condition

82. Saññojanasampayutto [V 3.0291] dhammo saññojanasampayuttassa dhammassa āsevanapaccayena paccayo… nava (āvajjanāpi vuṭṭhānampi natthi ).

82. A phenomenon associated with fetters is a condition for a phenomenon associated with fetters by way of the habituation condition... nine (there is no adverting or emergence).

Kammapaccayo

Kamma-condition

83. Saññojanasampayutto dhammo saññojanasampayuttassa dhammassa kammapaccayena paccayo – saññojanasampayuttā cetanā saññojanasampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ kammapaccayena paccayo. (1)

83. A phenomenon associated with fetters is a condition for a phenomenon associated with fetters by way of kamma-condition: Volition associated with fetters is a condition for the aggregates associated with fetters by way of kamma-condition. (1)

Saññojanasampayutto dhammo saññojanavippayuttassa dhammassa kammapaccayena paccayo – sahajātā, nānākkhaṇikā. Sahajātā – saññojanasampayuttā cetanā cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ kammapaccayena paccayo[T 3.0276]; uddhaccasahagatā cetanā mohassa cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ kammapaccayena paccayo. Nānākkhaṇikā – saññojanasampayuttakā cetanā vipākānaṃ khandhānaṃ kaṭattā ca rūpānaṃ kammapaccayena paccayo. (2)

A phenomenon associated with fetters is a condition for a phenomenon dissociated from fetters by way of kamma-condition: co-nascence, and occurring at different moments. Co-nascence: volition associated with fetters is a condition for mind-originated materiality by way of kamma-condition; volition accompanied by restlessness is a condition for delusion and mind-originated materiality by way of kamma-condition. Occurring at different moments: volition associated with fetters is a condition for resultant aggregates and kamma-originated materiality by way of kamma-condition. (2)

Saññojanasampayutto dhammo saññojanasampayuttassa ca saññojanavippayuttassa ca dhammassa kammapaccayena paccayo – saññojanasampayuttā cetanā sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ kammapaccayena paccayo; uddhaccasahagatā cetanā sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ mohassa ca cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ kammapaccayena paccayo. (3)

A phenomenon associated with fetters is a condition for a phenomenon associated with fetters and a phenomenon dissociated from fetters by way of kamma-condition: Volition associated with fetters is a condition for the associated aggregates and mind-originated materiality by way of kamma-condition; volition accompanied by restlessness is a condition for the associated aggregates, delusion, and mind-originated materiality by way of kamma-condition. (3)

Saññojanavippayutto dhammo saññojanavippayuttassa dhammassa kammapaccayena paccayo – sahajātā, nānākkhaṇikā. Sahajātā – saññojanavippayuttā cetanā sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ kammapaccayena paccayo; paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe…. Nānākkhaṇikā – saññojanavippayuttā cetanā vipākānaṃ khandhānaṃ kaṭattā ca rūpānaṃ kammapaccayena paccayo.

A phenomenon dissociated from fetters is a condition for a phenomenon dissociated from fetters by way of kamma-condition: co-nascence, and occurring at different moments. Co-nascence: volition dissociated from fetters is a condition for the associated aggregates and mind-originated materiality by way of kamma-condition; at the moment of rebirth-linking... and so on. Occurring at different moments: volition dissociated from fetters is a condition for resultant aggregates and kamma-originated materiality by way of kamma-condition.

Vipākapaccayo

Result Condition

84. Saññojanavippayutto [M 3.0240][V 3.0292] dhammo saññojanavippayuttassa dhammassa vipākapaccayena paccayo… ekaṃ.

84. A state dissociated from fetters is a condition for a state dissociated from fetters by way of result condition… one.

Āhārapaccayādi

Nutriment Condition, and so on.

85. Saññojanasampayutto dhammo saññojanasampayuttassa dhammassa āhārapaccayena paccayo… cattāri… indriyapaccayena paccayo… cattāri… jhānapaccayena paccayo… cattāri… maggapaccayena paccayo… cattāri… sampayuttapaccayena paccayo… cha.

85. A state associated with fetters is a condition for a state associated with fetters by way of nutriment condition… four; by way of faculty condition… four; by way of jhāna condition… four; by way of path condition… four; by way of association condition… six.

Vippayuttapaccayo

Dissociation Condition

86. Saññojanasampayutto [T 3.0277] dhammo saññojanavippayuttassa dhammassa vippayuttapaccayena paccayo – sahajātaṃ, pacchājātaṃ (saṃkhittaṃ). (1)

86. A state associated with fetters is a condition for a state dissociated from fetters by way of dissociation condition: co-nascence, post-nascence (in brief). (1)

Saññojanavippayutto dhammo saññojanavippayuttassa dhammassa vippayuttapaccayena paccayo – sahajātaṃ, purejātaṃ, pacchājātaṃ (saṃkhittaṃ). (1)

A state dissociated from fetters is a condition for a state dissociated from fetters by way of dissociation condition: co-nascence, pre-nascence, post-nascence (in brief). (1)

Saññojanavippayutto dhammo saññojanasampayuttassa dhammassa vippayuttapaccayena paccayo. Purejātaṃ – vatthu saññojanasampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ vippayuttapaccayena paccayo. (2)

A state dissociated from fetters is a condition for a state associated with fetters by way of dissociation condition. Pre-nascence: the physical basis is a condition for the aggregates associated with fetters by way of dissociation condition. (2)

Saññojanavippayutto dhammo saññojanasampayuttassa ca saññojanavippayuttassa ca dhammassa vippayuttapaccayena paccayo. Purejātaṃ – vatthu uddhaccasahagatānaṃ khandhānaṃ mohassa ca vippayuttapaccayena paccayo. (3)

A state dissociated from fetters is a condition for a state associated with fetters and for a state dissociated from fetters by way of dissociation condition. Pre-nascence: the physical basis is a condition for the aggregates accompanied by restlessness and for delusion by way of dissociation condition. (3)

Saññojanasampayutto ca saññojanavippayutto ca dhammā saññojanavippayuttassa dhammassa vippayuttapaccayena paccayo – sahajātaṃ, pacchājātaṃ (saṃkhittaṃ). (1)

Both a state associated with fetters and a state dissociated from fetters are conditions for a state dissociated from fetters by way of dissociation condition: co-nascence, post-nascence (in brief). (1)

Atthipaccayādi

Presence Condition, and so on.

87. Saññojanasampayutto [V 3.0293] dhammo saññojanasampayuttassa dhammassa atthipaccayena paccayo… ekaṃ (paṭiccavārasadisaṃ). (1)

87. A state associated with fetters is a condition for a state associated with fetters by way of presence condition… one (similar to the Paṭicca section). (1)

Saññojanasampayutto [M 3.0241] dhammo saññojanavippayuttassa dhammassa atthipaccayena paccayo – sahajātaṃ, pacchājātaṃ. Sahajātā – saññojanasampayuttā khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo; uddhaccasahagatā khandhā mohassa cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo. Pacchājātā – saññojanasampayuttā khandhā purejātassa [T 3.0278] imassa kāyassa atthipaccayena paccayo. (2)

A state associated with fetters is a condition for a state dissociated from fetters by way of presence condition: co-nascence, post-nascence. Co-nascence: the aggregates associated with fetters are a condition for mind-produced material phenomena by way of presence condition; the aggregates accompanied by restlessness are a condition for delusion and mind-produced material phenomena by way of presence condition. Post-nascence: the aggregates associated with fetters are a condition for this pre-arisen body by way of presence condition. (2)

Saññojanasampayutto dhammo saññojanasampayuttassa ca saññojanavippayuttassa ca dhammassa atthipaccayena paccayo – saññojanasampayutto eko khandho tiṇṇannaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo…pe… dve khandhā…pe… uddhaccasahagato eko khandho tiṇṇannaṃ khandhānaṃ mohassa ca cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo…pe…. (3)

A state associated with fetters is a condition for a state associated with fetters and for a state dissociated from fetters by way of presence condition. One aggregate associated with fetters is a condition for the three aggregates and for mind-produced material phenomena by way of presence condition… two aggregates… one aggregate accompanied by restlessness is a condition for the three aggregates, for delusion, and for mind-produced material phenomena by way of presence condition… (3)

88. Saññojanavippayutto dhammo saññojanavippayuttassa dhammassa atthipaccayena paccayo – sahajātaṃ, purejātaṃ, pacchājātaṃ, āhāraṃ, indriyaṃ (saṃkhittaṃ. Vitthāretabbaṃ). (1)

88. A state dissociated from fetters is a condition for a state dissociated from fetters by way of presence condition: co-nascence, pre-nascence, post-nascence, nutriment, faculty (in brief. To be expanded). (1)

Saññojanavippayutto dhammo saññojanasampayuttassa dhammassa atthipaccayena paccayo – sahajātaṃ, purejātaṃ. Sahajāto – uddhaccasahagato moho sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo. Purejātaṃ – cakkhuṃ…pe… vatthuṃ assādeti abhinandati, taṃ ārabbha rāgo uppajjati…pe… domanassaṃ uppajjati, vatthu saññojanasampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo. (2)

A state dissociated from fetters is a condition for a state associated with fetters by way of presence condition: co-nascence, pre-nascence. Co-nascence: delusion accompanied by restlessness is a condition for the associated aggregates by way of presence condition. Pre-nascence: the eye… the base is savored and rejoiced in; dependent on that, lust arises… displeasure arises; the base is a condition for the aggregates associated with fetters by way of presence condition. (2)

Saññojanavippayutto dhammo saññojanasampayuttassa ca saññojanavippayuttassa ca dhammassa atthipaccayena paccayo – sahajātaṃ, purejātaṃ. Sahajāto – uddhaccasahagato moho sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo. Purejātaṃ – cakkhuṃ [V 3.0294] …pe… vatthuṃ ārabbha uddhaccasahagatā khandhā ca moho ca uppajjanti, vatthu uddhaccasahagatānaṃ [T 3.0279] khandhānaṃ mohassa ca atthipaccayena paccayo. (3)

A state dissociated from fetters is a condition for a state associated with fetters and for a state dissociated from fetters by way of presence condition: co-nascence, pre-nascence. Co-nascence: delusion accompanied by restlessness is a condition for the associated aggregates and for mind-produced material phenomena by way of presence condition. Pre-nascence: taking the eye… the base as object, the aggregates accompanied by restlessness and delusion arise; the base is a condition for the aggregates accompanied by restlessness and for delusion by way of presence condition. (3)

89. Saññojanasampayutto ca saññojanavippayutto ca dhammā saññojanasampayuttassa dhammassa atthipaccayena paccayo – sahajātaṃ, purejātaṃ. Sahajāto – saññojanasampayutto eko khandho ca vatthu [M 3.0242] ca tiṇṇannaṃ khandhānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo…pe… dve khandhā ca…pe… uddhaccasahagato eko khandho ca moho ca tiṇṇannaṃ khandhānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo…pe… dve khandhā ca…pe…. (1)

89. Both a state associated with fetters and a state dissociated from fetters are a condition for a state associated with fetters by way of presence condition: co-nascence, pre-nascence. Co-nascence: one aggregate associated with fetters and the base are a condition for the three aggregates by way of presence condition… two aggregates… one aggregate accompanied by restlessness and delusion are a condition for the three aggregates by way of presence condition… two aggregates… (1)

Saññojanasampayutto ca saññojanavippayutto ca dhammā saññojanavippayuttassa dhammassa atthipaccayena paccayo – sahajātaṃ, purejātaṃ, pacchājātaṃ, āhāraṃ, indriyaṃ. Sahajātā – saññojanasampayuttā khandhā ca moho ca mahābhūtā ca cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo; uddhaccasahagatā khandhā ca moho ca cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo; uddhaccasahagatā khandhā ca vatthu ca mohassa atthipaccayena paccayo. Pacchājātā – uddhaccasahagatā khandhā ca moho ca purejātassa imassa kāyassa atthipaccayena paccayo. Pacchājātā – saññojanasampayuttā khandhā ca kabaḷīkāro āhāro ca imassa kāyassa atthipaccayena paccayo. Pacchājātā – saññojanasampayuttā khandhā ca rūpajīvitindriyañca kaṭattārūpānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo. (2)

States associated with fetters and states dissociated from fetters are a condition for a state dissociated from fetters by way of presence condition: co-nascence, pre-nascence, post-nascence, nutriment, faculty. Co-nascence: the aggregates associated with fetters, delusion, and the great elements are a condition for mind-produced material phenomena by way of presence condition; the aggregates accompanied by restlessness and delusion are a condition for mind-produced material phenomena by way of presence condition; the aggregates accompanied by restlessness and the physical basis are a condition for delusion by way of presence condition. Post-nascence: the aggregates accompanied by restlessness and delusion are a condition for this pre-arisen body by way of presence condition. Post-nascence: the aggregates associated with fetters and physical nutriment are a condition for this body by way of presence condition. Post-nascence: the aggregates associated with fetters and the life faculty of form are a condition for kamma-born material phenomena by way of presence condition. (2)

Saññojanasampayutto ca saññojanavippayutto ca dhammā saññojanasampayuttassa ca saññojanavippayuttassa [T 3.0280] ca dhammassa atthipaccayena paccayo – sahajātaṃ, purejātaṃ. Sahajāto – uddhaccasahagato eko khandho ca moho ca tiṇṇannaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo…pe… dve khandhā ca…pe…. Sahajāto – uddhaccasahagato eko khandho ca vatthu ca tiṇṇannaṃ khandhānaṃ mohassa ca atthipaccayena paccayo…pe… dve khandhā…pe…. (3)

States associated with fetters and states dissociated from fetters are a condition for states associated with fetters and states dissociated from fetters by presence condition: co-nascence, pre-nascence. Co-nascence: one aggregate accompanied by restlessness, and delusion, are a condition for the three aggregates and mind-produced material phenomena by presence condition… two aggregates… Co-nascence: one aggregate accompanied by restlessness, and the physical basis, are a condition for the three aggregates and delusion by presence condition… two aggregates… (3)

Natthipaccayena paccayo… vigatapaccayena paccayo… avigatapaccayena paccayo.

By absence condition… by disappearance condition… by non-disappearance condition.

Pure.

90. Hetuyā [V 3.0295] cha, ārammaṇe nava, adhipatiyā pañca, anantare nava, samanantare nava, sahajāte nava, aññamaññe cha, nissaye nava, upanissaye nava, purejāte tīṇi, pacchājāte tīṇi, āsevane nava, kamme cattāri, vipāke ekaṃ, āhāre cattāri, indriye cattāri, jhāne cattāri, magge [M 3.0243] cattāri, sampayutte cha, vippayutte pañca, atthiyā nava, natthiyā nava, vigate nava, avigate nava.

90. By root condition, six; by object condition, nine; by dominance condition, five; by contiguity condition, nine; by immediate contiguity condition, nine; by co-nascence condition, nine; by mutuality condition, six; by support condition, nine; by decisive support condition, nine; by pre-nascence condition, three; by post-nascence condition, three; by repetition condition, nine; by kamma condition, four; by kamma-result condition, one; by nutriment condition, four; by faculty condition, four; by jhāna condition, four; by path condition, four; by association condition, six; by dissociation condition, five; by presence condition, nine; by absence condition, nine; by disappearance condition, nine; by non-disappearance condition, nine.

91. Saññojanasampayutto dhammo saññojanasampayuttassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo… sahajātapaccayena paccayo… upanissayapaccayena paccayo. (1)

91. A state associated with a fetter is a condition for a state associated with a fetter by object condition… by co-nascence condition… by decisive support condition. (1)

Saññojanasampayutto dhammo saññojanavippayuttassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo… sahajātapaccayena paccayo… upanissayapaccayena paccayo… pacchājātapaccayena paccayo… kammapaccayena paccayo. (2)

A state associated with a fetter is a condition for a state dissociated from fetters by object condition… by co-nascence condition… by decisive support condition… by post-nascence condition… by kamma condition. (2)

Saññojanasampayutto [T 3.0281] dhammo saññojanasampayuttassa ca saññojanavippayuttassa ca dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo… sahajātapaccayena paccayo… upanissayapaccayena paccayo. (3)

A state associated with a fetter is a condition for a state associated with a fetter and for a state dissociated from fetters by object condition… by co-nascence condition… by decisive support condition. (3)

92. Saññojanavippayutto dhammo saññojanavippayuttassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo, sahajātapaccayena paccayo… upanissayapaccayena paccayo… purejātapaccayena paccayo [V 3.0296]… pacchājātapaccayena paccayo… kammapaccayena paccayo… āhārapaccayena paccayo… indriyapaccayena paccayo. (1)

92. A state dissociated from fetters is a condition for a state dissociated from fetters by object condition, by co-nascence condition… by decisive support condition… by pre-nascence condition… by post-nascence condition… by kamma condition… by nutriment condition… by faculty condition. (1)

Saññojanavippayutto dhammo saññojanasampayuttassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo… sahajātapaccayena paccayo… upanissayapaccayena paccayo… purejātapaccayena paccayo. (2)

A state dissociated from fetters is a condition for a state associated with fetters by object condition… by co-nascence condition… by decisive support condition… by pre-nascence condition. (2)

Saññojanavippayutto dhammo saññojanasampayuttassa ca saññojanavippayuttassa ca dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo… sahajātapaccayena paccayo… upanissayapaccayena paccayo… purejātapaccayena paccayo. (3)

A state dissociated from fetters is a condition for a state associated with fetters and for a state dissociated from fetters by object condition… by co-nascence condition… by decisive support condition… by pre-nascence condition. (3)

93. Saññojanasampayutto ca saññojanavippayutto ca dhammā saññojanasampayuttassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo… sahajātapaccayena paccayo… upanissayapaccayena paccayo. (1)

93. A state associated with a fetter and a state dissociated from fetters are a condition for a state associated with a fetter by object condition… by co-nascence condition… by decisive support condition. (1)

Saññojanasampayutto [M 3.0244] ca saññojanavippayutto ca dhammā saññojanavippayuttassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo… sahajātapaccayena paccayo… upanissayapaccayena paccayo… pacchājātapaccayena paccayo. (2)

A state associated with a fetter and a state dissociated from fetters are a condition for a state dissociated from fetters by object condition… by co-nascence condition… by decisive support condition… by post-nascence condition. (2)

Saññojanasampayutto ca saññojanavippayutto ca dhammā saññojanasampayuttassa [T 3.0282] ca saññojanavippayuttassa ca dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo… sahajātapaccayena paccayo… upanissayapaccayena paccayo. (3)

A state associated with a fetter and a state dissociated from fetters are a condition for a state associated with a fetter and for a state dissociated from fetters by object condition… by co-nascence condition… by decisive support condition. (3)

94. Nahetuyā nava, naārammaṇe nava (sabbattha nava), novigate nava, noavigate nava.

94. By not-root condition, nine; by not-object condition, nine (in all cases, nine); … by not-disappearance condition, nine; by not-non-disappearance condition, nine.

95. Hetupaccayā [V 3.0297] naārammaṇe cha…pe… nasamanantare cha, naaññamaññe dve, naupanissaye cha…pe… namagge cha, nasampayutte dve, navippayutte tīṇi, nonatthiyā cha, novigate cha.

95. By root condition, not by object condition, six… not by immediate contiguity condition, six; not by mutuality condition, two; not by decisive support condition, six… not by path condition, six; not by association condition, two; not by dissociation condition, three; not by absence condition, six; not by disappearance condition, six.

96. Nahetupaccayā ārammaṇe nava, adhipatiyā pañca (anulomapadāni gaṇitabbāni), avigate nava.

96. Not by root condition: by object condition, nine; by dominance condition, five (the positive terms are to be enumerated)… by non-disappearance condition, nine.

23. Saññojanasaññojaniyadukaṃ

23. The Dyad on Fetters and the Fettered.

1. Paṭiccavāro

Hetupaccayo

Root Condition.

97. Saññojanañceva [V 3.0298] saññojaniyañca dhammaṃ paṭicca saññojano ceva saññojaniyo ca dhammā uppajjanti hetupaccayā – kāmarāgasaññojanaṃ paṭicca diṭṭhisaññojanaṃ avijjāsaññojanaṃ (cakkaṃ). (1)

97. Dependent on a state that is both a fetter and fettered, states that are both fetters and fettered arise by root condition. For example, dependent on the fetter of sensual lust, the fetter of views and the fetter of ignorance arise (as a cycle). (1)

Saññojanañceva [M 3.0245] saññojaniyañca dhammaṃ paṭicca saññojaniyo ceva no ca saññojano dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – saññojane paṭicca sampayuttakā khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ. (2)

Dependent on a state that is both a fetter and fettered, a state that is fettered but not a fetter arises by root condition. For example, dependent on the fetters, the associated aggregates and mind-originated matter arise. (2)

Saññojanañceva [T 3.0283] saññojaniyañca dhammaṃ paṭicca saññojano ceva saññojaniyo ca saññojaniyo ceva no ca saññojano ca dhammā uppajjanti hetupaccayā – kāmarāgasaññojanaṃ paṭicca diṭṭhisaññojanaṃ avijjāsaññojanaṃ sampayuttakā khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ (cakkaṃ). (3)

Dependent on a state that is both a fetter and fettered, states that are both fetters and fettered, and states that are fettered but not fetters, arise by root condition. For example, dependent on the fetter of sensual lust, the fetter of views, the fetter of ignorance, the associated aggregates, and mind-originated matter arise (as a cycle). (3)

98. Saññojaniyañceva [V 3.0299] no ca saññojanaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca saññojaniyo ceva no ca saññojano dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – saññojaniyañceva no ca saññojanaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca tayo khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ…pe… dve khandhe…pe… paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe… (yāva mahābhūtā). (1)

98. Dependent on a state that is fettered but not a fetter, a state that is fettered but not a fetter arises by root condition. For example, dependent on one aggregate that is fettered but not a fetter, three aggregates and mind-originated matter arise... etc... two aggregates... etc... at the moment of rebirth-linking... etc... (as far as the great primary elements). (1)

Saññojaniyañceva no ca saññojanaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca saññojano ceva saññojaniyo ca dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – saññojaniye ceva no ca saññojane khandhe paṭicca saññojanā. (2)

Dependent on a state that is fettered but not a fetter, a state that is both a fetter and fettered arises by root condition. For example, dependent on the aggregates that are fettered but not fetters, the fetters arise. (2)

Saññojaniyañceva no ca saññojanaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca saññojano ceva saññojaniyo ca saññojaniyo ceva no ca saññojano ca dhammā uppajjanti hetupaccayā – saññojaniyañceva no ca saññojanaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca tayo khandhā saññojanā ca cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ…pe… dve khandhe…pe…. (3)

Dependent on a state that is fettered but not a fetter, states that are both fetters and fettered, and states that are fettered but not fetters, arise by root condition. For example, dependent on one aggregate that is fettered but not a fetter, three aggregates, the fetters, and mind-originated matter arise... etc... two aggregates... etc. (3)

99. Saññojanañceva saññojaniyañca saññojaniyañceva no ca saññojanaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca saññojano ceva saññojaniyo ca dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – kāmarāgasaññojanañca sampayuttake ca khandhe paṭicca diṭṭhisaññojanaṃ avijjāsaññojanaṃ (cakkaṃ). (1)

99. Dependent on a state that is a fetter and fettered, and on a state that is fettered but not a fetter, a state that is both a fetter and fettered arises by root condition. For example, dependent on the fetter of sensual lust and its associated aggregates, the fetter of views and the fetter of ignorance arise (as a cycle). (1)

Saññojanañceva saññojaniyañca saññojaniyañceva no ca saññojanañca dhammaṃ paṭicca saññojaniyo ceva no [T 3.0284] ca saññojano dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – saññojaniyañceva no ca saññojanaṃ ekaṃ khandhañca saññojane ca paṭicca tayo khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ…pe… dve khandhe…pe…. (2)

Dependent on a state that is a fetter and fettered, and on a state that is fettered but not a fetter, a state that is fettered but not a fetter arises by root condition. For example, dependent on one aggregate that is fettered but not a fetter and on the fetters, three aggregates and mind-originated matter arise... etc... two aggregates... etc. (2)

Saññojanañceva saññojaniyañca saññojaniyañceva no ca saññojanañca dhammaṃ paṭicca saññojano ceva saññojaniyo ca saññojaniyo ceva [M 3.0246] no ca saññojano ca dhammā uppajjanti hetupaccayā – saññojaniyañceva no ca saññojanaṃ ekaṃ khandhañca kāmarāgasaññojanañca [V 3.0300] paṭicca tayo khandhā diṭṭhisaññojanaṃ avijjāsaññojanaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ…pe… dve khandhe ca…pe… (cakkaṃ bandhitabbaṃ). (3)

Dependent on a state that is a fetter and fettered, and on a state that is fettered but not a fetter, states that are both fetters and fettered, and states that are fettered but not fetters, arise by root condition. For example, dependent on one aggregate that is fettered but not a fetter and on the fetter of sensual lust, three aggregates, the fetter of views, the fetter of ignorance, and mind-originated matter arise... etc... two aggregates... etc... (the cycle is to be constructed). (3)

(Saññojanagocchake paṭhamadukasadisaṃ.)

(This is similar to the first dyad in the Fetter Cluster.)

(Evaṃ imampi dukaṃ vitthāretabbaṃ, ninnānākaraṇaṃ ṭhapetvā lokuttaraṃ).

(In this way, this dyad too should be elaborated, with the exception of the distinctions concerning the supramundane.)

Saññojanasaññojaniyadukaṃ niṭṭhitaṃ.

The Dyad on Fetters and the Fettered is finished.

100. Saññojanañceva [V 3.0301] saññojanasampayuttañca dhammaṃ paṭicca saññojano ceva saññojanasampayutto ca dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – kāmarāgasaññojanaṃ paṭicca diṭṭhisaññojanaṃ avijjāsaññojanaṃ (cakkaṃ). (1)

100. Dependent on a state that is both a fetter and associated with a fetter, a state that is both a fetter and associated with a fetter arises by root condition. For example, dependent on the fetter of sensual lust, the fetter of views and the fetter of ignorance arise (as a cycle). (1)

Saññojanañceva saññojanasampayuttañca dhammaṃ paṭicca saññojanasampayutto ceva no ca saññojano dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – saññojane paṭicca sampayuttakā khandhā. (2)

Dependent on a state that is both a fetter and associated with a fetter, a state that is associated with a fetter but is not a fetter arises by root condition. For example, dependent on fetters, the associated aggregates arise. (2)

Saññojanañceva saññojanasampayuttañca [T 3.0285] dhammaṃ paṭicca saññojano ceva saññojanasampayutto ca saññojanasampayutto ceva no ca saññojano ca dhammā uppajjanti hetupaccayā – kāmarāgasaññojanaṃ paṭicca diṭṭhisaññojanaṃ avijjāsaññojanaṃ sampayuttakā ca khandhā (cakkaṃ). (3)

Dependent on a state that is both a fetter and associated with a fetter, states that are both fetters and associated with a fetter, and states that are associated with a fetter but are not fetters, arise by root condition. For example, dependent on the fetter of sensual lust, the fetter of views, the fetter of ignorance, and the associated aggregates arise (as a cycle). (3)

101. Saññojanasampayuttañceva no ca saññojanaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca saññojanasampayutto ceva [V 3.0302] no ca saññojano dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – saññojanasampayuttañceva no ca saññojanaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca tayo khandhā…pe… dve khandhe…pe…. (1)

101. Dependent on a state that is associated with a fetter but is not a fetter, a state that is associated with a fetter but is not a fetter arises by root condition. For example, dependent on one aggregate that is associated with a fetter but is not a fetter, three aggregates arise... etc... two aggregates... etc. (1)

Saññojanasampayuttañceva [M 3.0247] no ca saññojanaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca saññojano ceva saññojanasampayutto ca dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – saññojanasampayutte ceva no ca saññojane khandhe paṭicca saññojanā (2)

Dependent on a state that is associated with a fetter but is not a fetter, a state that is both a fetter and associated with a fetter arises by root condition. For example, dependent on aggregates that are associated with a fetter but are not fetters, the fetters arise. (2)

Saññojanasampayuttañceva no ca saññojanaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca saññojano ceva saññojanasampayutto ca saññojanasampayutto ceva no ca saññojano ca dhammā uppajjanti hetupaccayā – saññojanasampayuttañceva no ca saññojanaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca tayo khandhā saññojanā ca…pe… dve khandhe…pe…. (3)

Dependent on a state that is associated with a fetter but is not a fetter, states that are both fetters and associated with a fetter, and states that are associated with a fetter but are not fetters, arise by root condition. For example, dependent on one aggregate that is associated with a fetter but is not a fetter, three aggregates and the fetters arise... etc... two aggregates... etc. (3)

102. Saññojanañceva saññojanasampayuttañca saññojanasampayuttañceva no ca saññojanañca dhammaṃ paṭicca saññojano ceva saññojanasampayutto ca dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – kāmarāgasaññojanañca sampayuttake ca khandhe paṭicca diṭṭhisaññojanaṃ avijjāsaññojanaṃ (cakkaṃ). (1)

102. Conditioned by a phenomenon that is both a fetter and associated with a fetter, and a phenomenon that is associated with a fetter but is not a fetter, a phenomenon that is both a fetter and associated with a fetter arises by root condition: conditioned by the fetter of sensual desire and the associated aggregates, the fetter of views and the fetter of ignorance arise (cycle). (1)

Saññojanañceva saññojanasampayuttañca saññojanasampayuttañceva no ca saññojanañca dhammaṃ paṭicca saññojanasampayutto [T 3.0286] ceva no ca saññojano dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – saññojanasampayuttañceva no ca saññojanaṃ ekaṃ khandhañca saññojane ca paṭicca tayo khandhā…pe… dve khandhe ca…pe…. (2)

Conditioned by a phenomenon that is both a fetter and associated with a fetter, and a phenomenon that is associated with a fetter but is not a fetter, a phenomenon that is associated with a fetter but is not a fetter arises by root condition: conditioned by one aggregate that is associated with a fetter but is not a fetter and the fetters, three aggregates arise... and so on... two aggregates... and so on. (2)

Saññojanañceva saññojanasampayuttañca saññojanasampayuttañceva no ca saññojanañca dhammaṃ paṭicca saññojano ceva saññojanasampayutto ca saññojanasampayutto ceva no ca saññojano ca dhammā uppajjanti hetupaccayā – saññojanasampayuttañceva no ca saññojanaṃ ekaṃ khandhañca kāmarāgasaññojanañca paṭicca tayo khandhā diṭṭhisaññojanaṃ avijjāsaññojanaṃ…pe… dve khandhe ca…pe… (cakkaṃ). (3)

Conditioned by a phenomenon that is both a fetter and associated with a fetter, and a phenomenon that is associated with a fetter but is not a fetter, a phenomenon that is both a fetter and associated with a fetter, and a phenomenon that is associated with a fetter but is not a fetter, arise by root condition: conditioned by one aggregate that is associated with a fetter but is not a fetter and the fetter of sensual desire, three aggregates, the fetter of views, and the fetter of ignorance arise... and so on... two aggregates... and so on (cycle). (3)

104. Conditioned by a phenomenon that is both a fetter and associated with a fetter, a phenomenon that is both a fetter and associated with a fetter arises by non-root condition: conditioned by the fetter of doubt, the fetter of ignorance arises. (1)

Hetupaccayo

Root Condition

106. Saññojano ceva saññojanasampayutto ca dhammo saññojanassa ceva saññojanasampayuttassa ca dhammassa hetupaccayena paccayo – kāmarāgasaññojano [M 3.0249] diṭṭhisaññojanassa avijjāsaññojanassa hetupaccayena paccayo (cakkaṃ). (1)

106. A phenomenon that is both a fetter and associated with a fetter is a condition by root condition for a phenomenon that is both a fetter and associated with a fetter: the fetter of sensual desire is a condition by root condition for the fetter of views and the fetter of ignorance (cycle). (1)

Saññojano ceva saññojanasampayutto ca dhammo saññojanasampayuttassa ceva no ca saññojanassa dhammassa hetupaccayena paccayo – saññojanā ceva saññojanasampayuttā ca hetū sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ hetupaccayena paccayo. (2)

A phenomenon that is both a fetter and associated with a fetter is a condition by root condition for a phenomenon that is associated with a fetter but is not a fetter: the fetters and associated roots are a condition by root condition for the associated aggregates. (2)

Saññojano [V 3.0305] ceva saññojanasampayutto ca dhammo saññojanassa ceva saññojanasampayuttassa ca saññojanasampayuttassa ceva no ca saññojanassa ca dhammassa hetupaccayena paccayo – kāmarāgasaññojano diṭṭhisaññojanassa avijjāsaññojanassa sampayuttakānañca khandhānaṃ hetupaccayena paccayo (cakkaṃ). (3)

A phenomenon that is both a fetter and associated with a fetter is a condition by root condition for a phenomenon that is both a fetter and associated with a fetter, and for a phenomenon that is associated with a fetter but is not a fetter: the fetter of sensual desire is a condition by root condition for the fetter of views, the fetter of ignorance, and the associated aggregates (cycle). (3)

Ārammaṇapaccayo

Object Condition

107. Saññojano ceva saññojanasampayutto ca dhammo saññojanassa ceva saññojanasampayuttassa ca dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo [T 3.0288] – saññojane ārabbha saññojanā uppajjanti. (Mūlaṃ kātabbaṃ) saññojane ārabbha saññojanasampayuttā ceva no ca saññojanā khandhā uppajjanti. (Mūlaṃ kātabbaṃ) saññojane ārabbha saññojanā ca saññojanasampayuttakā ca khandhā uppajjanti. (1)

107. A phenomenon that is both a fetter and associated with a fetter is a condition by object condition for a phenomenon that is both a fetter and associated with a fetter: taking fetters as object, fetters arise. (The root should be applied.) Taking fetters as object, aggregates that are associated with fetters but are not fetters arise. (The root should be applied.) Taking fetters as object, fetters and associated aggregates arise. (1)

Saññojanasampayutto ceva no ca saññojano dhammo saññojanasampayuttassa ceva no ca saññojanassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo – saññojanasampayutte ceva no ca saññojane khandhe ārabbha saññojanasampayuttā ceva no ca saññojanā khandhā uppajjanti. (1)

A phenomenon that is associated with a fetter but is not a fetter is a condition by object condition for a phenomenon that is associated with a fetter but is not a fetter: taking as object aggregates that are associated with fetters but are not fetters, aggregates that are associated with fetters but are not fetters arise. (1)

Saññojanasampayutto ceva no ca saññojano dhammo saññojanassa ceva saññojanasampayuttassa ca dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo – saññojanasampayutte ceva no ca saññojane khandhe ārabbha saññojanā uppajjanti. (2)

A state that is associated with fetters but is not a fetter is a condition for a state that is both a fetter and associated with fetters by way of object condition. Taking as object the aggregates that are associated with fetters but are not fetters, fetters arise. (2)

Saññojanasampayutto ceva no ca saññojano dhammo saññojanassa ceva saññojanasampayuttassa ca saññojanasampayuttassa ceva no ca saññojanassa ca dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo – saññojanasampayutte ceva [M 3.0250] no ca saññojane khandhe ārabbha saññojanā ca saññojanasampayuttakā ca khandhā uppajjanti. (3)

A state that is associated with fetters but is not a fetter is a condition for a state that is both a fetter and associated with fetters, and for a state that is associated with fetters but is not a fetter, by way of object condition. Taking as object the aggregates that are associated with fetters but are not fetters, both fetters and the aggregates associated with fetters arise. (3)

Saññojano ceva saññojanasampayutto ca saññojanasampayutto ceva no ca saññojano ca dhammā saññojanassa ceva saññojanasampayuttassa ca dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo… tīṇi.

A state that is both a fetter and associated with fetters, and a state that is associated with fetters but is not a fetter, are conditions for a state that is both a fetter and associated with fetters by way of object condition… three.

Adhipatipaccayo

Dominance Condition

108. Saññojano [V 3.0306] ceva saññojanasampayutto ca dhammo saññojanassa [T 3.0289] ceva saññojanasampayuttassa ca dhammassa adhipatipaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇādhipati… tīṇi.

108. A state that is both a fetter and associated with fetters is a condition for a state that is both a fetter and associated with fetters by way of dominance condition: object-dominance… three.

Saññojanasampayutto ceva no ca saññojano dhammo saññojanasampayuttassa ceva no ca saññojanassa dhammassa adhipatipaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇādhipati, sahajātādhipati… tīṇi (imāsu tīsupi pañhāsu ārammaṇādhipatipi sahajātādhipatipi kātabbā).

A state that is associated with fetters but is not a fetter is a condition for a state that is associated with fetters but is not a fetter by way of dominance condition: object-dominance, conascence-dominance… three (in these three questions, both object-dominance and conascence-dominance should be applied).

Saññojano ceva saññojanasampayutto ca saññojanasampayutto ceva no ca saññojano ca dhammā saññojanassa ceva saññojanasampayuttassa ca dhammassa adhipatipaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇādhipati… tīṇi.

A state that is both a fetter and associated with fetters, and a state that is associated with fetters but is not a fetter, are conditions for a state that is both a fetter and associated with fetters by way of dominance condition: object-dominance… three.

Anantarapaccayādi

Proximity Condition, etc.

109. Saññojano ceva saññojanasampayutto ca dhammo saññojanassa ceva saññojanasampayuttassa ca dhammassa anantarapaccayena paccayo… nava (ninnānākaraṇaṃ, vibhajanā natthi. Ārammaṇasadisā)… samanantarapaccayena paccayo… nava… sahajātapaccayena paccayo… nava… aññamaññapaccayena paccayo… nava… nissayapaccayena paccayo… nava… upanissayapaccayena paccayo… nava (ārammaṇanayena kātabbā)… āsevanapaccayena paccayo… nava.

109. A state that is both a fetter and associated with fetters is a condition for a state that is both a fetter and associated with fetters by way of proximity condition… nine (undifferentiated, no analysis; similar to object condition)… by way of contiguity condition… nine… by way of conascence condition… nine… by way of mutuality condition… nine… by way of support condition… nine… by way of decisive support condition… nine (to be done according to the method of the object condition)… by way of repetition condition… nine.

Kammapaccayādi

Kamma Condition, etc.

110. Saññojanasampayutto ceva no ca saññojano dhammo saññojanasampayuttassa ceva no ca saññojanassa dhammassa kammapaccayena paccayo… tīṇi… āhārapaccayena paccayo… tīṇi… indriyapaccayena paccayo… tīṇi… jhānapaccayena paccayo… tīṇi… maggapaccayena [T 3.0290] paccayo… nava [M 3.0251]… sampayuttapaccayena paccayo… nava… atthipaccayena paccayo [V 3.0307]… nava… natthipaccayena paccayo… nava… vigatapaccayena paccayo… nava… avigatapaccayena paccayo… nava.

110. A state that is associated with fetters but is not a fetter is a condition for a state that is associated with fetters but is not a fetter by way of kamma condition… three… by way of nutriment condition… three… by way of faculty condition… three… by way of jhāna condition… three… by way of path condition… nine… by way of association condition… nine… by way of presence condition… nine… by way of absence condition… nine… by way of disappearance condition… nine… by way of non-disappearance condition… nine.

116. Saññojanavippayuttaṃ [V 3.0309] saññojaniyaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca saññojanavippayutto saññojaniyo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – saññojanavippayuttaṃ saññojaniyaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca tayo khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ…pe… dve khandhe…pe… paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe… (yāva asaññasattā, mahābhūtā).

116. A state dissociated from fetters but fetter-producing arises dependent on a state dissociated from fetters but fetter-producing by way of the root condition: dependent on one aggregate dissociated from fetters but fetter-producing, three aggregates and mind-originated materiality… and so on… dependent on two aggregates… and so on… at the moment of rebirth-linking… and so on… (up to non-percipient beings, the great elements).

Saññojanavippayuttaṃ asaññojaniyaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca saññojanavippayutto asaññojaniyo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – saññojanavippayuttaṃ asaññojaniyaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca tayo khandhā…pe… dve khandhe…pe….

A state dissociated from fetters and non-fetter-producing arises dependent on a state dissociated from fetters and non-fetter-producing by way of the root condition: dependent on one aggregate dissociated from fetters and non-fetter-producing, three aggregates… and so on… dependent on two aggregates… and so on….

Saññojanavippayuttaṃ asaññojaniyaṃ dhammaṃ…pe… (dve pañhā kātabbā).

A state dissociated from fetters and non-fetter-producing… and so on… (two questions should be made).

(Imaṃ dukaṃ cūḷantaraduke lokiyadukasadisaṃ ninnānākaraṇaṃ.)

(This dyad in the Minor Intermediate Dyads is similar to the mundane dyad, with no differentiation.)

Saññojanavippayuttasaññojaniyadukaṃ niṭṭhitaṃ.

The Dyad of 'Dissociated from Fetters but Fetter-Producing' is completed.

Saññojanagocchakaṃ niṭṭhitaṃ.

The Cluster on Fetters is completed.

1. Ganthaṃ [T 3.0292][M 3.0253][V 3.0310] dhammaṃ paṭicca gantho dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – sīlabbataparāmāsaṃ kāyaganthaṃ paṭicca abhijjhākāyagantho, abhijjhākāyaganthaṃ paṭicca sīlabbataparāmāso kāyagantho, idaṃsaccābhinivesaṃ kāyaganthaṃ paṭicca abhijjhākāyagantho, abhijjhākāyaganthaṃ paṭicca idaṃsaccābhiniveso kāyagantho. (1)

1. A knot arises dependent on a knot by way of the root condition: dependent on the bodily knot of clinging to rites and rituals, the bodily knot of covetousness arises; dependent on the bodily knot of covetousness, the bodily knot of clinging to rites and rituals arises; dependent on the bodily knot of adherence to 'This is the truth,' the bodily knot of covetousness arises; dependent on the bodily knot of covetousness, the bodily knot of adherence to 'This is the truth' arises. (1)

Ganthaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca nogantho dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – ganthe paṭicca sampayuttakā khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ. (2)

A non-knot state arises dependent on a knot by way of the root condition: dependent on the knots, the associated aggregates and mind-originated materiality arise. (2)

Ganthaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca gantho ca nogantho ca dhammā uppajjanti hetupaccayā – sīlabbataparāmāsaṃ kāyaganthaṃ paṭicca abhijjhākāyagantho sampayuttakā ca khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ (cakkaṃ). (3)

Both a knot and a non-knot state arise dependent on a knot by way of the root condition: dependent on the bodily knot of clinging to rites and rituals, the bodily knot of covetousness arises, along with the associated aggregates and mind-originated materiality (a cycle). (3)

2. Noganthaṃ [V 3.0311] dhammaṃ paṭicca nogantho dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – noganthaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca tayo khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ…pe… dve khandhe…pe… paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe… khandhe paṭicca vatthu, vatthuṃ paṭicca khandhā, ekaṃ mahābhūtaṃ…pe…. (1)

2. A non-knot state arises dependent on a non-knot state by way of the root condition: dependent on one non-knot aggregate, three aggregates and mind-originated materiality… and so on… dependent on two aggregates… and so on… at the moment of rebirth-linking… and so on… dependent on aggregates, the base; dependent on the base, aggregates; dependent on one great element… and so on…. (1)

Noganthaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca gantho dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – noganthe khandhe paṭicca ganthā. (2)

A knot arises dependent on a non-knot state by way of the root condition: dependent on the non-knot aggregates, knots arise. (2)

Noganthaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca gantho ca nogantho ca dhammā uppajjanti hetupaccayā – noganthaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca tayo khandhā ganthā ca cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ…pe… dve khandhe…pe…. (3)

Both a knot and a non-knot state arise dependent on a non-knot state by way of the root condition: dependent on one non-knot aggregate, three aggregates, knots, and mind-originated materiality arise… and so on… dependent on two aggregates… and so on…. (3)

3. Ganthañca noganthañca [T 3.0293] dhammaṃ paṭicca gantho dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – sīlabbataparāmāsaṃ kāyaganthañca sampayuttake ca khandhe paṭicca abhijjhākāyagantho (cakkaṃ). (1)

3. A knot arises dependent on both a knot and a non-knot state by way of the root condition: dependent on the bodily knot of clinging to rites and rituals and the associated aggregates, the bodily knot of covetousness arises (a cycle). (1)

Ganthañca [M 3.0254] noganthañca dhammaṃ paṭicca nogantho dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – noganthaṃ ekaṃ khandhañca ganthe ca paṭicca tayo khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ…pe… dve khandhe ca…pe… ganthe ca sampayuttake khandhe ca paṭicca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ. (2)

A non-knot state arises dependent on both a knot and a non-knot state by way of the root condition: dependent on one non-knot aggregate and the knots, three aggregates and mind-originated materiality arise… and so on… dependent on two aggregates and the knots… and so on… dependent on the knots and the associated aggregates, mind-originated materiality arises. (2)

Ganthañca noganthañca dhammaṃ paṭicca gantho ca nogantho ca dhammā uppajjanti hetupaccayā – noganthaṃ ekaṃ khandhañca sīlabbataparāmāsakāyaganthañca paṭicca tayo khandhā abhijjhākāyagantho cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ…pe… dve khandhe ca…pe…. (Cakkaṃ. Saṃkhittaṃ.) (3)

Both a knot and a non-knot state arise dependent on both a knot and a non-knot state by way of the root condition: dependent on one non-knot aggregate and the bodily knot of clinging to rites and rituals, three aggregates, the bodily knot of covetousness, and mind-originated materiality arise… and so on… dependent on two aggregates and the bodily knot… and so on…. (A cycle. Condensed.) (3)

Ārammaṇapaccayā…pe… avigatapaccayā.

By way of the object condition… and so on… by way of the non-disappearance condition.

Noganthaṃ [V 3.0313] dhammaṃ paṭicca nogantho dhammo uppajjati naārammaṇapaccayā – noganthe [T 3.0294] khandhe paṭicca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ; paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe… (yāva asaññasattā). (1)

Ganthañca [M 3.0255] noganthañca dhammaṃ paṭicca nogantho dhammo uppajjati naārammaṇapaccayā – ganthe ca sampayuttake ca khandhe paṭicca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ (saṃkhittaṃ).
