7. Ganthaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca gantho dhammo uppajjati napurejātapaccayā – arūpe idaṃsaccābhinivesaṃ kāyaganthaṃ paṭicca abhijjhākāyagantho, abhijjhākāyaganthaṃ paṭicca idaṃsaccābhiniveso kāyagantho (arūpe sīlabbataparāmāso natthi, evaṃ nava pañhā kātabbā), napacchājāte nava, naāsevane nava, nakamme tīṇi, navipāke nava, naāhāre ekaṃ, naindriye ekaṃ, najhāne ekaṃ, namagge ekaṃ, nasampayutte tīṇi, navippayutte nava, nonatthiyā tīṇi, novigate tīṇi.

7. A fettered phenomenon arises dependent on a fettered phenomenon by way of the non-prenascence condition. Dependent on the bodily fetter of insistence on 'this is the truth' in the immaterial realm, the bodily fetter of greed arises; and dependent on the bodily fetter of greed, the bodily fetter of insistence on 'this is the truth' arises (in the immaterial realm, there is no adherence to rites and rituals; thus, nine questions should be formulated). By way of Non-Postnascence, nine; by way of Non-Repetition, nine; by way of Non-Kamma, three; by way of Non-Result, nine; by way of Non-Nutriment, one; by way of Non-Faculty, one; by way of Non-Jhāna, one; by way of Non-Path, one; by way of Non-Association, three; by way of Non-Dissociation, nine; by way of Non-Absence, three; by way of Non-Disappearance, three.

18. A fetter phenomenon is a condition for a fetter phenomenon by way of root condition—the fetter-roots are a condition for the associated fetters by way of root condition. (1)

Gantho dhammo noganthassa dhammassa hetupaccayena paccayo – ganthā hetū sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ hetupaccayena paccayo. (2)

Gantho dhammo ganthassa ca noganthassa ca dhammassa hetupaccayena paccayo – ganthā hetū sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ ganthānañca cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ hetupaccayena paccayo. (3)

A fetter phenomenon is a condition for a fetter phenomenon and a non-fettered phenomenon by way of root condition—the fetter-roots are a condition for the associated aggregates, for the fetters, and for mind-originated materiality by way of root condition. (3)

19. Nogantho dhammo noganthassa dhammassa hetupaccayena paccayo – noganthā hetū sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ hetupaccayena paccayo; paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe…. (1)

19. A non-fettered phenomenon is a condition for a non-fettered phenomenon by way of root condition—the non-fettered roots are a condition for the associated aggregates and for mind-originated materiality by way of root condition; at the moment of rebirth-linking, and so on. (1)

Nogantho dhammo ganthassa dhammassa hetupaccayena paccayo – noganthā hetū sampayuttakānaṃ ganthānaṃ hetupaccayena paccayo. (2)

A non-fettered phenomenon is a condition for a fetter phenomenon by way of root condition—the non-fettered roots are a condition for the associated fetters by way of root condition. (2)

Nogantho dhammo ganthassa ca noganthassa ca dhammassa [T 3.0298] hetupaccayena paccayo – noganthā hetū sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ ganthānañca cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ hetupaccayena paccayo. (3)

A non-fettered phenomenon is a condition for a fetter phenomenon and a non-fettered phenomenon by way of root condition—the non-fettered roots are a condition for the associated aggregates, for the fetters, and for mind-originated materiality by way of root condition. (3)

20. Gantho ca nogantho ca dhammā ganthassa dhammassa hetupaccayena paccayo – ganthā ca noganthā ca hetū sampayuttakānaṃ ganthānaṃ hetupaccayena paccayo. (1)

20. Fetter phenomena and non-fettered phenomena are a condition for a fetter phenomenon by way of root condition—the fetter-roots and non-fettered roots are a condition for the associated fetters by way of root condition. (1)

Gantho [V 3.0318] ca nogantho ca dhammā noganthassa dhammassa hetupaccayena paccayo – ganthā ca noganthā ca hetū sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ hetupaccayena paccayo. (2)

Fetter phenomena and non-fettered phenomena are a condition for a non-fettered phenomenon by way of root condition—the fetter-roots and non-fettered roots are a condition for the associated aggregates and for mind-originated materiality by way of root condition. (2)

Gantho [M 3.0259] ca nogantho ca dhammā ganthassa ca noganthassa ca dhammassa hetupaccayena paccayo – ganthā ca noganthā ca hetū sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ ganthānañca cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ hetupaccayena paccayo. (3)

Fetter phenomena and non-fettered phenomena are a condition for a fetter phenomenon and a non-fettered phenomenon by way of root condition—the fetter-roots and non-fettered roots are a condition for the associated aggregates, for the fetters, and for mind-originated materiality by way of root condition. (3)

Ārammaṇapaccayo

Object Condition

21. Gantho dhammo ganthassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo – ganthe ārabbha ganthā uppajjanti. (Mūlaṃ kātabbaṃ) ganthe ārabbha noganthā khandhā uppajjanti. (Mūlaṃ kātabbaṃ) ganthe ārabbha ganthā ca sampayuttakā ca khandhā uppajjanti. (3)

21. A fetter-phenomenon is a condition for a fetter-phenomenon by way of object condition—fetters arise with fetters as object. (The root should be made.) Non-fettered aggregates arise with fetters as object. (The root should be made.) Fetters and concomitant aggregates arise with fetters as object. (3)

22. Nogantho dhammo noganthassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo – dānaṃ datvā sīlaṃ…pe… uposathakammaṃ katvā taṃ paccavekkhati, pubbe suciṇṇāni…pe… jhānā…pe… ariyā maggā vuṭṭhahitvā maggaṃ paccavekkhanti, phalaṃ paccavekkhanti, nibbānaṃ paccavekkhanti. Nibbānaṃ gotrabhussa, vodānassa, maggassa, phalassa, āvajjanāya [T 3.0299] ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo; ariyā noganthe pahīne kilese…pe… vikkhambhite kilese paccavekkhanti, pubbe…pe… cakkhuṃ…pe… vatthuṃ noganthe khandhe aniccato…pe… domanassaṃ uppajjati; dibbena cakkhunā rūpaṃ passati, dibbāya sotadhātuyā saddaṃ suṇāti. Cetopariyañāṇena noganthacittasamaṅgissa cittaṃ jānāti, ākāsānañcāyatanaṃ viññāṇañcāyatanassa…pe… ākiñcaññāyatanaṃ nevasaññānāsaññāyatanassa…pe… rūpāyatanaṃ cakkhuviññāṇassa…pe… phoṭṭhabbāyatanaṃ kāyaviññāṇassa…pe… noganthā khandhā iddhividhañāṇassa, cetopariyañāṇassa, pubbenivāsānussatiñāṇassa, yathākammūpagañāṇassa, anāgataṃsañāṇassa, āvajjanāya ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo. (1)

22. A non-fettered phenomenon is a condition for a non-fettered phenomenon by way of object condition—having given alms, observed morality, etc., having performed the Uposatha observance, one reflects on it; one reflects on past well-performed deeds, etc., meditative attainments, etc.; having emerged from the noble paths, noble ones reflect on the path, reflect on the fruit, reflect on Nibbāna. Nibbāna is a condition for the change-of-lineage consciousness, purification consciousness, path, fruit, and adverting by way of object condition. Noble ones reflect on abandoned defilements, etc., suppressed defilements; past, etc., the eye, etc., the base, the non-fettered aggregates as impermanent, etc., sorrow arises. With the divine eye, one sees visible forms; with the divine ear element, one hears sounds. With mind-penetrating knowledge, one knows the mind of one endowed with non-fettered consciousness. The sphere of infinite space is a condition for the sphere of infinite consciousness, etc., the sphere of nothingness is a condition for the sphere of neither-perception-nor-non-perception, etc., the visible form is a condition for eye-consciousness, etc., the tangible object is a condition for body-consciousness, etc. Non-fettered aggregates are a condition for the knowledge of psychic power, the knowledge of mind-penetration, the knowledge of the recollection of past lives, the knowledge of the passing away and reappearance of beings, the knowledge of the future, and adverting by way of object condition. (1)

Nogantho dhammo ganthassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo – dānaṃ datvā sīlaṃ…pe… uposathakammaṃ katvā taṃ assādeti abhinandati, taṃ ārabbha rāgo uppajjati, diṭṭhi uppajjati[V 3.0319], domanassaṃ uppajjati; pubbe suciṇṇāni…pe… jhānā…pe… cakkhuṃ…pe… vatthuṃ noganthe khandhe assādeti abhinandati, taṃ ārabbha rāgo uppajjati…pe… domanassaṃ uppajjati. (2)

A non-fettered phenomenon is a condition for a fetter-phenomenon by way of object condition—having given alms, observed morality, etc., performed the Uposatha observance, one savors it, rejoices in it; lust arises with that as object, wrong view arises, sorrow arises. One savors past well-performed deeds, etc., meditative attainments, etc., the eye, etc., the base, the non-fettered aggregates, savors them, rejoices in them; lust arises with that as object, etc., sorrow arises. (2)

Nogantho dhammo ganthassa ca noganthassa ca dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo – dānaṃ datvā sīlaṃ…pe… uposathakammaṃ katvā taṃ assādeti [M 3.0260] abhinandati, taṃ ārabbha ganthā ca sampayuttakā ca khandhā uppajjanti, pubbe suciṇṇāni…pe… jhānā…pe… cakkhuṃ…pe… vatthuṃ noganthe khandhe assādeti abhinandati, taṃ ārabbha ganthā ca sampayuttakā [T 3.0300] ca khandhā uppajjanti. (3)

A non-fettered phenomenon is a condition for a fetter-phenomenon and a non-fettered phenomenon by way of object condition—having given alms, observed morality, etc., performed the Uposatha observance, one savors it and rejoices in it; fetters and concomitant aggregates arise with that as object. One savors past well-performed deeds, etc., meditative attainments, etc., the eye, etc., the base, the non-fettered aggregates and rejoices in them; fetters and concomitant aggregates arise with that as object. (3)

Gantho ca nogantho ca dhammā ganthassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo… tīṇi (ārabbha kātabbā).

Fetter-phenomena and non-fettered phenomena are a condition for a fetter-phenomenon by way of object condition… three (to be made with object).

Adhipatipaccayo

Dominance Condition

23. Gantho dhammo ganthassa dhammassa adhipatipaccayena paccayo… tīṇi (ārammaṇasadisā, garukārammaṇā kātabbā).

23. A fetter-phenomenon is a condition for a fetter-phenomenon by way of the dominance condition… three (similar to the object condition; weighty objects should be made).

Nogantho dhammo noganthassa dhammassa adhipatipaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇādhipati, sahajātādhipati. Ārammaṇādhipati – dānaṃ…pe… sīlaṃ…pe… uposathakammaṃ…pe… pubbe…pe… jhānā…pe… ariyā maggā…pe… phalaṃ…pe… nibbānaṃ…pe… nibbānaṃ gotrabhussa, vodānassa, maggassa, phalassa adhipatipaccayena paccayo; cakkhuṃ…pe… vatthuṃ noganthe khandhe garuṃ katvā assādeti abhinandati, taṃ garuṃ katvā rāgo uppajjati, diṭṭhi uppajjati. Sahajātādhipati – noganthādhipati sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ adhipatipaccayena paccayo. (1)

A non-fettered phenomenon is a condition for a non-fettered phenomenon by way of the dominance condition—object-dominance and conascence-dominance. Object-dominance: giving… virtue… observance of the Uposatha… formerly… jhānas… noble paths… fruition… Nibbāna… Nibbāna is a condition for change-of-lineage, purification, path, and fruition by way of the dominance condition; the eye… the base, having made the non-fettered aggregates weighty, one savors and delights in them; having made them weighty, lust arises, wrong view arises. Conascence-dominance: a non-fettered dominant factor is a condition for the associated aggregates and mind-originated material forms by way of the dominance condition. (1)

Nogantho dhammo ganthassa dhammassa adhipatipaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇādhipati, sahajātādhipati. Ārammaṇādhipati – dānaṃ…pe… sīlaṃ…pe… uposathakammaṃ…pe… pubbe suciṇṇāni [V 3.0320] …pe… jhānā…pe… cakkhuṃ…pe… vatthuṃ noganthe khandhe garuṃ katvā taṃ assādeti abhinandati, taṃ garuṃ katvā rāgo uppajjati, diṭṭhi uppajjati. Sahajātādhipati – noganthādhipati ganthānaṃ adhipatipaccayena paccayo. (2)

A non-fettered phenomenon is a condition for a fetter-phenomenon by way of the dominance condition—object-dominance and conascence-dominance. Object-dominance: giving… virtue… observance of the Uposatha… previously well-practiced actions… jhānas… the eye… the base, having made the non-fettered aggregates weighty, one savors and delights in them; having made them weighty, lust arises, wrong view arises. Conascence-dominance: a non-fettered dominant factor is a condition for the fetters by way of the dominance condition. (2)

Nogantho dhammo ganthassa ca noganthassa ca dhammassa adhipatipaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇādhipati, sahajātādhipati. Ārammaṇādhipati – dānaṃ…pe… noganthe [T 3.0301] khandhe garuṃ katvā assādeti abhinandati, taṃ garuṃ katvā ganthā ca sampayuttakā ca khandhā uppajjanti. Sahajātādhipati – noganthādhipati sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ ganthānañca cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ adhipatipaccayena paccayo. (3)

A non-fettered phenomenon is a condition for both a fetter-phenomenon and a non-fettered phenomenon by way of the dominance condition—object-dominance and conascence-dominance. Object-dominance: giving… having made the non-fettered aggregates weighty, one savors and delights in them; having made them weighty, fetters and associated aggregates arise. Conascence-dominance: a non-fettered dominant factor is a condition for the associated aggregates, the fetters, and mind-originated material forms by way of the dominance condition. (3)

24. Gantho [M 3.0261] ca nogantho ca dhammā ganthassa dhammassa adhipatipaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇādhipati… tīṇi.

24. Fetter-phenomena and non-fetter-phenomena are conditions for a fetter-phenomenon by way of the dominance condition: object-dominance… three.

Anantarapaccayo

Immediacy Condition

25. Gantho dhammo ganthassa dhammassa anantarapaccayena paccayo – purimā purimā ganthā pacchimānaṃ pacchimānaṃ ganthānaṃ anantarapaccayena paccayo. (1)

25. A fetter-phenomenon is a condition for a fetter-phenomenon by way of the immediacy condition—the preceding fetters are conditions for the subsequent fetters by way of the immediacy condition. (1)

Gantho dhammo noganthassa dhammassa anantarapaccayena paccayo – purimā purimā ganthā pacchimānaṃ pacchimānaṃ noganthānaṃ khandhānaṃ anantarapaccayena paccayo; ganthā vuṭṭhānassa anantarapaccayena paccayo. (2)

A fetter-phenomenon is a condition for a non-fetter-phenomenon by way of the immediacy condition—the preceding fetters are conditions for the subsequent non-fettered aggregates by way of the immediacy condition; fetters are conditions for emergence by way of the immediacy condition. (2)

Gantho dhammo ganthassa ca noganthassa ca dhammassa anantarapaccayena paccayo – purimā purimā ganthā pacchimānaṃ pacchimānaṃ ganthānaṃ sampayuttakānañca khandhānaṃ anantarapaccayena paccayo. (3)

A bond is a condition for both a bond and a non-bond by way of the immediacy condition—the preceding bonds are conditions for the subsequent bonds and associated aggregates by way of the immediacy condition. (3)

26. Nogantho dhammo noganthassa dhammassa anantarapaccayena paccayo… tīṇi (dve āvajjanā kātabbā, paṭhamo natthi).

26. A non-bond is a condition for a non-bond by way of the immediacy condition… three (two advertings should be made, the first is absent).

Gantho [V 3.0321] ca nogantho ca dhammā ganthassa dhammassa anantarapaccayena paccayo… tīṇi (ekampi vuṭṭhānaṃ kātabbaṃ, majjhe).

Both a bond and a non-bond are conditions for a bond by way of the immediacy condition… three (one emergence should be made, in the middle).

Samanantarapaccayādi

Contiguity Condition, etc.

27. Gantho dhammo ganthassa dhammassa samanantarapaccayena paccayo… nava… sahajātapaccayena paccayo… nava… aññamaññapaccayena paccayo… nava[T 3.0302], nissayapaccayena paccayo… nava.

27. A bond is a condition for a bond by way of the contiguity condition… nine… by way of the conascence condition… nine… by way of the mutuality condition… nine; by way of the support condition… nine.

Upanissayapaccayo

Strong Dependence Condition

28. Gantho dhammo ganthassa dhammassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇūpanissayo, anantarūpanissayo, pakatūpanissayo…pe…. Pakatūpanissayo – ganthā ganthānaṃ upanissayapaccayena paccayo… tīṇi.

28. A bond is a condition for a bond by way of the strong dependence condition—object-strong dependence, immediacy-strong dependence, natural-strong dependence…pe…. Natural-strong dependence: bonds are a condition for bonds by way of the strong dependence condition… three.

29. Nogantho dhammo noganthassa dhammassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇūpanissayo, anantarūpanissayo, pakatūpanissayo [M 3.0262]…pe…. Pakatūpanissayo – saddhaṃ upanissāya dānaṃ deti…pe… mānaṃ jappeti, diṭṭhiṃ gaṇhāti; sīlaṃ…pe… senāsanaṃ upanissāya dānaṃ deti…pe… saṅghaṃ bhindati; saddhā…pe… senāsanaṃ saddhāya…pe… phalasamāpattiyā upanissayapaccayena paccayo. (1)

29. A non-bond is a condition for a non-bond by way of the strong dependence condition—object-strong dependence, immediacy-strong dependence, natural-strong dependence …pe…. Natural-strong dependence: relying on faith, one gives alms…pe… indulges in conceit, grasps a view; relying on virtue…pe… a dwelling, one gives alms…pe… splits the Saṅgha; faith…pe… a dwelling is a condition for faith…pe… for the attainment of fruition by way of the strong dependence condition. (1)

Nogantho dhammo ganthassa dhammassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇūpanissayo, anantarūpanissayo, pakatūpanissayo…pe…. Pakatūpanissayo – saddhaṃ upanissāya diṭṭhiṃ gaṇhāti; sīlaṃ…pe… senāsanaṃ upanissāya pāṇaṃ hanati…pe… saṅghaṃ bhindati; saddhā…pe… senāsanaṃ rāgassa…pe… patthanāya upanissayapaccayena paccayo. (2)

A non-bond is a condition for a bond by way of the strong dependence condition—object-strong dependence, immediacy-strong dependence, natural-strong dependence…pe…. Natural-strong dependence: relying on faith, one grasps a view; relying on virtue…pe… a dwelling, one kills a living being…pe… splits the Saṅgha; faith…pe… a dwelling is a condition for lust…pe… for longing by way of the strong dependence condition. (2)

Nogantho dhammo ganthassa ca noganthassa ca dhammassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇūpanissayo, anantarūpanissayo, pakatūpanissayo…pe…. Pakatūpanissayo – saddhaṃ upanissāya mānaṃ jappeti, diṭṭhiṃ gaṇhāti, sīlaṃ…pe… senāsanaṃ upanissāya pāṇaṃ hanati [V 3.0322] …pe… saṅghaṃ bhindati, saddhā…pe… senāsanaṃ ganthānaṃ sampayuttakānañca [T 3.0303] khandhānaṃ upanissayapaccayena paccayo. (3)

A non-bond is a condition for both a bond and a non-bond by way of the strong dependence condition—object-strong dependence, immediacy-strong dependence, natural-strong dependence…pe…. Natural-strong dependence: relying on faith, one indulges in conceit, grasps a view; relying on virtue…pe… a dwelling, one kills a living being …pe… splits the Saṅgha; faith…pe… a dwelling is a condition for the bonds and associated aggregates by way of the strong dependence condition. (3)

Gantho ca nogantho ca dhammā ganthassa dhammassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇūpanissayo, anantarūpanissayo, pakatūpanissayo…pe…. Pakatūpanissayo… tīṇi (ārammaṇanayena kātabbā).

Both a bond and a non-bond are conditions for a bond by way of the strong dependence condition—object-strong dependence, immediacy-strong dependence, natural-strong dependence…pe…. Natural-strong dependence… three (to be made according to the object method).

Purejātapaccayādi

Pre-nascence Condition, etc.

30. Nogantho dhammo noganthassa dhammassa purejātapaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇapurejātaṃ, vatthupurejātaṃ. Ārammaṇapurejātaṃ – cakkhuṃ…pe… vatthuṃ aniccato…pe… domanassaṃ uppajjati, dibbena cakkhunā rūpaṃ passati, dibbāya sotadhātuyā saddaṃ suṇāti, rūpāyatanaṃ cakkhuviññāṇassa…pe… phoṭṭhabbāyatanaṃ kāyaviññāṇassa…pe…. Vatthupurejātaṃ – cakkhāyatanaṃ cakkhuviññāṇassa…pe… kāyāyatanaṃ kāyaviññāṇassa…pe… vatthu noganthānaṃ khandhānaṃ purejātapaccayena paccayo. (1)

30. A non-bond is a condition for a non-bond by way of the pre-nascence condition—object pre-nascence, base pre-nascence. Object pre-nascence—the eye…pe… the base as impermanent…pe… sorrow arises; with the divine eye, one sees forms; with the divine ear element, one hears sounds; the visible form base is a condition for eye-consciousness…pe… the tangible base is a condition for body-consciousness…pe…. Base pre-nascence—the eye base is a condition for eye-consciousness…pe… the body base is a condition for body-consciousness…pe… the base is a condition for the non-bond aggregates by way of the pre-nascence condition. (1)

Nogantho dhammo ganthassa dhammassa purejātapaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇapurejātaṃ, vatthupurejātaṃ. Ārammaṇapurejātaṃ – cakkhuṃ…pe… vatthuṃ assādeti abhinandati, taṃ ārabbha rāgo uppajjati, diṭṭhi uppajjati, domanassaṃ [M 3.0263] uppajjati. Vatthupurejātaṃ – vatthu ganthānaṃ purejātapaccayena paccayo. (2)

A non-bond is a condition for a bond by way of the pre-nascence condition—object pre-nascence, base pre-nascence. Object pre-nascence—one relishes and delights in the eye…pe… the base, and on account of that, lust arises, a (wrong) view arises, sorrow arises. Base pre-nascence—the base is a condition for the bonds by way of the pre-nascence condition. (2)

Nogantho dhammo ganthassa ca noganthassa ca dhammassa purejātapaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇapurejātaṃ, vatthupurejātaṃ. Ārammaṇapurejātaṃ – cakkhuṃ…pe… vatthuṃ assādeti abhinandati, taṃ ārabbha ganthā ca sampayuttakā ca khandhā uppajjanti. Vatthupurejātaṃ [T 3.0304] – vatthu ganthānaṃ sampayuttakānañca khandhānaṃ purejātapaccayena paccayo. (3)

A non-bond is a condition for both a bond and a non-bond by way of the pre-nascence condition—object pre-nascence, base pre-nascence. Object pre-nascence—one relishes and delights in the eye…pe… the base; based on that, bonds and associated aggregates arise. Base pre-nascence—the base is a condition for the bonds and associated aggregates by way of the pre-nascence condition. (3)

Pacchājātapaccayena paccayo… tīṇi, āsevanapaccayena paccayo… nava.

By way of post-nascence condition… three; by way of repetition condition… nine.

Kammapaccayo

Kamma-condition

31. Nogantho [V 3.0323] dhammo noganthassa dhammassa kammapaccayena paccayo – sahajātā, nānākkhaṇikā. Sahajātā – noganthā cetanā sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ kammapaccayena paccayo; paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe…. Nānākkhaṇikā – noganthā cetanā vipākānaṃ khandhānaṃ kaṭattā ca rūpānaṃ kammapaccayena paccayo. (1)

31. A non-bond is a condition for a non-bond by way of kamma-condition—conascent, and of different moments. Conascent—non-bond volition is a condition for the associated aggregates and mind-produced material phenomena by way of kamma-condition; at the moment of rebirth-linking…pe…. Of different moments—non-bond volition is a condition for the resultant aggregates and kamma-originated material phenomena by way of kamma-condition. (1)

Nogantho dhammo ganthassa dhammassa kammapaccayena paccayo – noganthā cetanā sampayuttakānaṃ ganthānaṃ kammapaccayena paccayo. (2)

A non-bond is a condition for a bond by way of kamma-condition—non-bond volition is a condition for the associated bonds by way of kamma-condition. (2)

Nogantho dhammo ganthassa ca noganthassa ca dhammassa kammapaccayena paccayo – noganthā cetanā sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ ganthānañca cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ kammapaccayena paccayo. (3)

A non-bond is a condition for both a bond and a non-bond by way of kamma-condition—non-bond volition is a condition for the associated aggregates, the bonds, and mind-produced material phenomena by way of kamma-condition. (3)

Vipākapaccayādi

Result-condition, etc.

32. Nogantho dhammo noganthassa dhammassa vipākapaccayena paccayo… ekaṃ… āhārapaccayena paccayo… tīṇi… indriyapaccayena paccayo… tīṇi… jhānapaccayena paccayo… tīṇi… maggapaccayena paccayo… nava… sampayuttapaccayena paccayo… nava.

32. Non-fettering phenomena are a condition for non-fettering phenomena by way of result-condition... one. By way of nutriment condition... three. By way of faculty condition... three. By way of jhāna condition... three. By way of path condition... nine. By way of association condition... nine.

Vippayuttapaccayo

Dissociation Condition

33. Gantho dhammo noganthassa dhammassa vippayuttapaccayena paccayo – sahajātaṃ, pacchājātaṃ (saṃkhittaṃ). (1)

33. Fettering phenomena are a condition for non-fettering phenomena by way of dissociation condition—conascence, postnascence (in brief). (1)

Nogantho [M 3.0264] dhammo noganthassa dhammassa vippayuttapaccayena paccayo – sahajātaṃ, purejātaṃ, pacchājātaṃ [T 3.0305] (saṃkhittaṃ). (1)

Nogantho [V 3.0324] dhammo ganthassa ca noganthassa ca dhammassa vippayuttapaccayena paccayo. Purejātaṃ – vatthu ganthānaṃ sampayuttakānañca khandhānaṃ vippayuttapaccayena paccayo. (3)

Gantho ca nogantho ca dhammā noganthassa dhammassa vippayuttapaccayena paccayo – sahajātaṃ, pacchājātaṃ (saṃkhittaṃ). (1)

Atthipaccayo

Presence Condition

34. Gantho dhammo ganthassa dhammassa atthipaccayena paccayo… ekaṃ (paṭiccasadisaṃ).

34. Fettering phenomena are a condition for fettering phenomena by way of presence condition... one (similar to dependent origination). (1)

Gantho dhammo noganthassa dhammassa atthipaccayena paccayo – sahajātaṃ, pacchājātaṃ. Sahajātā – ganthā sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo. Pacchājātā – ganthā purejātassa imassa kāyassa atthipaccayena paccayo. (2)

Fettering phenomena are a condition for non-fettering phenomena by way of presence condition—conascence, postnascence. Conascence—fetters are a condition for the associated aggregates and mind-originated matter by way of presence condition. Postnascence—fetters are a condition for this pre-arisen body by way of presence condition. (2)

Gantho dhammo ganthassa ca noganthassa ca dhammassa atthipaccayena paccayo… ekaṃ (paṭiccasadisaṃ). (3)

Fettering phenomena are a condition for fettering phenomena and non-fettering phenomena by way of presence condition... one (similar to dependent origination). (3)

35. Nogantho dhammo noganthassa dhammassa atthipaccayena paccayo – sahajātaṃ, purejātaṃ, pacchājātaṃ, āhāraṃ, indriyaṃ (saṃkhittaṃ). (1)

35. Non-fettering phenomena are a condition for non-fettering phenomena by way of presence condition—conascence, prenascence, postnascence, nutriment, faculty (in brief). (1)

Nogantho dhammo ganthassa dhammassa atthipaccayena paccayo – sahajātaṃ, purejātaṃ. Sahajātā – noganthā khandhā ganthānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo. Purejātaṃ – cakkhuṃ…pe… vatthuṃ assādeti abhinandati, taṃ ārabbha rāgo uppajjati, diṭṭhi uppajjati, domanassaṃ uppajjati, vatthu ganthānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo[T 3.0306]. (2)

Non-fettering phenomena are a condition for fettering phenomena by way of presence condition—conascence, prenascence. Conascence—non-fettering aggregates are a condition for the fetters by way of presence condition. Prenascence—the eye... the base one relishes and delights in; based on that, lust arises, a view arises, grief arises; the base is a condition for the fetters by way of presence condition. (2)

Nogantho [M 3.0265] dhammo ganthassa ca noganthassa ca dhammassa atthipaccayena paccayo – sahajātaṃ, purejātaṃ. Sahajāto – nogantho eko khandho tiṇṇannaṃ khandhānaṃ ganthānañca cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo…pe…. Purejātaṃ – cakkhuṃ…pe… vatthuṃ assādeti abhinandati[V 3.0325], taṃ ārabbha ganthā ca sampayuttakā ca khandhā uppajjanti; vatthu ganthānaṃ sampayuttakānañca khandhānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo. (3)

Non-fettering phenomena are a condition for fettering phenomena and non-fettering phenomena by way of presence condition—conascence, prenascence. Conascence—one non-fettering aggregate is a condition for the other three aggregates, the fetters, and mind-originated matter by way of presence condition.... Prenascence—the eye... the base one relishes and delights in; based on that, fetters and associated aggregates arise; the base is a condition for the fetters and the associated aggregates by way of presence condition. (3)

36. Gantho ca nogantho ca dhammā ganthassa dhammassa atthipaccayena paccayo – sahajātaṃ, purejātaṃ. Sahajāto – sīlabbataparāmāso kāyagantho ca sampayuttakā ca khandhā abhijjhākāyaganthassa atthipaccayena paccayo (cakkaṃ). Sahajāto – sīlabbataparāmāso kāyagantho ca vatthu ca abhijjhākāyaganthassa atthipaccayena paccayo. (Cakkaṃ). (1)

36. Fettering phenomena and non-fettering phenomena are a condition for fettering phenomena by way of presence condition—conascence, prenascence. Conascence—adherence to rules and observances, which is a bodily fetter, and the associated aggregates are a condition for the bodily fetter of covetousness by way of presence condition (a cycle). Conascence—adherence to rules and observances, which is a bodily fetter, and the base are a condition for the bodily fetter of covetousness by way of presence condition (a cycle). (1)

Gantho ca nogantho ca dhammā noganthassa dhammassa atthipaccayena paccayo – sahajātaṃ, purejātaṃ, pacchājātaṃ, āhāraṃ, indriyaṃ. Sahajāto – nogantho eko khandho ca gantho ca tiṇṇannaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo…pe… dve khandhā ca…pe…. Sahajātā – ganthā ca vatthu ca noganthānaṃ khandhānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo. Sahajātā – ganthā ca mahābhūtā ca cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo. Pacchājātā – ganthā ca sampayuttakā ca khandhā purejātassa imassa kāyassa atthipaccayena paccayo. Pacchājātā – ganthā ca kabaḷīkāro [T 3.0307] āhāro ca imassa kāyassa atthipaccayena paccayo. Pacchājātā – ganthā ca rūpajīvitindriyañca kaṭattārūpānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo. (2)

Fettering phenomena and non-fettering phenomena are a condition for non-fettering phenomena by way of presence condition—conascence, prenascence, postnascence, nutriment, faculty. Conascence—one non-fettering aggregate and fetters are a condition for three aggregates and mind-originated matter by way of presence condition... two aggregates and.... Conascence—fetters and the base are a condition for non-fettering aggregates by way of presence condition. Conascence—fetters and the great elements are a condition for mind-originated matter by way of presence condition. Postnascence—fetters and associated aggregates are a condition for this pre-arisen body by way of presence condition. Postnascence—fetters and edible food are a condition for this body by way of presence condition. Postnascence—fetters and the material life faculty are a condition for kamma-originated matter by way of presence condition. (2)

Gantho ca nogantho ca dhammā ganthassa ca noganthassa ca dhammassa atthipaccayena paccayo – sahajātaṃ, purejātaṃ. Sahajāto – nogantho eko khandho ca sīlabbataparāmāso kāyagantho ca tiṇṇannaṃ khandhānaṃ abhijjhākāyaganthassa ca cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo…pe…. Sahajāto – sīlabbataparāmāso kāyagantho ca vatthu ca abhijjhākāyaganthassa ca sampayuttakānañca khandhānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo (cakkaṃ). (3)

Fettering phenomena and non-fettering phenomena are a condition for fettering phenomena and non-fettering phenomena by way of presence condition—conascence, prenascence. Conascence—one non-fettering aggregate and adherence to rules and observances, which is a bodily fetter, are a condition for the three aggregates, the bodily fetter of covetousness, and mind-originated matter by way of presence condition.... Conascence—adherence to rules and observances, which is a bodily fetter, and the base are a condition for the bodily fetter of covetousness and the associated aggregates by way of presence condition (a cycle). (3)

45. Ganthasampayuttaṃ [M 3.0268][V 3.0329] dhammaṃ paṭicca ganthasampayutto dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – ganthasampayuttaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca tayo khandhā…pe… dve khandhe…pe…. (1)

45. A phenomenon associated with fetters arises in dependence on a phenomenon associated with fetters by way of root condition—in dependence on one aggregate associated with fetters, three aggregates arise... in dependence on two aggregates.... (1)

Ganthasampayuttaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca ganthavippayutto dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – ganthasampayutte khandhe paṭicca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ, diṭṭhigatavippayuttalobhasahagate khandhe paṭicca [T 3.0310] lobho cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ, domanassasahagate khandhe paṭicca paṭighaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ. (2)

A phenomenon dissociated from fetters arises in dependence on a phenomenon associated with fetters by way of root condition—in dependence on the aggregates associated with fetters, mind-produced form arises; in dependence on the aggregates accompanied by greed and dissociated from wrong view, greed and mind-produced form arise; in dependence on the aggregates accompanied by displeasure, aversion and mind-produced form arise. (2)

Ganthasampayuttaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca ganthasampayutto ca ganthavippayutto ca dhammā uppajjanti hetupaccayā – ganthasampayuttaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca tayo khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ…pe… dve khandhe…pe… diṭṭhigatavippayuttalobhasahagataṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca tayo khandhā lobho ca cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ…pe… dve khandhe…pe… domanassasahagataṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca tayo khandhā paṭighañca cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ…pe… dve khandhe…pe…. (3)

A phenomenon associated with fetters is a condition for phenomena associated with fetters and dissociated from fetters by way of root condition: dependent on one aggregate associated with fetters, three aggregates and mind-produced form arise…pe… dependent on two aggregates…pe… dependent on one aggregate accompanied by greed and dissociated from wrong view, three aggregates, greed, and mind-produced form arise…pe… dependent on two aggregates…pe… dependent on one aggregate accompanied by displeasure, three aggregates, aversion, and mind-produced form arise…pe… dependent on two aggregates…pe…. (3)

46. Ganthavippayuttaṃ [V 3.0330] dhammaṃ paṭicca ganthavippayutto dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – ganthavippayuttaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca tayo khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ…pe… dve khandhe…pe… diṭṭhigatavippayuttaṃ lobhaṃ paṭicca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ, paṭighaṃ paṭicca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ; paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe… khandhe paṭicca (saṃkhittaṃ). (1)

46. A phenomenon dissociated from fetters is a condition for a phenomenon dissociated from fetters by way of root condition: dependent on one aggregate dissociated from fetters, three aggregates and mind-produced form arise…pe… dependent on two aggregates…pe… dependent on greed dissociated from wrong view, mind-produced form arises; dependent on aversion, mind-produced form arises; at the moment of rebirth-linking…pe… dependent on the aggregates (abbreviated). (1)

Ganthavippayuttaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca ganthasampayutto dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – diṭṭhigatavippayuttaṃ lobhaṃ paṭicca sampayuttakā khandhā, paṭighaṃ paṭicca sampayuttakā khandhā. (2)

A phenomenon dissociated from fetters is a condition for a phenomenon associated with fetters by way of root condition: dependent on greed dissociated from wrong view, the associated aggregates arise; dependent on aversion, the associated aggregates arise. (2)

Ganthavippayuttaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca ganthasampayutto ca ganthavippayutto ca dhammā uppajjanti hetupaccayā – diṭṭhigatavippayuttaṃ lobhaṃ paṭicca sampayuttakā khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ, paṭighaṃ paṭicca sampayuttakā khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ. (3)

A phenomenon dissociated from fetters is a condition for phenomena associated with fetters and dissociated from fetters by way of root condition: dependent on greed dissociated from wrong view, the associated aggregates and mind-produced form arise; dependent on aversion, the associated aggregates and mind-produced form arise. (3)

47. Ganthasampayuttañca ganthavippayuttañca dhammaṃ paṭicca ganthasampayutto dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – diṭṭhigatavippayuttalobhasahagataṃ [T 3.0311] ekaṃ khandhañca lobhañca [M 3.0269] paṭicca tayo khandhā…pe… dve khandhe…pe… domanassasahagataṃ ekaṃ khandhañca paṭighañca paṭicca tayo khandhā…pe… dve khandhe…pe…. (1)

47. A phenomenon associated with fetters and a phenomenon dissociated from fetters are conditions for a phenomenon associated with fetters by way of root condition: dependent on one aggregate accompanied by greed and dissociated from wrong view, and greed, three aggregates arise…pe… dependent on two aggregates…pe… dependent on one aggregate accompanied by displeasure, and aversion, three aggregates arise…pe… dependent on two aggregates…pe…. (1)

Ganthasampayuttañca ganthavippayuttañca dhammaṃ paṭicca ganthavippayutto dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – ganthasampayutte khandhe ca mahābhūte ca paṭicca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ, diṭṭhigatavippayuttalobhasahagate khandhe ca lobhañca paṭicca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ, domanassasahagate khandhe ca paṭighañca paṭicca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ. (2)

A phenomenon associated with fetters and a phenomenon dissociated from fetters are conditions for a phenomenon dissociated from fetters by way of root condition: dependent on the aggregates associated with fetters and the great elements, mind-produced form arises; dependent on the aggregates accompanied by greed and dissociated from wrong view, and greed, mind-produced form arises; dependent on the aggregates accompanied by displeasure, and aversion, mind-produced form arises. (2)

Ganthasampayuttañca ganthavippayuttañca dhammaṃ paṭicca ganthasampayutto ca ganthavippayutto ca dhammā uppajjanti hetupaccayā – diṭṭhigatavippayuttalobhasahagataṃ ekaṃ khandhañca lobhañca paṭicca tayo khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ…pe… dve khandhe…pe… domanassasahagataṃ ekaṃ khandhañca paṭighañca paṭicca tayo khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ…pe… dve khandhe…pe…. (3)

A phenomenon associated with fetters and a phenomenon dissociated from fetters are conditions for phenomena associated with fetters and dissociated from fetters by way of root condition: dependent on one aggregate accompanied by greed and dissociated from wrong view, and greed, three aggregates and mind-produced form arise…pe… dependent on two aggregates…pe… dependent on one aggregate accompanied by displeasure, and aversion, three aggregates and mind-produced form arise…pe… dependent on two aggregates…pe…. (3)

Object Condition

48. Ganthasampayuttaṃ [V 3.0331] dhammaṃ paṭicca ganthasampayutto dhammo uppajjati ārammaṇapaccayā – ganthasampayuttaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca tayo khandhā…pe… dve khandhe…pe…. (1)

48. A phenomenon associated with fetters is a condition for a phenomenon associated with fetters by way of object condition: dependent on one aggregate associated with fetters, three aggregates arise…pe… dependent on two aggregates…pe…. (1)

Ganthasampayuttaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca ganthavippayutto dhammo uppajjati ārammaṇapaccayā – diṭṭhigatavippayuttalobhasahagate khandhe paṭicca lobho, domanassasahagate khandhe paṭicca paṭighaṃ. (2)

A phenomenon associated with fetters is a condition for a phenomenon dissociated from fetters by way of object condition: dependent on the aggregates accompanied by greed and dissociated from wrong view, greed arises; dependent on the aggregates accompanied by displeasure, aversion arises. (2)

Ganthasampayuttaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca ganthasampayutto ca ganthavippayutto ca dhammā uppajjanti ārammaṇapaccayā [T 3.0312] – diṭṭhigatavippayuttalobhasahagataṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca tayo khandhā lobho ca…pe… dve khandhe…pe… domanassasahagataṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca tayo khandhā paṭighañca…pe… dve khandhe…pe…. (3)

A phenomenon associated with fetters is a condition for phenomena associated with fetters and dissociated from fetters by way of object condition: dependent on one aggregate accompanied by greed and dissociated from wrong view, three aggregates and greed arise…pe… dependent on two aggregates…pe… dependent on one aggregate accompanied by displeasure, three aggregates and aversion arise…pe… dependent on two aggregates…pe…. (3)

49. Ganthavippayuttaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca ganthavippayutto dhammo uppajjati ārammaṇapaccayā – ganthavippayuttaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca tayo khandhā…pe… dve khandhe…pe… paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe… vatthuṃ paṭicca khandhā. (1)

49. A phenomenon dissociated from fetters is a condition for a phenomenon dissociated from fetters by way of object condition: dependent on one aggregate dissociated from fetters, three aggregates arise…pe… dependent on two aggregates…pe… at the moment of rebirth-linking…pe… dependent on the base, the aggregates arise. (1)

Ganthavippayuttaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca ganthasampayutto dhammo uppajjati ārammaṇapaccayā – diṭṭhigatavippayuttaṃ lobhaṃ paṭicca sampayuttakā khandhā, paṭighaṃ paṭicca sampayuttakā khandhā. (2)

A phenomenon dissociated from fetters is a condition for a phenomenon associated with fetters by way of object condition: dependent on greed dissociated from wrong view, the associated aggregates arise; dependent on aversion, the associated aggregates arise. (2)

Ganthasampayuttañca [M 3.0270] ganthavippayuttañca dhammaṃ paṭicca ganthasampayutto dhammo uppajjati ārammaṇapaccayā – diṭṭhigatavippayuttalobhasahagataṃ ekaṃ khandhañca lobhañca paṭicca tayo khandhā…pe… dve khandhe…pe… domanassasahagataṃ ekaṃ khandhañca paṭighañca paṭicca tayo khandhā…pe… dve khandhe…pe… (saṃkhittaṃ). (1)

A phenomenon associated with fetters and a phenomenon dissociated from fetters are conditions for a phenomenon associated with fetters by way of object condition: dependent on one aggregate accompanied by greed and dissociated from wrong view, and greed, three aggregates arise…pe… dependent on two aggregates…pe… dependent on one aggregate accompanied by displeasure, and aversion, three aggregates arise…pe… dependent on two aggregates…pe… (abbreviated). (1)

Root Condition

55. Ganthasampayuttaṃ [V 3.0334] dhammaṃ paccayā ganthasampayutto dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā… tīṇi (paṭiccasadisā).

55. Dependent on a phenomenon conjoined with ties, a phenomenon conjoined with ties arises by way of root condition… three (similar to the dependent origination section).

Ganthavippayuttaṃ dhammaṃ paccayā ganthavippayutto dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – ganthavippayuttaṃ [T 3.0314] ekaṃ khandhaṃ paccayā…pe… paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe… khandhe paccayā vatthu, vatthuṃ paccayā khandhā, ekaṃ mahābhūtaṃ…pe… vatthuṃ paccayā ganthavippayuttā khandhā. (1)

Dependent on a phenomenon disjoined from ties, a phenomenon disjoined from ties arises by way of root condition: dependent on one aggregate disjoined from ties…pe… at the moment of rebirth-linking…pe… dependent on the aggregates, the base; dependent on the base, the aggregates; dependent on one great element…pe… dependent on the base, aggregates disjoined from ties. (1)

Ganthavippayuttaṃ [M 3.0272] dhammaṃ paccayā ganthasampayutto dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – vatthuṃ paccayā ganthasampayuttakā khandhā, diṭṭhigatavippayuttaṃ lobhaṃ paccayā sampayuttakā khandhā, paṭighaṃ paccayā sampayuttakā khandhā. (2)

Dependent on a phenomenon disjoined from ties, a phenomenon conjoined with ties arises by way of root condition: dependent on the base, aggregates conjoined with ties arise; dependent on greed disjoined from wrong view, the conjoined aggregates arise; dependent on aversion, the conjoined aggregates arise. (2)

Ganthavippayuttaṃ dhammaṃ paccayā ganthasampayutto ca ganthavippayutto ca dhammā uppajjanti hetupaccayā – vatthuṃ paccayā ganthasampayuttakā khandhā, mahābhūte paccayā cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ, diṭṭhigatavippayuttaṃ lobhaṃ paccayā sampayuttakā khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ, paṭighaṃ paccayā sampayuttakā khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ, vatthuṃ paccayā diṭṭhigatavippayuttalobhasahagatā khandhā ca lobho ca, vatthuṃ paccayā domanassasahagatā khandhā ca paṭighañca. (3)

Dependent on a phenomenon disjoined from ties, both a phenomenon conjoined with ties and a phenomenon disjoined from ties arise by way of root condition: dependent on the base, aggregates conjoined with ties arise; dependent on the great elements, mind-originated materiality arises; dependent on greed disjoined from wrong view, the conjoined aggregates and mind-originated materiality arise; dependent on aversion, the conjoined aggregates and mind-originated materiality arise; dependent on the base, aggregates accompanied by greed disjoined from wrong view, and greed, arise; dependent on the base, aggregates accompanied by displeasure, and aversion, arise. (3)

56. Ganthasampayuttañca ganthavippayuttañca dhammaṃ paccayā ganthasampayutto dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – ganthasampayuttaṃ ekaṃ khandhañca vatthuñca paccayā tayo khandhā…pe… dve khandhe…pe… diṭṭhigatavippayuttalobhasahagataṃ ekaṃ khandhañca vatthuñca lobhañca paccayā tayo khandhā [V 3.0335] …pe… dve khandhe…pe… domanassasahagataṃ ekaṃ khandhañca vatthuñca paṭighañca paccayā tayo khandhā…pe… dve khandhe…pe…. (1)

56. Dependent on a phenomenon conjoined with ties and a phenomenon disjoined from ties, a phenomenon conjoined with ties arises by way of root condition: dependent on one aggregate conjoined with ties and the base, three aggregates arise…pe… two aggregates…pe… dependent on one aggregate accompanied by greed disjoined from wrong view, the base, and greed, three aggregates arise…pe… two aggregates…pe… dependent on one aggregate accompanied by displeasure, the base, and aversion, three aggregates arise…pe… two aggregates…pe…. (1)

Ganthasampayuttañca ganthavippayuttañca dhammaṃ paccayā ganthavippayutto dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – ganthasampayutte [T 3.0315] khandhe ca mahābhūte ca paccayā cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ, diṭṭhigatavippayuttalobhasahagate khandhe ca lobhañca paccayā cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ, domanassasahagate khandhe ca paṭighañca paccayā cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ, diṭṭhigatavippayuttalobhasahagate khandhe ca vatthuñca paccayā lobho, domanassasahagate khandhe ca vatthuñca paccayā paṭighaṃ. (2)

Dependent on a phenomenon conjoined with ties and a phenomenon disjoined from ties, a phenomenon disjoined from ties arises by way of root condition: dependent on aggregates conjoined with ties and the great elements, mind-originated materiality arises; dependent on aggregates accompanied by greed disjoined from wrong view, and greed, mind-originated materiality arises; dependent on aggregates accompanied by displeasure, and aversion, mind-originated materiality arises; dependent on aggregates accompanied by greed disjoined from wrong view and the base, greed arises; dependent on aggregates accompanied by displeasure and the base, aversion arises. (2)

Ganthasampayuttañca ganthavippayuttañca dhammaṃ paccayā ganthasampayutto ca ganthavippayutto ca dhammā uppajjanti hetupaccayā – ganthasampayuttaṃ ekaṃ khandhañca vatthuñca paccayā tayo khandhā…pe… dve khandhe…pe… ganthasampayutte khandhe ca mahābhūte ca paccayā cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ, diṭṭhigatavippayuttalobhasahagataṃ ekaṃ khandhañca lobhañca paccayā tayo khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ…pe… dve khandhe…pe… domanassasahagataṃ ekaṃ khandhañca paṭighañca paccayā tayo khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ…pe… dve khandhe…pe… diṭṭhigatavippayuttalobhasahagataṃ ekaṃ khandhañca vatthuñca paccayā tayo khandhā lobho ca…pe… dve khandhe…pe… domanassasahagataṃ ekaṃ khandhañca vatthuñca paccayā tayo khandhā paṭighañca…pe… dve khandhe…pe… (saṃkhittaṃ). (3)

Dependent on a phenomenon conjoined with ties and a phenomenon disjoined from ties, both a phenomenon conjoined with ties and a phenomenon disjoined from ties arise by way of root condition: dependent on one aggregate conjoined with ties and the base, three aggregates arise…pe… two aggregates…pe… dependent on aggregates conjoined with ties and the great elements, mind-originated materiality arises; dependent on one aggregate accompanied by greed disjoined from wrong view, and greed, three aggregates and mind-originated materiality arise…pe… two aggregates…pe… dependent on one aggregate accompanied by displeasure, and aversion, three aggregates and mind-originated materiality arise…pe… two aggregates…pe… dependent on one aggregate accompanied by greed disjoined from wrong view and the base, three aggregates and greed arise…pe… two aggregates…pe… dependent on one aggregate accompanied by displeasure and the base, three aggregates and aversion arise…pe… two aggregates…pe… (in brief). (3)

62. Ganthasampayuttaṃ [V 3.0337] dhammaṃ saṃsaṭṭho ganthasampayutto dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – ganthasampayuttaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ saṃsaṭṭhā tayo khandhā…pe… dve khandhe…pe…. (1)

62. Concomitant with a state associated with fetters, a state associated with fetters arises by root condition: concomitant with one aggregate associated with fetters, three aggregates arise… two aggregates… (1)

Ganthasampayuttaṃ dhammaṃ saṃsaṭṭho ganthavippayutto [T 3.0317] dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – diṭṭhigatavippayuttalobhasahagate khandhe saṃsaṭṭho lobho, domanassasahagate khandhe saṃsaṭṭhaṃ paṭighaṃ. (2)

Concomitant with a state associated with fetters, a state dissociated from fetters arises by root condition: greed is concomitant with the aggregates accompanied by greed but dissociated from wrong view; aversion is concomitant with the aggregates accompanied by displeasure. (2)

Ganthasampayuttaṃ dhammaṃ saṃsaṭṭho ganthasampayutto ca ganthavippayutto ca dhammā uppajjanti hetupaccayā – diṭṭhigatavippayuttalobhasahagataṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ saṃsaṭṭhā tayo khandhā lobho ca…pe… dve khandhe…pe… domanassasahagataṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ saṃsaṭṭhā tayo khandhā paṭighañca…pe… dve khandhe…pe…. (3)

Concomitant with a state associated with fetters, states both associated with and dissociated from fetters arise by root condition: three aggregates and greed are concomitant with one aggregate accompanied by greed but dissociated from wrong view… two aggregates…; three aggregates and aversion are concomitant with one aggregate accompanied by displeasure… two aggregates… (3)

63. Ganthavippayuttaṃ dhammaṃ saṃsaṭṭho ganthavippayutto dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – ganthavippayuttaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ saṃsaṭṭhā tayo khandhā…pe… dve khandhe…pe… paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe…. (1)

63. Concomitant with a state dissociated from fetters, a state dissociated from fetters arises by root condition: concomitant with one aggregate dissociated from fetters, three aggregates arise… two aggregates… at the moment of rebirth-linking… (1)

Ganthavippayuttaṃ [V 3.0338] dhammaṃ saṃsaṭṭho ganthasampayutto dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – diṭṭhigatavippayuttaṃ lobhaṃ saṃsaṭṭhā sampayuttakā khandhā, paṭighaṃ saṃsaṭṭhā sampayuttakā khandhā. (2)

Concomitant with a state dissociated from fetters, a state associated with fetters arises by root condition: associated aggregates are concomitant with greed dissociated from wrong view; associated aggregates are concomitant with aversion. (2)

Ganthasampayuttañca ganthavippayuttañca dhammaṃ saṃsaṭṭho ganthasampayutto dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – diṭṭhigatavippayuttaṃ lobhasahagataṃ ekaṃ khandhañca lobhañca [M 3.0275] saṃsaṭṭhā tayo khandhā…pe… dve khandhe…pe… domanassasahagataṃ ekaṃ khandhañca paṭighañca saṃsaṭṭhā tayo khandhā…pe… dve khandhe…pe… (saṃkhittaṃ).

Concomitant with a state that is both associated with and dissociated from fetters, a state associated with fetters arises by root condition: three aggregates are concomitant with one aggregate accompanied by greed but dissociated from wrong view and with greed itself… two aggregates…; three aggregates are concomitant with one aggregate accompanied by displeasure and with aversion itself… two aggregates… (abbreviated).
