66. Nahetuyā [V 3.0339] ekaṃ, naadhipatiyā cha, napurejāte cha, napacchājāte cha, naāsevane cha, nakamme cattāri, navipāke cha, najhāne ekaṃ, namagge ekaṃ, navippayutte cha.

66. Not by root condition: one; not by predominance condition: six; not by prenascence condition: six; not by postnascence condition: six; not by repetition condition: six; not by kamma condition: four; not by result condition: six; not by jhāna condition: one; not by path condition: one; not by dissociation condition: six.

3. Paccayānulomapaccanīyaṃ

3. Affirmative-Negative

67. Hetupaccayā naadhipatiyā cha, napurejāte cha, napacchājāte cha, naāsevane cha, nakamme cattāri, navipāke cha, navippayutte cha.

67. By root condition, not by predominance condition: six; not by prenascence condition: six; not by postnascence condition: six; not by repetition condition: six; not by kamma condition: four; not by result condition: six; not by dissociation condition: six.

4. Paccayapaccanīyānulomaṃ

4. Negative-Affirmative

68. Nahetupaccayā [M 3.0276] ārammaṇe ekaṃ, anantare ekaṃ…pe… avigate ekaṃ.

68. Not by root condition, by object condition: one; by contiguity condition: one… and so on… by non-disappearance condition: one.

6. Sampayuttavāro

6. The Section on Conjunction

(Sampayuttavāro saṃsaṭṭhavārasadiso).

(The Section on Conjunction is similar to the Section on Concomitance).

7. Pañhāvāro

7. Question Section

1. Paccayānulomaṃ

1. Affirmative

1. Vibhaṅgavāro

1. The Chapter on Differentiation

Hetupaccayo

Root Condition

69. Ganthasampayutto dhammo ganthasampayuttassa dhammassa hetupaccayena paccayo – ganthasampayuttā hetū sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ hetupaccayena paccayo. (1)

69. A state associated with fetters is a condition for a state associated with fetters by root condition. Roots associated with fetters are a condition for the associated aggregates by root condition. (1)

Ganthasampayutto [V 3.0340] dhammo ganthavippayuttassa dhammassa hetupaccayena paccayo – ganthasampayuttā hetū cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ hetupaccayena paccayo; diṭṭhigatavippayuttalobhasahagato hetu lobhassa cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ hetupaccayena paccayo; domanassasahagato hetu paṭighassa cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ hetupaccayena paccayo. (2)

A state associated with fetters is a condition for a state dissociated from fetters by root condition. Roots associated with fetters are a condition for mind-originated material phenomena by root condition. A root accompanied by greed, dissociated from wrong view, is a condition for greed and for mind-originated material phenomena by root condition. A root accompanied by displeasure is a condition for aversion and for mind-originated material phenomena by root condition. (2)

Ganthasampayutto dhammo ganthasampayuttassa ca ganthavippayuttassa ca dhammassa hetupaccayena paccayo – ganthasampayuttā [T 3.0319] hetū sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ hetupaccayena paccayo; diṭṭhigatavippayuttalobhasahagato hetu sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ lobhassa ca cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ hetupaccayena paccayo; domanassasahagato hetu sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ paṭighassa ca cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ hetupaccayena paccayo. (3)

A state associated with fetters is a condition for a state associated with fetters and for a state dissociated from fetters by root condition. Roots associated with fetters are a condition for the associated aggregates and for mind-originated material phenomena by root condition. A root accompanied by greed, dissociated from wrong view, is a condition for the associated aggregates, for greed, and for mind-originated material phenomena by root condition. A root accompanied by displeasure is a condition for the associated aggregates, for aversion, and for mind-originated material phenomena by root condition. (3)

70. Ganthavippayutto dhammo ganthavippayuttassa dhammassa hetupaccayena paccayo – ganthavippayuttā hetū sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ [M 3.0277] hetupaccayena paccayo; diṭṭhigatavippayutto lobho cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ hetupaccayena paccayo; paṭighaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ hetupaccayena paccayo; paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe…. (1)

70. A state dissociated from fetters is a condition for a state dissociated from fetters by root condition. Roots dissociated from fetters are a condition for the associated aggregates and for mind-originated material phenomena by root condition. Greed dissociated from wrong view is a condition for mind-originated material phenomena by root condition. Aversion is a condition for mind-originated material phenomena by root condition. At the moment of rebirth-linking… and so on. (1)

Ganthavippayutto dhammo ganthasampayuttassa dhammassa hetupaccayena paccayo – diṭṭhigatavippayutto lobho sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ hetupaccayena paccayo; paṭighaṃ sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ hetupaccayena paccayo. (2)

A state dissociated from fetters is a condition for a state associated with fetters by root condition. Greed dissociated from wrong view is a condition for the associated aggregates by root condition. Aversion is a condition for the associated aggregates by root condition. (2)

Ganthavippayutto dhammo ganthasampayuttassa ca ganthavippayuttassa ca dhammassa hetupaccayena paccayo – diṭṭhigatavippayutto lobho sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ hetupaccayena paccayo; paṭighaṃ sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ hetupaccayena paccayo. (3)

A state dissociated from fetters is a condition for a state associated with fetters and for a state dissociated from fetters by root condition. Greed dissociated from wrong view is a condition for the associated aggregates and for mind-originated material phenomena by root condition. Aversion is a condition for the associated aggregates and for mind-originated material phenomena by root condition. (3)

71. Ganthasampayutto ca ganthavippayutto ca dhammā ganthasampayuttassa dhammassa hetupaccayena paccayo – diṭṭhigatavippayuttalobhasahagato hetu ca lobho ca sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ hetupaccayena [T 3.0320][V 3.0341] paccayo; domanassasahagato hetu ca paṭighañca sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ hetupaccayena paccayo. (1)

71. A state associated with fetters and a state dissociated from fetters are a condition for a state associated with fetters by root condition. The root accompanied by greed, dissociated from wrong view, and greed are a condition for the associated aggregates by root condition. The root accompanied by displeasure and aversion are a condition for the associated aggregates by root condition. (1)

Ganthasampayutto ca ganthavippayutto ca dhammā ganthavippayuttassa dhammassa hetupaccayena paccayo – diṭṭhigatavippayuttalobhasahagato hetu ca lobho ca cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ hetupaccayena paccayo; domanassasahagato hetu ca paṭighañca cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ hetupaccayena paccayo. (2)

A state associated with fetters and a state dissociated from fetters are a condition for a state dissociated from fetters by root condition. The root accompanied by greed, dissociated from wrong view, and greed are a condition for mind-originated material phenomena by root condition. The root accompanied by displeasure and aversion are a condition for mind-originated material phenomena by root condition. (2)

Ganthasampayutto ca ganthavippayutto ca dhammā ganthasampayuttassa ca ganthavippayuttassa ca dhammassa hetupaccayena paccayo – diṭṭhigatavippayuttalobhasahagato hetu ca lobho ca sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ hetupaccayena paccayo; domanassasahagato hetu ca paṭighañca sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ hetupaccayena paccayo. (3)

A state associated with fetters and a state dissociated from fetters are a condition for a state associated with fetters and for a state dissociated from fetters by root condition. The root accompanied by greed, dissociated from wrong view, and greed are a condition for the associated aggregates and for mind-originated material phenomena by root condition. The root accompanied by displeasure and aversion are a condition for the associated aggregates and for mind-originated material phenomena by root condition. (3)

Ārammaṇapaccayo

Object Condition

72. Ganthasampayutto dhammo ganthasampayuttassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo – ganthasampayutte khandhe ārabbha ganthasampayuttakā khandhā uppajjanti[M 3.0278]. (Tīsupi mūlā pucchitabbā) ganthasampayutte khandhe ārabbha ganthavippayuttā khandhā uppajjanti, ganthasampayutte khandhe ārabbha diṭṭhigatavippayuttalobhasahagatā khandhā ca lobho ca uppajjanti, domanassasahagatā khandhā ca paṭighañca uppajjanti. (3)

72. A state associated with fetters is a condition for a state associated with fetters by object condition: taking as object the aggregates associated with fetters, aggregates associated with fetters arise. (The three questions should be asked.) Taking as object the aggregates associated with fetters, aggregates dissociated from fetters arise. Taking as object the aggregates associated with fetters, aggregates accompanied by greed dissociated from wrong view and greed arise, and aggregates accompanied by displeasure and aversion arise. (3)

73. Ganthavippayutto dhammo ganthavippayuttassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo – dānaṃ datvā sīlaṃ…pe… uposathakammaṃ [T 3.0321] katvā taṃ paccavekkhati, pubbe suciṇṇāni paccavekkhati, jhānā vuṭṭhahitvā jhānaṃ paccavekkhati, ariyā maggā vuṭṭhahitvā maggaṃ paccavekkhanti, phalaṃ paccavekkhanti, nibbānaṃ paccavekkhanti, nibbānaṃ gotrabhussa, vodānassa, maggassa, phalassa, āvajjanāya ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo; ariyā ganthavippayutte pahīne kilese paccavekkhanti, vikkhambhite kilese paccavekkhanti, pubbe samudāciṇṇe kilese jānanti, cakkhuṃ…pe… vatthuṃ ganthavippayutte khandhe ca lobhañca paṭighañca aniccato…pe… vipassati, assādeti abhinandati[V 3.0342], taṃ ārabbha ganthavippayutto rāgo uppajjati, vicikicchā…pe… uddhaccaṃ…pe… domanassaṃ uppajjati, dibbena cakkhunā rūpaṃ passati, dibbāya sotadhātuyā saddaṃ suṇāti, cetopariyañāṇena ganthavippayuttacittasamaṅgissa cittaṃ jānāti, ākāsānañcāyatanaṃ viññāṇañcāyatanassa…pe… ākiñcaññāyatanaṃ nevasaññānāsaññāyatanassa…pe… rūpāyatanaṃ cakkhuviññāṇassa…pe… phoṭṭhabbāyatanaṃ kāyaviññāṇassa…pe… ganthavippayuttā khandhā iddhividhañāṇassa, cetopariyañāṇassa, pubbenivāsānussatiñāṇassa, yathākammūpagañāṇassa, anāgataṃsañāṇassa, āvajjanāya ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo. (1)

73. A phenomenon dissociated from fetters is a condition for a phenomenon dissociated from fetters by way of Object Condition: Having given alms, observed morality, etc., performed the Uposatha observance, one reflects upon that. One reflects upon past good deeds. Emerging from jhāna, one reflects upon the jhāna. The noble ones, emerging from the path, reflect upon the path, reflect upon the fruit, reflect upon Nibbāna. Nibbāna is an Object Condition for lineage-change, purification, the path, the fruit, and for advertence. The noble ones reflect upon the abandoned defilements dissociated from fetters, reflect upon the suppressed defilements, and know the previously accumulated defilements. One contemplates as impermanent, etc., the eye, etc., the base, the aggregates dissociated from fetters, greed, and aversion; one delights in and rejoices in that. Taking that as object, greed dissociated from fetters arises, doubt, etc., restlessness, etc., displeasure arises. With the divine eye, one sees forms. With the divine ear element, one hears sounds. With telepathic knowledge, one knows the mind of one possessing a mind dissociated from fetters. The base of boundless space is an Object Condition for the base of boundless consciousness, etc.; the base of nothingness for the base of neither-perception-nor-non-perception, etc.; the form base for eye-consciousness, etc.; the tangible base for body-consciousness, etc. The aggregates dissociated from fetters are an Object Condition for the knowledge of psychic power, telepathic knowledge, knowledge of recollection of past lives, knowledge of the passing away and reappearance of beings according to their kamma, knowledge of the future, and for advertence. (1)

Ganthavippayutto dhammo ganthasampayuttassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo – dānaṃ datvā sīlaṃ…pe… uposathakammaṃ…pe… pubbe…pe… jhānā…pe… taṃ assādeti abhinandati, taṃ ārabbha ganthasampayutto rāgo uppajjati… diṭṭhi uppajjati… domanassaṃ uppajjati [T 3.0322] (saṃkhittaṃ). (2)

A phenomenon dissociated from fetters is a condition for a phenomenon associated with fetters by way of Object Condition: One delights in and rejoices in having given alms, observed morality..., performed the Uposatha observance..., past good deeds..., jhāna... Taking that as object, greed associated with fetters arises, wrong view arises, displeasure arises (abbreviated). (2)

Ganthavippayutto dhammo ganthasampayuttassa ca ganthavippayuttassa ca dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo – cakkhuṃ…pe… vatthuṃ ganthavippayutte khandhe ca lobhañca paṭighañca ārabbha diṭṭhigatavippayuttalobhasahagatā khandhā ca lobho ca domanassasahagatā khandhā ca paṭighañca uppajjanti. (3)

A phenomenon dissociated from fetters is a condition for phenomena both associated with fetters and dissociated from fetters by way of Object Condition: Taking as object the eye, etc., the base, the aggregates dissociated from fetters, greed, and aversion, aggregates accompanied by greed dissociated from views and greed arise, and aggregates accompanied by displeasure and aversion arise. (3)

74. Ganthasampayutto [M 3.0279] ca ganthavippayutto ca dhammā ganthasampayuttassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo – diṭṭhigatavippayuttalobhasahagate khandhe ca lobhañca domanassasahagate khandhe ca paṭighañca ārabbha ganthasampayuttakā khandhā uppajjanti. (Mūlaṃ pucchitabbaṃ) diṭṭhigatavippayuttalobhasahagate khandhe ca lobhañca domanassasahagate khandhe ca paṭighañca ārabbha ganthavippayuttā khandhā uppajjanti, diṭṭhigatavippayuttalobhasahagate khandhe ca lobhañca domanassasahagate khandhe ca paṭighañca ārabbha diṭṭhigatavippayuttalobhasahagatā khandhā ca lobho ca domanassasahagatā khandhā ca paṭighañca uppajjanti. (3)

74. Phenomena both associated with fetters and dissociated from fetters are a condition for a phenomenon associated with fetters by way of Object Condition: Taking as object the aggregates accompanied by greed dissociated from views and greed, and the aggregates accompanied by displeasure and aversion, aggregates associated with fetters arise. (The root should be investigated.) Taking as object the aggregates accompanied by greed dissociated from views and greed, and the aggregates accompanied by displeasure and aversion, aggregates dissociated from fetters arise. Taking as object the aggregates accompanied by greed dissociated from views and greed, and the aggregates accompanied by displeasure and aversion, aggregates accompanied by greed dissociated from views and greed, and aggregates accompanied by displeasure and aversion arise. (3)

Adhipatipaccayo

Predominance Condition

75. Ganthasampayutto [V 3.0343] dhammo ganthasampayuttassa dhammassa adhipatipaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇādhipati, sahajātādhipati. Ārammaṇādhipati – ganthasampayutte khandhe garuṃ katvā ganthasampayuttakā khandhā uppajjanti. Sahajātādhipati – ganthasampayuttādhipati sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ adhipatipaccayena paccayo. (1)

75. A phenomenon associated with fetters is a condition for a phenomenon associated with fetters by way of Predominance Condition: Object Predominance, Co-arisen Predominance. Object Predominance: Having regarded the aggregates associated with fetters as important, aggregates associated with fetters arise. Co-arisen Predominance: A predominant factor associated with fetters is a condition for the associated aggregates by way of Predominance Condition. (1)

Ganthasampayutto dhammo ganthavippayuttassa dhammassa adhipatipaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇādhipati[T 3.0323], sahajātādhipati. Ārammaṇādhipati – ganthasampayutte khandhe garuṃ katvā diṭṭhigatavippayutto lobho uppajjati. Sahajātādhipati – ganthasampayuttādhipati cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ adhipatipaccayena paccayo; diṭṭhigatavippayuttalobhasahagatādhipati lobhassa ca cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ adhipatipaccayena paccayo; domanassasahagatādhipati paṭighassa ca cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ adhipatipaccayena paccayo. (2)

A phenomenon associated with fetters is a condition for a phenomenon dissociated from fetters by way of Predominance Condition: Object Predominance, Co-arisen Predominance. Object Predominance: Having regarded the aggregates associated with fetters as important, greed dissociated from views arises. Co-arisen Predominance: A predominant factor associated with fetters is a condition for mind-originated material phenomena by way of Predominance Condition. A predominant factor accompanied by greed dissociated from views is a condition for greed and for mind-originated material phenomena by way of Predominance Condition. A predominant factor accompanied by displeasure is a condition for aversion and for mind-originated material phenomena by way of Predominance Condition. (2)

Ganthasampayutto dhammo ganthasampayuttassa ca ganthavippayuttassa ca dhammassa adhipatipaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇādhipati, sahajātādhipati. Ārammaṇādhipati – ganthasampayutte khandhe garuṃ katvā diṭṭhigatavippayuttalobhasahagatā khandhā ca lobho ca uppajjanti. Sahajātādhipati – diṭṭhigatavippayuttalobhasahagatādhipati sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ lobhassa ca cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ adhipatipaccayena paccayo; domanassasahagatādhipati sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ paṭighassa ca cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ adhipatipaccayena paccayo.(3)

A phenomenon associated with fetters is a condition for phenomena both associated with fetters and dissociated from fetters by way of Predominance Condition: Object Predominance, Co-arisen Predominance. Object Predominance: Having regarded the aggregates associated with fetters as important, aggregates accompanied by greed dissociated from views and greed arise. Co-arisen Predominance: A predominant factor accompanied by greed dissociated from views is a condition for the associated aggregates, for greed, and for mind-originated material phenomena by way of Predominance Condition. A predominant factor accompanied by displeasure is a condition for the associated aggregates, for aversion, and for mind-originated material phenomena by way of Predominance Condition. (3)

76. Ganthavippayutto [M 3.0280] dhammo ganthavippayuttassa dhammassa adhipatipaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇādhipati, sahajātādhipati. Ārammaṇādhipati – dānaṃ…pe… sīlaṃ…pe… uposathakammaṃ katvā taṃ garuṃ katvā paccavekkhati, pubbe suciṇṇāni garuṃ katvā paccavekkhati, jhānā vuṭṭhahitvā jhānaṃ garuṃ katvā paccavekkhati, ariyā maggā vuṭṭhahitvā maggaṃ garuṃ katvā paccavekkhanti, phalā vuṭṭhahitvā phalaṃ garuṃ katvā paccavekkhanti[T 3.0324], nibbānaṃ garuṃ katvā paccavekkhanti, nibbānaṃ gotrabhussa, vodānassa, maggassa, phalassa adhipatipaccayena paccayo; cakkhuṃ…pe… vatthuṃ ganthavippayutte khandhe ca lobhañca garuṃ katvā assādeti [V 3.0344] abhinandati, taṃ garuṃ katvā ganthavippayutto rāgo uppajjati. Sahajātādhipati – ganthavippayuttādhipati sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ adhipatipaccayena paccayo. (1)

76. A phenomenon dissociated from fetters is a condition for a phenomenon dissociated from fetters by way of Predominance Condition: Object Predominance, Co-arisen Predominance. Object Predominance: Having given alms..., observed morality..., performed the Uposatha observance, one reflects upon it, regarding it as important. One reflects upon past good deeds, regarding them as important. Emerging from jhāna, one reflects upon the jhāna, regarding it as important. The noble ones, emerging from the path, reflect upon the path, regarding it as important; emerging from fruition, they reflect upon the fruition, regarding it as important; they reflect upon Nibbāna, regarding it as important. Nibbāna is a condition for change-of-lineage, purification, the path, and fruition by way of Predominance Condition. Regarding as important the eye..., the base..., the aggregates dissociated from fetters, and greed, one savors and delights in them. Regarding that as important, greed dissociated from fetters arises. Co-arisen Predominance: A predominant factor dissociated from fetters is a condition for its associated aggregates and for mind-originated material phenomena by way of Predominance Condition. (1)

Ganthavippayutto dhammo ganthasampayuttassa dhammassa adhipatipaccayena paccayo. Ārammaṇādhipati – dānaṃ…pe… sīlaṃ…pe… uposathakammaṃ…pe… pubbe suciṇṇāni…pe… jhānā vuṭṭhahitvā jhānaṃ…pe… cakkhuṃ…pe… vatthuṃ ganthavippayutte khandhe ca lobhañca garuṃ katvā assādeti abhinandati, taṃ garuṃ katvā ganthasampayutto rāgo uppajjati… diṭṭhi uppajjati. (2)

A phenomenon dissociated from fetters is a condition for a phenomenon associated with fetters by way of Predominance Condition. Object Predominance: Regarding as important, one savors and delights in: alms...; morality...; the Uposatha observance...; past good deeds...; jhāna, after emerging from it...; the eye...; the base; the aggregates dissociated from fetters, and greed. Regarding that as important, greed associated with fetters arises... wrong view arises. (2)

Ganthavippayutto dhammo ganthasampayuttassa ca ganthavippayuttassa ca dhammassa adhipatipaccayena paccayo. Ārammaṇādhipati – cakkhuṃ…pe… vatthuṃ ganthavippayutte khandhe ca lobhañca garuṃ katvā diṭṭhigatavippayuttalobhasahagatā khandhā ca lobho ca uppajjanti. (3)

A phenomenon dissociated from fetters is a condition for a phenomenon both associated with fetters and dissociated from fetters by way of Predominance Condition. Object Predominance: Regarding as important the eye..., the base, the aggregates dissociated from fetters, and greed, there arise aggregates accompanied by greed dissociated from wrong view, and the greed itself. (3)

77. Ganthasampayutto ca ganthavippayutto ca dhammā ganthasampayuttassa dhammassa adhipatipaccayena paccayo. Ārammaṇādhipati – diṭṭhigatavippayuttalobhasahagate khandhe ca lobhañca garuṃ katvā ganthasampayuttakā khandhā uppajjanti. (Mūlā pucchitabbā) diṭṭhigatavippayuttalobhasahagate khandhe ca lobhañca garuṃ katvā diṭṭhigatavippayutto lobho uppajjati. (Mūlā pucchitabbā) diṭṭhigatavippayuttalobhasahagate [T 3.0325] khandhe ca lobhañca garuṃ katvā diṭṭhigatavippayuttalobhasahagatā khandhā ca lobho ca uppajjanti. (3)

77. Phenomena both associated with fetters and dissociated from fetters are a condition for a phenomenon associated with fetters by way of Predominance Condition. Object Predominance: Regarding as important the aggregates accompanied by greed dissociated from wrong view and the greed, aggregates associated with fetters arise. (The roots should be asked.) Regarding as important the aggregates accompanied by greed dissociated from wrong view and the greed, greed dissociated from wrong view arises. (The roots should be asked.) Regarding as important the aggregates accompanied by greed dissociated from wrong view and the greed, aggregates accompanied by greed dissociated from wrong view and the greed arise. (3)

Anantarapaccayo

Contiguity Condition

78. Ganthasampayutto [M 3.0281] dhammo ganthasampayuttassa dhammassa anantarapaccayena paccayo – purimā purimā ganthasampayuttā khandhā pacchimānaṃ pacchimānaṃ ganthasampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ anantarapaccayena paccayo. (Mūlā pucchitabbā) purimā purimā diṭṭhigatavippayuttalobhasahagatā khandhā pacchimassa pacchimassa diṭṭhigatavippayuttassa lobhassa anantarapaccayena paccayo; purimā purimā domanassasahagatā khandhā pacchimassa pacchimassa paṭighassa anantarapaccayena paccayo; ganthasampayuttā [V 3.0345] khandhā vuṭṭhānassa anantarapaccayena paccayo. (Mūlā pucchitabbā) purimā purimā diṭṭhigatavippayuttalobhasahagatā khandhā pacchimānaṃ pacchimānaṃ diṭṭhigatavippayuttalobhasahagatānaṃ khandhānaṃ lobhassa ca anantarapaccayena paccayo; purimā purimā domanassasahagatā khandhā pacchimānaṃ pacchimānaṃ domanassasahagatānaṃ khandhānaṃ paṭighassa ca anantarapaccayena paccayo. (3)

78. A phenomenon associated with fetters is a condition for a phenomenon associated with fetters by way of Contiguity Condition: preceding aggregates associated with fetters are a condition for succeeding aggregates associated with fetters by way of Contiguity Condition. (The roots should be asked.) Preceding aggregates accompanied by greed dissociated from wrong view are a condition for succeeding greed dissociated from wrong view by way of Contiguity Condition; preceding aggregates accompanied by displeasure are a condition for succeeding aversion by way of Contiguity Condition; aggregates associated with fetters are a condition for emergence by way of Contiguity Condition. (The roots should be asked.) Preceding aggregates accompanied by greed dissociated from wrong view are a condition for succeeding aggregates accompanied by greed dissociated from wrong view and for the greed by way of Contiguity Condition; preceding aggregates accompanied by displeasure are a condition for succeeding aggregates accompanied by displeasure and for the aversion by way of Contiguity Condition. (3)

79. Ganthavippayutto dhammo ganthavippayuttassa dhammassa anantarapaccayena paccayo – purimo purimo diṭṭhigatavippayutto lobho pacchimassa pacchimassa diṭṭhigatavippayuttassa lobhassa anantarapaccayena paccayo; purimaṃ purimaṃ paṭighaṃ pacchimassa pacchimassa paṭighassa anantarapaccayena paccayo; purimā purimā ganthavippayuttā khandhā pacchimānaṃ [T 3.0326] pacchimānaṃ ganthavippayuttānaṃ khandhānaṃ anantarapaccayena paccayo; anulomaṃ gotrabhussa…pe… phalasamāpattiyā anantarapaccayena paccayo. (1)

79. A phenomenon dissociated from fetters is a condition for a phenomenon dissociated from fetters by way of Contiguity Condition: preceding greed dissociated from wrong view is a condition for succeeding greed dissociated from wrong view by way of Contiguity Condition; preceding aversion is a condition for succeeding aversion by way of Contiguity Condition; preceding aggregates dissociated from fetters are a condition for succeeding aggregates dissociated from fetters by way of Contiguity Condition; adaptation is a condition for change-of-lineage... and for the attainment of fruition by way of Contiguity Condition. (1)

Ganthavippayutto dhammo ganthasampayuttassa dhammassa anantarapaccayena paccayo – purimo purimo diṭṭhigatavippayutto lobho pacchimānaṃ pacchimānaṃ diṭṭhigatavippayuttalobhasahagatānaṃ khandhānaṃ anantarapaccayena paccayo; purimaṃ purimaṃ paṭighaṃ pacchimānaṃ pacchimānaṃ domanassasahagatānaṃ khandhānaṃ anantarapaccayena paccayo; āvajjanā ganthasampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ anantarapaccayena paccayo. (2)

A phenomenon dissociated from fetters is a condition for a phenomenon associated with fetters by way of Contiguity Condition: preceding greed dissociated from wrong view is a condition for succeeding aggregates accompanied by greed dissociated from wrong view by way of Contiguity Condition; preceding aversion is a condition for succeeding aggregates accompanied by displeasure by way of Contiguity Condition; advertence is a condition for aggregates associated with fetters by way of Contiguity Condition. (2)

Ganthavippayutto dhammo ganthasampayuttassa ca ganthavippayuttassa ca dhammassa anantarapaccayena paccayo – purimo purimo diṭṭhigatavippayutto lobho pacchimānaṃ pacchimānaṃ diṭṭhigatavippayuttalobhasahagatānaṃ khandhānaṃ lobhassa ca anantarapaccayena [M 3.0282] paccayo; purimaṃ purimaṃ paṭighaṃ pacchimānaṃ pacchimānaṃ domanassasahagatānaṃ khandhānaṃ paṭighassa ca anantarapaccayena paccayo; āvajjanā diṭṭhigatavippayuttalobhasahagatānaṃ khandhānaṃ lobhassa ca domanassasahagatānaṃ khandhānaṃ paṭighassa ca anantarapaccayena paccayo. (3)

A state dissociated from fetters is a condition for a state associated with fetters and for a state dissociated from fetters by way of the immediately contiguous condition: the preceding greed dissociated from wrong view is an immediately contiguous condition for the succeeding aggregates accompanied by greed dissociated from wrong view and for greed; the preceding aversion is an immediately contiguous condition for the succeeding aggregates accompanied by displeasure and for aversion; advertence is an immediately contiguous condition for the aggregates accompanied by greed dissociated from wrong view and for greed, and for the aggregates accompanied by displeasure and for aversion. (3)

80. Ganthasampayutto ca ganthavippayutto ca dhammā ganthasampayuttassa dhammassa anantarapaccayena paccayo – purimā purimā diṭṭhigatavippayuttalobhasahagatā khandhā ca lobho ca pacchimānaṃ pacchimānaṃ diṭṭhigatavippayuttalobhasahagatānaṃ khandhānaṃ anantarapaccayena paccayo; purimā [V 3.0346] purimā domanassasahagatā khandhā ca paṭighañca pacchimānaṃ [T 3.0327] pacchimānaṃ domanassasahagatānaṃ khandhānaṃ anantarapaccayena paccayo. (Mūlā pucchitabbā) purimā purimā diṭṭhigatavippayuttalobhasahagatā khandhā ca lobho ca pacchimassa pacchimassa diṭṭhigatavippayuttassa lobhassa anantarapaccayena paccayo; purimā purimā domanassasahagatā khandhā ca paṭighañca pacchimassa pacchimassa paṭighassa anantarapaccayena paccayo; diṭṭhigatavippayuttalobhasahagatā khandhā ca lobho ca domanassasahagatā khandhā ca paṭighañca vuṭṭhānassa anantarapaccayena paccayo. (Mūlā pucchitabbā) purimā purimā diṭṭhigatavippayuttalobhasahagatā khandhā ca lobho ca pacchimānaṃ pacchimānaṃ diṭṭhigatavippayuttalobhasahagatānaṃ khandhānaṃ lobhassa ca anantarapaccayena paccayo; purimā purimā domanassasahagatā khandhā ca paṭighañca pacchimānaṃ pacchimānaṃ domanassasahagatānaṃ khandhānaṃ paṭighassa ca anantarapaccayena paccayo. (3)

80. States associated with fetters and states dissociated from fetters are a condition for a state associated with fetters by way of the immediately contiguous condition: the preceding aggregates accompanied by greed dissociated from wrong view and greed are an immediately contiguous condition for the succeeding aggregates accompanied by greed dissociated from wrong view; the preceding aggregates accompanied by displeasure and aversion are an immediately contiguous condition for the succeeding aggregates accompanied by displeasure. (The roots should be asked.) The preceding aggregates accompanied by greed dissociated from wrong view and greed are an immediately contiguous condition for the succeeding greed dissociated from wrong view; the preceding aggregates accompanied by displeasure and aversion are an immediately contiguous condition for the succeeding aversion; the aggregates accompanied by greed dissociated from wrong view and greed, and the aggregates accompanied by displeasure and aversion, are an immediately contiguous condition for emergence. (The roots should be asked.) The preceding aggregates accompanied by greed dissociated from wrong view and greed are an immediately contiguous condition for the succeeding aggregates accompanied by greed dissociated from wrong view and for greed; the preceding aggregates accompanied by displeasure and aversion are an immediately contiguous condition for the succeeding aggregates accompanied by displeasure and for aversion. (3)

Samanantarapaccayādi

Immediately Contiguous Condition, etc.

81. Ganthasampayutto dhammo ganthasampayuttassa dhammassa samanantarapaccayena paccayo… sahajātapaccayena paccayo… aññamaññapaccayena paccayo… nissayapaccayena paccayo.

81. A state associated with fetters is a condition for a state associated with fetters by way of the immediately contiguous condition… by way of the co-nascence condition… by way of the mutuality condition… by way of the support condition.

Upanissayapaccayo

Decisive Support Condition

82. Ganthasampayutto dhammo ganthasampayuttassa dhammassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇūpanissayo, anantarūpanissayo, pakatūpanissayo…pe…. Pakatūpanissayo – ganthasampayuttā khandhā ganthasampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ upanissayapaccayena paccayo. (Mūlaṃ pucchitabbaṃ[T 3.0328], tīṇipi [M 3.0283] upanissayā) ganthasampayuttā khandhā ganthavippayuttānaṃ khandhānaṃ upanissayapaccayena paccayo. (Mūlaṃ, tīṇipi upanissayā) ganthasampayuttā khandhā diṭṭhigatavippayuttalobhasahagatānaṃ khandhānaṃ lobhassa ca upanissayapaccayena paccayo; domanassasahagatānaṃ khandhānaṃ paṭighassa ca upanissayapaccayena paccayo. (3)

82. A state associated with fetters is a condition for a state associated with fetters by way of decisive support condition—object decisive support, immediately proximate decisive support, natural decisive support… Natural decisive support: the aggregates associated with fetters are a condition for the aggregates associated with fetters by way of decisive support condition. (The root should be questioned; all three kinds of decisive support apply.) The aggregates associated with fetters are a condition for the aggregates dissociated from fetters by way of decisive support condition. (The root, and all three kinds of decisive support apply.) The aggregates associated with fetters are a condition for the aggregates accompanied by greed dissociated from wrong view, and for greed, by way of decisive support condition; they are a condition for the aggregates accompanied by displeasure, and for aversion, by way of decisive support condition. (3)

83. Ganthavippayutto dhammo ganthavippayuttassa dhammassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇūpanissayo, anantarūpanissayo, pakatūpanissayo…pe…. Pakatūpanissayo – saddhaṃ upanissāya dānaṃ deti…pe… samāpattiṃ uppādeti… mānaṃ jappeti… sīlaṃ…pe… paññaṃ [V 3.0347]… rāgaṃ… dosaṃ… mohaṃ… mānaṃ… patthanaṃ… kāyikaṃ sukhaṃ… kāyikaṃ dukkhaṃ… utuṃ… bhojanaṃ… senāsanaṃ upanissāya dānaṃ deti…pe… samāpattiṃ uppādeti… pāṇaṃ hanati…pe… saṅghaṃ bhindati; saddhā…pe… paññā, rāgo…pe… patthanā…pe… senāsanaṃ saddhāya…pe… paññāya… rāgassa… dosassa… mohassa… mānassa… patthanāya…pe… phalasamāpattiyā upanissayapaccayena paccayo. (1)

83. A state dissociated from fetters is a condition for a state dissociated from fetters by way of decisive support condition—object decisive support, immediately proximate decisive support, natural decisive support… Natural decisive support: relying on faith, one gives alms… attains meditative absorption… indulges in conceit… observes morality… develops wisdom… clings to lust… hatred… delusion… conceit… forms aspirations… experiences bodily pleasure… bodily pain… depending on climate… food… lodging, one gives alms… attains meditative absorption… kills living beings… splits the Saṅgha; faith… wisdom, lust… aspirations… lodging are conditions for faith… wisdom… lust… hatred… delusion… conceit… aspirations… and the attainment of fruition by way of decisive support condition. (1)

Ganthavippayutto dhammo ganthasampayuttassa dhammassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇūpanissayo, anantarūpanissayo, pakatūpanissayo…pe…. Pakatūpanissayo – saddhaṃ upanissāya mānaṃ jappeti, diṭṭhiṃ gaṇhāti; sīlaṃ…pe… paññaṃ… rāgaṃ…pe… mānaṃ… patthanaṃ…pe… senāsanaṃ upanissāya pāṇaṃ hanati…pe… saṅghaṃ bhindati; saddhā…pe… senāsanaṃ rāgassa… dosassa [T 3.0329]… mohassa… mānassa… diṭṭhiyā… patthanāya upanissayapaccayena paccayo. (2)

A state dissociated from fetters is a condition for a state associated with fetters by way of decisive support condition—object decisive support, immediately proximate decisive support, natural decisive support… Natural decisive support: relying on faith, one indulges in conceit, grasps wrong views; relying on virtue… wisdom… lust… conceit… aspirations… lodging, one kills living beings… splits the Saṅgha; faith… lodging are conditions for lust… hatred… delusion… conceit… wrong view… aspirations by way of decisive support condition. (2)

Ganthavippayutto dhammo ganthasampayuttassa ca ganthavippayuttassa ca dhammassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo (tīṇi upanissayā); saddhaṃ upanissāya mānaṃ jappeti; sīlaṃ…pe… paññaṃ… rāgaṃ… dosaṃ… mohaṃ… mānaṃ… patthanaṃ… kāyikaṃ sukhaṃ…pe… senāsanaṃ upanissāya pāṇaṃ hanati…pe… saṅghaṃ bhindati; saddhā…pe… paññā… rāgo… doso… moho… māno… patthanā…pe… senāsanaṃ diṭṭhigatavippayuttalobhasahagatānaṃ khandhānaṃ lobhassa ca domanassasahagatānaṃ khandhānaṃ paṭighassa ca upanissayapaccayena paccayo. (3)

A state dissociated from ties is a condition for a state associated with ties and for a state dissociated from ties by way of decisive support condition (three kinds of decisive support); relying on faith, one indulges in conceit; relying on virtue…pe… wisdom… lust… hatred… delusion… conceit… aspirations… bodily pleasure…pe… lodging, one kills living beings…pe… splits the Saṅgha; faith…pe… wisdom… lust… hatred… delusion… conceit… aspirations…pe… lodging are conditions by way of decisive support condition for the aggregates dissociated from wrong view but accompanied by greed, and for greed; and for the aggregates accompanied by displeasure, and for aversion. (3)

84. Ganthasampayutto ca ganthavippayutto ca dhammā ganthasampayuttassa dhammassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇūpanissayo, anantarūpanissayo, pakatūpanissayo [M 3.0284]…pe…. Pakatūpanissayo – diṭṭhigatavippayuttalobhasahagatā khandhā ca lobho ca domanassasahagatā khandhā ca paṭighañca ganthasampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ upanissayapaccayena paccayo. (Mūlaṃ kātabbaṃ) diṭṭhigatavippayuttalobhasahagatā khandhā ca lobho ca domanassasahagatā khandhā ca paṭighañca ganthavippayuttānaṃ khandhānaṃ diṭṭhigatavippayuttalobhassa ca paṭighassa ca upanissayapaccayena paccayo. (Mūlaṃ pucchitabbaṃ) diṭṭhigatavippayuttalobhasahagatā khandhā ca lobho [V 3.0348] ca domanassasahagatā khandhā ca paṭighañca diṭṭhigatavippayuttalobhasahagatānaṃ khandhānaṃ lobhassa ca domanassasahagatānaṃ khandhānaṃ paṭighassa [T 3.0330] ca upanissayapaccayena paccayo. (3)

84. States that are associated with ties and states that are dissociated from ties are a condition for states associated with ties by way of decisive support condition—object decisive support, immediately proximate decisive support, natural decisive support …pe…. Natural decisive support: the aggregates accompanied by greed dissociated from wrong view and greed, and the aggregates accompanied by displeasure and aversion, are a condition for the aggregates associated with ties by way of decisive support condition. (The root should be supplied.) The aggregates accompanied by greed dissociated from wrong view and greed, and the aggregates accompanied by displeasure and aversion, are a condition for the aggregates dissociated from ties, and for greed dissociated from wrong view and aversion, by way of decisive support condition. (The root should be questioned.) The aggregates accompanied by greed dissociated from wrong view and greed, and the aggregates accompanied by displeasure and aversion, are a condition for the aggregates accompanied by greed dissociated from wrong view, and for greed, and for the aggregates accompanied by displeasure, and for aversion, by way of decisive support condition. (3)

Purejātapaccayo

Pre-nascence Condition

85. Ganthavippayutto dhammo ganthavippayuttassa dhammassa purejātapaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇapurejātaṃ, vatthupurejātaṃ. Ārammaṇapurejātaṃ – cakkhuṃ…pe… vatthuṃ aniccato vipassati, assādeti abhinandati, taṃ ārabbha ganthavippayutto rāgo uppajjati, vicikicchā…pe… uddhaccaṃ…pe… domanassaṃ uppajjati; dibbena cakkhunā rūpaṃ passati, dibbāya sotadhātuyā saddaṃ suṇāti. Rūpāyatanaṃ cakkhuviññāṇassa…pe… phoṭṭhabbāyatanaṃ kāyaviññāṇassa…pe…. Vatthupurejātaṃ – cakkhāyatanaṃ cakkhuviññāṇassa…pe… kāyāyatanaṃ kāyaviññāṇassa…pe… vatthu ganthavippayuttānaṃ khandhānaṃ diṭṭhigatavippayuttassa lobhassa ca paṭighassa ca purejātapaccayena paccayo. (1)

85. A state dissociated from the ties is a condition for a state dissociated from the ties by way of the pre-nascence condition—object pre-nascence, base pre-nascence. Object pre-nascence: one discerns the eye…pe… and the base as impermanent, delights in it, rejoices in it; based on that, greed dissociated from the ties arises, doubt…pe… agitation…pe… displeasure arises; with the divine eye one sees forms, with the divine ear-element one hears sounds. The form base is a condition for eye-consciousness…pe… the tangible base is a condition for body-consciousness…pe…. Base pre-nascence: the eye base is a condition for eye-consciousness…pe… the body base is a condition for body-consciousness…pe… the base is a condition for the aggregates dissociated from the ties, and for greed dissociated from wrong view and for aversion, by way of the pre-nascence condition. (1)

Ganthavippayutto dhammo ganthasampayuttassa dhammassa purejātapaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇapurejātaṃ, vatthupurejātaṃ. Ārammaṇapurejātaṃ – cakkhuṃ…pe… vatthuṃ assādeti abhinandati, taṃ ārabbha ganthasampayutto rāgo uppajjati, diṭṭhi…pe… domanassaṃ uppajjati. Vatthupurejātaṃ – vatthu ganthasampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ purejātapaccayena paccayo. (2)

A state dissociated from the ties is a condition for a state associated with the ties by way of the pre-nascence condition—object pre-nascence, base pre-nascence. Object pre-nascence: one delights in the eye…pe… and the base, rejoices in it; based on that, greed associated with the ties arises, wrong view…pe… displeasure arises. Base pre-nascence: the base is a condition for the aggregates associated with the ties by way of the pre-nascence condition. (2)

Ganthavippayutto dhammo ganthasampayuttassa ca ganthavippayuttassa ca dhammassa purejātapaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇapurejātaṃ, vatthupurejātaṃ. Ārammaṇapurejātaṃ – cakkhuṃ…pe… vatthuṃ ārabbha diṭṭhigatavippayuttalobhasahagatā khandhā ca lobho ca domanassasahagatā khandhā ca paṭighañca uppajjanti[T 3.0331]. Vatthupurejātaṃ – vatthu diṭṭhigatavippayuttalobhasahagatānaṃ khandhānaṃ [M 3.0285] lobhassa ca domanassasahagatānaṃ khandhānaṃ paṭighassa ca purejātapaccayena paccayo. (3)

A state dissociated from the ties is a condition for both a state associated with the ties and a state dissociated from the ties by way of the pre-nascence condition—object pre-nascence, base pre-nascence. Object pre-nascence: based on the eye…pe… and the base, the aggregates accompanied by greed dissociated from wrong view, and greed, and the aggregates accompanied by displeasure, and aversion, arise. Base pre-nascence: the base is a condition for the aggregates accompanied by greed dissociated from wrong view, and for greed, and for the aggregates accompanied by displeasure, and for aversion, by way of the pre-nascence condition. (3)

Pacchājātapaccayo

Post-nascence Condition

86. Ganthasampayutto dhammo ganthavippayuttassa dhammassa pacchājātapaccayena paccayo… ekaṃ.

86. A state associated with the ties is a condition for a state dissociated from the ties by way of the post-nascence condition… one.

Ganthavippayutto [V 3.0349] dhammo ganthavippayuttassa dhammassa pacchājātapaccayena paccayo… ekaṃ.

A state dissociated from the ties is a condition for a state dissociated from the ties by way of the post-nascence condition… one.

Ganthasampayutto ca ganthavippayutto ca dhammā ganthavippayuttassa dhammassa pacchājātapaccayena paccayo – pacchājātā diṭṭhigatavippayuttalobhasahagatā khandhā ca lobho ca domanassasahagatā khandhā ca paṭighañca purejātassa imassa kāyassa pacchājātapaccayena paccayo. (1)

States associated with the ties and states dissociated from the ties are a condition for a state dissociated from the ties by way of the post-nascence condition. The post-nascent aggregates accompanied by greed dissociated from wrong view, and greed; and the aggregates accompanied by displeasure, and aversion, are a condition for this pre-nascent body by way of the post-nascence condition. (1)

Āsevanapaccayo

Repetition Condition

87. Ganthasampayutto dhammo ganthasampayuttassa dhammassa āsevanapaccayena paccayo (anantarasadisaṃ, āvajjanāpi vuṭṭhānampi natthi).

87. A state associated with the ties is a condition for a state associated with the ties by way of the repetition condition (similar to the contiguity condition; there is no adverting or arising here).

Kammapaccayo

Kamma-condition

88. Ganthasampayutto dhammo ganthasampayuttassa dhammassa kammapaccayena paccayo – ganthasampayuttā cetanā sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ kammapaccayena paccayo. (1)

88. A state associated with the ties is a condition for a state associated with the ties by way of the kamma-condition—volition associated with the ties is a condition for the associated aggregates by way of the kamma-condition. (1)

Ganthasampayutto dhammo ganthavippayuttassa dhammassa kammapaccayena paccayo – sahajātā, nānākkhaṇikā. Sahajātā – ganthasampayuttā cetanā cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ kammapaccayena paccayo; diṭṭhigatavippayuttalobhasahagatā cetanā lobhassa ca cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ kammapaccayena paccayo; domanassasahagatā [T 3.0332] cetanā paṭighassa ca cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ kammapaccayena paccayo. Nānākkhaṇikā – ganthasampayuttā cetanā vipākānaṃ khandhānaṃ kaṭattā ca rūpānaṃ kammapaccayena paccayo. (2)

A state associated with the ties is a condition for a state dissociated from the ties by way of kamma-condition—conascently and at different moments. Conascently—volition associated with the ties is a condition for mind-produced materiality by way of kamma-condition; volition accompanied by greed dissociated from wrong view is a condition for greed and for mind-produced materiality by way of kamma-condition; volition accompanied by displeasure is a condition for aversion and for mind-produced materiality by way of kamma-condition. At different moments—volition associated with the ties is a condition for resultant aggregates and for kamma-produced materiality by way of kamma-condition. (2)

Ganthasampayutto dhammo ganthasampayuttassa ca ganthavippayuttassa ca dhammassa kammapaccayena paccayo – ganthasampayuttā cetanā sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañca [M 3.0286] rūpānaṃ kammapaccayena paccayo; diṭṭhigatavippayuttalobhasahagatā cetanā sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ lobhassa ca cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ kammapaccayena paccayo; domanassasahagatā cetanā sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ paṭighassa ca cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ kammapaccayena paccayo. (3)

A state associated with the ties is a condition for states associated with the ties and for states dissociated from the ties by way of kamma-condition—volition associated with the ties is a condition for the associated aggregates and for mind-produced materiality by way of kamma-condition; volition accompanied by greed dissociated from wrong view is a condition for the associated aggregates, for greed, and for mind-produced materiality by way of kamma-condition; volition accompanied by displeasure is a condition for the associated aggregates, for aversion, and for mind-produced materiality by way of kamma-condition. (3)

89. Ganthavippayutto [V 3.0350] dhammo ganthavippayuttassa dhammassa kammapaccayena paccayo – sahajātā, nānākkhaṇikā. Sahajātā – ganthavippayuttā cetanā sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ kammapaccayena paccayo; paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe…. Nānākkhaṇikā – ganthavippayuttā cetanā vipākānaṃ khandhānaṃ kaṭattā ca rūpānaṃ kammapaccayena paccayo. (1)

89. A state dissociated from the ties is a condition for a state dissociated from the ties by way of kamma-condition—conascently and at different moments. Conascently—volition dissociated from the ties is a condition for the associated aggregates and for mind-produced materiality by way of kamma-condition; at the moment of relinking… and so on. At different moments—volition dissociated from the ties is a condition for resultant aggregates and for kamma-produced materiality by way of kamma-condition. (1)

Vipākapaccayādi

Result-condition, etc.

90. Ganthavippayutto dhammo ganthavippayuttassa dhammassa vipākapaccayena paccayo… ekaṃ.

90. A state dissociated from the ties is a condition for a state dissociated from the ties by way of result-condition; one.

Ganthasampayutto dhammo ganthasampayuttassa dhammassa āhārapaccayena paccayo… cattāri… indriyapaccayena paccayo… cattāri… jhānapaccayena paccayo… cattāri… maggapaccayena paccayo [T 3.0333]… cattāri… sampayuttapaccayena paccayo… cha.

A state associated with the ties is a condition for a state associated with the ties by way of nutriment-condition… four… by way of faculty-condition… four… by way of jhāna-condition… four… by way of path-condition… four… by way of association-condition… six.

Vippayuttapaccayo

dissociation-condition

91. Ganthasampayutto dhammo ganthavippayuttassa dhammassa vippayuttapaccayena paccayo – sahajātaṃ, pacchājātaṃ (saṃkhittaṃ, vibhajitabbaṃ). (1)

91. A state associated with the ties is a condition for a state dissociated from the ties by way of dissociation-condition—co-arising, post-arising (in brief, to be distinguished). (1)

Ganthavippayutto dhammo ganthavippayuttassa dhammassa vippayuttapaccayena paccayo – sahajātaṃ, purejātaṃ, pacchājātaṃ (saṃkhittaṃ). (1)

A state dissociated from the ties is a condition for a state dissociated from the ties by way of dissociation-condition—co-arising, pre-arising, post-arising (in brief). (1)

Ganthavippayutto dhammo ganthasampayuttassa dhammassa vippayuttapaccayena paccayo. Purejātaṃ – vatthu ganthasampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ vippayuttapaccayena paccayo. (2)

A state dissociated from the ties is a condition for a state associated with the ties by way of dissociation-condition. Pre-arising—the physical base is a condition for the aggregates associated with the ties by way of dissociation-condition. (2)

Ganthavippayutto dhammo ganthasampayuttassa ca ganthavippayuttassa ca dhammassa vippayuttapaccayena paccayo. Purejātaṃ – vatthu diṭṭhigatavippayuttalobhasahagatānaṃ khandhānaṃ lobhassa ca domanassasahagatānaṃ khandhānaṃ paṭighassa ca vippayuttapaccayena paccayo. (3)

A state dissociated from the ties is a condition for states associated with the ties and states dissociated from the ties by way of dissociation-condition. Pre-arising—the physical base is a condition by way of dissociation-condition for the aggregates accompanied by greed dissociated from wrong view, for greed, and for the aggregates accompanied by displeasure and for aversion. (3)

92. Ganthasampayutto [M 3.0287] ca ganthavippayutto ca dhammā ganthavippayuttassa dhammassa vippayuttapaccayena [V 3.0351] paccayo – sahajātaṃ, pacchājātaṃ. Sahajātā – diṭṭhigatavippayuttalobhasahagatā khandhā ca lobho ca cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ vippayuttapaccayena paccayo; domanassasahagatā khandhā ca paṭighañca cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ vippayuttapaccayena paccayo. Pacchājātā – diṭṭhigatavippayuttalobhasahagatā khandhā ca lobho ca domanassasahagatā khandhā ca paṭighañca purejātassa imassa kāyassa vippayuttapaccayena paccayo. (1)

92. States both associated with the ties and dissociated from the ties are a condition for a state dissociated from the ties by way of dissociation-condition—co-arising, post-arising. Co-arising—the aggregates accompanied by greed dissociated from wrong view and greed are a condition for mind-produced materiality by way of dissociation-condition; the aggregates accompanied by displeasure and aversion are a condition for mind-produced materiality by way of dissociation-condition. Post-arising—the aggregates accompanied by greed dissociated from wrong view and greed, and the aggregates accompanied by displeasure and aversion, are a condition for this pre-arisen body by way of dissociation-condition. (1)

Atthipaccayo

presence-condition

93. Ganthasampayutto dhammo ganthasampayuttassa dhammassa atthipaccayena [T 3.0334] paccayo… ekaṃ (paṭiccasadisaṃ). (1)

93. A state associated with the ties is a condition for a state associated with the ties by way of presence-condition… one (similar to the Dependence section). (1)

Ganthasampayutto dhammo ganthavippayuttassa dhammassa atthipaccayena paccayo – sahajātaṃ, pacchājātaṃ (saṃkhittaṃ, vibhajitabbaṃ). (2)

A state associated with the ties is a condition for a state dissociated from the ties by way of presence-condition—co-arising, post-arising (in brief, to be distinguished). (2)

Ganthasampayutto dhammo ganthasampayuttassa ca ganthavippayuttassa ca dhammassa atthipaccayena paccayo… ekaṃ (paṭiccasadisaṃ). (3)

A state associated with the ties is a condition for states associated with the ties and for states dissociated from the ties by way of presence-condition… one (similar to the Dependence section). (3)

94. Ganthavippayutto dhammo ganthavippayuttassa dhammassa atthipaccayena paccayo – sahajātaṃ, purejātaṃ, pacchājātaṃ, āhāraṃ, indriyaṃ (saṃkhittaṃ, vibhajitabbaṃ). (1)

94. A state dissociated from the ties is a condition for a state dissociated from the ties by way of presence-condition—co-arising, pre-arising, post-arising, nutriment, faculty (in brief, to be distinguished). (1)

Ganthavippayutto dhammo ganthasampayuttassa dhammassa atthipaccayena paccayo – sahajātaṃ, purejātaṃ. Sahajāto – diṭṭhigatavippayutto lobho sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo; domanassasahagataṃ paṭighaṃ sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo. Purejātaṃ – cakkhuṃ…pe… vatthuṃ assādeti abhinandati, taṃ ārabbha ganthasampayutto rāgo…pe… diṭṭhi…pe… domanassaṃ uppajjati, vatthu ganthasampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo. (2)

A state dissociated from the ties is a condition for a state associated with the ties by way of presence-condition—co-arising, pre-arising. Co-arising—greed dissociated from wrong view is a condition for the associated aggregates by way of presence-condition; aversion accompanied by displeasure is a condition for the associated aggregates by way of presence-condition. Pre-arising—the eye… the physical base is savored and delighted in, and dependent on that, tie-associated lust… wrong view… displeasure arise. The physical base is a condition for the aggregates associated with the ties by way of presence-condition. (2)

Ganthavippayutto dhammo ganthasampayuttassa ca ganthavippayuttassa ca dhammassa atthipaccayena paccayo [V 3.0352] – sahajātaṃ, purejātaṃ. Sahajāto – diṭṭhigatavippayutto lobho sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo; paṭighaṃ sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ [M 3.0288] atthipaccayena paccayo. Purejātaṃ – cakkhuṃ…pe… vatthuṃ ārabbha diṭṭhigatavippayuttalobhasahagatā khandhā ca lobho ca domanassasahagatā khandhā ca paṭighañca [T 3.0335] uppajjanti, vatthu diṭṭhigatavippayuttalobhasahagatānaṃ khandhānaṃ lobhassa ca domanassasahagatānaṃ khandhānaṃ paṭighassa ca atthipaccayena paccayo. (3)

A state dissociated from ties is a condition for states associated with ties and for states dissociated from ties by way of Presence-condition—co-arising, pre-arising. Co-arising—greed dissociated from wrong view is a condition by way of Presence-condition for the associated aggregates and for mind-originated material form; aversion is a condition by way of Presence-condition for the associated aggregates and for mind-originated material form. Pre-arising—dependent on the eye…the physical base, the aggregates accompanied by greed dissociated from wrong view and greed, and the aggregates accompanied by displeasure and aversion arise. The physical base is a condition by way of Presence-condition for the aggregates accompanied by greed dissociated from wrong view, for greed, for the aggregates accompanied by displeasure, and for aversion.

95. Ganthasampayutto ca ganthavippayutto ca dhammā ganthasampayuttassa dhammassa atthipaccayena paccayo – sahajātaṃ, purejātaṃ. Sahajāto – ganthasampayutto eko khandho ca vatthu ca tiṇṇannaṃ khandhānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo…pe… dve khandhā ca…pe…. Sahajāto – diṭṭhigatavippayuttalobhasahagato eko khandho ca lobho ca tiṇṇannaṃ khandhānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo…pe… dve khandhā ca…pe… domanassasahagato eko khandho ca paṭighañca tiṇṇannaṃ khandhānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo…pe… dve khandhā ca…pe…. (1)

95. States associated with ties and dissociated from ties are a condition for a state associated with ties by way of Presence-condition—co-arising, pre-arising. Co-arising—one aggregate associated with ties and the physical base are a condition for the three aggregates by way of Presence-condition…etc.… two aggregates…etc.… Co-arising—one aggregate accompanied by greed dissociated from wrong view and greed are a condition for the three aggregates by way of Presence-condition…etc.… two aggregates…etc.… one aggregate accompanied by displeasure and aversion are a condition for the three aggregates by way of Presence-condition…etc.… two aggregates…etc.…

Ganthasampayutto ca ganthavippayutto ca dhammā ganthavippayuttassa dhammassa atthipaccayena paccayo – sahajātaṃ, purejātaṃ, pacchājātaṃ, āhāraṃ, indriyaṃ. Sahajātā – ganthasampayuttā khandhā ca mahābhūtā ca cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo. Sahajātā – diṭṭhigatavippayuttalobhasahagatā khandhā ca lobho ca cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo. Sahajātā – domanassasahagatā khandhā ca paṭighañca cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo; diṭṭhigatavippayuttalobhasahagatā khandhā ca vatthu ca lobhassa atthipaccayena paccayo; domanassasahagatā khandhā ca vatthu ca paṭighassa atthipaccayena paccayo. Pacchājātā – diṭṭhigatavippayuttalobhasahagatā khandhā ca lobho ca domanassasahagatā khandhā ca paṭighañca [T 3.0336] purejātassa imassa kāyassa atthipaccayena paccayo. Pacchājātā – ganthasampayuttā khandhā ca kabaḷīkāro āhāro ca imassa kāyassa atthipaccayena paccayo. Pacchājātā – ganthasampayuttā khandhā ca rūpajīvitindriyañca kaṭattārūpānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo. (2)

States associated with ties and dissociated from ties are a condition for a state dissociated from ties by way of Presence-condition—co-arising, pre-arising, post-arising, nutriment, faculty. Co-arising—the aggregates associated with ties and the great primary elements are a condition for mind-originated material form by way of Presence-condition. Co-arising—the aggregates accompanied by greed dissociated from wrong view and greed are a condition for mind-originated material form by way of Presence-condition. Co-arising—the aggregates accompanied by displeasure and aversion are a condition for mind-originated material form by way of Presence-condition; the aggregates accompanied by greed dissociated from wrong view and the physical base are a condition for greed by way of Presence-condition; the aggregates accompanied by displeasure and the physical base are a condition for aversion by way of Presence-condition. Post-arising—the aggregates accompanied by greed dissociated from wrong view and greed, and the aggregates accompanied by displeasure and aversion, are a condition for this pre-arisen body by way of Presence-condition. Post-arising—the aggregates associated with ties and nutriment in the form of edible food are a condition for this body by way of Presence-condition. Post-arising—the aggregates associated with ties and the material life faculty are a condition for kamma-originated material form by way of Presence-condition.

Ganthasampayutto ca ganthavippayutto ca dhammā ganthasampayuttassa ca ganthavippayuttassa ca dhammassa [V 3.0353] atthipaccayena paccayo – sahajātaṃ, purejātaṃ. Sahajāto – diṭṭhigatavippayuttalobhasahagato eko khandho ca lobho [M 3.0289] ca tiṇṇannaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo…pe… dve khandhā ca…pe…. Sahajāto – domanassasahagato eko khandho ca paṭighañca tiṇṇannaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo…pe… dve khandhā ca…pe…. Sahajāto – diṭṭhigatavippayuttalobhasahagato eko khandho ca vatthu ca tiṇṇannaṃ khandhānaṃ lobhassa ca atthipaccayena paccayo…pe… dve khandhā ca…pe…. Sahajāto – domanassasahagato eko khandho ca vatthu ca tiṇṇannaṃ khandhānaṃ paṭighassa ca atthipaccayena paccayo…pe… dve khandhā ca…pe…. (3)

States associated with ties and dissociated from ties are a condition for states associated with ties and for states dissociated from ties by way of Presence-condition—co-arising, pre-arising. Co-arising—one aggregate accompanied by greed dissociated from wrong view and greed are a condition for the three aggregates and for mind-originated material form by way of Presence-condition…etc.… two aggregates…etc.… Co-arising—one aggregate accompanied by displeasure and aversion are a condition for the three aggregates and for mind-originated material form by way of Presence-condition…etc.… two aggregates…etc.… Co-arising—one aggregate accompanied by greed dissociated from wrong view and the physical base are a condition for the three aggregates and for greed by way of Presence-condition…etc.… two aggregates…etc.… Co-arising—one aggregate accompanied by displeasure and the physical base are a condition for the three aggregates and for aversion by way of Presence-condition…etc.… two aggregates…etc.…

Hetuyā nava, ārammaṇe nava, adhipatiyā nava, anantare nava, samanantare nava, sahajāte nava, aññamaññe cha, nissaye nava, upanissaye nava, purejāte tīṇi, pacchājāte tīṇi, āsevane nava, kamme cattāri, vipāke ekaṃ, āhāre cattāri[T 3.0337], indriye cattāri, jhāne cattāri, magge cattāri, sampayutte cha, vippayutte pañca, atthiyā nava, natthiyā nava, vigate nava, avigate nava.

96. By root condition, nine; by object condition, nine; by dominance condition, nine; by contiguity condition, nine; by immediate contiguity condition, nine; by co-nascence condition, nine; by reciprocity condition, six; by dependence condition, nine; by decisive support condition, nine; by pre-nascence condition, three; by post-nascence condition, three; by habituation condition, nine; by kamma condition, four; by result condition, one; by nutriment condition, four; by faculty condition, four; by absorption condition, four; by path condition, four; by association condition, six; by dissociation condition, five; by presence condition, nine; by absence condition, nine; by disappearance condition, nine; by non-disappearance condition, nine.

97. Ganthasampayutto dhammo ganthasampayuttassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo… sahajātapaccayena paccayo… upanissayapaccayena paccayo. (1)

97. A state associated with ties is a condition for a state associated with ties by way of object condition... by way of co-nascence condition... by way of decisive support condition.

Ganthasampayutto dhammo ganthavippayuttassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo… sahajātapaccayena [V 3.0354] paccayo… upanissayapaccayena paccayo… pacchājātapaccayena paccayo… kammapaccayena paccayo. (2)

A state associated with ties is a condition for a state dissociated from ties by way of object condition... by way of co-nascence condition... by way of decisive support condition... by way of post-nascence condition... by way of kamma condition.

Ganthasampayutto dhammo ganthasampayuttassa ca ganthavippayuttassa ca dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo… sahajātapaccayena paccayo… upanissayapaccayena paccayo. (3)

A state associated with ties is a condition for a state associated with ties and for a state dissociated from ties by way of object condition... by way of co-nascence condition... by way of decisive support condition.

98. Ganthavippayutto [M 3.0290] dhammo ganthavippayuttassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo… sahajātapaccayena paccayo… upanissayapaccayena paccayo… purejātapaccayena paccayo… pacchājātapaccayena paccayo… kammapaccayena paccayo… āhārapaccayena paccayo… indriyapaccayena paccayo. (1)

98. A state dissociated from ties is a condition for a state dissociated from ties by way of object condition... by way of co-nascence condition... by way of decisive support condition... by way of pre-nascence condition... by way of post-nascence condition... by way of kamma condition... by way of nutriment condition... by way of faculty condition. (1)

Ganthavippayutto dhammo ganthasampayuttassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo… sahajātapaccayena paccayo… upanissayapaccayena paccayo… purejātapaccayena paccayo. (2)

A state dissociated from ties is a condition for a state associated with ties by way of object condition... by way of co-nascence condition... by way of decisive support condition... by way of pre-nascence condition. (2)

Ganthavippayutto dhammo ganthasampayuttassa ca ganthavippayuttassa ca dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo… sahajātapaccayena [T 3.0338] paccayo… upanissayapaccayena paccayo… purejātapaccayena paccayo. (3)

A state dissociated from ties is a condition for a state associated with ties and a state dissociated from ties by way of object condition... by way of co-nascence condition... by way of decisive support condition... by way of pre-nascence condition. (3)

99. Ganthasampayutto ca ganthavippayutto ca dhammā ganthasampayuttassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo… sahajātapaccayena paccayo… upanissayapaccayena paccayo. (1)

99. States associated with ties and states dissociated from ties are a condition for a state associated with ties by way of object condition... by way of co-nascence condition... by way of decisive support condition. (1)

Ganthasampayutto ca ganthavippayutto ca dhammā ganthavippayuttassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo… sahajātapaccayena paccayo… upanissayapaccayena paccayo… pacchājātapaccayena paccayo. (2)

States associated with ties and states dissociated from ties are a condition for a state dissociated from ties by way of object condition... by way of co-nascence condition... by way of decisive support condition... by way of post-nascence condition. (2)

Ganthasampayutto ca ganthavippayutto ca dhammā ganthasampayuttassa ca ganthavippayuttassa ca dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo… sahajātapaccayena paccayo… upanissayapaccayena paccayo. (3)

States associated with ties and states dissociated from ties are a condition for a state associated with ties and for a state dissociated from ties by way of object condition… by way of co-nascence condition… by way of decisive support condition. (3)

29. The Dyad of Ties and What is Tied

1. Paṭiccavāro

Hetupaccayo

Root Condition

103. Ganthañceva [T 3.0339][V 3.0356] ganthaniyañca dhammaṃ paṭicca gantho ceva ganthaniyo ca dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – sīlabbataparāmāsaṃ kāyaganthaṃ paṭicca abhijjhākāyagantho, abhijjhākāyaganthaṃ paṭicca sīlabbataparāmāso kāyagantho, idaṃsaccābhinivesakāyaganthaṃ paṭicca abhijjhākāyagantho, abhijjhākāyaganthaṃ paṭicca idaṃsaccābhinivesakāyagantho. (1)

103. Dependent on a state that is both a tie and what is tied, a state that is both a tie and what is tied arises by way of root condition: dependent on the bodily tie of attachment to rites and rituals, the bodily tie of covetousness arises; dependent on the bodily tie of covetousness, the bodily tie of attachment to rites and rituals arises; dependent on the bodily tie of clinging to ‘this alone is the truth’, the bodily tie of covetousness arises; and dependent on the bodily tie of covetousness, the bodily tie of clinging to ‘this alone is the truth’ arises. (1)

Ganthañceva ganthaniyañca dhammaṃ paṭicca ganthaniyo ceva no ca gantho dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – ganthe paṭicca sampayuttakā khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ. (2)

Dependent on a state that is both a tie and what is tied, a state that is what is tied but not a tie arises by way of root condition: dependent on the ties, the associated aggregates and mind-originated matter arise. (2)

Ganthañceva ganthaniyañca dhammaṃ paṭicca gantho ceva ganthaniyo ca ganthaniyo ceva no ca gantho ca dhammā uppajjanti hetupaccayā. (1)

Dependent on a state that is both a tie and what is tied, states that are both a tie and what is tied, and states that are what is tied but not a tie, arise by way of root condition. (1)

Hetupaccayo

Root Condition

104. Gantho [M 3.0292][V 3.0357] ceva ganthaniyo ca dhammo ganthassa ceva ganthaniyassa ca dhammassa hetupaccayena paccayo – ganthā hetū sampayuttakānaṃ ganthānaṃ hetupaccayena paccayo (evaṃ nava pañhā vitthāretabbā).

104. A state that is both a tie and what is tied is a condition for a state that is both a tie and what is tied by way of root condition—the ties that are roots are a condition for the associated ties by way of root condition (thus, the nine questions should be elaborated in full).

Ārammaṇapaccayo

Object Condition

105. Gantho ceva ganthaniyo ca dhammo ganthassa ceva ganthaniyassa ca dhammassa [T 3.0340] ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo – ganthe ārabbha ganthā uppajjanti. (Mūlaṃ pucchitabbaṃ) ganthe ārabbha ganthaniyā ceva no ca ganthā khandhā uppajjanti. (Mūlaṃ pucchitabbaṃ) ganthe ārabbha ganthā ca sampayuttakā ca khandhā uppajjanti. (3)

105. A state that is both a fetter and what is to be bound is a condition for a state that is both a fetter and what is to be bound by way of object condition—dependent on a fetter, fetters arise. (The root should be questioned.) Dependent on a fetter, aggregates that are to be bound but are not fetters arise. (The root should be questioned.) Dependent on a fetter, fetters and associated aggregates arise. (3)

106. Ganthaniyo ceva no ca gantho dhammo ganthaniyassa ceva no ca ganthassa ca dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo – dānaṃ…pe… sīlaṃ…pe… uposathakammaṃ katvā taṃ paccavekkhati, pubbe suciṇṇāni…pe… jhānā…pe… ariyā gotrabhuṃ paccavekkhanti, vodānaṃ paccavekkhanti, pahīne kilese…pe… vikkhambhite kilese paccavekkhanti, pubbe samudāciṇṇe kilese jānanti, cakkhuṃ…pe… vatthuṃ ganthaniye ceva no ca ganthe khandhe aniccato…pe… domanassaṃ uppajjati; dibbena cakkhunā rūpaṃ passati, dibbāya sotadhātuyā saddaṃ suṇāti. (Sabbaṃ vitthāretabbaṃ) āvajjanāya ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo. (1)

106. A state that is to be bound but not a fetter is a condition for a state that is to be bound but not a fetter by way of object condition—having performed giving… moral precepts… Uposatha observance, one reflects upon it; previously well-performed deeds… jhānas… the noble ones reflect on the change-of-lineage, reflect on purification, reflect on abandoned defilements… reflect on suppressed defilements; they know previously accumulated defilements; the eye… the base, aggregates that are to be bound but not fetters, as impermanent… sorrow arises; with the divine eye one sees forms, with the divine ear element one hears sounds. (All should be elaborated.) It is a condition for attention by way of object condition. (1)

Ganthaniyo ceva no ca gantho dhammo ganthassa ceva ganthaniyassa ca dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo – dānaṃ…pe… sīlaṃ…pe… uposathakammaṃ katvā taṃ assādeti abhinandati[V 3.0358], taṃ ārabbha rāgo uppajjati, diṭṭhi…pe… vicikicchā…pe… domanassaṃ uppajjati; pubbe suciṇṇāni…pe… jhānā vuṭṭhahitvā jhānaṃ…pe… cakkhuṃ…pe… vatthuṃ ganthaniye ceva no ca ganthe khandhe assādeti abhinandati, taṃ ārabbha rāgo uppajjati, diṭṭhi…pe… domanassaṃ uppajjati. (2)

A state that is to be bound but not a fetter is a condition for a state that is both a fetter and what is to be bound by way of object condition—having performed giving… moral precepts… Uposatha observance, one savors and rejoices in that; dependent on that, lust arises, wrong view… doubt… sorrow arises; previously well-performed deeds… having emerged from jhānas, one savors and rejoices in the jhāna… the eye… the base, aggregates that are to be bound but not fetters; dependent on that, lust arises, wrong view… sorrow arises. (2)

Ganthaniyo [M 3.0293] ceva no ca gantho dhammo ganthassa ceva ganthaniyassa ca ganthaniyassa ceva no ca ganthassa ca dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena [T 3.0341] paccayo – dānaṃ…pe… sīlaṃ…pe… uposathakammaṃ…pe… pubbe suciṇṇāni…pe… jhānā vuṭṭhahitvā jhānaṃ…pe… cakkhuṃ…pe… vatthuṃ ganthaniye ceva no ca ganthe khandhe assādeti abhinandati, taṃ ārabbha ganthā ca sampayuttakā ca khandhā uppajjanti (evaṃ itarepi tīṇi vitthāretabbā). (3)

A state that is to be bound but not a fetter is a condition for a state that is both a fetter and what is to be bound, and for a state that is to be bound but not a fetter, by way of object condition—having performed giving… moral precepts… Uposatha observance… previously well-performed deeds… having emerged from jhānas, one savors and rejoices in the jhāna… the eye… the base, aggregates that are to be bound but not fetters; dependent on that, fetters and associated aggregates arise (thus, the other three should also be elaborated). (3)

(Ārabbha kātabbā. Imasmiṃ duke lokuttaraṃ natthi, ganthadukasadisaṃ, ninnānākaraṇaṃ. “Ganthaniya”nti niyāmetabbaṃ, magge nava pañhā kātabbā.)

(It should be done with reference to an object. In this dyad, there is nothing supramundane; it is similar to the dyad of fetters, without distinctions. ‘That which is to be bound’ should be determined; nine questions should be made regarding the path.)

Ganthaganthaniyadukaṃ niṭṭhitaṃ.

The Dyad of the Fetter and That Which is to be Bound is concluded.

30. Ganthaganthasampayuttadukaṃ

30. The Dyad of the Fetter and That Which is Associated with a Fetter

1. Paṭiccavāro

1. The Section on Dependent Arising

1-4. Paccayacatukkaṃ

1-4. The Tetrad of Conditions

Hetupaccayo

Root condition.

107. Ganthañceva [V 3.0359] ganthasampayuttañca dhammaṃ paṭicca gantho ceva ganthasampayutto ca dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – sīlabbataparāmāsaṃ kāyaganthaṃ paṭicca abhijjhākāyagantho, abhijjhākāyaganthaṃ paṭicca sīlabbataparāmāso kāyagantho, idaṃsaccābhinivesakāyaganthaṃ paṭicca abhijjhākāyagantho, abhijjhākāyaganthaṃ paṭicca idaṃsaccābhiniveso kāyagantho. (1)

107. Dependent on a state that is both a fetter and associated with a fetter, a state that is both a fetter and associated with a fetter arises by way of root condition—dependent on the bodily fetter of clinging to rules and observances, the bodily fetter of covetousness arises; dependent on the bodily fetter of covetousness, the bodily fetter of clinging to rules and observances arises; dependent on the bodily fetter of insistence on ‘this is the truth’, the bodily fetter of covetousness arises; dependent on the bodily fetter of covetousness, the bodily fetter of insistence on ‘this is the truth’ arises. (1)

Ganthañceva ganthasampayuttañca dhammaṃ paṭicca ganthasampayutto ceva no ca gantho dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – ganthe paṭicca sampayuttakā khandhā. (2)

Dependent on a state that is both a fetter and associated with a fetter, a state that is associated with a fetter but not a fetter arises by way of root condition—dependent on the fetters, the associated aggregates arise. (2)

Ganthañceva ganthasampayuttañca dhammaṃ paṭicca gantho ceva ganthasampayutto ca ganthasampayutto ceva no ca gantho ca dhammā uppajjanti [T 3.0342] hetupaccayā – sīlabbataparāmāsaṃ kāyaganthaṃ paṭicca abhijjhākāyagantho sampayuttakā ca khandhā (cakkaṃ). (3)

Dependent on a state that is both a fetter and associated with a fetter, states that are both a fetter and associated with a fetter, and states that are associated with a fetter but not a fetter, arise by way of root condition—dependent on the bodily fetter of clinging to rules and observances, the bodily fetter of covetousness and the associated aggregates arise (the cycle). (3)

108. Ganthasampayuttañceva no ca ganthaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca ganthasampayutto ceva no ca gantho dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – ganthasampayuttañceva no ca ganthaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca tayo khandhā…pe… dve khandhe…pe…. (1)

108. Dependent on a state that is associated with a fetter but not a fetter, a state that is associated with a fetter but not a fetter arises by way of root condition—dependent on one aggregate that is associated with a fetter but not a fetter, three aggregates arise… dependent on two aggregates, two aggregates arise…. (1)

Ganthasampayuttañceva [M 3.0294][V 3.0360] no ca ganthaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca gantho ceva ganthasampayutto ca dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – ganthasampayutte ceva no ca ganthe khandhe paṭicca ganthā. (2)

Dependent on a state that is associated with a fetter but not a fetter, a state that is both a fetter and associated with a fetter arises by way of root condition—dependent on the aggregates that are associated with a fetter but not a fetter, fetters arise. (2)

Ganthasampayuttañceva no ca ganthaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca gantho ceva ganthasampayutto ca ganthasampayutto ceva no ca gantho ca dhammā uppajjanti hetupaccayā – ganthasampayuttañceva no ca ganthaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca tayo khandhā ganthā ca…pe… dve khandhe…pe…. (3)

Dependent on a state that is associated with a fetter but not a fetter, states that are both a fetter and associated with a fetter, and states that are associated with a fetter but not a fetter, arise by way of root condition—dependent on one aggregate that is associated with a fetter but not a fetter, three aggregates and the fetters arise… dependent on two aggregates, two aggregates and the fetters arise…. (3)

109. Ganthañceva ganthasampayuttañca ganthasampayuttañceva no ca ganthañca dhammaṃ paṭicca gantho ceva ganthasampayutto ca dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – ganthe ca sampayuttake ca khandhe paṭicca ganthā. (1)

109. Dependent on a state that is both a fetter and associated with a fetter, and a state that is associated with a fetter but not a fetter, a state that is both a fetter and associated with a fetter arises by way of root condition—dependent on the fetters and the associated aggregates, fetters arise. (1)

Ganthañceva ganthasampayuttañca ganthasampayuttañceva no ca ganthañca dhammaṃ paṭicca ganthasampayutto ceva no ca gantho dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – ganthasampayuttañceva no ca ganthaṃ ekaṃ khandhañca ganthe ca paṭicca tayo khandhā…pe… dve khandhe ca…pe…. (2)

Dependent on a state that is both a fetter and associated with a fetter, and a state that is associated with a fetter but not a fetter, a state that is associated with a fetter but not a fetter arises by way of root condition—dependent on one aggregate that is associated with a fetter but not a fetter and on the fetters, three aggregates arise… dependent on two aggregates and on the fetters, two aggregates arise…. (2)

Ganthañceva ganthasampayuttañca ganthasampayuttañceva no ca ganthañca dhammaṃ paṭicca gantho ceva ganthasampayutto ca ganthasampayutto ceva no ca gantho ca dhammā uppajjanti hetupaccayā – ganthasampayuttañceva no ca ganthaṃ ekaṃ [T 3.0343] khandhañca sīlabbataparāmāsaṃ kāyaganthañca paṭicca tayo khandhā abhijjhākāyagantho ca…pe… dve khandhe ca…pe… (cakkaṃ bandhitabbaṃ. Saṃkhittaṃ). (3)

Dependent on a state that is both a fetter and associated with a fetter, and a state that is associated with fetters but not a fetter, states that are both a fetter and associated with a fetter, and states that are associated with fetters but not a fetter, arise by way of root condition—dependent on one aggregate that is associated with fetters but not a fetter and the bodily fetter of clinging to rules and observances, three aggregates and the bodily fetter of covetousness arise… and on two aggregates… (The cycle should be linked. Condensed.) (3)

110. Hetuyā nava, ārammaṇe nava (sabbattha nava), kamme nava, āhāre nava…pe… avigate nava.

110. There are nine by way of root condition, nine by way of object condition (nine in all cases), nine by way of kamma condition, nine by way of nutriment condition… and nine by way of non-disappearance condition.

Anulomaṃ.

The Direct Order.

2. Paccayapaccanīyaṃ

2. The Negative of Conditions

111. Ganthañceva [V 3.0361] ganthasampayuttañca dhammaṃ paṭicca gantho ceva ganthasampayutto ca dhammo uppajjati naadhipatipaccayā (saṃkhittaṃ).

111. Dependent on a state that is both a fetter and associated with fetters, a state that is both a fetter and associated with fetters arises, not by way of predominance condition (in brief).

(Idha [M 3.0295] nahetupaccayo natthi) naadhipatiyā nava, napurejāte nava, napacchājāte nava, naāsevane nava, nakamme tīṇi, navipāke nava, navippayutte nava.

(Here, there is no not-root condition.) There are nine by way of non-predominance, nine by way of non-prenascence, nine by way of non-postnascence, nine by way of non-repetition, three by way of non-kamma, nine by way of non-result, and nine by way of non-dissociation.

2-6. Sahajāta-paccaya-nissaya-saṃsaṭṭha-sampayuttavāro

2-6. The Section on Co-nascence, Condition, Support, Conjunction, and Association
