Hetupaccayo

Root Condition.

17. Noparāmāso [T 3.0396][V 3.0422] dhammo noparāmāsassa dhammassa hetupaccayena paccayo – noparāmāsā hetū sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ hetupaccayena paccayo; paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe…. (1)

17. A non-clinging state is a condition for a non-clinging state by way of root condition—non-clinging roots are a condition for the associated aggregates and mind-originated matter by way of root condition; at the moment of rebirth-linking… and so on…. (1)

Noparāmāso dhammo parāmāsassa dhammassa hetupaccayena paccayo – noparāmāsā hetū parāmāsassa hetupaccayena paccayo. (2)

A non-clinging state is a condition for a clinging state by way of root condition—non-clinging roots are a condition for clinging by way of root condition. (2)

Noparāmāso dhammo parāmāsassa ca noparāmāsassa ca dhammassa hetupaccayena paccayo – noparāmāsā hetū sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ parāmāsassa ca cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ hetupaccayena paccayo. (3)

A non-clinging state is a condition for both a clinging state and a non-clinging state by way of root condition—non-clinging roots are a condition for the associated aggregates, clinging, and mind-originated matter by way of root condition. (3)

Ārammaṇapaccayo

Object Condition.

18. Parāmāso [M 3.0342] dhammo parāmāsassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo – parāmāsaṃ ārabbha parāmāso uppajjati. (Mūlaṃ kātabbaṃ) parāmāsaṃ ārabbha noparāmāsā khandhā uppajjanti. (Mūlaṃ kātabbaṃ) parāmāsaṃ ārabbha parāmāso ca sampayuttakā ca khandhā uppajjanti. (3)

18. A clinging state is a condition for a clinging state by way of object condition—dependent on clinging, clinging arises. (The root should be applied.) Dependent on clinging, non-clinging aggregates arise. (The root should be applied.) Dependent on clinging, both clinging and the associated aggregates arise. (3)

19. Noparāmāso dhammo noparāmāsassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo – dānaṃ…pe… sīlaṃ…pe… uposathakammaṃ katvā taṃ paccavekkhati, assādeti abhinandati, taṃ ārabbha rāgo…pe… vicikicchā… uddhaccaṃ… domanassaṃ uppajjati; pubbe suciṇṇāni [V 3.0423] …pe… jhānā vuṭṭhahitvā jhānaṃ…pe… ariyā maggā vuṭṭhahitvā maggaṃ paccavekkhanti, phalaṃ paccavekkhanti, nibbānaṃ paccavekkhanti. Nibbānaṃ gotrabhussa, vodānassa, maggassa, phalassa, āvajjanāya ārammaṇapaccayena [T 3.0397] paccayo; ariyā noparāmāse pahīne kilese…pe… vikkhambhite kilese…pe… pubbe…pe… cakkhuṃ…pe… vatthuṃ noparāmāse khandhe aniccato…pe… vipassati, assādeti abhinandati, taṃ ārabbha rāgo…pe… vicikicchā… uddhaccaṃ… domanassaṃ uppajjati; dibbena cakkhunā rūpaṃ passati, dibbāya sotadhātuyā saddaṃ suṇāti. Cetopariyañāṇena noparāmāsacittasamaṅgissa cittaṃ jānāti, ākāsānañcāyatanaṃ viññāṇañcāyatanassa…pe… ākiñcaññāyatanaṃ nevasaññānāsaññāyatanassa…pe… rūpāyatanaṃ cakkhuviññāṇassa…pe… phoṭṭhabbāyatanaṃ kāyaviññāṇassa…pe… noparāmāsā khandhā iddhividhañāṇassa, cetopariyañāṇassa, pubbenivāsānussatiñāṇassa, yathākammūpagañāṇassa, anāgataṃsañāṇassa, āvajjanāya ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo. (1)

19. A state not clung to is a condition for a state not clung to by way of object condition—having performed generosity... morality... the observance day duties, one reflects on them, savors them, and rejoices in them. Dependent on that, lust... doubt... restlessness... grief arises. Previously well-practiced deeds... having emerged from jhāna, one reflects on the jhāna... noble ones, having emerged from the noble path, reflect on the path, reflect on the fruition, reflect on Nibbāna. Nibbāna is a condition for change-of-lineage consciousness, purification consciousness, path consciousness, fruition consciousness, and advertence by way of object condition; noble ones reflect on the abandoned defilements which are not clung to... the suppressed defilements... previously... the eye... the base... one contemplates the aggregates not clung to as impermanent..., savors them, and rejoices in them. Dependent on that, lust... doubt... restlessness... grief arises. With the divine eye, one sees forms; with the divine ear-element, one hears sounds. With the knowledge of others' minds, one knows the mind of one endowed with a mind that does not cling. The base of infinite space is a condition for the base of infinite consciousness... the base of nothingness for the base of neither-perception-nor-non-perception... the form base for eye-consciousness... the tangible base for body-consciousness... the aggregates not clung to are a condition for the knowledge of psychic powers, the knowledge of others' minds, knowledge of past lives, knowledge of the passing away and rebirth of beings according to their kamma, knowledge of the future, and advertence by way of object condition. (1)

Noparāmāso dhammo parāmāsassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo – dānaṃ…pe… sīlaṃ…pe… uposathakammaṃ…pe… taṃ assādeti abhinandati, taṃ ārabbha diṭṭhi uppajjati, pubbe…pe… jhānā…pe… cakkhuṃ…pe… vatthuṃ noparāmāse khandhe assādeti abhinandati, taṃ ārabbha diṭṭhi uppajjati. (2)

A state not clung to is a condition for a state that is clung to by way of object condition—generosity... morality... observance day duties... one savors and rejoices in them. Dependent on that, wrong view arises. Previously... jhāna... the eye... the base... one savors and rejoices in the aggregates not clung to. Dependent on that, wrong view arises. (2)

Noparāmāso dhammo parāmāsassa ca noparāmāsassa ca dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo – dānaṃ…pe… sīlaṃ…pe… uposathakammaṃ…pe… taṃ assādeti abhinandati, taṃ ārabbha parāmāso ca sampayuttakā ca khandhā uppajjanti, pubbe…pe… jhānā [M 3.0343]…pe… cakkhuṃ…pe… vatthuṃ noparāmāse khandhe assādeti abhinandati, taṃ ārabbha parāmāso ca sampayuttakā ca khandhā uppajjanti. (3)

A state not clung to is a condition for both a state that is clung to and a state not clung to by way of object condition—generosity... morality... observance day duties... one savors and rejoices in them. Dependent on that, clinging and its associated aggregates arise. Previously... jhānas... the eye... the base... one savors and rejoices in the aggregates not clung to. Dependent on that, clinging and its associated aggregates arise. (3)

20. Parāmāso ca noparāmāso ca dhammā parāmāsassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo – parāmāsañca sampayuttake ca khandhe ārabbha parāmāso uppajjati… tīṇi.

20. Both a state that is clung to and a state not clung to are conditions for a state that is clung to by way of object condition—clinging arises dependent on clinging and its associated aggregates... three.

Adhipatipaccayo

Dominance Condition

21. Parāmāso [V 3.0424] dhammo parāmāsassa dhammassa adhipatipaccayena paccayo – parāmāsaṃ garuṃ katvā parāmāso uppajjati… tīṇi (ārammaṇādhipatiyeva kātabbā).

21. A state that is clung to is a condition for a state that is clung to by way of dominance condition—clinging arises by regarding clinging as weighty... three (only object-dominance should be applied).

22. Noparāmāso dhammo noparāmāsassa dhammassa adhipatipaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇādhipati, sahajātādhipati. Ārammaṇādhipati – dānaṃ…pe… sīlaṃ…pe… uposathakammaṃ…pe… taṃ garuṃ katvā paccavekkhati, assādeti abhinandati, taṃ garuṃ katvā rāgo uppajjati, pubbe…pe… jhānā…pe… ariyā maggā vuṭṭhahitvā maggaṃ garuṃ katvā…pe… phalaṃ garuṃ katvā…pe… nibbānaṃ garuṃ katvā…pe… nibbānaṃ gotrabhussa, vodānassa, maggassa, phalassa adhipatipaccayena paccayo; cakkhuṃ…pe… vatthuṃ noparāmāse khandhe garuṃ katvā assādeti abhinandati, taṃ garuṃ katvā rāgo uppajjati. Sahajātādhipati – noparāmāsādhipati sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ adhipatipaccayena paccayo. (1)

22. A state not clung to is a condition for a state not clung to by way of dominance condition—object-dominance, conascence-dominance. Object-dominance—generosity... morality... observance day duties... one reflects on them, regarding them as weighty, savors and rejoices in them. Regarding that as weighty, lust arises. Previously... jhānas... noble ones, emerging from the noble path, regarding the path as weighty... the fruition as weighty... Nibbāna as weighty... Nibbāna is a condition for the change-of-lineage consciousness, purification consciousness, path consciousness, and fruition consciousness by way of dominance condition; the eye... the base... one savors and rejoices in the aggregates not clung to, regarding them as weighty. Regarding them as weighty, lust arises. Conascence-dominance—a dominant factor that is not clung to is a condition for its associated aggregates and for mind-originated matter by way of dominance condition. (1)

Noparāmāso dhammo parāmāsassa dhammassa adhipatipaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇādhipati, sahajātādhipati. Ārammaṇādhipati – dānaṃ…pe… sīlaṃ…pe… uposathakammaṃ…pe… pubbe…pe… jhānā…pe… cakkhuṃ…pe… vatthuṃ noparāmāse khandhe garuṃ katvā assādeti abhinandati, taṃ garuṃ katvā diṭṭhi uppajjati. Sahajātādhipati – noparāmāsādhipati parāmāsassa adhipatipaccayena [T 3.0399] paccayo. (2)

A state not clung to is a condition for a state that is clung to by way of dominance condition—object-dominance, conascence-dominance. Object-dominance—generosity... morality... observance day duties... previously... jhānas... the eye... the base... one savors and rejoices in the aggregates not clung to, regarding them as weighty. Regarding them as weighty, wrong view arises. Conascence-dominance—a dominant factor that is not clung to is a condition for clinging by way of dominance condition. (2)

Noparāmāso dhammo parāmāsassa ca noparāmāsassa ca dhammassa adhipatipaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇādhipati, sahajātādhipati. Ārammaṇādhipati – dānaṃ…pe… sīlaṃ…pe… uposathakammaṃ…pe… pubbe…pe… jhānā [M 3.0344]…pe… cakkhuṃ…pe… vatthuṃ noparāmāse khandhe garuṃ katvā assādeti abhinandati, taṃ garuṃ katvā parāmāso ca sampayuttakā ca khandhā uppajjanti. Sahajātādhipati – noparāmāsādhipati sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ parāmāsassa ca cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ adhipatipaccayena paccayo. (3)

A state not clung to is a condition for both a state that is clung to and a state not clung to by way of dominance condition—object-dominance, conascence-dominance. Object-dominance—generosity... morality... observance day duties... previously... jhānas... the eye... the base... one savors and rejoices in the aggregates not clung to, regarding them as weighty. Regarding them as weighty, clinging and its associated aggregates arise. Conascence-dominance—a dominant factor that is not clung to is a condition for its associated aggregates, for clinging, and for mind-originated matter by way of dominance condition. (3)

Parāmāso [V 3.0425] ca noparāmāso ca dhammā parāmāsassa dhammassa adhipatipaccayena paccayo. Ārammaṇādhipati – parāmāsañca sampayuttake ca khandhe garuṃ katvā parāmāso… tīṇi.

Both a state that is clung to and a state not clung to are conditions for a state that is clung to by way of dominance condition. Object-dominance—regarding clinging and its associated aggregates as weighty, clinging arises... three.

Anantarapaccayo

Immediate Condition

23. Parāmāso dhammo parāmāsassa dhammassa anantarapaccayena paccayo – purimo purimo parāmāso pacchimassa pacchimassa parāmāsassa anantarapaccayena paccayo. (Mūlaṃ kātabbaṃ) purimo purimo parāmāso pacchimānaṃ pacchimānaṃ noparāmāsānaṃ khandhānaṃ anantarapaccayena paccayo; parāmāso vuṭṭhānassa anantarapaccayena paccayo. (Mūlaṃ kātabbaṃ) purimo purimo parāmāso pacchimassa pacchimassa parāmāsassa sampayuttakānañca khandhānaṃ anantarapaccayena paccayo. (3)

23. A state of clinging is a condition for a state of clinging by way of immediacy condition: a preceding state of clinging is a condition for a subsequent state of clinging by way of immediacy condition. (The root should be established.) A preceding state of clinging is a condition for subsequent non-clinging aggregates by way of immediacy condition; clinging is a condition for emergence by way of immediacy condition. (The root should be established.) A preceding state of clinging is a condition for a subsequent state of clinging and its associated aggregates by way of immediacy condition. (3)

24. Noparāmāso dhammo noparāmāsassa dhammassa anantarapaccayena paccayo – purimā purimā noparāmāsā khandhā pacchimānaṃ [T 3.0400] pacchimānaṃ noparāmāsānaṃ khandhānaṃ anantarapaccayena paccayo…pe… anulomaṃ phalasamāpattiyā anantarapaccayena paccayo. (Mūlaṃ kātabbaṃ) purimā purimā noparāmāsā khandhā pacchimassa pacchimassa parāmāsassa anantarapaccayena paccayo; āvajjanā parāmāsassa anantarapaccayena paccayo. (Mūlaṃ kātabbaṃ) purimā purimā noparāmāsā khandhā pacchimassa pacchimassa parāmāsassa ca sampayuttakānañca khandhānaṃ anantarapaccayena paccayo; āvajjanā parāmāsassa ca sampayuttakānañca khandhānaṃ anantarapaccayena paccayo. (3)

24. A state of non-clinging is a condition for a state of non-clinging by way of immediacy condition: preceding non-clinging aggregates are a condition for subsequent non-clinging aggregates by way of immediacy condition… and so on… conformity is a condition for fruition-attainment by way of immediacy condition. (The root should be established.) Preceding non-clinging aggregates are a condition for a subsequent state of clinging by way of immediacy condition; advertence is a condition for clinging by way of immediacy condition. (The root should be established.) Preceding non-clinging aggregates are a condition for a subsequent state of clinging and its associated aggregates by way of immediacy condition; advertence is a condition for clinging and its associated aggregates by way of immediacy condition. (3)

25. Parāmāso ca noparāmāso ca dhammā parāmāsassa dhammassa anantarapaccayena paccayo – purimo purimo parāmāso ca sampayuttakā ca khandhā pacchimassa pacchimassa parāmāsassa anantarapaccayena paccayo. (Mūlaṃ kātabbaṃ) [M 3.0345] purimo purimo parāmāso ca sampayuttakā ca khandhā pacchimānaṃ pacchimānaṃ noparāmāsānaṃ khandhānaṃ anantarapaccayena paccayo; parāmāso ca sampayuttakā ca khandhā vuṭṭhānassa anantarapaccayena paccayo. (Mūlaṃ kātabbaṃ) purimo purimo parāmāso ca sampayuttakā ca khandhā pacchimassa pacchimassa parāmāsassa sampayuttakānañca khandhānaṃ anantarapaccayena paccayo. (3)

25. A state of clinging and a state of non-clinging are a condition for a state of clinging by way of immediacy condition: a preceding state of clinging and its associated aggregates are a condition for a subsequent state of clinging by way of immediacy condition. (The root should be established.) A preceding state of clinging and its associated aggregates are a condition for subsequent non-clinging aggregates by way of immediacy condition; a state of clinging and its associated aggregates are a condition for emergence by way of immediacy condition. (The root should be established.) A preceding state of clinging and its associated aggregates are a condition for a subsequent state of clinging and its associated aggregates by way of immediacy condition. (3)

Samanantarapaccayādi

Contiguity Condition, etc.

26. Parāmāso [V 3.0426] dhammo parāmāsassa dhammassa samanantarapaccayena paccayo… sahajātapaccayena paccayo… aññamaññapaccayena paccayo… nissayapaccayena paccayo… pañca.

26. A state of clinging is a condition for a state of clinging by way of contiguity condition… by way of co-nascence condition… by way of mutuality condition… by way of support condition… five.

Upanissayapaccayo

Decisive Support Condition

27. Parāmāso dhammo parāmāsassa dhammassa upanissayapaccayena [T 3.0401] paccayo – ārammaṇūpanissayo, anantarūpanissayo, pakatūpanissayo…pe…. Pakatūpanissayo – parāmāso parāmāsassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo… tīṇi.

27. A state of clinging is a condition for a state of clinging by way of decisive support condition: object decisive support, immediacy decisive support, natural decisive support… and so on…. Natural decisive support: clinging is a condition for clinging by way of decisive support condition… three.

28. Noparāmāso dhammo noparāmāsassa dhammassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇūpanissayo, anantarūpanissayo, pakatūpanissayo…pe…. Pakatūpanissayo – saddhaṃ upanissāya dānaṃ deti…pe… samāpattiṃ uppādeti… mānaṃ jappeti… sīlaṃ…pe… paññaṃ… rāgaṃ… dosaṃ… mohaṃ… mānaṃ… patthanaṃ… kāyikaṃ sukhaṃ…pe… senāsanaṃ upanissāya dānaṃ deti…pe… samāpattiṃ uppādeti… pāṇaṃ hanati…pe… saṅghaṃ bhindati; saddhā…pe… senāsanaṃ, saddhāya…pe… paññāya, rāgassa…pe… patthanāya… kāyikassa sukhassa…pe… maggassa, phalasamāpattiyā upanissayapaccayena paccayo. (1)

28. A state of non-clinging is a condition for a state of non-clinging by way of decisive support condition: object decisive support, immediacy decisive support, natural decisive support… and so on…. Natural decisive support: relying on faith, one gives alms… and so on… attains meditative absorption… mutters conceit… virtue… and so on… wisdom… lust… hatred… delusion… conceit… aspiration… bodily pleasure… and so on… relying on a dwelling place, one gives alms… and so on… attains meditative absorption… kills a living being… and so on… divides the Sangha; faith… and so on… a dwelling place, faith… and so on… wisdom, lust… and so on… aspiration, bodily pleasure… and so on… the path, is a condition for fruition-attainment by way of decisive support condition. (1)

Noparāmāso dhammo parāmāsassa dhammassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇūpanissayo, anantarūpanissayo, pakatūpanissayo…pe…. Pakatūpanissayo – saddhaṃ upanissāya diṭṭhiṃ gaṇhāti, sīlaṃ…pe… paññaṃ, rāgaṃ…pe… patthanaṃ, kāyikaṃ sukhaṃ…pe… senāsanaṃ upanissāya diṭṭhiṃ gaṇhāti; saddhā…pe… senāsanaṃ parāmāsassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo. (2)

A state of non-clinging is a condition for a state of clinging by way of decisive support condition: object decisive support, immediacy decisive support, natural decisive support… and so on…. Natural decisive support: relying on faith, one grasps a wrong view; relying on virtue… and so on… wisdom, lust… and so on… aspiration, bodily pleasure… and so on… relying on a dwelling place, one grasps a wrong view; faith… and so on… a dwelling place is a condition for clinging by way of decisive support condition. (2)

Noparāmāso [M 3.0346] dhammo parāmāsassa ca noparāmāsassa ca dhammassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇūpanissayo, anantarūpanissayo, pakatūpanissayo…pe…. Pakatūpanissayo – saddhaṃ upanissāya diṭṭhiṃ gaṇhāti, sīlaṃ…pe… senāsanaṃ upanissāya diṭṭhiṃ [T 3.0402][V 3.0427] gaṇhāti; saddhā…pe… senāsanaṃ parāmāsassa sampayuttakānañca khandhānaṃ upanissayapaccayena paccayo. (3)

A state of non-clinging is a condition for a state of clinging and a state of non-clinging by way of decisive support condition: object decisive support, immediacy decisive support, natural decisive support… and so on…. Natural decisive support: relying on faith, one grasps a wrong view; relying on virtue… and so on… relying on a dwelling place, one grasps a wrong view; faith… and so on… a dwelling place is a condition for clinging and its associated aggregates by way of decisive support condition. (3)

29. Parāmāso ca noparāmāso ca dhammā parāmāsassa dhammassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo – tīṇi upanissayā parāmāso ca sampayuttakā ca khandhā parāmāsassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo… tīṇi.

29. A state of clinging and a state of non-clinging are a condition for a state of clinging by way of decisive support condition: three decisive supports. A state of clinging and its associated aggregates are a condition for a state of clinging by way of decisive support condition… three.

Purejātapaccayo

Pre-nascence Condition

30. Noparāmāso dhammo noparāmāsassa dhammassa purejātapaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇapurejātaṃ, vatthupurejātaṃ. Ārammaṇapurejātaṃ – cakkhuṃ…pe… vatthuṃ aniccato…pe… vipassati assādeti abhinandati, taṃ ārabbha rāgo…pe… vicikicchā…pe… uddhaccaṃ…pe… domanassaṃ uppajjati; dibbena cakkhunā rūpaṃ passati, dibbāya sotadhātuyā saddaṃ suṇāti. Rūpāyatanaṃ cakkhuviññāṇassa…pe… phoṭṭhabbāyatanaṃ kāyaviññāṇassa…pe…. Vatthupurejātaṃ – cakkhāyatanaṃ cakkhuviññāṇassa…pe… kāyāyatanaṃ kāyaviññāṇassa…pe… vatthu noparāmāsānaṃ khandhānaṃ purejātapaccayena paccayo. (1)

30. A non-clinging phenomenon is a condition for a non-clinging phenomenon by way of pre-nascence condition: object pre-nascence, base pre-nascence. Object pre-nascence: one contemplates the eye…and so on…the base as impermanent…and so on…, savors, and delights in it; taking that as object, lust…and so on…doubt…and so on…restlessness…and so on…sorrow arises; with the divine eye, one sees forms; with the divine ear element, one hears sounds. The form base is a condition for eye-consciousness…and so on…the tangible base is a condition for body-consciousness…and so on…. Base pre-nascence: the eye base is a condition for eye-consciousness…and so on…the body base is a condition for body-consciousness…and so on…the base is a condition for the non-clinging aggregates by way of pre-nascence condition. (1)

Noparāmāso dhammo parāmāsassa dhammassa purejātapaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇapurejātaṃ, vatthupurejātaṃ. Ārammaṇapurejātaṃ – cakkhuṃ…pe… vatthuṃ assādeti abhinandati, taṃ ārabbha diṭṭhi uppajjati. Vatthupurejātaṃ – vatthu parāmāsassa purejātapaccayena paccayo. (2)

A non-clinging phenomenon is a condition for a clinging phenomenon by way of pre-nascence condition: object pre-nascence, base pre-nascence. Object pre-nascence: one savors and delights in the eye…and so on…the base; taking that as object, a wrong view arises. Base pre-nascence: the base is a condition for clinging by way of pre-nascence condition. (2)

Noparāmāso dhammo parāmāsassa ca noparāmāsassa ca dhammassa purejātapaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇapurejātaṃ, vatthupurejātaṃ. Ārammaṇapurejātaṃ – cakkhuṃ…pe… vatthuṃ assādeti abhinandati, taṃ ārabbha parāmāso [T 3.0403] ca sampayuttakā ca khandhā uppajjanti. Vatthupurejātaṃ – vatthu parāmāsassa ca sampayuttakānañca khandhānaṃ purejātapaccayena paccayo. (3)

A non-clinging phenomenon is a condition for a clinging phenomenon and a non-clinging phenomenon by way of pre-nascence condition: object pre-nascence, base pre-nascence. Object pre-nascence: one savors and delights in the eye…and so on…the base; taking that as object, clinging and its associated aggregates arise. Base pre-nascence: the base is a condition for clinging and its associated aggregates by way of pre-nascence condition. (3)

Pacchājātāsevanapaccayā

Post-nascence and Repetition Conditions

31. Parāmāso [M 3.0347] dhammo noparāmāsassa dhammassa pacchājātapaccayena paccayo… tīṇi (pacchājātā kātabbā)… āsevanapaccayena paccayo… nava.

31. A clinging phenomenon is a condition for a non-clinging phenomenon by way of post-nascence condition… three (the post-nascence section should be elaborated)… by way of repetition condition… nine.

Kammapaccayo

Kamma Condition

32. Noparāmāso [V 3.0428] dhammo noparāmāsassa dhammassa kammapaccayena paccayo – sahajātā, nānākkhaṇikā. Sahajātā – noparāmāsā cetanā sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ kammapaccayena paccayo; paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe…. Nānākkhaṇikā – noparāmāsā cetanā vipākānaṃ khandhānaṃ kaṭattā ca rūpānaṃ kammapaccayena paccayo. (Mūlaṃ kātabbaṃ) noparāmāsā cetanā parāmāsassa kammapaccayena paccayo. (Mūlaṃ kātabbaṃ) noparāmāsā cetanā parāmāsassa ca sampayuttakānañca khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ kammapaccayena paccayo. (3)

32. A non-clinging phenomenon is a condition for a non-clinging phenomenon by way of kamma condition: conascent, asynchronous. Conascent: non-clinging volition is a condition for its associated aggregates and for mind-originated materiality by way of kamma condition; at the moment of relinking… Asynchronous: non-clinging volition is a condition for resultant aggregates and for kamma-produced materiality by way of kamma condition. (The root section should be elaborated.) Non-clinging volition is a condition for clinging by way of kamma condition. (The root section should be elaborated.) Non-clinging volition is a condition for clinging, for its associated aggregates, and for mind-originated materiality by way of kamma condition. (3)

Vipākapaccayādi

Result Condition, and so on

33. Noparāmāso dhammo noparāmāsassa dhammassa vipākapaccayena paccayo… ekaṃ… āhārapaccayena paccayo… tīṇi, indriyapaccayena paccayo… tīṇi… jhānapaccayena paccayo… tīṇi.

33. A non-clinging phenomenon is a condition for a non-clinging phenomenon by way of result condition… one… by way of nutriment condition… three, by way of faculty condition… three… by way of jhāna condition… three.

Parāmāso dhammo noparāmāsassa dhammassa maggapaccayena paccayo – parāmāsāni maggaṅgāni…pe… (evaṃ pañca pañhā kātabbā) sampayuttapaccayena [T 3.0404] paccayo… pañca.

A clinging phenomenon is a condition for a non-clinging phenomenon by way of path condition: clinging path factors…and so on… (thus five cases should be made). By way of association condition… five.

Vippayuttapaccayo

Dissociation Condition

34. Parāmāso dhammo noparāmāsassa dhammassa vippayuttapaccayena paccayo – sahajātaṃ, pacchājātaṃ (saṃkhittaṃ). (1)

34. A clinging phenomenon is a condition for a non-clinging phenomenon by way of dissociation condition: conascent, post-nascent (in brief). (1)

Noparāmāso dhammo noparāmāsassa dhammassa vippayuttapaccayena paccayo – sahajātaṃ, purejātaṃ, pacchājātaṃ (saṃkhittaṃ). (1)

A non-clinging phenomenon is a condition for a non-clinging phenomenon by way of dissociation condition: conascent, pre-nascent, post-nascent (in brief). (1)

Noparāmāso dhammo parāmāsassa dhammassa vippayuttapaccayena paccayo. Purejātaṃ – vatthu parāmāsassa vippayuttapaccayena paccayo. (2)

A non-clinging phenomenon is a condition for a clinging phenomenon by way of dissociation condition. Pre-nascence: the base is a condition for clinging by way of dissociation condition. (2)

Noparāmāso [M 3.0348][V 3.0429] dhammo parāmāsassa ca noparāmāsassa ca dhammassa vippayuttapaccayena paccayo. Purejātaṃ – vatthu parāmāsassa ca sampayuttakānañca khandhānaṃ vippayuttapaccayena paccayo. (3)

A non-clinging phenomenon is a condition for a clinging phenomenon and a non-clinging phenomenon by way of dissociation condition. Pre-nascence: the base is a condition for clinging and its associated aggregates by way of dissociation condition. (3)

Parāmāso ca noparāmāso ca dhammā noparāmāsassa dhammassa vippayuttapaccayena paccayo – sahajātaṃ, pacchājātaṃ (saṃkhittaṃ). (1)

Clinging and non-clinging phenomena are a condition for a non-clinging phenomenon by way of dissociation condition: conascent, post-nascent (in brief). (1)

Atthipaccayo

Presence Condition

35. Parāmāso dhammo noparāmāsassa dhammassa atthipaccayena paccayo – sahajātaṃ, pacchājātaṃ. Sahajāto – parāmāso sampayuttakānañca khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo. Pacchājāto – parāmāso purejātassa imassa kāyassa atthipaccayena paccayo. (1)

35. A clinging phenomenon is a condition for a non-clinging phenomenon by way of presence condition: conascent, post-nascent. Conascent: clinging is a condition for its associated aggregates and for mind-originated materiality by way of presence condition. Post-nascent: clinging is a condition for this pre-nascent body by way of presence condition. (1)

36. Noparāmāso dhammo noparāmāsassa dhammassa atthipaccayena paccayo – sahajātaṃ, purejātaṃ, pacchājātaṃ, āhāraṃ, indriyaṃ (saṃkhittaṃ). (1)

36. A non-clinging phenomenon is a condition for a non-clinging phenomenon by way of presence condition: conascent, pre-nascent, post-nascent, nutriment, faculty (in brief). (1)

Noparāmāso dhammo parāmāsassa dhammassa atthipaccayena paccayo – sahajātaṃ, purejātaṃ. Sahajātā [T 3.0405] – noparāmāsā khandhā parāmāsassa atthipaccayena paccayo. Purejātaṃ – cakkhuṃ…pe… vatthuṃ assādeti abhinandati, taṃ ārabbha diṭṭhi uppajjati, vatthu parāmāsassa atthipaccayena paccayo. (2)

A non-clinging phenomenon is a condition for a clinging phenomenon by way of presence condition: conascent, pre-nascent. Conascent: the non-clinging aggregates are a condition for clinging by way of presence condition. Pre-nascence: one savors and delights in the eye…and so on…the base; taking that as object, a wrong view arises. The base is a condition for clinging by way of presence condition. (2)

Noparāmāso dhammo parāmāsassa ca noparāmāsassa ca dhammassa atthipaccayena paccayo – sahajātaṃ, purejātaṃ. Sahajāto – noparāmāso eko khandho tiṇṇannaṃ khandhānaṃ parāmāsassa ca cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo…pe…. Purejātaṃ – cakkhuṃ…pe… vatthuṃ assādeti abhinandati, taṃ ārabbha parāmāso ca sampayuttakā ca khandhā uppajjanti, vatthu parāmāsassa ca sampayuttakānañca khandhānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo. (3)

A non-clinging phenomenon is a condition for a clinging phenomenon and a non-clinging phenomenon by way of presence condition: conascent, pre-nascent. Conascent: one non-clinging aggregate is a condition for the other three aggregates, for clinging, and for mind-originated materiality by way of presence condition… Pre-nascence: one savors and delights in the eye…and so on…the base; taking that as object, clinging and its associated aggregates arise. The base is a condition for clinging and its associated aggregates by way of presence condition. (3)

37. Parāmāso [V 3.0430] ca noparāmāso ca dhammā noparāmāsassa dhammassa atthipaccayena paccayo – sahajātaṃ, purejātaṃ, pacchājātaṃ, āhāraṃ[M 3.0349], indriyaṃ. Sahajāto – noparāmāso eko khandho ca parāmāso ca tiṇṇannaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo…pe… dve khandhā ca…pe… parāmāso ca sampayuttakā ca khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo; parāmāso ca mahābhūtā ca cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo; parāmāso ca vatthu ca noparāmāsānaṃ khandhānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo. Pacchājāto – parāmāso ca sampayuttakā ca khandhā purejātassa imassa kāyassa atthipaccayena paccayo. Pacchājāto – parāmāso ca sampayuttakā ca [T 3.0406] khandhā kabaḷīkāro āhāro ca imassa kāyassa atthipaccayena paccayo. Pacchājāto – parāmāso ca sampayuttakā ca khandhā rūpajīvitindriyañca kaṭattārūpānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo. (1)

37. Clinging and non-clinging phenomena are a condition for a non-clinging phenomenon by way of presence condition: simultaneous, pre-nascence, post-nascence, nutriment, and faculty. Simultaneous: one non-clinging aggregate and clinging are conditions for the other three aggregates and for mind-originated materiality by way of presence condition…and so on… two aggregates…and so on… clinging and the associated aggregates are conditions for mind-originated materiality by way of presence condition; clinging and the great elements are conditions for mind-originated materiality by way of presence condition; clinging and the base are conditions for the non-clinging aggregates by way of presence condition. Post-nascence: clinging and the associated aggregates are conditions for this pre-nascent body by way of presence condition. Post-nascence: clinging and the associated aggregates and physical nutriment are conditions for this body by way of presence condition. Post-nascence: clinging and the associated aggregates and the life faculty of materiality are conditions for kamma-produced materiality by way of presence condition. (1)

2. Enumeration Chapter

Suddhaṃ

Pure

38. Hetuyā tīṇi, ārammaṇe nava, adhipatiyā nava, anantare nava, samanantare nava, sahajāte pañca, aññamaññe pañca, nissaye pañca, upanissaye nava, purejāte tīṇi, pacchājāte tīṇi, āsevane nava, kamme tīṇi, vipāke ekaṃ, āhāre tīṇi, indriye tīṇi, jhāne tīṇi, magge pañca, sampayutte pañca, vippayutte pañca, atthiyā pañca, natthiyā nava, vigate nava, avigate pañca.

38. By root condition—three; by object condition—nine; by dominance condition—nine; by contiguity condition—nine; by immediately contiguous condition—nine; by co-nascence condition—five; by reciprocity condition—five; by support condition—five; by decisive support condition—nine; by pre-nascence condition—three; by post-nascence condition—three; by repetition condition—nine; by kamma condition—three; by result condition—one; by nutriment condition—three; by faculty condition—three; by jhāna condition—three; by path condition—five; by association condition—five; by dissociation condition—five; by presence condition—five; by absence condition—nine; by disappearance condition—nine; by non-disappearance condition—five.

Anulomaṃ.

The Forward Method

Paccanīyuddhāro

The Reverse Method

39. Parāmāso [V 3.0431] dhammo parāmāsassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo… upanissayapaccayena paccayo. (1)

39. A clinging phenomenon is a condition for a clinging phenomenon by way of object condition... by way of decisive support condition. (1)

Parāmāso dhammo noparāmāsassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo… sahajātapaccayena paccayo… upanissayapaccayena paccayo… pacchājātapaccayena paccayo. (2)

A clinging phenomenon is a condition for a non-clinging phenomenon by way of object condition… by way of co-nascence condition… by way of decisive support condition… by way of post-nascence condition. (2)

Parāmāso [M 3.0350] dhammo parāmāsassa ca noparāmāsassa ca dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo… upanissayapaccayena paccayo. (3)

A clinging phenomenon is a condition for a clinging phenomenon and for a non-clinging phenomenon by way of object condition... by way of decisive support condition. (3)

40. Noparāmāso dhammo noparāmāsassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo… sahajātapaccayena paccayo… upanissayapaccayena paccayo… purejātapaccayena paccayo… pacchājātapaccayena paccayo… kammapaccayena paccayo… āhārapaccayena paccayo [T 3.0407]… indriyapaccayena paccayo. (1)

40. A non-clinging phenomenon is a condition for a non-clinging phenomenon by way of object condition... by way of co-nascence condition... by way of decisive support condition... by way of pre-nascence condition... by way of post-nascence condition... by way of kamma condition... by way of nutriment condition... by way of faculty condition. (1)

Noparāmāso dhammo parāmāsassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo… sahajātapaccayena paccayo… upanissayapaccayena paccayo… purejātapaccayena paccayo. (2)

A non-clinging phenomenon is a condition for a clinging phenomenon by way of object condition... by way of co-nascence condition... by way of decisive support condition... by way of pre-nascence condition. (2)

Noparāmāso dhammo parāmāsassa ca noparāmāsassa ca dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo… sahajātapaccayena paccayo… upanissayapaccayena paccayo… purejātapaccayena paccayo. (3)

A non-clinging phenomenon is a condition for a clinging phenomenon and for a non-clinging phenomenon by way of object condition... by way of co-nascence condition... by way of decisive support condition... by way of pre-nascence condition. (3)

41. Parāmāso ca noparāmāso ca dhammā parāmāsassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo… upanissayapaccayena paccayo. (1)

41. Clinging and non-clinging phenomena are conditions for a clinging phenomenon by way of object condition... by way of decisive support condition. (1)

Clinging and non-clinging phenomena are conditions for a non-clinging phenomenon by way of object condition... by way of co-nascence condition... by way of decisive support condition... by way of post-nascence condition. (2)

Parāmāso ca noparāmāso ca dhammā parāmāsassa ca noparāmāsassa ca dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo… upanissayapaccayena paccayo. (3)

Clinging and non-clinging phenomena are conditions for a clinging phenomenon and for a non-clinging phenomenon by way of object condition... by way of decisive support condition. (3)

A state concomitant with clinging is a condition for a state concomitant with clinging by way of root condition—the roots concomitant with clinging are conditions for the concomitant aggregates by way of root condition. (The root should be supplied.) The roots concomitant with clinging are conditions for mind-originated materiality by way of root condition. (The root should be supplied.) The roots concomitant with clinging are conditions for the concomitant aggregates and mind-originated materiality by way of root condition. (3)

Parāmāsavippayutto dhammo parāmāsavippayuttassa dhammassa hetupaccayena paccayo – parāmāsavippayuttā hetū sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ hetupaccayena paccayo; paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe…. (1)

A state dissociated from clinging is a condition for a state dissociated from clinging by way of root condition—roots dissociated from clinging are conditions for the concomitant aggregates and mind-originated materiality by way of root condition; at the moment of rebirth-linking… etc. (1)

Ārammaṇapaccayo

The Object Condition

64. Parāmāsasampayutto dhammo parāmāsasampayuttassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo – rāgaṃ assādeti abhinandati, taṃ ārabbha parāmāsasampayutto rāgo uppajjati; parāmāsasampayutte khandhe assādeti abhinandati, taṃ ārabbha parāmāsasampayutto rāgo uppajjati. (1)

64. A state concomitant with clinging is a condition for a state concomitant with clinging by way of object condition: one savors and delights in lust, and dependent on that, lust concomitant with clinging arises; one savors and delights in aggregates concomitant with clinging, and dependent on that, lust concomitant with clinging arises. (1)

Parāmāsasampayutto dhammo parāmāsavippayuttassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo – ariyā parāmāsasampayutte pahīne kilese paccavekkhanti, pubbe samudāciṇṇe kilese jānanti, parāmāsasampayutte khandhe aniccato…pe… vipassati, assādeti abhinandati, taṃ ārabbha parāmāsavippayutto rāgo…pe… vicikicchā…pe… uddhaccaṃ…pe… domanassaṃ uppajjati; cetopariyañāṇena parāmāsasampayuttacittasamaṅgissa cittaṃ jānāti, parāmāsasampayuttā khandhā cetopariyañāṇassa, pubbenivāsānussatiñāṇassa, yathākammūpagañāṇassa, anāgataṃsañāṇassa, āvajjanāya ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo. (2)

A state concomitant with clinging is a condition for a state dissociated from clinging by way of object condition—noble ones reflect upon the abandoned defilements concomitant with clinging, they know the defilements accumulated in the past, they contemplate the aggregates concomitant with clinging as impermanent… etc.…, or they savor and delight in them, and based on that, greed dissociated from clinging arises… etc.… doubt… etc.… restlessness… etc.… displeasure arises. Through the knowledge of penetration of minds, one knows the mind of a person endowed with a mind concomitant with clinging; the aggregates concomitant with clinging serve as object condition for the knowledge of penetration of minds, the knowledge of recollection of past lives, the knowledge of the passing away and reappearance of beings according to their kamma, the knowledge of future events, and for adverting. (2)

65. Parāmāsavippayutto dhammo parāmāsavippayuttassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo – dānaṃ…pe… sīlaṃ…pe… uposathakammaṃ katvā taṃ paccavekkhati, assādeti abhinandati, taṃ ārabbha parāmāsavippayutto rāgo…pe… vicikicchā…pe… uddhaccaṃ…pe… domanassaṃ uppajjati[T 3.0415]; pubbe suciṇṇāni…pe… jhānā…pe… ariyā maggā [V 3.0442] vuṭṭhahitvā maggaṃ paccavekkhanti, phalaṃ…pe… nibbānaṃ…pe… nibbānaṃ gotrabhussa, vodānassa, maggassa, phalassa, āvajjanāya ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo; ariyā parāmāsavippayutte pahīne kilese…pe… vikkhambhite kilese…pe… pubbe…pe… cakkhuṃ…pe… vatthuṃ parāmāsavippayutte khandhe [M 3.0358] aniccato…pe… vipassati, assādeti abhinandati, taṃ ārabbha parāmāsavippayutto rāgo…pe… vicikicchā…pe… uddhaccaṃ…pe… domanassaṃ uppajjati; dibbena cakkhunā rūpaṃ passati, dibbāya sotadhātuyā saddaṃ suṇāti. Cetopariyañāṇena parāmāsavippayuttacittasamaṅgissa cittaṃ jānāti, ākāsānañcāyatanaṃ viññāṇañcāyatanassa…pe… ākiñcaññāyatanaṃ nevasaññānāsaññāyatanassa…pe… rūpāyatanaṃ cakkhuviññāṇassa…pe… phoṭṭhabbāyatanaṃ kāyaviññāṇassa…pe… parāmāsavippayuttā khandhā iddhividhañāṇassa, cetopariyañāṇassa, pubbenivāsānussatiñāṇassa, yathākammūpagañāṇassa, anāgataṃsañāṇassa, āvajjanāya ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo. (1)

65. A state dissociated from clinging is a condition for a state dissociated from clinging by way of object condition—having performed acts of generosity… etc.… morality… etc.… observance of the Uposatha, one reflects upon them, savors and delights in them; based on that, greed dissociated from clinging arises… etc.… doubt… etc.… restlessness… etc.… displeasure arises. Having previously practiced good conduct… etc.… jhānas… etc.…, noble ones, having emerged from the path, reflect upon the path, the fruit… etc.… Nibbāna… etc.…; Nibbāna serves as object condition for change-of-lineage, for purification, for the path, for the fruit, and for adverting. Noble ones reflect upon the abandoned defilements dissociated from clinging… etc.… the suppressed defilements… etc.… previously… etc.… the eye… etc.… the base; they contemplate the aggregates dissociated from clinging as impermanent… etc.…, or they savor and delight in them, and based on that, greed dissociated from clinging arises… etc.… doubt… etc.… restlessness… etc.… displeasure arises. With the divine eye, one sees forms; with the divine ear element, one hears sounds. Through the knowledge of penetration of minds, one knows the mind of a person endowed with a mind dissociated from clinging. The base of infinite space is a condition for the base of infinite consciousness… etc.…; the base of nothingness for the base of neither-perception-nor-non-perception… etc.…; the form base for eye-consciousness… etc.…; the tangible base for body-consciousness… etc.…; the aggregates dissociated from clinging serve as object condition for the knowledge of psychic powers, the knowledge of penetration of minds, the knowledge of recollection of past lives, the knowledge of the passing away and reappearance of beings according to their kamma, the knowledge of future events, and for adverting. (1)

Parāmāsavippayutto dhammo parāmāsasampayuttassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo – dānaṃ…pe… sīlaṃ…pe… uposathakammaṃ…pe… pubbe…pe… jhānā…pe… cakkhuṃ…pe… vatthuṃ parāmāsavippayutte khandhe assādeti abhinandati. Taṃ ārabbha parāmāsasampayutto rāgo uppajjati. (2)

A state dissociated from clinging is a condition for a state concomitant with clinging by way of object condition: having performed acts of generosity… etc.… morality… etc.… observance of the Uposatha… etc.… having previously practiced good conduct… etc.… jhānas… etc.… the eye… etc.… the base, one savors and delights in the aggregates dissociated from clinging. Based on that, greed concomitant with clinging arises. (2)

Adhipatipaccayo

The Dominance Condition

66. Parāmāsasampayutto dhammo parāmāsasampayuttassa dhammassa adhipatipaccayena [T 3.0416] paccayo – ārammaṇādhipati, sahajātādhipati. Ārammaṇādhipati – rāgaṃ garuṃ katvā assādeti abhinandati, taṃ garuṃ katvā parāmāsasampayutto rāgo uppajjati, parāmāsasampayutte khandhe garuṃ katvā assādeti abhinandati, taṃ garuṃ katvā parāmāsasampayutto rāgo uppajjati. Sahajātādhipati – parāmāsasampayuttādhipati sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ adhipatipaccayena paccayo. (1)

66. A state concomitant with clinging is a condition for another state concomitant with clinging by way of the dominance condition: object dominance and conascence dominance. Object dominance: Having made lust the dominant factor, one savors and rejoices; having made that the dominant factor, lust concomitant with clinging arises. Having made the aggregates concomitant with clinging the dominant factor, one savors and rejoices; having made that the dominant factor, lust concomitant with clinging arises. Conascence dominance: Dominance concomitant with clinging is a dominance condition for the associated aggregates. (1)

Parāmāsasampayutto dhammo parāmāsavippayuttassa dhammassa adhipatipaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇādhipati, sahajātādhipati. Ārammaṇādhipati – parāmāsasampayutte khandhe garuṃ katvā assādeti [V 3.0443] abhinandati, taṃ garuṃ katvā parāmāsavippayutto rāgo uppajjati. Sahajātādhipati – parāmāsasampayuttādhipati cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ adhipatipaccayena paccayo. (2)

A state associated with clinging is a condition for a state dissociated from clinging by way of dominance condition: by object dominance and conascence dominance. As object dominance: having made the aggregates associated with clinging a dominant factor, one savors and rejoices in them; having made that a dominant factor, lust dissociated from clinging arises. As conascence dominance: a dominant factor associated with clinging is a condition for consciousness-originated matter by way of dominance condition. (2)

Parāmāsasampayutto dhammo parāmāsasampayuttassa ca parāmāsavippayuttassa ca dhammassa adhipatipaccayena paccayo. Sahajātādhipati – parāmāsasampayuttādhipati [M 3.0359] sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ adhipatipaccayena paccayo. (3)

A state associated with clinging is a condition for a state associated with clinging and for a state dissociated from clinging by way of dominance condition. As conascence dominance: a dominant factor associated with clinging is a condition for the associated aggregates and for consciousness-originated matter by way of dominance condition. (3)

67. Parāmāsavippayutto dhammo parāmāsavippayuttassa dhammassa adhipatipaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇādhipati, sahajātādhipati. Ārammaṇādhipati – dānaṃ…pe… sīlaṃ…pe… uposathakammaṃ katvā taṃ garuṃ katvā paccavekkhati, assādeti abhinandati, taṃ garuṃ katvā parāmāsavippayutto rāgo uppajjati, pubbe…pe… jhānā…pe… ariyā maggā vuṭṭhahitvā maggaṃ garuṃ katvā…pe… phalaṃ…pe… nibbānaṃ…pe… nibbānaṃ gotrabhussa[T 3.0417], vodānassa, maggassa, phalassa adhipatipaccayena paccayo; cakkhuṃ…pe… vatthuṃ parāmāsavippayutte khandhe garuṃ katvā assādeti abhinandati, taṃ garuṃ katvā parāmāsavippayutto rāgo uppajjati. Sahajātādhipati – parāmāsavippayuttādhipati sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ adhipatipaccayena paccayo. (1)

67. A state dissociated from clinging is a condition for a state dissociated from clinging by way of dominance condition: by object dominance and conascence dominance. As object dominance: having given a gift... undertaken morality... performed an Uposatha observance, and having made that a dominant factor, one reflects on it, savors it, and rejoices in it; having made that a dominant factor, lust dissociated from clinging arises. Previously... having emerged from the jhānas... from the noble path, having made the path a dominant factor... the fruit... Nibbāna... Nibbāna is a condition for change-of-lineage, for purification, for the path, and for the fruit by way of dominance condition. Having made the eye... the base... the aggregates dissociated from clinging a dominant factor, one savors and rejoices in them; having made that a dominant factor, lust dissociated from clinging arises. As conascence dominance: a dominant factor dissociated from clinging is a condition for the associated aggregates and for consciousness-originated matter by way of dominance condition. (1)

Parāmāsavippayutto dhammo parāmāsasampayuttassa dhammassa adhipatipaccayena paccayo. Ārammaṇādhipati – dānaṃ…pe… sīlaṃ…pe… uposathakammaṃ katvā taṃ garuṃ katvā assādeti abhinandati, taṃ garuṃ katvā parāmāsasampayutto rāgo uppajjati, pubbe…pe… jhānā…pe… cakkhuṃ…pe… vatthuṃ parāmāsavippayutte khandhe garuṃ katvā assādeti abhinandati, taṃ garuṃ katvā parāmāsasampayutto rāgo uppajjati. (2)

A state dissociated from clinging is a condition for a state associated with clinging by way of dominance condition. As object dominance: having given a gift... undertaken morality... performed an Uposatha observance, and having made that a dominant factor, one savors and rejoices in it; having made that a dominant factor, lust associated with clinging arises. Previously... having emerged from the jhānas... having made the eye... the base... the aggregates dissociated from clinging a dominant factor, one savors and rejoices in them; having made that a dominant factor, lust associated with clinging arises. (2)

Anantara-samanantarapaccayā

Immediacy and Contiguity Conditions

68. Parāmāsasampayutto dhammo parāmāsasampayuttassa dhammassa anantarapaccayena paccayo – purimā purimā parāmāsasampayuttā khandhā pacchimānaṃ pacchimānaṃ parāmāsasampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ anantarapaccayena paccayo. (1)

68. A state associated with clinging is a condition for a state associated with clinging by way of immediacy condition—the preceding aggregates associated with clinging are a condition for the subsequent aggregates associated with clinging by way of immediacy condition. (1)

Parāmāsasampayutto [V 3.0444] dhammo parāmāsavippayuttassa dhammassa anantarapaccayena paccayo – parāmāsasampayuttā khandhā vuṭṭhānassa anantarapaccayena paccayo. (2)

A state associated with clinging is a condition for a state dissociated from clinging by way of immediacy condition. The aggregates associated with clinging are a condition for emergence by way of immediacy condition. (2)

69. Parāmāsavippayutto dhammo parāmāsavippayuttassa dhammassa anantarapaccayena paccayo – purimā purimā parāmāsavippayuttā khandhā pacchimānaṃ [M 3.0360] pacchimānaṃ parāmāsavippayuttānaṃ khandhānaṃ anantarapaccayena paccayo; anulomaṃ…pe… phalasamāpattiyā anantarapaccayena paccayo. (1)

69. A state dissociated from clinging is a condition for a state dissociated from clinging by way of immediacy condition—the preceding aggregates dissociated from clinging are a condition for the subsequent aggregates dissociated from clinging by way of immediacy condition; conformity... is a condition for the attainment of fruition by way of immediacy condition. (1)

Parāmāsavippayutto [T 3.0418] dhammo parāmāsasampayuttassa dhammassa anantarapaccayena paccayo – āvajjanā parāmāsasampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ anantarapaccayena paccayo… samanantarapaccayena paccayo. (2)

A state dissociated from clinging is a condition for a state associated with clinging by way of immediacy condition—adverting is a condition for the aggregates associated with clinging by way of immediacy condition... by way of contiguity condition. (2)

Sahajātapaccayādi

Conascence Condition, etc.

70. Parāmāsasampayutto dhammo parāmāsasampayuttassa dhammassa sahajātapaccayena paccayo… pañca… aññamaññapaccayena paccayo… dve… nissayapaccayena paccayo… satta.

70. A state associated with clinging is a condition for a state associated with clinging by way of conascence condition… five; by way of mutuality condition… two; by way of support condition… seven.

Upanissayapaccayo

Strong-Dependence Condition

71. Parāmāsasampayutto dhammo parāmāsasampayuttassa dhammassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇūpanissayo, anantarūpanissayo, pakatūpanissayo…pe…. Pakatūpanissayo – parāmāsasampayutto rāgo… moho… patthanā parāmāsasampayuttassa rāgassa… mohassa… patthanāya upanissayapaccayena paccayo. (1)

71. A state associated with clinging is a condition for a state associated with clinging by way of strong-dependence condition: by object-strong-dependence, immediacy-strong-dependence, and natural-strong-dependence… and so on. As natural-strong-dependence: lust… delusion… aspiration associated with clinging is a condition for lust… delusion… aspiration associated with clinging by way of strong-dependence condition. (1)

Parāmāsasampayutto dhammo parāmāsavippayuttassa dhammassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇūpanissayo, anantarūpanissayo, pakatūpanissayo…pe…. Pakatūpanissayo – parāmāsasampayuttaṃ rāgaṃ upanissāya dānaṃ deti…pe… samāpattiṃ uppādeti, mānaṃ jappeti; parāmāsasampayuttaṃ mohaṃ… patthanaṃ upanissāya dānaṃ deti…pe… samāpattiṃ uppādeti, mānaṃ jappeti, pāṇaṃ hanati…pe… saṅghaṃ bhindati; parāmāsasampayutto rāgo… moho… patthanā saddhāya [V 3.0445] …pe… paññāya, rāgassa… dosassa… mohassa… mānassa… patthanāya… kāyikassa sukhassa…pe… phalasamāpattiyā upanissayapaccayena paccayo. (2)

A state associated with clinging is a condition for a state dissociated from clinging by way of strong-dependence condition: by object-strong-dependence, immediacy-strong-dependence, and natural-strong-dependence… and so on. As natural-strong-dependence: depending on lust associated with clinging, one gives a gift… generates a meditative attainment, arouses conceit; depending on delusion… aspiration associated with clinging, one gives a gift… generates a meditative attainment, arouses conceit, kills a living being… splits the Saṅgha. Lust… delusion… aspiration associated with clinging is a condition for faith… wisdom, for lust… hatred… delusion… conceit… aspiration… for bodily pleasure… for the attainment of fruition by way of strong-dependence condition. (2)

72. Parāmāsavippayutto dhammo parāmāsavippayuttassa dhammassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇūpanissayo, anantarūpanissayo, pakatūpanissayo…pe…. Pakatūpanissayo – saddhaṃ upanissāya dānaṃ deti [M 3.0361]…pe… samāpattiṃ uppādeti, mānaṃ jappeti; sīlaṃ…pe… paññaṃ, rāgaṃ…pe… mānaṃ…pe… patthanaṃ upanissāya dānaṃ deti…pe… samāpattiṃ uppādeti, pāṇaṃ hanati…pe… saṅghaṃ bhindati; kāyikaṃ sukhaṃ…pe… senāsanaṃ upanissāya dānaṃ deti…pe… saṅghaṃ bhindati; saddhā…pe… paññā, rāgo…pe… māno… patthanā… kāyikaṃ sukhaṃ…pe… senāsanaṃ saddhāya…pe… paññāya, rāgassa…pe… mānassa… patthanāya… kāyikassa sukhassa…pe… phalasamāpattiyā upanissayapaccayena paccayo. (1)

72. A state dissociated from clinging is a condition for a state dissociated from clinging by way of strong dependence condition: object-strong dependence, immediate strong dependence, natural strong dependence… and so on…. Natural strong dependence: Relying on faith, one gives alms… attains meditative absorption, dwells on conceit; relying on virtue… wisdom, lust… conceit… aspiration, one gives alms… attains meditative absorption, kills living beings… splits the Saṅgha; relying on bodily pleasure… lodgings, one gives alms… splits the Saṅgha. Faith… wisdom, lust… conceit… aspiration… bodily pleasure… lodgings is a condition for faith… wisdom, for lust… conceit… aspiration… for bodily pleasure… for fruition-attainment by way of strong dependence condition. (1)

Parāmāsavippayutto dhammo parāmāsasampayuttassa dhammassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇūpanissayo, anantarūpanissayo, pakatūpanissayo…pe…. Pakatūpanissayo – saddhaṃ upanissāya parāmāsasampayutto rāgo uppajjati; sīlaṃ…pe… senāsanaṃ upanissāya parāmāsasampayutto rāgo uppajjati; saddhā…pe… senāsanaṃ parāmāsasampayuttassa rāgassa…pe… patthanāya upanissayapaccayena paccayo. (2)

A state dissociated from clinging is a condition for a state associated with clinging by way of strong dependence condition: object-strong dependence, immediate strong dependence, natural strong dependence… and so on…. Natural strong dependence: Relying on faith, lust associated with clinging arises; relying on virtue… lodgings, lust associated with clinging arises. Faith… lodgings is a condition for lust associated with clinging… for aspiration by way of strong dependence condition. (2)

Purejātapaccayo

Pre-nascence Condition

73. Parāmāsavippayutto dhammo parāmāsavippayuttassa dhammassa purejātapaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇapurejātaṃ, vatthupurejātaṃ. Ārammaṇapurejātaṃ – cakkhuṃ…pe… vatthuṃ aniccato…pe… vipassati, assādeti abhinandati, taṃ ārabbha parāmāsavippayutto rāgo…pe… vicikicchā…pe… uddhaccaṃ…pe… domanassaṃ uppajjati; dibbena cakkhunā rūpaṃ passati, dibbāya sotadhātuyā saddaṃ suṇāti. Rūpāyatanaṃ cakkhuviññāṇassa…pe… phoṭṭhabbāyatanaṃ kāyaviññāṇassa purejātapaccayena paccayo. Vatthupurejātaṃ – cakkhāyatanaṃ cakkhuviññāṇassa [V 3.0446] …pe… kāyāyatanaṃ kāyaviññāṇassa…pe… vatthu parāmāsavippayuttānaṃ khandhānaṃ purejātapaccayena paccayo. (1)

73. A state dissociated from clinging is a condition for a state dissociated from clinging by way of pre-nascence condition: object-pre-nascence, base-pre-nascence. Object-pre-nascence: One contemplates the eye… the base as impermanent…, savors, and delights in it; dependent on that, lust dissociated from clinging… doubt… restlessness… displeasure arises; with the divine eye one sees a form, with the divine ear-element one hears a sound. The form base is a condition for eye-consciousness… the tangible base is a condition for body-consciousness by way of pre-nascence condition. Base-pre-nascence: The eye-base is a condition for eye-consciousness… the body-base is a condition for body-consciousness… the base is a condition for the aggregates dissociated from clinging by way of pre-nascence condition. (1)

Parāmāsavippayutto dhammo parāmāsasampayuttassa dhammassa purejātapaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇapurejātaṃ, vatthupurejātaṃ. Ārammaṇapurejātaṃ – cakkhuṃ…pe… vatthuṃ assādeti abhinandati, taṃ ārabbha parāmāsasampayutto rāgo uppajjati. Vatthupurejātaṃ – vatthu parāmāsasampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ purejātapaccayena paccayo. (2)

A state dissociated from clinging is a condition for a state associated with clinging by way of pre-nascence condition: object-pre-nascence, base-pre-nascence. Object-pre-nascence: One savors and delights in the eye… the base; dependent on that, lust associated with clinging arises. Base-pre-nascence: The base is a condition for the aggregates associated with clinging by way of pre-nascence condition. (2)

Pacchājātāsevanapaccayā

Post-nascence and Repetition Conditions

74. Parāmāsasampayutto [M 3.0362] dhammo parāmāsavippayuttassa dhammassa pacchājātapaccayena paccayo (saṃkhittaṃ). (1)

74. A state associated with clinging is a condition for a state dissociated from clinging by way of post-nascence condition (in brief). (1)

Parāmāsavippayutto dhammo parāmāsavippayuttassa dhammassa pacchājātapaccayena paccayo (saṃkhittaṃ). (1)

A state dissociated from clinging is a condition for a state dissociated from clinging by way of post-nascence condition (in brief). (1)

Parāmāsasampayutto dhammo parāmāsasampayuttassa dhammassa āsevanapaccayena paccayo… dve.

A state associated with clinging is a condition for a state associated with clinging by way of repetition condition… two.

Kammapaccayādi

Kamma Condition, etc.

75. Parāmāsasampayutto dhammo parāmāsasampayuttassa dhammassa kammapaccayena paccayo – parāmāsasampayuttā cetanā sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ kammapaccayena paccayo. (1)

75. A state associated with clinging is a condition for a state associated with clinging by way of kamma condition—volition associated with clinging is a condition for the associated aggregates by way of kamma condition. (1)

Parāmāsasampayutto dhammo parāmāsavippayuttassa dhammassa kammapaccayena paccayo – sahajātā, nānākkhaṇikā. Sahajātā – parāmāsasampayuttā cetanā cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ kammapaccayena paccayo. Nānākkhaṇikā – parāmāsasampayuttā cetanā vipākānaṃ khandhānaṃ kaṭattā ca rūpānaṃ kammapaccayena paccayo. (Mūlaṃ kātabbaṃ) parāmāsasampayuttā cetanā sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ kammapaccayena paccayo. (3)

A state associated with clinging is a condition for a state dissociated from clinging by way of kamma condition—co-nascent, different-moment. Co-nascent: volition associated with clinging is a condition for mind-originated materiality by way of kamma condition. Different-moment: volition associated with clinging is a condition for the resultant aggregates and for kamma-produced materiality by way of kamma condition. (The root should be done.) Volition associated with clinging is a condition for the associated aggregates and for mind-originated materiality by way of kamma condition. (3)

Parāmāsavippayutto [V 3.0447] dhammo parāmāsavippayuttassa dhammassa kammapaccayena paccayo – sahajātā, nānākkhaṇikā. Sahajātā – parāmāsavippayuttā cetanā sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ kammapaccayena paccayo; paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe…. Nānākkhaṇikā – parāmāsavippayuttā cetanā vipākānaṃ khandhānaṃ kaṭattā ca rūpānaṃ kammapaccayena paccayo. (1)

A state dissociated from clinging is a condition for a state dissociated from clinging by way of kamma condition—co-nascent, different-moment. Co-nascent: volition dissociated from clinging is a condition for the associated aggregates and for mind-originated materiality by way of kamma condition; at the moment of rebirth… and so on…. Different-moment: volition dissociated from clinging is a condition for the resultant aggregates and for kamma-produced materiality by way of kamma condition. (1)

Vipākapaccayena paccayo… ekaṃ, āhārapaccayena paccayo… cattāri, indriyapaccayena paccayo… cattāri, jhānapaccayena paccayo… cattāri, maggapaccayena paccayo… cattāri, sampayuttapaccayena paccayo… dve.

Is a condition by way of result condition… one; is a condition by way of nutriment condition… four; is a condition by way of faculty condition… four; is a condition by way of jhāna condition… four; is a condition by way of path condition… four; is a condition by way of association condition… two.

Vippayuttapaccayo

Dissociation Condition

76. Parāmāsasampayutto [M 3.0363] dhammo parāmāsavippayuttassa dhammassa vippayuttapaccayena paccayo – sahajātaṃ, pacchājātaṃ (saṃkhittaṃ). (1)

76. A state associated with clinging is a condition for a state dissociated from clinging by way of dissociation condition—co-nascent, post-nascent (in brief). (1)

Parāmāsavippayutto dhammo parāmāsavippayuttassa dhammassa vippayuttapaccayena paccayo – sahajātaṃ, purejātaṃ, pacchājātaṃ (saṃkhittaṃ). (1)

A state dissociated from clinging is a condition for a state dissociated from clinging by way of dissociation condition—co-nascent, pre-nascent, post-nascent (in brief). (1)

Parāmāsavippayutto dhammo parāmāsasampayuttassa dhammassa vippayuttapaccayena paccayo. Purejātaṃ – vatthu parāmāsampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ vippayuttapaccayena paccayo. (1)

A state dissociated from clinging is a condition for a state associated with clinging by way of dissociation condition. Pre-nascent: The base is a condition for the aggregates associated with clinging by way of dissociation condition. (1)

Atthipaccayo

Presence Condition

77. Parāmāsasampayutto dhammo parāmāsasampayuttassa dhammassa atthipaccayena paccayo – parāmāsasampayutto eko khandho tiṇṇannaṃ khandhānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo…pe… dve khandhā…pe…. (1)

77. A state associated with clinging is a condition for a state associated with clinging by way of presence condition—one aggregate associated with clinging is a condition for the other three aggregates by way of presence condition… and so on… two aggregates… and so on.

Parāmāsasampayutto dhammo parāmāsavippayuttassa dhammassa atthipaccayena paccayo – parāmāsasampayuttā khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo. (Mūlaṃ kātabbaṃ.) (2)

A state associated with clinging is a condition for a state dissociated from clinging by way of presence condition—the aggregates associated with clinging are a condition for mind-originated materiality by way of presence condition. (The root section should be done.)

Parāmāsasampayutto [V 3.0448] dhammo parāmāsasampayuttassa ca parāmāsavippayuttassa ca dhammassa atthipaccayena paccayo – parāmāsasampayutto eko khandho tiṇṇannaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo…pe… dve khandhā…pe…. (3)

A state associated with clinging is a condition for both a state associated with clinging and a state dissociated from clinging by way of presence condition—one aggregate associated with clinging is a condition for the other three aggregates and for mind-originated materiality by way of presence condition… and so on… two aggregates… and so on.

78. Parāmāsavippayutto dhammo parāmāsavippayuttassa dhammassa atthipaccayena paccayo – sahajātaṃ, purejātaṃ, pacchājātaṃ, āhāraṃ, indriyaṃ (saṃkhittaṃ). (1)

78. A state dissociated from clinging is a condition for a state dissociated from clinging by way of presence condition—by way of co-nascence, pre-nascence, post-nascence, nutriment, and faculty conditions (in brief).

Parāmāsavippayutto dhammo parāmāsasampayuttassa dhammassa atthipaccayena paccayo. Purejātaṃ – cakkhuṃ…pe… vatthuṃ assādeti abhinandati, taṃ ārabbha parāmāsasampayutto rāgo uppajjati, vatthu parāmāsasampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo. (2)

A state dissociated from clinging is a condition for a state associated with clinging by way of presence condition. By way of pre-nascence condition: the eye… and so on… the base is delighted in and enjoyed; dependent on it, greed associated with clinging arises. The base is a condition for the aggregates associated with clinging by way of presence condition.

79. Parāmāsasampayutto [M 3.0364] ca parāmāsavippayutto ca dhammā parāmāsasampayuttassa dhammassa atthipaccayena paccayo – sahajātaṃ, purejātaṃ. Sahajāto – parāmāsasampayutto eko khandho ca vatthu ca tiṇṇannaṃ khandhānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo…pe… dve khandhā ca…pe…. (1)

79. Both a state associated with clinging and a state dissociated from clinging are a condition for a state associated with clinging by way of presence condition—by way of co-nascence and pre-nascence conditions. By way of co-nascence condition: one aggregate associated with clinging and the base are a condition for the other three aggregates by way of presence condition… and so on… two aggregates… and so on.

Parāmāsasampayutto ca parāmāsavippayutto ca dhammā parāmāsavippayuttassa dhammassa atthipaccayena paccayo – sahajātaṃ, pacchājātaṃ, āhāraṃ, indriyaṃ. Sahajātā – parāmāsasampayuttā khandhā ca mahābhūtā ca cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo. Pacchājātā – parāmāsasampayuttā khandhā ca kabaḷīkāro āhāro ca imassa kāyassa atthipaccayena paccayo. Pacchājātā – parāmāsasampayuttā khandhā ca rūpajīvitindriyañca kaṭattārūpānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo. (2)

Both a state associated with clinging and a state dissociated from clinging are a condition for a state dissociated from clinging by way of presence condition—by way of co-nascence, post-nascence, nutriment, and faculty conditions. By way of co-nascence condition: the aggregates associated with clinging and the great elements are a condition for mind-originated materiality by way of presence condition. By way of post-nascence condition: the aggregates associated with clinging and edible food are a condition for this body by way of presence condition. By way of post-nascence condition: the aggregates associated with clinging and the material life faculty are a condition for kamma-produced materiality by way of presence condition.

80. Hetuyā cattāri, ārammaṇe cattāri, adhipatiyā pañca, anantare cattāri, samanantare [V 3.0449] cattāri, sahajāte pañca, aññamaññe dve, nissaye satta, upanissaye cattāri, purejāte dve, pacchājāte dve, āsevane dve, kamme cattāri, vipāke ekaṃ, āhāre cattāri, indriye cattāri, jhāne cattāri, magge cattāri, sampayutte dve, vippayutte tīṇi, atthiyā satta, natthiyā cattāri, vigate cattāri, avigate satta.

80. In cause condition, four; in object condition, four; in predominance condition, five; in contiguity condition, four; in immediate contiguity condition, four; in co-nascence condition, five; in mutuality condition, two; in dependence condition, seven; in decisive support condition, four; in pre-nascence condition, two; in post-nascence condition, two; in repetition condition, two; in kamma condition, four; in result condition, one; in nutriment condition, four; in faculty condition, four; in jhāna condition, four; in path condition, four; in association condition, two; in dissociation condition, three; in presence condition, seven; in absence condition, four; in disappearance condition, four; in non-disappearance condition, seven.

The Positive

Paccanīyuddhāro

The Negative Exposition

81. Parāmāsasampayutto dhammo parāmāsasampayuttassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo… sahajātapaccayena paccayo… upanissayapaccayena paccayo. (1)

81. A state associated with clinging is a condition for a state associated with clinging by way of object condition... by way of co-nascence condition... by way of decisive support condition.

Parāmāsasampayutto dhammo parāmāsavippayuttassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo… sahajātapaccayena paccayo… upanissayapaccayena paccayo… pacchājātapaccayena paccayo… kammapaccayena paccayo. (2)

A state associated with clinging is a condition for a state dissociated from clinging by way of object condition... by way of co-nascence condition... by way of decisive support condition... by way of post-nascence condition... by way of kamma condition.

Parāmāsasampayutto [M 3.0365] dhammo parāmāsasampayuttassa ca parāmāsavippayuttassa ca dhammassa sahajātapaccayena paccayo. (3)

A state associated with clinging is a condition for a state associated with clinging and for a state dissociated from clinging by way of co-nascence condition.

82. Parāmāsavippayutto dhammo parāmāsavippayuttassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo… sahajātapaccayena paccayo… upanissayapaccayena paccayo… purejātapaccayena paccayo… pacchājātapaccayena paccayo… kammapaccayena paccayo… āhārapaccayena paccayo… indriyapaccayena paccayo. (1)

82. A state dissociated from clinging is a condition for a state dissociated from clinging by way of object condition... by way of co-nascence condition... by way of decisive support condition... by way of pre-nascence condition... by way of post-nascence condition... by way of kamma condition... by way of nutriment condition... by way of faculty condition.

Parāmāsavippayutto dhammo parāmāsasampayuttassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo… upanissayapaccayena paccayo… purejātapaccayena paccayo. (2)

A state dissociated from clinging is a condition for a state associated with clinging by way of object condition... by way of decisive support condition... by way of pre-nascence condition.

Parāmāsasampayutto [V 3.0450] ca parāmāsavippayutto ca dhammā parāmāsasampayuttassa dhammassa sahajātaṃ, purejātaṃ. (1)

States associated with clinging and dissociated from clinging are conditions for a state associated with clinging by way of co-nascence and pre-nascence conditions.

Parāmāsasampayutto ca parāmāsavippayutto ca dhammā parāmāsavippayuttassa dhammassa sahajātaṃ, pacchājātaṃ, āhāraṃ, indriyaṃ. (2)

States associated with clinging and dissociated from clinging are conditions for a state dissociated from clinging by way of co-nascence, post-nascence, nutriment, and faculty conditions.

84. In cause condition, not-object condition, four; not-predominance condition, four; not-contiguity condition, four; not-immediate contiguity condition, four; not-mutuality condition, two; not-decisive support condition, four (in all, four); not-path condition, four; not-association condition, two; not-dissociation condition, two; not-absence condition, four; not-disappearance condition, four.

Root Condition

86. Parāmāsañceva [V 3.0451] parāmaṭṭhañca dhammaṃ paṭicca parāmaṭṭho ceva no ca parāmāso dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – parāmāsaṃ paṭicca sampayuttakā khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ. (1)

86. Dependent on a phenomenon that is both clinging and what is clung to, a phenomenon that is what is clung to but not clinging arises by way of root condition. Dependent on clinging, the associated aggregates and mind-originated form arise. (1)

Parāmaṭṭhañceva no ca parāmāsaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca parāmaṭṭho ceva no ca parāmāso dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – parāmaṭṭhañceva no ca parāmāsaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca tayo khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ…pe… dve khandhe…pe… paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe… (yāva ajjhattikā mahābhūtā). (1)

Dependent on a phenomenon that is what is clung to but not clinging, a phenomenon that is what is clung to but not clinging arises by way of root condition. Dependent on one aggregate that is what is clung to but not clinging, three aggregates and mind-originated form arise... and so on... dependent on two aggregates... and so on... at the moment of rebirth... and so on... (up to the internal great elements). (1)

Parāmaṭṭhañceva no ca parāmāsaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca parāmāso ceva parāmaṭṭho ca dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – parāmaṭṭhe ceva no ca parāmāse khandhe paṭicca parāmāso. (2)

Dependent on a phenomenon that is what is clung to but not clinging, a phenomenon that is both clinging and what is clung to arises by way of root condition. Dependent on the aggregates that are what is clung to but not clinging, clinging arises. (2)

Parāmaṭṭhañceva no ca parāmāsaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca parāmāso ceva parāmaṭṭho ca parāmaṭṭho ceva no ca parāmāso ca dhammā uppajjanti hetupaccayā – parāmaṭṭhañceva no ca parāmāsaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca tayo khandhā parāmāso ca cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ…pe… dve khandhe…pe…. (3)

Dependent on a phenomenon that is what is clung to but not clinging, phenomena that are both clinging and what is clung to, and what is clung to but not clinging, arise by way of root condition. Dependent on one aggregate that is what is clung to but not clinging, three aggregates, clinging, and mind-originated form arise... and so on... dependent on two aggregates... and so on... (3)

Parāmāsañceva parāmaṭṭhañca parāmaṭṭhañceva no ca parāmāsañca dhammaṃ paṭicca parāmaṭṭho ceva no [V 3.0452] ca parāmāso dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – parāmaṭṭhañceva [M 3.0367] no ca parāmāsaṃ ekaṃ khandhañca parāmāsañca paṭicca tayo khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ…pe… dve khandhe ca…pe… (saṃkhittaṃ).

Dependent on a phenomenon that is both clinging and what is clung to, and a phenomenon that is what is clung to but not clinging, a phenomenon that is what is clung to but not clinging arises by way of root condition. Dependent on one aggregate that is what is clung to but not clinging, and on clinging, three aggregates and mind-originated form arise... and so on... dependent on two aggregates and... and so on... (in brief).

Hetupaccayo

Root condition.

87. Parāmaṭṭho ceva no ca parāmāso dhammo parāmaṭṭhassa ceva no ca parāmāsassa dhammassa hetupaccayena paccayo – parāmaṭṭhā ceva no ca parāmāsā hetū sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ hetupaccayena paccayo; paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe…. (1)

87. A phenomenon that is clung to but not a clinging is a condition for a phenomenon that is clung to but not a clinging by way of root condition. The roots that are clung to but not clingings are a condition for the associated aggregates and mind-originated form by way of root condition; at the moment of rebirth-linking… and so on… (1)

Parāmaṭṭho ceva no ca parāmāso dhammo parāmāsassa ceva parāmaṭṭhassa ca dhammassa hetupaccayena paccayo – parāmaṭṭhā ceva no ca parāmāsā hetū parāmāsassa hetupaccayena paccayo. (2)

A phenomenon that is clung to but not a clinging is a condition for a phenomenon that is both a clinging and clung to by way of root condition. The roots that are clung to but not clingings are a condition for clinging by way of root condition. (2)

Parāmaṭṭho ceva no ca parāmāso dhammo parāmāsassa ceva parāmaṭṭhassa ca parāmaṭṭhassa ceva no ca parāmāsassa ca dhammassa hetupaccayena paccayo – parāmaṭṭhā ceva no ca parāmāsā hetū sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ parāmāsassa ca cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ hetupaccayena paccayo. (3)

A phenomenon that is clung to but not a clinging is a condition for a phenomenon that is both a clinging and clung to, and for a phenomenon that is clung to but not a clinging, by way of root condition. The roots that are clung to but not clingings are a condition for the associated aggregates, for clinging, and for mind-originated form by way of root condition. (3)

Ārammaṇapaccayo

Object condition.

88. Parāmāso [V 3.0453] ceva parāmaṭṭho ca dhammo parāmāsassa ceva parāmaṭṭhassa ca dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo… tīṇi (ārabbha kātabbāni parāmāsadukasadisaṃ).

88. A phenomenon that is both a clinging and clung to is a condition for a phenomenon that is both a clinging and clung to by way of object condition… (three cases should be done starting from this, similar to the dyad on clinging).

89. Parāmaṭṭho ceva no ca parāmāso dhammo parāmaṭṭhassa ceva no ca parāmāsassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo – dānaṃ…pe… sīlaṃ…pe… uposathakammaṃ katvā taṃ paccavekkhati, assādeti abhinandati, taṃ ārabbha rāgo…pe… vicikicchā, uddhaccaṃ, domanassaṃ uppajjati, pubbe…pe… jhānā…pe… ariyā gotrabhuṃ paccavekkhanti, vodānaṃ paccavekkhanti, pahīne kilese…pe… vikkhambhite [M 3.0368] kilese…pe… pubbe…pe… cakkhuṃ…pe… vatthuṃ parāmaṭṭhe ceva no ca parāmāse khandhe aniccato…pe… domanassaṃ uppajjati. Dibbena cakkhunā rūpaṃ passati (yāva āvajjanā sabbaṃ kātabbaṃ). (1)

89. A phenomenon that is clung to but not a clinging is a condition for a phenomenon that is clung to but not a clinging by way of object condition. Having performed acts of generosity… virtue… observance, one reflects upon it, relishes it, and delights in it. Taking that as object, lust… doubt, restlessness, and displeasure arise. Previously… jhānas… noble ones reflect on change-of-lineage, reflect on purification, reflect on abandoned defilements… suppressed defilements… Previously… the eye… the physical base, the aggregates that are clung to but not clingings, as impermanent… displeasure arises. With the divine eye, one sees forms (everything should be done up to adverting). (1)

Parāmaṭṭho ceva no ca parāmāso dhammo parāmāsassa ceva parāmaṭṭhassa ca dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo – dānaṃ…pe… sīlaṃ…pe… uposathakammaṃ…pe… pubbe…pe… jhānā…pe… cakkhuṃ…pe… vatthuṃ parāmaṭṭhe ceva no ca parāmāse khandhe assādeti abhinandati, taṃ ārabbha diṭṭhi uppajjati. (2)

A phenomenon that is clung to but not a clinging is a condition for a phenomenon that is both a clinging and clung to by way of object condition. Generosity… virtue… observance… previously… jhānas… the eye… the physical base, the aggregates that are clung to but not clingings, one savors and delights in, and taking that as object, wrong view arises. (2)

Parāmaṭṭho ceva no ca parāmāso dhammo parāmāsassa ceva parāmaṭṭhassa ca parāmaṭṭhassa ceva no ca parāmāsassa ca dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo – dānaṃ…pe… sīlaṃ…pe… uposathakammaṃ…pe… pubbe…pe… jhānā…pe… cakkhuṃ…pe… vatthuṃ parāmaṭṭhe ceva no ca parāmāse khandhe assādeti abhinandati, taṃ ārabbha parāmāso ca sampayuttakā ca khandhā uppajjanti. (3)

A phenomenon that is clung to but not a clinging is a condition for a phenomenon that is both a clinging and clung to, and for a phenomenon that is clung to but not a clinging, by way of object condition. Generosity… virtue… observance… previously… jhānas… the eye… the physical base, the aggregates that are clung to but not clingings, one savors and delights in, and taking that as object, clinging and the associated aggregates arise. (3)

(Evaṃ itarepi tīṇi ārabbha kātabbāni. Imaṃ dukaṃ parāmāsadukasadisaṃ. Lokuttaraṃ yahiṃ na labbhati tahiṃ na kātabbaṃ.)

(Thus, the other three should also be done starting from this. This dyad is similar to the dyad on clinging. The supramundane should not be applied where it is not found.)

Parāmāsaparāmaṭṭhadukaṃ niṭṭhitaṃ.

The Dyad of Clinging and What is Clung To is concluded.

Root Condition

90. Parāmāsavippayuttaṃ [V 3.0454] parāmaṭṭhaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca parāmāsavippayutto parāmaṭṭho dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – parāmāsavippayuttaṃ parāmaṭṭhaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca tayo khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ…pe… dve khandhe…pe….

90. A phenomenon that is unassociated with clinging and grasped arises dependent on a phenomenon that is unassociated with clinging and grasped by way of root condition. Dependent on one aggregate that is unassociated with clinging and grasped, three aggregates and mind-originated material phenomena…pe… two aggregates…pe….

Parāmāsavippayuttaṃ aparāmaṭṭhaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca parāmāsavippayutto aparāmaṭṭho dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā (saṃkhittaṃ).

A phenomenon that is unassociated with clinging and ungrasped arises dependent on a phenomenon that is unassociated with clinging and ungrasped by way of root condition (in brief).

(Yathā cūḷantaraduke lokiyadukaṃ evaṃ kātabbaṃ ninnānākaraṇaṃ.)

(This should be done in the same way as the mundane dyad in the minor intermediate dyad, without variation.)

Parāmāsavippayuttaparāmaṭṭhadukaṃ niṭṭhitaṃ.

The Dyad on the Unassociated with Clinging and Grasped is concluded.

Parāmāsagocchakaṃ niṭṭhitaṃ.

The Cluster on Clinging is concluded.
