Nahetupaccayo

Non-Root Condition

18. Sārammaṇaṃ dhammaṃ paccayā sārammaṇo dhammo uppajjati nahetupaccayā… tīṇi (paṭiccavārasadisaṃ).

18. A phenomenon with an object conditions a phenomenon with an object to arise by way of non-root condition… three (similar to the dependence section).

Anārammaṇaṃ dhammaṃ paccayā anārammaṇo dhammo uppajjati nahetupaccayā – ekaṃ mahābhūtaṃ…pe… asaññasattānaṃ ekaṃ mahābhūtaṃ…pe…. (1)

A phenomenon without an object conditions a phenomenon without an object to arise by way of non-root condition: one great element, etc.; for non-percipient beings, one great element, etc. (1)

Anārammaṇaṃ dhammaṃ paccayā sārammaṇo dhammo uppajjati nahetupaccayā – cakkhāyatanaṃ paccayā cakkhuviññāṇaṃ…pe… kāyāyatanaṃ paccayā kāyaviññāṇaṃ, vatthuṃ paccayā ahetukā sārammaṇā khandhā; paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe… vatthuṃ paccayā vicikicchāsahagato uddhaccasahagato moho. (2)

A phenomenon without an object conditions a phenomenon with an object to arise by way of non-root condition: the eye base conditions eye-consciousness, etc.; the body base conditions body-consciousness; the physical base conditions the rootless aggregates with an object; at the moment of rebirth-linking, etc.; the physical base conditions delusion accompanied by doubt and restlessness. (2)

Anārammaṇaṃ [M 3.0375] dhammaṃ paccayā sārammaṇo ca anārammaṇo ca dhammā uppajjanti nahetupaccayā – vatthuṃ paccayā ahetukā sārammaṇā khandhā, mahābhūte paccayā cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ; paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe…. (3)

A phenomenon without an object conditions a phenomenon with an object and a phenomenon without an object to arise by way of non-root condition: the physical base conditions the rootless aggregates with an object; the great elements condition mind-originated materiality; at the moment of rebirth-linking, etc. (3)

19. Sārammaṇañca anārammaṇañca dhammaṃ paccayā sārammaṇo dhammo uppajjati nahetupaccayā – cakkhuviññāṇasahagataṃ ekaṃ khandhañca cakkhāyatanañca paccayā tayo khandhā…pe… dve khandhe ca…pe… kāyaviññāṇasahagataṃ…pe… ahetukaṃ sārammaṇaṃ ekaṃ khandhañca [T 4.0008][V 3.0463] vatthuñca paccayā tayo khandhā…pe… dve khandhe ca…pe… ahetukapaṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe… vicikicchāsahagate uddhaccasahagate khandhe ca vatthuñca paccayā vicikicchāsahagato uddhaccasahagato moho. (1)

19. A phenomenon with an object and a phenomenon without an object condition a phenomenon with an object to arise by way of non-root condition: one aggregate associated with eye-consciousness and the eye base condition the three aggregates, etc., and two aggregates, etc.; associated with body-consciousness, etc.; one rootless aggregate with an object and the physical base condition the three aggregates, etc., and two aggregates, etc.; at the moment of rootless rebirth-linking, etc.; the aggregates accompanied by doubt and restlessness and the physical base condition delusion accompanied by doubt and restlessness. (1)

Sārammaṇañca anārammaṇañca dhammaṃ paccayā anārammaṇo dhammo uppajjati nahetupaccayā – ahetuke sārammaṇe khandhe ca mahābhūte ca paccayā cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ; paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe…. (2)

A phenomenon with an object and a phenomenon without an object condition a phenomenon without an object to arise by way of non-root condition: the rootless aggregates with an object and the great elements condition mind-originated materiality; at the moment of rebirth-linking, etc. (2)

Sārammaṇañca anārammaṇañca dhammaṃ paccayā sārammaṇo ca anārammaṇo ca dhammā uppajjanti nahetupaccayā – ahetukaṃ sārammaṇaṃ ekaṃ khandhañca vatthuñca paccayā tayo khandhā…pe… dve khandhe ca…pe… ahetuke sārammaṇe khandhe ca mahābhūte ca paccayā cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ; ahetukapaṭisandhikkhaṇe ahetukaṃ sārammaṇaṃ ekaṃ khandhañca vatthuñca paccayā tayo khandhā…pe… dve khandhe ca…pe… ahetuke sārammaṇe khandhe ca mahābhūte ca paccayā kaṭattārūpaṃ…pe… (saṃkhittaṃ). (3)

A state with an object and a state without an object arise dependent on a state with an object and a state without an object by way of non-root condition—one rootless aggregate with an object and the physical basis are conditions for the three aggregates… (etc.)… and two aggregates… (etc.)… the rootless aggregates with an object and the great elements are conditions for mind-originated material form; at the moment of rootless rebirth-linking, one rootless aggregate with an object and the physical basis are conditions for the three aggregates… (etc.)… and two aggregates… (etc.)… the rootless aggregates with an object and the great elements are conditions for kamma-originated material form… (etc.)… (abbreviated). (3)

Hetupaccayo

Root Condition

27. Sārammaṇo [M 3.0377] dhammo sārammaṇassa dhammassa hetupaccayena paccayo – sārammaṇā hetū sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ hetupaccayena paccayo; paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe…. (1)

27. A state with an object is a condition for a state with an object by way of root condition. Roots with an object are a condition for the associated aggregates by way of root condition; at the moment of rebirth-linking… (1)

Sārammaṇo dhammo anārammaṇassa dhammassa hetupaccayena paccayo – sārammaṇā hetū cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ hetupaccayena paccayo; paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe…. (2)

A state with an object is a condition for a state without an object by way of root condition. Roots with an object are a condition for mind-originated material form by way of root condition; at the moment of rebirth-linking… (2)

Sārammaṇo dhammo sārammaṇassa ca [T 4.0010] anārammaṇassa ca dhammassa hetupaccayena paccayo – sārammaṇā hetū sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ hetupaccayena paccayo; paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe…. (3)

A state with an object is a condition for a state with an object and a state without an object by way of root condition. Roots with an object are a condition for the associated aggregates and for mind-originated material form by way of root condition; at the moment of rebirth-linking… (3)

Ārammaṇapaccayo

Object Condition

28. Sārammaṇo [V 3.0466] dhammo sārammaṇassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo – dānaṃ…pe… sīlaṃ…pe… uposathakammaṃ katvā taṃ paccavekkhati assādeti abhinandati, taṃ ārabbha rāgo uppajjati…pe… domanassaṃ uppajjati; pubbe suciṇṇāni…pe… jhānā…pe… ariyā maggā vuṭṭhahitvā maggaṃ paccavekkhanti, phalaṃ paccavekkhanti, pahīne kilese…pe… vikkhambhite kilese…pe… pubbe samudāciṇṇe kilese jānanti, sārammaṇe khandhe aniccato…pe… domanassaṃ uppajjati; cetopariyañāṇena sārammaṇacittasamaṅgissa cittaṃ jānāti, ākāsānañcāyatanaṃ viññāṇañcāyatanassa…pe… ākiñcaññāyatanaṃ nevasaññānāsaññāyatanassa…pe… sārammaṇā khandhā iddhividhañāṇassa, cetopariyañāṇassa, pubbenivāsānussatiñāṇassa, yathākammūpagañāṇassa, anāgataṃsañāṇassa, āvajjanāya ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo. (1)

28. A state with an object is a condition for a state with an object by way of object condition. Having performed generosity... virtue... or the Uposatha observance, one reflects upon it, savors it, and rejoices in it; taking that as an object, lust arises... or grief arises; one recollects past good deeds... or the jhānas... or having emerged from the noble paths, noble ones reflect upon the path, reflect upon the fruit, know the abandoned defilements... or the suppressed defilements... or the previously accumulated defilements; one regards the aggregates with an object as impermanent... and grief arises; through knowledge of others' minds, one knows the mind of a person endowed with a mind that has an object; the base of infinite space is a condition for the base of infinite consciousness... or the base of nothingness for the base of neither-perception-nor-non-perception... the aggregates with an object are conditions for the knowledge of psychic power, knowledge of others' minds, knowledge of past lives, knowledge of the destiny of beings according to their actions, knowledge of the future, and for adverting by way of object condition. (1)

29. Anārammaṇo dhammo sārammaṇassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo – ariyā nibbānaṃ paccavekkhanti, nibbānaṃ gotrabhussa, vodānassa, maggassa[M 3.0378], phalassa, āvajjanāya ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo; cakkhuṃ…pe… vatthuṃ aniccato…pe… domanassaṃ uppajjati; dibbena cakkhunā rūpaṃ passati, dibbāya sotadhātuyā saddaṃ [T 4.0011] suṇāti. Rūpāyatanaṃ cakkhuviññāṇassa…pe… phoṭṭhabbāyatanaṃ kāyaviññāṇassa…pe… anārammaṇā khandhā iddhividhañāṇassa, pubbenivāsānussatiñāṇassa, anāgataṃsañāṇassa, āvajjanāya ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo. (1)

29. A phenomenon without an object is a condition for a phenomenon with an object by way of object condition. The noble ones reflect upon Nibbāna; Nibbāna is a condition for change-of-lineage, purification, the path, the fruit, and adverting by way of object condition. One regards the eye... the physical base as impermanent... and sorrow arises; with the divine eye one sees a form; with the divine ear-element one hears a sound. The form base is a condition for eye-consciousness... the tangible base for body-consciousness... The aggregates without an object are a condition for the knowledge of psychic powers, the knowledge of the recollection of past lives, the knowledge of the future, and for adverting, by way of object condition. (1)

Adhipatipaccayo

Predominance Condition

30. Sārammaṇo dhammo sārammaṇassa dhammassa adhipatipaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇādhipati, sahajātādhipati. Ārammaṇādhipati – dānaṃ…pe… sīlaṃ…pe… uposathakammaṃ katvā taṃ garuṃ katvā paccavekkhati assādeti abhinandati, taṃ garuṃ katvā rāgo uppajjati, diṭṭhi uppajjati, pubbe suciṇṇāni…pe… jhānā vuṭṭhahitvā jhānaṃ…pe… ariyā maggā vuṭṭhahitvā maggaṃ garuṃ…pe… phalaṃ garuṃ…pe… sārammaṇe khandhe garuṃ katvā assādeti abhinandati, taṃ garuṃ katvā rāgo uppajjati, diṭṭhi uppajjati[V 3.0467]. Sahajātādhipati – sārammaṇādhipati sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ adhipatipaccayena paccayo. (1)

30. A phenomenon with an object is a condition for a phenomenon with an object by way of predominance condition, namely, object-predominance and conascent predominance. Object-predominance: Having given a gift... observed virtue... or performed the Uposatha observance, one esteems it, reflects upon it, savors it, and delights in it. Esteeming it, lust arises, wrong view arises. Past good deeds... Having emerged from jhāna, one esteems the jhāna... The noble ones, having emerged from the path, esteem the path... esteem the fruit... Esteeming the aggregates with an object, one savors and delights in them. Esteeming them, lust arises, wrong view arises. Conascent predominance: a predominance with an object is a condition for the concomitant aggregates by way of predominance condition. (1)

Sārammaṇo dhammo anārammaṇassa dhammassa adhipatipaccayena paccayo. Sahajātādhipati – sārammaṇādhipati cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ adhipatipaccayena paccayo. (2)

A phenomenon with an object is a condition for a phenomenon without an object by way of predominance condition. Conascent predominance: a predominance with an object is a condition for consciousness-originated matter by way of predominance condition. (2)

Sārammaṇo dhammo sārammaṇassa ca anārammaṇassa ca dhammassa adhipatipaccayena paccayo. Sahajātādhipati – sārammaṇādhipati sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ adhipatipaccayena paccayo. (3)

A phenomenon with an object is a condition for a phenomenon with an object and for a phenomenon without an object by way of predominance condition. Conascent predominance: a predominance with an object is a condition for the concomitant aggregates and for consciousness-originated matter by way of predominance condition. (3)

31. Anārammaṇo dhammo sārammaṇassa dhammassa adhipatipaccayena paccayo. Ārammaṇādhipati – ariyā nibbānaṃ garuṃ katvā paccavekkhanti; nibbānaṃ gotrabhussa[T 4.0012], vodānassa, maggassa, phalassa, adhipatipaccayena paccayo; cakkhuṃ…pe… vatthuṃ garuṃ katvā assādeti abhinandati, taṃ garuṃ katvā rāgo uppajjati, diṭṭhi uppajjati. (1)

31. A phenomenon without an object is a condition for a phenomenon with an object by way of predominance condition. Object-predominance: the noble ones reflect upon Nibbāna, esteeming it; Nibbāna is a condition for change-of-lineage, purification, the path, and the fruit by way of predominance condition; one esteems the eye... or the physical base, savors it, and delights in it; esteeming it, lust arises, wrong view arises. (1)

Anantarapaccayādi

Proximity Condition, etc.

32. Sārammaṇo [M 3.0379] dhammo sārammaṇassa dhammassa anantarapaccayena paccayo – purimā purimā sārammaṇā…pe… phalasamāpattiyā anantarapaccayena paccayo… samanantarapaccayena paccayo… ekaṃ… sahajātapaccayena paccayo… satta (paṭiccavāre sahajātasadisā)… aññamaññapaccayena paccayo… cha (paṭiccavāre aññamaññasadisaṃ)… nissayapaccayena paccayo… satta (paccayavāre nissayasadiso).

32. A phenomenon with an object is a condition for a phenomenon with an object by way of proximity condition—the preceding phenomena with an object… for the attainment of fruition by way of proximity condition… by way of contiguity condition… one… by way of conascence condition… seven (in the Dependent section, similar to conascence)… by way of mutuality condition… six (in the Dependent section, similar to mutuality)… by way of support condition… seven (in the Condition section, similar to support).

Upanissayapaccayo

Decisive Support Condition

33. Sārammaṇo dhammo sārammaṇassa dhammassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇūpanissayo, anantarūpanissayo, pakatūpanissayo…pe…. Pakatūpanissayo – saddhaṃ upanissāya dānaṃ deti…pe… mānaṃ jappeti, diṭṭhiṃ gaṇhāti. Sīlaṃ…pe… paññaṃ, rāgaṃ…pe… patthanaṃ, kāyikaṃ sukhaṃ… kāyikaṃ dukkhaṃ upanissāya dānaṃ deti…pe… samāpattiṃ [V 3.0468] uppādeti, pāṇaṃ hanati…pe… saṅghaṃ bhindati. Saddhā…pe… paññā, rāgo…pe… patthanā, kāyikaṃ sukhaṃ… kāyikaṃ dukkhaṃ saddhāya…pe… paññāya, rāgassa…pe… patthanāya, kāyikassa sukhassa, kāyikassa dukkhassa, maggassa, phalasamāpattiyā upanissayapaccayena paccayo. (1)

33. A phenomenon with an object is a condition for a phenomenon with an object by way of decisive support condition—object decisive support, proximity decisive support, natural decisive support, etc. Natural decisive support: relying on faith, one gives alms… harbors conceit, adopts a view. Relying on virtue… wisdom, lust… aspiration, bodily pleasure… bodily pain, one gives alms… produces an attainment, kills a living being… splits the Saṅgha. Faith… wisdom, lust… aspiration, bodily pleasure, and bodily pain are a condition for faith… wisdom, for lust… aspiration, for bodily pleasure, for bodily pain, for the path, and for the attainment of fruition, by way of decisive support condition. (1)

Anārammaṇo dhammo sārammaṇassa dhammassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇūpanissayo, pakatūpanissayo…pe…. Pakatūpanissayo – utuṃ, bhojanaṃ[T 4.0013], senāsanaṃ upanissāya dānaṃ deti…pe… samāpattiṃ uppādeti, pāṇaṃ hanati…pe… saṅghaṃ bhindati. Utu… bhojanaṃ… senāsanaṃ saddhāya…pe… patthanāya, kāyikassa sukhassa, kāyikassa dukkhassa, maggassa, phalasamāpattiyā upanissayapaccayena paccayo. (1)

A phenomenon without an object is a condition for a phenomenon with an object by way of decisive support condition—object decisive support, natural decisive support, etc. Natural decisive support: relying on climate, food, or lodging, one gives alms… produces an attainment, kills a living being… splits the Saṅgha. Climate, food, and lodging are a condition for faith… aspiration, for bodily pleasure, for bodily pain, for the path, and for the attainment of fruition, by way of decisive support condition. (1)

Purejātapaccayo

Prenascence Condition

34. Anārammaṇo dhammo sārammaṇassa dhammassa purejātapaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇapurejātaṃ, vatthupurejātaṃ. Ārammaṇapurejātaṃ – cakkhuṃ…pe… vatthuṃ aniccato…pe… domanassaṃ uppajjati; dibbena cakkhunā rūpaṃ passati[M 3.0380], dibbāya sotadhātuyā saddaṃ suṇāti. Rūpāyatanaṃ cakkhuviññāṇassa…pe… phoṭṭhabbāyatanaṃ kāyaviññāṇassa…pe…. Vatthupurejātaṃ – cakkhāyatanaṃ cakkhuviññāṇassa…pe… kāyāyatanaṃ kāyaviññāṇassa…pe… vatthu sārammaṇānaṃ khandhānaṃ purejātapaccayena paccayo. (1)

34. A phenomenon without an object is a condition for a phenomenon with an object by way of prenasence condition—object-prenascence, base-prenascence. Object-prenascence: one regards the eye… the physical base as impermanent… and sorrow arises; with the divine eye one sees a form; with the divine ear-element one hears a sound. The form base is a condition for eye-consciousness… the tangible base is a condition for body-consciousness…. Base-prenascence: the eye base is a condition for eye-consciousness… the body base is a condition for body-consciousness… the physical base is a condition for the aggregates with an object by way of prenasence condition. (1)

Pacchājātāsevanapaccayā

Postnascence and Repetition Conditions

35. Sārammaṇo dhammo anārammaṇassa dhammassa pacchājātapaccayena paccayo… ekaṃ.

35. A phenomenon with an object is a condition for a phenomenon without an object by way of postnascence condition… one.

Sārammaṇo dhammo sārammaṇassa dhammassa āsevanapaccayena paccayo… ekaṃ.

A phenomenon with an object is a condition for a phenomenon with an object by way of repetition condition… one.

Kammapaccayo

Kamma Condition

36. Sārammaṇo dhammo sārammaṇassa dhammassa kammapaccayena paccayo – sahajātā, nānākkhaṇikā[V 3.0469]. Sahajātā – sārammaṇā cetanā sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ kammapaccayena paccayo; paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe…. Nānākkhaṇikā – sārammaṇā cetanā vipākānaṃ khandhānaṃ kammapaccayena paccayo. (1)

36. A phenomenon with an object is a condition for a phenomenon with an object by way of the Kamma Condition: co-nascent, non-co-nascent. Co-nascent: volition with an object is a condition for the associated aggregates by way of the Kamma Condition; at the moment of rebirth-linking…. Non-co-nascent: volition with an object is a condition for the resultant aggregates by way of the Kamma Condition. (1)

Sārammaṇo dhammo anārammaṇassa dhammassa kammapaccayena paccayo – sahajātā[T 4.0014], nānākkhaṇikā. Sahajātā – sārammaṇā cetanā cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ kammapaccayena paccayo; paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe…. Nānākkhaṇikā – sārammaṇā cetanā kaṭattārūpānaṃ kammapaccayena paccayo. (2)

A phenomenon with an object is a condition for a phenomenon without an object by way of the Kamma Condition: co-nascent, non-co-nascent. Co-nascent: volition with an object is a condition for mind-produced material form by way of the Kamma Condition; at the moment of rebirth-linking…. Non-co-nascent: volition with an object is a condition for kamma-produced material form by way of the Kamma Condition. (2)

Sārammaṇo dhammo sārammaṇassa ca anārammaṇassa ca dhammassa kammapaccayena paccayo – sahajātā, nānākkhaṇikā. Sahajātā – sārammaṇā cetanā sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ kammapaccayena paccayo; paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe…. Nānākkhaṇikā – sārammaṇā cetanā vipākānaṃ khandhānaṃ kaṭattā ca rūpānaṃ kammapaccayena paccayo. (3)

A phenomenon with an object is a condition for both a phenomenon with an object and a phenomenon without an object by way of the Kamma Condition: co-nascent, non-co-nascent. Co-nascent: volition with an object is a condition for the associated aggregates and for mind-produced material form by way of the Kamma Condition; at the moment of rebirth-linking…. Non-co-nascent: volition with an object is a condition for the resultant aggregates and for kamma-produced material form by way of the Kamma Condition. (3)

Vipāka-āhārapaccayā

Result and Nutriment Conditions

37. Sārammaṇo dhammo sārammaṇassa dhammassa vipākapaccayena paccayo… tīṇi.

37. A phenomenon with an object is a condition for a phenomenon with an object by way of the Result Condition… three.

Sārammaṇo [M 3.0381] dhammo sārammaṇassa dhammassa āhārapaccayena paccayo… tīṇi.

A phenomenon with an object is a condition for a phenomenon with an object by way of the Nutriment Condition… three.

Anārammaṇo dhammo anārammaṇassa dhammassa āhārapaccayena paccayo – kabaḷīkāro āhāro imassa kāyassa āhārapaccayena paccayo. (1)

A phenomenon without an object is a condition for a phenomenon without an object by way of the Nutriment Condition. Edible food is a condition for this body by way of the Nutriment Condition. (1)

Indriyapaccayo

Faculty Condition

38. Sārammaṇo dhammo sārammaṇassa dhammassa indriyapaccayena paccayo… tīṇi.

38. A phenomenon with an object is a condition for a phenomenon with an object by way of the Faculty Condition… three.

Anārammaṇo dhammo anārammaṇassa dhammassa indriyapaccayena paccayo – rūpajīvitindriyaṃ kaṭattārūpānaṃ indriyapaccayena paccayo. (1)

A phenomenon without an object is a condition for a phenomenon without an object by way of the Faculty Condition. The material life faculty is a condition for kamma-produced material form by way of the Faculty Condition. (1)

Anārammaṇo [V 3.0470] dhammo sārammaṇassa dhammassa indriyapaccayena paccayo – cakkhundriyaṃ cakkhuviññāṇassa…pe… kāyindriyaṃ kāyaviññāṇassa indriyapaccayena paccayo. (1)

A phenomenon without an object is a condition for a phenomenon with an object by way of the Faculty Condition. The eye faculty is a condition for eye-consciousness… the body faculty is a condition for body-consciousness by way of the Faculty Condition. (1)

Sārammaṇo ca anārammaṇo [T 4.0015] ca dhammā sārammaṇassa dhammassa indriyapaccayena paccayo – cakkhundriyañca cakkhuviññāṇañca cakkhuviññāṇasahagatānaṃ khandhānaṃ indriyapaccayena paccayo…pe… kāyindriyañca kāyaviññāṇañca kāyaviññāṇasahagatānaṃ khandhānaṃ indriyapaccayena paccayo. (1)

Both a phenomenon with an object and a phenomenon without an object are conditions for a phenomenon with an object by way of the Faculty Condition. The eye faculty and eye-consciousness are conditions for the aggregates associated with eye-consciousness by way of the Faculty Condition… the body faculty and body-consciousness are conditions for the aggregates associated with body-consciousness by way of the Faculty Condition. (1)

Jhānapaccayādi

Jhāna Condition, etc.

39. Sārammaṇo dhammo sārammaṇassa dhammassa jhānapaccayena paccayo… tīṇi, maggapaccayena paccayo… tīṇi, sampayuttapaccayena paccayo… ekaṃ.

39. A phenomenon with an object is a condition for a phenomenon with an object by way of the Jhāna Condition… three; by way of the Path Condition… three; by way of the Association Condition… one.

Vippayuttapaccayo

Dissociation Condition

40. Sārammaṇo dhammo anārammaṇassa dhammassa vippayuttapaccayena paccayo – sahajātaṃ, pacchājātaṃ (saṃkhittaṃ). (1)

40. A phenomenon with an object is a condition for a phenomenon without an object by way of the Dissociation Condition: co-nascent, post-nascent (in brief). (1)

Anārammaṇo dhammo sārammaṇassa dhammassa vippayuttapaccayena paccayo – sahajātaṃ, purejātaṃ. Sahajātaṃ – paṭisandhikkhaṇe vatthu sārammaṇānaṃ khandhānaṃ [M 3.0382] vippayuttapaccayena paccayo. Purejātaṃ cakkhāyatanaṃ cakkhuviññāṇassa…pe… kāyāyatanaṃ kāyaviññāṇassa vippayuttapaccayena paccayo; vatthu sārammaṇānaṃ khandhānaṃ vippayuttapaccayena paccayo. (1)

A phenomenon without an object is a condition for a phenomenon with an object by way of the Dissociation Condition: co-nascent, pre-nascent. Co-nascent: At the moment of rebirth-linking, the physical base is a condition for the aggregates with an object by way of the Dissociation Condition. Pre-nascent: The eye-base is a condition for eye-consciousness… the body-base is a condition for body-consciousness… the physical base is a condition for the aggregates with an object by way of the Dissociation Condition. (1)

Atthipaccayo

Presence Condition

41. Sārammaṇo dhammo sārammaṇassa dhammassa atthipaccayena paccayo – sārammaṇo eko khandho tiṇṇannaṃ khandhānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo…pe… dve khandhā…pe… paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe…. (1)

41. A phenomenon with an object is a condition for a phenomenon with an object by way of the Presence Condition. One aggregate with an object is a condition for three aggregates by way of the Presence Condition… two aggregates… at the moment of rebirth-linking…. (1)

Sārammaṇo [V 3.0471] dhammo anārammaṇassa dhammassa atthipaccayena paccayo – sahajātaṃ, pacchājātaṃ (saṃkhittaṃ). (2)

A phenomenon with an object is a condition for a phenomenon without an object by way of the Presence Condition: co-nascent, post-nascent (in brief). (2)

Sārammaṇo dhammo sārammaṇassa ca anārammaṇassa ca dhammassa atthipaccayena paccayo (paṭiccasadisaṃ). (3)

A phenomenon with an object is a condition for a phenomenon with an object and for a phenomenon without an object by way of the Presence Condition (similar to dependent origination). (3)

42. Anārammaṇo dhammo anārammaṇassa dhammassa atthipaccayena paccayo – sahajātaṃ, āhāraṃ, indriyaṃ. Sahajātaṃ – ekaṃ mahābhūtaṃ…pe… (yāva [T 4.0016] asaññasattā). (1)

42. A phenomenon without an object is a condition for a phenomenon without an object by way of the Presence Condition: co-nascent, nutriment, faculty. Co-nascent: One great element… up to non-percipient beings. (1)

Anārammaṇo dhammo sārammaṇassa dhammassa atthipaccayena paccayo – sahajātaṃ, purejātaṃ. Sahajātaṃ – paṭisandhikkhaṇe vatthu sārammaṇānaṃ khandhānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo. Purejātaṃ – cakkhuṃ…pe… vatthuṃ aniccato…pe… domanassaṃ uppajjati; dibbena cakkhunā rūpaṃ passati, dibbāya sotadhātuyā saddaṃ suṇāti. Rūpāyatanaṃ cakkhuviññāṇassa…pe… phoṭṭhabbāyatanaṃ kāyaviññāṇassa…pe… cakkhāyatanaṃ cakkhuviññāṇassa…pe… kāyāyatanaṃ kāyaviññāṇassa…pe… vatthu sārammaṇānaṃ khandhānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo. (2)

A phenomenon without an object is a condition for a phenomenon with an object by way of the Presence Condition: co-nascent, pre-nascent. Co-nascent: At the moment of rebirth-linking, the physical base is a condition for the aggregates with an object by way of the Presence Condition. Pre-nascent: The eye… the physical base is considered with respect to impermanence… displeasure arises; one sees a form with the divine eye, one hears a sound with the divine ear element. The form-base is a condition for eye-consciousness… the tangible-base is a condition for body-consciousness… the eye-base is a condition for eye-consciousness… the body-base is a condition for body-consciousness… the physical base is a condition for the aggregates with an object by way of the Presence Condition. (2)

43. Sārammaṇo ca anārammaṇo ca dhammā sārammaṇassa dhammassa atthipaccayena paccayo – sahajātaṃ, purejātaṃ. Sahajāto – cakkhuviññāṇasahagato eko khandho ca cakkhāyatanañca tiṇṇannaṃ khandhānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo…pe… dve khandhā ca…pe… kāyaviññāṇasahagato eko khandho ca kāyāyatanañca tiṇṇannaṃ khandhānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo…pe… dve khandhā ca…pe… sārammaṇo eko khandho ca vatthu ca tiṇṇannaṃ khandhānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo…pe… dve khandhā ca…pe… paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe…. (1)

43. A phenomenon with an object and a phenomenon without an object are conditions for a phenomenon with an object by way of the Presence Condition: co-nascent, pre-nascent. Co-nascent: One aggregate co-arisen with eye-consciousness and the eye-base are conditions for three aggregates by way of the Presence Condition… two aggregates and… one aggregate co-arisen with body-consciousness and the body-base are conditions for three aggregates by way of the Presence Condition… two aggregates and… one aggregate with an object and the physical base are conditions for three aggregates by way of the Presence Condition… two aggregates and… at the moment of rebirth-linking…. (1)

Sārammaṇo [M 3.0383] ca anārammaṇo ca dhammā anārammaṇassa dhammassa atthipaccayena paccayo – sahajātaṃ, pacchājātaṃ, āhāraṃ, indriyaṃ. Sahajātā – sārammaṇā khandhā ca mahābhūtā ca cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo; paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe…. Pacchājātā – sārammaṇā khandhā ca kabaḷīkāro āhāro ca imassa kāyassa atthipaccayena paccayo. Pacchājātā [V 3.0472] – sārammaṇā [T 4.0017] khandhā ca rūpajīvitindriyañca kaṭattārūpānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo. (2)

Phenomena with an object and without an object are conditions for a phenomenon without an object by way of presence condition: conascence, postnascence, nutriment, faculty. Conascence: Aggregates with an object and the great elements are conditions for mind-originated materiality by way of presence condition; at the moment of rebirth-linking…. Postnascence: Aggregates with an object and edible food are conditions for this body by way of presence condition. Postnascence: Aggregates with an object and the material life faculty are conditions for kamma-originated materiality by way of presence condition. (2)

Suddhaṃ

Pure

44. Hetuyā tīṇi, ārammaṇe dve, adhipatiyā cattāri, anantare ekaṃ, samanantare ekaṃ, sahajāte satta, aññamaññe cha, nissaye satta, upanissaye dve, purejāte ekaṃ, pacchājāte ekaṃ, āsevane ekaṃ, kamme tīṇi, vipāke tīṇi, āhāre cattāri, indriye cha, jhāne tīṇi, magge tīṇi, sampayutte ekaṃ, vippayutte dve, atthiyā satta, natthiyā ekaṃ, vigate ekaṃ, avigate satta.

44. By root condition, three; by object condition, two; by dominance condition, four; by contiguity condition, one; by immediate contiguity condition, one; by conascence condition, seven; by mutuality condition, six; by dependence condition, seven; by decisive support condition, two; by prenascence condition, one; by postnascence condition, one; by repetition condition, one; by kamma condition, three; by result condition, three; by nutriment condition, four; by faculty condition, six; by jhāna condition, three; by path condition, three; by association condition, one; by dissociation condition, two; by presence condition, seven; by absence condition, one; by disappearance condition, one; by non-disappearance condition, seven.

Paccanīyuddhāro

The Negative Method

45. Sārammaṇo dhammo sārammaṇassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo… sahajātapaccayena paccayo… upanissayapaccayena paccayo… kammapaccayena paccayo. (1)

45. A phenomenon with an object is a condition for a phenomenon with an object by way of object condition... by way of conascence condition... by way of decisive support condition... by way of kamma condition. (1)

Sārammaṇo dhammo anārammaṇassa dhammassa sahajātapaccayena paccayo… pacchājātapaccayena paccayo… kammapaccayena paccayo. (2)

A phenomenon with an object is a condition for a phenomenon without an object by way of conascence condition... by way of postnascence condition... by way of kamma condition. (2)

Sārammaṇo dhammo sārammaṇassa ca anārammaṇassa ca dhammassa sahajātapaccayena paccayo… kammapaccayena paccayo. (3)

A phenomenon with an object is a condition for a phenomenon with an object and a phenomenon without an object by way of conascence condition... by way of kamma condition. (3)

46. Anārammaṇo dhammo anārammaṇassa dhammassa sahajātapaccayena paccayo… āhārapaccayena paccayo… indriyapaccayena paccayo. (1)

46. A phenomenon without an object is a condition for a phenomenon without an object by way of conascence condition... by way of nutriment condition... by way of faculty condition. (1)

Anārammaṇo [M 3.0384][V 3.0473] dhammo sārammaṇassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo… sahajātapaccayena paccayo… upanissayapaccayena paccayo… purejātapaccayena paccayo. (2)

A phenomenon without an object is a condition for a phenomenon with an object by way of object condition... by way of conascence condition... by way of decisive support condition... by way of prenascence condition. (2)

Sārammaṇo [T 4.0018] ca anārammaṇo ca dhammā sārammaṇassa dhammassa sahajātaṃ, purejātaṃ. (1)

Phenomena with an object and without an object are conditions for a phenomenon with an object by way of conascence and prenascence. (1)

Sārammaṇo ca anārammaṇo ca dhammā anārammaṇassa dhammassa sahajātaṃ, pacchājātaṃ, āhāraṃ, indriyaṃ. (2)

Phenomena with an object and without an object are conditions for a phenomenon without an object by way of conascence, postnascence, nutriment, and faculty. (2)

2. Paccayapaccanīyaṃ

2. The Negative Method of Conditional Relations

2. Saṅkhyāvāro

2. Enumeration Section

Suddhaṃ

Pure

47. Nahetuyā satta, naārammaṇe satta…pe… nasamanantare satta, nasahajāte cha, na aññamaññe cha, nanissaye cha, naupanissaye satta, napurejāte satta, napacchājāte satta…pe… namagge satta, nasampayutte cha, navippayutte pañca, noatthiyā cattāri, nonatthiyā satta, novigate satta, noavigate cattāri.

47. Not by root, seven; not by object, seven… not by immediate contiguity, seven; not by conascence, six; not by mutuality, six; not by dependence, six; not by decisive support, seven; not by prenascence, seven; not by postnascence, seven… not by path, seven; not by association, six; not by dissociation, five; not by presence, four; not by absence, seven; not by disappearance, seven; not by non-disappearance, four.

3. Paccayānulomapaccanīyaṃ

3. The Direct Order and Negative Method of Conditional Relations

48. Hetupaccayā naārammaṇe tīṇi, naadhipatiyā…pe… nasamanantare tīṇi, naaññamaññe ekaṃ, naupanissaye tīṇi…pe… namagge tīṇi, nasampayutte ekaṃ, navippayutte ekaṃ, nonatthiyā tīṇi, novigate tīṇi.

48. By way of root condition, three are not by object, not by dominance… not by immediate contiguity, three; not by mutuality, one; not by decisive support, three… not by path, three; not by association, one; not by dissociation, one; not by absence, three; not by disappearance, three.

4. Paccayapaccanīyānulomaṃ

4. The Negative Method and Direct Order of Conditional Relations

49. Nahetupaccayā ārammaṇe dve, adhipatiyā cattāri, anantare ekaṃ (anulomamātikā kātabbā)…pe… avigate satta.

49. Not by way of root condition, two by way of object; four by way of dominance; one by way of contiguity (the direct order matrix should be done)… by way of non-disappearance, seven.

Sārammaṇadukaṃ niṭṭhitaṃ.

The Dyad on 'With an Object' is finished.

56. Cittadukaṃ

56. The Mind Dyad

1. Paṭiccavāro

1. The Dependence Section

1. Paccayānulomaṃ

1. The Direct Order of Conditional Relations

1. The Analysis Section

Hetupaccayo

Root Condition

50. Cittaṃ [T 4.0019][M 3.0385][V 3.0474] dhammaṃ paṭicca nocitto dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – cittaṃ paṭicca sampayuttakā khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ; paṭisandhikkhaṇe cittaṃ paṭicca sampayuttakā khandhā kaṭattā ca rūpaṃ. (1)

50. Dependent on a mind-phenomenon, a non-mind phenomenon arises by way of root condition. Dependent on mind, associated aggregates and mind-originated matter arise; at the moment of rebirth-linking, dependent on mind, associated aggregates and kamma-originated matter arise. (1)

Nocittaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca nocitto dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – nocittaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca dve khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ, dve khandhe paṭicca eko khandho cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ; paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe… khandhe paṭicca vatthu, vatthuṃ paṭicca khandhā, ekaṃ mahābhūtaṃ paṭicca…pe…. (1)

Dependent on a non-mind phenomenon, a non-mind phenomenon arises by way of root condition. Dependent on one non-mind aggregate, two aggregates and mind-originated matter arise; dependent on two aggregates, one aggregate and mind-originated matter arise; at the moment of rebirth-linking… dependent on aggregates, the base arises; dependent on the base, aggregates arise; dependent on one great element… (1)

Nocittaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca citto dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – nocitte khandhe paṭicca cittaṃ; paṭisandhikkhaṇe nocitte khandhe paṭicca cittaṃ; paṭisandhikkhaṇe vatthuṃ paṭicca cittaṃ. (2)

Dependent on a non-mind phenomenon, a mind-phenomenon arises by way of root condition. Dependent on non-mind aggregates, mind arises; at the moment of rebirth-linking, dependent on non-mind aggregates, mind arises; at the moment of rebirth-linking, dependent on the base, mind arises. (2)

Nocittaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca citto ca nocitto ca dhammā uppajjanti hetupaccayā – nocittaṃ ekaṃ [V 3.0475] khandhaṃ paṭicca dve khandhā cittañca cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ, dve khandhe…pe… paṭisandhikkhaṇe nocittaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca dve khandhā cittañca kaṭattā ca rūpaṃ, dve khandhe paṭicca eko khandho cittañca kaṭattā ca rūpaṃ; paṭisandhikkhaṇe vatthuṃ paṭicca cittañca sampayuttakā ca khandhā. (3)

Dependent on a non-mind phenomenon, both mind and non-mind phenomena arise by way of root condition: dependent on one non-mind aggregate, two aggregates, mind, and mind-originated matter arise; dependent on two aggregates... at the moment of rebirth-linking, dependent on one non-mind aggregate, two aggregates, mind, and kamma-produced matter arise; dependent on two aggregates, one aggregate, mind, and kamma-produced matter arise; at the moment of rebirth-linking, dependent on the base, mind and associated aggregates arise. (3)

Cittañca nocittañca dhammaṃ paṭicca nocitto dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā [T 4.0020] – nocittaṃ ekaṃ khandhañca cittañca paṭicca dve khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ, dve khandhe ca…pe… cittañca mahābhūte ca paṭicca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ; paṭisandhikkhaṇe nocittaṃ ekaṃ khandhañca cittañca paṭicca dve khandhā kaṭattā ca rūpaṃ, dve khandhe…pe… paṭisandhikkhaṇe cittañca vatthuñca paṭicca nocittā khandhā; paṭisandhikkhaṇe cittañca mahābhūte ca paṭicca kaṭattārūpaṃ. (1)

Dependent on a mind phenomenon and a non-mind phenomenon, a non-mind phenomenon arises by way of root condition: dependent on one non-mind aggregate and mind, two aggregates and mind-originated matter arise; dependent on two aggregates... dependent on mind and the great elements, mind-originated matter arises; at the moment of rebirth-linking, dependent on one non-mind aggregate and mind, two aggregates and kamma-produced matter arise; dependent on two aggregates... at the moment of rebirth-linking, dependent on mind and the base, non-mind aggregates arise; at the moment of rebirth-linking, dependent on mind and the great elements, kamma-produced matter arises. (1)

Ārammaṇapaccayo

Object Condition

51. Cittaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca nocitto dhammo uppajjati ārammaṇapaccayā – cittaṃ paṭicca sampayuttakā khandhā; paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe…. (1)

51. Dependent on a mind phenomenon, a non-mind phenomenon arises by way of object condition: dependent on mind, the associated aggregates arise; at the moment of rebirth-linking… (1)

Nocittaṃ [M 3.0386] dhammaṃ paṭicca nocitto dhammo uppajjati ārammaṇapaccayā – nocittaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca dve khandhā, dve khandhe…pe… paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe… paṭisandhikkhaṇe vatthuṃ paṭicca khandhā. (1)

Dependent on a non-mind phenomenon, a non-mind phenomenon arises by way of object condition: dependent on one non-mind aggregate, two aggregates arise; dependent on two aggregates…; at the moment of rebirth-linking…; at the moment of rebirth-linking, dependent on the base, the aggregates arise. (1)

Nocittaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca citto dhammo uppajjati ārammaṇapaccayā – nocitte khandhe paṭicca cittaṃ; paṭisandhikkhaṇe nocitte khandhe paṭicca cittaṃ; paṭisandhikkhaṇe vatthuṃ paṭicca cittaṃ. (2)

Dependent on a non-mind phenomenon, a mind phenomenon arises by way of object condition: dependent on non-mind aggregates, mind arises; at the moment of rebirth-linking, dependent on non-mind aggregates, mind arises; at the moment of rebirth-linking, dependent on the base, mind arises. (2)

Nocittaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca citto ca nocitto ca dhammā uppajjanti ārammaṇapaccayā – nocittaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca dve khandhā cittañca, dve khandhe paṭicca…pe… paṭisandhikkhaṇe nocittaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca dve khandhā cittañca, dve khandhe…pe… paṭisandhikkhaṇe vatthuṃ paṭicca cittañca sampayuttakā ca khandhā. (3)

Dependent on a non-mind phenomenon, both mind and non-mind phenomena arise by way of object condition: dependent on one non-mind aggregate, two aggregates and mind arise; dependent on two aggregates…; at the moment of rebirth-linking, dependent on one non-mind aggregate, two aggregates and mind arise; dependent on two aggregates…; at the moment of rebirth-linking, dependent on the base, mind and associated aggregates arise. (3)

Cittañca [V 3.0476] nocittañca dhammaṃ paṭicca nocitto dhammo uppajjati ārammaṇapaccayā – nocittaṃ ekaṃ khandhañca cittañca paṭicca dve khandhā, dve khandhe ca…pe… paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe… paṭisandhikkhaṇe cittañca vatthuñca paṭicca nocittā khandhā. (1) (Saṃkhittaṃ).

Dependent on a mind and a non-mind phenomenon, a non-mind phenomenon arises by way of object condition: dependent on one non-mind aggregate and mind, two aggregates arise; dependent on two aggregates…; at the moment of rebirth-linking…; at the moment of rebirth-linking, dependent on mind and the base, non-mind aggregates arise. (1) (Summary).

1. Chapter on Analysis

Nahetupaccayo

Non-Root Condition

53. Cittaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca nocitto dhammo uppajjati nahetupaccayā – ahetukaṃ cittaṃ paṭicca sampayuttakā khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ; ahetukapaṭisandhikkhaṇe cittaṃ…pe… vicikicchāsahagataṃ uddhaccasahagataṃ cittaṃ paṭicca vicikicchāsahagato uddhaccasahagato moho. (1)

53. Dependent on a mind phenomenon, a non-mind phenomenon arises by way of non-root condition: dependent on rootless mind, the associated aggregates and mind-originated matter arise; at the moment of rootless rebirth-linking, mind…; dependent on mind accompanied by doubt and restlessness, delusion accompanied by doubt and restlessness arises. (1)

Nocittaṃ [M 3.0387] dhammaṃ paṭicca nocitto dhammo uppajjati nahetupaccayā – ahetukaṃ nocittaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca dve khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ, dve khandhe…pe… ahetukapaṭisandhikkhaṇe [V 3.0477]…pe… (yāva asaññasattā) vicikicchāsahagate uddhaccasahagate khandhe paṭicca vicikicchāsahagato uddhaccasahagato moho. (1)

Dependent on a non-mind phenomenon, a non-mind phenomenon arises by way of non-root condition: dependent on one rootless non-mind aggregate, two aggregates and mind-originated matter arise; dependent on two aggregates…; at the moment of rootless rebirth-linking… (up to the non-percipient beings); dependent on aggregates accompanied by doubt and restlessness, delusion accompanied by doubt and restlessness arises. (1)

Nocittaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca citto dhammo uppajjati nahetupaccayā – ahetuke nocitte khandhe paṭicca cittaṃ; ahetukapaṭisandhikkhaṇe nocitte khandhe paṭicca cittaṃ; ahetukapaṭisandhikkhaṇe vatthuṃ paṭicca cittaṃ. (2)

Dependent on a non-mind phenomenon, a mind phenomenon arises by way of non-root condition: dependent on rootless non-mind aggregates, mind arises; at the moment of rootless rebirth-linking, dependent on non-mind aggregates, mind arises; at the moment of rootless rebirth-linking, dependent on the base, mind arises. (2)

Nocittaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca citto ca nocitto ca dhammā uppajjanti nahetupaccayā – ahetukaṃ nocittaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca [T 4.0022] dve khandhā cittañca cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ, dve khandhe…pe… ahetukapaṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe… ahetukapaṭisandhikkhaṇe vatthuṃ paṭicca cittañca sampayuttakā ca khandhā. (3)

Dependent on a non-mind phenomenon, both mind and non-mind phenomena arise by way of non-root condition: dependent on one rootless non-mind aggregate, two aggregates, mind, and mind-originated matter arise; dependent on two aggregates…; at the moment of rootless rebirth-linking…; at the moment of rootless rebirth-linking, dependent on the base, mind and associated aggregates arise. (3)

Cittañca nocittañca dhammaṃ paṭicca nocitto dhammo uppajjati nahetupaccayā – ahetukaṃ nocittaṃ ekaṃ khandhañca cittañca paṭicca dve khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ, dve khandhe ca…pe… ahetukapaṭisandhikkhaṇe nocittaṃ ekaṃ khandhañca cittañca paṭicca dve khandhā kaṭattā ca rūpaṃ, dve khandhe ca…pe… ahetukapaṭisandhikkhaṇe cittañca vatthuñca paṭicca nocittā khandhā, vicikicchāsahagataṃ uddhaccasahagataṃ cittañca sampayuttake ca khandhe paṭicca vicikicchāsahagato uddhaccasahagato moho. (1)

Dependent on a mind and a non-mind phenomenon, a non-mind phenomenon arises by way of non-root condition: dependent on one rootless non-mind aggregate and mind, two aggregates and mind-originated matter arise; dependent on two aggregates…; at the moment of rootless rebirth-linking, dependent on one rootless non-mind aggregate and mind, two aggregates and kamma-produced matter arise; dependent on two aggregates…; at the moment of rootless rebirth-linking, dependent on mind and the base, non-mind aggregates arise; dependent on mind accompanied by doubt and restlessness and its associated aggregates, delusion accompanied by doubt and restlessness arises. (1)

Naārammaṇapaccayo

Non-Object Condition

54. Cittaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca nocitto dhammo uppajjati naārammaṇapaccayā – cittaṃ paṭicca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ; paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe…. (1)

54. Dependent on a mental phenomenon, a non-mental phenomenon arises, not by way of object condition. Dependent on mind, mind-originated material form arises. At the moment of rebirth-linking… and so on. (1)

Nocittaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca nocitto dhammo uppajjati naārammaṇapaccayā – nocitte khandhe paṭicca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ; paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe… (yāva asaññasattā). (2)

Dependent on a non-mental phenomenon, a non-mental phenomenon arises, not by way of object condition. Dependent on non-mental aggregates, mind-originated material form arises. At the moment of rebirth-linking… and so on… (up to non-percipient beings). (2)

Cittañca nocittañca dhammaṃ paṭicca nocitto dhammo uppajjati naārammaṇapaccayā – cittañca sampayuttake ca khandhe paṭicca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ, cittañca mahābhūte ca paṭicca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ; paṭisandhikkhaṇe cittañca sampayuttake ca khandhe paṭicca kaṭattārūpaṃ, cittañca mahābhūte ca paṭicca kaṭattārūpaṃ. (1)

Dependent on a mental phenomenon and a non-mental phenomenon, a non-mental phenomenon arises, not by way of object condition. Dependent on mind and associated aggregates, mind-originated material form arises; dependent on mind and the great elements, mind-originated material form arises. At the moment of rebirth-linking, dependent on mind and associated aggregates, kamma-resultant material form arises; dependent on mind and the great elements, kamma-resultant material form arises. (1)

Naadhipatipaccayādi

Non-predominance Condition, etc.

55. Cittaṃ [M 3.0388][V 3.0478] dhammaṃ paṭicca nocitto dhammo uppajjati naadhipatipaccayā [T 4.0023]… pañca… naanantarapaccayā…pe… naupanissayapaccayā… tīṇi.

55. Dependent on a mental phenomenon, a non-mental phenomenon arises, not by way of predominance condition… (five cases). Not by way of contiguity condition… and so on… not by way of strong dependence condition… (three cases).

Napurejātapaccayādi

Non-prenascence Condition, etc.

56. Cittaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca nocitto dhammo uppajjati napurejātapaccayā – arūpe cittaṃ paṭicca sampayuttakā khandhā, cittaṃ paṭicca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ; paṭisandhikkhaṇe cittaṃ paṭicca sampayuttakā khandhā kaṭattā ca rūpaṃ. (1)

56. Dependent on a mental phenomenon, a non-mental phenomenon arises, not by way of prenascence condition. In the immaterial realm, dependent on mind, associated aggregates arise; dependent on mind, mind-originated material form arises. At the moment of rebirth-linking, dependent on mind, associated aggregates and kamma-resultant material form arise. (1)

Nocittaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca nocitto dhammo uppajjati napurejātapaccayā – arūpe nocittaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca dve khandhā, dve khandhe…pe… nocitte khandhe paṭicca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ; paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe… (yāva asaññasattā). (1)

Dependent on a non-mental phenomenon, a non-mental phenomenon arises, not by way of prenascence condition. In the immaterial realm, dependent on one non-mental aggregate, two aggregates arise; dependent on two aggregates… and so on… dependent on non-mental aggregates, mind-originated material form arises. At the moment of rebirth-linking… and so on… (up to non-percipient beings). (1)

Nocittaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca citto dhammo uppajjati napurejātapaccayā – arūpe nocitte khandhe paṭicca cittaṃ; paṭisandhikkhaṇe… vatthuṃ paṭicca cittaṃ. (2)

Dependent on a non-mental phenomenon, a mental phenomenon arises, not by way of prenascence condition. In the immaterial realm, mind arises dependent on non-mental aggregates. At the moment of rebirth-linking… mind arises dependent on the physical base. (2)

Nocittaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca citto ca nocitto ca dhammā uppajjanti napurejātapaccayā – arūpe nocittaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca dve khandhā cittañca, dve khandhe…pe… paṭisandhikkhaṇe vatthuṃ paṭicca cittañca sampayuttakā ca khandhā. (3)

Dependent on a non-mental phenomenon, both mental and non-mental phenomena arise, not by way of prenascence condition. In the immaterial realm, dependent on one non-mental aggregate, two aggregates and mind arise; dependent on two aggregates… and so on… At the moment of rebirth-linking, dependent on the physical base, mind and associated aggregates arise. (3)

Cittañca nocittañca dhammaṃ paṭicca nocitto dhammo uppajjati napurejātapaccayā – arūpe nocittaṃ ekaṃ khandhañca cittañca paṭicca dve khandhā, dve khandhe ca…pe… nocitte khandhe ca cittañca paṭicca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ, cittañca mahābhūte ca paṭicca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ; paṭisandhikkhaṇe cittañca vatthuñca paṭicca nocittā khandhā; paṭisandhikkhaṇe cittañca sampayuttake ca khandhe paṭicca kaṭattārūpaṃ, cittañca [T 4.0024] mahābhūte ca paṭicca kaṭattārūpaṃ. (1)

Dependent on a mental phenomenon and a non-mental phenomenon, a non-mental phenomenon arises, not by way of prenascence condition. In the immaterial realm, dependent on one non-mental aggregate and mind, two aggregates arise; dependent on two aggregates… and so on… dependent on non-mental aggregates and mind, mind-originated material form arises; dependent on mind and the great elements, mind-originated material form arises. At the moment of rebirth-linking, non-mental aggregates arise dependent on mind and the physical base. At the moment of rebirth-linking, kamma-resultant material form arises dependent on mind and associated aggregates, and kamma-resultant material form arises dependent on mind and the great elements. (1)

Napacchājātapaccayā… naāsevanapaccayā….

Not by way of post-nascence condition… not by way of repetition condition….

Nakammapaccayo

Non-kamma Condition

57. Cittaṃ [V 3.0479] dhammaṃ paṭicca nocitto dhammo uppajjati nakammapaccayā – cittaṃ paṭicca sampayuttakā cetanā. (1)

57. Dependent on a mental phenomenon, a non-mental phenomenon arises, not by way of kamma condition. Dependent on mind, associated volitions arise. (1)

Nocittaṃ [M 3.0389] dhammaṃ paṭicca nocitto dhammo uppajjati nakammapaccayā – nocitte khandhe paṭicca sampayuttakā cetanā; bāhiraṃ… āhārasamuṭṭhānaṃ… utusamuṭṭhānaṃ…pe…. (1)

Dependent on a non-mental phenomenon, a non-mental phenomenon arises, not by way of kamma condition. Dependent on non-mental aggregates, associated volitions arise. External… food-originated… temperature-originated… and so on. (1)

Cittañca nocittañca dhammaṃ paṭicca nocitto dhammo uppajjati nakammapaccayā – nocitte khandhe ca cittañca paṭicca sampayuttakā cetanā (saṃkhittaṃ). (1)

Dependent on a mental phenomenon and a non-mental phenomenon, a non-mental phenomenon arises, not by way of kamma condition. Dependent on non-mental aggregates and mind, associated volitions arise (summarized). (1)

Hetupaccayo

Root Condition

61. Cittaṃ [T 4.0025] dhammaṃ paccayā nocitto dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – cittaṃ paccayā sampayuttakā khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ; paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe…. (1)

61. A mental phenomenon conditions a non-mental phenomenon to arise by way of root condition: consciousness conditions the associated aggregates and mind-originated material form; at the moment of rebirth-linking…etc.…. (1)

Nocittaṃ [M 3.0390] dhammaṃ paccayā nocitto dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – nocittaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paccayā dve khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ, dve khandhe…pe… paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe… (yāva mahābhūtā), vatthuṃ paccayā nocittā khandhā. (1)

A non-mental phenomenon conditions a non-mental phenomenon to arise by way of root condition: one non-mental aggregate conditions two aggregates and mind-originated material form; two aggregates…etc.… at the moment of rebirth-linking…etc.… (up to the great elements); the physical base conditions non-mental aggregates. (1)

Nocittaṃ dhammaṃ paccayā citto dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – nocitte khandhe paccayā cittaṃ, vatthuṃ paccayā cittaṃ; paṭisandhikkhaṇe nocitte khandhe paccayā cittaṃ, paṭisandhikkhaṇe vatthuṃ paccayā cittaṃ. (2)

A non-mental phenomenon conditions a mental phenomenon to arise by way of root condition: non-mental aggregates condition consciousness; the physical base conditions consciousness; at the moment of rebirth-linking, non-mental aggregates condition consciousness; at the moment of rebirth-linking, the physical base conditions consciousness. (2)

Nocittaṃ [V 3.0481] dhammaṃ paccayā citto ca nocitto ca dhammā uppajjanti hetupaccayā – nocittaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paccayā dve khandhā cittañca cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ, dve khandhe…pe… vatthuṃ paccayā cittañca sampayuttakā ca khandhā; paṭisandhikkhaṇe nocittaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paccayā dve khandhā cittañca kaṭattā ca rūpaṃ, dve khandhe…pe… paṭisandhikkhaṇe vatthuṃ paccayā cittañca sampayuttakā ca khandhā. (3)

A non-mental phenomenon conditions both mental and non-mental phenomena to arise by way of root condition: one non-mental aggregate conditions two aggregates, consciousness, and mind-originated material form; two aggregates…etc.… the physical base conditions consciousness and the associated aggregates; at the moment of rebirth-linking, one non-mental aggregate conditions two aggregates, consciousness, and kamma-originated material form; two aggregates…etc.… at the moment of rebirth-linking, the physical base conditions consciousness and the associated aggregates. (3)

Cittañca nocittañca dhammaṃ paccayā nocitto dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – nocittaṃ ekaṃ khandhañca cittañca paccayā dve khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ, dve khandhe ca…pe… cittañca mahābhūte ca paccayā cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ, cittañca vatthuñca paccayā nocittā khandhā, paṭisandhikkhaṇe nocittaṃ ekaṃ khandhañca cittañca paccayā dve khandhā kaṭattā [T 4.0026] ca rūpaṃ, dve khandhe ca…pe… paṭisandhikkhaṇe cittañca mahābhūte ca paccayā kaṭattārūpaṃ; paṭisandhikkhaṇe cittañca vatthuñca paccayā nocittā khandhā. (1)

Both a mental and a non-mental phenomenon condition a non-mental phenomenon to arise by way of root condition: one non-mental aggregate and consciousness condition two aggregates and mind-originated material form; two aggregates and…etc.… consciousness and the great elements condition mind-originated material form; consciousness and the physical base condition non-mental aggregates; at the moment of rebirth-linking, one non-mental aggregate and consciousness condition two aggregates and kamma-originated material form; two aggregates and…etc.… at the moment of rebirth-linking, consciousness and the great elements condition kamma-originated material form; at the moment of rebirth-linking, consciousness and the physical base condition non-mental aggregates. (1)

Ārammaṇapaccayo

Object Condition

62. Cittaṃ dhammaṃ paccayā nocitto dhammo uppajjati ārammaṇapaccayā… ekaṃ (paṭiccavārasadisaṃ).

62. A mental phenomenon conditions a non-mental phenomenon to arise by way of object condition… one (similar to the Dependent Section).

Nocittaṃ dhammaṃ paccayā nocitto dhammo uppajjati ārammaṇapaccayā – nocittaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paccayā dve khandhā, dve khandhe…pe… paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe… paṭisandhikkhaṇe vatthuṃ paccayā khandhā, cakkhāyatanaṃ paccayā cakkhuviññāṇasahagatā khandhā…pe… kāyāyatanaṃ paccayā kāyaviññāṇasahagatā khandhā, vatthuṃ paccayā nocittā khandhā. (1)

A non-mental phenomenon conditions a non-mental phenomenon to arise by way of object condition: one non-mental aggregate conditions two aggregates; two aggregates…etc.… at the moment of rebirth-linking…etc.… at the moment of rebirth-linking, the physical base conditions the aggregates; the eye-base conditions the aggregates associated with eye-consciousness…etc.… the body-base conditions the aggregates associated with body-consciousness; the physical base conditions non-mental aggregates. (1)

Nocittaṃ dhammaṃ paccayā citto dhammo uppajjati ārammaṇapaccayā – nocitte khandhe paccayā cittaṃ, vatthuṃ paccayā cittaṃ; paṭisandhikkhaṇe nocitte [M 3.0391] khandhe paccayā cittaṃ, paṭisandhikkhaṇe vatthuṃ paccayā cittaṃ, cakkhāyatanaṃ paccayā cakkhuviññāṇaṃ…pe… kāyāyatanaṃ paccayā kāyaviññāṇaṃ. (2)

A non-mental phenomenon conditions a mental phenomenon to arise by way of object condition: non-mental aggregates condition consciousness; the physical base conditions consciousness; at the moment of rebirth-linking, non-mental aggregates condition consciousness; at the moment of rebirth-linking, the physical base conditions consciousness; the eye-base conditions eye-consciousness…etc.… the body-base conditions body-consciousness. (2)

Nocittaṃ [V 3.0482] dhammaṃ paccayā citto ca nocitto ca dhammā uppajjanti ārammaṇapaccayā – nocittaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paccayā dve khandhā cittañca, dve khandhe…pe… vatthuṃ paccayā cittañca sampayuttakā ca khandhā; paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe… paṭisandhikkhaṇe vatthuṃ paccayā cittañca sampayuttakā ca khandhā, cakkhāyatanaṃ paccayā cakkhuviññāṇaṃ sampayuttakā ca khandhā…pe… kāyāyatanaṃ paccayā kāyaviññāṇaṃ sampayuttakā ca khandhā. (3)

A non-mental phenomenon conditions both mental and non-mental phenomena to arise by way of object condition: one non-mental aggregate conditions two aggregates and consciousness; two aggregates…etc.… the physical base conditions consciousness and the associated aggregates; at the moment of rebirth-linking…etc.… at the moment of rebirth-linking, the physical base conditions consciousness and the associated aggregates; the eye-base conditions eye-consciousness and the associated aggregates…etc.… the body-base conditions body-consciousness and the associated aggregates. (3)

Cittañca nocittañca dhammaṃ paccayā nocitto dhammo uppajjati ārammaṇapaccayā – nocittaṃ [T 4.0027] ekaṃ khandhañca cittañca paccayā dve khandhā, dve khandhe ca…pe… cittañca vatthuñca paccayā nocittā khandhā, paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe… paṭisandhikkhaṇe cittañca vatthuñca paccayā nocittā khandhā, cakkhāyatanañca cakkhuviññāṇañca paccayā cakkhuviññāṇasahagatā khandhā…pe… kāyāyatanaṃ ca…pe… (saṃkhittaṃ). (1)

Both a mental and a non-mental phenomenon condition a non-mental phenomenon to arise by way of object condition: one non-mental aggregate and consciousness condition two aggregates; two aggregates and…etc.… consciousness and the physical base condition non-mental aggregates; at the moment of rebirth-linking…etc.… at the moment of rebirth-linking, consciousness and the physical base condition non-mental aggregates; the eye-base and eye-consciousness condition the aggregates associated with eye-consciousness…etc.… the body-base and…etc.… (abbreviated). (1)

64. Cittaṃ dhammaṃ paccayā nocitto dhammo uppajjati nahetupaccayā – ahetukaṃ cittaṃ paccayā sampayuttakā khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ; ahetukapaṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe… vicikicchāsahagataṃ uddhaccasahagataṃ cittaṃ paccayā vicikicchāsahagato uddhaccasahagato moho. (1)

64. A mental phenomenon conditions a non-mental phenomenon to arise by way of non-root condition: rootless consciousness conditions the associated aggregates and mind-originated material form; at the moment of rootless rebirth-linking…etc.… consciousness accompanied by doubt and restlessness conditions delusion accompanied by doubt and restlessness. (1)

65. Nocittaṃ dhammaṃ paccayā nocitto dhammo uppajjati nahetupaccayā – ahetukaṃ nocittaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paccayā dve khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ, dve khandhe…pe… ahetukapaṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe… (yāva asaññasattā), cakkhāyatanaṃ paccayā cakkhuviññāṇasahagatā khandhā…pe… kāyāyatanaṃ paccayā kāyaviññāṇasahagatā khandhā, vatthuṃ paccayā [V 3.0483] ahetukā nocitte [M 3.0392] khandhā vicikicchāsahagate uddhaccasahagate khandhe ca vatthuñca paccayā vicikicchāsahagato uddhaccasahagato moho. (1)

65. A non-mental phenomenon conditions a non-mental phenomenon to arise by way of non-root condition: one rootless non-mental aggregate conditions two aggregates and mind-originated material form; two aggregates…etc.… at the moment of rootless rebirth-linking…etc.… (up to non-percipient beings); the eye-base conditions the aggregates associated with eye-consciousness…etc.… the body-base conditions the aggregates associated with body-consciousness; the physical base conditions rootless non-mental aggregates; aggregates accompanied by doubt and restlessness and the physical base condition delusion accompanied by doubt and restlessness. (1)

Nocittaṃ dhammaṃ paccayā citto dhammo uppajjati nahetupaccayā – ahetuke nocitte khandhe paccayā cittaṃ, vatthuṃ paccayā cittaṃ; ahetukapaṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe… ahetukapaṭisandhikkhaṇe vatthuṃ paccayā [T 4.0028] cittaṃ, cakkhāyatanaṃ paccayā cakkhuviññāṇaṃ…pe… kāyāyatanaṃ paccayā kāyaviññāṇaṃ. (2)

A non-mind phenomenon conditions a mind phenomenon to arise by way of non-root condition: rootless non-mind aggregates condition the mind, the base conditions the mind; at the moment of rootless rebirth-linking… at the moment of rootless rebirth-linking, the base conditions the mind; the eye-base conditions eye-consciousness… the body-base conditions body-consciousness. (2)

Nocittaṃ dhammaṃ paccayā citto ca nocitto ca dhammā uppajjanti nahetupaccayā – ahetukaṃ nocittaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paccayā dve khandhā cittañca cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ, dve khandhe…pe… vatthuṃ paccayā cittañca sampayuttakā ca khandhā; ahetukapaṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe… ahetukapaṭisandhikkhaṇe vatthuṃ paccayā cittañca sampayuttakā ca khandhā, cakkhāyatanaṃ paccayā cakkhuviññāṇaṃ…pe… kāyāyatanaṃ paccayā kāyaviññāṇaṃ. (3)

A non-mind phenomenon conditions mind and non-mind phenomena to arise by way of non-root condition: one rootless non-mind aggregate conditions two aggregates, mind, and mind-originated form; two aggregates… the base conditions mind and associated aggregates; at the moment of rootless rebirth-linking… at the moment of rootless rebirth-linking, the base conditions mind and associated aggregates; the eye-base conditions eye-consciousness… the body-base conditions body-consciousness. (3)

Cittañca nocittañca dhammaṃ paccayā nocitto dhammo uppajjati nahetupaccayā – ahetukaṃ nocittaṃ ekaṃ khandhañca cittañca paccayā dve khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ, dve khandhe ca…pe… cittañca vatthuñca paccayā nocittā khandhā; ahetukapaṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe… ahetukapaṭisandhikkhaṇe cittañca vatthuñca paccayā nocittā khandhā, cakkhāyatanañca cakkhuviññāṇañca paccayā cakkhuviññāṇasahagatā khandhā…pe… kāyāyatanaṃ ca…pe… vicikicchāsahagate uddhaccasahagate khandhe ca cittañca paccayā vicikicchāsahagato uddhaccasahagato moho. (1) (Saṃkhittaṃ.)

Mind and non-mind phenomena condition a non-mind phenomenon to arise by way of non-root condition: one rootless non-mind aggregate and mind condition two aggregates and mind-originated form; two aggregates and so on… mind and the base condition non-mind aggregates; at the moment of rootless rebirth-linking… at the moment of rootless rebirth-linking, mind and the base condition non-mind aggregates; the eye-base and eye-consciousness condition aggregates accompanied by eye-consciousness… the body-base and so on… doubt-accompanied and restlessness-accompanied aggregates and mind condition doubt-accompanied and restlessness-accompanied delusion. (1) (Abbreviated.)

Nocittaṃ [V 3.0485] dhammaṃ saṃsaṭṭho citto dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – nocitte khandhe saṃsaṭṭhaṃ cittaṃ; paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe…. (2)
