Hetupaccayo

Root Condition

70. Nocitto dhammo nocittassa dhammassa hetupaccayena paccayo – nocittā hetū sampayuttakānaṃ [V 3.0486] khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ hetupaccayena paccayo; paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe…. (1)

70. A non-mind phenomenon is a condition for a non-mind phenomenon by way of root condition: non-mind roots are a condition for associated aggregates and for mind-originated material phenomena by way of root condition; at the moment of rebirth-linking… (1)

Nocitto dhammo cittassa dhammassa hetupaccayena paccayo – nocittā hetū cittassa hetupaccayena paccayo; paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe…. (2)

A non-mental phenomenon is a condition for a mental phenomenon by way of the causal condition: non-mental roots are a condition for the mental phenomenon by way of the causal condition; at the moment of rebirth-linking, etc. (2)

Nocitto dhammo cittassa ca nocittassa ca dhammassa hetupaccayena paccayo – nocittā hetū sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittassa ca cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ hetupaccayena paccayo; paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe…. (3)

A non-mental phenomenon is a condition for both a mental phenomenon and a non-mental phenomenon by way of the causal condition: non-mental roots are a condition for the associated aggregates, the mental phenomenon, and mind-originated material phenomena by way of the causal condition; at the moment of rebirth-linking, etc. (3)

Ārammaṇapaccayo

The Object Condition.

71. Citto dhammo cittassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo – cittaṃ ārabbha cittaṃ uppajjati. (Mūlaṃ kātabbaṃ) cittaṃ ārabbha nocittā khandhā uppajjanti. (Mūlaṃ kātabbaṃ) cittaṃ ārabbha cittañca sampayuttakā ca khandhā uppajjanti. (3)

71. A mental phenomenon is a condition for a mental phenomenon by way of the object condition: taking a mental phenomenon as object, a mental phenomenon arises. (The root should be supplied.) Taking a mental phenomenon as object, non-mental aggregates arise. (The root should be supplied.) Taking a mental phenomenon as object, both a mental phenomenon and associated aggregates arise. (3)

72. Nocitto dhammo nocittassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo – dānaṃ datvā sīlaṃ…pe… uposathakammaṃ katvā taṃ paccavekkhati assādeti abhinandati[T 4.0031], taṃ ārabbha rāgo uppajjati…pe… domanassaṃ uppajjati, pubbe suciṇṇāni…pe… jhānā vuṭṭhahitvā jhānaṃ…pe… ariyā maggā vuṭṭhahitvā [M 3.0395] maggaṃ paccavekkhanti, phalaṃ paccavekkhanti, nibbānaṃ paccavekkhanti. Nibbānaṃ gotrabhussa, vodānassa, maggassa, phalassa, āvajjanāya ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo; ariyā nocitte pahīne kilese paccavekkhanti, vikkhambhite kilese paccavekkhanti, pubbe samudāciṇṇe kilese jānanti, cakkhuṃ…pe… vatthuṃ nocitte khandhe aniccato…pe… domanassaṃ uppajjati; dibbena cakkhunā rūpaṃ passati, dibbāya sotadhātuyā saddaṃ suṇāti. Cetopariyañāṇena nocittasamaṅgissa cittaṃ jānāti, ākāsānañcāyatanaṃ…pe… ākiñcaññāyatanaṃ…pe… rūpāyatanaṃ cakkhuviññāṇasahagatānaṃ khandhānaṃ…pe… phoṭṭhabbāyatanaṃ kāyaviññāṇasahagatānaṃ khandhānaṃ…pe… nocittā khandhā iddhividhañāṇassa[V 3.0487], cetopariyañāṇassa, pubbenivāsānussatiñāṇassa, yathākammūpagañāṇassa, anāgataṃsañāṇassa, āvajjanāya ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo. (1)

72. A non-mental phenomenon is a condition for a non-mental phenomenon by way of the object condition: having given alms, kept precepts, etc., having performed the Uposatha observance, one reflects upon it, delights in it, and rejoices in it. Taking that as object, lust arises, etc., sorrow arises. Previously performed wholesome deeds, etc. Emerging from jhāna, one reflects upon the jhāna, etc. Emerging from the noble path, noble ones reflect upon the path, reflect upon the fruition, reflect upon Nibbāna. Nibbāna is a condition by way of the object condition for change-of-lineage, for purification, for the path, for the fruition, and for advertence. Noble ones reflect upon abandoned defilements, reflect upon suppressed defilements, and know previously accumulated defilements. Taking the eye, etc., the base, etc., the non-mental aggregates as impermanent, etc., sorrow arises. With the divine eye, one sees forms; with the divine ear-element, one hears sounds. With the knowledge of penetrating the minds of others, one knows the mind of one associated with non-mental states. The base of the infinity of space, etc., the base of nothingness, etc., the form base is a condition for the aggregates associated with eye-consciousness, etc., the tangible base is a condition for the aggregates associated with body-consciousness, etc. Non-mental aggregates are a condition by way of the object condition for the knowledge of psychic power, for the knowledge of penetrating the minds of others, for the knowledge of the recollection of past lives, for the knowledge of the passing away and reappearance of beings according to their kamma, for the knowledge of the future, and for advertence. (1)

Nocitto dhammo cittassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo – dānaṃ datvā…pe… (paṭhamagamanasadisaṃ ninnānākaraṇaṃ, imaṃ nānaṃ) rūpāyatanaṃ cakkhuviññāṇassa…pe… phoṭṭhabbāyatanaṃ kāyaviññāṇassa…pe… nocittā khandhā iddhividhañāṇassa…pe… āvajjanāya ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo. (2)

A non-mental phenomenon is a condition for a mental phenomenon by way of the object condition: having given alms, etc. (Similar to the first passage, without variation; this is the difference:) The form base is a condition for eye-consciousness, etc. The tangible base is a condition for body-consciousness, etc. Non-mental aggregates are a condition by way of the object condition for the knowledge of psychic power, etc., and for advertence. (2)

Nocitto dhammo cittassa ca nocittassa ca dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo – dānaṃ datvā…pe… (paṭhamagamanasadisaṃ ninnānākaraṇaṃ, imaṃ [T 4.0032] nānaṃ), rūpāyatanaṃ cakkhuviññāṇassa sampayuttakānañca khandhānaṃ…pe… phoṭṭhabbāyatanaṃ kāyaviññāṇassa sampayuttakānañca khandhānaṃ…pe… nocittā khandhā iddhividhañāṇassa…pe… āvajjanāya ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo. (3)

A non-mental phenomenon is a condition for both a mental phenomenon and a non-mental phenomenon by way of the object condition: having given alms, etc. (Similar to the first passage, without variation; this is the difference:) The form base is a condition for eye-consciousness and its associated aggregates, etc. The tangible base is a condition for body-consciousness and its associated aggregates, etc. Non-mental aggregates are a condition by way of the object condition for the knowledge of psychic power, etc., and for advertence. (3)

Citto ca nocitto ca dhammā cittassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo – cittañca sampayuttake ca khandhe ārabbha cittaṃ uppajjati… tīṇi.

Both a mental phenomenon and a non-mental phenomenon are a condition for a mental phenomenon by way of the object condition: taking both a mental phenomenon and associated aggregates as object, a mental phenomenon arises… (Three instances.)

Adhipatipaccayo

The Dominance Condition.

73. Citto dhammo cittassa dhammassa adhipatipaccayena paccayo. Ārammaṇādhipati – cittaṃ garuṃ katvā cittaṃ uppajjati. (1)

73. A mental phenomenon is a condition for a mental phenomenon by way of the dominance condition. Object-dominance: having made a mental phenomenon weighty, a mental phenomenon arises. (1)

Citto dhammo nocittassa dhammassa adhipatipaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇādhipati, sahajātādhipati. Ārammaṇādhipati – cittaṃ garuṃ katvā [M 3.0396] nocittā khandhā uppajjanti. Sahajātādhipati – cittādhipati sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ adhipatipaccayena paccayo. (2)

A mental phenomenon is a condition for a non-mental phenomenon by way of the dominance condition: object-dominance and co-nascence dominance. Object-dominance: having made a mental phenomenon weighty, non-mental aggregates arise. Co-nascence dominance: a mental dominant is a condition by way of the dominance condition for associated aggregates and mind-originated material phenomena. (2)

Citto [V 3.0488] dhammo cittassa ca nocittassa ca dhammassa adhipatipaccayena paccayo. Ārammaṇādhipati – cittaṃ garuṃ katvā cittañca sampayuttakā ca khandhā uppajjanti. (3)

A mental phenomenon is a condition for both a mental phenomenon and a non-mental phenomenon by way of the dominance condition. Object-dominance: having made a mental phenomenon weighty, both a mental phenomenon and associated aggregates arise. (3)

74. Nocitto dhammo nocittassa dhammassa adhipatipaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇādhipati, sahajātādhipati. Ārammaṇādhipati – dānaṃ…pe… sīlaṃ…pe… uposathakammaṃ katvā taṃ garuṃ katvā paccavekkhati assādeti abhinandati, taṃ garuṃ katvā rāgo uppajjati, diṭṭhi uppajjati, pubbe…pe… jhānā…pe… ariyā maggā vuṭṭhahitvā maggaṃ garuṃ [T 4.0033] katvā paccavekkhanti. Phalaṃ garuṃ katvā paccavekkhanti, nibbānaṃ garuṃ katvā paccavekkhanti, nibbānaṃ gotrabhussa, vodānassa, maggassa, phalassa, adhipatipaccayena paccayo; cakkhuṃ…pe… vatthuṃ nocitte khandhe garuṃ katvā assādeti abhinandati, taṃ garuṃ katvā rāgo uppajjati, diṭṭhi uppajjati. Sahajātādhipati – nocittādhipati sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ adhipatipaccayena paccayo. (1)

74. A non-mental phenomenon is a condition for a non-mental phenomenon by way of the dominance condition: object-dominance and co-nascence dominance. Object-dominance: having performed generosity, etc., morality, etc., the Uposatha observance, one reflects upon it, delights in it, and rejoices in it, having made it weighty. Having made it weighty, lust arises, wrong view arises. Previously performed wholesome deeds, etc. Emerging from jhāna, etc. Having emerged from the noble path, noble ones reflect upon the path, having made it weighty. They reflect upon the fruition, having made it weighty. They reflect upon Nibbāna, having made it weighty. Nibbāna is a condition for change-of-lineage, for purification, for the path, and for the fruition by way of the dominance condition. Having made the eye, etc., the base, etc., the non-mental aggregates weighty, one delights in and rejoices in them. Having made them weighty, lust arises, wrong view arises. Co-nascence dominance: a non-mental dominant is a condition for the associated aggregates and mind-originated material phenomena by way of the dominance condition. (1)

Nocitto dhammo cittassa dhammassa adhipatipaccayena paccayo (dvepi gamanā paṭhamagamanasadisaṃ ninnānākaraṇaṃ. Ārammaṇādhipati sahajātādhipati kātabbā). (2)

A non-mental phenomenon is a condition for a mental phenomenon by way of the dominance condition. (Both passages are similar to the first, without variation. Object-dominance and co-nascence dominance should be supplied.) (2)

Citto ca nocitto ca dhammā cittassa dhammassa adhipatipaccayena paccayo… ārammaṇādhipati (tīṇipi garukārammaṇā kātabbā, ārammaṇādhipatiyeva).

Both a mental phenomenon and a non-mental phenomenon are a condition for a mental phenomenon by way of the dominance condition… Object-dominance. (All three instances should be made with weighty objects; only object-dominance applies.)

Anantarapaccayādi

Immediately Contiguous Condition, etc.

75. Citto dhammo cittassa dhammassa anantarapaccayena paccayo – purimaṃ purimaṃ cittaṃ pacchimassa pacchimassa cittassa anantarapaccayena paccayo. (1)

75. A mental phenomenon is a condition for a mental phenomenon by way of the immediately contiguous condition: each preceding mental state is a condition for each succeeding mental state by way of the immediately contiguous condition. (1)

Citto dhammo nocittassa dhammassa anantarapaccayena paccayo – purimaṃ purimaṃ cittaṃ pacchimānaṃ pacchimānaṃ nocittānaṃ khandhānaṃ anantarapaccayena paccayo; cittaṃ vuṭṭhānassa anantarapaccayena paccayo. (2)

A mental phenomenon is a condition for a non-mental phenomenon by way of the immediately contiguous condition: each preceding mental state is a condition for each succeeding non-mental aggregate by way of the immediately contiguous condition; a mental state is a condition for emergence by way of the immediately contiguous condition. (2)

Citto [M 3.0397][V 3.0489] dhammo cittassa ca nocittassa ca dhammassa anantarapaccayena paccayo – purimaṃ purimaṃ cittaṃ pacchimassa pacchimassa cittassa sampayuttakānañca khandhānaṃ anantarapaccayena paccayo. (3)

A mental phenomenon is a condition for a mental phenomenon and a non-mental phenomenon by way of the immediately contiguous condition: each preceding mental state is a condition for each succeeding mental state and its associated aggregates by way of the immediately contiguous condition. (3)

76. Nocitto dhammo nocittassa dhammassa anantarapaccayena paccayo – purimā purimā nocittā khandhā…pe… phalasamāpattiyā anantarapaccayena paccayo (ime [T 4.0034] dve pūretukāmena kātabbā, purimagamanasadisaṃ).

76. A non-mental phenomenon is a condition for a non-mental phenomenon by way of the immediately contiguous condition: each preceding non-mental aggregate… and so on… is a condition for fruition-attainment by way of the immediately contiguous condition. (These two should be filled in as desired, similar to the preceding passage.)

Citto ca nocitto ca dhammā cittassa dhammassa anantarapaccayena paccayo – purimaṃ purimaṃ cittañca sampayuttakā ca khandhā pacchimassa pacchimassa cittassa anantarapaccayena paccayo. (Mūlaṃ pucchitabbaṃ) purimaṃ purimaṃ cittañca sampayuttakā ca khandhā pacchimānaṃ pacchimānaṃ nocittānaṃ khandhānaṃ anantarapaccayena paccayo – cittañca sampayuttakā ca khandhā vuṭṭhānassa anantarapaccayena paccayo. (Mūlaṃ pucchitabbaṃ) purimaṃ purimaṃ cittañca sampayuttakā ca khandhā pacchimassa pacchimassa cittassa sampayuttakānañca khandhānaṃ anantarapaccayena paccayo. (3)

A mental phenomenon and a non-mental phenomenon are conditions for a mental phenomenon by way of the immediately contiguous condition: each preceding mental state and its associated aggregates are conditions for each succeeding mental state by way of the immediately contiguous condition. (The root should be inquired into.) Each preceding mental state and its associated aggregates are conditions for each succeeding non-mental aggregate by way of the immediately contiguous condition: a mental state and its associated aggregates are conditions for emergence by way of the immediately contiguous condition. (The root should be inquired into.) Each preceding mental state and its associated aggregates are conditions for each succeeding mental state and its associated aggregates by way of the immediately contiguous condition. (3)

Samanantarapaccayena paccayo… sahajātapaccayena paccayo… aññamaññapaccayena paccayo (paṭiccavārasadisā)… nissayapaccayena paccayo… pañca (paccayavārasadisā).

By way of the contiguity condition… by way of the co-nascence condition… by way of the mutual condition (similar to the dependent origination section)… by way of the dependence condition… five (similar to the conditional relations section).

Upanissayapaccayo

Decisive Support Condition

77. Citto dhammo cittassa dhammassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇūpanissayo, anantarūpanissayo, pakatūpanissayo…pe…. Pakatūpanissayo – cittaṃ cittassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo… tīṇi.

77. A mental phenomenon is a condition for a mental phenomenon by way of the decisive support condition: object decisive support, contiguity decisive support, natural decisive support… and so on. Natural decisive support: a mental state is a condition for a mental state by way of the decisive support condition… three.

Nocitto dhammo nocittassa dhammassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇūpanissayo, anantarūpanissayo, pakatūpanissayo…pe…. Pakatūpanissayo – saddhaṃ upanissāya dānaṃ deti…pe… mānaṃ jappeti, diṭṭhiṃ gaṇhāti; sīlaṃ…pe… senāsanaṃ upanissāya dānaṃ deti [V 3.0490]…pe… saṅghaṃ bhindati; saddhā…pe… senāsanaṃ saddhāya…pe… maggassa, phalasamāpattiyā [T 4.0035] upanissayapaccayena paccayo. (1)

A non-mental phenomenon is a condition for a non-mental phenomenon by way of the decisive support condition: object decisive support, contiguity decisive support, natural decisive support… and so on. Natural decisive support: depending on faith, one gives a gift… and so on… fosters conceit, adheres to views; virtue… and so on… depending on lodging, one gives a gift… and so on… splits the Saṅgha; faith… and so on… lodging is a condition for faith… and so on… for the path, for fruition-attainment by way of the decisive support condition. (1)

Nocitto dhammo cittassa dhammassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo (ime dvepi pūretukāmena sabbattha kātabbā, paṭhamagamanasadisaṃ ninnānākaraṇaṃ).

A non-mental phenomenon is a condition for a mental phenomenon by way of the decisive support condition. (These two should both be filled in as desired everywhere, similar to the first passage, without making a distinction.)

Citto [M 3.0398] ca nocitto ca dhammā cittassa dhammassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇūpanissayo, anantarūpanissayo, pakatūpanissayo…pe…. Pakatūpanissayo – cittañca sampayuttakā ca khandhā cittassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo… tīṇi.

A mental phenomenon and a non-mental phenomenon are conditions for a mental phenomenon by way of the decisive support condition: object decisive support, contiguity decisive support, natural decisive support… and so on. Natural decisive support: a mental state and its associated aggregates are conditions for a mental state by way of the decisive support condition… three.

Purejātapaccayo

Pre-nascence Condition

78. Nocitto dhammo nocittassa dhammassa purejātapaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇapurejātaṃ, vatthupurejātaṃ. Ārammaṇapurejātaṃ – cakkhuṃ…pe… vatthuṃ aniccato…pe… domanassaṃ uppajjati; dibbena cakkhunā rūpaṃ passati, dibbāya sotadhātuyā saddaṃ suṇāti. Rūpāyatanaṃ cakkhuviññāṇasahagatānaṃ khandhānaṃ…pe… phoṭṭhabbāyatanaṃ kāyaviññāṇasahagatānaṃ khandhānaṃ purejātapaccayena paccayo. Vatthupurejātaṃ – cakkhāyatanaṃ cakkhuviññāṇasahagatānaṃ khandhānaṃ…pe… kāyāyatanaṃ…pe… vatthu nocittānaṃ khandhānaṃ purejātapaccayena paccayo. (1)

78. A non-mental phenomenon is a condition for a non-mental phenomenon by way of the pre-nascence condition: object pre-nascence, base pre-nascence. Object pre-nascence: the eye… and so on… the base as impermanent… and so on… grief arises; with the divine eye, one sees forms; with the divine ear element, one hears sounds. The visible form base is a condition for the aggregates associated with eye-consciousness… and so on… the tangible base is a condition for the aggregates associated with body-consciousness by way of the pre-nascence condition. Base pre-nascence: the eye base is a condition for the aggregates associated with eye-consciousness… and so on… the body base… and so on… the base is a condition for non-mental aggregates by way of the pre-nascence condition. (1)

Nocitto dhammo cittassa dhammassa purejātapaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇapurejātaṃ, vatthupurejātaṃ. Ārammaṇapurejātaṃ – cakkhuṃ…pe… vatthuṃ aniccato…pe… domanassaṃ uppajjati; dibbena cakkhunā rūpaṃ passati, dibbāya sotadhātuyā saddaṃ suṇāti. Rūpāyatanaṃ cakkhuviññāṇassa…pe… phoṭṭhabbāyatanaṃ kāyaviññāṇassa…pe…. Vatthupurejātaṃ – cakkhāyatanaṃ cakkhuviññāṇassa [T 4.0036] …pe… kāyāyatanaṃ kāyaviññāṇassa…pe… vatthu cittassa purejātapaccayena paccayo. (2)

A non-mental phenomenon is a condition for a mental phenomenon by way of the pre-nascence condition: object pre-nascence, base pre-nascence. Object pre-nascence: the eye… and so on… the base as impermanent… and so on… grief arises; with the divine eye, one sees forms; with the divine ear element, one hears sounds. The visible form base is a condition for eye-consciousness… and so on… the tangible base is a condition for body-consciousness… and so on. Base pre-nascence: the eye base is a condition for eye-consciousness… and so on… the body base is a condition for body-consciousness… and so on… the base is a condition for a mental state by way of the pre-nascence condition. (2)

Nocitto dhammo cittassa ca nocittassa ca dhammassa purejātapaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇapurejātaṃ, vatthupurejātaṃ. Ārammaṇapurejātaṃ – cakkhuṃ…pe… vatthuṃ aniccato…pe… domanassaṃ [V 3.0491] uppajjati; dibbena cakkhunā rūpaṃ passati, dibbāya sotadhātuyā saddaṃ suṇāti. Rūpāyatanaṃ cakkhuviññāṇassa ca sampayuttakānañca khandhānaṃ…pe… phoṭṭhabbāyatanaṃ…pe…. Vatthupurejātaṃ – cakkhāyatanaṃ cakkhuviññāṇassa sampayuttakānañca khandhānaṃ purejātapaccayena paccayo…pe… kāyāyatanaṃ kāyaviññāṇassa sampayuttakānañca khandhānaṃ…pe… vatthu cittassa ca sampayuttakānañca khandhānaṃ purejātapaccayena paccayo. (3)

A non-mental phenomenon is a condition for a mental phenomenon and a non-mental phenomenon by way of the pre-nascence condition: object pre-nascence, base pre-nascence. Object pre-nascence: the eye… and so on… the base as impermanent… and so on… grief arises; with the divine eye, one sees forms; with the divine ear element, one hears sounds. The visible form base is a condition for eye-consciousness and its associated aggregates… and so on… the tangible base… and so on. Base pre-nascence: the eye base is a condition for eye-consciousness and its associated aggregates by way of the pre-nascence condition… and so on… the body base is a condition for body-consciousness and its associated aggregates… and so on… the base is a condition for a mental state and its associated aggregates by way of the pre-nascence condition. (3)

Pacchājātāsevanapaccayā

Post-nascence and Repetition Conditions

79. Citto [M 3.0399] dhammo nocittassa dhammassa pacchājātapaccayena paccayo (saṃkhittaṃ). (1)

79. A mental phenomenon is a condition for a non-mental phenomenon by way of post-nascence condition (in brief). (1)

Nocitto dhammo nocittassa dhammassa pacchājātapaccayena paccayo (saṃkhittaṃ). (1)

A non-mental phenomenon is a condition for a non-mental phenomenon by way of post-nascence condition (in brief). (1)

Citto ca nocitto ca dhammā nocittassa dhammassa pacchājātapaccayena paccayo (saṃkhittaṃ). (1)

Mental and non-mental phenomena are a condition for a non-mental phenomenon by way of post-nascence condition (in brief). (1)

Citto dhammo cittassa dhammassa āsevanapaccayena paccayo… nava.

A mental phenomenon is a condition for a mental phenomenon by way of repetition condition... nine.

Kammapaccayo

Kamma Condition

80. Nocitto dhammo nocittassa dhammassa kammapaccayena paccayo – sahajātā, nānākkhaṇikā. Sahajātā – nocittā cetanā sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ kammapaccayena paccayo; paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe…. Nānākkhaṇikā – nocittā cetanā vipākānaṃ khandhānaṃ kaṭattā [T 4.0037] ca rūpānaṃ kammapaccayena paccayo. (1)

80. A non-mental phenomenon is a condition for a non-mental phenomenon by way of kamma condition—co-nascent, non-simultaneous. Co-nascent: non-mental volition is a condition for its associated aggregates and for mind-originated materiality by way of kamma condition; at the moment of rebirth-linking... and so on. Non-simultaneous: non-mental volition is a condition for resultant aggregates and for kamma-produced materiality by way of kamma condition. (1)

Nocitto dhammo cittassa dhammassa kammapaccayena paccayo – sahajātā, nānākkhaṇikā. Sahajātā – nocittā cetanā cittassa kammapaccayena paccayo; paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe…. Nānākkhaṇikā – nocittā cetanā vipākassa cittassa kammapaccayena paccayo. (2)

A non-mental phenomenon is a condition for a mental phenomenon by way of kamma condition—co-nascent, non-simultaneous. Co-nascent: non-mental volition is a condition for consciousness by way of kamma condition; at the moment of rebirth-linking... and so on. Non-simultaneous: non-mental volition is a condition for resultant consciousness by way of kamma condition. (2)

Nocitto dhammo cittassa ca nocittassa ca dhammassa kammapaccayena paccayo – sahajātā, nānākkhaṇikā[V 3.0492]. Sahajātā – nocittā cetanā sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittassa ca cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ kammapaccayena paccayo; paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe…. Nānākkhaṇikā – nocittā cetanā vipākānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittassa ca kaṭattā ca rūpānaṃ kammapaccayena paccayo. (3)

A non-mental phenomenon is a condition for a mental phenomenon and a non-mental phenomenon by way of kamma condition—co-nascent, non-simultaneous. Co-nascent: non-mental volition is a condition for its associated aggregates, for consciousness, and for mind-originated materiality by way of kamma condition; at the moment of rebirth-linking... and so on. Non-simultaneous: non-mental volition is a condition for resultant aggregates, for consciousness, and for kamma-produced materiality by way of kamma condition. (3)

Vipākapaccayādi

Result Condition, etc.

81. Citto dhammo nocittassa dhammassa vipākapaccayena paccayo… pañca… āhārapaccayena paccayo… pañca… indriyapaccayena paccayo… pañca. Nocitto dhammo nocittassa dhammassa jhānapaccayena paccayo… tīṇi… maggapaccayena paccayo… tīṇi… sampayuttapaccayena paccayo… pañca.

81. A mental phenomenon is a condition for a non-mental phenomenon by way of result condition... five... by way of nutriment condition... five... by way of faculty condition... five. A non-mental phenomenon is a condition for a non-mental phenomenon by way of jhāna condition... three... by way of path condition... three... by way of association condition... five.

Vippayuttapaccayo

Dissociation Condition

82. Citto [M 3.0400] dhammo nocittassa dhammassa vippayuttapaccayena paccayo – sahajātaṃ, pacchājātaṃ (saṃkhittaṃ). (1)

82. A mental phenomenon is a condition for a non-mental phenomenon by way of dissociation condition: co-nascent, post-nascent (in brief). (1)

Nocitto dhammo nocittassa dhammassa vippayuttapaccayena paccayo – sahajātaṃ, purejātaṃ, pacchājātaṃ. Sahajātā – nocittā khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ vippayuttapaccayena [T 4.0038] paccayo; paṭisandhikkhaṇe nocittā khandhā kaṭattārūpānaṃ…pe… nocittā khandhā vatthussa vippayuttapaccayena paccayo; vatthu khandhānaṃ vippayuttapaccayena paccayo. Purejātaṃ – cakkhāyatanaṃ cakkhuviññāṇasahagatānaṃ khandhānaṃ…pe… kāyāyatanaṃ kāyaviññāṇasahagatānaṃ khandhānaṃ…pe… vatthu nocittānaṃ khandhānaṃ vippayuttapaccayena paccayo. Pacchājātā – nocittā khandhā purejātassa imassa kāyassa vippayuttapaccayena paccayo. (1)

A non-mental phenomenon is a condition for a non-mental phenomenon by way of dissociation condition—co-nascent, pre-nascent, post-nascent. Co-nascent: non-mental aggregates are a condition for mind-originated materiality by way of dissociation condition; at the moment of rebirth-linking, non-mental aggregates are a condition for kamma-produced materiality... and so on... non-mental aggregates are a condition for the physical base by way of dissociation condition; the physical base is a condition for the aggregates by way of dissociation condition. Pre-nascent: the eye-base is a condition for the aggregates associated with eye-consciousness... and so on... the body-base is a condition for the aggregates associated with body-consciousness... and so on... the physical base is a condition for non-mental aggregates by way of dissociation condition. Post-nascent: non-mental aggregates are a condition for this pre-arisen body by way of dissociation condition. (1)

Nocitto dhammo cittassa dhammassa vippayuttapaccayena paccayo – sahajātaṃ, purejātaṃ. Sahajātaṃ – paṭisandhikkhaṇe vatthu cittassa vippayuttapaccayena paccayo. Purejātaṃ – cakkhāyatanaṃ cakkhuviññāṇassa…pe… kāyāyatanaṃ kāyaviññāṇassa…pe… vatthu cittassa vippayuttapaccayena paccayo. (2)

A non-mental phenomenon is a condition for a mental phenomenon by way of dissociation condition: co-nascent, pre-nascent. Co-nascent: at the moment of rebirth-linking, the physical base is a condition for consciousness by way of dissociation condition. Pre-nascent: the eye-base is a condition for eye-consciousness... and so on... the body-base is a condition for body-consciousness... and so on... the physical base is a condition for consciousness by way of dissociation condition. (2)

Nocitto [V 3.0493] dhammo cittassa ca nocittassa ca dhammassa vippayuttapaccayena paccayo – sahajātaṃ, purejātaṃ. Sahajātaṃ – paṭisandhikkhaṇe vatthu cittassa sampayuttakānañca khandhānaṃ vippayuttapaccayena paccayo. Purejātaṃ – cakkhāyatanaṃ cakkhuviññāṇassa sampayuttakānañca khandhānaṃ vippayuttapaccayena paccayo…pe… kāyāyatanaṃ kāyaviññāṇassa sampayuttakānañca khandhānaṃ…pe… vatthu cittassa ca sampayuttakānañca khandhānaṃ vippayuttapaccayena paccayo. (3)

A non-mental phenomenon is a condition for a mental phenomenon and a non-mental phenomenon by way of dissociation condition—co-nascent, pre-nascent. Co-nascent: at the moment of rebirth-linking, the physical base is a condition for consciousness and its associated aggregates by way of dissociation condition. Pre-nascent: the eye-base is a condition for eye-consciousness and its associated aggregates by way of dissociation condition... and so on... the body-base is a condition for body-consciousness and its associated aggregates... and so on... the physical base is a condition for consciousness and its associated aggregates by way of dissociation condition. (3)

Citto ca nocitto ca dhammā nocittassa dhammassa vippayuttapaccayena paccayo – sahajātaṃ, pacchājātaṃ (saṃkhittaṃ). (1)

Mental and non-mental phenomena are a condition for a non-mental phenomenon by way of dissociation condition—co-nascent, post-nascent (in brief). (1)

Atthipaccayo

Presence Condition

83. Citto dhammo nocittassa dhammassa atthipaccayena paccayo – sahajātaṃ, pacchājātaṃ (saṃkhittaṃ). (1)

83. A mental phenomenon is a condition for a non-mental phenomenon by way of presence condition: co-nascent, post-nascent (in brief). (1)

Nocitto dhammo nocittassa dhammassa [T 4.0039] atthipaccayena paccayo – sahajātaṃ, purejātaṃ, pacchājātaṃ, āhāraṃ, indriyaṃ (saṃkhittaṃ). (1)

A non-mental phenomenon is a condition for a non-mental phenomenon by way of presence condition: co-nascent, pre-nascent, post-nascent, nutriment, faculty (in brief). (1)

Nocitto [M 3.0401] dhammo cittassa dhammassa atthipaccayena paccayo – sahajātaṃ, purejātaṃ. Sahajātā – nocittā khandhā cittassa atthipaccayena paccayo; paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe… paṭisandhikkhaṇe vatthu cittassa atthipaccayena paccayo. Purejātaṃ – cakkhuṃ…pe… vatthuṃ aniccato…pe… (purejātasadisaṃ, saṃkhittaṃ). (2)

A non-mental phenomenon is a condition for a mental phenomenon by way of presence condition: co-nascent, pre-nascent. Co-nascent: non-mental aggregates are a condition for consciousness by way of presence condition; at the moment of rebirth-linking... and so on... at the moment of rebirth-linking, the physical base is a condition for consciousness by way of presence condition. Pre-nascent: the eye... and so on... the physical base as impermanent... and so on... (similar to pre-nascent, in brief). (2)

Nocitto dhammo cittassa ca nocittassa ca dhammassa atthipaccayena paccayo – sahajātaṃ, purejātaṃ. Sahajāto – nocitto eko khandho dvinnaṃ khandhānaṃ cittassa ca cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo; paṭisandhikkhaṇe nocitto eko khandho…pe… paṭisandhikkhaṇe vatthu cittassa sampayuttakānañca khandhānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo. Purejātaṃ – cakkhuṃ…pe… vatthuṃ…pe… (purejātasadisaṃ, saṃkhittaṃ). (3)

A non-mental phenomenon is a condition for a mental phenomenon and for a non-mental phenomenon by way of presence condition: co-nascence, pre-nascence. Co-nascent: one non-mental aggregate is a condition for two aggregates, for consciousness, and for mind-originated material phenomena by way of presence condition; at the moment of rebirth-linking, one non-mental aggregate…pe… at the moment of rebirth-linking, the physical base is a condition for consciousness and for the associated aggregates by way of presence condition. Pre-nascent: the eye…pe… the physical base…pe… (similar to pre-nascence, in brief). (3)

84. Citto [V 3.0494] ca nocitto ca dhammā nocittassa dhammassa atthipaccayena paccayo – sahajātaṃ, purejātaṃ, pacchājātaṃ, āhāraṃ, indriyaṃ. Sahajāto – nocitto eko khandho ca cittañca dvinnaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo; dve khandhā ca…pe…. Sahajātaṃ – cittañca vatthuñca nocittānaṃ khandhānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo (paṭisandhikkhaṇepi dve). Sahajātaṃ – cittañca sampayuttakā ca khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo. Sahajātaṃ – cittañca mahābhūtā ca cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo (paṭisandhikkhaṇepi dve). Pacchājātaṃ – cittañca sampayuttakā ca khandhā purejātassa imassa kāyassa atthipaccayena paccayo. Pacchājātaṃ – cittañca sampayuttakā [T 4.0040] ca khandhā kabaḷīkāro āhāro ca imassa kāyassa atthipaccayena paccayo. Pacchājātaṃ – cittañca sampayuttakā ca khandhā rūpajīvitindriyañca kaṭattārūpānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo. (1)

84. Mental and non-mental phenomena are a condition for a non-mental phenomenon by way of presence condition: co-nascence, pre-nascence, post-nascence, nutriment, faculty. Co-nascent: one non-mental aggregate and consciousness are a condition for two aggregates and for mind-originated material phenomena by way of presence condition; two aggregates and…pe…. Co-nascent: consciousness and the physical base are a condition for non-mental aggregates by way of presence condition (also two at the moment of rebirth-linking). Co-nascent: consciousness and the associated aggregates are a condition for mind-originated material phenomena by way of presence condition. Co-nascent: consciousness and the great elements are a condition for mind-originated material phenomena by way of presence condition (also two at the moment of rebirth-linking). Post-nascent: consciousness and the associated aggregates are a condition for this pre-nascent body by way of presence condition. Post-nascent: consciousness, the associated aggregates, and edible food are a condition for this body by way of presence condition. Post-nascent: consciousness, the associated aggregates, and the material life faculty are a condition for kamma-produced material phenomena by way of presence condition. (1)

Conditioned by a non-mental phenomenon, a mental phenomenon arises by way of non-root condition: conditioned by rootless consciousness, the associated aggregates [arise]; at the moment of rootless rebirth-linking, conditioned by consciousness, the associated aggregates [arise]; at the moment of rootless rebirth-linking, conditioned by the physical base, the mental aggregates [arise]; conditioned by consciousness accompanied by doubt and by restlessness, the delusion accompanied by doubt and by restlessness [arises]. (2)

Acetasikaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca cetasiko ca acetasiko ca dhammā uppajjanti nahetupaccayā – ahetukaṃ cittaṃ paṭicca sampayuttakā khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ; ahetukapaṭisandhikkhaṇe cittaṃ paṭicca sampayuttakā khandhā kaṭattā ca rūpaṃ, ahetukapaṭisandhikkhaṇe vatthuṃ paṭicca cittañca sampayuttakā ca khandhā. (3)

Conditioned by a non-mental phenomenon, mental and non-mental phenomena arise by way of non-root condition: conditioned by rootless consciousness, the associated aggregates and mind-originated materiality [arise]; at the moment of rootless rebirth-linking, conditioned by consciousness, the associated aggregates and kamma-born materiality [arise]; at the moment of rootless rebirth-linking, conditioned by the physical base, consciousness and the associated aggregates [arise]. (3)

101. Cetasikañca acetasikañca dhammaṃ paṭicca cetasiko dhammo uppajjati nahetupaccayā – ahetukaṃ cetasikaṃ ekaṃ khandhañca cittañca paṭicca dve khandhā, dve khandhe ca…pe… ahetukapaṭisandhikkhaṇe cetasikaṃ ekaṃ khandhañca cittañca paṭicca dve khandhā, dve [T 4.0047] khandhe [V 3.0502] ca…pe… ahetukapaṭisandhikkhaṇe cetasikaṃ ekaṃ khandhañca vatthuñca paṭicca dve khandhā, dve khandhe ca…pe… vicikicchāsahagate uddhaccasahagate khandhe ca cittañca paṭicca vicikicchāsahagato uddhaccasahagato moho. (1)

101. Conditioned by a mental phenomenon and a non-mental phenomenon, a mental phenomenon arises by way of non-root condition: conditioned by one rootless mental aggregate and consciousness, two aggregates [arise]; conditioned by two aggregates...and so on... at the moment of rootless rebirth-linking, conditioned by one rootless mental aggregate and consciousness, two aggregates [arise]; conditioned by two aggregates...and so on... at the moment of rootless rebirth-linking, conditioned by one rootless mental aggregate and the physical base, two aggregates [arise]; conditioned by two aggregates...and so on... conditioned by the aggregates and consciousness accompanied by doubt and by restlessness, the delusion accompanied by doubt and by restlessness [arises]. (1)

Cetasikañca acetasikañca dhammaṃ paṭicca acetasiko dhammo uppajjati nahetupaccayā – ahetuke cetasike khandhe ca cittañca paṭicca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ, ahetuke cetasike khandhe ca mahābhūte ca paṭicca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ; ahetukapaṭisandhikkhaṇe cetasike khandhe ca cittañca paṭicca kaṭattārūpaṃ, ahetukapaṭisandhikkhaṇe cetasike khandhe ca mahābhūte ca paṭicca kaṭattārūpaṃ, ahetukapaṭisandhikkhaṇe cetasike khandhe ca vatthuñca paṭicca cittaṃ. (2)

Conditioned by a mental phenomenon and a non-mental phenomenon, a non-mental phenomenon arises by way of non-root condition: conditioned by the rootless mental aggregates and consciousness, mind-originated materiality [arises]; conditioned by the rootless mental aggregates and the great elements, mind-originated materiality [arises]; at the moment of rootless rebirth-linking, conditioned by the rootless mental aggregates and consciousness, kamma-born materiality [arises]; at the moment of rootless rebirth-linking, conditioned by the rootless mental aggregates and the great elements, kamma-born materiality [arises]; at the moment of rootless rebirth-linking, conditioned by the rootless mental aggregates and the physical base, consciousness [arises]. (2)

Cetasikañca acetasikañca dhammaṃ paṭicca cetasiko ca acetasiko ca dhammā uppajjanti nahetupaccayā – ahetukaṃ cetasikaṃ ekaṃ khandhañca cittañca paṭicca [M 3.0408] dve khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ; ahetukapaṭisandhikkhaṇe cetasikaṃ ekaṃ khandhañca cittañca paṭicca dve khandhā kaṭattā ca rūpaṃ, ahetukapaṭisandhikkhaṇe cetasikaṃ ekaṃ khandhañca vatthuñca paṭicca dve khandhā cittañca, dve khandhe ca…pe…. (3)

Conditioned by a mental phenomenon and a non-mental phenomenon, mental and non-mental phenomena arise by way of non-root condition: conditioned by one rootless mental aggregate and consciousness, two aggregates and mind-originated materiality [arise]; at the moment of rootless rebirth-linking, conditioned by one rootless mental aggregate and consciousness, two aggregates and kamma-born materiality [arise]; at the moment of rootless rebirth-linking, conditioned by one rootless mental aggregate and the physical base, two aggregates and consciousness [arise]; conditioned by two aggregates...and so on.... (3)

Naārammaṇapaccayo

Non-Object Condition

102. Cetasikaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca acetasiko dhammo uppajjati naārammaṇapaccayā – cetasike khandhe paṭicca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ; paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe…. (1)

102. Conditioned by a mental phenomenon, a non-mental phenomenon arises by way of non-object condition: conditioned by the mental aggregates, mind-originated materiality [arises]; at the moment of rebirth-linking…and so on…. (1)

Acetasikaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca acetasiko dhammo uppajjati naārammaṇapaccayā – cittaṃ paṭicca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ; paṭisandhikkhaṇe [T 4.0048] …pe… (yāva asaññasattā). (1)

Conditioned by a non-mental phenomenon, a non-mental phenomenon arises by way of non-object condition: conditioned by consciousness, mind-originated materiality [arises]; at the moment of rebirth-linking …and so on… (up to the non-percipient beings). (1)

Cetasikañca acetasikañca dhammaṃ paṭicca acetasiko dhammo uppajjati naārammaṇapaccayā – cetasike khandhe ca cittañca paṭicca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ, cetasike khandhe ca mahābhūte ca paṭicca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ (paṭisandhikkhaṇe dvepi kātabbā, saṃkhittaṃ).

Conditioned by a mental and a non-mental phenomenon, a non-mental phenomenon arises through the non-object condition—mental aggregates and consciousness condition mind-originated material form; mental aggregates and the great elements condition mind-originated material form (at the moment of rebirth-linking, both should be done; in brief).

103. 103. Hetupaccayo

The Root Condition

106. Cetasikaṃ [V 3.0504] dhammaṃ paccayā cetasiko dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā… tīṇi (paṭiccasadisā).

106. Conditioned by a mental phenomenon, a mental phenomenon arises by way of root condition... three (similar to the Dependence Section).

Acetasikaṃ dhammaṃ paccayā acetasiko dhammo [T 4.0049] uppajjati hetupaccayā – cittaṃ paccayā cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ, vatthuṃ paccayā cittaṃ; paṭisandhikkhaṇe cittaṃ paccayā kaṭattārūpaṃ, cittaṃ paccayā vatthu, vatthuṃ paccayā cittaṃ, ekaṃ mahābhūtaṃ…pe…. (1)

Conditioned by a non-mental phenomenon, a non-mental phenomenon arises by way of root condition: consciousness is a condition for consciousness-originated materiality; the physical base is a condition for consciousness; at the moment of rebirth-linking, consciousness is a condition for kamma-born materiality, consciousness is a condition for the physical base, the physical base is a condition for consciousness, one great element…and so on… (1)

Acetasikaṃ dhammaṃ paccayā cetasiko dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – cittaṃ paccayā sampayuttakā khandhā, vatthuṃ paccayā cetasikā khandhā (paṭisandhikkhaṇe dvepi kātabbā). (2)

Conditioned by a non-mental phenomenon, a mental phenomenon arises by way of root condition: consciousness is a condition for the associated aggregates; the physical base is a condition for the mental aggregates (at the moment of rebirth-linking, both should be done). (2)

Acetasikaṃ dhammaṃ paccayā cetasiko ca acetasiko ca dhammā uppajjanti hetupaccayā – cittaṃ paccayā sampayuttakā khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ, vatthuṃ paccayā cittañca sampayuttakā ca khandhā (paṭisandhikkhaṇe dvepi kātabbā). (3)

Conditioned by a non-mental phenomenon, mental and non-mental phenomena arise by way of root condition—consciousness is a condition for the associated aggregates and consciousness-originated materiality; the physical base is a condition for consciousness and the associated aggregates (at the moment of rebirth-linking, both should be done). (3)

107. Cetasikañca acetasikañca dhammaṃ paccayā cetasiko dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – cetasikaṃ ekaṃ khandhañca cittañca paccayā dve khandhā, dve khandhe ca…pe… cetasikaṃ ekaṃ khandhañca vatthuñca paccayā dve khandhā, dve khandhe ca…pe… (paṭisandhikkhaṇe dvepi kātabbā). (1)

107. Conditioned by a mental and a non-mental phenomenon, a mental phenomenon arises by way of root condition: one mental aggregate and consciousness are a condition for two aggregates, two aggregates and… and so on… one mental aggregate and the physical base are a condition for two aggregates, two aggregates and… and so on… (at the moment of rebirth-linking, both should be done). (1)

Cetasikañca [M 3.0410] acetasikañca dhammaṃ paccayā acetasiko dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – cetasike khandhe ca cittañca paccayā cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ, cetasike khandhe ca mahābhūte [V 3.0505] ca paccayā cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ, cetasike khandhe ca vatthuñca paccayā cittaṃ (paṭisandhikkhaṇe tīṇipi kātabbā). (2)

Conditioned by a mental and a non-mental phenomenon, a non-mental phenomenon arises by way of root condition: the mental aggregates and consciousness are a condition for consciousness-originated materiality; the mental aggregates and the great elements are a condition for consciousness-originated materiality; the mental aggregates and the physical base are a condition for consciousness (at the moment of rebirth-linking, all three should be done). (2)

Cetasikañca acetasikañca dhammaṃ paccayā cetasiko ca acetasiko ca dhammā uppajjanti hetupaccayā – cetasikaṃ ekaṃ khandhañca cittañca paccayā dve khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ, dve khandhe ca…pe… cetasikaṃ ekaṃ [T 4.0050] khandhañca vatthuñca paccayā dve khandhā cittañca, dve khandhe ca…pe… (paṭisandhikkhaṇe dvepi kātabbā). (3)

Conditioned by a mental and a non-mental phenomenon, both mental and non-mental phenomena arise by way of root condition—one mental aggregate and consciousness are a condition for two aggregates and consciousness-originated materiality, two aggregates and… and so on… one mental aggregate and the physical base are a condition for two aggregates and consciousness, two aggregates and… and so on… (at the moment of rebirth-linking, both should be done). (3)

Ārammaṇapaccayo

The Object Condition

108. Cetasikaṃ dhammaṃ paccayā cetasiko dhammo uppajjati ārammaṇapaccayā… tīṇi (paṭiccasadisā).

108. Conditioned by a mental phenomenon, a mental phenomenon arises by way of object condition... three (similar to the Dependence Section).

Acetasikaṃ dhammaṃ paccayā acetasiko dhammo uppajjati ārammaṇapaccayā – cakkhāyatanaṃ paccayā cakkhuviññāṇaṃ…pe… kāyāyatanaṃ paccayā kāyaviññāṇaṃ, vatthuṃ paccayā cittaṃ; paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe…. (1)

Conditioned by a non-mental phenomenon, a non-mental phenomenon arises by way of object condition—the eye base is a condition for eye-consciousness… and so on… the body base is a condition for body-consciousness, the physical base is a condition for consciousness; at the moment of rebirth-linking… and so on… (1)

Acetasikaṃ dhammaṃ paccayā cetasiko dhammo uppajjati ārammaṇapaccayā – cakkhāyatanaṃ paccayā cakkhuviññāṇasahagatā khandhā…pe… kāyāyatanaṃ paccayā…pe… cittaṃ paccayā sampayuttakā khandhā, vatthuṃ paccayā cetasikā khandhā (paṭisandhikkhaṇe dvepi kātabbā). (2)

Conditioned by a non-mental phenomenon, a mental phenomenon arises by way of object condition—the eye base is a condition for the aggregates associated with eye-consciousness… and so on… the body base is a condition for… and so on… consciousness is a condition for the associated aggregates, the physical base is a condition for the mental aggregates (at the moment of rebirth-linking, both should be done). (2)

Acetasikaṃ dhammaṃ paccayā cetasiko ca acetasiko ca dhammā uppajjanti ārammaṇapaccayā – cakkhāyatanaṃ paccayā cakkhuviññāṇaṃ sampayuttakā ca khandhā…pe… kāyāyatanaṃ paccayā…pe… vatthuṃ paccayā cittaṃ sampayuttakā ca khandhā (paṭisandhikkhaṇe ekaṃ). (3)

Conditioned by a non-mental phenomenon, both mental and non-mental phenomena arise by way of object condition: the eye base is a condition for eye-consciousness and its associated aggregates… and so on… the body base is a condition for… and so on… the physical base is a condition for consciousness and its associated aggregates (one, at the moment of rebirth-linking). (3)

109. Cetasikañca acetasikañca dhammaṃ paccayā cetasiko dhammo uppajjati ārammaṇapaccayā – cakkhuviññāṇasahagataṃ ekaṃ khandhañca cakkhuviññāṇañca paccayā dve khandhā, dve khandhe ca…pe… cakkhuviññāṇasahagataṃ ekaṃ khandhañca cakkhāyatanañca paccayā dve khandhā, dve khandhe ca…pe… kāyaviññāṇasahagataṃ…pe… cetasikaṃ ekaṃ khandhañca cittañca paccayā dve khandhā, dve khandhe ca…pe… cetasikaṃ ekaṃ khandhañca vatthuñca [T 4.0051] paccayā dve khandhā, dve khandhe ca…pe… (paṭisandhikkhaṇe dve). (1)

109. Conditioned by a mental and a non-mental phenomenon, a mental phenomenon arises by way of object condition—one aggregate associated with eye-consciousness and eye-consciousness are a condition for two aggregates, two aggregates and… and so on… one aggregate associated with eye-consciousness and the eye base are a condition for two aggregates, two aggregates and… and so on… associated with body-consciousness… and so on… one mental aggregate and consciousness are a condition for two aggregates, two aggregates and… and so on… one mental aggregate and the physical base are a condition for two aggregates, two aggregates and… and so on… (at the moment of rebirth-linking, two). (1)

Cetasikañca [M 3.0411][V 3.0506] acetasikañca dhammaṃ paccayā acetasiko dhammo uppajjati ārammaṇapaccayā – cakkhuviññāṇasahagate khandhe ca cakkhāyatanañca paccayā cakkhuviññāṇaṃ…pe… kāyaviññāṇasahagate…pe… cetasike khandhe ca vatthuñca paccayā cittaṃ (paṭisandhikkhaṇe ekaṃ). (2)

A non-mental phenomenon arises dependent on a mental and a non-mental phenomenon by way of object condition: dependent on the aggregates associated with eye-consciousness and the eye-base, eye-consciousness arises… dependent on the aggregates associated with body-consciousness… dependent on the mental aggregates and the physical base, consciousness arises (one instance, at the moment of rebirth-linking). (2)

Cetasikañca acetasikañca dhammaṃ paccayā cetasiko ca acetasiko ca dhammā uppajjanti ārammaṇapaccayā – cakkhuviññāṇasahagataṃ ekaṃ khandhañca cakkhāyatanañca paccayā dve khandhā cakkhuviññāṇañca, dve khandhe ca…pe… cetasikaṃ ekaṃ khandhañca vatthuñca paccayā dve khandhā cittañca, dve khandhe ca…pe… (paṭisandhikkhaṇe ekaṃ, saṃkhittaṃ). (3)

Mental and non-mental phenomena arise dependent on a mental and a non-mental phenomenon by way of object condition: dependent on one aggregate associated with eye-consciousness and the eye-base, two aggregates and eye-consciousness arise; dependent on two aggregates… dependent on one mental aggregate and the physical base, two aggregates and consciousness arise; dependent on two aggregates… (one instance, at the moment of rebirth-linking, in brief). (3)

111. A mental phenomenon arises dependent on a mental phenomenon by way of non-root condition: a rootless mental phenomenon (in brief).

115. Cetasikaṃ [V 3.0508] dhammaṃ saṃsaṭṭho cetasiko dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – cetasikaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ saṃsaṭṭhā dve khandhā, dve khandhe…pe… paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe…. (1)

116. Hetuyā [V 3.0509] pañca, ārammaṇe pañca, adhipatiyā pañca (sabbattha pañca), avigate pañca.

116. By way of root condition, five; by way of object condition, five; by way of dominance condition, five (in all cases, five); by way of non-disappearance condition, five.

117. A mental phenomenon associated with a mental phenomenon arises by way of non-root condition (thus, all five questions should be addressed; only three involve delusion. Abbreviated).
