1. The Section on Analysis

Hetupaccayo

Root Condition

119. Cetasiko [V 3.0510] dhammo cetasikassa dhammassa hetupaccayena paccayo – cetasikā hetū sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ hetupaccayena paccayo; paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe…. (1)

119. A mental phenomenon is a condition for a mental phenomenon by way of root condition—mental roots are a condition for the associated aggregates by way of root condition; at the moment of rebirth-linking… and so on…. (1)

Cetasiko dhammo acetasikassa dhammassa hetupaccayena paccayo – cetasikā hetū cittassa cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ hetupaccayena paccayo; paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe…. (2)

A mental phenomenon is a condition for a non-mental phenomenon by way of root condition—mental roots are a condition for consciousness and for consciousness-originated materiality by way of root condition; at the moment of rebirth-linking… and so on…. (2)

Cetasiko [M 3.0414] dhammo cetasikassa ca acetasikassa ca dhammassa hetupaccayena paccayo – cetasikā hetū sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittassa ca cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ hetupaccayena paccayo; paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe…. (3)

A mental phenomenon is a condition for a mental phenomenon and a non-mental phenomenon by way of root condition—mental roots are a condition for the associated aggregates, for consciousness, and for consciousness-originated materiality by way of root condition; at the moment of rebirth-linking… and so on…. (3)

Ārammaṇapaccayo

Object Condition

120. Cetasiko dhammo cetasikassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo – cetasike khandhe ārabbha cetasikā khandhā uppajanti. (Mūlaṃ pucchitabbaṃ) cetasike khandhe ārabbha cittaṃ uppajjati. (Mūlaṃ pucchitabbaṃ) cetasike khandhe ārabbha cetasikā khandhā ca cittañca uppajjanti[T 4.0054]. (3)

120. A mental phenomenon is a condition for a mental phenomenon by way of object condition—with mental aggregates as object, mental aggregates arise. (The root should be questioned.) With mental aggregates as object, consciousness arises. (The root should be questioned.) With mental aggregates as object, mental aggregates and consciousness arise. (3)

121. Acetasiko dhammo acetasikassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo – ariyā maggā vuṭṭhahitvā…pe… phalaṃ paccavekkhanti, nibbānaṃ paccavekkhanti. Nibbānaṃ gotrabhussa, vodānassa, maggassa, phalassa, āvajjanāya ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo; cakkhuṃ…pe… vatthuṃ acetasike khandhe aniccato…pe… vipassati assādeti abhinandati[V 3.0511], taṃ ārabbha cittaṃ uppajjati. Dibbena cakkhunā rūpaṃ passati, dibbāya sotadhātuyā saddaṃ suṇāti. Cetopariyañāṇena acetasikacittasamaṅgissa cittaṃ jānāti, ākāsānañcāyatanaṃ…pe… ākiñcaññāyatanaṃ…pe… rūpāyatanaṃ cakkhuviññāṇassa…pe… phoṭṭhabbāyatanaṃ kāyaviññāṇassa…pe… acetasikā khandhā iddhividhañāṇassa, cetopariyañāṇassa, pubbenivāsānussatiñāṇassa, anāgataṃsañāṇassa, āvajjanāya ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo. (1)

121. A non-mental phenomenon is a condition for a non-mental phenomenon by way of object condition—having emerged from the noble path, noble ones review the fruition, they review Nibbāna. Nibbāna is a condition for change-of-lineage, for purification, for the path, for the fruition, and for advertence by way of object condition. The eye… the base, the non-mental aggregates as impermanent… one contemplates, delights in, and rejoices in them; taking them as object, consciousness arises. With the divine eye, one sees forms; with the divine ear-element, one hears sounds. Through mind-reading knowledge, one knows the consciousness of one endowed with a non-cetasika consciousness. The base of infinite space… the base of nothingness… the form-sphere is for eye-consciousness… the tangible-sphere is for body-consciousness… the non-mental aggregates are a condition for knowledge of psychic powers, for mind-reading knowledge, for knowledge of past lives, for knowledge of the future, and for advertence by way of object condition. (1)

Acetasiko dhammo cetasikassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo – ariyā maggā vuṭṭhahitvā…pe… nibbānaṃ paccavekkhanti (paṭhamagamanasadisaṃ); cakkhuṃ…pe… vatthuṃ acetasike khandhe aniccato…pe… domanassaṃ uppajjati; dibbena cakkhunā rūpaṃ passati, dibbāya sotadhātuyā saddaṃ suṇāti. Cetopariyañāṇena acetasikacittasamaṅgissa cittaṃ jānāti, ākāsānañcāyatanaṃ…pe… ākiñcaññāyatanaṃ nevasaññānāsaññāyatanassa…pe… rūpāyatanaṃ cakkhuviññāṇasahagatānaṃ khandhānaṃ…pe… phoṭṭhabbāyatanaṃ kāyaviññāṇasahagatānaṃ khandhānaṃ…pe… acetasikā khandhā iddhividhañāṇassa, cetopariyañāṇassa, pubbenivāsānussatiñāṇassa, anāgataṃsañāṇassa, āvajjanāya ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo. (2)

A non-mental phenomenon is a condition for a mental phenomenon by way of object condition—having emerged from the noble path, noble ones review Nibbāna (similar to the first instance). The eye… the base, the non-mental aggregates as impermanent… sorrow arises. With the divine eye, one sees forms; with the divine ear-element, one hears sounds. Through mind-reading knowledge, one knows the consciousness of one endowed with a non-cetasika consciousness; the base of infinite space… the base of nothingness for the base of neither-perception-nor-non-perception… the form-sphere for the aggregates associated with eye-consciousness… the tangible-sphere for the aggregates associated with body-consciousness… the non-mental aggregates are a condition for knowledge of psychic powers, for mind-reading knowledge, for knowledge of past lives, for knowledge of the future, and for advertence by way of object condition. (2)

Acetasiko [M 3.0415] dhammo cetasikassa [T 4.0055] ca acetasikassa ca dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo – ariyā maggā vuṭṭhahitvā…pe… nibbānaṃ paccavekkhanti (paṭhamagamanasadisaṃ); cakkhuṃ…pe… vatthuṃ acetasike khandhe aniccato…pe… vipassati assādeti abhinandati, taṃ ārabbha cittañca sampayuttakā ca khandhā uppajjanti. Dibbena cakkhunā rūpaṃ passati…pe… rūpāyatanaṃ cakkhuviññāṇassa sampayuttakānañca khandhānaṃ ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo…pe… phoṭṭhabbāyatanaṃ kāyaviññāṇassa sampayuttakānañca khandhānaṃ…pe… acetasikā khandhā iddhividhañāṇassa, cetopariyañāṇassa, pubbenivāsānussatiñāṇassa, anāgataṃsañāṇassa, āvajjanāya ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo. (3)

A non-mental phenomenon is a condition for a mental phenomenon and a non-mental phenomenon by way of object condition—having emerged from the noble path, noble ones review Nibbāna (similar to the first instance). The eye… the base, the non-mental aggregates as impermanent… one contemplates, delights in, and rejoices in them; taking them as object, consciousness and the associated aggregates arise. With the divine eye, one sees forms… the form-sphere is a condition for eye-consciousness and the associated aggregates by way of object condition… the tangible-sphere is a condition for body-consciousness and the associated aggregates… the non-mental aggregates are a condition for knowledge of psychic powers, for mind-reading knowledge, for knowledge of past lives, for knowledge of the future, and for advertence by way of object condition. (3)

122. Cetasiko ca acetasiko ca dhammā cetasikassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo – cetasike khandhe ca cittañca ārabbha cetasikā khandhā uppajjanti. (Mūlaṃ pucchitabbaṃ) [V 3.0512] cetasike khandhe ca cittañca ārabbha cittaṃ uppajjati. (Mūlaṃ pucchitabbaṃ) cetasike khandhe ca cittañca ārabbha cetasikā khandhā ca cittañca uppajjanti. (3)

122. Mental and non-mental phenomena are a condition for a mental phenomenon by way of object condition—with the mental aggregates and consciousness as object, mental aggregates arise. (The root should be questioned.) With the mental aggregates and consciousness as object, consciousness arises. (The root should be questioned.) With the mental aggregates and consciousness as object, both mental aggregates and consciousness arise. (3)

Adhipatipaccayo

Dominance Condition

123. Cetasiko dhammo cetasikassa dhammassa adhipatipaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇādhipati, sahajātādhipati. Ārammaṇādhipati – cetasike khandhe garuṃ katvā cetasikā khandhā uppajjanti. Sahajātādhipati – cetasikādhipati sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ adhipatipaccayena paccayo. (Mūlaṃ pucchitabbaṃ) ārammaṇādhipati – cetasike khandhe garuṃ katvā cittaṃ uppajjati. Sahajātādhipati – cetasikādhipati cittassa cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ adhipatipaccayena paccayo. (Mūlaṃ pucchitabbaṃ [T 4.0056]) ārammaṇādhipati – cetasike khandhe garuṃ katvā cetasikā khandhā ca cittañca uppajjanti. Sahajātādhipati – cetasikādhipati sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittassa ca cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ adhipatipaccayena paccayo. (3)

123. A mental phenomenon is a condition for a mental phenomenon by way of the Dominance Condition: Object Dominance and Co-nascence Dominance. Object Dominance: having made the mental aggregates weighty, mental aggregates arise. Co-nascence Dominance: a dominant mental factor is a condition for the associated aggregates by way of the Dominance Condition. (The root is to be asked.) Object Dominance: having made the mental aggregates weighty, consciousness arises. Co-nascence Dominance: a dominant mental factor is a condition for consciousness and for consciousness-originated material phenomena by way of the Dominance Condition. (The root is to be asked.) Object Dominance: having made the mental aggregates weighty, mental aggregates and consciousness arise. Co-nascence Dominance: a dominant mental factor is a condition for the associated aggregates, for consciousness, and for consciousness-originated material phenomena by way of the Dominance Condition. (3)

124. Acetasiko dhammo acetasikassa dhammassa adhipatipaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇādhipati, sahajātādhipati. Ārammaṇādhipati – ariyā maggā vuṭṭhahitvā…pe… nibbānaṃ garuṃ katvā paccavekkhanti, nibbānaṃ gotrabhussa, vodānassa. Maggassa, phalassa adhipatipaccayena paccayo; cakkhuṃ [M 3.0416]…pe… vatthuṃ acetasike khandhe garuṃ katvā assādeti abhinandati, taṃ garuṃ katvā cittaṃ uppajjati. Sahajātādhipati – acetasikādhipati cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ adhipatipaccayena paccayo. (1)

124. A non-mental phenomenon is a condition for a non-mental phenomenon by way of the Dominance Condition: Object Dominance and Co-nascence Dominance. Object Dominance: noble ones, having emerged from the paths… and so on… contemplate Nibbāna, having made it weighty; Nibbāna is a condition for change-of-lineage consciousness, for purification consciousness, for the path, and for the fruit by way of the Dominance Condition. Having made the eye… and so on… the base, the non-mental aggregates weighty, one delights in and rejoices in them; having made that weighty, consciousness arises. Co-nascence Dominance: a dominant non-mental phenomenon is a condition for consciousness-originated material phenomena by way of the Dominance Condition. (1)

Acetasiko dhammo cetasikassa dhammassa adhipatipaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇādhipati, sahajātādhipati. Ārammaṇādhipati – ariyā maggā vuṭṭhahitvā…pe… nibbānaṃ garuṃ katvā…pe… (paṭhamagamanasadisaṃ); cakkhuṃ…pe… vatthuṃ acetasike khandhe garuṃ katvā assādeti abhinandati, taṃ garuṃ katvā rāgo uppajjati, diṭṭhi uppajjati. Sahajātādhipati – acetasikādhipati sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ adhipatipaccayena paccayo. (2)

A non-mental phenomenon is a condition for a mental phenomenon by way of the Dominance Condition: Object Dominance and Co-nascence Dominance. Object Dominance: noble ones, having emerged from the paths… and so on… having made Nibbāna weighty… and so on… (similar to the first passage); having made the eye… and so on… the base, the non-mental aggregates weighty, one delights in and rejoices in them; having made that weighty, lust arises, wrong view arises. Co-nascence Dominance: a dominant non-mental phenomenon is a condition for the associated aggregates by way of the Dominance Condition. (2)

Acetasiko dhammo cetasikassa ca acetasikassa ca dhammassa adhipatipaccayena paccayo [V 3.0513] – ārammaṇādhipati, sahajātādhipati. Ārammaṇādhipati – ariyā maggā vuṭṭhahitvā…pe… nibbānaṃ…pe… (paṭhamagamanaṃ) acetasike khandhe garuṃ katvā assādeti abhinandati, taṃ garuṃ katvā cetasikā khandhā ca cittañca uppajjanti. Sahajātādhipati [T 4.0057] – acetasikādhipati sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ adhipatipaccayena paccayo. (3)

A non-mental phenomenon is a condition for both a mental phenomenon and a non-mental phenomenon by way of the Dominance Condition: Object Dominance and Co-nascence Dominance. Object Dominance: noble ones, having emerged from the paths… and so on… Nibbāna… and so on… (the first passage); having made the non-mental aggregates weighty, one delights in and rejoices in them; having made that weighty, mental aggregates and consciousness arise. Co-nascence Dominance: a dominant non-mental phenomenon is a condition for the associated aggregates and for consciousness-originated material phenomena by way of the Dominance Condition. (3)

Cetasiko ca acetasiko ca dhammā cetasikassa dhammassa adhipatipaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇādhipati… tīṇi (ārammaṇādhipatiyeva).

Both a mental phenomenon and a non-mental phenomenon are conditions for a mental phenomenon by way of the Dominance Condition: Object Dominance… three (Object Dominance only).

Anantarapaccayādi

Immediately Proximate Condition, etc.

125. Cetasiko dhammo cetasikassa dhammassa anantarapaccayena paccayo – purimā purimā cetasikā khandhā pacchimānaṃ pacchimānaṃ cetasikānaṃ khandhānaṃ anantarapaccayena paccayo. (Mūlaṃ pucchitabbaṃ) purimā purimā cetasikā khandhā pacchimassa pacchimassa cittassa anantarapaccayena paccayo. (Mūlaṃ pucchitabbaṃ) purimā purimā cetasikā khandhā pacchimānaṃ pacchimānaṃ cetasikānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittassa ca anantarapaccayena paccayo. (3)

125. A mental phenomenon is a condition for a mental phenomenon by way of the Immediately Proximate Condition: preceding mental aggregates are a condition for succeeding mental aggregates by way of the Immediately Proximate Condition. (The root is to be asked.) Preceding mental aggregates are a condition for succeeding consciousness by way of the Immediately Proximate Condition. (The root is to be asked.) Preceding mental aggregates are a condition for succeeding mental aggregates and consciousness by way of the Immediately Proximate Condition. (3)

126. Acetasiko dhammo acetasikassa dhammassa anantarapaccayena paccayo – purimaṃ purimaṃ cittaṃ pacchimassa pacchimassa cittassa anantarapaccayena paccayo; anulomaṃ gotrabhussa…pe… phalasamāpattiyā anantarapaccayena paccayo. (1)

126. A non-mental phenomenon is a condition for a non-mental phenomenon by way of the Immediately Proximate Condition: preceding consciousness is a condition for succeeding consciousness by way of the Immediately Proximate Condition; adaptation is a condition for change-of-lineage… and so on… for fruition-attainment by way of the Immediately Proximate Condition. (1)

Acetasiko [M 3.0417] dhammo cetasikassa dhammassa anantarapaccayena paccayo (evaṃ tīṇi kātabbāni, paṭhamagamanasadisaṃ. Pūritvā kātabbaṃ, ninnānākaraṇaṃ).

A non-mental phenomenon is a condition for a mental phenomenon by way of the Immediately Proximate Condition. (Thus three are to be made, similar to the first passage. It is to be filled in, without any difference.)

Cetasiko ca acetasiko ca dhammā cetasikassa dhammassa anantarapaccayena paccayo… tīṇi (āvajjanāpi vuṭṭhānampi natthi).

Both a mental phenomenon and a non-mental phenomenon are conditions for a mental phenomenon by way of the Immediately Proximate Condition… three (there is neither adverting nor emergence).

Samanantarapaccayena paccayo… nava, sahajātapaccayena paccayo… nava (paṭiccavārasadisaṃ)[V 3.0514], aññamaññapaccayena paccayo… nava (paṭiccavārasadisaṃ), nissayapaccayena paccayo… nava [T 4.0058] (paccayavārasadisaṃ).

By way of the Immediately Contiguous Condition… nine. By way of the Co-nascence Condition… nine (similar to the Dependent Origination section). By way of the Mutuality Condition… nine (similar to the Dependent Origination section). By way of the Dependence Condition… nine (similar to the Condition section).

Upanissayapaccayo

Decisive Support Condition

127. Cetasiko dhammo cetasikassa dhammassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇūpanissayo, anantarūpanissayo, pakatūpanissayo…pe…. Pakatūpanissayo – cetasikā khandhā cetasikānaṃ khandhānaṃ upanissayapaccayena paccayo. (Mūlaṃ pucchitabbaṃ, tīṇi upanissayā) cetasikā khandhā cittassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo. (Mūlaṃ pucchitabbaṃ, tīṇi upanissayā) cetasikā khandhā cetasikānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittassa ca upanissayapaccayena paccayo. (3)

127. A mental phenomenon is a condition for a mental phenomenon by way of the Decisive Support Condition: Object Decisive Support, Contiguity Decisive Support, and Natural Decisive Support… and so on. Natural Decisive Support: mental aggregates are a condition for mental aggregates by way of the Decisive Support Condition. (The root is to be asked; there are three decisive supports.) Mental aggregates are a condition for consciousness by way of the Decisive Support Condition. (The root is to be asked; there are three decisive supports.) Mental aggregates are a condition for mental aggregates and for consciousness by way of the Decisive Support Condition. (3)

128. Acetasiko dhammo acetasikassa dhammassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇūpanissayo, anantarūpanissayo, pakatūpanissayo…pe…. Pakatūpanissayo – utuṃ… bhojanaṃ… senāsanaṃ cittaṃ upanissāya dānaṃ deti…pe… saṅghaṃ bhindati; utuṃ… bhojanaṃ… senāsanaṃ cittaṃ saddhāya…pe… paññāya… rāgassa…pe… patthanāya kāyikassa sukhassa, kāyikassa dukkhassa, maggassa, phalasamāpattiyā upanissayapaccayena paccayo. (1)

128. A non-mental phenomenon is a condition for a non-mental phenomenon by way of dependence condition: object-support dependence, contiguity dependence, natural-support dependence.... Natural-support dependence—depending on climate... food... lodging... mind, one gives alms... or splits the Saṅgha; climate... food... lodging... mind are conditions for faith... wisdom... lust... aspiration, bodily pleasure, bodily pain, the path, and the attainment of fruition by way of dependence condition. (1)

Acetasiko dhammo cetasikassa dhammassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇūpanissayo, anantarūpanissayo pakatūpanissayo…pe…. Pakatūpanissayo – utuṃ… bhojanaṃ… senāsanaṃ cittaṃ upanissāya dānaṃ deti…pe… (tīṇi, paṭhamagamanasadisaṃ ninnānākaraṇaṃ).

A non-mental phenomenon is a condition for a mental phenomenon by way of dependence condition: object-support dependence, contiguity dependence, natural-support dependence.... Natural-support dependence—depending on climate... food... lodging... mind, one gives alms... (three, similar to the first passage, without differentiation).

Cetasiko ca acetasiko ca dhammā cetasikassa dhammassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo… tīṇi.

Both mental and non-mental phenomena are conditions for a mental phenomenon by way of dependence condition... three (factors).

Purejātapaccayo

Pre-nascence Condition

129. Acetasiko [M 3.0418] dhammo acetasikassa dhammassa purejātapaccayena [T 4.0059] paccayo – ārammaṇapurejātaṃ[V 3.0515], vatthupurejātaṃ. Ārammaṇapurejātaṃ – cakkhuṃ…pe… vatthuṃ aniccato…pe… vipassati assādeti abhinandati, taṃ ārabbha cittaṃ uppajjati. Dibbena cakkhunā rūpaṃ passati, dibbāya sotadhātuyā saddaṃ suṇāti. Rūpāyatanaṃ cakkhuviññāṇassa…pe… phoṭṭhabbāyatanaṃ kāyaviññāṇassa…pe…. Vatthupurejātaṃ – cakkhāyatanaṃ cakkhuviññāṇassa…pe… kāyāyatanaṃ kāyaviññāṇassa…pe… vatthu cittassa purejātapaccayena paccayo. (1)

129. A non-mental phenomenon is a condition for a non-mental phenomenon by way of the pre-nascence condition—object pre-nascence and base pre-nascence. Object pre-nascence—the eye... one discerns the base as impermanent... delights in it, rejoices in it; the mind arises dependent on that. With the divine eye, one sees a form; with the divine ear element, one hears a sound. The visible form base is a condition for eye-consciousness... the tangible base is a condition for body-consciousness.... Base pre-nascence—the eye base is a condition for eye-consciousness... the body base is a condition for body-consciousness... the base is a condition for consciousness by way of the pre-nascence condition. (1)

Acetasiko dhammo cetasikassa dhammassa purejātapaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇapurejātaṃ, vatthupurejātaṃ. Ārammaṇapurejātaṃ – cakkhuṃ…pe… vatthuṃ aniccato…pe… domanassaṃ uppajjati; dibbena cakkhunā rūpaṃ passati, dibbāya sotadhātuyā saddaṃ suṇāti. Rūpāyatanaṃ cakkhuviññāṇasahagatānaṃ khandhānaṃ…pe… phoṭṭhabbāyatanaṃ kāyaviññāṇasahagatānaṃ khandhānaṃ…pe…. Vatthupurejātaṃ – cakkhāyatanaṃ cakkhuviññāṇasahagatānaṃ khandhānaṃ…pe… kāyāyatanaṃ…pe… vatthu cetasikānaṃ khandhānaṃ purejātapaccayena paccayo. (2)

A non-mental phenomenon is a condition for a mental phenomenon by way of the pre-nascence condition—object pre-nascence and base pre-nascence. Object pre-nascence—regarding the eye... the base as impermanent... sorrow arises; with the divine eye, one sees a form; with the divine ear element, one hears a sound. The visible form base is a condition for the aggregates associated with eye-consciousness... the tangible base is a condition for the aggregates associated with body-consciousness.... Base pre-nascence—the eye base is a condition for the aggregates associated with eye-consciousness... the body base... the base is a condition for the mental aggregates by way of the pre-nascence condition. (2)

Acetasiko dhammo cetasikassa ca acetasikassa ca dhammassa purejātapaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇapurejātaṃ, vatthupurejātaṃ. Ārammaṇapurejātaṃ – cakkhuṃ…pe… vatthuṃ aniccato…pe… vipassati assādeti abhinandati, taṃ ārabbha cittañca sampayuttakā ca khandhā uppajjanti. Dibbena cakkhunā rūpaṃ passati, dibbāya sotadhātuyā saddaṃ suṇāti. Rūpāyatanaṃ cakkhuviññāṇassa sampayuttakānañca khandhānaṃ…pe… phoṭṭhabbāyatanaṃ…pe…. Vatthupurejātaṃ – cakkhāyatanaṃ cakkhuviññāṇassa [T 4.0060] sampayuttakānañca khandhānaṃ…pe… kāyāyatanaṃ…pe… vatthu cittassa sampayuttakānañca khandhānaṃ purejātapaccayena paccayo. (3)

A non-mental phenomenon is a condition for both mental and non-mental phenomena by way of pre-nascence condition—object pre-nascence and base pre-nascence. Object pre-nascence: one discerns the eye... the base as impermanent... delights in it, rejoices in it. Based on that, consciousness and associated aggregates arise. With the divine eye, one sees a form; with the divine ear element, one hears a sound. The visible form base is a condition for eye-consciousness and its associated aggregates... the tangible base.... Base pre-nascence: the eye base is a condition for eye-consciousness and its associated aggregates... the body base... the base is a condition for consciousness and its associated aggregates by way of pre-nascence condition. (3)

Pacchājātāsevanapaccayā

Post-nascence and Repetition Conditions

130. Cetasiko dhammo acetasikassa dhammassa pacchājātapaccayena paccayo (saṃkhittaṃ).

130. A mental phenomenon is a condition for a non-mental phenomenon by way of the post-nascence condition (briefly).

Acetasiko [M 3.0419] dhammo acetasikassa dhammassa pacchājātapaccayena paccayo (saṃkhittaṃ).

A non-mental phenomenon is a condition for a non-mental phenomenon by way of the post-nascence condition (briefly).

Cetasiko [V 3.0516] ca acetasiko ca dhammā acetasikassa dhammassa pacchājātapaccayena paccayo (saṃkhittaṃ).

Both mental and non-mental phenomena are conditions for a non-mental phenomenon by way of the post-nascence condition (in brief).

Cetasiko dhammo cetasikassa dhammassa āsevanapaccayena paccayo (saṃkhittaṃ).

A mental phenomenon is a condition for a mental phenomenon by way of the repetition condition (in brief).

Kammapaccayo

Kamma-condition

131. Cetasiko dhammo cetasikassa dhammassa kammapaccayena paccayo – sahajātā, nānākkhaṇikā. Sahajātā – cetasikā cetanā sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ kammapaccayena paccayo; paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe…. Nānākkhaṇikā – cetasikā cetanā vipākānaṃ khandhānaṃ kammapaccayena paccayo. (1)

131. A mental phenomenon is a condition for a mental phenomenon by way of kamma-condition: co-nascent and non-co-nascent. Co-nascent: Mental volition is a condition for associated aggregates by way of kamma-condition; at the moment of rebirth-linking... Non-co-nascent: Mental volition is a condition for resultant aggregates by way of kamma-condition. (1)

Cetasiko dhammo acetasikassa dhammassa kammapaccayena paccayo – sahajātā, nānākkhaṇikā. Sahajātā – cetasikā cetanā cittassa cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ kammapaccayena paccayo; paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe…. Nānākkhaṇikā – cetasikā cetanā vipākassa cittassa kaṭattā ca rūpānaṃ kammapaccayena paccayo. (2)

A mental phenomenon is a condition for a non-mental phenomenon by way of kamma-condition: co-nascent and non-co-nascent. Co-nascent: Mental volition is a condition for consciousness and mind-originated material phenomena by way of kamma-condition; at the moment of rebirth-linking... Non-co-nascent: Mental volition is a condition for resultant consciousness and kamma-produced materiality by way of kamma-condition. (2)

Cetasiko dhammo cetasikassa ca acetasikassa ca dhammassa kammapaccayena paccayo – sahajātā, nānākkhaṇikā. Sahajātā – cetasikā cetanā sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittassa ca cittasamuṭṭhānānañca [T 4.0061] rūpānaṃ kammapaccayena paccayo; paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe…. Nānākkhaṇikā – cetasikā cetanā vipākānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittassa kaṭattā ca rūpānaṃ kammapaccayena paccayo. (3)

A mental phenomenon is a condition for both mental and non-mental phenomena by way of kamma-condition: co-nascent and non-co-nascent. Co-nascent: Mental volition is a condition for associated aggregates, consciousness, and mind-originated material phenomena by way of kamma-condition; at the moment of rebirth-linking... Non-co-nascent: Mental volition is a condition for resultant aggregates, consciousness, and kamma-produced materiality by way of kamma-condition. (3)

Vipākapaccayādi

Result-condition, and so on.

132. Cetasiko dhammo cetasikassa dhammassa vipākapaccayena paccayo… nava… āhārapaccayena paccayo… nava… indriyapaccayena paccayo… nava… jhānapaccayena paccayo… tīṇi… maggapaccayena paccayo… tīṇi… sampayuttapaccayena paccayo… pañca.

132. A mental phenomenon is a condition for a mental phenomenon by way of result-condition... nine... by way of nutriment-condition... nine... by way of faculty-condition... nine... by way of jhāna-condition... three... by way of path-condition... three... by way of association-condition... five.

Vippayuttapaccayo

Dissociation-condition

133. Cetasiko [M 3.0420][V 3.0517] dhammo acetasikassa dhammassa vippayuttapaccayena paccayo – sahajātaṃ, pacchājātaṃ (saṃkhittaṃ). (1)

133. A mental phenomenon is a condition for a non-mental phenomenon by way of dissociation-condition: co-nascent and post-nascent (in brief). (1)

Acetasiko dhammo acetasikassa dhammassa vippayuttapaccayena paccayo – sahajātaṃ, purejātaṃ, pacchājātaṃ. Sahajātaṃ – cittaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ vippayuttapaccayena paccayo; paṭisandhikkhaṇe cittaṃ kaṭattārūpānaṃ vippayuttapaccayena paccayo; cittaṃ vatthussa vippayuttapaccayena paccayo; vatthu cittassa vippayuttapaccayena paccayo. Purejātaṃ – cakkhāyatanaṃ cakkhuviññāṇassa vippayuttapaccayena paccayo…pe… kāyāyatanaṃ kāyaviññāṇassa…pe… vatthu cittassa vippayuttapaccayena paccayo. Pacchājātaṃ – cittaṃ purejātassa imassa kāyassa vippayuttapaccayena paccayo. (1)

A non-mental phenomenon is a condition for a non-mental phenomenon by way of dissociation-condition: co-nascent, pre-nascent, and post-nascent. Co-nascent: Consciousness is a condition for mind-originated material phenomena by way of dissociation-condition; at the moment of rebirth-linking, consciousness is a condition for kamma-produced materiality by way of dissociation-condition; consciousness is a condition for the physical basis by way of dissociation-condition; the physical basis is a condition for consciousness by way of dissociation-condition. Pre-nascent: The eye-base is a condition for eye-consciousness by way of dissociation-condition... the body-base is a condition for body-consciousness... the physical basis is a condition for consciousness by way of dissociation-condition. Post-nascent: Consciousness is a condition for this pre-nascent body by way of dissociation-condition. (1)

Acetasiko dhammo cetasikassa dhammassa vippayuttapaccayena paccayo – sahajātaṃ, purejātaṃ. Sahajātaṃ – paṭisandhikkhaṇe vatthu cetasikānaṃ khandhānaṃ vippayuttapaccayena paccayo. Purejātaṃ – cakkhāyatanaṃ cakkhuviññāṇasahagatānaṃ khandhānaṃ…pe… kāyāyatanaṃ kāyaviññāṇasahagatānaṃ khandhānaṃ…pe… vatthu cetasikānaṃ khandhānaṃ vippayuttapaccayena paccayo. (2)

A non-mental phenomenon is a condition for a mental phenomenon by way of dissociation-condition: co-nascent and pre-nascent. Co-nascent: At the moment of rebirth-linking, the physical base is a condition for the mental aggregates by way of dissociation-condition. Pre-nascent: The eye-base is a condition for the aggregates associated with eye-consciousness... the body-base is a condition for the aggregates associated with body-consciousness... the physical base is a condition for the mental aggregates by way of dissociation-condition. (2)

Acetasiko dhammo cetasikassa ca acetasikassa ca dhammassa vippayuttapaccayena paccayo – sahajātaṃ, purejātaṃ. Sahajātaṃ – paṭisandhikkhaṇe vatthu cetasikānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittassa ca vippayuttapaccayena paccayo. Purejātaṃ – cakkhāyatanaṃ [T 4.0062] cakkhuviññāṇassa sampayuttakānañca khandhānaṃ…pe… kāyāyatanaṃ kāyaviññāṇassa sampayuttakānañca khandhānaṃ…pe… vatthu cittassa sampayuttakānañca khandhānaṃ vippayuttapaccayena paccayo. (3)

A non-mental phenomenon is a condition for both a mental phenomenon and a non-mental phenomenon by way of dissociation-condition: co-nascent and pre-nascent. Co-nascent: At the moment of rebirth-linking, the physical base is a condition for the mental aggregates and consciousness by way of dissociation-condition. Pre-nascent: The eye-base is a condition for eye-consciousness and its associated aggregates... the body-base is a condition for body-consciousness and its associated aggregates... the physical base is a condition for consciousness and its associated aggregates by way of dissociation-condition. (3)

Cetasiko ca acetasiko ca dhammā acetasikassa dhammassa vippayuttapaccayena paccayo – sahajātaṃ, pacchājātaṃ (saṃkhittaṃ).

Both a mental phenomenon and a non-mental phenomenon are conditions for a non-mental phenomenon by way of dissociation-condition: co-nascent and post-nascent (abbreviated).

Atthipaccayo

Presence-condition

134. Cetasiko [V 3.0518] dhammo cetasikassa dhammassa atthipaccayena paccayo… ekaṃ (paṭiccavārasadisaṃ).

134. A mental phenomenon is a condition for a mental phenomenon by way of presence-condition... one (similar to the Paṭicca section).

Cetasiko dhammo acetasikassa dhammassa atthipaccayena paccayo – sahajātaṃ, pacchājātaṃ (saṃkhittaṃ). (2)

A mental phenomenon is a condition for a non-mental phenomenon by way of presence-condition: co-nascent, post-nascent (in brief). (2)

Cetasiko [M 3.0421] dhammo cetasikassa ca acetasikassa ca dhammassa atthipaccayena paccayo… ekaṃ (paṭiccavārasadisaṃ). (3)

A mental phenomenon is a condition for a mental phenomenon and for a non-mental phenomenon by way of presence-condition... one (similar to the Paṭicca section). (3)

135. Acetasiko dhammo acetasikassa dhammassa atthipaccayena paccayo – sahajātaṃ, purejātaṃ, pacchājātaṃ, āhāraṃ, indriyaṃ (saṃkhittaṃ). (1)

135. A non-mental phenomenon is a condition for a non-mental phenomenon by way of presence-condition: co-nascent, pre-nascent, post-nascent, nutriment, faculty (abbreviated). (1)

Acetasiko dhammo cetasikassa dhammassa atthipaccayena paccayo – sahajātaṃ, purejātaṃ. Sahajātaṃ – cittaṃ cetasikānaṃ khandhānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo; paṭisandhikkhaṇe cittaṃ…pe… paṭisandhikkhaṇe vatthu cetasikānaṃ khandhānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo. Purejātaṃ – cakkhuṃ…pe… vatthuṃ aniccato…pe… (purejātasadisaṃ ninnānākaraṇaṃ). (2)

A non-mental phenomenon is a condition for a mental phenomenon by way of presence-condition: co-nascent and pre-nascent. Co-nascent: Consciousness is a condition for the mental aggregates by way of presence-condition; at the moment of rebirth-linking, consciousness... at the moment of rebirth-linking, the physical base is a condition for the mental aggregates by way of presence-condition. Pre-nascent: The eye... the physical base as impermanent... (similar to the pre-nascent section, without differentiation). (2)

Acetasiko [T 4.0063] dhammo cetasikassa ca acetasikassa ca dhammassa atthipaccayena paccayo – sahajātaṃ, purejātaṃ. Sahajātaṃ – cittaṃ sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo; paṭisandhikkhaṇe cittaṃ…pe… paṭisandhikkhaṇe vatthu cetasikānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittassa ca atthipaccayena paccayo. Purejātaṃ – cakkhuṃ…pe… vatthuṃ aniccato…pe… (purejātasadisaṃ ninnānaṃ). (3)

A non-mental phenomenon is a condition for a mental phenomenon and a non-mental phenomenon by way of presence-condition: co-nascent and pre-nascent. Co-nascent: Consciousness is a condition by way of presence-condition for the associated aggregates and for mind-originated material phenomena; at the moment of rebirth-linking, consciousness... at the moment of rebirth-linking, the physical base is a condition by way of presence-condition for the mental aggregates and for consciousness. Pre-nascent: The eye... the physical base as impermanent... (similar to the pre-nascent section, without differentiation). (3)

136. Cetasiko ca acetasiko ca dhammā cetasikassa dhammassa atthipaccayena paccayo – sahajātaṃ, purejātaṃ. Sahajāto – cakkhuviññāṇasahagato eko khandho ca cakkhāyatanañca dvinnaṃ khandhānaṃ…pe… kāyaviññāṇasahagato…pe… cetasiko eko khandho ca [V 3.0519] vatthu ca dvinnaṃ khandhānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo; dve khandhā ca…pe…. Sahajāto – cetasiko eko khandho ca cittañca dvinnaṃ khandhānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo; dve khandhā ca…pe… (paṭisandhikkhaṇe) dvepi kātabbā. (1)

136. A mental phenomenon and a non-mental phenomenon are conditions for a mental phenomenon by way of presence-condition: co-nascent and pre-nascent. Co-nascent: One aggregate associated with eye-consciousness and the eye-base are conditions for two aggregates... one aggregate associated with body-consciousness... one mental aggregate and the physical base are conditions for two aggregates by way of presence-condition; two aggregates... Co-nascent: One mental aggregate and consciousness are conditions for two aggregates by way of presence-condition; two aggregates... (at the moment of rebirth-linking, both should be done). (1)

Cetasiko ca acetasiko ca dhammā acetasikassa dhammassa atthipaccayena paccayo – sahajātaṃ, purejātaṃ, pacchājātaṃ, āhāraṃ, indriyaṃ. Sahajātā – cakkhuviññāṇasahagatā khandhā ca cakkhāyatanañca cakkhuviññāṇassa…pe… kāyaviññāṇassa…pe… cetasikā khandhā ca cittañca cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo; cetasikā khandhā ca cittañca mahābhūtā ca cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo. Sahajātā [M 3.0422] – cetasikā khandhā ca vatthu ca cittassa atthipaccayena paccayo (paṭisandhikkhaṇe tīṇipi [T 4.0064] kātabbā). Pacchājātā – cetasikā khandhā ca cittañca purejātassa imassa kāyassa atthipaccayena paccayo. Pacchājātā – cetasikā khandhā ca cittañca kabaḷīkāro āhāro ca imassa kāyassa atthipaccayena paccayo. Pacchājātā – cetasikā khandhā ca cittañca rūpajīvitindriyañca kaṭattārūpānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo. (2)

A mental phenomenon and a non-mental phenomenon are conditions for a non-mental phenomenon by way of presence-condition: co-nascent, pre-nascent, post-nascent, nutriment, faculty. Co-nascent: The aggregates associated with eye-consciousness and the eye-base are conditions for eye-consciousness... for body-consciousness... the mental aggregates and consciousness are conditions for mind-originated material phenomena by way of presence-condition; the mental aggregates, consciousness, and the great elements are conditions for mind-originated material phenomena by way of presence-condition. Co-nascent: The mental aggregates and the physical base are conditions for consciousness by way of presence-condition (at the moment of rebirth-linking, all three should be done). Post-nascent: The mental aggregates and consciousness are conditions for this pre-nascent body by way of presence-condition. Post-nascent: The mental aggregates, consciousness, and edible food are conditions for this body by way of presence-condition. Post-nascent: The mental aggregates, consciousness, and the material life faculty are conditions for kamma-produced materiality by way of presence-condition. (2)

Cetasiko ca acetasiko ca dhammā cetasikassa ca acetasikassa ca dhammassa atthipaccayena paccayo – sahajātaṃ, purejātaṃ. Sahajāto – cakkhuviññāṇasahagato eko khandho ca cakkhāyatanañca dvinnaṃ khandhānaṃ cakkhuviññāṇassa ca atthipaccayena paccayo…pe… kāyaviññāṇasahagato eko khandho ca kāyāyatanañca dvinnaṃ khandhānaṃ kāyaviññāṇassa ca atthipaccayena paccayo; dve khandhā ca…pe…. Sahajāto – cetasiko eko khandho ca vatthu ca dvinnaṃ khandhānaṃ cittassa ca atthipaccayena paccayo; dve khandhā ca…pe… (paṭisandhiyā dve kātabbā). (3)

A mental phenomenon and a non-mental phenomenon are conditions for both a mental phenomenon and a non-mental phenomenon by way of presence condition: co-nascent and pre-nascent. Co-nascent: one aggregate associated with eye-consciousness and the eye-base are conditions for two aggregates and for eye-consciousness by way of presence condition...pe... one aggregate associated with body-consciousness and the body-base are conditions for two aggregates and for body-consciousness by way of presence condition; two aggregates and...pe.... Co-nascent: one mental aggregate and the physical base are conditions for two aggregates and for consciousness by way of presence condition; two aggregates and...pe... (at rebirth-linking, two cases should be made). (3)

Suddhaṃ

Pure

137. Hetuyā [V 3.0520] tīṇi, ārammaṇe nava, adhipatiyā nava, anantare nava, samanantare nava, sahajāte nava, aññamaññe nava, nissaye nava, upanissaye nava, purejāte tīṇi, pacchājāte tīṇi, āsevane nava, kamme tīṇi, vipāke nava, āhāre nava, indriye nava, jhāne tīṇi, magge tīṇi, sampayutte pañca, vippayutte pañca, atthiyā nava, natthiyā nava, vigate nava, avigate nava.

137. By root condition, three; by object condition, nine; by decisive support condition, nine; by contiguity condition, nine; by immediacy condition, nine; by co-nascence condition, nine; by reciprocity condition, nine; by dependence condition, nine; by strong dependence condition, nine; by pre-nascence condition, three; by post-nascence condition, three; by repetition condition, nine; by kamma condition, three; by result condition, nine; by nutriment condition, nine; by faculty condition, nine; by jhāna condition, three; by path condition, three; by association condition, five; by dissociation condition, five; by presence condition, nine; by absence condition, nine; by disappearance condition, nine; by non-disappearance condition, nine.

Anulomaṃ.

The Direct Order

Paccanīyuddhāro

Section on the Negative

138. Cetasiko dhammo cetasikassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo [T 4.0065]… sahajātapaccayena paccayo… upanissayapaccayena paccayo… kammapaccayena paccayo. (1)

138. A mental phenomenon is a condition for a mental phenomenon by way of object condition... by way of co-nascence condition... by way of strong dependence condition... by way of kamma condition. (1)

Cetasiko [M 3.0423] dhammo acetasikassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo… sahajātapaccayena paccayo… upanissayapaccayena paccayo… pacchājātapaccayena paccayo… kammapaccayena paccayo. (2)

A mental phenomenon is a condition for a non-mental phenomenon by way of object condition... by way of co-nascence condition... by way of strong dependence condition... by way of post-nascence condition... by way of kamma condition. (2)

Cetasiko dhammo cetasikassa ca acetasikassa ca dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo… sahajātapaccayena paccayo… upanissayapaccayena paccayo… kammapaccayena paccayo. (3)

A mental phenomenon is a condition for both a mental and a non-mental phenomenon by way of object condition... by way of co-nascence condition... by way of strong dependence condition... by way of kamma condition. (3)

139. Acetasiko dhammo acetasikassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo… sahajātapaccayena [V 3.0521] paccayo… upanissayapaccayena paccayo… purejātapaccayena paccayo… pacchājātapaccayena paccayo… āhārapaccayena paccayo… indriyapaccayena paccayo. (1)

139. A non-mental phenomenon is a condition for a non-mental phenomenon by way of object condition... by way of co-nascence condition... by way of strong dependence condition... by way of pre-nascence condition... by way of post-nascence condition... by way of nutriment condition... by way of faculty condition. (1)

Acetasiko dhammo cetasikassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo… sahajātapaccayena paccayo… upanissayapaccayena paccayo… purejātapaccayena paccayo. (2)

A non-mental phenomenon is a condition for a mental phenomenon by way of object condition... by way of co-nascence condition... by way of strong dependence condition... by way of pre-nascence condition. (2)

Acetasiko dhammo cetasikassa ca acetasikassa ca dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo… sahajātapaccayena paccayo… upanissayapaccayena paccayo… purejātapaccayena paccayo. (3)

A non-mental phenomenon is a condition for both a mental and a non-mental phenomenon by way of object condition... by way of co-nascence condition... by way of strong dependence condition... by way of pre-nascence condition. (3)

140. Cetasiko ca acetasiko ca dhammā cetasikassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo… sahajātapaccayena paccayo… upanissayapaccayena paccayo. (1)

140. A mental phenomenon and a non-mental phenomenon are conditions for a mental phenomenon by way of object condition... by way of co-nascence condition... by way of strong dependence condition. (1)

Cetasiko ca acetasiko ca dhammā acetasikassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo… sahajātapaccayena paccayo… upanissayapaccayena paccayo… pacchājātapaccayena [T 4.0066] paccayo. (2)

A mental phenomenon and a non-mental phenomenon are conditions for a non-mental phenomenon by way of object condition... by way of co-nascence condition... by way of strong dependence condition... by way of post-nascence condition. (2)

Cetasiko ca acetasiko ca dhammā cetasikassa ca acetasikassa ca dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo… sahajātapaccayena paccayo… upanissayapaccayena paccayo. (3)

A mental phenomenon and a non-mental phenomenon are conditions for both a mental and a non-mental phenomenon by way of object condition... by way of co-nascence condition... by way of strong dependence condition. (3)

141. Nahetuyā nava, naārammaṇe nava (sabbattha nava), noavigate nava.

3. Paccayānulomapaccanīyaṃ

3. Conditions in the Direct-Negative Order

142. Hetupaccayā [M 3.0424] naārammaṇe tīṇi, naadhipatiyā tīṇi, naanantare tīṇi, nasamanantare [V 3.0522] tīṇi, naaññamaññe ekaṃ, naupanissaye tīṇi (sabbattha tīṇi), namagge tīṇi, nasampayutte ekaṃ, navippayutte tīṇi, nonatthiyā tīṇi, novigate tīṇi.

142. Cittasampayuttañca cittavippayuttañca dhammaṃ paccayā cittasampayutto dhammo uppajjati nahetupaccayā – cakkhuviññāṇasahagataṃ ekaṃ khandhañca cakkhāyatanañca paccayā dve khandhā, dve khandhe ca…pe… kāyaviññāṇasahagataṃ ekaṃ khandhañca kāyāyatanañca paccayā dve khandhā, dve khandhe ca…pe… ahetukaṃ cittasampayuttaṃ ekaṃ khandhañca vatthuñca paccayā dve khandhā, dve khandhe ca…pe… ahetukapaṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe… vicikicchāsahagate uddhaccasahagate khandhe ca vatthuñca paccayā vicikicchāsahagato uddhaccasahagato moho. (Evaṃ dve pañhā pavattipaṭisandhi kātabbā. Saṃkhittaṃ.)

A state associated with consciousness arises dependent on both a state associated with consciousness and a state dissociated from consciousness by way of non-root condition: dependent on one aggregate associated with eye-consciousness and the eye base, two aggregates arise; and on two aggregates… and so on; dependent on one aggregate associated with body-consciousness and the body base, two aggregates arise; and on two aggregates… and so on; dependent on one rootless aggregate associated with consciousness and the physical base, two aggregates arise; and on two aggregates… and so on; at the moment of rootless rebirth-linking… and so on… dependent on the aggregates associated with doubt and restlessness and the physical base, delusion accompanied by doubt and restlessness arises. (Thus, two questions should be treated for the course of existence and for rebirth-linking. Abbreviated.)

2. Paccayapaccanīyaṃ

2. The Negative

2. Saṅkhyāvāro

2. Enumeration Section

Suddhaṃ

Pure Section

159. Nahetuyā [M 3.0430] nava, naārammaṇe tīṇi, naadhipatiyā nava, naanantare tīṇi, nasamanantare tīṇi, naaññamaññe tīṇi, naupanissaye tīṇi, napurejāte nava[T 4.0073], napacchājāte nava[V 3.0531], naāsevane nava, nakamme cattāri, navipāke nava, naāhāre ekaṃ, naindriye ekaṃ, najhāne cattāri, namagge nava, nasampayutte tīṇi, navippayutte dve, nonatthiyā tīṇi, novigate tīṇi.

159. By non-root, nine; by non-object, three; by non-dominance, nine; by non-contiguity, three; by non-immediate contiguity, three; by non-mutuality, three; by non-decisive support, three; by non-prenascence, nine; by non-postnascence, nine; by non-repetition, nine; by non-kamma, four; by non-resultant, nine; by non-nutriment, one; by non-faculty, one; by non-jhāna, four; by non-path, nine; by non-association, three; by non-dissociation, two; by non-absence, three; by non-disappearance, three.

3. Paccayānulomapaccanīyaṃ

3. Positive-Negative

160. Hetupaccayā naārammaṇe tīṇi…pe… nakamme tīṇi…pe… navippayutte ekaṃ, nonatthiyā tīṇi, novigate tīṇi.

160. By root condition, not by object condition, three… and so on… not by kamma condition, three… and so on… not by dissociation condition, one; not by absence condition, three; not by disappearance condition, three.

4. Paccayapaccanīyānulomaṃ

4. Negative-Positive

161. Nahetupaccayā ārammaṇe tīṇi…pe… magge tīṇi…pe… avigate nava.

161. By non-root condition, by object condition, three… and so on… by path condition, three… and so on… by presence condition, nine.

4. Nissayavāro

4. Dependence Section

(Nissayavāro paccayavārasadiso.)

(The Dependence Section is similar to the Condition Section.)

5. Saṃsaṭṭhavāro

5. Concomitance Section

1-4. Paccayānulomādi

1–4. Positive, etc.

162. Cittasampayuttaṃ dhammaṃ saṃsaṭṭho cittasampayutto dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – cittasampayuttaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ saṃsaṭṭhā dve khandhā, dve khandhe…pe… paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe….

162. A state associated with consciousness arises, being concomitant with a state associated with consciousness, by way of root condition: two aggregates are concomitant with one aggregate associated with consciousness; two aggregates… and so on… at the moment of rebirth-linking… and so on.

Hetuyā ekaṃ, ārammaṇe ekaṃ, adhipatiyā ekaṃ (sabbattha ekaṃ), avigate ekaṃ.

By root, one; by object, one; by dominance, one (in all cases, one); by presence, one.

Nahetuyā [M 3.0431] ekaṃ, naadhipatiyā ekaṃ, napurejāte ekaṃ, napacchājāte ekaṃ, naāsevane ekaṃ, nakamme ekaṃ, navipāke ekaṃ, najhāne ekaṃ, namagge ekaṃ, navippayutte ekaṃ.

By non-root, one; by non-dominance, one; by non-prenascence, one; by non-postnascence, one; by non-repetition, one; by non-kamma, one; by non-resultant, one; by non-jhāna, one; by non-path, one; by non-dissociation, one.

6. Sampayuttavāro

6. Association Section

(Evaṃ [V 3.0532] itare dve gaṇanāpi sampayuttavāropi kātabbo.)

(Thus, the other two enumerations as well as the Association Section should also be done.)

7. Pañhāvāro

7. Question Section

1. Paccayānulomaṃ

1. Positive

1. Vibhaṅgavāro

1. Analysis Section

Hetupaccayo

Root Condition

163. Cittasampayutto [T 4.0074] dhammo cittasampayuttassa dhammassa hetupaccayena paccayo – cittasampayuttā hetū sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ hetupaccayena paccayo; paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe…. (1)

163. A state associated with consciousness is a condition for a state associated with consciousness by way of root condition: roots associated with consciousness are a condition for the associated aggregates by way of root condition; at the moment of rebirth-linking… and so on. (1)

Cittasampayutto dhammo cittavippayuttassa dhammassa hetupaccayena paccayo – cittasampayuttā hetū cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ hetupaccayena paccayo; paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe…. (2)

A state associated with consciousness is a condition for a state dissociated from consciousness by way of root condition: roots associated with consciousness are a condition for consciousness-originated material forms by way of root condition; at the moment of rebirth-linking… and so on. (2)

Cittasampayutto dhammo cittasampayuttassa ca cittavippayuttassa ca dhammassa hetupaccayena paccayo – cittasampayuttā hetū sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ hetupaccayena paccayo; paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe…. (3)

A state associated with consciousness is a condition for a state associated with consciousness and for a state dissociated from consciousness by way of root condition: roots associated with consciousness are a condition for the associated aggregates and for consciousness-originated material forms by way of root condition; at the moment of rebirth-linking… and so on. (3)

Ārammaṇapaccayo

Object Condition

164. Cittasampayutto dhammo cittasampayuttassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo – dānaṃ…pe… sīlaṃ…pe… uposathakammaṃ katvā taṃ paccavekkhati assādeti abhinandati, taṃ ārabbha rāgo uppajjati…pe… domanassaṃ uppajjati; pubbe suciṇṇāni…pe… jhānā vuṭṭhahitvā jhānaṃ…pe… ariyā maggā vuṭṭhahitvā maggaṃ paccavekkhanti, phalaṃ paccavekkhanti. Pahīne [V 3.0533] kilese…pe… vikkhambhite kilese paccavekkhanti. Pubbe samudāciṇṇe kilese jānanti. Cittasampayutte khandhe aniccato…pe… domanassaṃ uppajjati. Cetopariyañāṇena cittasampayuttasamaṅgissa cittaṃ jānanti. Ākāsānañcāyatanaṃ viññāṇañcāyatanassa…pe… ākiñcaññāyatanaṃ [M 3.0432] nevasaññānāsaññāyatanassa…pe… cittasampayuttā khandhā iddhividhañāṇassa, cetopariyañāṇassa, pubbenivāsānussatiñāṇassa[T 4.0075], yathākammūpagañāṇassa, anāgataṃsañāṇassa, āvajjanāya ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo. (1)

164. A state associated with consciousness is a condition for a state associated with consciousness by way of object condition: having given a gift… and so on, undertaken the moral precepts… and so on, performed the Uposatha observance, one reviews it, savors it, delights in it; taking that as object, lust arises… and so on… distress arises. Previously well-practiced deeds… and so on. Having emerged from jhāna, one reviews the jhāna… and so on. The noble ones, having emerged from the path, review the path, review the fruition. They review the abandoned defilements… and so on, the suppressed defilements. They know the defilements previously accumulated. Contemplating the aggregates associated with consciousness as impermanent… and so on, distress arises. With the knowledge of penetration of others’ minds, one knows the mind of one endowed with states associated with consciousness. The base of infinite space is a condition for the base of infinite consciousness… and so on… the base of nothingness for the base of neither-perception-nor-non-perception… and so on… aggregates associated with consciousness are a condition for the knowledge of psychic powers, the knowledge of penetration of others’ minds, the knowledge of recollection of past lives, the knowledge of the passing away and reappearance of beings according to their kamma, the knowledge of the future, and for adverting, by way of object condition. (1)

165. Cittavippayutto dhammo cittasampayuttassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo – ariyā nibbānaṃ paccavekkhanti. Nibbānaṃ gotrabhussa, vodānassa, maggassa, phalassa, āvajjanāya ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo; cakkhuṃ…pe… vatthuṃ cittavippayutte khandhe aniccato…pe… domanassaṃ uppajjati; dibbena cakkhunā rūpaṃ passati, dibbāya sotadhātuyā saddaṃ suṇāti. Rūpāyatanaṃ cakkhuviññāṇasahagatānaṃ khandhānaṃ…pe… phoṭṭhabbāyatanaṃ…pe… cittavippayuttā khandhā iddhividhañāṇassa, pubbenivāsānussatiñāṇassa, anāgataṃsañāṇassa, āvajjanāya ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo. (1)

165. A state dissociated from consciousness is a condition for a state associated with consciousness by way of object condition: the noble ones review Nibbāna. Nibbāna is a condition for change-of-lineage, for purification, for the path, for the fruition, and for adverting, by way of object condition. The eye… and so on… the physical base. Contemplating the aggregates dissociated from consciousness as impermanent… and so on… distress arises. With the divine eye, one sees forms; with the divine ear element, one hears sounds. The form base is a condition for the aggregates associated with eye-consciousness… and so on… the tangible base… and so on. The aggregates dissociated from consciousness are a condition for the knowledge of psychic powers, the knowledge of recollection of past lives, the knowledge of the future, and for adverting, by way of object condition. (1)

Adhipatipaccayo

Dominance Condition

166. Cittasampayutto dhammo cittasampayuttassa dhammassa adhipatipaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇādhipati, sahajātādhipati. Ārammaṇādhipati – dānaṃ…pe… sīlaṃ…pe… uposathakammaṃ katvā taṃ garuṃ katvā paccavekkhati assādeti abhinandati, taṃ garuṃ katvā rāgo uppajjati, diṭṭhi uppajjati. Pubbe…pe… jhānā…pe… ariyā maggā vuṭṭhahitvā maggaṃ garuṃ katvā paccavekkhanti, phalaṃ garuṃ katvā paccavekkhanti, cittasampayutte khandhe garuṃ katvā assādeti abhinandati, taṃ garuṃ katvā rāgo uppajjati, diṭṭhi uppajjati. Sahajātādhipati – cittasampayuttādhipati sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ adhipatipaccayena paccayo. (1)

166. A phenomenon concomitant with consciousness is a condition for a phenomenon concomitant with consciousness by way of dominance condition: dominance by way of object and dominance by way of conascence. Dominance by way of object: Having performed generosity... and so on, virtue... and so on, the Uposatha practice, one reviews it, regarding it as important, savors it, delights in it; regarding that as important, lust arises, wrong view arises. Previously... and so on... jhānas... and so on... having emerged from the noble path, the noble ones review the path, regarding it as important; they review the fruition, regarding it as important. One savors and delights in the aggregates concomitant with consciousness, regarding them as important; regarding that as important, lust arises, wrong view arises. Dominance by way of Conascence: The dominant phenomenon concomitant with consciousness is a condition for the concomitant aggregates by way of dominance condition. (1)

Cittasampayutto dhammo cittavippayuttassa [T 4.0076] dhammassa adhipatipaccayena paccayo. Sahajātādhipati – cittasampayuttādhipati cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ adhipatipaccayena paccayo. (2)

A phenomenon concomitant with consciousness is a condition for a phenomenon dissociated from consciousness by way of dominance condition. Dominance by way of Conascence: The dominant phenomenon concomitant with consciousness is a condition for consciousness-originated material phenomena by way of dominance condition. (2)

Cittasampayutto [V 3.0534] dhammo cittasampayuttassa ca cittavippayuttassa ca dhammassa adhipatipaccayena paccayo. Sahajātādhipati – cittasampayuttādhipati sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ adhipatipaccayena paccayo. (3)

A phenomenon concomitant with consciousness is a condition for a phenomenon concomitant with consciousness and a phenomenon dissociated from consciousness by way of dominance condition. Dominance by way of Conascence: The dominant phenomenon concomitant with consciousness is a condition for the concomitant aggregates and for consciousness-originated material phenomena by way of dominance condition. (3)

167. Cittavippayutto [M 3.0433] dhammo cittasampayuttassa dhammassa adhipatipaccayena paccayo. Ārammaṇādhipati – ariyā nibbānaṃ garuṃ katvā paccavekkhanti. Nibbānaṃ gotrabhussa, vodānassa, maggassa, phalassa, adhipatipaccayena paccayo; cakkhuṃ…pe… vatthuṃ cittavippayutte khandhe garuṃ katvā assādeti abhinandati, taṃ garuṃ katvā rāgo uppajjati, diṭṭhi uppajjati. (1)

167. A phenomenon dissociated from consciousness is a condition for a phenomenon concomitant with consciousness by way of dominance condition. Dominance by way of Object: The noble ones review Nibbāna, regarding it as important. Nibbāna is a condition by way of dominance condition for change-of-lineage, for purification, for the path, and for fruition. The eye... and so on... the physical base... One savors and delights in the aggregates dissociated from consciousness, regarding them as important; regarding that as important, lust arises, wrong view arises. (1)

Anantarapaccayādi

Immediately Preceding Condition, etc.

168. Cittasampayutto dhammo cittasampayuttassa dhammassa anantarapaccayena paccayo – purimā purimā cittasampayuttā khandhā…pe… phalasamāpattiyā anantarapaccayena paccayo… samanantarapaccayena paccayo… sahajātapaccayena paccayo… satta (paṭiccasadisā, pañhāghaṭanā natthi)… aññamaññapaccayena paccayo… cha (paṭiccasadisā)… nissayapaccayena paccayo… satta (paccayavārasadisā, pañhāghaṭanā natthi).

168. A phenomenon concomitant with consciousness is a condition for a phenomenon concomitant with consciousness by way of immediately preceding condition: the preceding, preceding aggregates concomitant with consciousness... and so on... for the attainment of fruition, it is a condition by way of immediately preceding condition... by way of contiguous condition... by way of conascence condition... seven (similar to Dependent Origination, there is no construction of questions)... by way of mutual condition... six (similar to Dependent Origination)... by way of support condition... seven (similar to the Condition Section, there is no construction of questions).

Upanissayapaccayo

Decisive Support Condition

169. Cittasampayutto dhammo cittasampayuttassa dhammassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇūpanissayo, anantarūpanissayo, pakatūpanissayo [T 4.0077] …pe…. Pakatūpanissayo – saddhaṃ upanissāya dānaṃ deti…pe… mānaṃ jappeti, diṭṭhiṃ gaṇhāti; sīlaṃ…pe… patthanaṃ kāyikaṃ sukhaṃ… kāyikaṃ dukkhaṃ upanissāya dānaṃ deti…pe… pāṇaṃ hanati…pe… saṅghaṃ bhindati; saddhā…pe… kāyikaṃ dukkhaṃ saddhāya…pe… maggassa, phalasamāpattiyā upanissayapaccayena paccayo. (1)

169. A phenomenon concomitant with consciousness is a condition for a phenomenon concomitant with consciousness by way of decisive support condition: object decisive support, immediate decisive support, and natural decisive support... and so on. Natural decisive support: Relying on faith, one gives a gift... utters conceit, grasps a view; relying on virtue... aspiration... bodily pleasure... bodily pain, one gives a gift... kills a living being... splits the Saṅgha. Faith... bodily pain is a condition for faith... for the path, for the attainment of fruition, by way of decisive support condition. (1)

Cittavippayutto dhammo cittasampayuttassa dhammassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇūpanissayo, pakatūpanissayo…pe…. Pakatūpanissayo – utuṃ… bhojanaṃ… senāsanaṃ upanissāya [V 3.0535] dānaṃ deti…pe… saṅghaṃ bhindati; utu… bhojanaṃ… senāsanaṃ saddhāya…pe… phalasamāpattiyā upanissayapaccayena paccayo. (1)

A phenomenon dissociated from consciousness is a condition for a phenomenon concomitant with consciousness by way of decisive support condition: object decisive support and natural decisive support... and so on. Natural decisive support: Relying on climate... food... lodging, one gives a gift... splits the Saṅgha. Climate... food... lodging is a condition for faith... for the attainment of fruition, by way of decisive support condition. (1)

Purejātapaccayo

Prenascence Condition

170. Cittavippayutto dhammo cittasampayuttassa dhammassa purejātapaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇapurejātaṃ, vatthupurejātaṃ. Ārammaṇapurejātaṃ – cakkhuṃ…pe… vatthuṃ aniccato…pe… domanassaṃ uppajjati; dibbena cakkhunā [M 3.0434] rūpaṃ passati, dibbāya sotadhātuyā saddaṃ suṇāti. Rūpāyatanaṃ cakkhuviññāṇasahagatānaṃ khandhānaṃ…pe… phoṭṭhabbāyatanaṃ…pe…. Vatthupurejātaṃ – cakkhāyatanaṃ cakkhuviññāṇasahagatānaṃ khandhānaṃ…pe… kāyāyatanaṃ…pe… vatthu cittasampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ purejātapaccayena paccayo. (1)

170. A phenomenon dissociated from consciousness is a condition for a phenomenon concomitant with consciousness by way of prenascence condition: object prenascence and base prenascence. Object prenascence: The eye... and so on... the physical base, contemplating as impermanent... and so on... grief arises; with the divine eye one sees a form, with the divine ear-element one hears a sound. The form base is a condition for the aggregates concomitant with eye-consciousness... and so on... the tangible object base... and so on. Base prenascence: The eye base is a condition for the aggregates concomitant with eye-consciousness... and so on... the body base... and so on... the physical base is a condition for the aggregates concomitant with consciousness by way of prenascence condition. (1)

Pacchājātāsevanapaccayā

Postnascence and Repetition Conditions

171. Cittasampayutto dhammo cittavippayuttassa dhammassa pacchājātapaccayena paccayo (saṃkhittaṃ) ekaṃ, āsevanapaccayena paccayo [T 4.0078]… ekaṃ.

171. A phenomenon concomitant with consciousness is a condition for a phenomenon dissociated from consciousness by way of postnascence condition (in brief), in one way; by way of repetition condition, in one way.

Kammapaccayo

Kamma Condition

172. Cittasampayutto dhammo cittasampayuttassa dhammassa kammapaccayena paccayo – sahajātā, nānākkhaṇikā. Sahajātā – cittasampayuttā cetanā sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ kammapaccayena paccayo; paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe…. Nānākkhaṇikā – cittasampayuttā cetanā vipākānaṃ khandhānaṃ kammapaccayena paccayo. (1)

172. A phenomenon concomitant with consciousness is a condition for a phenomenon concomitant with consciousness by way of kamma condition: conascent and different-moment. Conascent: Volition concomitant with consciousness is a condition for the concomitant aggregates by way of kamma condition; at the moment of rebirth-linking... and so on. Different-moment: Volition concomitant with consciousness is a condition for the resultant aggregates by way of kamma condition. (1)

Cittasampayutto dhammo cittavippayuttassa dhammassa kammapaccayena paccayo – sahajātā, nānākkhaṇikā. Sahajātā – cittasampayuttā cetanā cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ kammapaccayena paccayo; paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe…. Nānākkhaṇikā – cittasampayuttā cetanā kaṭattārūpānaṃ kammapaccayena paccayo. (2)

A phenomenon concomitant with consciousness is a condition for a phenomenon dissociated from consciousness by way of kamma condition: conascent and different-moment. Conascent: Volition concomitant with consciousness is a condition for consciousness-originated material phenomena by way of kamma condition; at the moment of rebirth-linking... and so on. Different-moment: Volition concomitant with consciousness is a condition for kamma-produced material phenomena by way of kamma condition. (2)

Cittasampayutto [V 3.0536] dhammo cittasampayuttassa ca cittavippayuttassa ca dhammassa kammapaccayena paccayo – sahajātā, nānākkhaṇikā. Sahajātā – cittasampayuttā cetanā sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ kammapaccayena paccayo; paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe…. Nānākkhaṇikā – cittasampayuttā cetanā vipākānaṃ khandhānaṃ kaṭattā ca rūpānaṃ kammapaccayena paccayo. (3)

A phenomenon associated with consciousness is a condition for both a phenomenon associated with consciousness and a phenomenon dissociated from consciousness by way of kamma condition—co-nascent, or occurring at different moments. Co-nascent: volition associated with consciousness is a condition for the associated aggregates and for consciousness-originated material phenomena by way of kamma condition; at the moment of rebirth-linking... Occurring at different moments: volition associated with consciousness is a condition for the resultant aggregates and for kamma-produced material phenomena by way of kamma condition. (3)

Vipākāhārapaccayā

Result and Nutriment Conditions

173. Cittasampayutto dhammo cittasampayuttassa dhammassa vipākapaccayena paccayo… tīṇi.

173. A phenomenon associated with consciousness is a condition for a phenomenon associated with consciousness by way of result condition... three.

Cittasampayutto dhammo cittasampayuttassa dhammassa āhārapaccayena paccayo… tīṇi.

A phenomenon associated with consciousness is a condition for a phenomenon associated with consciousness by way of nutriment condition... three.

Cittavippayutto [M 3.0435] dhammo cittavippayuttassa dhammassa āhārapaccayena paccayo – kabaḷīkāro āhāro imassa [T 4.0079] kāyassa āhārapaccayena paccayo. (1)

A phenomenon dissociated from consciousness is a condition for a phenomenon dissociated from consciousness by way of nutriment condition. Physical nutriment is a condition for this body by way of nutriment condition. (1)

Indriyapaccayādi

The Faculty Condition, etc.

174. Cittasampayutto dhammo cittasampayuttassa dhammassa indriyapaccayena paccayo… tīṇi.

174. A phenomenon associated with consciousness is a condition for a phenomenon associated with consciousness by way of the faculty condition… three.

Cittavippayutto dhammo cittavippayuttassa dhammassa indriyapaccayena paccayo – rūpajīvitindriyaṃ kaṭattārūpānaṃ indriyapaccayena paccayo. (1)

A phenomenon dissociated from consciousness is a condition for a phenomenon dissociated from consciousness by way of the faculty condition: the material life faculty is a condition for kamma-produced materiality by way of the faculty condition. (1)

Cittavippayutto dhammo cittasampayuttassa dhammassa indriyapaccayena paccayo – cakkhundriyaṃ cakkhuviññāṇasahagatānaṃ khandhānaṃ indriyapaccayena paccayo…pe… kāyindriyaṃ…pe…. (2)

A phenomenon dissociated from consciousness is a condition for a phenomenon associated with consciousness by way of the faculty condition: the eye faculty is a condition for the aggregates associated with eye-consciousness by way of the faculty condition; …the body faculty…and so on. (2)

Cittasampayutto ca cittavippayutto ca dhammā cittasampayuttassa dhammassa indriyapaccayena paccayo – cakkhundriyañca upekkhindriyañca cakkhuviññāṇasahagatānaṃ khandhānaṃ indriyapaccayena paccayo [V 3.0537]…pe… kāyindriyañca sukhindriyañca…pe… kāyindriyañca dukkhindriyañca kāyaviññāṇasahagatānaṃ khandhānaṃ indriyapaccayena paccayo. (1)

A phenomenon associated with consciousness and a phenomenon dissociated from consciousness are conditions for a phenomenon associated with consciousness by way of the faculty condition: the eye faculty and the equanimity faculty are conditions for the aggregates associated with eye-consciousness by way of the faculty condition; …the body faculty and the pleasure faculty…the body faculty and the pain faculty are conditions for the aggregates associated with body-consciousness by way of the faculty condition. (1)

Jhānapaccayena paccayo… tīṇi… maggapaccayena paccayo… tīṇi… sampayuttapaccayena paccayo… ekaṃ.

By way of jhāna condition… three; by way of path condition… three; by way of associated condition… one.

Vippayuttapaccayo

The Dissociation Condition

175. Cittasampayutto dhammo cittavippayuttassa dhammassa vippayuttapaccayena paccayo – sahajātaṃ, pacchājātaṃ (saṃkhittaṃ). (1)

175. A phenomenon associated with consciousness is a condition for a phenomenon dissociated from consciousness by way of the dissociation condition: co-nascence, post-nascence (abbreviated). (1)

Cittavippayutto dhammo cittasampayuttassa dhammassa vippayuttapaccayena paccayo – sahajātaṃ, purejātaṃ. Sahajātaṃ – paṭisandhikkhaṇe vatthu cittasampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ vippayuttapaccayena paccayo. Purejātaṃ – cakkhāyatanaṃ cakkhuviññāṇasahagatānaṃ khandhānaṃ vippayuttapaccayena paccayo…pe… kāyāyatanaṃ [T 4.0080] …pe… vatthu cittasampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ vippayuttapaccayena paccayo. (1)

A phenomenon dissociated from consciousness is a condition for a phenomenon associated with consciousness by way of the dissociation condition: co-nascence, pre-nascence. Co-nascence: at the moment of rebirth-linking, the physical base is a condition for the aggregates associated with consciousness by way of the dissociation condition. Pre-nascence: the eye-base is a condition for the aggregates associated with eye-consciousness by way of the dissociation condition; …the body-base…the physical base is a condition for the aggregates associated with consciousness by way of the dissociation condition. (1)

Atthipaccayo

The Presence Condition

176. Cittasampayutto [M 3.0436] dhammo cittasampayuttassa dhammassa atthipaccayena paccayo… ekaṃ (paṭiccasadisaṃ). (1)

176. A phenomenon associated with consciousness is a condition for a phenomenon associated with consciousness by way of the presence condition… one (similar to dependence). (1)

Cittasampayutto dhammo cittavippayuttassa dhammassa atthipaccayena paccayo – sahajātaṃ, pacchājātaṃ (saṃkhittaṃ). (2)

A phenomenon associated with consciousness is a condition for a phenomenon dissociated from consciousness by way of the presence condition: co-nascence, post-nascence (abbreviated). (2)

Cittasampayutto dhammo cittasampayuttassa ca cittavippayuttassa ca dhammassa atthipaccayena paccayo (paṭiccasadisaṃ). (3)

A phenomenon associated with consciousness is a condition for both a phenomenon associated with consciousness and a phenomenon dissociated from consciousness by way of the presence condition (similar to dependence). (3)

177. Cittavippayutto [V 3.0538] dhammo cittavippayuttassa dhammassa atthipaccayena paccayo – sahajātaṃ, āhāraṃ, indriyaṃ (saṃkhittaṃ). (1)

177. A phenomenon dissociated from consciousness is a condition for a phenomenon dissociated from consciousness by way of the presence condition: co-nascence, nutriment, faculty (abbreviated). (1)

Cittavippayutto dhammo cittasampayuttassa dhammassa atthipaccayena paccayo – sahajātaṃ, purejātaṃ. Sahajātaṃ – paṭisandhikkhaṇe vatthu cittasampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo. Purejātaṃ – cakkhuṃ…pe… vatthuṃ aniccato…pe… (purejātasadisaṃ). (2)

A phenomenon dissociated from consciousness is a condition for a phenomenon associated with consciousness by way of the presence condition: co-nascence, pre-nascence. Co-nascence: at the moment of rebirth-linking, the physical base is a condition for the aggregates associated with consciousness by way of the presence condition. Pre-nascence: the eye…the physical base as impermanent…and so on (similar to pre-nascence). (2)

178. Cittasampayutto ca cittavippayutto ca dhammā cittasampayuttassa dhammassa atthipaccayena paccayo – sahajātaṃ, purejātaṃ. Sahajāto – cakkhuviññāṇasahagato eko khandho ca cakkhāyatanañca dvinnaṃ khandhānaṃ…pe… kāyaviññāṇasahagato eko khandho ca kāyāyatanañca dvinnaṃ khandhānaṃ…pe… cittasampayutto eko khandho ca vatthu ca dvinnaṃ khandhānaṃ…pe… dve khandhā ca…pe… paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe…. (1)

178. A phenomenon associated with consciousness and a phenomenon dissociated from consciousness are conditions for a phenomenon associated with consciousness by way of the presence condition: co-nascence, pre-nascence. Co-nascence: one aggregate associated with eye-consciousness and the eye-base are conditions for two aggregates; …one aggregate associated with body-consciousness and the body-base are conditions for two aggregates; …one aggregate associated with consciousness and the physical base are conditions for two aggregates; …two aggregates; …at the moment of rebirth-linking; …and so on. (1)

Cittasampayutto ca cittavippayutto ca dhammā cittavippayuttassa dhammassa atthipaccayena paccayo – sahajātaṃ, pacchājātaṃ, āhāraṃ, indriyaṃ. Sahajātā – cittasampayuttā khandhā ca mahābhūtā ca cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ atthipaccayena [T 4.0081] paccayo; paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe…. Pacchājātā – cittasampayuttakā khandhā ca kabaḷīkāro āhāro ca imassa kāyassa atthipaccayena paccayo. Pacchājātā – cittasampayuttakā khandhā ca rūpajīvitindriyañca kaṭattārūpānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo. (2)

A phenomenon associated with consciousness and a phenomenon dissociated from consciousness are conditions for a phenomenon dissociated from consciousness by way of the presence condition: co-nascence, post-nascence, nutriment, and faculty. Co-nascence: the aggregates associated with consciousness and the great elements are conditions for consciousness-originated materiality by way of the presence condition; at the moment of rebirth-linking, etc. Post-nascence: the aggregates associated with consciousness and physical nutriment are conditions for this body by way of the presence condition. Post-nascence: the aggregates associated with consciousness and the material life faculty are conditions for kamma-produced materiality by way of the presence condition. (2)
