1. The Section on Differentiation

Hetupaccayo

Root Condition

186. Cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ [V 3.0542] dhammaṃ paṭicca cittasamuṭṭhāno dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca dve khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ, dve khandhe…pe… paṭisandhikkhaṇe cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca dve khandhā, dve khandhe…pe… ekaṃ mahābhūtaṃ…pe… mahābhūte paṭicca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ upādārūpaṃ. (1)

186. A consciousness-originated phenomenon arises dependent on a consciousness-originated phenomenon by way of root condition—dependent on one consciousness-originated aggregate, two aggregates and consciousness-originated materiality; dependent on two aggregates…[etc.]… at the moment of rebirth-linking, dependent on one consciousness-originated aggregate, two aggregates; dependent on two aggregates…[etc.]… dependent on one great primary element…[etc.]… dependent on the great primary elements, consciousness-originated materiality and derived materiality. (1)

Cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca nocittasamuṭṭhāno dhammo [T 4.0084] uppajjati hetupaccayā – cittasamuṭṭhāne khandhe paṭicca cittaṃ; paṭisandhikkhaṇe cittasamuṭṭhāne khandhe paṭicca cittaṃ kaṭattā ca rūpaṃ. (2)

A non-consciousness-originated phenomenon arises dependent on a consciousness-originated phenomenon by way of root condition: dependent on the consciousness-originated aggregates, consciousness; at the moment of rebirth-linking, dependent on the consciousness-originated aggregates, consciousness and kamma-originated materiality. (2)

Cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca cittasamuṭṭhāno ca nocittasamuṭṭhāno ca dhammā uppajjanti hetupaccayā – cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca dve khandhā cittañca cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ, dve khandhe…pe… paṭisandhikkhaṇe cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca dve khandhā cittañca kaṭattā ca rūpaṃ, dve khandhe…pe…. (3)

Consciousness-originated and non-consciousness-originated phenomena arise dependent on a consciousness-originated phenomenon by way of root condition: dependent on one consciousness-originated aggregate, two aggregates, consciousness, and consciousness-originated materiality; dependent on two aggregates…[etc.]… at the moment of rebirth-linking, dependent on one consciousness-originated aggregate, two aggregates, consciousness, and kamma-originated materiality; dependent on two aggregates…[etc.]. (3)

187. Nocittasamuṭṭhānaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca nocittasamuṭṭhāno dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – paṭisandhikkhaṇe cittaṃ paṭicca kaṭattārūpaṃ; cittaṃ paṭicca vatthu, vatthuṃ paṭicca cittaṃ, ekaṃ mahābhūtaṃ…pe… mahābhūte paṭicca kaṭattārūpaṃ upādārūpaṃ. (1)

187. A non-consciousness-originated phenomenon arises dependent on a non-consciousness-originated phenomenon by way of root condition—at the moment of rebirth-linking, dependent on consciousness, kamma-originated materiality; dependent on consciousness, the physical base; dependent on the physical base, consciousness; dependent on one great primary element…[etc.]… dependent on the great primary elements, kamma-originated materiality and derived materiality. (1)

Nocittasamuṭṭhānaṃ [V 3.0543] dhammaṃ paṭicca cittasamuṭṭhāno dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – cittaṃ paṭicca sampayuttakā khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ; paṭisandhikkhaṇe cittaṃ paṭicca sampayuttakā khandhā, paṭisandhikkhaṇe vatthuṃ paṭicca cittasamuṭṭhānā khandhā. (2)

A consciousness-originated phenomenon arises dependent on a non-consciousness-originated phenomenon by way of root condition: dependent on consciousness, the associated aggregates and consciousness-originated materiality; at the moment of rebirth-linking, dependent on consciousness, the associated aggregates; at the moment of rebirth-linking, dependent on the physical base, the consciousness-originated aggregates. (2)

Nocittasamuṭṭhānaṃ [M 3.0440] dhammaṃ paṭicca cittasamuṭṭhāno ca nocittasamuṭṭhāno ca dhammā uppajjanti hetupaccayā – paṭisandhikkhaṇe cittaṃ paṭicca sampayuttakā khandhā kaṭattā ca rūpaṃ; paṭisandhikkhaṇe vatthuṃ paṭicca cittaṃ sampayuttakā ca khandhā. (3)

Consciousness-originated and non-consciousness-originated phenomena arise dependent on a non-consciousness-originated phenomenon by way of root condition—at the moment of rebirth-linking, dependent on consciousness, the associated aggregates and kamma-originated materiality; at the moment of rebirth-linking, dependent on the physical base, consciousness and the associated aggregates. (3)

188. Cittasamuṭṭhānañca nocittasamuṭṭhānañca dhammaṃ paṭicca cittasamuṭṭhāno dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ ekaṃ khandhañca cittañca [T 4.0085] paṭicca dve khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ, dve khandhe ca…pe… paṭisandhikkhaṇe cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ ekaṃ khandhañca cittañca paṭicca dve khandhā, dve khandhe ca…pe… paṭisandhikkhaṇe cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ ekaṃ khandhañca vatthuñca paṭicca dve khandhā, dve khandhe ca…pe…. (1)

188. A consciousness-originated phenomenon arises dependent on a consciousness-originated phenomenon and a non-consciousness-originated phenomenon by way of root condition: dependent on one consciousness-originated aggregate and consciousness, two aggregates and consciousness-originated materiality; dependent on two aggregates and…[etc.]… at the moment of rebirth-linking, dependent on one consciousness-originated aggregate and consciousness, two aggregates; dependent on two aggregates and…[etc.]… at the moment of rebirth-linking, dependent on one consciousness-originated aggregate and the physical base, two aggregates; dependent on two aggregates and…[etc.]. (1)

Cittasamuṭṭhānañca nocittasamuṭṭhānañca dhammaṃ paṭicca nocittasamuṭṭhāno dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – paṭisandhikkhaṇe cittasamuṭṭhāne khandhe ca cittañca paṭicca kaṭattārūpaṃ; paṭisandhikkhaṇe cittasamuṭṭhāne khandhe ca mahābhūte ca paṭicca kaṭattārūpaṃ, paṭisandhikkhaṇe cittasamuṭṭhāne khandhe ca vatthuñca paṭicca cittaṃ. (2)

A non-consciousness-originated phenomenon arises dependent on a consciousness-originated phenomenon and a non-consciousness-originated phenomenon by way of root condition: at the moment of rebirth-linking, dependent on the consciousness-originated aggregates and consciousness, kamma-originated materiality; at the moment of rebirth-linking, dependent on the consciousness-originated aggregates and the great primary elements, kamma-originated materiality; at the moment of rebirth-linking, dependent on the consciousness-originated aggregates and the physical base, consciousness. (2)

Cittasamuṭṭhānañca nocittasamuṭṭhānañca dhammaṃ paṭicca cittasamuṭṭhāno ca nocittasamuṭṭhāno ca dhammā uppajjanti hetupaccayā – paṭisandhikkhaṇe cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ ekaṃ khandhañca cittañca paṭicca dve khandhā kaṭattā ca rūpaṃ, dve khandhe ca…pe… paṭisandhikkhaṇe cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ ekaṃ khandhañca vatthuñca paṭicca dve khandhā cittañca, dve khandhe ca…pe…. (3)

Consciousness-originated and non-consciousness-originated phenomena arise dependent on a consciousness-originated phenomenon and a non-consciousness-originated phenomenon by way of root condition: at the moment of rebirth-linking, dependent on one consciousness-originated aggregate and consciousness, two aggregates and kamma-originated materiality; dependent on two aggregates and…[etc.]… at the moment of rebirth-linking, dependent on one consciousness-originated aggregate and the physical base, two aggregates and consciousness; dependent on two aggregates and…[etc.]. (3)

Ārammaṇapaccayo

Object Condition

189. Cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca cittasamuṭṭhāno dhammo uppajjati ārammaṇapaccayā – cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca dve khandhā, dve khandhe…pe… paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe…. (1)

189. A consciousness-originated phenomenon arises dependent on a consciousness-originated phenomenon by way of object condition: dependent on one consciousness-originated aggregate, two aggregates; dependent on two aggregates…[etc.]… at the moment of rebirth-linking…[etc.]. (1)

Cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ [V 3.0544] dhammaṃ paṭicca nocittasamuṭṭhāno dhammo uppajjati ārammaṇapaccayā – cittasamuṭṭhāne khandhe paṭicca cittaṃ; paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe…. (2)

A non-consciousness-originated phenomenon arises dependent on a consciousness-originated phenomenon by way of object condition: dependent on the consciousness-originated aggregates, consciousness; at the moment of rebirth-linking…[etc.]. (2)

Cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca cittasamuṭṭhāno ca nocittasamuṭṭhāno ca dhammā uppajjanti ārammaṇapaccayā – cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca dve khandhā cittañca[T 4.0086], dve khandhe…pe… paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe…. (3)

Consciousness-originated and non-consciousness-originated phenomena arise dependent on a consciousness-originated phenomenon by way of object condition: dependent on one consciousness-originated aggregate, two aggregates and consciousness; dependent on two aggregates…[etc.]… at the moment of rebirth-linking…[etc.]. (3)

190. Nocittasamuṭṭhānaṃ [M 3.0441] dhammaṃ paṭicca nocittasamuṭṭhāno dhammo uppajjati ārammaṇapaccayā – paṭisandhikkhaṇe vatthuṃ paṭicca cittaṃ. (1)

190. A non-consciousness-originated phenomenon arises dependent on a non-consciousness-originated phenomenon by way of object condition: at the moment of rebirth-linking, dependent on the physical base, consciousness. (1)

Nocittasamuṭṭhānaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca cittasamuṭṭhāno dhammo uppajjati ārammaṇapaccayā – cittaṃ paṭicca sampayuttakā khandhā; paṭisandhikkhaṇe cittaṃ paṭicca sampayuttakā khandhā; paṭisandhikkhaṇe vatthuṃ paṭicca cittasamuṭṭhānā khandhā. (2)

A consciousness-originated phenomenon arises dependent on a non-consciousness-originated phenomenon by way of object condition: dependent on consciousness, the associated aggregates; at the moment of rebirth-linking, dependent on consciousness, the associated aggregates; at the moment of rebirth-linking, dependent on the physical base, the consciousness-originated aggregates. (2)

Nocittasamuṭṭhānaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca cittasamuṭṭhāno ca nocittasamuṭṭhāno ca dhammā uppajjanti ārammaṇapaccayā – paṭisandhikkhaṇe vatthuṃ paṭicca cittaṃ sampayuttakā ca khandhā. (3)

Consciousness-originated and non-consciousness-originated phenomena arise dependent on a non-consciousness-originated phenomenon by way of object condition: at the moment of rebirth-linking, dependent on the physical base, consciousness and the associated aggregates. (3)

191. Cittasamuṭṭhānañca nocittasamuṭṭhānañca dhammaṃ paṭicca cittasamuṭṭhāno dhammo uppajjati ārammaṇapaccayā – cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ ekaṃ khandhañca cittañca paṭicca dve khandhā, dve khandhe…pe… paṭisandhikkhaṇe cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ ekaṃ khandhañca cittañca paṭicca dve khandhā, dve khandhe…pe… paṭisandhikkhaṇe cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ ekaṃ khandhañca vatthuñca paṭicca dve khandhā, dve khandhe…pe…. (1)

191. Dependent on a mind-originated phenomenon and a non-mind-originated phenomenon, a mind-originated phenomenon arises by way of Object Condition: dependent on one mind-originated aggregate and consciousness, two aggregates arise; dependent on two aggregates… and so on. At the moment of rebirth-linking, dependent on one mind-originated aggregate and consciousness, two aggregates arise; dependent on two aggregates… and so on. At the moment of rebirth-linking, dependent on one mind-originated aggregate and the physical base, two aggregates arise; dependent on two aggregates… and so on. (1)

Dependent on a mind-originated phenomenon and a non-mind-originated phenomenon, a non-mind-originated phenomenon arises by way of Object Condition: at the moment of rebirth-linking, dependent on the mind-originated aggregates and the physical base, consciousness arises. (2)

Cittasamuṭṭhānañca nocittasamuṭṭhānañca dhammaṃ paṭicca cittasamuṭṭhāno ca nocittasamuṭṭhāno ca [V 3.0545] dhammā uppajjanti ārammaṇapaccayā – paṭisandhikkhaṇe cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ ekaṃ khandhañca vatthuñca [T 4.0087] paṭicca dve khandhā cittañca, dve khandhe…pe…. (3)

Dependent on a mind-originated phenomenon and a non-mind-originated phenomenon, a mind-originated phenomenon and a non-mind-originated phenomenon arise by way of Object Condition: At the moment of rebirth-linking, dependent on one mind-originated aggregate and the physical base, two aggregates and consciousness arise; dependent on two aggregates… and so on. (3)

Non-Root Condition

193. Cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ [M 3.0442] dhammaṃ paṭicca cittasamuṭṭhāno dhammo uppajjati nahetupaccayā – ahetukaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca dve khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ, dve khandhe…pe… ahetukapaṭisandhikkhaṇe cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca dve khandhā, dve khandhe…pe… cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ ekaṃ mahābhūtaṃ…pe… mahābhūte paṭicca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ upādārūpaṃ, vicikicchāsahagate uddhaccasahagate khandhe paṭicca vicikicchāsahagato uddhaccasahagato moho. (1)

193. Dependent on a mind-originated phenomenon, a mind-originated phenomenon arises by way of Non-Root Condition: dependent on one rootless mind-originated aggregate, two aggregates and mind-originated materiality arise; dependent on two aggregates… and so on. At the moment of rootless rebirth-linking, dependent on one mind-originated aggregate, two aggregates arise; dependent on two aggregates… and so on. Dependent on one mind-originated great primary element… and so on… dependent on the great primary elements, mind-originated materiality and derived materiality arise; dependent on the aggregates accompanied by doubt and restlessness, the delusion accompanied by doubt and restlessness arises. (1)

Cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ [V 3.0546] dhammaṃ paṭicca nocittasamuṭṭhāno dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – ahetuke cittasamuṭṭhāne khandhe paṭicca cittaṃ; ahetukapaṭisandhikkhaṇe cittasamuṭṭhāne khandhe paṭicca cittaṃ kaṭattā ca rūpaṃ. (2)

Dependent on a mind-originated phenomenon, a non-mind-originated phenomenon arises by way of Non-Root Condition: dependent on the rootless mind-originated aggregates, consciousness arises; at the moment of rootless rebirth-linking, dependent on the mind-originated aggregates, consciousness and kamma-produced materiality arise. (2)

Cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca cittasamuṭṭhāno ca nocittasamuṭṭhāno ca dhammā uppajjanti nahetupaccayā – ahetukaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca dve khandhā cittañca cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ, dve khandhe…pe… ahetukapaṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe…. (3)

Dependent on a mind-originated phenomenon, a mind-originated phenomenon and a non-mind-originated phenomenon arise by way of Non-Root Condition: dependent on one rootless mind-originated aggregate, two aggregates, consciousness, and mind-originated materiality arise; dependent on two aggregates… and so on… at the moment of rootless rebirth-linking… and so on. (3)

194. Nocittasamuṭṭhānaṃ [T 4.0088] dhammaṃ paṭicca nocittasamuṭṭhāno dhammo uppajjati nahetupaccayā – ahetukapaṭisandhikkhaṇe cittaṃ paṭicca kaṭattārūpaṃ, cittaṃ paṭicca vatthu, vatthuṃ paṭicca cittaṃ, ekaṃ mahābhūtaṃ…pe… (yāva asaññasattā kātabbā). (1)

194. Dependent on a non-mind-originated phenomenon, a non-mind-originated phenomenon arises by way of Non-Root Condition: at the moment of rootless rebirth-linking, dependent on consciousness, kamma-produced materiality arises; dependent on consciousness, the physical base arises; dependent on the physical base, consciousness arises; dependent on one great primary element… and so on… (to be elaborated as far as the non-percipient beings). (1)

Nocittasamuṭṭhānaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca cittasamuṭṭhāno dhammo uppajjati nahetupaccayā – ahetukaṃ cittaṃ paṭicca sampayuttakā khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ; ahetukapaṭisandhikkhaṇe cittaṃ…pe… ahetukapaṭisandhikkhaṇe vatthuṃ paṭicca cittasamuṭṭhānā khandhā, vicikicchāsahagate uddhaccasahagate khandhe paṭicca vicikicchāsahagato uddhaccasahagato moho. (2)

Dependent on a non-mind-originated phenomenon, a mind-originated phenomenon arises by way of Non-Root Condition: dependent on rootless consciousness, associated aggregates and mind-originated materiality arise; at the moment of rootless rebirth-linking, dependent on consciousness… and so on… at the moment of rootless rebirth-linking, dependent on the physical base, mind-originated aggregates arise; dependent on the aggregates accompanied by doubt and restlessness, delusion accompanied by doubt and restlessness arises. (2)

Nocittasamuṭṭhānaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca cittasamuṭṭhāno ca nocittasamuṭṭhāno ca dhammā uppajjanti nahetupaccayā – ahetukapaṭisandhikkhaṇe cittaṃ paṭicca sampayuttakā khandhā kaṭattā ca rūpaṃ; ahetukapaṭisandhikkhaṇe vatthuṃ paṭicca cittaṃ sampayuttakā khandhā ca. (3)

Dependent on a non-mind-originated phenomenon, mind-originated phenomena and non-mind-originated phenomena arise by way of Non-Root Condition: at the moment of rootless rebirth-linking, dependent on consciousness, associated aggregates and kamma-produced materiality arise; at the moment of rootless rebirth-linking, dependent on the physical base, consciousness and associated aggregates arise. (3)

195. Cittasamuṭṭhānañca [M 3.0443] nocittasamuṭṭhānañca dhammaṃ paṭicca cittasamuṭṭhāno dhammo uppajjati nahetupaccayā – ahetukaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ ekaṃ khandhañca cittañca paṭicca dve khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ, dve khandhe…pe… ahetukapaṭisandhikkhaṇe cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ ekaṃ khandhañca cittañca paṭicca dve khandhā, dve khandhe…pe… ahetukapaṭisandhikkhaṇe cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ ekaṃ khandhañca vatthuñca paṭicca dve khandhā, dve khandhe…pe… vicikicchāsahagate uddhaccasahagate khandhe ca cittañca paṭicca vicikicchāsahagato uddhaccasahagato moho. (1)

195. Dependent on a mind-originated phenomenon and a non-mind-originated phenomenon, a mind-originated phenomenon arises by way of Non-Root Condition: dependent on one rootless mind-originated aggregate and consciousness, two aggregates and mind-originated materiality arise; dependent on two aggregates… and so on… at the moment of rootless rebirth-linking, dependent on one mind-originated aggregate and consciousness, two aggregates arise; dependent on two aggregates… and so on… at the moment of rootless rebirth-linking, dependent on one mind-originated aggregate and the physical base, two aggregates arise; dependent on two aggregates… and so on… dependent on aggregates accompanied by doubt and restlessness and on consciousness, delusion accompanied by doubt and restlessness arises. (2)

Dependent on a mind-originated phenomenon and a non-mind-originated phenomenon, a non-mind-originated phenomenon arises by way of Non-Root Condition: at the moment of rootless rebirth-linking, dependent on the mind-originated aggregates and consciousness, kamma-produced materiality arises; at the moment of rootless rebirth-linking, dependent on the mind-originated aggregates and the great primary elements, kamma-produced materiality arises; at the moment of rootless rebirth-linking, dependent on the mind-originated aggregates and the physical base, consciousness arises. (2)

Cittasamuṭṭhānañca nocittasamuṭṭhānañca dhammaṃ paṭicca cittasamuṭṭhāno ca nocittasamuṭṭhāno ca dhammā uppajjanti nahetupaccayā – ahetukapaṭisandhikkhaṇe cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ ekaṃ khandhañca cittañca paṭicca dve khandhā kaṭattā ca rūpaṃ, dve khandhe…pe… ahetukapaṭisandhikkhaṇe cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ ekaṃ khandhañca vatthuñca paṭicca dve khandhā cittañca, dve khandhe…pe…. (3)

Dependent on a mind-originated phenomenon and a non-mind-originated phenomenon, mind-originated phenomena and non-mind-originated phenomena arise by way of non-root condition: at the moment of rootless rebirth-linking, dependent on one mind-originated aggregate and consciousness, two aggregates and kamma-produced materiality arise; dependent on two aggregates… and so on… at the moment of rootless rebirth-linking, dependent on one mind-originated aggregate and the physical base, two aggregates and consciousness arise; dependent on two aggregates… and so on. (3)

Dependent on a mind-originated phenomenon, a mind-originated phenomenon arises by way of non-object condition: dependent on mind-originated aggregates, mind-originated materiality arises; dependent on one mind-originated great element… and so on… dependent on the great elements, mind-originated materiality and derived materiality arise. Dependent on a mind-originated phenomenon and a non-mind-originated phenomenon, a mind-originated phenomenon arises by way of non-object condition: dependent on mind-originated aggregates and mind, mind-originated materiality arises; dependent on mind and the great elements, mind-originated materiality arises. (1)

Dependent on a mind-originated phenomenon and a non-mind-originated phenomenon, a non-mind-originated phenomenon arises by way of non-object condition: at the moment of rebirth-linking, dependent on mind-originated aggregates and mind, kamma-produced materiality arises; at the moment of rebirth-linking, dependent on mind-originated aggregates and the great elements, kamma-produced materiality arises (abbreviated). Nocittasamuṭṭhānaṃ dhammaṃ paccayā nocittasamuṭṭhāno dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – vatthuṃ paccayā cittaṃ; paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe… (paṭiccavārasadisā). (1)

Conditioned by a non-mind-originated phenomenon, a non-mind-originated phenomenon arises by way of root condition: the base is a condition for the mind; at the moment of rebirth-linking… and so on… (similar to the Conditional Relation Section). (1)

Nocittasamuṭṭhānaṃ dhammaṃ paccayā cittasamuṭṭhāno dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – cittaṃ paccayā sampayuttakā khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ, vatthuṃ paccayā cittasamuṭṭhānā khandhā (paṭisandhikkhaṇe dvepi kātabbā). (1)

Conditioned by a non-mind-originated phenomenon, a mind-originated phenomenon arises by way of root condition: the mind is a condition for associated aggregates and mind-originated materiality; the base is a condition for mind-originated aggregates (at the moment of rebirth-linking, both should be stated). (1)

Nocittasamuṭṭhānaṃ dhammaṃ paccayā cittasamuṭṭhāno ca nocittasamuṭṭhāno ca dhammā uppajjanti hetupaccayā – vatthuṃ paccayā cittaṃ sampayuttakā ca khandhā; paṭisandhikkhaṇe dve (paṭiccavārasadisaṃ). (3)

Conditioned by a non-mind-originated phenomenon, a mind-originated phenomenon and a non-mind-originated phenomenon arise by way of root condition: the base is a condition for the mind and its associated aggregates; at the moment of rebirth-linking, two (similar to the Conditional Relation Section). (3)

202. Cittasamuṭṭhānañca nocittasamuṭṭhānañca dhammaṃ paccayā cittasamuṭṭhāno dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ ekaṃ khandhañca cittañca paccayā dve khandhā, dve khandhe…pe… cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ ekaṃ khandhañca vatthuñca paccayā dve khandhā, dve khandhe…pe… (paṭisandhikkhaṇe dvepi paṭiccavārasadisā). (1)

202. Conditioned by a mind-originated phenomenon and a non-mind-originated phenomenon, a mind-originated phenomenon arises by way of root condition: one mind-originated aggregate and the mind are a condition for two aggregates; two aggregates… and so on… one mind-originated aggregate and the base are a condition for two aggregates; two aggregates… and so on… (at the moment of rebirth-linking, both are similar to the Conditional Relation Section). (1)

Cittasamuṭṭhānañca nocittasamuṭṭhānañca dhammaṃ paccayā nocittasamuṭṭhāno dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā [V 3.0550] – cittasamuṭṭhāne khandhe ca vatthuñca paccayā cittaṃ [T 4.0092] (paṭisandhikkhaṇe tīṇipi kātabbā paṭiccavārasadisā). (2)

Conditioned by a mind-originated phenomenon and a non-mind-originated phenomenon, a non-mind-originated phenomenon arises by way of root condition: mind-originated aggregates and the base are a condition for the mind (at the moment of rebirth-linking, all three should be stated, similar to the Conditional Relation Section). (2)

Cittasamuṭṭhānañca nocittasamuṭṭhānañca dhammaṃ paccayā cittasamuṭṭhāno ca nocittasamuṭṭhāno ca dhammā uppajjanti hetupaccayā – cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ ekaṃ khandhañca vatthuñca paccayā dve khandhā cittañca, dve khandhe…pe… (paṭisandhikkhaṇe dvepi kātabbā paṭiccavārasadisā). (3)

Conditioned by a mind-originated phenomenon and a non-mind-originated phenomenon, a mind-originated phenomenon and a non-mind-originated phenomenon arise by way of root condition: one mind-originated aggregate and the base are a condition for two aggregates and the mind; two aggregates… and so on… (at the moment of rebirth-linking, both should be stated, similar to the Conditional Relation Section). (3)

Ārammaṇapaccayo

Object Condition

203. Cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ dhammaṃ paccayā cittasamuṭṭhāno dhammo uppajjati ārammaṇapaccayā… tīṇi (paṭiccavārasadisā).

203. A mind-originated phenomenon is a condition for a mind-originated phenomenon by way of object condition… three (similar to the section on dependent origination).

Nocittasamuṭṭhānaṃ [M 3.0446] dhammaṃ paccayā nocittasamuṭṭhāno dhammo uppajjati ārammaṇapaccayā – cakkhāyatanaṃ paccayā cakkhuviññāṇaṃ…pe… kāyāyatanaṃ paccayā kāyaviññāṇaṃ…pe… vatthuṃ paccayā cittaṃ. (1)

A non-mind-originated phenomenon is a condition for a non-mind-originated phenomenon by way of object condition: the eye-base is a condition for eye-consciousness… the body-base is a condition for body-consciousness… the physical base is a condition for mind. (1)

Nocittasamuṭṭhānaṃ dhammaṃ paccayā cittasamuṭṭhāno dhammo uppajjati ārammaṇapaccayā – cakkhāyatanaṃ paccayā cakkhuviññāṇasahagatā khandhā…pe… kāyāyatanaṃ paccayā kāyaviññāṇasahagatā khandhā, cittaṃ paccayā sampayuttakā khandhā, vatthuṃ paccayā cittasamuṭṭhānā khandhā (paṭisandhikkhaṇe dvepi). (2)

A non-mind-originated phenomenon is a condition for a mind-originated phenomenon by way of object condition: the eye-base is a condition for the aggregates associated with eye-consciousness… the body-base is a condition for the aggregates associated with body-consciousness; mind is a condition for the associated aggregates; the physical base is a condition for the mind-originated aggregates (both at the moment of rebirth-linking). (2)

Nocittasamuṭṭhānaṃ dhammaṃ paccayā cittasamuṭṭhāno ca nocittasamuṭṭhāno ca dhammā uppajjanti ārammaṇapaccayā – cakkhāyatanaṃ paccayā cakkhuviññāṇaṃ sampayuttakā ca khandhā…pe… kāyāyatanaṃ…pe… vatthuṃ paccayā cittaṃ sampayuttakā ca khandhā; paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe…. (3)

A non-mind-originated phenomenon is a condition for mind-originated and non-mind-originated phenomena by way of object condition: the eye-base is a condition for eye-consciousness and associated aggregates… the body-base… the physical base is a condition for mind and associated aggregates; at the moment of rebirth-linking… (3)

204. Cittasamuṭṭhānañca nocittasamuṭṭhānañca dhammaṃ paccayā cittasamuṭṭhāno dhammo uppajjati ārammaṇapaccayā – cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ ekaṃ khandhañca cittañca paccayā dve khandhā, dve khandhe [T 4.0093][V 3.0551]…pe… cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ ekaṃ khandhañca vatthuñca paccayā dve khandhā, dve khandhe…pe… (paṭisandhikkhaṇe dvepi kātabbā). (1)

204. A mind-originated phenomenon and a non-mind-originated phenomenon are conditions for a mind-originated phenomenon by way of object condition: one mind-originated aggregate and mind are conditions for two aggregates, two aggregates… one mind-originated aggregate and the physical base are conditions for two aggregates, two aggregates… (At the moment of rebirth-linking, both should be done.) (1)

Cittasamuṭṭhānañca nocittasamuṭṭhānañca dhammaṃ paccayā nocittasamuṭṭhāno dhammo uppajjati ārammaṇapaccayā – cakkhuviññāṇasahagate khandhe ca cakkhāyatanañca paccayā cakkhuviññāṇaṃ…pe… kāyaviññāṇasahagate…pe… cittasamuṭṭhāne khandhe ca vatthuñca paccayā cittaṃ; paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe…. (2)

A mind-originated phenomenon and a non-mind-originated phenomenon are conditions for a non-mind-originated phenomenon by way of object condition: the aggregates associated with eye-consciousness and the eye-base are conditions for eye-consciousness… the aggregates associated with body-consciousness… the mind-originated aggregates and the physical base are conditions for mind; at the moment of rebirth-linking… (2)

Cittasamuṭṭhānañca nocittasamuṭṭhānañca dhammaṃ paccayā cittasamuṭṭhāno ca nocittasamuṭṭhāno ca dhammā uppajjanti ārammaṇapaccayā – cakkhuviññāṇasahagataṃ ekaṃ khandhañca cakkhāyatanañca paccayā dve khandhā cakkhuviññāṇañca, dve khandhe…pe… kāyaviññāṇasahagataṃ…pe… cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ ekaṃ khandhañca vatthuñca paccayā dve khandhā cittañca, dve khandhe…pe… paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe…. (3) (Saṃkhittaṃ).

A mind-originated phenomenon and a non-mind-originated phenomenon are conditions for mind-originated and non-mind-originated phenomena by way of object condition: one aggregate associated with eye-consciousness and the eye-base are conditions for two aggregates and eye-consciousness; two aggregates… the aggregates associated with body-consciousness… one mind-originated aggregate and the physical base are conditions for two aggregates and mind; two aggregates… at the moment of rebirth-linking… (3) (Abbreviated).

208. Cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ dhammaṃ saṃsaṭṭho cittasamuṭṭhāno dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ saṃsaṭṭhā dve khandhā, dve khandhe…pe… paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe…. (1)

208. Associated with a mind-originated phenomenon, a mind-originated phenomenon arises by way of root condition: one mind-originated aggregate, associated with which are two aggregates; two aggregates… at the moment of rebirth-linking… (1)

Cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ dhammaṃ saṃsaṭṭho nocittasamuṭṭhāno dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – cittasamuṭṭhāne khandhe saṃsaṭṭhaṃ cittaṃ; paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe…. (2)

Associated with a mind-originated phenomenon, a non-mind-originated phenomenon arises by way of root condition: mind associated with mind-originated aggregates; at the moment of rebirth-linking… (2)

Cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ dhammaṃ saṃsaṭṭho cittasamuṭṭhāno ca nocittasamuṭṭhāno ca dhammā uppajjanti hetupaccayā – cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ saṃsaṭṭhā dve khandhā cittañca, dve khandhe…pe… paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe…. (3)

Associated with a mind-originated phenomenon, mind-originated and non-mind-originated phenomena arise by way of root condition: one mind-originated aggregate, associated with which are two aggregates and mind; two aggregates… at the moment of rebirth-linking… (3)

209. Nocittasamuṭṭhānaṃ [M 3.0448][V 3.0553] dhammaṃ saṃsaṭṭho cittasamuṭṭhāno dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – cittasaṃsaṭṭhā sampayuttakā khandhā; paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe…. (1)

209. Associated with a non-mind-originated phenomenon, a mind-originated phenomenon arises by way of root condition: associated aggregates associated with mind; at the moment of rebirth-linking… (1)

Cittasamuṭṭhānañca nocittasamuṭṭhānañca dhammaṃ saṃsaṭṭho cittasamuṭṭhāno dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ ekaṃ khandhañca cittañca saṃsaṭṭhā dve khandhā, dve khandhe…pe… paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe… (saṃkhittaṃ). (1)

Associated with a mind-originated phenomenon and a non-mind-originated phenomenon, a mind-originated phenomenon arises by way of root condition: one mind-originated aggregate and mind, associated with which are two aggregates; two aggregates… at the moment of rebirth-linking… (Abbreviated). (1)

Hetuyā pañca, ārammaṇe pañca (sabbattha pañca), avigate pañca.

By way of root condition, five; by way of object condition, five (everywhere, five); by way of non-disappearance condition, five.

Cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ [T 4.0095] dhammaṃ saṃsaṭṭho cittasamuṭṭhāno dhammo uppajjati nahetupaccayā (pañca pañhā kātabbā. Tīṇi. Moho).

Associated with a mind-originated phenomenon, a mind-originated phenomenon arises by way of non-root condition. (Five questions should be done. Three. Delusion.)

Nahetuyā pañca, naadhipatiyā pañca, napurejāte pañca, napacchājāte pañca, naāsevane pañca, nakamme tīṇi, navipāke pañca, najhāne pañca, namagge pañca, navippayutte pañca.

Not by way of root condition, five; not by way of predominance condition, five; not by way of prenascent condition, five; not by way of postnascent condition, five; not by way of habituation condition, five; not by way of action condition, three; not by way of result condition, five; not by way of jhāna condition, five; not by way of path condition, five; not by way of dissociation condition, five.

Hetupaccayo

Root Condition

210. Cittasamuṭṭhāno dhammo cittasamuṭṭhānassa dhammassa hetupaccayena paccayo – cittasamuṭṭhānā [V 3.0554] hetū sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ hetupaccayena paccayo; paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe…. (1)

210. A mind-originated phenomenon is a condition for a mind-originated phenomenon by way of root condition—mind-originated roots are a condition for associated aggregates and for mind-originated materiality by way of root condition; at the moment of rebirth-linking… and so on. (1)

Cittasamuṭṭhāno dhammo nocittasamuṭṭhānassa dhammassa hetupaccayena paccayo – cittasamuṭṭhānā hetū cittassa hetupaccayena paccayo; paṭisandhikkhaṇe cittasamuṭṭhānā hetū cittassa kaṭattā ca rūpānaṃ hetupaccayena paccayo. (2)

A mind-originated phenomenon is a condition for a non-mind-originated phenomenon by way of root condition—mind-originated roots are a condition for the mind by way of root condition; at the moment of rebirth-linking, mind-originated roots are a condition for the mind and for kamma-originated materiality by way of root condition. (2)

Cittasamuṭṭhāno dhammo cittasamuṭṭhānassa ca nocittasamuṭṭhānassa ca dhammassa hetupaccayena paccayo – cittasamuṭṭhānā hetū sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittassa ca cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ hetupaccayena paccayo; paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe…. (3)

A mind-originated phenomenon is a condition for a mind-originated phenomenon and for a non-mind-originated phenomenon by way of root condition—mind-originated roots are a condition for associated aggregates, for the mind, and for mind-originated materiality by way of root condition; at the moment of rebirth-linking… and so on. (3)

Ārammaṇapaccayo

Object Condition

211. Cittasamuṭṭhāno [M 3.0449] dhammo cittasamuṭṭhānassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo – cittasamuṭṭhāne khandhe ārabbha cittasamuṭṭhānā khandhā uppajjanti. (Mūlaṃ kātabbaṃ) cittasamuṭṭhāne khandhe [T 4.0096] ārabbha cittaṃ uppajjati. (Mūlaṃ kātabbaṃ) cittasamuṭṭhāne khandhe ārabbha cittasamuṭṭhānā khandhā ca cittañca uppajjanti. (3)

211. A mind-originated phenomenon is a condition for a mind-originated phenomenon by way of object condition—having taken mind-originated aggregates as object, mind-originated aggregates arise. (The root should be done.) Having taken mind-originated aggregates as object, consciousness arises. (The root should be done.) Having taken mind-originated aggregates as object, mind-originated aggregates and consciousness arise. (3)

212. Nocittasamuṭṭhāno dhammo nocittasamuṭṭhānassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo – ariyā maggā vuṭṭhahitvā maggaṃ paccavekkhanti, phalaṃ…pe… nibbānaṃ paccavekkhanti. Nibbānaṃ gotrabhussa, vodānassa, maggassa, phalassa, āvajjanāya ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo; cakkhuṃ…pe… vatthuṃ nocittasamuṭṭhāne khandhe aniccato…pe… vipassati, assādeti abhinandati, taṃ ārabbha cittaṃ uppajjati. Dibbena cakkhunā rūpaṃ passati, dibbāya sotadhātuyā saddaṃ suṇāti. Cetopariyañāṇena nocittasamuṭṭhānacittasamaṅgissa cittaṃ jānāti, ākāsānañcāyatanaṃ…pe… ākiñcaññāyatanaṃ…pe… rūpāyatanaṃ cakkhuviññāṇassa…pe… phoṭṭhabbāyatanaṃ…pe… nocittasamuṭṭhānā khandhā iddhividhañāṇassa, cetopariyañāṇassa, pubbenivāsānussatiñāṇassa, anāgataṃsañāṇassa, āvajjanāya ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo. (1)

212. A non-mind-originated phenomenon is a condition for a non-mind-originated phenomenon by way of object condition—the noble ones, having emerged from the path, review the path, the fruit… and so on… they review Nibbāna. Nibbāna is a condition for change-of-lineage consciousness, purification, the path, the fruit, and advertence by way of object condition; one sees the eye… and so on… the base, among non-mind-originated aggregates, as impermanent… and so on… one sees clearly, enjoys, and delights in it; based on that, consciousness arises. With the divine eye, one sees forms; with the divine ear element, one hears sounds. By means of the knowledge of penetration of minds, one knows the mind of one endowed with a non-mind-originated mind. The base of the infinity of space… and so on… the base of nothingness… and so on… the form base is a condition for eye-consciousness… and so on… the tangible base… and so on… non-mind-originated aggregates are conditions for the knowledge of psychic power, the knowledge of penetration of minds, the knowledge of the recollection of past lives, the knowledge of future events, and advertence by way of object condition. (1)

Nocittasamuṭṭhāno [V 3.0555] dhammo cittasamuṭṭhānassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo – ariyā maggā…pe… nibbānaṃ paccavekkhanti (paṭhamagamanasadisaṃ); cakkhuṃ…pe… vatthuṃ nocittasamuṭṭhāne khandhe aniccato…pe… domanassaṃ uppajjati; dibbena cakkhunā rūpaṃ passati…pe… rūpāyatanaṃ cakkhuviññāṇasahagatānaṃ khandhānaṃ…pe… phoṭṭhabbāyatanaṃ…pe… nocittasamuṭṭhānā khandhā iddhividhañāṇassa, cetopariyañāṇassa, pubbenivāsānussatiñāṇassa, anāgataṃsañāṇassa[T 4.0097], āvajjanāya ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo. (2)

A non-mind-originated phenomenon is a condition for a mind-originated phenomenon by way of object condition—the noble ones, having emerged from the path… and so on… they review Nibbāna (similar to the first occurrence); one sees the eye… and so on… the base, among non-mind-originated aggregates, as impermanent… and so on… sorrow arises; with the divine eye, one sees forms… and so on… the form base is a condition for the aggregates associated with eye-consciousness… and so on… the tangible base… and so on… non-mind-originated aggregates are conditions for the knowledge of psychic power, the knowledge of penetration of minds, the knowledge of the recollection of past lives, the knowledge of future events, and advertence by way of object condition. (2)

Nocittasamuṭṭhāno dhammo cittasamuṭṭhānassa ca nocittasamuṭṭhānassa ca dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo – ariyā maggā…pe… nibbānaṃ paccavekkhanti (paṭhamagamanasadisaṃ), nocittasamuṭṭhāne khandhe aniccato…pe… vipassati assādeti abhinandati, taṃ ārabbha cittañca sampayuttakā ca khandhā uppajjanti. Dibbena cakkhunā rūpaṃ passati, dibbāya sotadhātuyā saddaṃ suṇāti. Rūpāyatanaṃ cakkhuviññāṇassa sampayuttakānañca khandhānaṃ…pe… phoṭṭhabbāyatanaṃ…pe… nocittasamuṭṭhānā [M 3.0450] khandhā iddhividhañāṇassa, cetopariyañāṇassa, pubbenivāsānussatiñāṇassa anāgataṃsañāṇassa, āvajjanāya ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo. (3)

A non-mind-originated phenomenon is a condition for a mind-originated phenomenon and for a non-mind-originated phenomenon by way of object condition—the noble ones, having emerged from the path… and so on… they review Nibbāna (similar to the first occurrence); one sees the eye… and so on… the base, among non-mind-originated aggregates, as impermanent… and so on… one sees clearly, enjoys, and delights in it; based on that, consciousness and associated aggregates arise. With the divine eye, one sees forms; with the divine ear element, one hears sounds. The form base is a condition for eye-consciousness and its associated aggregates… and so on… the tangible base… and so on… non-mind-originated aggregates are conditions for the knowledge of psychic power, the knowledge of penetration of minds, the knowledge of the recollection of past lives, the knowledge of future events, and advertence by way of object condition. (3)

Cittasamuṭṭhāno ca nocittasamuṭṭhāno ca dhammā cittasamuṭṭhānassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo… tīṇi (ārabbha kātabbā).

A mind-originated phenomenon and a non-mind-originated phenomenon are conditions for a mind-originated phenomenon by way of object condition… three (should be done by taking as object).

Adhipatipaccayo

Dominance Condition

213. Cittasamuṭṭhāno dhammo cittasamuṭṭhānassa dhammassa adhipatipaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇādhipati, sahajātādhipati. Ārammaṇādhipati – cittasamuṭṭhāne khandhe garuṃ katvā cittasamuṭṭhānā khandhā uppajjanti. Sahajātādhipati – cittasamuṭṭhānādhipati sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ adhipatipaccayena paccayo (tīṇipi ārammaṇādhipati, sahajātādhipatipi kātabbā). (3)

213. A mind-originated phenomenon is a condition for a mind-originated phenomenon by way of the dominance condition: object dominance and conascence dominance. Object dominance: Having made the mind-originated aggregates weighty, mind-originated aggregates arise. Conascence dominance: mind-originated dominance is a condition for the associated aggregates and mind-originated materiality by way of the dominance condition (all three should be done as object dominance and conascence dominance). (3)

Nocittasamuṭṭhāno dhammo nocittasamuṭṭhānassa dhammassa adhipatipaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇādhipati [V 3.0556] – ariyā maggā…pe… nibbānaṃ garuṃ katvā…pe… nocittasamuṭṭhāne [T 4.0098] khandhe garuṃ katvā assādeti abhinandati, taṃ garuṃ katvā cittaṃ uppajjati. (1)

A non-mind-originated phenomenon is a condition for a non-mind-originated phenomenon by way of the dominance condition: object dominance—the noble ones… having made Nibbāna weighty… having made the non-mind-originated aggregates weighty, one savors and delights in them; having made that weighty, consciousness arises. (1)

Nocittasamuṭṭhāno dhammo cittasamuṭṭhānassa dhammassa adhipatipaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇādhipati, sahajātādhipati. Ārammaṇādhipati – ariyā maggā…pe… nibbānaṃ garuṃ katvā paccavekkhanti…pe… nocittasamuṭṭhāne khandhe garuṃ katvā assādeti abhinandati, taṃ garuṃ katvā rāgo uppajjati, diṭṭhi uppajjati. Sahajātādhipati – nocittasamuṭṭhānādhipati sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ adhipatipaccayena paccayo. (2)

A not mind-arisen phenomenon is a condition for a mind-arisen phenomenon by way of the dominance condition: object dominance, conascence dominance. Object dominance: noble ones… having made Nibbāna weighty, they review… having made the not mind-arisen aggregates weighty, one savors and delights in them; having made that weighty, lust arises, wrong view arises. Conascence dominance: a not mind-arisen dominance factor is a condition for the associated aggregates and for mind-arisen material phenomena by way of the dominance condition. (2)

Nocittasamuṭṭhāno dhammo cittasamuṭṭhānassa ca nocittasamuṭṭhānassa ca dhammassa adhipatipaccayena paccayo. Ārammaṇādhipati – ariyā maggā…pe… nibbānaṃ garuṃ katvā paccavekkhanti…pe… nocittasamuṭṭhāne khandhe garuṃ katvā…pe… cittañca sampayuttakā ca khandhā uppajjanti. (3)

A not mind-arisen phenomenon is a condition for a mind-arisen phenomenon and for a not mind-arisen phenomenon by way of the dominance condition. Object dominance: noble ones… having made Nibbāna weighty, they review… having made the not mind-arisen aggregates weighty… mind and the associated aggregates arise. (3)

Cittasamuṭṭhāno ca nocittasamuṭṭhāno ca dhammā cittasamuṭṭhānassa dhammassa adhipatipaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇādhipati… tīṇi (ārammaṇādhipatiyeva).

Mind-arisen phenomena and not mind-arisen phenomena are a condition for a mind-arisen phenomenon by way of the dominance condition: object dominance… three (only object dominance).

Anantara-samanantarapaccayā

Immediate and Contiguity Conditions

214. Cittasamuṭṭhāno [M 3.0451] dhammo cittasamuṭṭhānassa dhammassa anantarapaccayena paccayo… tīṇi (vuṭṭhānaṃ natthi).

214. A mind-arisen phenomenon is a condition for a mind-arisen phenomenon by way of the immediate condition… three (there is no emergence).

Nocittasamuṭṭhāno dhammo nocittasamuṭṭhānassa dhammassa anantarapaccayena paccayo – purimaṃ purimaṃ cittaṃ pacchimassa pacchimassa…pe… nirodhā vuṭṭhahantassa nevasaññānāsaññāyatanaṃ phalasamāpattiyā anantarapaccayena paccayo (itare dve gaṇanā, imassa sadisāyeva kātabbā).

A not mind-arisen phenomenon is a condition for a not mind-arisen phenomenon by way of the immediate condition: each preceding mind is a condition for each succeeding mind… for one emerging from cessation, the base of neither perception nor non-perception is a condition for the attainment of fruition by way of the immediate condition (the other two enumerations should be done similarly to this one).

Cittasamuṭṭhāno ca nocittasamuṭṭhāno [T 4.0099] ca dhammā cittasamuṭṭhānassa dhammassa anantarapaccayena paccayo (tīṇi kātabbā, vuṭṭhānaṃ natthi)… samanantarapaccayena paccayo.

Mind-arisen phenomena and not mind-arisen phenomena are conditions for a mind-arisen phenomenon by way of the immediate condition (all three should be done, there is no emergence)… by way of the contiguity condition.

Sahajātapaccayādi

Conascence Condition, etc.

215. Cittasamuṭṭhāno [V 3.0557] dhammo cittasamuṭṭhānassa dhammassa sahajātapaccayena paccayo (paṭiccavārasadisaṃ)… aññamaññapaccayena paccayo (paṭiccavārasadisaṃ)… nissayapaccayena paccayo (paccayavārasadisaṃ).

215. A mind-arisen phenomenon is a condition for a mind-arisen phenomenon by way of the conascence condition (similar to the Dependent Section)… by way of the mutuality condition (similar to the Dependent Section)… by way of the support condition (similar to the Condition Section).

Upanissayapaccayo

Decisive Support Condition

216. Cittasamuṭṭhāno dhammo cittasamuṭṭhānassa dhammassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇūpanissayo, anantarūpanissayo, pakatūpanissayo…pe…. Pakatūpanissayo – (tīṇi pañhā kātabbā). (3)

216. A mind-arisen phenomenon is a condition for a mind-arisen phenomenon by way of the decisive support condition: object decisive support, immediate decisive support, natural decisive support… Natural decisive support: (the three questions should be done). (3)

Nocittasamuṭṭhāno dhammo nocittasamuṭṭhānassa dhammassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇūpanissayo, anantarūpanissayo, pakatūpanissayo…pe…. Pakatūpanissayo – utuṃ… bhojanaṃ… senāsanaṃ cittaṃ upanissāya dānaṃ deti…pe… saṅghaṃ bhindati; utu… bhojanaṃ… senāsanaṃ cittaṃ cittassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo. (1)

A not mind-arisen phenomenon is a condition for a not mind-arisen phenomenon by way of the decisive support condition: object decisive support, immediate decisive support, natural decisive support… Natural decisive support: relying on climate… food… lodging… mind, one gives a gift… or splits the Saṅgha; climate… food… lodging… mind are a condition for mind by way of the decisive support condition. (1)

Nocittasamuṭṭhāno dhammo cittasamuṭṭhānassa dhammassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇūpanissayo, anantarūpanissayo, pakatūpanissayo…pe…. Pakatūpanissayo – utuṃ… bhojanaṃ… senāsanaṃ cittaṃ upanissāya [M 3.0452] dānaṃ deti…pe… saṅghaṃ bhindati; utu… bhojanaṃ… senāsanaṃ cittaṃ saddhāya…pe… maggassa phalasamāpattiyā upanissayapaccayena paccayo. (2)

A not mind-arisen phenomenon is a condition for a mind-arisen phenomenon by way of the decisive support condition: object decisive support, immediate decisive support, natural decisive support… Natural decisive support: relying on climate… food… lodging… mind, one gives a gift… or splits the Saṅgha; climate… food… lodging… mind are conditions for faith… for the path, for the attainment of fruition by way of the decisive support condition. (2)

Nocittasamuṭṭhāno dhammo cittasamuṭṭhānassa ca nocittasamuṭṭhānassa ca dhammassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇūpanissayo, anantarūpanissayo[T 4.0100], pakatūpanissayo…pe…. Pakatūpanissayo – utuṃ… bhojanaṃ… senāsanaṃ cittaṃ upanissāya dānaṃ deti…pe… saṅghaṃ bhindati; utu… bhojanaṃ… senāsanaṃ cittaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittassa ca upanissayapaccayena paccayo. (3)

A not mind-arisen phenomenon is a condition for a mind-arisen phenomenon and for a not mind-arisen phenomenon by way of the decisive support condition: object decisive support, immediate decisive support, natural decisive support… Natural decisive support: relying on climate… food… lodging… mind, one gives a gift… or splits the Saṅgha; climate… food… lodging… mind are conditions for the mind-arisen aggregates and for mind by way of the decisive support condition. (3)

Cittasamuṭṭhāno ca nocittasamuṭṭhāno ca dhammā cittasamuṭṭhānassa dhammassa upanissayapaccayena [V 3.0558] paccayo – ārammaṇūpanissayo, anantarūpanissayo, pakatūpanissayo…pe…. Pakatūpanissayo… tīṇi.

Mind-arisen phenomena and not mind-arisen phenomena are a condition for a mind-arisen phenomenon by way of the decisive support condition: object decisive support, immediate decisive support, natural decisive support… Natural decisive support… three.

Purejātapaccayo

Prenascence Condition

217. Cittasamuṭṭhāno dhammo cittasamuṭṭhānassa dhammassa purejātapaccayena paccayo. Ārammaṇapurejātaṃ – cittasamuṭṭhāne rūpe…pe… phoṭṭhabbe aniccato…pe… vipassati…pe… domanassaṃ uppajjati; dibbena cakkhunā rūpaṃ passati, dibbāya sotadhātuyā saddaṃ suṇāti. Rūpāyatanaṃ cakkhuviññāṇasahagatānaṃ khandhānaṃ purejātapaccayena paccayo…pe… phoṭṭhabbāyatanaṃ kāyaviññāṇasahagatānaṃ khandhānaṃ purejātapaccayena paccayo. (1)

217. A mind-arisen phenomenon is a condition for a mind-arisen phenomenon by way of the prenascence condition. Object-prenascence: one contemplates mind-arisen form... tangible objects as impermanent... sorrow arises; with the divine eye, one sees form; with the divine ear element, one hears sound. The form base is a condition for the aggregates associated with eye-consciousness by way of the prenascence condition... the tangible base is a condition for the aggregates associated with body-consciousness by way of the prenascence condition. (1)

Cittasamuṭṭhāno dhammo nocittasamuṭṭhānassa dhammassa purejātapaccayena paccayo. Ārammaṇapurejātaṃ – cittasamuṭṭhāne rūpe…pe… phoṭṭhabbe aniccato…pe… vipassati assādeti abhinandati, taṃ ārabbha cittaṃ uppajjati. Dibbena cakkhunā rūpaṃ passati, dibbāya sotadhātuyā saddaṃ suṇāti. Rūpāyatanaṃ cakkhuviññāṇassa…pe… phoṭṭhabbāyatanaṃ kāyaviññāṇassa purejātapaccayena paccayo. (2)

A mind-arisen phenomenon is a condition for a not mind-arisen phenomenon by way of the prenascence condition. Object-prenascence: one contemplates mind-arisen form... tangible objects as impermanent... savors and delights in them; taking that as object, consciousness arises. With the divine eye, one sees form; with the divine ear element, one hears sound. The form base is a condition for eye-consciousness... the tangible base is a condition for body-consciousness by way of the prenascence condition. (2)

Cittasamuṭṭhāno dhammo cittasamuṭṭhānassa [T 4.0101] ca nocittasamuṭṭhānassa ca dhammassa purejātapaccayena paccayo. Ārammaṇapurejātaṃ – cittasamuṭṭhāne rūpe…pe… phoṭṭhabbe aniccato…pe… vipassati assādeti abhinandati, taṃ ārabbha cittañca sampayuttakā ca khandhā uppajjanti. Dibbena cakkhunā rūpaṃ passati, dibbāya [M 3.0453] sotadhātuyā saddaṃ suṇāti. Rūpāyatanaṃ cakkhuviññāṇassa sampayuttakānañca khandhānaṃ purejātapaccayena paccayo…pe… phoṭṭhabbāyatanaṃ…pe…. (3)

A mind-originated phenomenon is a condition for a mind-originated phenomenon and for a non-mind-originated phenomenon by way of pre-nascence condition. Object pre-nascence: one contemplates... delights in, and rejoices in mind-originated form... tangible object as impermanent...; dependent on that, consciousness and its associated aggregates arise. With the divine eye, one sees form; with the divine ear element, one hears sound. The form base is a condition for eye-consciousness and its associated aggregates by way of pre-nascence condition... the tangible base... (3)

218. Nocittasamuṭṭhāno dhammo nocittasamuṭṭhānassa dhammassa purejātapaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇapurejātaṃ, vatthupurejātaṃ. Ārammaṇapurejātaṃ – cakkhuṃ…pe… kāyaṃ, rūpe…pe… phoṭṭhabbe vatthuṃ aniccato…pe… taṃ ārabbha cittaṃ uppajjati. Dibbena cakkhunā rūpaṃ passati, dibbāya sotadhātuyā saddaṃ suṇāti. Rūpāyatanaṃ cakkhuviññāṇassa…pe… phoṭṭhabbāyatanaṃ [V 3.0559]…pe…. Vatthupurejātaṃ – cakkhāyatanaṃ cakkhuviññāṇassa…pe… kāyāyatanaṃ…pe… vatthu cittassa purejātapaccayena paccayo. (1)

218. A non-mind-originated phenomenon is a condition for a non-mind-originated phenomenon by way of pre-nascence condition: object pre-nascence, base pre-nascence. Object pre-nascence: the eye... body, forms... tangible objects, the base as impermanent...; taking that as object, consciousness arises. With the divine eye, one sees form; with the divine ear element, one hears sound. The form base is a condition for eye-consciousness... the tangible base... Base pre-nascence: the eye base is a condition for eye-consciousness... the body base... the base is a condition for consciousness by way of pre-nascence condition. (1)

Nocittasamuṭṭhāno dhammo cittasamuṭṭhānassa dhammassa purejātapaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇapurejātaṃ, vatthupurejātaṃ. Ārammaṇapurejātaṃ – cakkhuṃ…pe… vatthuṃ aniccato…pe… domanassaṃ uppajjati. Dibbena cakkhunā rūpaṃ passati, dibbāya sotadhātuyā saddaṃ suṇāti. Rūpāyatanaṃ cakkhuviññāṇasahagatānaṃ khandhānaṃ…pe… phoṭṭhabbāyatanaṃ…pe…. Vatthupurejātaṃ – cakkhāyatanaṃ cakkhuviññāṇasahagatānaṃ khandhānaṃ…pe… kāyāyatanaṃ…pe… vatthu cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ khandhānaṃ purejātapaccayena [T 4.0102] paccayo. (2)

A non-mind-originated phenomenon is a condition for a mind-originated phenomenon by way of pre-nascence condition: object pre-nascence, base pre-nascence. Object pre-nascence: the eye... the base as impermanent... grief arises. With the divine eye, one sees form; with the divine ear element, one hears sound. The form base is a condition for the aggregates associated with eye-consciousness... the tangible base... Base pre-nascence: the eye base is a condition for the aggregates associated with eye-consciousness... the body base... the base is a condition for the mind-originated aggregates by way of pre-nascence condition. (2)

Nocittasamuṭṭhāno dhammo cittasamuṭṭhānassa ca nocittasamuṭṭhānassa ca dhammassa purejātapaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇapurejātaṃ, vatthupurejātaṃ. Ārammaṇapurejātaṃ – cakkhuṃ…pe… vatthuṃ aniccato…pe… taṃ ārabbha cittañca sampayuttakā ca khandhā uppajjanti. Dibbena cakkhunā rūpaṃ passati, dibbāya sotadhātuyā saddaṃ suṇāti. Rūpāyatanaṃ cakkhuviññāṇassa sampayuttakānañca khandhānaṃ…pe… phoṭṭhabbāyatanaṃ…pe…. Vatthupurejātaṃ – cakkhāyatanaṃ cakkhuviññāṇassa sampayuttakānañca khandhānaṃ…pe… kāyāyatanaṃ…pe… vatthu cittassa sampayuttakānañca khandhānaṃ purejātapaccayena paccayo. (3)

A non-mind-originated phenomenon is a condition for a mind-originated phenomenon and for a non-mind-originated phenomenon by way of pre-nascence condition: object pre-nascence, base pre-nascence. Object pre-nascence: the eye... the base as impermanent...; dependent on that, consciousness and its associated aggregates arise. With the divine eye, one sees form; with the divine ear element, one hears sound. The form base is a condition for eye-consciousness and its associated aggregates... the tangible base... Base pre-nascence: the eye base is a condition for eye-consciousness and its associated aggregates... the body base... the base is a condition for consciousness and its associated aggregates by way of pre-nascence condition. (3)

219. Cittasamuṭṭhāno ca nocittasamuṭṭhāno ca dhammā cittasamuṭṭhānassa dhammassa purejātapaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇapurejātaṃ, vatthupurejātaṃ. Cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpāyatanañca cakkhāyatanañca cakkhuviññāṇasahagatānaṃ khandhānaṃ [M 3.0454]…pe… cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ phoṭṭhabbāyatanañca kāyāyatanañca kāyaviññāṇasahagatānaṃ khandhānaṃ purejātapaccayena paccayo; cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpāyatanañca vatthu ca cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ khandhānaṃ purejātapaccayena paccayo…pe… cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ phoṭṭhabbāyatanañca vatthu ca…pe…. (1)

219. A mind-originated phenomenon and a non-mind-originated phenomenon are a condition for a mind-originated phenomenon by way of pre-nascence condition: object pre-nascence, base pre-nascence. The mind-originated form base and the eye base are a condition for the aggregates associated with eye-consciousness… the mind-originated tangible base and the body base are a condition for the aggregates associated with body-consciousness by way of pre-nascence condition; the mind-originated form base and the base are a condition for the mind-originated aggregates by way of pre-nascence condition… the mind-originated tangible base and the base… (1)

Cittasamuṭṭhāno ca nocittasamuṭṭhāno ca dhammā nocittasamuṭṭhānassa dhammassa purejātapaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇapurejātaṃ, vatthupurejātaṃ. Cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpāyatanañca cakkhāyatanañca cakkhuviññāṇassa…pe… cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ phoṭṭhabbāyatanañca kāyāyatanañca kāyaviññāṇassa [V 3.0560] purejātapaccayena paccayo; cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpāyatanañca vatthu ca cittassa purejātapaccayena paccayo…pe… cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ phoṭṭhabbāyatanañca vatthu ca…pe…. (2)

A mind-originated phenomenon and a non-mind-originated phenomenon are a condition for a non-mind-originated phenomenon by way of pre-nascence condition: object pre-nascence, base pre-nascence. The mind-originated form base and the eye base are a condition for eye-consciousness… the mind-originated tangible base and the body base are a condition for body-consciousness by way of pre-nascence condition; the mind-originated form base and the base are a condition for consciousness by way of pre-nascence condition… the mind-originated tangible base and the base… (2)

Cittasamuṭṭhāno [T 4.0103] ca nocittasamuṭṭhāno ca dhammā cittasamuṭṭhānassa ca nocittasamuṭṭhānassa ca dhammassa purejātapaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇapurejātaṃ, vatthupurejātaṃ. Cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpāyatanañca cakkhāyatanañca cakkhuviññāṇassa sampayuttakānañca khandhānaṃ purejātapaccayena paccayo…pe… cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ phoṭṭhabbāyatanaṃ ca…pe… cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpāyatanañca vatthu ca cittassa sampayuttakānañca khandhānaṃ purejātapaccayena paccayo…pe… cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ phoṭṭhabbāyatanañca vatthu ca…pe…. (3)

A mind-originated phenomenon and a non-mind-originated phenomenon are a condition for a mind-originated phenomenon and for a non-mind-originated phenomenon by way of pre-nascence condition: object pre-nascence, base pre-nascence. The mind-originated form base and the eye base are a condition for eye-consciousness and its associated aggregates by way of pre-nascence condition… the mind-originated tangible base… the mind-originated form base and the base are a condition for consciousness and its associated aggregates by way of pre-nascence condition… the mind-originated tangible base and the base… (3)

Pacchājātāsevanapaccayā

Post-nascence and Repetition Conditions

220. Cittasamuṭṭhāno dhammo cittasamuṭṭhānassa dhammassa pacchājātapaccayena paccayo – pacchājātā cittasamuṭṭhānā khandhā purejātassa imassa cittasamuṭṭhānassa kāyassa pacchājātapaccayena paccayo (iminākāreneva pacchājāto vitthāretabbo)… āsevanapaccayena paccayo… nava.

220. A mind-originated phenomenon is a condition for a mind-originated phenomenon by way of post-nascence condition. Subsequently arisen mind-originated aggregates are a condition for this previously arisen mind-originated body by way of post-nascence condition (post-nascence should be elaborated in this same way)… by way of repetition condition… nine.

Kamma-vipākapaccayā

Kamma and Result Conditions

221. Cittasamuṭṭhāno dhammo cittasamuṭṭhānassa dhammassa kammapaccayena paccayo – sahajātā, nānākkhaṇikā. Sahajātā – cittasamuṭṭhānā cetanā sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ kammapaccayena paccayo; paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe…. Nānākkhaṇikā – cittasamuṭṭhānā cetanā vipākānaṃ khandhānaṃ kammapaccayena paccayo. (1)

221. A mind-originated phenomenon is a condition for a mind-originated phenomenon by way of kamma condition: co-arising, occurring at different moments. Co-arising: mind-originated volition is a condition for the associated aggregates and for mind-originated material phenomena by way of kamma condition; at the moment of rebirth-linking…and so on. Occurring at different moments: mind-originated volition is a condition for resultant aggregates by way of kamma condition. (1)

Cittasamuṭṭhāno [M 3.0455] dhammo nocittasamuṭṭhānassa dhammassa kammapaccayena paccayo – sahajātā, nānākkhaṇikā. Sahajātā – cittasamuṭṭhānā cetanā cittassa [T 4.0104] kammapaccayena paccayo; paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe…. Nānākkhaṇikā – cittasamuṭṭhānā cetanā vipākassa cittassa kaṭattā ca rūpānaṃ kammapaccayena paccayo. (2)

A mind-originated phenomenon is a condition for a non-mind-originated phenomenon by way of kamma condition: co-arising, occurring at different moments. Co-arising: mind-originated volition is a condition for the mind by way of kamma condition; at the moment of rebirth-linking… and so on. Occurring at different moments: mind-originated volition is a condition for resultant consciousness and for kamma-produced material phenomena by way of kamma condition. (2)

Cittasamuṭṭhāno [V 3.0561] dhammo cittasamuṭṭhānassa ca nocittasamuṭṭhānassa ca dhammassa kammapaccayena paccayo – sahajātā, nānākkhaṇikā. Sahajātā – cittasamuṭṭhānā cetanā sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittassa ca cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ kammapaccayena paccayo; paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe…. Nānākkhaṇikā – cittasamuṭṭhānā cetanā vipākānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittassa ca kaṭattā ca rūpānaṃ kammapaccayena paccayo. (3)

A mind-originated phenomenon is a condition for a mind-originated phenomenon and for a non-mind-originated phenomenon by way of kamma condition: co-arising, occurring at different moments. Co-arising: mind-originated volition is a condition for the associated aggregates, for the mind, and for mind-originated material phenomena by way of kamma condition; at the moment of rebirth-linking… and so on. Occurring at different moments: mind-originated volition is a condition for the resultant aggregates, for the mind, and for kamma-produced material phenomena by way of kamma condition. (3)

Cittasamuṭṭhāno dhammo cittasamuṭṭhānassa dhammassa vipākapaccayena paccayo… nava.

A mind-originated phenomenon is a condition for a mind-originated phenomenon by way of result condition… nine.

Āhārapaccayo

Nutriment Condition

222. Cittasamuṭṭhāno dhammo cittasamuṭṭhānassa dhammassa āhārapaccayena paccayo – cittasamuṭṭhānā āhārā sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ āhārapaccayena paccayo; paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe…. (Mūlaṃ kātabbaṃ) cittasamuṭṭhānā āhārā cittassa āhārapaccayena paccayo; paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe… cittasamuṭṭhāno kabaḷīkāro āhāro imassa nocittasamuṭṭhānassa kāyassa āhārapaccayena paccayo. (Mūlaṃ kātabbaṃ) cittasamuṭṭhānā āhārā sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittassa ca cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ āhārapaccayena paccayo; paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe…. (3)

222. A mind-originated phenomenon is a condition for a mind-originated phenomenon by way of nutriment condition: mind-originated nutriment is a condition for associated aggregates and for mind-originated material phenomena by way of nutriment condition; at the moment of rebirth-linking…and so on. (The root should be applied.) Mind-originated nutriment is a condition for mind by way of nutriment condition; at the moment of rebirth-linking…and so on. Mind-originated physical nutriment is a condition for this non-mind-originated body by way of nutriment condition. (The root should be applied.) Mind-originated nutriment is a condition for associated aggregates, mind, and mind-originated material phenomena by way of nutriment condition; at the moment of rebirth-linking…and so on. (3)

223. Nocittasamuṭṭhāno dhammo nocittasamuṭṭhānassa dhammassa āhārapaccayena paccayo – paṭisandhikkhaṇe nocittasamuṭṭhānā [T 4.0105] āhārā kaṭattārūpānaṃ āhārapaccayena paccayo; nocittasamuṭṭhāno kabaḷīkāro āhāro imassa nocittasamuṭṭhānassa kāyassa āhārapaccayena paccayo. (Mūlaṃ kātabbaṃ) nocittasamuṭṭhānā āhārā sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ āhārapaccayena paccayo; paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe…. (Mūlaṃ kātabbaṃ) paṭisandhikkhaṇe nocittasamuṭṭhānā āhārā [M 3.0456] sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ kaṭattā ca rūpānaṃ āhārapaccayena paccayo. (3)

223. A non-mind-originated phenomenon is a condition for a non-mind-originated phenomenon by way of nutriment condition: at the moment of rebirth-linking, non-mind-originated nutriment is a condition for kamma-produced material phenomena by way of nutriment condition; non-mind-originated physical nutriment is a condition for this non-mind-originated body by way of nutriment condition. (The root should be applied.) Non-mind-originated nutriment is a condition for associated aggregates and for mind-originated material phenomena by way of nutriment condition; at the moment of rebirth-linking… and so on. (The root should be applied.) At the moment of rebirth-linking, non-mind-originated nutriment is a condition for associated aggregates and for kamma-produced material phenomena by way of nutriment condition. (3)

224. Cittasamuṭṭhāno ca nocittasamuṭṭhāno ca dhammā cittasamuṭṭhānassa dhammassa āhārapaccayena paccayo – cittasamuṭṭhānā ca nocittasamuṭṭhānā ca āhārā sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ [V 3.0562] cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ āhārapaccayena paccayo; paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe…. (Mūlaṃ kātabbaṃ) paṭisandhikkhaṇe cittasamuṭṭhānā ca nocittasamuṭṭhānā ca āhārā kaṭattārūpānaṃ āhārapaccayena paccayo; cittasamuṭṭhāno ca nocittasamuṭṭhāno ca kabaḷīkāro āhāro imassa nocittasamuṭṭhānassa kāyassa āhārapaccayena paccayo. (Mūlaṃ kātabbaṃ) paṭisandhikkhaṇe cittasamuṭṭhānā ca nocittasamuṭṭhānā ca āhārā sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ kaṭattā ca rūpānaṃ āhārapaccayena paccayo. (3)

224. Both mind-originated and non-mind-originated phenomena are conditions for a mind-originated phenomenon by way of nutriment condition: mind-originated and non-mind-originated nutriments are conditions for the associated aggregates and for mind-originated material phenomena by way of nutriment condition; at the moment of rebirth-linking…and so on. (The root should be applied.) At the moment of rebirth-linking, mind-originated and non-mind-originated nutriments are conditions for kamma-produced material phenomena by way of nutriment condition. Both mind-originated and non-mind-originated physical nutriment are a condition for this non-mind-originated body by way of nutriment condition. (The root should be applied.) At the moment of rebirth-linking, mind-originated and non-mind-originated nutriments are conditions for the associated aggregates and for kamma-produced material phenomena by way of nutriment condition. (3)

Indriyapaccayādi

Faculty Condition, etc.

225. Cittasamuṭṭhāno dhammo cittasamuṭṭhānassa dhammassa indriyapaccayena paccayo… tīṇi.

225. A mind-originated phenomenon is a condition for a mind-originated phenomenon by way of the faculty condition… three.

Nocittasamuṭṭhāno dhammo nocittasamuṭṭhānassa dhammassa indriyapaccayena paccayo – paṭisandhikkhaṇe nocittasamuṭṭhānā [T 4.0106] indriyā kaṭattārūpānaṃ indriyapaccayena paccayo; paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe… cakkhundriyaṃ cakkhuviññāṇassa…pe… kāyindriyaṃ kāyaviññāṇassa…pe… rūpajīvitindriyaṃ kaṭattārūpānaṃ indriyapaccayena paccayo. (Mūlaṃ kātabbaṃ) nocittasamuṭṭhānā indriyā sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ indriyapaccayena paccayo; paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe… cakkhundriyaṃ cakkhuviññāṇasahagatānaṃ khandhānaṃ…pe… kāyindriyaṃ…pe…. (Mūlaṃ kātabbaṃ) paṭisandhikkhaṇe nocittasamuṭṭhānā indriyā sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ kaṭattā ca rūpānaṃ indriyapaccayena paccayo; cakkhundriyaṃ cakkhuviññāṇassa cakkhuviññāṇasahagatānañca khandhānaṃ…pe… kāyindriyaṃ…pe…. (3)

A non-mind-originated phenomenon is a condition for a non-mind-originated phenomenon by way of the faculty condition: at the moment of rebirth-linking, non-mind-originated faculties are conditions for kamma-produced material phenomena by way of the faculty condition; at the moment of rebirth-linking… the eye faculty is a condition for eye-consciousness… the body faculty is a condition for body-consciousness… the life faculty of materiality is a condition for kamma-produced material phenomena by way of the faculty condition. (The root should be applied.) Non-mind-originated faculties are conditions for associated aggregates and for mind-originated material phenomena by way of the faculty condition: at the moment of rebirth-linking… the eye faculty is a condition for the aggregates associated with eye-consciousness… the body faculty… (The root should be applied.) At the moment of rebirth-linking, non-mind-originated faculties are conditions for associated aggregates and for kamma-produced material phenomena by way of the faculty condition: the eye faculty is a condition for eye-consciousness and for the aggregates associated with eye-consciousness… the body faculty… (3)

226. Cittasamuṭṭhāno ca nocittasamuṭṭhāno ca dhammā cittasamuṭṭhānassa dhammassa indriyapaccayena paccayo – cittasamuṭṭhānā ca nocittasamuṭṭhānā ca indriyā sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ indriyapaccayena paccayo[M 3.0457]; paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe… cakkhundriyañca upekkhindriyañca cakkhuviññāṇasahagatānaṃ khandhānaṃ…pe… kāyindriyañca sukhindriyañca…pe… kāyindriyañca dukkhindriyañca kāyaviññāṇasahagatānaṃ khandhānaṃ indriyapaccayena paccayo. (Mūlaṃ kātabbaṃ) paṭisandhikkhaṇe cittasamuṭṭhānā ca nocittasamuṭṭhānā ca indriyā kaṭattārūpānaṃ indriyapaccayena paccayo; cakkhundriyañca upekkhindriyañca cakkhuviññāṇassa [V 3.0563]…pe… kāyindriyañca…pe…. (Mūlaṃ kātabbaṃ) paṭisandhikkhaṇe cittasamuṭṭhānā ca nocittasamuṭṭhānā ca indriyā sampayuttakānaṃ [T 4.0107] khandhānaṃ kaṭattā ca rūpānaṃ indriyapaccayena paccayo; cakkhundriyañca upekkhindriyañca cakkhuviññāṇassa sampayuttakānañca khandhānaṃ indriyapaccayena paccayo; kāyindriyaṃ ca…pe…. (3)

226. Both mind-originated and non-mind-originated phenomena are conditions for a mind-originated phenomenon by way of the faculty condition—both mind-originated and non-mind-originated faculties are conditions for the associated aggregates and for mind-originated material phenomena by way of the faculty condition; at the moment of rebirth-linking… the eye faculty and the equanimity faculty are conditions for the aggregates associated with eye-consciousness… the body faculty and the pleasure faculty… the body faculty and the pain faculty are conditions for the aggregates associated with body-consciousness by way of the faculty condition. (The root should be applied.) At the moment of rebirth-linking, both mind-originated and non-mind-originated faculties are conditions for kamma-produced material phenomena by way of the faculty condition; the eye faculty and the equanimity faculty are conditions for eye-consciousness… the body faculty… (The root should be applied.) At the moment of rebirth-linking, both mind-originated and non-mind-originated faculties are conditions for the associated aggregates and for kamma-produced material phenomena by way of the faculty condition; the eye faculty and the equanimity faculty are conditions for eye-consciousness and for the associated aggregates by way of the faculty condition; the body faculty… (3)

Jhānapaccayena paccayo… tīṇi… maggapaccayena paccayo… tīṇi… sampayuttapaccayena paccayo… pañca…pe….

By jhāna condition... three... by path condition... three... by association condition... five...

Vippayuttapaccayo

Dissociation Condition

227. Cittasamuṭṭhāno dhammo cittasamuṭṭhānassa dhammassa vippayuttapaccayena paccayo – sahajātaṃ, pacchājātaṃ (saṃkhittaṃ). (1)

227. A mind-originated phenomenon is a condition for a mind-originated phenomenon by way of the dissociation condition: co-arising, post-arising (in brief). (1)

Cittasamuṭṭhāno dhammo nocittasamuṭṭhānassa dhammassa vippayuttapaccayena paccayo – sahajātaṃ, pacchājātaṃ. Sahajātaṃ – paṭisandhikkhaṇe (saṃkhittaṃ). (2)

A mind-originated phenomenon is a condition for a non-mind-originated phenomenon by way of the dissociation condition: co-arising, post-arising. Co-arising: at the moment of rebirth-linking (abbreviated). (2)

Cittasamuṭṭhāno dhammo cittasamuṭṭhānassa ca nocittasamuṭṭhānassa ca dhammassa vippayuttapaccayena paccayo… pacchājātaṃ (saṃkhittaṃ). (3)

A mind-originated phenomenon is a condition for mind-originated and non-mind-originated phenomena by way of the dissociation condition… post-arising (abbreviated). (3)

228. Nocittasamuṭṭhāno dhammo nocittasamuṭṭhānassa dhammassa vippayuttapaccayena paccayo – sahajātaṃ, purejātaṃ, pacchājātaṃ. Sahajātaṃ – paṭisandhikkhaṇe cittaṃ kaṭattā rūpānaṃ vippayuttapaccayena paccayo, cittaṃ vatthussa vippayuttapaccayena paccayo, vatthu cittassa vippayuttapaccayena paccayo. Purejātaṃ – cakkhāyatanaṃ cakkhuviññāṇassa…pe… kāyāyatanaṃ kāyaviññāṇassa…pe… vatthu cittassa vippayuttapaccayena paccayo. Pacchājātā – nocittasamuṭṭhānā khandhā purejātassa imassa nocittasamuṭṭhānassa kāyassa vippayuttapaccayena paccayo. (1)

228. A non-mind-originated phenomenon is a condition for a non-mind-originated phenomenon by way of the dissociation condition: co-arising, pre-arising, post-arising. Co-arising: at the moment of rebirth-linking, mind is a condition for kamma-produced material phenomena by way of the dissociation condition, mind is a condition for the physical basis by way of the dissociation condition, the physical basis is a condition for mind by way of the dissociation condition. Pre-arising: the eye-base is a condition for eye-consciousness… the body-base is a condition for body-consciousness… the physical basis is a condition for mind by way of the dissociation condition. Post-arising: non-mind-originated aggregates are a condition for this pre-arisen non-mind-originated body by way of the dissociation condition. (1)

Nocittasamuṭṭhāno [V 3.0564] dhammo cittasamuṭṭhānassa dhammassa vippayuttapaccayena paccayo – sahajātaṃ, purejātaṃ, pacchājātaṃ [T 4.0108] (saṃkhittaṃ). (2)

A non-mind-originated phenomenon is a condition for a mind-originated phenomenon by way of the dissociation condition: co-arising, pre-arising, post-arising (abbreviated). (2)

Nocittasamuṭṭhāno [M 3.0458] dhammo cittasamuṭṭhānassa ca nocittasamuṭṭhānassa ca dhammassa vippayuttapaccayena paccayo – sahajātaṃ, purejātaṃ, pacchājātaṃ (saṃkhittaṃ). (3)

A non-mind-originated phenomenon is a condition for mind-originated and non-mind-originated phenomena by way of the dissociation condition: co-arising, pre-arising, post-arising (abbreviated). (3)

229. Cittasamuṭṭhāno ca nocittasamuṭṭhāno ca dhammā cittasamuṭṭhānassa dhammassa vippayuttapaccayena paccayo – sahajātaṃ, pacchājātaṃ (saṃkhittaṃ). (1)

229. Both mind-originated and non-mind-originated phenomena are conditions for a mind-originated phenomenon by way of the dissociation condition: co-arising, post-arising (abbreviated). (1)

Cittasamuṭṭhāno ca nocittasamuṭṭhāno ca dhammā nocittasamuṭṭhānassa dhammassa vippayuttapaccayena paccayo – sahajātaṃ, pacchājātaṃ (saṃkhittaṃ). (2)

Both mind-originated and non-mind-originated phenomena are conditions for a non-mind-originated phenomenon by way of the dissociation condition: co-arising, post-arising (abbreviated). (2)

Cittasamuṭṭhāno ca nocittasamuṭṭhāno ca dhammā cittasamuṭṭhānassa ca nocittasamuṭṭhānassa ca dhammassa vippayuttapaccayena paccayo… pacchājātaṃ (saṃkhittaṃ). (3)

Both mind-originated and non-mind-originated phenomena are conditions for mind-originated and non-mind-originated phenomena by way of the dissociation condition… post-arising (abbreviated). (3)

Atthipaccayādi

Presence Condition, and so on.

230. Cittasamuṭṭhāno dhammo cittasamuṭṭhānassa dhammassa atthipaccayena paccayo – sahajātaṃ, purejātaṃ, pacchājātaṃ (saṃkhittaṃ). (1)

230. A mind-originated phenomenon is a condition for a mind-originated phenomenon by way of the presence condition: co-arising, pre-arising, post-arising (abbreviated). (1)

Cittasamuṭṭhāno dhammo nocittasamuṭṭhānassa dhammassa atthipaccayena paccayo – sahajātaṃ, purejātaṃ, pacchājātaṃ, āhāraṃ (saṃkhittaṃ). (2)

A mind-originated phenomenon is a condition for a non-mind-originated phenomenon by way of the presence condition: co-arising, pre-arising, post-arising, nutriment (abbreviated). (2)

Cittasamuṭṭhāno dhammo cittasamuṭṭhānassa ca nocittasamuṭṭhānassa ca dhammassa atthipaccayena paccayo – sahajātaṃ, purejātaṃ, pacchājātaṃ (saṃkhittaṃ). (3)

A mind-originated phenomenon is a condition for mind-originated and non-mind-originated phenomena by way of the presence condition: co-arising, pre-arising, post-arising (abbreviated). (3)

Nocittasamuṭṭhāno dhammo nocittasamuṭṭhānassa dhammassa atthipaccayena paccayo – sahajātaṃ, purejātaṃ, pacchājātaṃ, āhāraṃ, indriyaṃ (saṃkhittaṃ). (1)

A non-mind-originated phenomenon is a condition for a non-mind-originated phenomenon by way of the presence condition: co-arising, pre-arising, post-arising, nutriment, faculty (abbreviated). (1)

Nocittasamuṭṭhāno dhammo cittasamuṭṭhānassa dhammassa atthipaccayena paccayo – sahajātaṃ, purejātaṃ, pacchājātaṃ (saṃkhittaṃ). (2)

A non-mind-originated phenomenon is a condition for a mind-originated phenomenon by way of the presence condition: co-arising, pre-arising, post-arising (abbreviated). (2)

Nocittasamuṭṭhāno [V 3.0565] dhammo cittasamuṭṭhānassa ca nocittasamuṭṭhānassa ca dhammassa atthipaccayena paccayo – sahajātaṃ, purejātaṃ, pacchājātaṃ, āhāraṃ (saṃkhittaṃ)[T 4.0109]. (3)

A non-mind-originated phenomenon is a condition for mind-originated and non-mind-originated phenomena by way of the presence condition: co-arising, pre-arising, post-arising, nutriment (abbreviated). (3)

231. Cittasamuṭṭhāno [M 3.0459] ca nocittasamuṭṭhāno ca dhammā cittasamuṭṭhānassa dhammassa atthipaccayena paccayo – sahajātaṃ, purejātaṃ, pacchājātaṃ. Sahajāto – cakkhuviññāṇasahagato eko khandho…pe… (saṃkhittaṃ). (1)

231. Both mind-originated and non-mind-originated phenomena are conditions for a mind-originated phenomenon by way of the presence condition: co-arising, pre-arising, post-arising. Co-arising: one aggregate associated with eye-consciousness... (abbreviated). (1)

Cittasamuṭṭhāno ca nocittasamuṭṭhāno ca dhammā nocittasamuṭṭhānassa dhammassa atthipaccayena paccayo – sahajātaṃ, purejātaṃ, pacchājātaṃ, āhāraṃ, indriyaṃ. Sahajātā – cakkhuviññāṇasahagatā khandhā ca cakkhāyatanañca cakkhuviññāṇassa atthipaccayena paccayo…pe… kāyaviññāṇasahagatā…pe…. Sahajātā – cittasamuṭṭhānā…pe… (paccayavārasadisaṃ paṭisandhipi pavattipi kātabbā sabbesampi pañhānaṃ.) Pacchājātā – cittasamuṭṭhānā khandhā ca cittañca purejātassa imassa nocittasamuṭṭhānassa kāyassa atthipaccayena paccayo. Pacchājātā – cittasamuṭṭhānā khandhā ca cittañca kabaḷīkāro āhāro ca imassa nocittasamuṭṭhānassa kāyassa atthipaccayena paccayo. Pacchājātā – cittasamuṭṭhānā khandhā ca cittañca rūpajīvitindriyañca kaṭattārūpānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo. (2)

Mind-originated and non-mind-originated phenomena are conditions for a non-mind-originated phenomenon by way of Presence Condition: co-nascence, pre-nascence, post-nascence, nutriment, faculty. Co-nascent: the aggregates associated with eye-consciousness and the eye base are conditions for eye-consciousness by way of Presence Condition... and so on... body-consciousness... and so on. Co-nascent: mind-originated phenomena... and so on. (For all questions, this should be applied to both relinking and the course of existence, as in the Section on Conditions.) Post-nascent: the mind-originated aggregates and mind are conditions for this pre-nascent, non-mind-originated body by way of Presence Condition. Post-nascent: the mind-originated aggregates, mind, and material food are conditions for this non-mind-originated body by way of Presence Condition. Post-nascent: the mind-originated aggregates, mind, and the life faculty of form are conditions for kamma-born matter by way of Presence Condition. (2)

Cittasamuṭṭhāno ca nocittasamuṭṭhāno ca dhammā cittasamuṭṭhānassa ca nocittasamuṭṭhānassa ca dhammassa atthipaccayena paccayo – sahajātaṃ, purejātaṃ, pacchājātaṃ. Sahajāto – cakkhuviññāṇasahagato…pe… (saṃkhittaṃ). (3)

Mind-originated and non-mind-originated phenomena are conditions for mind-originated and non-mind-originated phenomena by way of Presence Condition: co-nascence, pre-nascence, post-nascence. Co-nascent: associated with eye-consciousness... and so on... (abbreviated). (3)

Natthipaccayena [T 4.0110] paccayo… vigatapaccayena paccayo… avigatapaccayena paccayo.

By way of Absence Condition... by way of Disappearance Condition... by way of Non-Disappearance Condition.
