2. The Enumeration Section

Suddhaṃ

Pure

232. Hetuyā [V 3.0566] tīṇi, ārammaṇe nava, adhipatiyā nava, anantare nava, samanantare nava, sahajāte nava, aññamaññe nava, nissaye nava, upanissaye nava, purejāte nava, pacchājāte nava, āsevane nava, kamme tīṇi, vipāke nava (sabbattha nava), indriye nava, jhāne tīṇi, magge tīṇi, sampayutte pañca, vippayutte nava…pe… avigate nava.

232. By way of Root Condition, three; by way of Object Condition, nine; by way of Dominance Condition, nine; by way of Contiguity Condition, nine; by way of Immediate Contiguity Condition, nine; by way of Co-nascence Condition, nine; by way of Mutuality Condition, nine; by way of Support Condition, nine; by way of Decisive Support Condition, nine; by way of Pre-nascence Condition, nine; by way of Post-nascence Condition, nine; by way of Repetition Condition, nine; by way of Kamma Condition, three; by way of Result Condition, nine; by way of Faculty Condition, nine; by way of Jhāna Condition, three; by way of Path Condition, three; by way of Association Condition, five; by way of Dissociation Condition, nine... and so on... by way of Non-Disappearance Condition, nine.

233. Cittasamuṭṭhāno [M 3.0460] dhammo cittasamuṭṭhānassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo… sahajātapaccayena paccayo… upanissayapaccayena paccayo… purejātapaccayena paccayo… pacchājātapaccayena paccayo… kammapaccayena paccayo. (1)

233. A mind-originated phenomenon is a condition for a mind-originated phenomenon by way of Object Condition... by way of Co-nascence Condition... by way of Decisive Support Condition... by way of Pre-nascence Condition... by way of Post-nascence Condition... by way of Kamma Condition. (1)

Cittasamuṭṭhāno dhammo nocittasamuṭṭhānassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo… sahajātapaccayena paccayo… upanissayapaccayena paccayo… purejātapaccayena paccayo… pacchājātapaccayena paccayo… kammapaccayena paccayo… āhārapaccayena paccayo. (2)

A mind-originated phenomenon is a condition for a non-mind-originated phenomenon by way of Object Condition... by way of Co-nascence Condition... by way of Decisive Support Condition... by way of Pre-nascence Condition... by way of Post-nascence Condition... by way of Kamma Condition... by way of Nutriment Condition. (2)

Cittasamuṭṭhāno dhammo cittasamuṭṭhānassa ca nocittasamuṭṭhānassa ca dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo… sahajātapaccayena paccayo… upanissayapaccayena paccayo… purejātapaccayena paccayo… pacchājātapaccayena paccayo… kammapaccayena paccayo. (3)

A mind-originated phenomenon is a condition for a mind-originated phenomenon and a non-mind-originated phenomenon by way of Object Condition... by way of Co-nascence Condition... by way of Decisive Support Condition... by way of Pre-nascence Condition... by way of Post-nascence Condition... by way of Kamma Condition. (3)

234. Nocittasamuṭṭhāno dhammo nocittasamuṭṭhānassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena [T 4.0111] paccayo… sahajātapaccayena [V 3.0567] paccayo… upanissayapaccayena paccayo… purejātapaccayena paccayo… pacchājātapaccayena paccayo… āhārapaccayena paccayo… indriyapaccayena paccayo. (1)

234. A non-mind-originated phenomenon is a condition for a non-mind-originated phenomenon by way of Object Condition... by way of Co-nascence Condition... by way of Decisive Support Condition... by way of Pre-nascence Condition... by way of Post-nascence Condition... by way of Nutriment Condition... by way of Faculty Condition. (1)

Nocittasamuṭṭhāno dhammo cittasamuṭṭhānassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo… sahajātapaccayena paccayo… upanissayapaccayena paccayo… purejātapaccayena paccayo… pacchājātapaccayena paccayo. (2)

A non-mind-originated phenomenon is a condition for a mind-originated phenomenon by way of Object Condition... by way of Co-nascence Condition... by way of Decisive Support Condition... by way of Pre-nascence Condition... by way of Post-nascence Condition. (2)

Nocittasamuṭṭhāno dhammo cittasamuṭṭhānassa ca nocittasamuṭṭhānassa ca dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo… sahajātapaccayena paccayo… upanissayapaccayena paccayo… purejātapaccayena paccayo… pacchājātapaccayena paccayo. (3)

A non-mind-originated phenomenon is a condition for mind-originated and non-mind-originated phenomena by way of Object Condition... by way of Co-nascence Condition... by way of Decisive Support Condition... by way of Pre-nascence Condition... by way of Post-nascence Condition. (3)

235. Cittasamuṭṭhāno ca nocittasamuṭṭhāno ca dhammā cittasamuṭṭhānassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo… sahajātapaccayena paccayo… upanissayapaccayena paccayo… purejātapaccayena paccayo… pacchājātapaccayena paccayo. (1)

235. Mind-originated and non-mind-originated phenomena are conditions for a mind-originated phenomenon by way of Object Condition... by way of Co-nascence Condition... by way of Decisive Support Condition... by way of Pre-nascence Condition... by way of Post-nascence Condition. (1)

Cittasamuṭṭhāno [M 3.0461] ca nocittasamuṭṭhāno ca dhammā nocittasamuṭṭhānassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo… sahajātapaccayena paccayo… upanissayapaccayena paccayo… purejātapaccayena paccayo… pacchājātapaccayena paccayo… āhārapaccayena paccayo. (2)

Mind-originated and non-mind-originated phenomena are conditions for a non-mind-originated phenomenon by way of Object Condition... by way of Co-nascence Condition... by way of Decisive Support Condition... by way of Pre-nascence Condition... by way of Post-nascence Condition... by way of Nutriment Condition. (2)

Cittasamuṭṭhāno ca nocittasamuṭṭhāno ca dhammā cittasamuṭṭhānassa ca nocittasamuṭṭhānassa ca dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo… sahajātapaccayena paccayo… upanissayapaccayena paccayo… purejātapaccayena [T 4.0112] paccayo… pacchājātapaccayena paccayo. (3)

Mind-originated and non-mind-originated phenomena are conditions for mind-originated and non-mind-originated phenomena by way of Object Condition... by way of Co-nascence Condition... by way of Decisive Support Condition... by way of Pre-nascence Condition... by way of Post-nascence Condition. (3)

Hetupaccayo

Root Condition

239. Cittasahabhuṃ [V 3.0569] dhammaṃ paṭicca cittasahabhū dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – cittasahabhuṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca dve khandhā cittasahabhu cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ[M 3.0462], dve khandhe…pe… paṭisandhikkhaṇe cittasahabhuṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca dve khandhā, dve khandhe…pe…. (1)

239. A phenomenon co-nascent with mind, dependent on a phenomenon co-nascent with mind, arises by way of root condition. Dependent on one aggregate co-nascent with mind, two aggregates co-nascent with mind and mind-originated materiality arise; dependent on two aggregates... At the moment of rebirth-linking, dependent on one aggregate co-nascent with mind, two aggregates arise; dependent on two aggregates... (1)

Cittasahabhuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca nocittasahabhū dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – cittasahabhū khandhe paṭicca cittaṃ nocittasahabhu cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ; paṭisandhikkhaṇe [T 4.0113] cittasahabhū khandhe paṭicca cittaṃ kaṭattā ca rūpaṃ. (2)

A phenomenon not co-nascent with mind, dependent on a phenomenon co-nascent with mind, arises by way of root condition. Dependent on aggregates co-nascent with mind, consciousness and mind-originated materiality, which are not co-nascent with mind, arise; at the moment of rebirth-linking, dependent on aggregates co-nascent with mind, consciousness and kamma-produced materiality arise. (2)

Cittasahabhuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca cittasahabhū ca nocittasahabhū ca dhammā uppajjanti hetupaccayā – cittasahabhuṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca dve khandhā cittañca cittasahabhu ca nocittasahabhu ca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ, dve khandhe…pe… paṭisandhikkhaṇe cittasahabhuṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca dve khandhā cittañca kaṭattā ca rūpaṃ, dve khandhe…pe…. (3)

Phenomena both co-nascent with mind and not co-nascent with mind, dependent on a phenomenon co-nascent with mind, arise by way of root condition. Dependent on one aggregate co-nascent with mind, two aggregates, consciousness, and mind-originated materiality arise; dependent on two aggregates... At the moment of rebirth-linking, dependent on one aggregate co-nascent with mind, two aggregates, consciousness, and kamma-produced materiality arise; dependent on two aggregates... (3)

240. Nocittasahabhuṃ [V 3.0570] dhammaṃ paṭicca nocittasahabhū dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – cittaṃ paṭicca nocittasahabhu cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ; paṭisandhikkhaṇe cittaṃ paṭicca kaṭattārūpaṃ, cittaṃ paṭicca vatthu, vatthuṃ paṭicca cittaṃ, ekaṃ mahābhūtaṃ…pe… mahābhūte paṭicca nocittasahabhu cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ kaṭattārūpaṃ upādārūpaṃ. (1)

240. A phenomenon not co-nascent with mind, dependent on a phenomenon not co-nascent with mind, arises by way of root condition. Dependent on consciousness, mind-originated materiality arises; at the moment of rebirth-linking, dependent on consciousness, kamma-produced materiality arises. Dependent on consciousness, the physical base arises; dependent on the physical base, consciousness arises. Dependent on one great element... dependent on the great elements, mind-originated materiality, kamma-produced materiality, and derived materiality arise. (1)

Nocittasahabhuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca cittasahabhū dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – cittaṃ paṭicca sampayuttakā khandhā cittasahabhu cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ; paṭisandhikkhaṇe cittaṃ paṭicca sampayuttakā khandhā, paṭisandhikkhaṇe vatthuṃ paṭicca cittasahabhū khandhā, mahābhūte paṭicca cittasahabhu cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ upādārūpaṃ. (2)

A phenomenon co-nascent with mind, dependent on a phenomenon not co-nascent with mind, arises by way of root condition. Dependent on consciousness, associated aggregates and mind-originated materiality, which are co-nascent with mind, arise; at the moment of rebirth-linking, dependent on consciousness, associated aggregates arise; at the moment of rebirth-linking, dependent on the physical base, aggregates co-nascent with mind arise; dependent on the great elements, mind-originated materiality and derived materiality arise. (2)

Nocittasahabhuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca cittasahabhū ca nocittasahabhū ca dhammā uppajjanti hetupaccayā – cittaṃ paṭicca sampayuttakā khandhā cittasahabhu ca nocittasahabhu ca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ; paṭisandhikkhaṇe cittaṃ paṭicca sampayuttakā khandhā kaṭattā ca rūpaṃ, paṭisandhikkhaṇe vatthuṃ paṭicca cittañca sampayuttakā ca khandhā, mahābhūte paṭicca cittasahabhu ca nocittasahabhu ca [T 4.0114] cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ upādārūpaṃ. (3)

Phenomena both co-nascent with mind and not co-nascent with mind, dependent on a phenomenon not co-nascent with mind, arise by way of root condition. Dependent on consciousness, associated aggregates (which are co-nascent with mind) and mind-originated materiality (which is not co-nascent with mind) arise; at the moment of rebirth-linking, dependent on consciousness, associated aggregates and kamma-produced materiality arise; at the moment of rebirth-linking, dependent on the physical base, consciousness and associated aggregates arise; dependent on the great elements, mind-originated materiality and derived materiality arise. (3)

241. Cittasahabhuñca nocittasahabhuñca dhammaṃ paṭicca cittasahabhū dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – cittasahabhuṃ ekaṃ khandhañca cittañca paṭicca dve khandhā cittasahabhu cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ, dve khandhe ca…pe… paṭisandhikkhaṇe cittasahabhuṃ ekaṃ khandhañca cittañca paṭicca dve khandhā, dve khandhe ca…pe… paṭisandhikkhaṇe cittasahabhuṃ ekaṃ [M 3.0463] khandhañca vatthuñca paṭicca dve khandhā, dve khandhe ca…pe… cittasahabhū khandhe ca mahābhūte ca paṭicca cittasahabhu cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ upādārūpaṃ. (1)

241. A phenomenon co-nascent with mind, dependent on a phenomenon co-nascent with mind and a phenomenon not co-nascent with mind, arises by way of root condition. Dependent on one aggregate co-nascent with mind and consciousness, two aggregates co-nascent with mind and mind-originated materiality arise; dependent on two aggregates... At the moment of rebirth-linking, dependent on one aggregate co-nascent with mind and consciousness, two aggregates arise; dependent on two aggregates... At the moment of rebirth-linking, dependent on one aggregate co-nascent with mind and the physical base, two aggregates arise; dependent on two aggregates... Dependent on aggregates co-nascent with mind and the great elements, mind-originated materiality and derived materiality arise. (1)

Cittasahabhuñca nocittasahabhuñca dhammaṃ paṭicca nocittasahabhū dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – cittasahabhū khandhe ca cittañca paṭicca nocittasahabhu cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ; paṭisandhikkhaṇe cittasahabhū khandhe ca cittañca paṭicca kaṭattārūpaṃ, paṭisandhikkhaṇe cittasahabhū khandhe ca vatthuñca paṭicca cittaṃ, cittasahabhū khandhe ca mahābhūte ca paṭicca nocittasahabhu cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ kaṭattārūpaṃ upādārūpaṃ. (2)

A phenomenon not co-nascent with mind, dependent on a phenomenon co-nascent with mind and a phenomenon not co-nascent with mind, arises by way of root condition. Dependent on aggregates co-nascent with mind and consciousness, mind-originated materiality (which is not co-nascent with mind) arises; at the moment of rebirth-linking, dependent on aggregates co-nascent with mind and consciousness, kamma-produced materiality arises; at the moment of rebirth-linking, dependent on aggregates co-nascent with mind and the physical base, consciousness arises; dependent on aggregates co-nascent with mind and the great elements, mind-originated materiality, kamma-produced materiality, and derived materiality (all of which are not co-nascent with mind) arise. (2)

Cittasahabhuñca [V 3.0571] nocittasahabhuñca dhammaṃ paṭicca cittasahabhū ca nocittasahabhū ca dhammā uppajjanti hetupaccayā – cittasahabhuṃ ekaṃ khandhañca cittañca paṭicca dve khandhā cittasahabhu ca nocittasahabhu ca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ, dve khandhe ca…pe… paṭisandhikkhaṇe cittasahabhuṃ ekaṃ khandhañca cittañca paṭicca dve khandhā kaṭattā ca rūpaṃ, dve khandhe ca…pe… paṭisandhikkhaṇe cittasahabhuṃ eka khandhañca vatthuñca paṭicca dve khandhā cittañca, dve khandhe ca…pe… cittasahabhū khandhe [T 4.0115] ca mahābhūte ca paṭicca kaṭattārūpaṃ upādārūpaṃ (saṃkhittaṃ). (3)

Phenomena both co-nascent with mind and not co-nascent with mind, dependent on a phenomenon co-nascent with mind and a phenomenon not co-nascent with mind, arise by way of root condition. Dependent on one aggregate co-nascent with mind and consciousness, two aggregates (which are co-nascent with mind) and mind-originated materiality (which is not co-nascent with mind) arise; dependent on two aggregates... At the moment of rebirth-linking, dependent on one aggregate co-nascent with mind and consciousness, two aggregates and kamma-produced materiality arise; dependent on two aggregates... At the moment of rebirth-linking, dependent on one aggregate co-nascent with mind and the physical base, two aggregates and consciousness arise; dependent on two aggregates... Dependent on aggregates co-nascent with mind and the great elements, kamma-produced materiality and derived materiality arise (abbreviated). (3)

242. Hetuyā nava, ārammaṇe nava (arūpaṃ sabbaṃ uddharitabbaṃ. Cittasamuṭṭhānadukasadisaṃ.) Adhipatiyā nava (mahābhūtā chasupi pañhesu kātabbā, adhipatiyā tīsu natthi.) 242. By way of root condition, nine; by way of object condition, nine (all immaterial states should be excluded; similar to the dyad on mind-originated phenomena); by way of dominance condition, nine (the great elements should be included in all six questions; in the three cases of dominance condition, they are not present); by way of contiguity condition, nine; by way of immediate proximity condition, nine; by way of co-nascence condition, nine; by way of mutuality condition, nine; by way of support condition, nine; by way of decisive support condition, nine; by way of prenascence condition, five; by way of repetition condition, five; by way of kamma condition, nine (in all cases, nine); by way of non-disappearance condition, nine.

Nahetupaccayo

Non-Root Condition

243. Cittasahabhuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca cittasahabhū dhammo uppajjati nahetupaccayā – ahetukaṃ cittasahabhuṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca dve khandhā cittasahabhu cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ, dve khandhe…pe… ahetukapaṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe… vicikicchāsahagate uddhaccasahagate [M 3.0464] khandhe paṭicca vicikicchāsahagato uddhaccasahagato moho. (Evaṃ navapi pañhā kātabbā. “Ahetuka”nti niyāmetabbaṃ. Yathā anulome labbhati evaṃ kātabbaṃ. Tīṇi moho yathā cittasamuṭṭhānaduke evameva kātabbā.)

243. A phenomenon co-nascent with consciousness is related to a phenomenon co-nascent with consciousness by non-root condition: dependent on one rootless aggregate co-nascent with consciousness, two aggregates co-nascent with consciousness and consciousness-originated matter arise; dependent on two aggregates…; at the moment of rootless rebirth-linking…; dependent on the aggregates accompanied by doubt and restlessness, delusion accompanied by doubt and restlessness arises. (Thus, nine questions are to be formulated. It should be specified as ‘rootless’. It should be done as it is found in the positive method. The three instances of delusion are to be treated just as in the dyad on consciousness-originated matter.)

Nakammapaccayo

The Non-Kamma Condition

244. Cittasahabhuṃ [V 3.0572] dhammaṃ paṭicca cittasahabhū dhammo uppajjati nakammapaccayā – cittasahabhū khandhe paṭicca cittasahabhū cetanā.

244. A phenomenon co-nascent with consciousness is related to a phenomenon co-nascent with consciousness by non-kamma condition: dependent on the aggregates co-nascent with consciousness, volition co-nascent with consciousness arises.

Nocittasahabhuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca nocittasahabhū dhammo uppajjati nakammapaccayā [T 4.0116] – bāhiraṃ… āhārasamuṭṭhānaṃ… utusamuṭṭhānaṃ…pe….

A phenomenon not co-nascent with consciousness is related to a phenomenon not co-nascent with consciousness by non-kamma condition: external…; nutriment-originated…; temperature-originated….

Nocittasahabhuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca cittasahabhū dhammo uppajjati nakammapaccayā – cittaṃ paṭicca sampayuttakā cetanā.

A phenomenon not co-nascent with consciousness is related to a phenomenon co-nascent with consciousness by non-kamma condition: dependent on consciousness, associated volition arises.

Cittasahabhuñca nocittasahabhuñca dhammaṃ paṭicca cittasahabhū dhammo uppajjati nakammapaccayā – cittasahabhū khandhe ca cittañca paṭicca sampayuttakā cetanā.

A phenomenon co-nascent with consciousness and a phenomenon not co-nascent with consciousness are related to a phenomenon co-nascent with consciousness by non-kamma condition: dependent on aggregates co-nascent with consciousness and consciousness, associated volition arises.

Najhānapaccayo

The Non-Jhāna Condition

245. Cittasahabhuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca cittasahabhū dhammo uppajjati najhānapaccayā – pañcaviññāṇasahagataṃ…pe….

245. A phenomenon co-nascent with consciousness is related to a phenomenon co-nascent with consciousness by non-jhāna condition: that accompanied by the five consciousnesses….

Pure

246. Nahetuyā nava, naārammaṇe nava, naadhipatiyā nava, naanantare nava, nasamanantare nava, naaññamaññe nava, naupanissaye nava, napurejāte nava, napacchājāte nava, naāsevane nava, nakamme cattāri, navipāke nava, naāhāre ekaṃ, naindriye ekaṃ, najhāne cha, namagge nava, nasampayutte nava, navippayutte cha, nonatthiyā nava, novigate nava (evaṃ itare dvepi gaṇanā kātabbā).

246. By non-root, nine; by non-object, nine; by non-dominance, nine; by non-contiguity, nine; by non-immediacy, nine; by non-mutuality, nine; by non-support, nine; by non-prenascence, nine; by non-postnascence, nine; by non-repetition, nine; by non-kamma, four; by non-result, nine; by non-nutriment, one; by non-faculty, one; by non-jhāna, six; by non-path, nine; by non-association, nine; by non-dissociation, six; by non-absence, nine; by non-disappearance, nine (in this way the other two enumerations should also be done).

Hetupaccayo

Root Condition

247. Cittasahabhuṃ [M 3.0465] dhammaṃ paccayā cittasahabhū dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā… tīṇi (paṭiccasadisā).

247. A phenomenon co-nascent with consciousness is a condition for a phenomenon co-nascent with consciousness by way of root condition… three (similar to the Dependence Section).

Nocittasahabhuṃ dhammaṃ paccayā nocittasahabhū dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – vatthuṃ paccayā cittaṃ, cittaṃ paccayā nocittasahabhu cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ; paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe… (paṭiccavārasadisaṃ, sabbe mahābhūtā). (1)

A phenomenon not co-nascent with consciousness is a condition for a phenomenon not co-nascent with consciousness by way of root condition: the physical base is a condition for consciousness; consciousness is a condition for matter that is not co-nascent with it and is originated by consciousness; at the moment of rebirth-linking… (similar to the Dependence Section, all great elements). (1)

Nocittasahabhuṃ dhammaṃ paccayā cittasahabhū dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – cittaṃ paccayā sampayuttakā khandhā cittasahabhu [T 4.0117] cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ, vatthuṃ paccayā cittasahabhū khandhā; paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe… (sabbe mahābhūtā paṭiccasadisaṃ). (2)

A phenomenon not co-nascent with consciousness is a condition for a phenomenon co-nascent with consciousness by way of root condition: consciousness is a condition for the associated aggregates and for matter that is co-nascent with consciousness and originated by consciousness; the physical base is a condition for the aggregates co-nascent with consciousness; at the moment of rebirth-linking… (all great elements, similar to the Dependence Section). (2)

Nocittasahabhuṃ dhammaṃ paccayā cittasahabhū ca nocittasahabhū ca dhammā uppajjanti hetupaccayā – cittaṃ paccayā sampayuttakā khandhā cittasahabhu ca nocittasahabhu ca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ, vatthuṃ paccayā cittañca sampayuttakā ca khandhā; paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe… (paṭiccasadisaṃ, sabbe mahābhūtā). (3)

A phenomenon not co-nascent with consciousness is a condition for both a phenomenon co-nascent with consciousness and a phenomenon not co-nascent with consciousness by way of root condition: consciousness is a condition for the associated aggregates and for consciousness-originated matter that is both co-nascent and not co-nascent with consciousness; the physical base is a condition for consciousness and the associated aggregates; at the moment of rebirth-linking… (similar to the Dependence Section, all great elements). (3)

248. Cittasahabhuñca [V 3.0574] nocittasahabhuñca dhammaṃ paccayā cittasahabhū dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – cittasahabhuṃ ekaṃ khandhañca cittañca paccayā dve khandhā cittasahabhu cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ, dve khandhe ca…pe… cittasahabhuṃ ekaṃ khandhañca vatthuñca paccayā dve khandhā, dve khandhe ca…pe… paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe… (paṭiccasadisaṃ, sabbe mahābhūtā). (1)

248. A phenomenon co-nascent with consciousness and a phenomenon not co-nascent with consciousness are a condition for a phenomenon co-nascent with consciousness by way of root condition: one aggregate co-nascent with consciousness and consciousness are a condition for two aggregates and for matter that is co-nascent with consciousness and originated by consciousness; two aggregates and…; one aggregate co-nascent with consciousness and the physical base are a condition for two aggregates; two aggregates and…; at the moment of rebirth-linking… (similar to the Dependence Section, all great elements). (1)

Cittasahabhuñca nocittasahabhuñca dhammaṃ paccayā nocittasahabhū dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – cittasahabhū khandhe ca cittañca paccayā nocittasahabhu cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ, cittasahabhū khandhe ca vatthuñca paccayā cittaṃ. Cittasahabhū khandhe ca mahābhūte ca paccayā nocittasahabhu cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ; paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe… (paṭiccasadisaṃ, sabbe mahābhūtā). (2)

A phenomenon co-nascent with consciousness and a phenomenon not co-nascent with consciousness are a condition for a phenomenon not co-nascent with consciousness by way of root condition: aggregates co-nascent with consciousness and consciousness are a condition for matter that is not co-nascent with consciousness and is originated by consciousness; aggregates co-nascent with consciousness and the physical base are a condition for consciousness. Aggregates co-nascent with consciousness and the great elements are a condition for matter that is not co-nascent with consciousness and is originated by consciousness; at the moment of rebirth-linking… (similar to the Dependence Section, all great elements). (2)

Cittasahabhuñca nocittasahabhuñca dhammaṃ paccayā cittasahabhū ca nocittasahabhū ca dhammā uppajjanti hetupaccayā – cittasahabhuṃ ekaṃ khandhañca cittañca paccayā [M 3.0466] dve khandhā cittasahabhu ca nocittasahabhu ca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ, cittasahabhuṃ ekaṃ khandhañca vatthuñca paccayā dve khandhā cittañca, dve [T 4.0118] khandhe ca…pe… paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe… (paṭiccasadisaṃ, sabbe mahābhūtā). (3)

A phenomenon co-nascent with consciousness and a phenomenon not co-nascent with consciousness are a condition for both a phenomenon co-nascent with consciousness and a phenomenon not co-nascent with consciousness by way of root condition: one aggregate co-nascent with consciousness and consciousness are a condition for two aggregates and for consciousness-originated matter that is both co-nascent and not co-nascent with consciousness; one aggregate co-nascent with consciousness and the physical base are a condition for two aggregates and consciousness; two aggregates and…; at the moment of rebirth-linking… (similar to the Dependence Section, all great elements). (3)

Ārammaṇapaccayo

Object Condition

249. Cittasahabhuṃ dhammaṃ paccayā cittasahabhū dhammo uppajjati ārammaṇapaccayā… tīṇi (paṭiccasadisaṃ).

249. A phenomenon co-nascent with consciousness is a condition for a phenomenon co-nascent with consciousness by way of object condition… three (similar to the Dependence Section).

Nocittasahabhuṃ dhammaṃ paccayā nocittasahabhū dhammo uppajjati ārammaṇapaccayā…pe… cakkhāyatanaṃ paccayā cakkhuviññāṇaṃ…pe… kāyāyatanaṃ…pe…. (Imaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānadukaṃ paccayavāre ārammaṇasadisaṃ. Channampi imesaṃ pañcaviññāṇamūlā kātabbā. Saṃkhittaṃ.)

A phenomenon not co-nascent with consciousness is a condition for a phenomenon not co-nascent with consciousness by way of object condition… the eye-base is a condition for eye-consciousness… the body-base…. (This dyad on consciousness-originated phenomena is similar to the object condition in the Condition Section. For all six of these, the five consciousnesses should be taken as the basis. In brief.)

255. Cittasahabhuṃ dhammaṃ saṃsaṭṭho cittasahabhū dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – cittasahabhuṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ saṃsaṭṭhā dve khandhā, dve khandhe…pe… paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe…. (1)

255. A co-nascent mental phenomenon, concomitant with a co-nascent mental phenomenon, arises by way of Root Condition—two aggregates are concomitant with one co-nascent aggregate, two aggregates… (and so on) … at the moment of rebirth-linking… (and so on). (1)

Cittasahabhuṃ dhammaṃ saṃsaṭṭho nocittasahabhū dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – cittasahabhū khandhe saṃsaṭṭhaṃ cittaṃ; paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe…. (2)

Mind, concomitant with a co-nascent mental phenomenon, arises by way of Root Condition—the mind concomitant with co-nascent aggregates; at the moment of rebirth-linking… (and so on). (2)

Cittasahabhuṃ dhammaṃ saṃsaṭṭho cittasahabhū ca nocittasahabhū ca dhammā uppajjanti hetupaccayā – cittasahabhuṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ saṃsaṭṭhā dve khandhā cittañca, dve khandhe…pe… paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe…. (3)

Co-nascent mental phenomena and mind, concomitant with a co-nascent mental phenomenon, arise by way of Root Condition—two aggregates and the mind are concomitant with one co-nascent aggregate, two aggregates… (and so on) … at the moment of rebirth-linking… (and so on). (3)

256. Nocittasahabhuṃ [V 3.0577] dhammaṃ saṃsaṭṭho cittasahabhū dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – cittaṃ saṃsaṭṭhā sampayuttakā khandhā; paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe…. (1)

256. A co-nascent mental phenomenon, concomitant with mind, arises by way of Root Condition—associated aggregates are concomitant with the mind; at the moment of rebirth-linking… (and so on). (1)

Cittasahabhuñca [M 3.0468] nocittasahabhuñca dhammaṃ saṃsaṭṭho cittasahabhū dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – cittasahabhuṃ ekaṃ khandhañca cittañca saṃsaṭṭhā dve khandhā, dve khandhe ca…pe… paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe… (saṃkhittaṃ). (2)

A co-nascent mental phenomenon, concomitant with both a co-nascent mental phenomenon and mind, arises by way of Root Condition—two aggregates are concomitant with one co-nascent aggregate and the mind, two aggregates and… (and so on) … at the moment of rebirth-linking… (and so on) … (Abbreviated). (2)

Hetuyā pañca, ārammaṇe pañca (sabbattha pañca), avigate pañca.

By Root Condition, five; by Object Condition, five (five everywhere); by Non-disappearance Condition, five.

By Non-root, five (three, delusion); by Non-dominance, five; by Non-prenascence, five; by Non-postnascence, five; by Non-repetition, five; by Non-kamma, three; by Non-result, five; by Non-jhāna, five; by Non-path, five; by Non-dissociation, five.

1. The Chapter on Analysis

Hetupaccayo

Root Condition.

257. Cittasahabhū dhammo cittasahabhussa dhammassa hetupaccayena paccayo – cittasahabhū hetū [V 3.0578] sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasahabhūnaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ hetupaccayena paccayo; paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe…. (1)

257. A phenomenon co-nascent with consciousness is a condition for a phenomenon co-nascent with consciousness by way of Root Condition—roots co-nascent with consciousness are a condition for the associated aggregates and for material phenomena originated by consciousness that are co-nascent with consciousness, by way of Root Condition; at the moment of rebirth-linking… and so on. (1)

Cittasahabhū dhammo nocittasahabhussa dhammassa hetupaccayena paccayo – cittasahabhū hetū cittassa nocittasahabhūnaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ hetupaccayena paccayo; paṭisandhikkhaṇe cittasahabhū hetū cittassa kaṭattā ca rūpānaṃ hetupaccayena paccayo. (2)

A phenomenon co-nascent with consciousness is a condition for a phenomenon not co-nascent with consciousness by way of Root Condition—roots co-nascent with consciousness are a condition for consciousness and for material phenomena originated by consciousness that are not co-nascent with consciousness, by way of Root Condition; at the moment of rebirth-linking, roots co-nascent with consciousness are a condition for consciousness and for material phenomena produced by kamma, by way of Root Condition. (2)

Cittasahabhū dhammo cittasahabhussa ca nocittasahabhussa ca dhammassa hetupaccayena paccayo; cittasahabhū hetū sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittassa ca cittasahabhūnañca nocittasahabhūnañca cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ hetupaccayena paccayo. (3)

A phenomenon co-nascent with consciousness is a condition for a phenomenon that is both co-nascent with consciousness and not co-nascent with consciousness, by way of Root Condition—roots co-nascent with consciousness are a condition for the associated aggregates, for consciousness, and for material phenomena originated by consciousness that are both co-nascent and not co-nascent with consciousness, by way of Root Condition. (3)

Ārammaṇapaccayo

Object Condition.

258. Cittasahabhū dhammo cittasahabhussa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo… nava (cittasamuṭṭhānadukasadisaṃ, ninnānākaraṇaṃ).

258. A phenomenon co-nascent with consciousness is a condition for a phenomenon co-nascent with consciousness by way of Object Condition… nine (similar to the dyad of consciousness-originated phenomena, without differentiation).

Adhipatipaccayo

Dominance Condition.

259. Cittasahabhū [M 3.0469] dhammo cittasahabhussa dhammassa adhipatipaccayena paccayo… tīṇi (ārammaṇādhipatipi sahajātādhipatipi kātabbā).

259. A phenomenon co-nascent with consciousness is a condition for a phenomenon co-nascent with consciousness by way of Dominance Condition… three (both object-dominance and conascence-dominance should be applied).

Nocittasahabhū [T 4.0121] dhammo nocittasahabhussa dhammassa adhipatipaccayena paccayo… tīṇi (ārammaṇādhipatipi sahajātādhipatipi imesampi tiṇṇaṃ kātabbā. Navapi pañhā cittasamuṭṭhānadukasadisā. Ante tīṇi ārammaṇādhipatiyeva).

A phenomenon not co-nascent with consciousness is a condition for a phenomenon not co-nascent with consciousness by way of Dominance Condition… three (both object-dominance and conascence-dominance should be applied for these three as well. The nine questions are also similar to the dyad of consciousness-originated phenomena. In the end, the three are object-dominance only).

Anantarapaccayādi

Proximity Condition, and so on.

260. Cittasahabhū dhammo cittasahabhussa dhammassa anantarapaccayena paccayo… nava (cittasamuṭṭhānadukasadisaṃ, ninnānākaraṇaṃ)… samanantarapaccayena paccayo… nava (paṭiccasadisā) [V 3.0579]… sahajātapaccayena paccayo… nava (paṭiccasadisā)… aññamaññapaccayena paccayo… nava (paṭiccasadisā)… nissayapaccayena paccayo… nava (paccayavārasadisā)… upanissayapaccayena paccayo… nava (cittasamuṭṭhānadukasadisā).

260. A phenomenon co-nascent with consciousness is a condition for a phenomenon co-nascent with consciousness by way of Proximity Condition… nine (similar to the dyad of consciousness-originated phenomena, without differentiation)… by way of Contiguity Condition… nine (similar to the Paṭicca section) … by way of Conascence Condition… nine (similar to the Paṭicca section)… by way of Mutuality Condition… nine (similar to the Paṭicca section)… by way of Support Condition… nine (similar to the section on conditions)… by way of Decisive Support Condition… nine (similar to the dyad of consciousness-originated phenomena).

Purejātapaccayo

Pre-nascence Condition.

261. Nocittasahabhū dhammo nocittasahabhussa dhammassa purejātapaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇapurejātaṃ, vatthupurejātaṃ… tīṇi (nocittasahabhū mūlaṃyeva labbhati, cittasamuṭṭhānadukasadisā. Tīṇipi ninnānākaraṇaṃ).

261. A phenomenon not co-nascent with consciousness is a condition for a phenomenon not co-nascent with consciousness by way of Pre-nascence Condition: object pre-nascence, base pre-nascence… three (only the root 'not co-nascent with consciousness' is obtained, similar to the dyad of consciousness-originated phenomena. The three are also without differentiation).

Pacchājātāsevanapaccayā

Post-nascence and Repetition Conditions.

262. Cittasahabhū dhammo nocittasahabhussa dhammassa pacchājātapaccayena paccayo – pacchājātā cittasahabhū khandhā purejātassa imassa nocittasahabhussa kāyassa pacchājātapaccayena paccayo. (1)

262. A phenomenon co-nascent with consciousness is a condition for a phenomenon not co-nascent with consciousness by way of Post-nascence Condition—the post-nascent aggregates co-nascent with consciousness are a condition for this pre-nascent body, which is not co-nascent with consciousness, by way of Post-nascence Condition. (1)

Nocittasahabhū dhammo nocittasahabhussa dhammassa pacchājātapaccayena paccayo…pe…. (1)

A phenomenon not co-nascent with consciousness is a condition for a phenomenon not co-nascent with consciousness by way of Post-nascence Condition… and so on. (1)

Cittasahabhū ca nocittasahabhū ca dhammā nocittasahabhussa dhammassa pacchājātapaccayena paccayo (saṃkhittaṃ)… āsevanapaccayena paccayo… nava.

Phenomena that are both co-nascent with consciousness and not co-nascent with consciousness are a condition for a phenomenon not co-nascent with consciousness by way of Post-nascence Condition (abbreviated)… by way of Repetition Condition… nine.

Kammapaccayo

Kamma Condition.

263. Cittasahabhū [T 4.0122][M 3.0470] dhammo cittasahabhussa dhammassa kammapaccayena paccayo – sahajātā, nānākkhaṇikā. Sahajātā – cittasahabhū cetanā sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasahabhūnaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ kammapaccayena paccayo; paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe…. Nānākkhaṇikā – cittasahabhū cetanā vipākānaṃ cittasahabhūnaṃ khandhānaṃ kammapaccayena paccayo. (1)

263. A phenomenon co-nascent with consciousness is a condition for a phenomenon co-nascent with consciousness by way of Kamma Condition—conascent and different-moment. Conascent: volition co-nascent with consciousness is a condition for the associated aggregates that are co-nascent with consciousness and for material phenomena originated by consciousness, by way of Kamma Condition; at the moment of rebirth-linking… and so on. Different-moment: volition co-nascent with consciousness is a condition for the resultant aggregates that are co-nascent with consciousness, by way of Kamma Condition. (1)

Cittasahabhū dhammo nocittasahabhussa dhammassa kammapaccayena paccayo – sahajātā, nānākkhaṇikā[V 3.0580]. Sahajātā – cittasahabhū cetanā cittassa nocittasahabhūnaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ kammapaccayena paccayo; paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe…. Nānākkhaṇikā – cittasahabhū cetanā vipākassa cittassa kaṭattā ca rūpānaṃ kammapaccayena paccayo. (2)

A phenomenon co-nascent with consciousness is a condition for a phenomenon not co-nascent with consciousness by way of Kamma Condition—conascent and different-moment. Conascent: volition co-nascent with consciousness is a condition for consciousness and for material phenomena originated by consciousness that are not co-nascent with consciousness, by way of Kamma Condition; at the moment of rebirth-linking… and so on. Different-moment: volition co-nascent with consciousness is a condition for resultant consciousness and for material phenomena produced by kamma, by way of Kamma Condition. (2)

Cittasahabhū dhammo cittasahabhussa ca nocittasahabhussa ca dhammassa kammapaccayena paccayo – sahajātā, nānākkhaṇikā. Sahajātā – cittasahabhū cetanā sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittassa ca cittasahabhūnañca nocittasahabhūnañca cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ kammapaccayena paccayo; paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe…. Nānākkhaṇikā – cittasahabhū cetanā vipākānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittassa kaṭattā ca rūpānaṃ kammapaccayena paccayo. (3)

A phenomenon co-nascent with consciousness is a condition for a phenomenon that is both co-nascent with consciousness and not co-nascent with consciousness, by way of Kamma Condition—conascent and different-moment. Conascent: volition co-nascent with consciousness is a condition for the associated aggregates, for consciousness, and for material phenomena originated by consciousness that are both co-nascent and not co-nascent with consciousness, by way of Kamma Condition; at the moment of rebirth-linking… and so on. Different-moment: volition co-nascent with consciousness is a condition for the resultant aggregates, for consciousness, and for material phenomena produced by kamma, by way of Kamma Condition. (3)

Vipākapaccayādi

Result Condition, and so on.

264. Cittasahabhū dhammo cittasahabhussa dhammassa vipākapaccayena paccayo (cittasamuṭṭhānadukasadisaṃ)… āhārapaccayena paccayo… nava (cittasamuṭṭhānadukasadisā. Imampi ekaṃ kabaḷīkāraāhārasadisaṃ). Cittasahabhū dhammo cittasahabhussa dhammassa indriyapaccayena paccayo… nava (cittasamuṭṭhānadukasadisaṃ, ninnānākaraṇaṃ)… jhānapaccayena [T 4.0123] paccayo… tīṇi… maggapaccayena paccayo… tīṇi… sampayuttapaccayena paccayo… pañca.

264. A phenomenon co-nascent with consciousness is a condition for a phenomenon co-nascent with consciousness by way of Result Condition (similar to the dyad of consciousness-originated phenomena)… by way of Nutriment Condition… nine (similar to the dyad of consciousness-originated phenomena. This one is also similar to physical food). A phenomenon co-nascent with consciousness is a condition for a phenomenon co-nascent with consciousness by way of Faculty Condition… nine (similar to the dyad of consciousness-originated phenomena, without differentiation)… by way of Jhāna Condition… three… by way of Path Condition… three… by way of Association Condition… five.

Vippayuttapaccayo

Dissociation Condition.

265. Cittasahabhū dhammo cittasahabhussa dhammassa vippayuttapaccayena paccayo. Sahajātā – cittasahabhū khandhā cittasahabhūnaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ vippayuttapaccayena paccayo. (1)

265. A phenomenon co-nascent with consciousness is a condition for a phenomenon co-nascent with consciousness by way of Dissociation Condition. Conascent: the aggregates co-nascent with consciousness are a condition for the material phenomena originated by consciousness that are co-nascent with consciousness, by way of Dissociation Condition. (1)

Cittasahabhū [M 3.0471] dhammo nocittasahabhussa dhammassa vippayuttapaccayena paccayo – sahajātaṃ, pacchājātaṃ. Sahajātā – cittasahabhū khandhā nocittasahabhūnaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ vippayuttapaccayena paccayo; paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe…. Pacchājātā – cittasahabhū khandhā purejātassa imassa nocittasahabhussa kāyassa vippayuttapaccayena paccayo. (2)

A phenomenon concomitant with consciousness is a condition for a phenomenon not concomitant with consciousness by way of dissociation condition—as co-arisen and as post-arisen. Co-arisen: The aggregates concomitant with consciousness are a condition for mind-originated material phenomena that are not concomitant with consciousness by way of dissociation condition; at the moment of rebirth-linking... and so on. Post-arisen: The aggregates concomitant with consciousness are a condition for this previously arisen body, which is not concomitant with consciousness, by way of dissociation condition. (2)

Cittasahabhū dhammo cittasahabhussa ca nocittasahabhussa ca dhammassa vippayuttapaccayena paccayo[V 3.0581]. Sahajātā – cittasahabhū khandhā cittasahabhūnañca nocittasahabhūnañca cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ vippayuttapaccayena paccayo. (3)

A phenomenon concomitant with consciousness is a condition for a phenomenon concomitant with consciousness and for a phenomenon not concomitant with consciousness by way of dissociation condition. Co-arisen: The aggregates concomitant with consciousness are a condition for phenomena concomitant with consciousness and for mind-originated material phenomena that are not concomitant with consciousness by way of dissociation condition. (3)

266. Nocittasahabhū dhammo nocittasahabhussa dhammassa vippayuttapaccayena paccayo – sahajātaṃ, purejātaṃ, pacchājātaṃ. Sahajātaṃ – cittaṃ nocittasahabhūnaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ vippayuttapaccayena paccayo; paṭisandhikkhaṇe cittaṃ kaṭattārūpānaṃ vippayuttapaccayena paccayo; cittaṃ vatthussa vippayuttapaccayena paccayo; vatthu cittassa vippayuttapaccayena [T 4.0124] paccayo. Purejātaṃ – cakkhāyatanaṃ cakkhuviññāṇassa vippayuttapaccayena paccayo…pe… kāyāyatanaṃ…pe… vatthu cittassa vippayuttapaccayena paccayo. Pacchājātaṃ – cittaṃ purejātassa imassa nocittasahabhussa kāyassa vippayuttapaccayena paccayo. (1)

266. A phenomenon not concomitant with consciousness is a condition for a phenomenon not concomitant with consciousness by way of dissociation condition—as co-arisen, as pre-arisen, and as post-arisen. Co-arisen: Consciousness is a condition for mind-originated material phenomena that are not concomitant with consciousness by way of dissociation condition; at the moment of rebirth-linking, consciousness is a condition for kamma-produced material phenomena by way of dissociation condition; consciousness is a condition for the base by way of dissociation condition; the base is a condition for consciousness by way of dissociation condition. Pre-arisen: The eye-base is a condition for eye-consciousness by way of dissociation condition... and so on... the body-base... and so on... the base is a condition for consciousness by way of dissociation condition. Post-arisen: Consciousness is a condition for this previously arisen body, which is not concomitant with consciousness, by way of dissociation condition. (1)

Nocittasahabhū dhammo cittasahabhussa dhammassa vippayuttapaccayena paccayo – sahajātaṃ, purejātaṃ. Sahajātaṃ – cittaṃ cittasahabhūnaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ vippayuttapaccayena paccayo. Purejātaṃ – cakkhāyatanaṃ cakkhuviññāṇasahagatānaṃ khandhānaṃ vippayuttapaccayena paccayo…pe… kāyāyatanaṃ…pe… vatthu cittasahabhūnaṃ khandhānaṃ vippayuttapaccayena paccayo. (2)

A phenomenon not concomitant with consciousness is a condition for a phenomenon concomitant with consciousness by way of dissociation condition—as co-arisen and as pre-arisen. Co-arisen: Consciousness is a condition for mind-originated material phenomena that are concomitant with consciousness by way of dissociation condition. Pre-arisen: The eye-base is a condition for the aggregates accompanied by eye-consciousness by way of dissociation condition... and so on... the body-base... and so on... the base is a condition for the aggregates concomitant with consciousness by way of dissociation condition. (2)

Nocittasahabhū dhammo cittasahabhussa ca nocittasahabhussa ca dhammassa vippayuttapaccayena paccayo – sahajātaṃ, purejātaṃ. Sahajātaṃ – cittaṃ cittasahabhūnañca nocittasahabhūnañca cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ vippayuttapaccayena paccayo; paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe…. Vatthupurejātaṃ – cakkhāyatanaṃ cakkhuviññāṇassa sampayuttakānañca rūpānaṃ vippayuttapaccayena paccayo…pe… kāyāyatanaṃ…pe… vatthu cittassa sampayuttakānañca khandhānaṃ vippayuttapaccayena paccayo. (3)

A phenomenon not concomitant with consciousness is a condition for a phenomenon concomitant with consciousness and for a phenomenon not concomitant with consciousness by way of dissociation condition—as co-arisen and as pre-arisen. Co-arisen: Consciousness is a condition for phenomena concomitant with consciousness and for mind-originated material phenomena that are not concomitant with consciousness by way of dissociation condition; at the moment of rebirth-linking... and so on. Pre-arisen (base): The eye-base is a condition for eye-consciousness and its associated aggregates by way of dissociation condition... and so on... the body-base... and so on... the base is a condition for consciousness and its associated aggregates by way of dissociation condition. (3)

267. Cittasahabhū [M 3.0472] ca nocittasahabhū ca dhammā cittasahabhussa dhammassa vippayuttapaccayena paccayo. Sahajātā – cittasahabhū khandhā ca cittañca cittasahabhūnaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ vippayuttapaccayena paccayo. (1)

267. Phenomena concomitant with consciousness and phenomena not concomitant with consciousness are a condition for a phenomenon concomitant with consciousness by way of dissociation condition. Co-arisen: The aggregates concomitant with consciousness and consciousness are a condition for mind-originated material phenomena that are concomitant with consciousness by way of dissociation condition. (1)

Cittasahabhū ca nocittasahabhū ca dhammā nocittasahabhussa dhammassa vippayuttapaccayena paccayo – sahajātaṃ, pacchājātaṃ. Sahajātā – cittasahabhū khandhā ca cittañca nocittasahabhūnaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ [V 3.0582] rūpānaṃ vippayuttapaccayena paccayo; paṭisandhikkhaṇe [T 4.0125] …pe…. Pacchājātā – cittasahabhū khandhā ca cittañca purejātassa imassa nocittasahabhussa kāyassa vippayuttapaccayena paccayo. (2)

Phenomena concomitant with consciousness and phenomena not concomitant with consciousness are a condition for a phenomenon not concomitant with consciousness by way of dissociation condition—as co-arisen and as post-arisen. Co-arisen: The aggregates concomitant with consciousness and consciousness are a condition for mind-originated material phenomena that are not concomitant with consciousness by way of dissociation condition; at the moment of rebirth-linking... and so on. Post-arisen: The aggregates concomitant with consciousness and consciousness are a condition for this previously arisen body, which is not concomitant with consciousness, by way of dissociation condition. (2)

Cittasahabhū ca nocittasahabhū ca dhammā cittasahabhussa ca nocittasahabhussa ca dhammassa vippayuttapaccayena paccayo – cittasahabhū khandhā ca cittañca cittasahabhūnañca nocittasahabhūnañca cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ vippayuttapaccayena paccayo. (3)

Phenomena concomitant with consciousness and phenomena not concomitant with consciousness are a condition for a phenomenon concomitant with consciousness and for a phenomenon not concomitant with consciousness by way of dissociation condition—the aggregates concomitant with consciousness and consciousness are a condition for phenomena concomitant with consciousness and for mind-originated material phenomena that are not concomitant with consciousness by way of dissociation condition. (3)

Atthipaccayo

Presence Condition

268. Cittasahabhū dhammo cittasahabhussa dhammassa atthipaccayena paccayo – cittasahabhū eko khandho…pe… (paṭiccasadisaṃ). (1)

268. A phenomenon concomitant with consciousness is a condition for a phenomenon concomitant with consciousness by way of presence condition—one aggregate concomitant with consciousness… and so on… (similar to the dependent analysis). (1)

Cittasahabhū dhammo nocittasahabhussa dhammassa atthipaccayena paccayo – sahajātaṃ, pacchājātaṃ (saṃkhittaṃ). (2)

A phenomenon concomitant with consciousness is a condition for a phenomenon not concomitant with consciousness by way of presence condition—as co-arisen and as post-arisen (abbreviated). (2)

Cittasahabhū dhammo cittasahabhussa ca nocittasahabhussa ca dhammassa atthipaccayena paccayo – cittasahabhū eko khandho…pe… (paṭiccasadisaṃ). (3)

A phenomenon concomitant with consciousness is a condition for a phenomenon concomitant with consciousness and for a phenomenon not concomitant with consciousness by way of presence condition—one aggregate concomitant with consciousness… and so on… (similar to the dependent analysis). (3)

Nocittasahabhū dhammo nocittasahabhussa dhammassa atthipaccayena paccayo – sahajātaṃ, purejātaṃ, pacchājātaṃ, āhāraṃ, indriyaṃ (saṃkhittaṃ). (1)

A phenomenon not concomitant with consciousness is a condition for a phenomenon not concomitant with consciousness by way of presence condition—as co-arisen, as pre-arisen, as post-arisen, as nutriment, and as faculty (abbreviated). (1)

Nocittasahabhū dhammo cittasahabhussa dhammassa atthipaccayena paccayo – sahajātaṃ, purejātaṃ (saṃkhittaṃ. (2)

A phenomenon not concomitant with consciousness is a condition for a phenomenon concomitant with consciousness by way of presence condition—as co-arisen and as pre-arisen (abbreviated). (2)

Nocittasahabhū dhammo cittasahabhussa ca nocittasahabhussa ca dhammassa atthipaccayena paccayo – sahajātaṃ, purejātaṃ (saṃkhittaṃ). (3)

A phenomenon not concomitant with consciousness is a condition for a phenomenon concomitant with consciousness and for a phenomenon not concomitant with consciousness by way of presence condition—as co-arisen and as pre-arisen (abbreviated). (3)

269. Cittasahabhū [M 3.0473][V 3.0583] ca nocittasahabhū ca dhammā cittasahabhussa dhammassa atthipaccayena paccayo – sahajātaṃ, purejātaṃ. Sahajāto – cakkhuviññāṇasahagato eko khandho ca cakkhāyatanañca cakkhuviññāṇañca dvinnaṃ khandhānaṃ…pe… dve khandhā ca…pe… (sabbaṃ paṭisandhiyaṃ [T 4.0126] kātabbaṃ, sahajātaṃ purejātampi). (1)

269. Phenomena concomitant with consciousness and phenomena not concomitant with consciousness are a condition for a phenomenon concomitant with consciousness by way of presence condition—as co-arisen and as pre-arisen. Co-arisen: one aggregate associated with eye-consciousness, the eye-base, and eye-consciousness are a condition for two aggregates… and so on… two aggregates and… and so on… (all should be applied at the moment of rebirth-linking, for both co-arisen and pre-arisen). (1)

Cittasahabhū ca nocittasahabhū ca dhammā nocittasahabhussa dhammassa atthipaccayena paccayo – sahajātaṃ, purejātaṃ, pacchājātaṃ, āhāraṃ, indriyaṃ. Sahajātā – cakkhuviññāṇasahagatā khandhā cakkhāyatanañca cakkhuviññāṇassa atthipaccayena paccayo…pe… kāyaviññāṇasahagatā…pe… cittasahabhū khandhā ca cittañca nocittasahabhūnaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo. Sahajātā – cittasahabhū khandhā ca vatthu ca cittassa atthipaccayena paccayo. Sahajātā – cittasahabhū khandhā ca mahābhūtā ca nocittasahabhūnaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo (paṭisandhikkhaṇe tīṇipi kātabbā). Pacchājātā – cittasahabhū khandhā ca cittañca purejātassa imassa nocittasahabhussa kāyassa atthipaccayena paccayo. Pacchājātā – cittasahabhū khandhā ca kabaḷīkāro āhāro ca imassa nocittasahabhussa kāyassa atthipaccayena paccayo. Pacchājātā – cittasahabhū khandhā ca rūpajīvitindriyañca kaṭattārūpānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo. (2)

Phenomena concomitant with consciousness and phenomena not concomitant with consciousness are a condition for a phenomenon not concomitant with consciousness by way of presence condition: co-arising, pre-arising, post-arising, nutriment, and faculty. Co-arising: The aggregates associated with eye-consciousness and the eye-base are a condition for eye-consciousness by way of presence condition…pe… (similarly for aggregates associated with body-consciousness)…pe… The aggregates concomitant with consciousness and consciousness are a condition for mind-originated material phenomena not concomitant with consciousness by way of presence condition. Co-arising: The aggregates concomitant with consciousness and the physical basis are a condition for consciousness by way of presence condition. Co-arising: The aggregates concomitant with consciousness and the great elements are a condition for mind-originated material phenomena not concomitant with consciousness by way of presence condition (all three should be applied at the rebirth-linking moment). Post-arising: The aggregates concomitant with consciousness and consciousness are a condition for this pre-arisen body, which is not concomitant with consciousness, by way of presence condition. Post-arising: The aggregates concomitant with consciousness and physical nutriment are a condition for this body, which is not concomitant with consciousness, by way of presence condition. Post-arising: The aggregates concomitant with consciousness and the life faculty of materiality are a condition for kamma-produced material phenomena by way of presence condition. (2)

Cittasahabhū ca nocittasahabhū ca dhammā cittasahabhussa ca nocittasahabhussa ca dhammassa atthipaccayena paccayo – sahajātaṃ, purejātaṃ. Sahajāto – cakkhuviññāṇasahagato eko khandho ca cakkhāyatanaṃ ca…pe… (paccayavārasadisaṃ). (3)

Phenomena concomitant with consciousness and phenomena not concomitant with consciousness are a condition for a phenomenon concomitant with consciousness and for a phenomenon not concomitant with consciousness by way of presence condition: co-arising, pre-arising. Co-arising: one aggregate associated with eye-consciousness and the eye-base…pe… (similar to the Condition Section). (3)

Suddhaṃ

The Pure

270. Hetuyā tīṇi, ārammaṇe nava, adhipatiyā nava, anantare nava, samanantare nava, sahajāte nava, aññamaññe nava, nissaye [T 4.0127] nava, upanissaye nava, purejāte tīṇi, pacchājāte [V 3.0584] tīṇi, āsevane nava, kamme [M 3.0474] tīṇi, vipāke nava, āhāre nava, indriye nava, jhāne tīṇi, magge tīṇi, sampayutte pañca, vippayutte nava, atthiyā nava, natthiyā nava, vigate nava, avigate nava.

270. By root condition, three; by object condition, nine; by dominance condition, nine; by contiguity condition, nine; by immediate contiguity condition, nine; by co-arising condition, nine; by reciprocity condition, nine; by support condition, nine; by decisive support condition, nine; by pre-arising condition, three; by post-arising condition, three; by recurrence condition, nine; by kamma condition, three; by resultant condition, nine; by nutriment condition, nine; by faculty condition, nine; by jhana condition, three; by path condition, three; by association condition, five; by dissociation condition, nine; by presence condition, nine; by non-existence condition, nine; by disappearance condition, nine; by non-disappearance condition, nine.

Anulomaṃ.

The Negative Section

271. Cittasahabhū dhammo cittasahabhussa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo… sahajātapaccayena paccayo… upanissayapaccayena paccayo… kammapaccayena paccayo. (1)

271. A phenomenon concomitant with consciousness is a condition for a phenomenon concomitant with consciousness by way of object condition… by way of co-arising condition… by way of decisive support condition… by way of kamma condition. (1)

Cittasahabhū dhammo nocittasahabhussa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo… sahajātapaccayena paccayo… upanissayapaccayena paccayo… pacchājātapaccayena paccayo… kammapaccayena paccayo. (2)

A phenomenon concomitant with consciousness is a condition for a phenomenon not concomitant with consciousness by way of object condition… by way of co-arising condition… by way of decisive support condition… by way of post-arising condition… by way of kamma condition. (2)

Cittasahabhū dhammo cittasahabhussa ca nocittasahabhussa ca dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo… sahajātapaccayena paccayo… upanissayapaccayena paccayo… kammapaccayena paccayo. (3)

A phenomenon concomitant with consciousness is a condition for a phenomenon concomitant with consciousness and for a phenomenon not concomitant with consciousness by way of object condition… by way of co-arising condition… by way of decisive support condition… by way of kamma condition. (3)

272. Nocittasahabhū dhammo nocittasahabhussa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo… sahajātapaccayena paccayo… upanissayapaccayena paccayo… purejātapaccayena paccayo… pacchājātapaccayena paccayo… āhārapaccayena paccayo… indriyapaccayena paccayo. (1)

272. A phenomenon not concomitant with consciousness is a condition for a phenomenon not concomitant with consciousness by way of object condition… by way of co-arising condition… by way of decisive support condition… by way of pre-arising condition… by way of post-arising condition… by way of nutriment condition… by way of faculty condition. (1)

Nocittasahabhū dhammo cittasahabhussa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo… sahajātapaccayena paccayo… upanissayapaccayena paccayo… purejātapaccayena paccayo. (2)

A phenomenon not concomitant with consciousness is a condition for a phenomenon concomitant with consciousness by way of object condition… by way of co-arising condition… by way of decisive support condition… by way of pre-arising condition. (2)

Nocittasahabhū dhammo cittasahabhussa ca nocittasahabhussa ca dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo [V 3.0585]… sahajātapaccayena paccayo… upanissayapaccayena [T 4.0128] paccayo… purejātapaccayena paccayo. (3)

A phenomenon not concomitant with consciousness is a condition for a phenomenon concomitant with consciousness and for a phenomenon not concomitant with consciousness by way of object condition… by way of co-arising condition… by way of decisive support condition… by way of pre-arising condition. (3)

273. Cittasahabhū [M 3.0475] ca nocittasahabhū ca dhammā cittasahabhussa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo… sahajātapaccayena paccayo… upanissayapaccayena paccayo. (1)

273. Phenomena concomitant with consciousness and phenomena not concomitant with consciousness are a condition for a phenomenon concomitant with consciousness by way of object condition… by way of co-arising condition… by way of decisive support condition. (1)

Cittasahabhū ca nocittasahabhū ca dhammā nocittasahabhussa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo… sahajātapaccayena paccayo… upanissayapaccayena paccayo… pacchājātapaccayena paccayo. (2)

Phenomena concomitant with consciousness and phenomena not concomitant with consciousness are a condition for a phenomenon not concomitant with consciousness by way of object condition… by way of co-arising condition… by way of decisive support condition… by way of post-arising condition. (2)

Cittasahabhū ca nocittasahabhū ca dhammā cittasahabhussa ca nocittasahabhussa ca dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo… sahajātapaccayena paccayo… upanissayapaccayena paccayo. (3)

Phenomena concomitant with consciousness and phenomena not concomitant with consciousness are a condition for a phenomenon concomitant with consciousness and for a phenomenon not concomitant with consciousness by way of object condition… by way of co-arising condition… by way of decisive support condition. (3)

1. Paṭiccavāro

1. The Section on Dependence

277. Cittānuparivattiṃ [T 4.0129][V 3.0586] dhammaṃ paṭicca cittānuparivatti dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – cittānuparivattiṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca dve khandhā cittānuparivattiṃ cittasamuṭṭhānañca [M 3.0476] rūpaṃ, dve khandhe…pe… paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe… (yathā cittasahabhūdukaṃ evaṃ imaṃ dukaṃ kātabbaṃ, ninnānākaraṇaṃ).

277. Dependent on a mind-conforming phenomenon, a mind-conforming phenomenon arises by way of root condition—dependent on one mind-conforming aggregate, two aggregates and mind-conforming, mind-originated materiality arise; dependent on two aggregates…pe… at the moment of rebirth-linking…pe… (this dyad should be treated like the dyad on phenomena concomitant with consciousness; there is no difference in method).

Cittānuparivattidukaṃ niṭṭhitaṃ.

The Dyad on Mind-Conforming Phenomena is Concluded.

Hetupaccayo

Root Condition

278. Cittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhānaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca cittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhāno dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – cittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhānaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca dve khandhā, dve khandhe paṭicca eko khandho; paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe…. (1)

278. A phenomenon associated with mind and arisen from mind arises dependent on a phenomenon associated with mind and arisen from mind by way of root condition—dependent on one aggregate associated with mind and arisen from mind, two aggregates arise; dependent on two aggregates, one aggregate arises; at the moment of rebirth-linking…pe….

Cittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhānaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca nocittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhāno dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – cittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhāne khandhe paṭicca cittaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ; paṭisandhikkhaṇe cittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhāne khandhe paṭicca cittaṃ kaṭattā ca rūpaṃ. (2)

A phenomenon not associated with mind and arisen from mind arises dependent on a phenomenon associated with mind and arisen from mind by way of root condition—dependent on the aggregates associated with mind and arisen from mind, mind and mind-originated materiality arise; at the moment of rebirth-linking, dependent on the aggregates associated with mind and arisen from mind, mind and materiality produced by kamma arise.

Cittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhānaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca cittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhāno ca nocittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhāno ca dhammā uppajjanti hetupaccayā – cittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhānaṃ [T 4.0130] ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca dve khandhā cittañca cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ, dve khandhe…pe… paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe…. (3)

Dependent on a phenomenon associated with mind and arisen from mind, phenomena both associated with mind and arisen from mind and not associated with mind and arisen from mind arise by way of root condition—dependent on one aggregate associated with mind and arisen from mind, two aggregates, mind, and mind-originated materiality arise; dependent on two aggregates…pe… at the moment of rebirth-linking…pe….

279. Nocittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhānaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca nocittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhāno dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – cittaṃ paṭicca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ; paṭisandhikkhaṇe cittaṃ paṭicca kaṭattārūpaṃ, cittaṃ paṭicca vatthu, vatthuṃ paṭicca cittaṃ, ekaṃ mahābhūtaṃ…pe… mahābhūte paṭicca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ kaṭattārūpaṃ upādārūpaṃ. (1)

279. A phenomenon not associated with mind and arisen from mind arises dependent on a phenomenon not associated with mind and arisen from mind by way of root condition—dependent on mind, mind-originated materiality arises; at the moment of rebirth-linking, dependent on mind, materiality produced by kamma arises; dependent on mind, the physical base arises; dependent on the physical base, mind arises; dependent on one great element…pe… dependent on the great elements, mind-originated materiality, materiality produced by kamma, and derived materiality arise.

Nocittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhānaṃ [V 3.0588] dhammaṃ paṭicca cittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhāno dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – cittaṃ paṭicca sampayuttakā khandhā; paṭisandhikkhaṇe cittaṃ paṭicca sampayuttakā khandhā, paṭisandhikkhaṇe vatthuṃ paṭicca cittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhānā khandhā. (2)

A phenomenon associated with mind and arisen from mind arises dependent on a phenomenon that is not associated with mind and arisen from mind by way of root condition: dependent on mind, the associated aggregates arise; at the moment of rebirth-linking, dependent on mind, the associated aggregates arise; at the moment of rebirth-linking, dependent on the physical base, the aggregates associated with mind and arisen from mind arise.

Nocittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhānaṃ [M 3.0477] dhammaṃ paṭicca cittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhāno ca nocittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhāno ca dhammā uppajjanti hetupaccayā – cittaṃ paṭicca sampayuttakā khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ; paṭisandhikkhaṇe cittaṃ paṭicca sampayuttakā khandhā kaṭattā ca rūpaṃ, paṭisandhikkhaṇe vatthuṃ paṭicca cittaṃ sampayuttakā ca khandhā. (3)

Dependent on a phenomenon not associated with mind and arisen from mind, phenomena both associated with mind and arisen from mind and not associated with mind and arisen from mind arise by way of root condition: dependent on mind, the associated aggregates and mind-originated materiality arise; at the moment of rebirth-linking, dependent on mind, the associated aggregates and materiality produced by kamma arise; at the moment of rebirth-linking, dependent on the physical base, mind and the associated aggregates arise.

280. Cittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhānañca nocittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhānañca dhammaṃ paṭicca cittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhāno dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – cittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhānaṃ ekaṃ khandhañca cittañca paṭicca dve khandhā, dve khandhe…pe… paṭisandhikkhaṇe cittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhānaṃ ekaṃ khandhañca cittañca paṭicca dve khandhā, dve khandhe…pe… paṭisandhikkhaṇe cittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhānaṃ [T 4.0131] ekaṃ khandhañca vatthuñca paṭicca dve khandhā, dve khandhe…pe…. (1)

280. A phenomenon associated with mind and arisen from mind arises dependent on a phenomenon associated with mind and arisen from mind and a phenomenon not associated with mind and arisen from mind by way of root condition—dependent on one aggregate associated with mind and arisen from mind and on mind, two aggregates arise; dependent on two aggregates…pe… at the moment of rebirth-linking, dependent on one aggregate associated with mind and arisen from mind and on mind, two aggregates arise; dependent on two aggregates…pe… at the moment of rebirth-linking, dependent on one aggregate associated with mind and arisen from mind and on the physical base, two aggregates arise; dependent on two aggregates…pe….

Cittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhānañca nocittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhānañca dhammaṃ paṭicca nocittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhāno dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – cittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhāne khandhe ca cittañca paṭicca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ, cittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhāne khandhe ca mahābhūte ca paṭicca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ; paṭisandhikkhaṇe cittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhāne khandhe ca cittañca paṭicca kaṭattārūpaṃ, paṭisandhikkhaṇe cittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhāne khandhe ca mahābhūte ca paṭicca kaṭattārūpaṃ, paṭisandhikkhaṇe cittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhāne khandhe ca vatthuñca paṭicca cittaṃ. (2)

A phenomenon not associated with mind and arisen from mind arises dependent on a phenomenon associated with mind and arisen from mind and a phenomenon not associated with mind and arisen from mind by way of root condition: dependent on the aggregates associated with mind and arisen from mind and on mind, mind-originated materiality arises; dependent on the aggregates associated with mind and arisen from mind and on the great elements, mind-originated materiality arises. At the moment of rebirth-linking, dependent on the aggregates associated with mind and arisen from mind and on mind, materiality produced by kamma arises; at the moment of rebirth-linking, dependent on the aggregates associated with mind and arisen from mind and on the great elements, materiality produced by kamma arises; at the moment of rebirth-linking, dependent on the aggregates associated with mind and arisen from mind and on the physical base, mind arises.

Cittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhānañca nocittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhānañca dhammaṃ paṭicca cittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhāno ca nocittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhāno ca dhammā uppajjanti hetupaccayā – cittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhānaṃ ekaṃ khandhañca cittañca paṭicca dve khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ, dve khandhe…pe… paṭisandhikkhaṇe cittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhānaṃ ekaṃ khandhañca cittañca paṭicca dve khandhā kaṭattā ca rūpaṃ, dve khandhe…pe… paṭisandhikkhaṇe cittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhānaṃ ekaṃ khandhañca vatthuñca paṭicca dve khandhā cittañca, dve khandhe…pe… (saṃkhittaṃ). (3)

Dependent on a phenomenon associated with mind and arisen from mind and a phenomenon not associated with mind and arisen from mind, phenomena both associated with mind and arisen from mind and not associated with mind and arisen from mind arise by way of root condition: dependent on one aggregate associated with mind and arisen from mind and on mind, two aggregates and mind-originated materiality arise; dependent on two aggregates…pe… at the moment of rebirth-linking, dependent on one aggregate associated with mind and arisen from mind and on mind, two aggregates and materiality produced by kamma arise; dependent on two aggregates…pe… at the moment of rebirth-linking, dependent on one aggregate associated with mind and arisen from mind and on the physical base, two aggregates and mind arise; dependent on two aggregates…pe… (Abbreviated).

The Pure

281. Hetuyā [V 3.0589] nava, ārammaṇe nava, adhipatiyā nava, anantare nava, samanantare nava, sahajāte nava, aññamaññe nava, nissaye nava, upanissaye nava, purejāte pañca, āsevane pañca[T 4.0132], kamme nava, vipāke nava (sabbattha nava), avigate nava.

281. By way of root, nine; by way of object, nine; by way of predominance, nine; by way of contiguity, nine; by way of immediate contiguity, nine; by way of co-nascence, nine; by way of mutuality, nine; by way of support, nine; by way of decisive support, nine; by way of pre-nascence, five; by way of repetition, five; by way of kamma, nine; by way of resultant, nine (everywhere, nine); by way of non-disappearance, nine.

Anulomaṃ.
