1. The Section on Analysis

Nahetupaccayo

Non-Root Condition

282. Cittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhānaṃ [M 3.0478] dhammaṃ paṭicca cittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhāno dhammo uppajjati nahetupaccayā – ahetukaṃ cittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhānaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca dve khandhā, dve khandhe…pe… ahetukapaṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe… vicikicchāsahagate uddhaccasahagate khandhe paṭicca vicikicchāsahagato uddhaccasahagato moho. (1)

282. A phenomenon associated with mind and arisen from mind arises dependent on a phenomenon associated with mind and arisen from mind by way of non-root condition – dependent on one rootless aggregate associated with mind and arisen from mind, two aggregates arise; dependent on two aggregates…pe… at the moment of rootless rebirth-linking…pe… dependent on the aggregates accompanied by doubt and restlessness, delusion accompanied by doubt and restlessness arises.

Cittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhānaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca nocittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhāno dhammo uppajjati nahetupaccayā – ahetuke cittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhāne khandhe paṭicca cittaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ; ahetukapaṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe…. (2)

Dependent on a phenomenon that is mind-associated and mind-originated, a phenomenon that is not mind-associated and mind-originated arises by way of non-root condition. For example: dependent on rootless mind-associated and mind-originated aggregates, mind and mind-originated form arise; at the moment of rootless rebirth-linking… (and so on). (2)

Cittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhānaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca cittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhāno ca nocittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhāno ca dhammā uppajjanti [V 3.0590] nahetupaccayā – ahetukaṃ cittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhānaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca dve khandhā cittañca cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ, dve khandhe…pe… ahetukapaṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe…. (3)

Dependent on a phenomenon that is mind-associated and mind-originated, both phenomena that are mind-associated and mind-originated and phenomena that are not mind-associated and mind-originated arise by way of non-root condition. For example: dependent on one rootless mind-associated and mind-originated aggregate, two aggregates, mind, and mind-originated form arise; two aggregates… (and so on)… at the moment of rootless rebirth-linking… (and so on). (3)

283. Nocittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhānaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca nocittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhāno dhammo uppajjati nahetupaccayā – ahetukaṃ cittaṃ paṭicca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ; ahetukapaṭisandhikkhaṇe cittaṃ paṭicca kaṭattārūpaṃ, cittaṃ paṭicca vatthu, vatthuṃ paṭicca cittaṃ, ekaṃ mahābhūtaṃ…pe… (yāva asaññasattā). (1)

283. Dependent on a phenomenon that is not mind-associated and mind-originated, a phenomenon that is not mind-associated and mind-originated arises by way of non-root condition. For example: dependent on rootless mind, mind-originated form arises; at the moment of rootless rebirth-linking, dependent on mind, kamma-originated form arises; dependent on mind, the base arises; dependent on the base, mind arises; one great element… (and so on)… (up to non-percipient beings). (1)

Nocittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhānaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca cittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhāno dhammo uppajjati nahetupaccayā – ahetukaṃ cittaṃ paṭicca sampayuttakā khandhā; ahetukapaṭisandhikkhaṇe cittaṃ paṭicca sampayuttakā khandhā, ahetukapaṭisandhikkhaṇe vatthuṃ paṭicca [T 4.0133] cittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhānā khandhā, vicikicchāsahagataṃ uddhaccasahagataṃ cittaṃ paṭicca vicikicchāsahagato uddhaccasahagato moho. (2)

Dependent on a phenomenon that is not mind-associated and mind-originated, a phenomenon that is mind-associated and mind-originated arises by way of non-root condition. For example: dependent on rootless mind, associated aggregates arise; at the moment of rootless rebirth-linking, dependent on mind, associated aggregates arise; at the moment of rootless rebirth-linking, dependent on the base, mind-associated and mind-originated aggregates arise; dependent on the mind accompanied by doubt and restlessness, delusion accompanied by doubt and restlessness arises. (2)

Nocittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhānaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca cittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhāno ca nocittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhāno ca dhammā uppajjanti nahetupaccayā – ahetukaṃ cittaṃ paṭicca sampayuttakā khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ; ahetukapaṭisandhikkhaṇe cittaṃ paṭicca sampayuttakā khandhā kaṭattā ca rūpaṃ, ahetukapaṭisandhikkhaṇe vatthuṃ paṭicca cittaṃ sampayuttakā ca khandhā. (3)

Dependent on a phenomenon that is not mind-associated and mind-originated, both phenomena that are mind-associated and mind-originated and phenomena that are not mind-associated and mind-originated arise by way of non-root condition. For example: dependent on rootless mind, associated aggregates and mind-originated form arise; at the moment of rootless rebirth-linking, dependent on mind, associated aggregates and kamma-originated form arise; at the moment of rootless rebirth-linking, dependent on the base, mind and associated aggregates arise. (3)

284. Cittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhānañca [M 3.0479] nocittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhānañca dhammaṃ paṭicca cittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhāno dhammo uppajjati nahetupaccayā – ahetukaṃ cittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhānaṃ ekaṃ khandhañca cittañca paṭicca dve khandhā, dve khandhe…pe… ahetukapaṭisandhikkhaṇe cittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhānaṃ ekaṃ khandhañca citañca…pe… ahetukapaṭisandhikkhaṇe cittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhānaṃ ekaṃ khandhañca vatthuñca paṭicca dve khandhā, dve khandhe…pe… vicikicchāsahagate uddhaccasahagate khandhe ca cittañca paṭicca vicikicchāsahagato uddhaccasahagato moho. (1)

284. Dependent on a phenomenon that is mind-associated and mind-originated and a phenomenon that is not mind-associated and mind-originated, a phenomenon that is mind-associated and mind-originated arises by way of non-root condition. For example: dependent on one rootless mind-associated and mind-originated aggregate and mind, two aggregates arise; two aggregates… (and so on)… at the moment of rootless rebirth-linking, dependent on one mind-associated and mind-originated aggregate and mind… (and so on)… at the moment of rootless rebirth-linking, dependent on one mind-associated and mind-originated aggregate and the base, two aggregates arise; two aggregates… (and so on)… dependent on the aggregates and mind accompanied by doubt and restlessness, delusion accompanied by doubt and restlessness arises. (1)

Cittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhānañca nocittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhānañca dhammaṃ paṭicca nocittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhāno dhammo uppajjati nahetupaccayā – ahetuke cittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhāne khandhe ca cittañca paṭicca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ, ahetuke cittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhāne khandhe ca mahābhūte ca paṭicca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ[V 3.0591]; ahetukapaṭisandhikkhaṇe cittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhāne khandhe [T 4.0134] ca cittañca paṭicca kaṭattārūpaṃ, ahetukapaṭisandhikkhaṇe cittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhāne khandhe ca mahābhūte ca paṭicca kaṭattārūpaṃ, ahetukapaṭisandhikkhaṇe cittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhāne khandhe ca vatthuñca paṭicca cittaṃ. (2)

Dependent on a phenomenon that is mind-associated and mind-originated and a phenomenon that is not mind-associated and mind-originated, a phenomenon that is not mind-associated and mind-originated arises by way of non-root condition. For example: dependent on rootless mind-associated and mind-originated aggregates and mind, mind-originated form arises; dependent on rootless mind-associated and mind-originated aggregates and great elements, mind-originated form arises; at the moment of rootless rebirth-linking, dependent on mind-associated and mind-originated aggregates and mind, kamma-originated form arises; at the moment of rootless rebirth-linking, dependent on mind-associated and mind-originated aggregates and great elements, kamma-originated form arises; at the moment of rootless rebirth-linking, dependent on mind-associated and mind-originated aggregates and the base, mind arises. (2)

Cittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhānañca nocittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhānañca dhammaṃ paṭicca cittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhāno ca nocittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhāno ca dhammā uppajjanti nahetupaccayā – ahetukaṃ cittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhānaṃ ekaṃ khandhañca cittañca paṭicca dve khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ, dve khandhe…pe… (ahetukapaṭisandhikkhaṇe dvepi kātabbā). (3)

Dependent on a phenomenon that is mind-associated and mind-originated and a phenomenon that is not mind-associated and mind-originated, both phenomena that are mind-associated and mind-originated and phenomena that are not mind-associated and mind-originated arise by way of non-root condition. For example: dependent on one rootless mind-associated and mind-originated aggregate and mind, two aggregates and mind-originated form arise; two aggregates… (and so on)… (at the moment of rootless rebirth-linking, both should be done). (3)

Naārammaṇapaccayo

Non-object Condition

285. Cittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhānaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca nocittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhāno dhammo uppajjati naārammaṇapaccayā – cittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhāne khandhe paṭicca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ; paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe…. (1)

285. A phenomenon that is mind-associated and mind-originated conditions a phenomenon that is not mind-associated and mind-originated, not by way of object condition—the mind-associated and mind-originated aggregates condition mind-originated material form; at the moment of rebirth-linking… (and so on). (1)

Nocittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhānaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca nocittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhāno dhammo uppajjati naārammaṇapaccayā – cittaṃ paṭicca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ; paṭisandhikkhaṇe cittaṃ paṭicca kaṭattārūpaṃ, cittaṃ paṭicca vatthu, ekaṃ mahābhūtaṃ…pe… (yāva asaññasattā). (1)

A phenomenon that is not mind-associated and mind-originated conditions a phenomenon that is not mind-associated and mind-originated, not by way of object condition—mind conditions mind-originated material form; at the moment of rebirth-linking, mind conditions kamma-produced material form; mind conditions the physical base; one great element… (and so on)… (up to non-percipient beings). (1)

Cittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhānañca nocittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhānañca dhammaṃ paṭicca nocittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhāno dhammo uppajjati naārammaṇapaccayā – cittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhāne khandhe [M 3.0480] ca cittañca paṭicca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ, cittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhāne khandhe ca mahābhūte ca paṭicca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ (paṭisandhikkhaṇe dve, saṃkhittaṃ). (1)

A phenomenon that is mind-associated and mind-originated, and a phenomenon that is not mind-associated and mind-originated, condition a phenomenon that is not mind-associated and mind-originated, not by way of object condition—the mind-associated and mind-originated aggregates and mind condition mind-originated material form; the mind-associated and mind-originated aggregates and the great elements condition mind-originated material form (two at the moment of rebirth-linking; in brief). (1)

A phenomenon neither mind-associated nor mind-originated conditions a phenomenon neither mind-associated nor mind-originated by way of Root Condition—mind conditions mind-originated material form; the physical base conditions mind; at the moment of rebirth-linking, etc. (up to the great elements). Nocittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhānaṃ dhammaṃ paccayā cittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhāno dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – cittaṃ paccayā sampayuttakā khandhā, vatthuṃ paccayā cittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhānā khandhā (paṭisandhikkhaṇe dvepi kātabbā) tīṇi. (3)

Ārammaṇapaccayo

Ārammaṇapaccayo

(Mūlaṃ kātabbaṃ) cittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhāne khandhe ārabbha cittaṃ uppajjati. (Mūlaṃ kātabbaṃ) cittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhāne khandhe ārabbha cittañca sampayuttakā ca khandhā uppajjanti. (3)

Tīṇipi sahajātā, nānākkhaṇikā)… vipākapaccayena paccayo… nava… āhārapaccayena paccayo… nava (cittasahabhūgamanasadisā, ekaṃyeva kabaḷīkāraṃ āhāraṃ)… indriyapaccayena paccayo… nava… jhānapaccayena paccayo… tīṇi… maggapaccayena paccayo… tīṇi… sampayuttapaccayena paccayo… pañca.

Vippayuttapaccayo

Vippayuttapaccayo

306. Cittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhāno dhammo nocittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhānassa dhammassa vippayuttapaccayena paccayo – sahajātaṃ, pacchājātaṃ (saṃkhittaṃ). (1)

306. Cittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhāno dhammo nocittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhānassa dhammassa vippayuttapaccayena paccayo – sahajātaṃ, pacchājātaṃ (saṃkhittaṃ). (1)

Nocittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhāno [M 3.0487] dhammo nocittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhānassa dhammassa vippayuttapaccayena paccayo – sahajātaṃ, purejātaṃ, pacchājātaṃ (saṃkhittaṃ). (1)

Nocittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhāno dhammo nocittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhānassa dhammassa vippayuttapaccayena paccayo – sahajātaṃ, purejātaṃ, pacchājātaṃ (saṃkhittaṃ). (1)

Nocittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhāno dhammo cittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhānassa dhammassa vippayuttapaccayena paccayo – sahajātaṃ, purejātaṃ. Sahajātaṃ – paṭisandhikkhaṇe vatthu cittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhānānaṃ khandhānaṃ vippayuttapaccayena paccayo. Purejātaṃ – cakkhāyatanaṃ cakkhuviññāṇasahagatānaṃ khandhānaṃ vippayuttapaccayena paccayo…pe… kāyāyatanaṃ…pe… vatthu cittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhānānaṃ khandhānaṃ vippayuttapaccayena paccayo. (2)

A phenomenon not arisen conjoined with mind is a condition by way of dissociation condition for a phenomenon arisen conjoined with mind—co-nascence, pre-nascence. Co-nascence: At the moment of rebirth-linking, the base is a condition by way of dissociation condition for the aggregates arisen conjoined with mind. Pre-nascence: The eye-base is a condition by way of dissociation condition for the aggregates co-arisen with eye-consciousness…pe… the body-base…pe… the base is a condition by way of dissociation condition for the aggregates arisen conjoined with mind. (2)

Nocittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhāno dhammo cittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhānassa ca nocittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhānassa ca dhammassa vippayuttapaccayena paccayo – sahajātaṃ, purejātaṃ. Sahajātaṃ – paṭisandhikkhaṇe vatthu cittassa sampayuttakānañca khandhānaṃ vippayuttapaccayena [T 4.0143] paccayo. Purejātaṃ – cakkhāyatanaṃ cakkhuviññāṇassa [V 3.0601] sampayuttakānañca khandhānaṃ vippayuttapaccayena paccayo…pe… kāyāyatanaṃ…pe… vatthu cittassa sampayuttakānañca khandhānaṃ vippayuttapaccayena paccayo. (3)

A phenomenon not arisen conjoined with mind is a condition by way of dissociation condition for a phenomenon arisen conjoined with mind and for a phenomenon not arisen conjoined with mind—co-nascence, pre-nascence. Co-nascence: At the moment of rebirth-linking, the base is a condition by way of dissociation condition for the mind and its associated aggregates. Pre-nascence: The eye-base is a condition by way of dissociation condition for eye-consciousness and its associated aggregates…pe… the body-base…pe… the base is a condition by way of dissociation condition for the mind and its associated aggregates. (3)

Cittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhāno ca nocittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhāno ca dhammā nocittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhānassa dhammassa vippayuttapaccayena paccayo – sahajātaṃ, pacchājātaṃ (saṃkhittaṃ).

Phenomena arisen conjoined with mind and phenomena not arisen conjoined with mind are a condition by way of dissociation condition for a phenomenon not arisen conjoined with mind—co-nascence, post-nascence (in brief).

Atthipaccayo

Presence Condition

307. Cittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhāno dhammo cittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhānassa dhammassa atthipaccayena paccayo (paṭiccasadisā). Cittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhāno dhammo nocittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhānassa dhammassa atthipaccayena paccayo – sahajātaṃ, pacchājātaṃ (saṃkhittaṃ). Cittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhāno dhammo cittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhānassa ca nocittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhānassa ca dhammassa atthipaccayena paccayo (paṭiccasadisā). (3)

307. A phenomenon arisen conjoined with mind is a condition by way of presence condition for a phenomenon arisen conjoined with mind (similar to the section on Dependence). A phenomenon arisen conjoined with mind is a condition by way of presence condition for a phenomenon not arisen conjoined with mind—co-nascence, post-nascence (in brief). A phenomenon arisen conjoined with mind is a condition by way of presence condition for a phenomenon arisen conjoined with mind and for a phenomenon not arisen conjoined with mind (similar to the section on Dependence). (3)

Nocittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhāno dhammo nocittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhānassa dhammassa atthipaccayena paccayo – sahajātaṃ, purejātaṃ, pacchājātaṃ, āhāraṃ, indriyaṃ (purejātasadisaṃ purejātaṃ kātabbaṃ. Sabbaṃ saṃkhittaṃ. Vitthāretabbaṃ). (1)

A phenomenon not arisen conjoined with mind is a condition by way of presence condition for a phenomenon not arisen conjoined with mind—co-nascence, pre-nascence, post-nascence, nutriment, faculty (the pre-nascence should be treated like the pre-nascence condition. All are in brief. It should be expanded). (1)

Nocittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhāno [M 3.0488] dhammo cittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhānassa dhammassa atthipaccayena paccayo – sahajātaṃ, purejātaṃ. Sahajātaṃ – cittaṃ sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo; paṭisandhikkhaṇe cittaṃ sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo, paṭisandhikkhaṇe vatthu cittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhānānaṃ khandhānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo. Purejātaṃ (purejātasadisaṃ, ninnānākaraṇaṃ). (2)

A phenomenon not arisen conjoined with mind is a condition by way of presence condition for a phenomenon arisen conjoined with mind—co-nascence, pre-nascence. Co-nascence: Mind is a condition by way of presence condition for its associated aggregates; at the moment of rebirth-linking, mind is a condition by way of presence condition for its associated aggregates; at the moment of rebirth-linking, the base is a condition by way of presence condition for the aggregates arisen conjoined with mind. Pre-nascence (similar to the pre-nascence condition, without distinction). (2)

Nocittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhāno dhammo cittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhānassa ca nocittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhānassa ca dhammassa atthipaccayena paccayo – sahajātaṃ, purejātaṃ. Sahajātaṃ – cittaṃ sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo; paṭisandhikkhaṇe cittaṃ sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ kaṭattā ca rūpānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo, paṭisandhikkhaṇe vatthu cittassa sampayuttakānañca khandhānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo. Purejātaṃ [T 4.0144] (purejātasadisaṃ). (3)

A phenomenon not arisen conjoined with mind is a condition by way of presence condition for a phenomenon arisen conjoined with mind and for a phenomenon not arisen conjoined with mind—co-nascence, pre-nascence. Co-nascence: Mind is a condition by way of presence condition for its associated aggregates and for mind-originated material phenomena; at the moment of rebirth-linking, mind is a condition by way of presence condition for its associated aggregates and for kamma-originated material phenomena; at the moment of rebirth-linking, the base is a condition by way of presence condition for the mind and its associated aggregates. Pre-nascence (similar to the pre-nascence condition). (3)

308. Cittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhāno [V 3.0602] ca nocittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhāno ca dhammā cittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhānassa dhammassa atthipaccayena paccayo – sahajātaṃ, purejātaṃ. Sahajāto – cakkhuviññāṇasahagato eko khandho ca cakkhuviññāṇañca dvinnaṃ khandhānaṃ…pe… dve khandhā ca…pe… cakkhuviññāṇasahagato eko khandho ca cakkhāyatanañca dvinnaṃ khandhānaṃ…pe… dve khandhā ca…pe… kāyaviññāṇasahagato…pe… cittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhāno eko khandho ca cittañca dvinnaṃ khandhānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo, dve khandhā ca…pe… cittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhāno eko khandho ca vatthu ca dvinnaṃ khandhānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo…pe… dve khandhā ca…pe… (paṭisandhikkhaṇe dvepi kātabbā). (1)

308. Phenomena arisen conjoined with mind and phenomena not arisen conjoined with mind are a condition by way of presence condition for a phenomenon arisen conjoined with mind—co-nascence, pre-nascence. Co-nascence: One aggregate co-arisen with eye-consciousness and eye-consciousness are a condition by way of presence condition for two aggregates…pe… and two aggregates…pe… One aggregate co-arisen with eye-consciousness and the eye-base are a condition by way of presence condition for two aggregates…pe… and two aggregates…pe… (This is to be expanded for body-consciousness, etc.) One aggregate arisen conjoined with mind and the mind are a condition by way of presence condition for two aggregates…pe… and two aggregates…pe… One aggregate arisen conjoined with mind and the base are a condition by way of presence condition for two aggregates…pe… and two aggregates…pe… (At the moment of rebirth-linking, both should be treated). (1)

Cittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhāno ca nocittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhāno ca dhammā nocittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhānassa dhammassa atthipaccayena paccayo – sahajātaṃ, purejātaṃ, pacchājātaṃ, āhāraṃ, indriyaṃ. Sahajātā – cakkhuviññāṇasahagatā khandhā ca cakkhāyatanañca cakkhuviññāṇassa atthipaccayena paccayo…pe… kāyaviññāṇasahagatā…pe… cittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhānā khandhā [T 4.0145] ca cittañca cittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo, cittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhānā khandhā ca mahābhūtā ca cittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo, cittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhānā khandhā ca vatthu ca cittassa atthipaccayena paccayo (paṭisandhikkhaṇe [M 3.0489] tīṇi kātabbā). Pacchājātā – cittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhānā khandhā ca cittañca purejātassa imassa nocittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhānassa kāyassa atthipaccayena paccayo. Pacchājātā – cittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhānā khandhā ca cittañca kabaḷīkāro āhāro ca imassa nocittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhānassa kāyassa atthipaccayena paccayo. Pacchājātā – cittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhānā khandhā ca cittañca rūpajīvitindriyañca kaṭattārūpānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo. (2)

Phenomena associated with consciousness and arisen from it and phenomena not associated with consciousness and not arisen from it are a condition by way of presence condition for a phenomenon not associated with consciousness and not arisen from it—co-nascence, pre-nascence, post-nascence, nutriment, faculty. Co-nascence: The aggregates co-nascent with eye-consciousness and the eye-base are a condition by way of presence condition for eye-consciousness… and so on for body-consciousness… The aggregates associated with consciousness and arisen from it and the mind are a condition by way of presence condition for mind-originated material phenomena. The aggregates associated with consciousness and arisen from it and the great elements are a condition by way of presence condition for mind-originated material phenomena. The aggregates associated with consciousness and arisen from it and the base are a condition by way of presence condition for the mind (at the moment of rebirth-linking, these three should be done). Post-nascence: The aggregates associated with consciousness and arisen from it and the mind are a condition by way of presence condition for this pre-existent body which is not associated with consciousness and not arisen from it. Post-nascence: The aggregates associated with consciousness and arisen from it, the mind, and edible food are a condition by way of presence condition for this body which is not associated with consciousness and not arisen from it. Post-nascence: The aggregates associated with consciousness and arisen from it, the mind, and the material life faculty are a condition by way of presence condition for kamma-originated material phenomena. (2)

Cittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhāno ca nocittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhāno ca dhammā cittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhānassa ca nocittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhānassa ca dhammassa atthipaccayena paccayo – sahajātaṃ, purejātaṃ. Sahajāto – cakkhuviññāṇasahagato eko khandho ca cakkhāyatanañca dvinnaṃ khandhānaṃ cakkhuviññāṇassa ca atthipaccayena paccayo, dve khandhā ca…pe… kāyaviññāṇasahagato…pe…. Sahajāto – cittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhāno eko khandho ca cittañca dvinnaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo, dve khandhā ca…pe… cittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhāno eko khandho ca vatthu ca dvinnaṃ [V 3.0603] khandhānaṃ cittassa ca atthipaccayena paccayo, dve khandhā ca…pe… (paṭisandhikkhaṇe dvepi kātabbā). (3)

Phenomena associated with consciousness and arisen from it and phenomena not associated with consciousness and not arisen from it are a condition by way of presence condition for a phenomenon associated with consciousness and arisen from it and for a phenomenon not associated with consciousness and not arisen from it—co-nascence, pre-nascence. Co-nascence: One aggregate co-nascent with eye-consciousness and the eye-base are a condition by way of presence condition for two aggregates and for eye-consciousness; two aggregates… and so on for body-consciousness… Co-nascence: One aggregate associated with consciousness and arisen from it and the mind are a condition by way of presence condition for two aggregates and for mind-originated material phenomena; two aggregates… and so on… One aggregate associated with consciousness and arisen from it and the base are a condition by way of presence condition for two aggregates and for the mind; two aggregates… and so on… (at the moment of rebirth-linking, both should be done). (3)

310. Cittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhāno dhammo cittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhānassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo… sahajātapaccayena paccayo… upanissayapaccayena paccayo… kammapaccayena paccayo. (1)

310. A phenomenon associated with consciousness and arisen from it is a condition for a phenomenon associated with consciousness and arisen from it by way of object condition… by way of co-nascence condition… by way of decisive support condition… by way of kamma condition. (1)

Cittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhāno [M 3.0490] dhammo nocittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhānassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo… sahajātapaccayena paccayo… upanissayapaccayena paccayo… pacchājātapaccayena paccayo… kammapaccayena paccayo. (2)

A phenomenon associated with consciousness and arisen from it is a condition for a phenomenon not associated with consciousness and not arisen from it by way of object condition… by way of co-nascence condition… by way of decisive support condition… by way of post-nascence condition… by way of kamma condition. (2)

Cittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhāno dhammo cittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhānassa ca nocittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhānassa ca dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena [V 3.0604] paccayo… sahajātapaccayena paccayo… upanissayapaccayena paccayo… kammapaccayena paccayo. (3)

A phenomenon associated with consciousness and arisen from it is a condition for a phenomenon associated with consciousness and arisen from it and for a phenomenon not associated with consciousness and not arisen from it by way of object condition… by way of co-nascence condition… by way of decisive support condition… by way of kamma condition. (3)

311. Nocittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhāno dhammo nocittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhānassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo… sahajātapaccayena paccayo… upanissayapaccayena paccayo… purejātapaccayena paccayo… pacchājātapaccayena paccayo… āhārapaccayena paccayo… indriyapaccayena paccayo. (1)

311. A phenomenon not associated with consciousness and not arisen from it is a condition for a phenomenon not associated with consciousness and not arisen from it by way of object condition… by way of co-nascence condition… by way of decisive support condition… by way of pre-nascence condition… by way of post-nascence condition… by way of nutriment condition… by way of faculty condition. (1)

Nocittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhāno dhammo cittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhānassa [T 4.0147] dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo… sahajātapaccayena paccayo… upanissayapaccayena paccayo… purejātapaccayena paccayo. (2)

A phenomenon not associated with consciousness and not arisen from it is a condition for a phenomenon associated with consciousness and arisen from it by way of object condition… by way of co-nascence condition… by way of decisive support condition… by way of pre-nascence condition. (2)

Nocittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhāno dhammo cittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhānassa ca nocittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhānassa ca dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo… sahajātapaccayena paccayo… upanissayapaccayena paccayo… purejātapaccayena paccayo. (3)

A phenomenon not associated with consciousness and not arisen from it is a condition for a phenomenon associated with consciousness and arisen from it and for a phenomenon not associated with consciousness and not arisen from it by way of object condition… by way of co-nascence condition… by way of decisive support condition… by way of pre-nascence condition. (3)

312. Cittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhāno ca nocittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhāno ca dhammā cittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhānassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo… sahajātapaccayena paccayo… upanissayapaccayena paccayo. (1)

312. A phenomenon associated with consciousness and arisen from it and a phenomenon not associated with consciousness and not arisen from it are conditions for a phenomenon associated with consciousness and arisen from it by way of object condition… by way of co-nascence condition… by way of decisive support condition. (1)

Cittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhāno ca nocittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhāno ca dhammā nocittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhānassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo… sahajātapaccayena paccayo… upanissayapaccayena paccayo… pacchājātapaccayena paccayo. (2)

A phenomenon associated with consciousness and arisen from it and a phenomenon not associated with consciousness and not arisen from it are conditions for a phenomenon not associated with consciousness and not arisen from it by way of object condition… by way of co-nascence condition… by way of decisive support condition… by way of post-nascence condition. (2)

Cittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhāno ca nocittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhāno ca dhammā cittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhānassa ca nocittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhānassa ca dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo… sahajātapaccayena paccayo… upanissayapaccayena paccayo. (3)

A phenomenon associated with consciousness and arisen therefrom and a phenomenon not associated with consciousness and not arisen therefrom are related to a phenomenon associated with consciousness and arisen therefrom and to a phenomenon not associated with consciousness and not arisen therefrom by object condition… by conascence condition… by decisive support condition. (3)

Hetupaccayo

Root Condition

318. Ajjhattikaṃ [V 3.0608] dhammaṃ paṭicca ajjhattiko dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – paṭisandhikkhaṇe cittaṃ paṭicca ajjhattikaṃ kaṭattārūpaṃ. (1)

318. Dependent on an internal phenomenon, an internal phenomenon arises by root condition: at the moment of rebirth-linking, dependent on the mind, internal kamma-produced materiality arises. (1)

Ajjhattikaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca bāhiro dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – cittaṃ paṭicca sampayuttakā khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ; paṭisandhikkhaṇe cittaṃ paṭicca sampayuttakā khandhā bāhiraṃ kaṭattā ca rūpaṃ. (2)

Dependent on an internal phenomenon, an external phenomenon arises by root condition: dependent on the mind, the associated aggregates and mind-originated materiality arise; at the moment of rebirth-linking, dependent on the mind, the associated aggregates and external kamma-produced materiality arise. (2)

Ajjhattikaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca ajjhattiko ca bāhiro ca dhammā uppajjanti hetupaccayā – paṭisandhikkhaṇe cittaṃ paṭicca sampayuttakā khandhā ajjhattikañca bāhirañca kaṭattārūpaṃ. (3)

Dependent on an internal phenomenon, both internal and external phenomena arise by root condition: at the moment of rebirth-linking, dependent on the mind, the associated aggregates and both internal and external kamma-produced materiality arise. (3)

319. Bāhiraṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca bāhiro dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – bāhiraṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca dve khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ, dve khandhe…pe… paṭisandhikkhaṇe bāhiraṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca dve khandhā bāhiraṃ kaṭattā ca rūpaṃ, dve khandhe…pe… khandhe paṭicca vatthu, vatthuṃ paṭicca khandhā, ekaṃ [T 4.0150] mahābhūtaṃ…pe… mahābhūte paṭicca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ kaṭattārūpaṃ upādārūpaṃ. (1)

319. Dependent on an external phenomenon, an external phenomenon arises by root condition: dependent on one external aggregate, two aggregates and mind-originated materiality arise; dependent on two aggregates… At the moment of rebirth-linking, dependent on one external aggregate, two aggregates and external kamma-produced materiality arise; dependent on two aggregates… Dependent on the aggregates, the physical base arises; dependent on the physical base, the aggregates arise; dependent on one great element… Dependent on the great elements, mind-originated materiality, kamma-produced materiality, and derived materiality arise. (1)

Bāhiraṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca ajjhattiko dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – bāhire khandhe paṭicca [V 3.0609] cittaṃ; paṭisandhikkhaṇe bāhire khandhe paṭicca cittaṃ ajjhattikaṃ kaṭattā ca rūpaṃ, paṭisandhikkhaṇe bāhiraṃ vatthuṃ paṭicca cittaṃ. (2)

Dependent on an external phenomenon, an internal phenomenon arises by root condition: dependent on external aggregates, the mind arises; at the moment of rebirth-linking, dependent on external aggregates, the mind and internal kamma-produced materiality arise; at the moment of rebirth-linking, dependent on an external physical base, the mind arises. (2)

Bāhiraṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca ajjhattiko ca bāhiro ca dhammā uppajjanti hetupaccayā – bāhiraṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca dve khandhā cittañca cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ, dve khandhe…pe… paṭisandhikkhaṇe bāhiraṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca dve khandhā cittañca ajjhattikañca bāhirañca kaṭattārūpaṃ[M 3.0493], dve khandhe…pe… paṭisandhikkhaṇe vatthuṃ paṭicca cittaṃ sampayuttakā ca khandhā. (3)

Dependent on an external phenomenon, both internal and external phenomena arise by root condition: dependent on one external aggregate, two aggregates, the mind, and mind-originated materiality arise; dependent on two aggregates… at the moment of rebirth-linking, dependent on one external aggregate, two aggregates, the mind, and both internal and external kamma-produced materiality arise; dependent on two aggregates… at the moment of rebirth-linking, dependent on the physical base, the mind and the associated aggregates arise. (3)

320. Ajjhattikañca bāhirañca dhammaṃ paṭicca ajjhattiko dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – paṭisandhikkhaṇe cittañca sampayuttake ca khandhe paṭicca ajjhattikaṃ kaṭattārūpaṃ. (1)

320. An internal and an external phenomenon condition an internal phenomenon by way of root condition: at the moment of rebirth-linking, mind and associated aggregates condition internal kamma-produced materiality. (1)

Ajjhattikañca bāhirañca dhammaṃ paṭicca bāhiro dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – bāhiraṃ ekaṃ khandhañca cittañca paṭicca dve khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ, dve khandhe ca…pe… cittañca mahābhūte ca paṭicca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ; paṭisandhikkhaṇe bāhiraṃ ekaṃ khandhañca cittañca paṭicca dve khandhā bāhiraṃ kaṭattā ca rūpaṃ, dve khandhe ca…pe… cittañca mahābhūte ca paṭicca bāhiraṃ kaṭattārūpaṃ, paṭisandhikkhaṇe cittañca vatthuñca paṭicca bāhirā khandhā. (2)

An internal and an external phenomenon condition an external phenomenon by way of root condition: one external aggregate and mind condition two aggregates and mind-originated materiality; two aggregates, etc. … mind and the great elements condition mind-originated materiality. At the moment of rebirth-linking, one external aggregate and mind condition two aggregates and external kamma-produced materiality; two aggregates, etc. … mind and the great elements condition external kamma-produced materiality. At the moment of rebirth-linking, mind and the base condition external aggregates. (2)

Ajjhattikañca bāhirañca dhammaṃ paṭicca ajjhattiko ca bāhiro ca dhammā uppajjanti hetupaccayā [T 4.0151] – paṭisandhikkhaṇe bāhiraṃ ekaṃ khandhañca cittañca paṭicca dve khandhā ajjhattikañca bāhirañca kaṭattārūpaṃ, dve khandhe ca…pe…. (3)

An internal and an external phenomenon condition an internal and an external phenomenon by way of root condition: at the moment of rebirth-linking, one external aggregate and mind condition two aggregates and both internal and external kamma-produced materiality; two aggregates, etc. …. (3)

Ārammaṇapaccayo

Object Condition

321. Ajjhattikaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca bāhiro dhammo uppajjati ārammaṇapaccayā – cittaṃ paṭicca sampayuttakā khandhā; paṭisandhikkhaṇe cittaṃ paṭicca sampayuttakā khandhā. (1)

321. An internal phenomenon conditions an external phenomenon by way of object condition: mind conditions associated aggregates; at the moment of rebirth-linking, mind conditions associated aggregates. (1)

Bāhiraṃ [V 3.0610] dhammaṃ paṭicca bāhiro dhammo uppajjati ārammaṇapaccayā – bāhiraṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca dve khandhā, dve khandhe…pe… paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe… vatthuṃ paṭicca khandhā. (1)

An external phenomenon conditions an external phenomenon by way of object condition: one external aggregate conditions two aggregates; two aggregates, etc. … at the moment of rebirth-linking, etc. … the physical base conditions aggregates. (1)

Bāhiraṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca ajjhattiko dhammo uppajjati ārammaṇapaccayā – bāhire khandhe paṭicca cittaṃ; paṭisandhikkhaṇe bāhire khandhe paṭicca cittaṃ, paṭisandhikkhaṇe vatthuṃ paṭicca cittaṃ. (2)

An external phenomenon conditions an internal phenomenon by way of object condition: external aggregates condition mind; at the moment of rebirth-linking, external aggregates condition mind; at the moment of rebirth-linking, the physical base conditions mind. (2)

Bāhiraṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca ajjhattiko ca bāhiro ca dhammā uppajjanti ārammaṇapaccayā – bāhiraṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca dve khandhā cittañca, dve khandhe…pe… paṭisandhikkhaṇe bāhiraṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca dve khandhā cittañca, dve khandhe…pe… paṭisandhikkhaṇe vatthuṃ paṭicca cittaṃ sampayuttakā ca khandhā. (3)

An external phenomenon conditions an internal and an external phenomenon by way of object condition: one external aggregate conditions two aggregates and mind; two aggregates, etc. … At the moment of rebirth-linking, one external aggregate conditions two aggregates and mind; two aggregates, etc. … At the moment of rebirth-linking, the physical base conditions mind and associated aggregates. (3)

Ajjhattikañca [M 3.0494] bāhirañca dhammaṃ paṭicca bāhiro dhammo uppajjati ārammaṇapaccayā – bāhiraṃ ekaṃ khandhañca cittañca paṭicca dve khandhā, dve khandhe ca…pe… paṭisandhikkhaṇe bāhiraṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ cittañca paṭicca dve khandhā, dve khandhe ca…pe… paṭisandhikkhaṇe bāhiraṃ ekaṃ khandhañca cittañca vatthuñca paṭicca dve khandhā, dve khandhe ca…pe… (saṃkhittaṃ). (1)

An internal and an external phenomenon condition an external phenomenon by way of object condition: one external aggregate and mind condition two aggregates; two aggregates, etc. … at the moment of rebirth-linking, one external aggregate and mind condition two aggregates; two aggregates, etc. … at the moment of rebirth-linking, one external aggregate, mind, and the physical base condition two aggregates; two aggregates, etc. … (abbreviated). (1)

Nahetupaccayo

Non-Root Condition

323. Ajjhattikaṃ [V 3.0611] dhammaṃ paṭicca ajjhattiko dhammo uppajjati nahetupaccayā – ahetukapaṭisandhikkhaṇe cittaṃ paṭicca ajjhattikaṃ kaṭattārūpaṃ. (1)

323. Dependent on an internal phenomenon, an internal phenomenon arises by way of non-root condition: at the moment of rootless rebirth-linking, consciousness conditions internal kamma-produced materiality. (1)

Ajjhattikaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca bāhiro dhammo uppajjati nahetupaccayā – ahetukaṃ cittaṃ paṭicca sampayuttakā khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ; ahetukapaṭisandhikkhaṇe cittaṃ paṭicca sampayuttakā khandhā bāhiraṃ kaṭattā ca rūpaṃ, vicikicchāsahagataṃ uddhaccasahagataṃ cittaṃ paṭicca vicikicchāsahagato uddhaccasahagato moho. (2)

Dependent on an internal phenomenon, an external phenomenon arises by way of non-root condition: rootless consciousness conditions the associated aggregates and mind-originated materiality; at the moment of rootless rebirth-linking, consciousness conditions the associated aggregates and external kamma-produced materiality; consciousness accompanied by doubt and consciousness accompanied by restlessness condition delusion accompanied by doubt and delusion accompanied by restlessness. (2)

Ajjhattikaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca ajjhattiko ca bāhiro ca dhammā uppajjanti nahetupaccayā – ahetukapaṭisandhikkhaṇe cittaṃ paṭicca sampayuttakā khandhā ajjhattikañca bāhirañca kaṭattārūpaṃ. (3)

Dependent on an internal phenomenon, an internal and an external phenomenon arise by way of non-root condition: at the moment of rootless rebirth-linking, consciousness conditions the associated aggregates and both internal and external kamma-produced materiality. (3)

324. Bāhiraṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca bāhiro dhammo uppajjati nahetupaccayā – ahetukaṃ bāhiraṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca dve khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ, dve khandhe…pe… ahetukapaṭisandhikkhaṇe [M 3.0495] …pe… (yāva asaññasattā) vicikicchāsahagate uddhaccasahagate khandhe paṭicca vicikicchāsahagato uddhaccasahagato moho[T 4.0153]. (1)

324. Dependent on an external phenomenon, an external phenomenon arises by way of non-root condition: one rootless external aggregate conditions two aggregates and mind-originated materiality; two aggregates, etc. … at the moment of rootless rebirth-linking, etc. … (up to non-percipient beings); aggregates accompanied by doubt and aggregates accompanied by restlessness condition delusion accompanied by doubt and delusion accompanied by restlessness. (1)

Bāhiraṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca ajjhattiko dhammo uppajjati nahetupaccayā – ahetuke bāhire khandhe paṭicca cittaṃ; ahetukapaṭisandhikkhaṇe bāhire khandhe paṭicca cittaṃ ajjhattikaṃ kaṭattā ca rūpaṃ, ahetukapaṭisandhikkhaṇe vatthuṃ paṭicca cittaṃ. (2)

Dependent on an external phenomenon, an internal phenomenon arises by way of non-root condition: rootless external aggregates condition consciousness; at the moment of rootless rebirth-linking, external aggregates condition consciousness and internal kamma-produced materiality; at the moment of rootless rebirth-linking, the base conditions consciousness. (2)

Bāhiraṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca ajjhattiko ca bāhiro ca dhammā uppajjanti nahetupaccayā – ahetukaṃ bāhiraṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca dve khandhā cittañca cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ, dve khandhe [V 3.0612]…pe… ahetukapaṭisandhikkhaṇe bāhiraṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca dve khandhā cittañca ajjhattikañca bāhirañca kaṭattārūpaṃ, ahetukapaṭisandhikkhaṇe vatthuṃ paṭicca cittaṃ sampayuttakā ca khandhā. (3)

Both internal and external phenomena arise dependent on an external phenomenon by way of non-root condition: one rootless external aggregate conditions two aggregates, consciousness, and mind-originated materiality; two aggregates... and so on; at the moment of rootless rebirth-linking, one external aggregate conditions two aggregates, consciousness, and both internal and external kamma-produced materiality; at the moment of rootless rebirth-linking, the physical base conditions consciousness and the associated aggregates. (3)

325. Ajjhattikañca bāhirañca dhammaṃ paṭicca ajjhattiko dhammo uppajjati nahetupaccayā – ahetukapaṭisandhikkhaṇe cittañca sampayuttake ca khandhe paṭicca ajjhattikaṃ kaṭattārūpaṃ. (1)

325. An internal phenomenon arises dependent on an internal and an external phenomenon by way of non-root condition: at the moment of rootless rebirth-linking, consciousness and the associated aggregates condition internal kamma-produced materiality. (1)

Ajjhattikañca bāhirañca dhammaṃ paṭicca bāhiro dhammo uppajjati nahetupaccayā – ahetukaṃ bāhiraṃ ekaṃ khandhañca cittañca paṭicca dve khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ, dve khandhe…pe… ahetukaṃ cittañca mahābhūte ca paṭicca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ; ahetukapaṭisandhikkhaṇe bāhiraṃ ekaṃ khandhañca cittañca paṭicca dve khandhā bāhiraṃ kaṭattā ca rūpaṃ; ahetukapaṭisandhikkhaṇe cittañca mahābhūte ca paṭicca bāhiraṃ kaṭattārūpaṃ, ahetukapaṭisandhikkhaṇe cittañca vatthuñca paṭicca bāhirā khandhā, vicikicchāsahagate uddhaccasahagate khandhe ca cittañca [T 4.0154] paṭicca vicikicchāsahagato uddhaccasahagato moho. (2)

An external phenomenon arises dependent on an internal and an external phenomenon by way of non-root condition: one rootless external aggregate and consciousness condition two aggregates and mind-originated materiality; two aggregates... and so on; rootless consciousness and the great elements condition mind-originated materiality; at the moment of rootless rebirth-linking, one external aggregate and consciousness condition two aggregates and external kamma-produced materiality; at the moment of rootless rebirth-linking, consciousness and the great elements condition external kamma-produced materiality; at the moment of rootless rebirth-linking, consciousness and the physical base condition the external aggregates; doubt-accompanied and restlessness-accompanied aggregates and consciousness condition doubt-accompanied and restlessness-accompanied delusion. (2)

Ajjhattikañca bāhirañca dhammaṃ paṭicca ajjhattiko ca bāhiro ca dhammā uppajjanti nahetupaccayā – ahetukapaṭisandhikkhaṇe bāhiraṃ ekaṃ khandhañca cittañca paṭicca dve khandhā ajjhattikañca bāhirañca kaṭattārūpaṃ, dve khandhe ca…pe…. (3)

Both internal and external phenomena arise dependent on an internal and an external phenomenon by way of non-root condition: at the moment of rootless rebirth-linking, one external aggregate and consciousness condition two aggregates and both internal and external kamma-produced materiality; two aggregates... and so on. (3)

Naārammaṇapaccayo

Non-object Condition

326. Ajjhattikaṃ [M 3.0496] dhammaṃ paṭicca ajjhattiko dhammo uppajjati naārammaṇapaccayā – paṭisandhikkhaṇe cittaṃ paṭicca ajjhattikaṃ kaṭattārūpaṃ. (1)

326. An internal phenomenon arises dependent on an internal phenomenon by way of non-object condition: at the moment of rebirth-linking, consciousness conditions internal kamma-produced materiality. (1)

Ajjhattikaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca bāhiro dhammo uppajjati naārammaṇapaccayā – cittaṃ paṭicca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ; paṭisandhikkhaṇe cittaṃ paṭicca bāhiraṃ kaṭattārūpaṃ. (2)

An external phenomenon arises dependent on an internal phenomenon by way of non-object condition: consciousness conditions mind-originated materiality; at the moment of rebirth-linking, consciousness conditions external kamma-produced materiality. (2)

Ajjhattikaṃ [V 3.0613] dhammaṃ paṭicca ajjhattiko ca bāhiro ca dhammā uppajjanti naārammaṇapaccayā; paṭisandhikkhaṇe cittaṃ paṭicca ajjhattikañca bāhirañca kaṭattārūpaṃ. (3)

Both internal and external phenomena arise dependent on an internal phenomenon by way of non-object condition: at the moment of rebirth-linking, consciousness conditions both internal and external kamma-produced materiality. (3)

Bāhiraṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca bāhiro dhammo uppajjati naārammaṇapaccayā – bāhire khandhe paṭicca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ; paṭisandhikkhaṇe bāhire khandhe paṭicca bāhiraṃ kaṭattārūpaṃ, bāhire khandhe paṭicca vatthu, ekaṃ mahābhūtaṃ…pe… (yāva asaññasattā). (1)

An external phenomenon arises dependent on an external phenomenon by way of non-object condition: external aggregates condition mind-originated materiality; at the moment of rebirth-linking, external aggregates condition external kamma-produced materiality; external aggregates condition the physical base; one great element... and so on, up to non-percipient beings. (1)

Bāhiraṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca ajjhattiko dhammo uppajjati naārammaṇapaccayā – paṭisandhikkhaṇe bāhire khandhe paṭicca ajjhattikaṃ kaṭattārūpaṃ. (2)

An internal phenomenon arises dependent on an external phenomenon by way of non-object condition: at the moment of rebirth-linking, external aggregates condition internal kamma-produced materiality. (2)

Bāhiraṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca ajjhattiko ca bāhiro ca dhammā uppajjanti naārammaṇapaccayā – paṭisandhikkhaṇe bāhire khandhe paṭicca ajjhattikañca bāhirañca kaṭattārūpaṃ. (3)

Both internal and external phenomena arise dependent on an external phenomenon by way of non-object condition: at the moment of rebirth-linking, the external aggregates condition both internal and external kamma-produced materiality. (3)

327. Ajjhattikañca [T 4.0155] bāhirañca dhammaṃ paṭicca ajjhattiko dhammo uppajjati naārammaṇapaccayā – paṭisandhikkhaṇe cittañca sampayuttake ca khandhe paṭicca ajjhattikaṃ kaṭattārūpaṃ. (1)

327. An internal phenomenon arises dependent on an internal and an external phenomenon by way of non-object condition: at the moment of rebirth-linking, consciousness and the associated aggregates condition internal kamma-produced materiality. (1)

Ajjhattikañca bāhirañca dhammaṃ paṭicca bāhiro dhammo uppajjati naārammaṇapaccayā – bāhire khandhe ca cittañca paṭicca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ, cittañca mahābhūte ca paṭicca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ (paṭisandhikkhaṇe dve kātabbā).

An external phenomenon arises dependent on an internal and an external phenomenon by way of non-object condition: external aggregates and consciousness condition mind-originated materiality; consciousness and the great elements condition mind-originated materiality (at rebirth-linking, two cases should be made).

Ajjhattikañca bāhirañca dhammaṃ paṭicca ajjhattiko ca bāhiro ca dhammā uppajjanti naārammaṇapaccayā – paṭisandhikkhaṇe cittañca sampayuttake ca khandhe paṭicca ajjhattikañca bāhirañca kaṭattārūpaṃ (saṃkhittaṃ). (3)

Both internal and external phenomena arise dependent on an internal and an external phenomenon by way of non-object condition: at the moment of rebirth-linking, consciousness and the associated aggregates condition both internal and external kamma-produced materiality (in brief). (3)

Najhānapaccayo

Non-jhāna Condition

328. Ajjhattikaṃ [M 3.0497][V 3.0614] dhammaṃ paṭicca bāhiro dhammo uppajjati najhānapaccayā – cakkhuviññāṇaṃ paṭicca sampayuttakā khandhā…pe… kāyaviññāṇaṃ…pe….

328. An external phenomenon arises dependent on an internal phenomenon by way of non-jhāna condition: dependent on eye-consciousness, the associated aggregates arise… and so on; dependent on body-consciousness… and so on.

Bāhiraṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca bāhiro dhammo uppajjati najhānapaccayā – cakkhuviññāṇasahagataṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca dve khandhā, dve khandhe…pe… kāyaviññāṇasahagataṃ…pe… bāhiraṃ… āhārasamuṭṭhānaṃ… utusamuṭṭhānaṃ… asaññasattānaṃ…pe…. Bāhiraṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca ajjhattiko dhammo uppajjati najhānapaccayā – cakkhuviññāṇasahagate khandhe paṭicca cakkhuviññāṇaṃ…pe… kāyaviññāṇasahagate khandhe paṭicca kāyaviññāṇaṃ[T 4.0156]. Bāhiraṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca ajjhattiko ca bāhiro ca dhammā uppajjanti najhānapaccayā – cakkhuviññāṇasahagataṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca dve khandhā cakkhuviññāṇañca, dve khandhe…pe… kāyaviññāṇasahagataṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ…pe…. (3)

An external phenomenon arises dependent on an external phenomenon by way of non-jhāna condition: dependent on one aggregate associated with eye-consciousness, two aggregates arise; dependent on two aggregates… and so on; associated with body-consciousness… and so on; external… nutriment-originated… temperature-originated… of non-percipient beings… and so on. An internal phenomenon arises dependent on an external phenomenon by way of non-jhāna condition: dependent on the aggregates associated with eye-consciousness, eye-consciousness arises… and so on; dependent on the aggregates associated with body-consciousness, body-consciousness arises. Both internal and external phenomena arise dependent on an external phenomenon by way of non-jhāna condition: dependent on one aggregate associated with eye-consciousness, two aggregates and eye-consciousness arise; dependent on two aggregates… and so on; dependent on one aggregate associated with body-consciousness… and so on. (3)

Ajjhattikañca bāhirañca dhammaṃ paṭicca bāhiro dhammo uppajjati najhānapaccayā – cakkhuviññāṇasahagataṃ ekaṃ khandhañca cakkhuviññāṇañca paṭicca dve khandhā, dve khandhe…pe… kāyaviññāṇaṃ (cakkaṃ).

Dependent on an internal phenomenon and an external phenomenon, an external phenomenon arises by way of non-jhāna condition: dependent on one aggregate associated with eye-consciousness and on eye-consciousness, two aggregates arise; dependent on two aggregates… and so on, up to body-consciousness (the wheel).

2. Paccayapaccanīyaṃ

2. Saṅkhyāvāro

2. The Numerical Section

329. Nahetuyā nava, naārammaṇe nava, naadhipatiyā nava, naanantare nava (sabbattha nava), nakamme tīṇi, navipāke pañca, naāhāre ekaṃ, naindriye ekaṃ, najhāne pañca, namagge nava, nasampayutte nava, navippayutte pañca, nonatthiyā nava, novigate nava.

329. By way of non-root condition, nine; by way of non-object condition, nine; by way of non-predominance condition, nine; by way of non-contiguity condition, nine (nine in all cases); by way of non-kamma condition, three; by way of non-resultant condition, five; by way of non-nutriment condition, one; by way of non-faculty condition, one; by way of non-jhāna condition, five; by way of non-path condition, nine; by way of non-association condition, nine; by way of non-dissociation condition, five; by way of non-absence condition, nine; by way of non-disappearance condition, nine.

3. Paccayānulomapaccanīyaṃ

3. The Affirmation-Negation of Conditions

330. Hetupaccayā naārammaṇe nava, naadhipatiyā nava (saṃkhittaṃ).

330. By way of root condition, nine are by way of non-object condition; nine are by way of non-predominance condition (abbreviated).

4. Paccayapaccanīyānulomaṃ

4. The Negation-Affirmation of Conditions

331. Nahetupaccayā [V 3.0615] ārammaṇe pañca, anantare pañca, samanantare pañca, sahajāte nava…pe… magge tīṇi (saṃkhittaṃ).

331. By way of non-root condition, five are by way of object condition; five are by way of contiguity condition; five are by way of immediate contiguity condition; nine are by way of co-nascence condition… and so on; three are by way of path condition (abbreviated).

Hetupaccayo

Root Condition

332. Ajjhattikaṃ [M 3.0498] dhammaṃ paccayā ajjhattiko dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā… tīṇi (paṭiccasadisā).

332. Dependent on an internal phenomenon, an internal phenomenon arises by way of root condition… three (similar to the Dependence Section).

Bāhiraṃ dhammaṃ paccayā bāhiro dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – bāhiraṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paccayā dve khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ, dve khandhe…pe… (paṭisandhikkhaṇe dvepi kātabbā, yāva ajjhattikā mahābhūtā) vatthuṃ paccayā [T 4.0157] bāhirā khandhā. Bāhiraṃ dhammaṃ paccayā ajjhattiko dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – bāhire khandhe paccayā cittaṃ, vatthuṃ paccayā cittaṃ (paṭisandhikkhaṇe dvepi kātabbā). Bāhiraṃ dhammaṃ paccayā ajjhattiko ca bāhiro ca dhammā uppajjanti hetupaccayā – bāhiraṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paccayā dve khandhā cittañca cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ, dve khandhe…pe… vatthuṃ paccayā cittaṃ sampayuttakā ca khandhā (paṭisandhikkhaṇe dvepi kātabbā). (3)

Dependent on an external phenomenon, an external phenomenon arises by way of root condition: dependent on one external aggregate, two aggregates and mind-originated materiality arise; dependent on two aggregates… and so on… (at the moment of rebirth-linking, both should be included, up to the internal great elements); dependent on the physical base, external aggregates arise. Dependent on an external phenomenon, an internal phenomenon arises by way of root condition: dependent on external aggregates, consciousness arises; dependent on the physical base, consciousness arises (at the moment of rebirth-linking, both should be included). Dependent on an external phenomenon, both an internal phenomenon and an external phenomenon arise by way of root condition: dependent on one external aggregate, two aggregates, consciousness, and mind-originated materiality arise; dependent on two aggregates… and so on; dependent on the physical base, consciousness and associated aggregates arise (at the moment of rebirth-linking, both should be included). (3)

333. Ajjhattikañca [V 3.0616] bāhirañca dhammaṃ paccayā ajjhattiko dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – paṭisandhikkhaṇe cittañca sampayuttake ca khandhe paccayā ajjhattikaṃ kaṭattārūpaṃ. Ajjhattikañca bāhirañca dhammaṃ paccayā bāhiro dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – bāhiraṃ ekaṃ khandhañca cittañca paccayā dve khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ, dve khandhe…pe… cittañca mahābhūte ca paccayā cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ, cittañca vatthuñca paccayā bāhirā khandhā (paṭisandhikkhaṇe tīṇipi kātabbā). Ajjhattikañca bāhirañca dhammaṃ paccayā ajjhattiko ca bāhiro ca dhammā uppajjanti hetupaccayā – paṭisandhikkhaṇe bāhiraṃ ekaṃ khandhañca cittañca paccayā dve khandhā ajjhattikañca bāhirañca kaṭattārūpaṃ, dve khandhe…pe…. (3)

333. Dependent on an internal phenomenon and an external phenomenon, an internal phenomenon arises by way of root condition: at the moment of rebirth-linking, dependent on consciousness and its associated aggregates, internal kamma-produced materiality arises. Dependent on an internal phenomenon and an external phenomenon, an external phenomenon arises by way of root condition: dependent on one external aggregate and on consciousness, two aggregates and mind-originated materiality arise; dependent on two aggregates… and so on; dependent on consciousness and the great elements, mind-originated materiality arises; dependent on consciousness and the physical base, external aggregates arise (at the moment of rebirth-linking, all three should be included). Dependent on an internal phenomenon and an external phenomenon, both an internal phenomenon and an external phenomenon arise by way of root condition: at the moment of rebirth-linking, dependent on one external aggregate and on consciousness, two aggregates and both internal and external kamma-produced materiality arise; dependent on two aggregates… and so on. (3)

Ārammaṇapaccayo

Object Condition

334. Ajjhattikaṃ dhammaṃ paccayā ajjhattiko dhammo uppajjati ārammaṇapaccayā – cakkhāyatanaṃ paccayā cakkhuviññāṇaṃ…pe… kāyāyatanaṃ [T 4.0158] …pe…. Ajjhattikaṃ dhammaṃ paccayā bāhiro dhammo uppajjati ārammaṇapaccayā – cakkhāyatanañca [M 3.0499] cakkhuviññāṇañca paccayā cakkhuviññāṇasahagatā khandhā…pe… kāyāyatanañca…pe… cittaṃ paccayā sampayuttakā khandhā; paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe…. Ajjhattikaṃ dhammaṃ paccayā ajjhattiko ca bāhiro ca dhammā uppajjanti ārammaṇapaccayā – cakkhāyatanaṃ paccayā cakkhuviññāṇaṃ sampayuttakā ca khandhā…pe… kāyāyatanaṃ…pe…. (3)

334. Dependent on an internal phenomenon, an internal phenomenon arises by way of object condition: dependent on the eye-base, eye-consciousness arises… and so on… dependent on the body-base… and so on. Dependent on an internal phenomenon, an external phenomenon arises by way of object condition: dependent on the eye-base and on eye-consciousness, the aggregates associated with eye-consciousness arise… and so on… dependent on the body-base and so on… dependent on consciousness, the associated aggregates arise; at the moment of rebirth-linking… and so on. Dependent on an internal phenomenon, both an internal phenomenon and an external phenomenon arise by way of object condition: dependent on the eye-base, eye-consciousness and the associated aggregates arise… and so on… dependent on the body-base… and so on. (3)

Bāhiraṃ dhammaṃ paccayā bāhiro dhammo uppajjati ārammaṇapaccayā – bāhiraṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paccayā dve khandhā, dve khandhe…pe… paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe… vatthuṃ paccayā bāhirā khandhā. Bāhiraṃ dhammaṃ paccayā ajjhattiko dhammo uppajjati ārammaṇapaccayā – bāhire khandhe paccayā cittaṃ, vatthuṃ paccayā cittaṃ (paṭisandhikkhaṇe dvepi kātabbā). Bāhiraṃ dhammaṃ paccayā ajjhattiko ca bāhiro ca dhammā uppajjanti ārammaṇapaccayā – vatthuṃ paccayā cittañca sampayuttakā ca khandhā (paṭisandhikkhaṇe ekaṃ kātabbaṃ). (3)

Dependent on an external phenomenon, an external phenomenon arises by way of object condition: dependent on one external aggregate, two aggregates arise; dependent on two aggregates… and so on; at the moment of rebirth-linking… and so on; dependent on the physical base, external aggregates arise. Dependent on an external phenomenon, an internal phenomenon arises by way of object condition: dependent on external aggregates, consciousness arises; dependent on the physical base, consciousness arises (at the moment of rebirth-linking, both should be included). Dependent on an external phenomenon, both an internal phenomenon and an external phenomenon arise by way of object condition: dependent on the physical base, consciousness and associated aggregates arise (at the moment of rebirth-linking, one should be included). (3)

335. Ajjhattikañca bāhirañca dhammaṃ paccayā ajjhattiko dhammo uppajjati ārammaṇapaccayā [V 3.0617] – cakkhuviññāṇasahagate khandhe ca cakkhāyatanañca paccayā cakkhuviññāṇaṃ…pe… kāyaviññāṇasahagate…pe….

335. Dependent on an internal phenomenon and an external phenomenon, an internal phenomenon arises by way of object condition: dependent on the aggregates associated with eye-consciousness and on the eye-base, eye-consciousness arises… and so on… dependent on the aggregates associated with body-consciousness… and so on.

Ajjhattikañca bāhirañca dhammaṃ paccayā bāhiro dhammo uppajjati ārammaṇapaccayā – cakkhuviññāṇasahagataṃ ekaṃ khandhañca cakkhāyatanañca cakkhuviññāṇañca paccayā dve khandhā, dve khandhe…pe… kāyaviññāṇasahagataṃ…pe… bāhiraṃ [T 4.0159] ekaṃ khandhañca cittañca paccayā dve khandhā, dve khandhe…pe… cittañca vatthuñca paccayā bāhirā khandhā (paṭisandhikkhaṇe dvepi kātabbā). Ajjhattikañca bāhirañca dhammaṃ paccayā ajjhattiko ca bāhiro ca dhammā uppajjanti ārammaṇapaccayā – cakkhuviññāṇasahagataṃ ekaṃ khandhañca cakkhāyatanañca paccayā dve khandhā cakkhuviññāṇañca, dve khandhe…pe… (saṃkhittaṃ). (3)

Dependent on an internal phenomenon and an external phenomenon, an external phenomenon arises by way of object condition: dependent on one aggregate associated with eye-consciousness, the eye-base, and eye-consciousness, two aggregates arise; dependent on two aggregates…; dependent on one aggregate associated with body-consciousness…; dependent on one external aggregate and consciousness, two aggregates arise; dependent on two aggregates…; dependent on consciousness and the physical base, external aggregates arise (at the moment of rebirth-linking, both should be included). Dependent on an internal phenomenon and an external phenomenon, both an internal phenomenon and an external phenomenon arise by way of object condition: dependent on one aggregate associated with eye-consciousness and the eye-base, two aggregates and eye-consciousness arise; dependent on two aggregates… (abbreviated). (3)

336. Hetuyā nava, ārammaṇe nava, adhipatiyā pañca, anantare nava, samanantare nava, sahajāte nava, aññamaññe nava, nissaye nava, upanissaye nava, purejāte nava, āsevane nava, kamme nava (sabbattha nava), avigate nava.

336. By root condition, nine; by object condition, nine; by dominance condition, five; by contiguity condition, nine; by immediacy condition, nine; by conascence condition, nine; by mutuality condition, nine; by dependence condition, nine; by decisive support condition, nine; by prenascence condition, nine; by repetition condition, nine; by kamma condition, nine (in all cases, nine); by non-disappearance condition, nine.

Nahetupaccayo

Not by Root Condition

337. Ajjhattikaṃ [M 3.0500] dhammaṃ paccayā ajjhattiko dhammo uppajjati nahetupaccayā – ahetukapaṭisandhikkhaṇe cittaṃ paccayā ajjhattikaṃ kaṭattārūpaṃ, cakkhāyatanaṃ paccayā cakkhuviññāṇaṃ. (Saṃkhittaṃ. Evaṃ navapi pañhā kātabbā. Pañcaviññāṇampi pavesetvā tīṇiyeva moho.)

337. Dependent on an internal phenomenon, an internal phenomenon arises not by root condition: at the moment of rootless rebirth-linking, consciousness is a condition for internal kamma-born form; the eye-base is a condition for eye-consciousness. (Abbreviated. In this way all nine questions should be formulated. Including the five consciousnesses, there are only three cases involving delusion.)

Pure

338. Nahetuyā [V 3.0618] nava, naārammaṇe nava, naadhipatiyā nava, naanantare nava, nasamanantare nava, naaññamaññe nava, naupanissaye nava, napurejāte nava, napacchājāte nava, naāsevane nava, nakamme tīṇi, navipāke pañca, naāhāre ekaṃ, naindriye ekaṃ, najhāne nava, namagge nava, nasampayutte nava, navippayutte pañca, nonatthiyā [T 4.0160] nava, novigate nava.

338. Not by root condition, nine; not by object condition, nine; not by dominance condition, nine; not by contiguity condition, nine; not by immediacy condition, nine; not by mutuality condition, nine; not by decisive support condition, nine; not by prenascence condition, nine; not by postnascence condition, nine; not by repetition condition, nine; not by kamma condition, three; not by resultant condition, five; not by nutriment condition, one; not by faculty condition, one; not by jhāna condition, nine; not by path condition, nine; not by associated condition, nine; not by dissociated condition, five; not by absence condition, nine; not by disappearance condition, nine.

1-4. Positive Method, etc.

339. Ajjhattikaṃ dhammaṃ saṃsaṭṭho bāhiro dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – cittaṃ saṃsaṭṭhā sampayuttakā khandhā; paṭisandhikkhaṇe cittaṃ saṃsaṭṭhā sampayuttakā khandhā. (1)

339. Combined with an internal phenomenon, an external phenomenon arises by root condition: the associated aggregates are combined with consciousness; at the moment of rebirth-linking, the associated aggregates are combined with consciousness. (1)

Bāhiraṃ dhammaṃ saṃsaṭṭho bāhiro dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – bāhiraṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ saṃsaṭṭhā dve khandhā, dve khandhe…pe… paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe…. Bāhiraṃ dhammaṃ saṃsaṭṭho ajjhattiko dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – bāhire khandhe saṃsaṭṭhaṃ cittaṃ; paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe…. Bāhiraṃ dhammaṃ saṃsaṭṭho ajjhattiko ca bāhiro ca dhammā uppajjanti hetupaccayā – bāhiraṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ saṃsaṭṭhā dve khandhā cittañca, dve khandhe…pe… paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe…. (3)

Combined with an external phenomenon, an external phenomenon arises by root condition: two aggregates are combined with one external aggregate; two aggregates…; at the moment of rebirth-linking…. Combined with an external phenomenon, an internal phenomenon arises by root condition: consciousness is combined with external aggregates; at the moment of rebirth-linking…. Combined with an external phenomenon, internal and external phenomena arise by root condition: two aggregates and consciousness are combined with one external aggregate; two aggregates…; at the moment of rebirth-linking…. (3)

Ajjhattikañca [M 3.0501][V 3.0619] bāhirañca dhammaṃ saṃsaṭṭho bāhiro dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – bāhiraṃ ekaṃ khandhañca cittañca saṃsaṭṭhā dve khandhā, dve khandhe…pe… paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe… (saṃkhittaṃ). Hetuyā pañca, ārammaṇe pañca, adhipatiyā pañca (sabbattha pañca), avigate pañca (anulomaṃ).

Combined with an internal and an external phenomenon, an external phenomenon arises by root condition: two aggregates are combined with one external aggregate and consciousness; two aggregates…; at the moment of rebirth-linking… (abbreviated). By root condition, five; by object condition, five; by dominance condition, five (in all cases, five); by non-disappearance condition, five (Positive Method).

Ajjhattikaṃ dhammaṃ saṃsaṭṭho bāhiro dhammo uppajjati nahetupaccayā (evaṃ pañca kātabbā, tīṇiyeva moho).

Combined with an internal phenomenon, an external phenomenon arises not by root condition (in this way five permutations should be formulated; there are only three cases involving delusion).

Nahetuyā [T 4.0161] pañca, naadhipatiyā pañca, napurejāte pañca, napacchājāte pañca, naāsevane pañca, nakamme tīṇi, navipāke pañca, najhāne pañca, namagge pañca, navippayutte pañca (paccanīyaṃ).

Not by root condition, five; not by dominance condition, five; not by prenascence condition, five; not by postnascence condition, five; not by repetition condition, five; not by kamma condition, three; not by resultant condition, five; not by jhāna condition, five; not by path condition, five; not by dissociated condition, five (Negative Method).
