1. Analysis Section

Hetupaccayo

Root Condition

340. Bāhiro dhammo bāhirassa dhammassa hetupaccayena paccayo – bāhirā hetū sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ hetupaccayena paccayo – paṭisandhikkhaṇe bāhirā hetū sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ bāhirānañca kaṭattārūpānaṃ hetupaccayena paccayo. (1)

340. An external phenomenon is a condition for an external phenomenon by root condition: external roots are a condition by root condition for associated aggregates and for consciousness-originated form; at the moment of rebirth-linking, external roots are a condition by root condition for associated aggregates and for external kamma-born form. (1)

Bāhiro [V 3.0620] dhammo ajjhattikassa dhammassa hetupaccayena paccayo – bāhirā hetū cittassa hetupaccayena paccayo; paṭisandhikkhaṇe bāhirā hetū cittassa ajjhattikānañca kaṭattārūpānaṃ hetupaccayena paccayo. (2)

An external phenomenon is a condition for an internal phenomenon by root condition: external roots are a condition by root condition for consciousness; at the moment of rebirth-linking, external roots are a condition by root condition for consciousness and for internal kamma-born form. (2)

Bāhiro dhammo ajjhattikassa ca bāhirassa ca dhammassa hetupaccayena paccayo – bāhirā hetū sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittassa ca cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ hetupaccayena paccayo; paṭisandhikkhaṇe bāhirā hetū sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittassa ca ajjhattikānañca bāhirānañca kaṭattārūpānaṃ hetupaccayena paccayo. (3)

An external phenomenon is a condition for an internal phenomenon and for an external phenomenon by root condition: external roots are a condition by root condition for associated aggregates, for consciousness, and for consciousness-originated form; at the moment of rebirth-linking, external roots are a condition by root condition for associated aggregates, for consciousness, and for internal and external kamma-born form. (3)

Ārammaṇapaccayo

Object Condition

341. Ajjhattiko [M 3.0502] dhammo ajjhattikassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo – cittaṃ ārabbha cittaṃ uppajjati. (Mūlaṃ pucchitabbaṃ) cittaṃ [T 4.0162] ārabbha bāhirā khandhā uppajjanti. (Mūlaṃ pucchitabbaṃ) cittaṃ ārabbha cittañca sampayuttakā ca khandhā uppajjanti. (3)

341. An internal phenomenon is a condition for an internal phenomenon by way of object condition: taking mind as object, mind arises. (The root should be asked.) Taking mind as object, external aggregates arise. (The root should be asked.) Taking mind as object, mind and its associated aggregates arise. (3)

Bāhiro dhammo bāhirassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo – dānaṃ…pe… sīlaṃ…pe… uposathakammaṃ katvā taṃ paccavekkhati assādeti abhinandati, taṃ ārabbha rāgo…pe… domanassaṃ uppajjati; pubbe suciṇṇāni paccavekkhati, jhānā vuṭṭhahitvā jhānaṃ…pe… ariyā maggā vuṭṭhahitvā maggaṃ…pe… phalaṃ…pe… nibbānaṃ paccavekkhanti… nibbānaṃ gotrabhussa, vodānassa, maggassa, phalassa, āvajjanāya ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo. Ariyā bāhire pahīne kilese paccavekkhanti, vikkhambhite kilese…pe… pubbe samudāciṇṇe kilese jānanti, rūpe…pe… vatthuṃ bāhire khandhe aniccato…pe… domanassaṃ uppajjati; dibbena cakkhunā rūpaṃ passati, dibbāya sotadhātuyā saddaṃ suṇāti. Cetopariyañāṇena bāhiracittasamaṅgissa cittaṃ jānāti, ākāsānañcāyatanaṃ viññāṇañcāyatanassa…pe… ākiñcaññāyatanaṃ nevasaññānāsaññāyatanassa…pe… rūpāyatanaṃ cakkhuviññāṇasahagatānaṃ khandhānaṃ ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo…pe… phoṭṭhabbāyatanaṃ…pe… bāhirā khandhā iddhividhañāṇassa, cetopariyañāṇassa[V 3.0621], pubbenivāsānussatiñāṇassa, yathākammūpagañāṇassa, anāgataṃsañāṇassa, āvajjanāya ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo. (1)

An external phenomenon is a condition for an external phenomenon by way of object condition: having given a gift… undertaken the precepts… undertaken the Uposatha observance, one reviews it, savors it, and delights in it; taking that as object, lust… grief arises. One reviews past good deeds. Having emerged from jhāna, one reviews the jhāna… Noble ones, having emerged from the path, review the path… the fruition… they review Nibbāna. Nibbāna is a condition for change-of-lineage, for purification, for the path, for the fruition, and for adverting by way of object condition. Noble ones review the abandoned defilements, which are external, the suppressed defilements… they know the defilements formerly practiced. Regarding forms… matter, one regards the external aggregates as impermanent… grief arises. With the divine eye one sees forms; with the divine ear-element one hears sounds. With the knowledge of others’ minds one knows the mind of one who possesses an external mind. The base of infinite space is a condition for the base of infinite consciousness… the base of nothingness is a condition for the base of neither-perception-nor-non-perception… The form base is a condition for the aggregates accompanying eye-consciousness by way of object condition… the tangible base… The external aggregates are a condition for the knowledge of the kinds of psychic power, for the knowledge of others’ minds, for the knowledge of the recollection of past lives, for the knowledge of the passing away and rebirth of beings according to their kamma, for the knowledge of the future, and for adverting by way of object condition. (1)

Bāhiro dhammo ajjhattikassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo – dānaṃ…pe… sīlaṃ…pe… uposathakammaṃ katvā taṃ paccavekkhati assādeti [T 4.0163] abhinandati, taṃ ārabbha cittaṃ uppajjati. Pubbe suciṇṇāni…pe… jhānaṃ…pe… (saṃkhittaṃ, sabbaṃ kātabbaṃ) pubbe samudāciṇṇe…pe… rūpe…pe… vatthuṃ bāhire khandhe aniccato…pe… vipassati, assādeti abhinandati, taṃ ārabbha cittaṃ uppajjati. Dibbena cakkhunā rūpaṃ passati…pe… rūpāyatanaṃ cakkhuviññāṇassa…pe… phoṭṭhabbāyatanaṃ…pe… bāhirā khandhā iddhividhañāṇassa, cetopariyañāṇassa, pubbenivāsānussatiñāṇassa, yathākammūpagañāṇassa, anāgataṃsañāṇassa, āvajjanāya ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo. (3)

An external phenomenon is a condition for an internal phenomenon by way of object condition: having given a gift… undertaken the precepts… undertaken the Uposatha observance, one reviews it, savors it, and delights in it; taking that as object, mind arises. Past good deeds… jhāna… (Abbreviated; all should be supplied.) … formerly practiced… forms… matter, one regards the external aggregates as impermanent… sees with insight, savors, and delights in it; taking that as object, mind arises. With the divine eye one sees forms… the form base is a condition for eye-consciousness… the tangible base… The external aggregates are a condition for the knowledge of the kinds of psychic power, for the knowledge of others’ minds, for the knowledge of the recollection of past lives, for the knowledge of the passing away and rebirth of beings according to their kamma, for the knowledge of the future, and for adverting by way of object condition. (3)

Bāhiro [M 3.0503] dhammo ajjhattikassa ca bāhirassa ca dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo – dānaṃ…pe… sīlaṃ…pe… uposathakammaṃ katvā taṃ paccavekkhati assādeti abhinandati, taṃ ārabbha cittañca sampayuttakā ca khandhā uppajjanti (saṃkhittaṃ, sabbaṃ kātabbaṃ). Bāhire khandhe aniccato…pe… vipassati, assādeti abhinandati, taṃ ārabbha cittañca sampayuttakā ca khandhā uppajjanti. Dibbena cakkhunā rūpaṃ passati…pe… rūpāyatanaṃ cakkhuviññāṇassa ca sampayuttakānañca khandhānaṃ…pe… phoṭṭhabbāyatanaṃ…pe… bāhirā khandhā iddhividhañāṇassa, cetopariyañāṇassa, pubbenivāsānussatiñāṇassa, yathākammūpagañāṇassa, anāgataṃsañāṇassa, āvajjanāya ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo. (3)

An external phenomenon is a condition for an internal phenomenon and for an external phenomenon by way of object condition: having given a gift… undertaken the precepts… undertaken the Uposatha observance, one reviews it, savors it, and delights in it; taking that as object, mind and its associated aggregates arise. (Abbreviated; all should be supplied.) One regards the external aggregates as impermanent… sees with insight, savors, and delights in it; taking that as object, mind and its associated aggregates arise. With the divine eye one sees forms… the form base is a condition for eye-consciousness and its associated aggregates… the tangible base… The external aggregates are a condition for the knowledge of the kinds of psychic power, for the knowledge of others’ minds, for the knowledge of the recollection of past lives, for the knowledge of the passing away and rebirth of beings according to their kamma, for the knowledge of the future, and for adverting by way of object condition. (3)

Ajjhattiko ca bāhiro ca dhammā ajjhattikassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo… tīṇi.

An internal phenomenon and an external phenomenon are a condition for an internal phenomenon by way of object condition… three.

Adhipatipaccayo

Dominance Condition

342. Ajjhattiko [T 4.0164] dhammo ajjhattikassa dhammassa adhipatipaccayena paccayo. Ārammaṇādhipati – cittaṃ garuṃ katvā cittaṃ uppajjati. (1)

342. An internal phenomenon is a condition for an internal phenomenon by way of dominance condition. By way of object-dominance: having given weight to mind, mind arises. (1)

Ajjhattiko [V 3.0622] dhammo bāhirassa dhammassa adhipatipaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇādhipati, sahajātādhipati. Ārammaṇādhipati – cittaṃ garuṃ katvā bāhirā khandhā uppajjanti. Sahajātādhipati – cittādhipati sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ adhipatipaccayena paccayo. (Mūlaṃ) ārammaṇādhipati – ajjhattikaṃ cittaṃ garuṃ katvā cittañca sampayuttakā ca khandhā uppajjanti. (3)

An internal phenomenon is a condition for an external phenomenon by way of dominance condition: by way of object-dominance and conascence-dominance. By way of object-dominance: having given weight to mind, external aggregates arise. By way of conascence-dominance: dominant mind is a condition for its associated aggregates and for mind-originated matter by way of dominance condition. (Root) By way of object-dominance: having given weight to the internal mind, mind and its associated aggregates arise. (3)

Bāhiro dhammo bāhirassa dhammassa adhipatipaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇādhipati, sahajātādhipati. Ārammaṇādhipati – dānaṃ datvā…pe… tīṇi (dve adhipatī tiṇṇampi kātabbā). (3)

An external phenomenon is a condition for an external phenomenon by way of dominance condition: by way of object-dominance and conascence-dominance. By way of object-dominance: having given a gift… three. (The two dominances should be applied to all three cases.) (3)

Ajjhattiko ca bāhiro ca dhammā ajjhattikassa dhammassa adhipatipaccayena paccayo… tīṇi (tiṇṇampi ekāyeva adhipati).

An internal phenomenon and an external phenomenon are a condition for an internal phenomenon by way of dominance condition… three. (For all three cases, there is only one dominance.)

Anantarapaccayādi

Contiguity Condition, etc.

343. Ajjhattiko [M 3.0504] dhammo ajjhattikassa dhammassa anantarapaccayena paccayo – purimaṃ purimaṃ cittaṃ pacchimassa pacchimassa cittassa anantarapaccayena paccayo… tīṇi.

343. An internal phenomenon is a condition for an internal phenomenon by way of contiguity condition: each preceding consciousness is a condition for each subsequent consciousness by way of contiguity condition… three.

Bāhiro dhammo bāhirassa dhammassa anantarapaccayena paccayo – purimā purimā bāhirā khandhā pacchimānaṃ pacchimānaṃ khandhānaṃ anantarapaccayena paccayo; anulomaṃ gotrabhussa…pe… tīṇi (tiṇṇampi ekasadisā).

An external phenomenon is a condition for an external phenomenon by way of contiguity condition: preceding external aggregates are a condition for subsequent external aggregates by way of contiguity condition; adaptation, for change-of-lineage… three (all three are similar).

Ajjhattiko ca bāhiro ca dhammā ajjhattikassa dhammassa anantarapaccayena paccayo… tīṇi[T 4.0165], samanantarapaccayena paccayo… nava, sahajātapaccayena paccayo… nava (paṭiccasadisā), aññamaññapaccayena paccayo… pañca (paṭiccasadisā), nissayapaccayena paccayo… nava, (paccayavārasadisā).

Internal and external phenomena are a condition for an internal phenomenon by way of contiguity condition… three; by way of immediacy condition… nine; by way of conascence condition… nine (similar to the Dependent Origination Section); by way of mutuality condition… five (similar to the Dependent Origination Section); by way of support condition… nine (similar to the Condition Section).

Upanissayapaccayo

Decisive Support Condition

344. Ajjhattiko [V 3.0623] dhammo ajjhattikassa dhammassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇūpanissayo, anantarūpanissayo, pakatūpanissayo…pe…. Pakatūpanissayo – cittaṃ cittassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo… tīṇi.

344. An internal phenomenon is a condition for an internal phenomenon by way of decisive support condition: object decisive support, contiguity decisive support, natural decisive support… and so on. Natural decisive support: consciousness is a condition for consciousness by way of decisive support condition… three.

Bāhiro dhammo bāhirassa dhammassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇūpanissayo, anantarūpanissayo, pakatūpanissayo…pe…. Pakatūpanissayo – saddhaṃ upanissāya dānaṃ deti…pe… mānaṃ jappeti, diṭṭhiṃ gaṇhāti; sīlaṃ…pe… senāsanaṃ upanissāya dānaṃ deti…pe… saṅghaṃ bhindati; saddhā…pe… senāsanaṃ saddhāya…pe… phalasamāpattiyā upanissayapaccayena paccayo, (tīṇipi pūretvā kātabbā, cittassāti kātabbā, sampayuttakānañcāti kātabbā).

An external phenomenon is a condition for an external phenomenon by way of decisive support condition: object decisive support, contiguity decisive support, natural decisive support… and so on. Natural decisive support: relying on faith, one gives a gift… generates conceit, grasps a view; relying on virtue… a lodging, one gives a gift… splits the Sangha; faith… a lodging is a condition for faith… for fruition attainment by way of decisive support condition. (All three should be completed: it should be done for consciousness, and for the associated factors).

Ajjhattiko ca bāhiro ca dhammā ajjhattikassa dhammassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo… tīṇi.

Internal and external phenomena are a condition for an internal phenomenon by way of decisive support condition… three.

Purejātapaccayo

Prenascence Condition

345. Ajjhattiko dhammo ajjhattikassa dhammassa purejātapaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇapurejātaṃ, vatthupurejātaṃ. Ārammaṇapurejātaṃ – cakkhuṃ [M 3.0505]…pe… kāyaṃ aniccato…pe… vipassati, assādeti abhinandati, taṃ ārabbha cittaṃ uppajjati. Vatthupurejātaṃ – cakkhāyatanaṃ cakkhuviññāṇassa…pe… kāyāyatanaṃ kāyaviññāṇassa purejātapaccayena paccayo[T 4.0166]. (1)

345. An internal phenomenon is a condition for an internal phenomenon by way of prenascence condition: object prenascence and base prenascence. Object prenascence: one sees with insight the eye… the body as impermanent… one relishes and delights in it; taking that as object, consciousness arises. Base prenascence: the eye base is a condition for eye-consciousness… the body base is a condition for body-consciousness by way of prenascence condition. (1)

Ajjhattiko dhammo bāhirassa dhammassa purejātapaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇapurejātaṃ, vatthupurejātaṃ. Ārammaṇapurejātaṃ – cakkhuṃ…pe… kāyaṃ aniccato…pe… vipassati, assādeti…pe… domanassaṃ uppajjati. Vatthupurejātaṃ – cakkhāyatanaṃ cakkhuviññāṇasahagatānaṃ khandhānaṃ…pe… kāyāyatanaṃ kāyaviññāṇasahagatānaṃ khandhānaṃ purejātapaccayena paccayo. (2)

An internal phenomenon is a condition for an external phenomenon by way of prenascence condition: object prenascence and base prenascence. Object prenascence: one sees with insight the eye… the body as impermanent… one relishes… and grief arises. Base prenascence: the eye base is a condition for the aggregates associated with eye-consciousness… the body base is a condition for the aggregates associated with body-consciousness by way of prenascence condition. (2)

Ajjhattiko [V 3.0624] dhammo ajjhattikassa ca bāhirassa ca dhammassa purejātapaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇapurejātaṃ, vatthupurejātaṃ. Ārammaṇapurejātaṃ – cakkhuṃ…pe… kāyaṃ aniccato…pe… vipassati, taṃ ārabbha cittañca sampayuttakā khandhā ca uppajjanti. Vatthupurejātaṃ – cakkhāyatanaṃ cakkhuviññāṇassa sampayuttakānañca khandhānaṃ…pe… kāyāyatanaṃ kāyaviññāṇassa sampayuttakānañca khandhānaṃ purejātapaccayena paccayo. (3)

An internal phenomenon is a condition for both internal and external phenomena by way of prenascence condition: object prenascence and base prenascence. Object prenascence: one sees with insight the eye… the body as impermanent…; taking that as object, consciousness and its associated aggregates arise. Base prenascence: the eye base is a condition for eye-consciousness and its associated aggregates… the body base is a condition for body-consciousness and its associated aggregates by way of prenascence condition. (3)

346. Bāhiro dhammo bāhirassa dhammassa purejātapaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇapurejātaṃ, vatthupurejātaṃ. Ārammaṇapurejātaṃ – rūpe…pe… phoṭṭhabbe… vatthuṃ aniccato…pe… domanassaṃ uppajjati; dibbena cakkhunā rūpaṃ passati, dibbāya sotadhātuyā saddaṃ suṇāti. Vatthupurejātaṃ – vatthu bāhirānaṃ khandhānaṃ purejātapaccayena paccayo. (1)

346. An external phenomenon is a condition for an external phenomenon by way of prenascence condition: object prenascence and base prenascence. Object prenascence: forms… tangibles… an object as impermanent… grief arises; with the divine eye one sees forms, with the divine ear-element one hears sounds. Base prenascence: the physical base is a condition for external aggregates by way of prenascence condition. (1)

Bāhiro dhammo ajjhattikassa dhammassa purejātapaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇapurejātaṃ, vatthupurejātaṃ. Ārammaṇapurejātaṃ – rūpe…pe… phoṭṭhabbe… vatthuṃ aniccato…pe… taṃ ārabbha cittaṃ uppajjati. Dibbena cakkhunā rūpaṃ passati, dibbāya sotadhātuyā saddaṃ suṇāti. Vatthupurejātaṃ – vatthu cittassa purejātapaccayena paccayo. (2)

An external phenomenon is a condition for an internal phenomenon by way of prenascence condition: object prenascence and base prenascence. Object prenascence: forms… tangibles… an object as impermanent… taking that as object, consciousness arises. With the divine eye one sees forms, with the divine ear-element one hears sounds. Base prenascence: the physical base is a condition for consciousness by way of prenascence condition. (2)

Bāhiro dhammo ajjhattikassa ca bāhirassa [T 4.0167] ca dhammassa purejātapaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇapurejātaṃ, vatthupurejātaṃ. Ārammaṇapurejātaṃ – rūpe…pe… phoṭṭhabbe… vatthuṃ aniccato…pe… taṃ ārabbha cittañca sampayuttakā khandhā ca uppajjanti. Dibbena cakkhunā rūpaṃ passati, dibbāya sotadhātuyā saddaṃ [M 3.0506] suṇāti. Vatthupurejātaṃ – vatthu cittassa sampayuttakānañca khandhānaṃ purejātapaccayena paccayo. (3)

An external phenomenon is a condition for both internal and external phenomena by way of prenascence condition: object prenascence and base prenascence. Object prenascence: forms… tangibles… an object as impermanent… taking that as object, consciousness and its associated aggregates arise. With the divine eye one sees forms, with the divine ear-element one hears sounds. Base prenascence: the physical base is a condition for consciousness and its associated aggregates by way of prenascence condition. (3)

347. Ajjhattiko ca bāhiro ca dhammā ajjhattikassa dhammassa purejātapaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇapurejātaṃ, vatthupurejātaṃ. Cakkhāyatanañca vatthu ca cittassa…pe… kāyāyatanañca vatthu ca cittassa purejātapaccayena paccayo; rūpāyatanañca cakkhāyatanañca cakkhuviññāṇassa…pe… phoṭṭhabbāyatanañca kāyāyatanañca kāyaviññāṇassa purejātapaccayena paccayo. (1)

347. Internal and external phenomena are a condition for an internal phenomenon by way of prenascence condition: object prenascence and base prenascence. The eye base and the physical base are a condition for consciousness… the body base and the physical base are a condition for consciousness by way of prenascence condition; the form base and the eye base are a condition for eye-consciousness… the tangible base and the body base are a condition for body-consciousness by way of prenascence condition. (1)

Ajjhattiko [V 3.0625] ca bāhiro ca dhammā bāhirassa dhammassa purejātapaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇapurejātaṃ, vatthupurejātaṃ. Cakkhāyatanañca vatthu ca bāhirānaṃ khandhānaṃ purejātapaccayena paccayo…pe… kāyāyatanañca vatthu ca bāhirānaṃ khandhānaṃ purejātapaccayena paccayo; rūpāyatanañca cakkhāyatanañca cakkhuviññāṇasahagatānaṃ khandhānaṃ purejātapaccayena paccayo…pe… phoṭṭhabbāyatanañca kāyāyatanañca kāyaviññāṇasahagatānaṃ khandhānaṃ purejātapaccayena paccayo. (2)

Internal and external phenomena are a condition for an external phenomenon by way of prenascence condition: object prenascence and base prenascence. The eye base and the physical base are a condition for the external aggregates by way of prenascence condition… the body base and the physical base are a condition for the external aggregates by way of prenascence condition; the form base and the eye base are a condition for the aggregates associated with eye-consciousness by way of prenascence condition… the tangible base and the body base are a condition for the aggregates associated with body-consciousness by way of prenascence condition. (2)

Ajjhattiko ca bāhiro ca dhammā ajjhattikassa ca bāhirassa ca dhammassa purejātapaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇapurejātaṃ, vatthupurejātaṃ. Cakkhāyatanañca vatthu ca cittassa sampayuttakānañca khandhānaṃ purejātapaccayena paccayo…pe… kāyāyatanañca vatthu ca…pe… rūpāyatanañca [T 4.0168] cakkhāyatanañca cakkhuviññāṇassa sampayuttakānañca khandhānaṃ purejātapaccayena paccayo…pe… phoṭṭhabbāyatanañca…pe…. (3)

Internal and external phenomena are a condition for internal and external phenomena by way of prenascence condition: object prenascence and base prenascence. The eye base and the physical base are a condition for consciousness and its associated aggregates by way of prenascence condition… the body base and the physical base… the form base and the eye base are a condition for eye-consciousness and its associated aggregates by way of prenascence condition… the tangible base…. (3)

Pacchājātāsevanapaccayā

Postnascence and Repetition Conditions

348. Ajjhattiko dhammo ajjhattikassa dhammassa pacchājātapaccayena paccayo – pacchājātā ajjhattikā khandhā purejātassa imassa ajjhattikassa kāyassa pacchājātapaccayena paccayo. (Mūlaṃ kātabbaṃ) pacchājātā ajjhattikā khandhā purejātassa imassa bāhirassa kāyassa pacchājātapaccayena paccayo. (Mūlaṃ kātabbaṃ) pacchājātā ajjhattikā khandhā purejātassa imassa ajjhattikassa ca bāhirassa ca kāyassa [M 3.0507] pacchājātapaccayena paccayo (evaṃ navapi pañhā kātabbā), āsevanapaccayena paccayo (nava pañhā kātabbā).

348. An internal phenomenon is a condition for an internal phenomenon by way of postnascence condition: post-nascent internal aggregates are a condition for this pre-nascent internal body by way of postnascence condition. (The root should be formulated.) Post-nascent internal aggregates are a condition for this pre-nascent external body by way of postnascence condition. (The root should be formulated.) Post-nascent internal aggregates are a condition for this pre-nascent internal and external body by way of postnascence condition. (Thus nine questions should be formulated.) It is a condition by way of repetition condition. (Nine questions should be formulated.)

Kamma-vipākapaccayā

Kamma and Result Conditions

349. Bāhiro dhammo bāhirassa dhammassa kammapaccayena paccayo – sahajātā, nānākkhaṇikā. Sahajātā – bāhirā cetanā sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ kammapaccayena paccayo; paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe…. Nānākkhaṇikā – bāhirā cetanā vipākānaṃ bāhirānaṃ khandhānaṃ kaṭattā ca rūpānaṃ kammapaccayena paccayo. (1)

349. An external phenomenon is a condition for an external phenomenon by way of kamma condition: conascent and at a different moment. Conascent: external volition is a condition for its associated aggregates and for mind-originated matter by way of kamma condition; at the moment of rebirth-linking… At a different moment: external volition is a condition for resultant external aggregates and for kamma-produced matter by way of kamma condition. (1)

Bāhiro [V 3.0626] dhammo ajjhattikassa dhammassa kammapaccayena paccayo – sahajātā, nānākkhaṇikā. Sahajātā – bāhirā cetanā cittassa kammapaccayena paccayo; paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe…. Nānākkhaṇikā – bāhirā cetanā vipākassa cittassa ajjhattikānañca kaṭattārūpānaṃ kammapaccayena paccayo. (2)

An external phenomenon is a condition for an internal phenomenon by way of kamma condition: conascent and at a different moment. Conascent: external volition is a condition for consciousness by way of kamma condition; at the moment of rebirth-linking… At a different moment: external volition is a condition for resultant consciousness and for internal kamma-produced matter by way of kamma condition. (2)

Bāhiro dhammo ajjhattikassa ca bāhirassa ca dhammassa kammapaccayena paccayo – sahajātā, nānākkhaṇikā. Sahajātā – bāhirā cetanā sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittassa ca cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ kammapaccayena paccayo; paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe…. Nānākkhaṇikā – bāhirā [T 4.0169] cetanā vipākānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittassa ca ajjhattikānañca bāhirānañca kaṭattārūpānaṃ kammapaccayena paccayo. (3) Vipākapaccayena paccayo… nava.

An external phenomenon is a condition for an internal and an external phenomenon by way of kamma condition: conascent and at a different moment. Conascent: external volition is a condition for the associated aggregates, consciousness, and mind-originated matter by way of kamma condition; at the moment of rebirth-linking… At a different moment: external volition is a condition for the resultant aggregates, consciousness, and both internal and external kamma-produced matter by way of kamma condition. (3) It is a condition by way of result condition… nine.

Āhārapaccayo

Nutriment Condition

350. Ajjhattiko dhammo ajjhattikassa dhammassa āhārapaccayena paccayo – paṭisandhikkhaṇe ajjhattikā āhārā ajjhattikānaṃ kaṭattārūpānaṃ āhārapaccayena paccayo. (1)

350. An internal phenomenon is a condition for an internal phenomenon by way of nutriment condition: at the moment of rebirth-linking, internal nutriments are a condition for internal kamma-produced matter by way of nutriment condition. (1)

Ajjhattiko dhammo bāhirassa dhammassa āhārapaccayena paccayo – ajjhattikā āhārā sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ āhārapaccayena paccayo; paṭisandhikkhaṇe ajjhattikā āhārā sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ bāhirānañca kaṭattārūpānaṃ āhārapaccayena paccayo. (Mūlaṃ kātabbaṃ) paṭisandhikkhaṇe ajjhattikā āhārā sampayuttakānaṃ [M 3.0508] khandhānaṃ ajjhattikānañca bāhirānañca kaṭattārūpānaṃ āhārapaccayena paccayo. (3)

An internal phenomenon is a condition for an external phenomenon by way of nutriment condition: internal nutriments are a condition for the associated aggregates and mind-originated matter by way of nutriment condition; at the moment of rebirth-linking, internal nutriments are a condition for the associated aggregates and for external kamma-produced matter by way of nutriment condition. (The root should be formulated.) At the moment of rebirth-linking, internal nutriments are a condition for the associated aggregates and for both internal and external kamma-produced matter by way of nutriment condition. (3)

351. Bāhiro dhammo bāhirassa dhammassa āhārapaccayena paccayo – bāhirā āhārā sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ āhārapaccayena paccayo; paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe… bāhiro kabaḷīkāro āhāro bāhirassa kāyassa āhārapaccayena paccayo. (1)

351. An external phenomenon is a condition for an external phenomenon by way of nutriment condition: external nutriments are a condition for the associated aggregates and mind-originated matter by way of nutriment condition; at the moment of rebirth-linking… external physical nutriment is a condition for the external body by way of nutriment condition. (1)

Bāhiro [V 3.0627] dhammo ajjhattikassa dhammassa āhārapaccayena paccayo – bāhirā āhārā cittassa āhārapaccayena paccayo; paṭisandhikkhaṇe bāhirā āhārā cittassa ajjhattikānañca kaṭattārūpānaṃ āhārapaccayena [T 4.0170] paccayo; bāhiro kabaḷīkāro āhāro ajjhattikassa kāyassa āhārapaccayena paccayo. (2)

An external phenomenon is a condition for an internal phenomenon by way of nutriment condition: external nutriments are a condition for consciousness by way of nutriment condition; at the moment of rebirth-linking, external nutriments are a condition for consciousness and internal kamma-produced matter by way of nutriment condition; external physical nutriment is a condition for the internal body by way of nutriment condition. (2)

Bāhiro dhammo ajjhattikassa ca bāhirassa ca dhammassa āhārapaccayena paccayo – bāhirā āhārā sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittassa ca cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ āhārapaccayena paccayo; paṭisandhikkhaṇe bāhirā āhārā sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittassa ca ajjhattikānañca bāhirānañca kaṭattārūpānaṃ āhārapaccayena paccayo; bāhiro kabaḷīkāro āhāro ajjhattikassa ca bāhirassa ca kāyassa āhārapaccayena paccayo. (3)

An external phenomenon is a condition for an internal and an external phenomenon by way of nutriment condition: external nutriments are a condition for the associated aggregates, consciousness, and mind-originated matter by way of nutriment condition; at the moment of rebirth-linking, external nutriments are a condition for the associated aggregates, consciousness, and both internal and external kamma-produced matter by way of nutriment condition; external physical nutriment is a condition for both the internal and the external body by way of nutriment condition. (3)

352. Ajjhattiko ca bāhiro ca dhammā ajjhattikassa dhammassa āhārapaccayena paccayo – paṭisandhikkhaṇe ajjhattikā ca bāhirā ca āhārā ajjhattikānaṃ kaṭattārūpānaṃ āhārapaccayena paccayo. (1)

352. Internal and external phenomena are a condition for an internal phenomenon by way of nutriment condition: at the moment of rebirth-linking, internal and external nutriments are a condition for internal kamma-produced matter by way of nutriment condition. (1)

Ajjhattiko ca bāhiro ca dhammā bāhirassa dhammassa āhārapaccayena paccayo – ajjhattikā ca bāhirā ca āhārā sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ āhārapaccayena paccayo; paṭisandhikkhaṇe ajjhattikā ca bāhirā ca āhārā sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ bāhirānañca kaṭattārūpānaṃ āhārapaccayena paccayo. (2)

Internal and external phenomena are a condition for an external phenomenon by way of nutriment condition: internal and external nutriments are a condition for the associated aggregates and mind-originated matter by way of nutriment condition; at the moment of rebirth-linking, internal and external nutriments are a condition for the associated aggregates and for external kamma-produced matter by way of nutriment condition. (2)

Ajjhattiko ca bāhiro ca dhammā ajjhattikassa ca bāhirassa ca dhammassa āhārapaccayena paccayo – paṭisandhikkhaṇe ajjhattikā ca bāhirā ca āhārā [M 3.0509] sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ ajjhattikānañca bāhirānañca kaṭattārūpānaṃ āhārapaccayena paccayo. (3)

Internal and external phenomena are a condition for an internal and an external phenomenon by way of nutriment condition: at the moment of rebirth-linking, internal and external nutriments are a condition for the associated aggregates and for both internal and external kamma-produced matter by way of nutriment condition. (3)

Indriyapaccayo

Faculty Condition

353. Ajjhattiko [T 4.0171] dhammo ajjhattikassa dhammassa indriyapaccayena paccayo – paṭisandhikkhaṇe ajjhattikā indriyā ajjhattikānaṃ kaṭattārūpānaṃ indriyapaccayena paccayo, cakkhundriyaṃ [V 3.0628] cakkhuviññāṇassa…pe… kāyindriyaṃ kāyaviññāṇassa indriyapaccayena paccayo. (1)

353. An internal phenomenon is a condition for an internal phenomenon by way of faculty condition: at the moment of rebirth-linking, internal faculties are a condition for internal kamma-produced materiality by way of faculty condition; the eye faculty is a condition for eye-consciousness...pe... the body faculty is a condition for body-consciousness by way of faculty condition. (1)

Ajjhattiko dhammo bāhirassa dhammassa indriyapaccayena paccayo – ajjhattikā indriyā sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ indriyapaccayena paccayo; paṭisandhikkhaṇe ajjhattikā indriyā sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ bāhirānañca kaṭattārūpānaṃ indriyapaccayena paccayo, cakkhundriyaṃ cakkhuviññāṇasahagatānaṃ khandhānaṃ…pe… kāyindriyaṃ kāyaviññāṇasahagatānaṃ khandhānaṃ indriyapaccayena paccayo. (2)

An internal phenomenon is a condition for an external phenomenon by way of faculty condition—internal faculties are a condition for the associated aggregates and for mind-originated materiality by way of faculty condition; at the moment of rebirth-linking, internal faculties are a condition for the associated aggregates and for external kamma-produced materiality by way of faculty condition; the eye faculty is a condition for the aggregates associated with eye-consciousness...pe... the body faculty is a condition for the aggregates associated with body-consciousness by way of faculty condition. (2)

Ajjhattiko dhammo ajjhattikassa ca bāhirassa ca dhammassa indriyapaccayena paccayo – paṭisandhikkhaṇe ajjhattikā indriyā sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ ajjhattikānañca bāhirānañca kaṭattārūpānaṃ indriyapaccayena paccayo, cakkhundriyaṃ cakkhuviññāṇassa sampayuttakānañca khandhānaṃ…pe… kāyindriyaṃ kāyaviññāṇassa sampayuttakānañca khandhānaṃ indriyapaccayena paccayo. (3)

An internal phenomenon is a condition for an internal phenomenon and an external phenomenon by way of faculty condition—at the moment of rebirth-linking, internal faculties are a condition for the associated aggregates and for both internal and external kamma-produced materiality by way of faculty condition; the eye faculty is a condition for eye-consciousness and the associated aggregates...pe... the body faculty is a condition for body-consciousness and the associated aggregates by way of faculty condition. (3)

354. Bāhiro dhammo bāhirassa dhammassa indriyapaccayena paccayo – bāhirā indriyā sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ indriyapaccayena paccayo; paṭisandhikkhaṇe bāhirā indriyā sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ bāhirānañca kaṭattārūpānaṃ indriyapaccayena paccayo[T 4.0172], rūpajīvitindriyaṃ bāhirānaṃ kaṭattārūpānaṃ indriyapaccayena paccayo. (1)

354. An external phenomenon is a condition for an external phenomenon by way of faculty condition—external faculties are a condition for the associated aggregates and for mind-originated materiality by way of faculty condition; at the moment of rebirth-linking, external faculties are a condition for the associated aggregates and for external kamma-produced materiality by way of faculty condition; the material life-faculty is a condition for external kamma-produced materiality by way of faculty condition. (1)

Bāhiro dhammo ajjhattikassa dhammassa indriyapaccayena paccayo – bāhirā indriyā cittassa indriyapaccayena paccayo; paṭisandhikkhaṇe bāhirā indriyā cittassa ajjhattikānañca kaṭattārūpānaṃ indriyapaccayena paccayo, rūpajīvitindriyaṃ ajjhattikānaṃ kaṭattārūpānaṃ indriyapaccayena paccayo. (2)

An external phenomenon is a condition for an internal phenomenon by way of faculty condition—external faculties are a condition for consciousness by way of faculty condition; at the moment of rebirth-linking, external faculties are a condition for consciousness and for internal kamma-produced materiality by way of faculty condition; the material life-faculty is a condition for internal kamma-produced materiality by way of faculty condition. (2)

Bāhiro [M 3.0510] dhammo ajjhattikassa ca bāhirassa ca dhammassa indriyapaccayena paccayo – bāhirā indriyā sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittassa ca cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ indriyapaccayena paccayo; paṭisandhikkhaṇe bāhirā indriyā sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittassa ca ajjhattikānañca bāhirānañca [V 3.0629] kaṭattārūpānaṃ indriyapaccayena paccayo, rūpajīvitindriyaṃ ajjhattikānañca bāhirānañca kaṭattārūpānaṃ indriyapaccayena paccayo. (3)

An external phenomenon is a condition for an internal phenomenon and an external phenomenon by way of faculty condition—external faculties are a condition for the associated aggregates, for consciousness, and for mind-originated materiality by way of faculty condition; at the moment of rebirth-linking, external faculties are a condition for the associated aggregates, for consciousness, and for both internal and external kamma-produced materiality by way of faculty condition; the material life-faculty is a condition for both internal and external kamma-produced materiality by way of faculty condition. (3)

355. Ajjhattiko ca bāhiro ca dhammā ajjhattikassa dhammassa indriyapaccayena paccayo – paṭisandhikkhaṇe ajjhattikā ca bāhirā ca indriyā ajjhattikānaṃ kaṭattārūpānaṃ indriyapaccayena paccayo, cakkhundriyañca upekkhindriyañca cakkhuviññāṇassa indriyapaccayena paccayo…pe… kāyindriyañca sukhindriyaṃ ca…pe… kāyindriyañca dukkhindriyañca kāyaviññāṇassa indriyapaccayena paccayo. (1)

355. Internal and external phenomena are a condition for an internal phenomenon by way of faculty condition—at the moment of rebirth-linking, internal and external faculties are a condition for internal kamma-produced materiality by way of faculty condition; the eye faculty and the equanimity faculty are a condition for eye-consciousness by way of faculty condition...pe... the body faculty and the pleasure faculty...pe... the body faculty and the pain faculty are a condition for body-consciousness by way of faculty condition. (1)

Ajjhattiko ca bāhiro ca dhammā bāhirassa dhammassa indriyapaccayena paccayo – ajjhattikā ca bāhirā ca indriyā sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañca [T 4.0173] rūpānaṃ indriyapaccayena paccayo; paṭisandhikkhaṇe ajjhattikā ca bāhirā ca indriyā sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ bāhirānañca kaṭattārūpānaṃ indriyapaccayena paccayo, cakkhundriyañca upekkhindriyañca cakkhuviññāṇasahagatānaṃ khandhānaṃ indriyapaccayena paccayo…pe… kāyindriyañca sukhindriyañca…pe… kāyindriyañca dukkhindriyañca kāyaviññāṇasahagatānaṃ khandhānaṃ indriyapaccayena paccayo. (2)

Internal and external phenomena are a condition for an external phenomenon by way of faculty condition—internal and external faculties are a condition for the associated aggregates and for mind-originated materiality by way of faculty condition; at the moment of rebirth-linking, internal and external faculties are a condition for the associated aggregates and for external kamma-produced materiality by way of faculty condition; the eye faculty and the equanimity faculty are a condition for the aggregates associated with eye-consciousness by way of faculty condition...pe... the body faculty and the pleasure faculty...pe... the body faculty and the pain faculty are a condition for the aggregates associated with body-consciousness by way of faculty condition. (2)

Ajjhattiko ca bāhiro ca dhammā ajjhattikassa ca bāhirassa ca dhammassa indriyapaccayena paccayo – paṭisandhikkhaṇe ajjhattikā ca bāhirā ca indriyā sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ ajjhattikānañca bāhirānañca kaṭattārūpānaṃ indriyapaccayena paccayo, cakkhundriyañca upekkhindriyañca cakkhuviññāṇassa sampayuttakānañca khandhānaṃ indriyapaccayena paccayo… kāyindriyañca…pe…. (3)

Internal and external phenomena are a condition for an internal phenomenon and an external phenomenon by way of faculty condition—at the moment of rebirth-linking, internal and external faculties are a condition for the associated aggregates and for both internal and external kamma-produced materiality by way of faculty condition; the eye faculty and the equanimity faculty are a condition for eye-consciousness and the associated aggregates by way of faculty condition...pe... the body faculty...pe... (3)

Jhānapaccayādi

Jhāna-condition, etc.

356. Bāhiro dhammo bāhirassa dhammassa jhānapaccayena paccayo… tīṇi… maggapaccayena paccayo… tīṇi… sampayuttapaccayena paccayo… pañca.

356. An external phenomenon is a condition for an external phenomenon by way of jhāna condition... three... by way of path condition... three... by way of association condition... five.

Vippayuttapaccayo

Dissociation Condition

357. Ajjhattiko [M 3.0511][V 3.0630] dhammo ajjhattikassa dhammassa vippayuttapaccayena paccayo – sahajātaṃ, purejātaṃ, pacchājātaṃ. Sahajātaṃ – paṭisandhikkhaṇe cittaṃ ajjhattikānaṃ kaṭattārūpānaṃ vippayuttapaccayena paccayo. Purejātaṃ – cakkhāyatanaṃ cakkhuviññāṇassa…pe… kāyāyatanaṃ kāyaviññāṇassa vippayuttapaccayena paccayo. Pacchājātā – ajjhattikā khandhā [T 4.0174] purejātassa imassa ajjhattikassa kāyassa vippayuttapaccayena paccayo. (1)

357. An internal phenomenon is a condition for an internal phenomenon by way of dissociation condition—conascence, prenascence, postnascence. Conascence: at the moment of rebirth-linking, consciousness is a condition for internal kamma-produced matter by way of dissociation condition. Prenascence: the eye-base is a condition for eye-consciousness …pe… the body-base is a condition for body-consciousness by way of dissociation condition. Postnascence: the internal aggregates are a condition for this prenascent internal body by way of dissociation condition. (1)

Ajjhattiko dhammo bāhirassa dhammassa vippayuttapaccayena paccayo – sahajātaṃ, purejātaṃ, pacchājātaṃ. Sahajātā – ajjhattikā khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ vippayuttapaccayena paccayo; paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe…. Purejātaṃ – cakkhāyatanaṃ cakkhuviññāṇasahagatānaṃ khandhānaṃ…pe… kāyāyatanaṃ kāyaviññāṇasahagatānaṃ khandhānaṃ vippayuttapaccayena paccayo. Pacchājātā – ajjhattikā khandhā purejātassa imassa bāhirassa kāyassa vippayuttapaccayena paccayo. (2)

An internal phenomenon is a condition for an external phenomenon by way of dissociation condition—conascence, prenascence, postnascence. Conascence: the internal aggregates are a condition for mind-originated matter by way of dissociation condition; at the moment of rebirth-linking …pe… Prenascence: the eye-base is a condition for the aggregates associated with eye-consciousness …pe… the body-base is a condition for the aggregates associated with body-consciousness by way of dissociation condition. Postnascence: the internal aggregates are a condition for this prenascent external body by way of dissociation condition. (2)

Ajjhattiko dhammo ajjhattikassa ca bāhirassa ca dhammassa vippayuttapaccayena paccayo – sahajātaṃ, purejātaṃ, pacchājātaṃ. Sahajātā – paṭisandhikkhaṇe ajjhattikā khandhā ajjhattikānañca bāhirānañca kaṭattārūpānaṃ vippayuttapaccayena paccayo. Purejātaṃ – cakkhāyatanaṃ cakkhuviññāṇassa sampayuttakānañca khandhānaṃ…pe… kāyāyatanaṃ kāyaviññāṇassa sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ vippayuttapaccayena paccayo. Pacchājātā – ajjhattikā khandhā purejātassa imassa ajjhattikassa ca bāhirassa ca kāyassa vippayuttapaccayena paccayo. (3)

An internal phenomenon is a condition for an internal and an external phenomenon by way of dissociation condition—conascence, prenascence, postnascence. Conascence: at the moment of rebirth-linking, the internal aggregates are a condition for the internal and external kamma-produced matter by way of dissociation condition. Prenascence: the eye-base is a condition for eye-consciousness and its associated aggregates …pe… the body-base is a condition for body-consciousness and its associated aggregates by way of dissociation condition. Postnascence: the internal aggregates are a condition for this prenascent internal and external body by way of dissociation condition. (3)

358. Bāhiro dhammo bāhirassa dhammassa vippayuttapaccayena paccayo – sahajātaṃ, purejātaṃ, pacchājātaṃ. Sahajātā – bāhirā khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ vippayuttapaccayena paccayo; paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe… khandhā vatthussa vippayuttapaccayena paccayo; vatthu khandhānaṃ vippayuttapaccayena [T 4.0175] paccayo. Purejātaṃ – vatthu bāhirānaṃ khandhānaṃ vippayuttapaccayena paccayo. Pacchājātā – bāhirā khandhā purejātassa imassa bāhirassa kāyassa vippayuttapaccayena paccayo. (1)

358. An external phenomenon is a condition for an external phenomenon by way of dissociation condition—conascence, prenascence, postnascence. Conascence: the external aggregates are a condition for mind-originated matter by way of dissociation condition; at the moment of rebirth-linking …pe… the aggregates are a condition for the physical base by way of dissociation condition; the physical base is a condition for the aggregates by way of dissociation condition. Prenascence: the physical base is a condition for the external aggregates by way of dissociation condition. Postnascence: the external aggregates are a condition for this prenascent external body by way of dissociation condition. (1)

Bāhiro [M 3.0512][V 3.0631] dhammo ajjhattikassa dhammassa vippayuttapaccayena paccayo – sahajātaṃ, purejātaṃ, pacchājātaṃ. Sahajātā – paṭisandhikkhaṇe bāhirā khandhā ajjhattikānaṃ kaṭattārūpānaṃ vippayuttapaccayena paccayo; paṭisandhikkhaṇe vatthu cittassa vippayuttapaccayena paccayo. Purejātaṃ – vatthu cittassa vippayuttapaccayena paccayo. Pacchājātā – bāhirā khandhā purejātassa imassa ajjhattikassa kāyassa vippayuttapaccayena paccayo. (2)

An external phenomenon is a condition for an internal phenomenon by way of dissociation condition—conascence, prenascence, postnascence. Conascence: at the moment of rebirth-linking, the external aggregates are a condition for the internal kamma-produced matter by way of dissociation condition; at the moment of rebirth-linking, the physical base is a condition for consciousness by way of dissociation condition. Prenascence: the physical base is a condition for consciousness by way of dissociation condition. Postnascence: the external aggregates are a condition for this prenascent internal body by way of dissociation condition. (2)

Bāhiro dhammo ajjhattikassa ca bāhirassa ca dhammassa vippayuttapaccayena paccayo – sahajātaṃ, purejātaṃ, pacchājātaṃ (saṃkhittaṃ). (3)

An external phenomenon is a condition for an internal and an external phenomenon by way of dissociation condition—conascence, prenascence, postnascence (in brief). (3)

359. Ajjhattiko ca bāhiro ca dhammā ajjhattikassa dhammassa vippayuttapaccayena paccayo – sahajātaṃ, pacchājātaṃ. Sahajātā – paṭisandhikkhaṇe ajjhattikā ca bāhirā ca khandhā ajjhattikānaṃ kaṭattārūpānaṃ vippayuttapaccayena paccayo. Pacchājātaṃ – pacchājātā…pe… (saṃkhittaṃ). (1)

359. Internal and external phenomena are a condition for an internal phenomenon by way of dissociation condition—conascence, postnascence. Conascence: at the moment of rebirth-linking, the internal and external aggregates are a condition for the internal kamma-produced matter by way of dissociation condition. Postnascence: the postnascent …pe… (in brief). (1)

Ajjhattiko ca bāhiro ca dhammā bāhirassa dhammassa vippayuttapaccayena paccayo – sahajātaṃ, pacchājātaṃ (saṃkhittaṃ). (2)

Internal and external phenomena are a condition for an external phenomenon by way of dissociation condition—conascence, postnascence (in brief). (2)

Ajjhattiko ca bāhiro ca dhammā ajjhattikassa ca bāhirassa ca dhammassa vippayuttapaccayena paccayo – sahajātaṃ, pacchājātaṃ. Sahajātā – paṭisandhikkhaṇe ajjhattikā ca bāhirā ca khandhā…pe… (saṃkhittaṃ). (3)

Internal and external phenomena are a condition for an internal and an external phenomenon by way of dissociation condition—conascence, postnascence. Conascence: at the moment of rebirth-linking, the internal and external aggregates …pe… (in brief). (3)

Atthipaccayādi

Presence Condition, and so on.

360. Ajjhattiko [T 4.0176] dhammo ajjhattikassa dhammassa atthipaccayena paccayo – sahajātaṃ, purejātaṃ, pacchājātaṃ. Sahajātā – paṭisandhikkhaṇe cittaṃ ajjhattikānaṃ kaṭattārūpānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo. Purejātaṃ – cakkhuṃ…pe… kāyaṃ aniccato…pe… (purejātasadisaṃ, ninnānākaraṇaṃ). Pacchājātaṃ (pacchājātasadisaṃ kātabbaṃ). (1)

360. An internal phenomenon is a condition for an internal phenomenon by way of presence condition—conascence, prenascence, postnascence. By conascence: at the moment of rebirth-linking, consciousness is a condition for internal kamma-produced matter by way of presence condition. By prenascence: the eye …pe… the body as impermanent …pe… (similar to the prenascence section, without differentiation). By postnascence (to be treated similarly to the postnascence section). (1)

Ajjhattiko [V 3.0632] dhammo bāhirassa dhammassa atthipaccayena paccayo – sahajātaṃ, purejātaṃ, pacchājātaṃ. Sahajātaṃ – sahajātā ajjhattikā khandhā sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo (saṃkhittaṃ). (2)

An internal phenomenon is a condition for an external phenomenon by way of presence condition—conascence, prenascence, postnascence. By conascence: conascent internal aggregates are a condition for associated aggregates and for mind-originated matter by way of presence condition (in brief). (2)

(Idha [M 3.0513] atthi sabbaṭṭhāne sahajātaṃ paccayavārasadisaṃ. Purejātaṃ purejātasadisaṃ. Pacchājātaṃ pacchājātasadisaṃ kātabbaṃ, ninnānākaraṇaṃ).

(Here, in all instances, conascence is similar to the Condition Section. Prenascence is similar to the prenascence section. Postnascence is to be treated as similar to the postnascence section, without making any difference.)

Ajjhattiko dhammo ajjhattikassa ca bāhirassa ca dhammassa atthipaccayena paccayo – sahajātaṃ, purejātaṃ, pacchājātaṃ (saṃkhittaṃ). (3)

An internal phenomenon is a condition for both internal and external phenomena by way of presence condition—conascence, prenascence, postnascence (in brief). (3)

361. Bāhiro dhammo bāhirassa dhammassa atthipaccayena paccayo – sahajātaṃ, purejātaṃ, pacchājātaṃ, āhāraṃ, indriyaṃ (sabbaṃ vitthāretabbaṃ). (1)

361. An external phenomenon is a condition for an external phenomenon by way of presence condition—conascence, prenascence, postnascence, nutriment, faculty (all to be elaborated in full). (1)

Bāhiro dhammo ajjhattikassa dhammassa atthipaccayena paccayo – sahajātaṃ, purejātaṃ, pacchājātaṃ, āhāraṃ, indriyaṃ (saṃkhittaṃ). (2)

An external phenomenon is a condition for an internal phenomenon by way of presence condition: by conascence, prenascence, postnascence, nutriment, and faculty (in brief). (2)

Bāhiro dhammo ajjhattikassa ca bāhirassa ca dhammassa atthipaccayena paccayo – sahajātaṃ, purejātaṃ, pacchājātaṃ, āhāraṃ, indriyaṃ (saṃkhittaṃ). (3)

An external phenomenon is a condition for both an internal phenomenon and an external phenomenon by way of presence condition: by conascence, prenascence, postnascence, nutriment, and faculty (in brief). (3)

362. Ajjhattiko ca bāhiro ca dhammā ajjhattikassa dhammassa atthipaccayena paccayo – sahajātaṃ, purejātaṃ, pacchājātaṃ, āhāraṃ, indriyaṃ. Sahajātā – cakkhuviññāṇasahagatā khandhā [T 4.0177] ca cakkhāyatanañca cakkhuviññāṇasahagatā khandhā ca cakkhāyatanañca cakkhuviññāṇassa atthipaccayena paccayo…pe… kāyaviññāṇasahagatā khandhā ca…pe… paṭisandhikkhaṇe ajjhattikā ca bāhirā ca khandhā ajjhattikānaṃ kaṭattārūpānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo. Purejātaṃ – cakkhāyatanañca vatthu ca cittassa atthipaccayena paccayo…pe… kāyāyatanañca vatthu ca cittassa atthipaccayena paccayo; rūpāyatanañca cakkhāyatanañca cakkhuviññāṇassa…pe… phoṭṭhabbāyatanañca kāyāyatanañca kāyaviññāṇassa atthipaccayena paccayo. Pacchājātā – ajjhattikā ca bāhirā ca khandhā purejātassa [V 3.0633] imassa ajjhattikassa kāyassa atthipaccayena paccayo. Pacchājātā – ajjhattikā ca bāhirā ca khandhā kabaḷīkāro āhāro ca imassa ajjhattikassa kāyassa atthipaccayena paccayo. Pacchājātā – ajjhattikā ca bāhirā ca khandhā rūpajīvitindriyañca ajjhattikānaṃ kaṭattārūpānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo. (1)

362. Both internal and external phenomena are a condition for an internal phenomenon by way of presence condition: by conascence, prenascence, postnascence, nutriment, and faculty. By conascence: the aggregates associated with eye-consciousness and the eye-base, the aggregates associated with eye-consciousness and the eye-base, are a condition for eye-consciousness by way of presence condition …pe… the aggregates associated with body-consciousness …pe… at the moment of rebirth-linking, both internal and external aggregates are a condition for internal kamma-produced matter by way of presence condition. By prenascence: the eye-base and the physical base are a condition for consciousness by way of presence condition …pe… the body-base and the physical base are a condition for consciousness by way of presence condition; the form-base and the eye-base are a condition for eye-consciousness …pe… the tangible-base and the body-base are a condition for body-consciousness by way of presence condition. By postnascence: both internal and external aggregates are a condition for this prenascent internal body by way of presence condition. By postnascence: both internal and external aggregates and edible food are a condition for this internal body by way of presence condition. By postnascence: both internal and external aggregates and the material life-faculty are a condition for internal kamma-produced matter by way of presence condition. (1)

Ajjhattiko ca bāhiro ca dhammā bāhirassa dhammassa atthipaccayena paccayo – sahajātaṃ, purejātaṃ, pacchājātaṃ, āhāraṃ, indriyaṃ. Sahajāto [M 3.0514] – cakkhuviññāṇasahagato eko khandho ca cakkhāyatanañca cakkhuviññāṇañca dvinnaṃ khandhānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo…pe… (sahajātapaccayavārasadisaṃ ninnānākaraṇaṃ, paṭhamagamanasadisaṃyeva. Sabbe padā paṭhamaghaṭanānayena vibhajitabbā). (2)

Internal and external phenomena are a condition for an external phenomenon by way of presence condition: by conascence, prenascence, postnascence, nutriment, and faculty. By conascence: one aggregate associated with eye-consciousness, and the eye-base, and eye-consciousness are a condition for the two other aggregates by way of presence condition …pe… (similar to the Conascence-Condition Section, without differentiation, just like the first instance. All terms are to be analyzed according to the method of the first combination). (2)

Ajjhattiko ca bāhiro ca dhammā ajjhattikassa ca bāhirassa ca dhammassa atthipaccayena paccayo – sahajātaṃ, purejātaṃ, pacchājātaṃ, āhāraṃ[T 4.0178], indriyaṃ. Sahajāto – cakkhuviññāṇasahagato eko khandho ca cakkhāyatanañca dvinnaṃ khandhānaṃ cakkhuviññāṇassa ca atthipaccayena paccayo (saṃkhittaṃ. Sabbe padā vibhajitabbā paṭhamaghaṭanānayena). (3)

Internal and external phenomena are a condition for both an internal phenomenon and an external phenomenon by way of presence condition: by conascence, prenascence, postnascence, nutriment, and faculty. By conascence: one aggregate associated with eye-consciousness and the eye-base are a condition for the two other aggregates and for eye-consciousness by way of presence condition (in brief. All terms are to be analyzed according to the method of the first combination). (3)

Natthipaccayena paccayo… vigatapaccayena paccayo… avigatapaccayena paccayo.

By absence condition… by disappearance condition… by non-disappearance condition.

363. Hetuyā tīṇi, ārammaṇe nava, adhipatiyā nava, anantare nava, samanantare nava, sahajāte nava, aññamaññe pañca, nissaye nava, upanissaye nava, purejāte nava, pacchājāte nava, āsevane nava, kamme tīṇi, vipāke nava, āhāre nava, indriye nava, jhāne tīṇi, magge tīṇi, sampayutte pañca, vippayutte nava, atthiyā nava, natthiyā nava, vigate nava, avigate nava.

363. By root condition, three; by object condition, nine; by dominance condition, nine; by contiguity condition, nine; by immediacy condition, nine; by conascence condition, nine; by mutuality condition, five; by dependence condition, nine; by strong dependence condition, nine; by prenascence condition, nine; by postnascence condition, nine; by repetition condition, nine; by kamma condition, three; by resultant condition, nine; by nutriment condition, nine; by faculty condition, nine; by jhāna condition, three; by path condition, three; by association condition, five; by dissociation condition, nine; by presence condition, nine; by absence condition, nine; by disappearance condition, nine; by non-disappearance condition, nine.

Ajjhattiko ca bāhiro ca dhammā bāhirassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo… sahajātapaccayena paccayo… upanissayapaccayena paccayo… purejātapaccayena paccayo… pacchājātapaccayena paccayo. (2)

An internal phenomenon and an external phenomenon are a condition for an external phenomenon by way of object condition... by way of conascence condition... by way of strong dependence condition... by way of prenascence condition... by way of postnascence condition. (2)

Ajjhattiko [T 4.0180] ca bāhiro ca dhammā ajjhattikassa ca bāhirassa ca dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo… sahajātapaccayena paccayo… upanissayapaccayena paccayo… purejātapaccayena paccayo… pacchājātapaccayena paccayo. (3)

An internal phenomenon and an external phenomenon are a condition for an internal phenomenon and an external phenomenon by way of object condition... by way of conascence condition... by way of strong dependence condition... by way of prenascence condition... by way of postnascence condition. (3)

2. Paccayapaccanīyaṃ

2. Conditional Negative

2. Saṅkhyāvāro

2. Enumeration Section

367. Nahetuyā nava, naārammaṇe nava (sabbattha nava), noavigate nava.

367. By not-root condition, nine; by not-object condition, nine (in all cases, nine); by not-non-disappearance condition, nine.

3. Paccayānulomapaccanīyaṃ

3. Positive-Negative Method

368. Hetupaccayā [M 3.0516] naārammaṇe tīṇi, naadhipatiyā tīṇi, naanantare tīṇi, nasamanantare tīṇi, naaññamaññe tīṇi, naupanissaye tīṇi (sabbattha tīṇi), nasampayutte tīṇi, navippayutte tīṇi, nonatthiyā tīṇi, novigate tīṇi.

368. In relation to root condition: by not-object condition, three; by not-dominance condition, three; by not-contiguity condition, three; by not-immediacy condition, three; by not-mutuality condition, three; by not-strong dependence condition, three (in all cases, three); by not-association condition, three; by not-dissociation condition, three; by not-absence condition, three; by not-disappearance condition, three.

4. Paccayapaccanīyānulomaṃ

4. Negative-Positive Method

369. Nahetupaccayā ārammaṇe nava, adhipatiyā nava (anulomamātikā kātabbā)…pe… avigate nava.

369. In relation to not-root condition: by object condition, nine; by dominance condition, nine (the positive matrix is to be applied)… by non-disappearance condition, nine.

Ajjhattikadukaṃ niṭṭhitaṃ.

The Internal Couplet is finished.

1. Exposition Section

Hetupaccayo

Root Condition

370. Upādā [V 3.0636] dhammaṃ paṭicca noupādā dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – paṭisandhikkhaṇe vatthuṃ paṭicca noupādā khandhā. (1)

370. Dependent on a clinging phenomenon, a non-clinging phenomenon arises by way of root condition. At the moment of rebirth-linking, dependent on the physical basis, the non-clinging aggregates arise. (1)

Noupādā dhammaṃ [T 4.0181] paṭicca noupādā dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – noupādā ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca tayo khandhā noupādā ca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ…pe… dve khandhe…pe… paṭisandhikkhaṇe noupādā ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca tayo khandhā noupādā ca kaṭattārūpaṃ…pe… dve khandhe…pe… ekaṃ mahābhūtaṃ…pe… dve mahābhūte paṭicca dve mahābhūtā. (1)

Dependent on a non-clinging phenomenon, a non-clinging phenomenon arises by way of root condition. Dependent on one non-clinging aggregate, three aggregates and non-clinging mind-originated materiality arise… dependent on two aggregates… At the moment of rebirth-linking, dependent on one non-clinging aggregate, three aggregates and non-clinging kamma-born materiality arise… dependent on two aggregates… Dependent on one great element… dependent on two great elements, two great elements arise. (1)

Noupādā dhammaṃ paṭicca upādā dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – noupādā khandhe paṭicca upādā cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ; paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe… mahābhūte paṭicca upādā cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ kaṭattārūpaṃ upādārūpaṃ. (2)

Dependent on a non-clinging phenomenon, a clinging phenomenon arises by way of root condition. Dependent on the non-clinging aggregates, clinging mind-originated materiality arises. At the moment of rebirth-linking… dependent on the great elements, clinging mind-originated materiality, kamma-born materiality, and derived materiality arise. (2)

Noupādā dhammaṃ paṭicca upādā ca noupādā ca dhammā uppajjanti hetupaccayā – noupādā [V 3.0637] ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca tayo khandhā upādā ca noupādā ca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ…pe… dve khandhe…pe… paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe…. (3)

Dependent on a non-clinging phenomenon, clinging and non-clinging phenomena arise by way of root condition. Dependent on one non-clinging aggregate, three aggregates and both clinging and non-clinging mind-originated materiality arise… dependent on two aggregates… At the moment of rebirth-linking…. (3)

Upādā [M 3.0517] ca noupādā ca dhammaṃ paṭicca noupādā dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – paṭisandhikkhaṇe noupādā ekaṃ khandhañca vatthuñca paṭicca tayo khandhā, dve khandhe ca…pe…. (1)

Dependent on a clinging and a non-clinging phenomenon, a non-clinging phenomenon arises by way of root condition. At the moment of rebirth-linking, dependent on one non-clinging aggregate and the physical basis, three aggregates arise; dependent on two aggregates and the physical basis…. (1)

Ārammaṇapaccayo

Object Condition

371. Upādā dhammaṃ paṭicca noupādā dhammo uppajjati ārammaṇapaccayā – paṭisandhikkhaṇe vatthuṃ paṭicca noupādā khandhā. (1)

371. Dependent on a clinging phenomenon, a non-clinging phenomenon arises by way of object condition: at the moment of rebirth-linking, dependent on the physical basis, non-clinging aggregates arise. (1)

Noupādā dhammaṃ paṭicca noupādā dhammo uppajjati ārammaṇapaccayā – noupādā ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca tayo khandhā…pe… dve khandhe…pe… paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe…. (1)

Dependent on a non-clinging phenomenon, a non-clinging phenomenon arises by way of object condition: dependent on one non-clinging aggregate, three aggregates arise... dependent on two aggregates... at the moment of rebirth-linking... (1)

Upādā ca noupādā ca dhammaṃ paṭicca noupādā dhammo uppajjati ārammaṇapaccayā – paṭisandhikkhaṇe noupādā [T 4.0182] ekaṃ khandhañca vatthuñca paṭicca tayo khandhā…pe… dve khandhe ca…pe…. (1)

Dependent on a clinging phenomenon and a non-clinging phenomenon, a non-clinging phenomenon arises by way of object condition: at the moment of rebirth-linking, dependent on one non-clinging aggregate and the physical basis, three aggregates arise... dependent on two aggregates and the physical basis... (1)

Adhipatipaccayādi

Dominance Condition, etc.

372. Noupādā dhammaṃ paṭicca noupādā dhammo uppajjati adhipatipaccayā – noupādā ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca tayo khandhā noupādā ca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ…pe… dve khandhe…pe…. (1)

372. Dependent on a non-clinging phenomenon, a non-clinging phenomenon arises by way of dominance condition: dependent on one non-clinging aggregate, three aggregates and non-clinging mind-originated materiality arise... dependent on two aggregates... (1)

Noupādā dhammaṃ paṭicca upādā dhammo uppajjati adhipatipaccayā – noupādā khandhe paṭicca upādā cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ, mahābhūte paṭicca upādā cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ. (2)

Dependent on a non-clinging phenomenon, a clinging phenomenon arises by way of dominance condition: dependent on non-clinging aggregates, clinging mind-originated materiality arises; dependent on the great elements, clinging mind-originated materiality arises. (2)

Noupādā dhammaṃ paṭicca upādā ca noupādā ca dhammā uppajjanti adhipatipaccayā – noupādā [V 3.0638] ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca tayo khandhā upādā ca noupādā ca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ…pe… dve khandhe…pe…. (3)

Dependent on a non-clinging phenomenon, both clinging and non-clinging phenomena arise by way of dominance condition: dependent on one non-clinging aggregate, three aggregates and both clinging and non-clinging mind-originated materiality arise... dependent on two aggregates... (3)

Anantarapaccayā tīṇi, samanantarapaccayā tīṇi, sahajātapaccayā pañca.

Contiguity condition—three; immediacy condition—three; conascence condition—five.

Aññamaññapaccayo

Reciprocity Condition

373. Upādā dhammaṃ paṭicca noupādā dhammo uppajjati aññamaññapaccayā – paṭisandhikkhaṇe vatthuṃ paṭicca noupādā khandhā. (1)

373. Dependent on a phenomenon subject to clinging, a phenomenon not subject to clinging arises by way of reciprocity condition: at the moment of rebirth-linking, aggregates not subject to clinging arise dependent on the physical base. (1)

Noupādā dhammaṃ paṭicca noupādā dhammo uppajjati aññamaññapaccayā – noupādā ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca tayo khandhā…pe… dve khandhe…pe… paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe… ekaṃ [M 3.0518] mahābhūtaṃ…pe… asaññasattānaṃ ekaṃ mahābhūtaṃ paṭicca…pe… dve mahābhūte paṭicca dve mahābhūtā. (1)

Dependent on a phenomenon not subject to clinging, a phenomenon not subject to clinging arises by way of reciprocity condition: dependent on one aggregate not subject to clinging, three aggregates arise... and so on... dependent on two aggregates... and so on... at the moment of rebirth-linking... and so on... dependent on one great element... and so on... for non-percipient beings, dependent on one great element... and so on... dependent on two great elements, two great elements arise. (1)

Noupādā dhammaṃ paṭicca upādā dhammo uppajjati aññamaññapaccayā – paṭisandhikkhaṇe noupādā khandhe paṭicca vatthu. (2)

Dependent on a phenomenon not subject to clinging, a phenomenon subject to clinging arises by way of reciprocity condition: at the moment of rebirth-linking, the physical base arises dependent on aggregates not subject to clinging. (2)

Noupādā dhammaṃ paṭicca upādā ca noupādā ca dhammā uppajjanti aññamaññapaccayā – paṭisandhikkhaṇe noupādā ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca tayo khandhā [T 4.0183] vatthu ca…pe… dve khandhe…pe…. (3)

Dependent on a phenomenon not subject to clinging, both phenomena subject to clinging and phenomena not subject to clinging arise by way of reciprocity condition: at the moment of rebirth-linking, dependent on one aggregate not subject to clinging, three aggregates and the physical base arise... and so on... dependent on two aggregates... and so on.... (3)

Upādā ca noupādā ca dhammaṃ paṭicca noupādā dhammo uppajjati aññamaññapaccayā – paṭisandhikkhaṇe noupādā ekaṃ khandhañca vatthuñca paṭicca tayo khandhā…pe… dve khandhe ca…pe… (saṃkhittaṃ). (1)

Dependent on a phenomenon subject to clinging and a phenomenon not subject to clinging, a phenomenon not subject to clinging arises by way of reciprocity condition: at the moment of rebirth-linking, dependent on one aggregate not subject to clinging and the physical base, three aggregates arise... and so on... dependent on two aggregates and... and so on... (Abbreviated). (1)

1. Paccayānulomaṃ

1. Positive Permutation of Conditions

2. Saṅkhyāvāro
