Hetupaccayo

Root Condition

17. Upādāno dhammo upādānassa dhammassa hetupaccayena paccayo – upādānā hetū sampayuttakānaṃ upādānānaṃ hetupaccayena paccayo. (Mūlaṃ kātabbaṃ) upādānā hetū sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ [M 3.0566] hetupaccayena paccayo. (Mūlaṃ kātabbaṃ) upādānā hetū sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ upādānānañca cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ hetupaccayena paccayo. (3)

17. A clinging phenomenon is a condition for a clinging phenomenon by way of root condition: roots that are clingings are a condition for associated clingings by way of root condition. (The triad is to be formulated.) Roots that are clingings are a condition for associated aggregates and for mind-originated material form by way of root condition. (The triad is to be formulated.) Roots that are clingings are a condition for associated aggregates, for clingings, and for mind-originated material form by way of root condition. (3)

18. Noupādāno dhammo noupādānassa dhammassa hetupaccayena paccayo – noupādānā hetū sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ hetupaccayena paccayo; paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe…. (1)

18. A non-clinging phenomenon is a condition for a non-clinging phenomenon by way of root condition: non-clinging roots are a condition for associated aggregates and for mind-originated matter by way of root condition; at the moment of rebirth-linking …pe….

Noupādāno dhammo upādānassa dhammassa [T 4.0241] hetupaccayena paccayo – noupādānā hetū sampayuttakānaṃ upādānānaṃ hetupaccayena paccayo. (Mūlaṃ kātabbaṃ) noupādānā hetū sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ upādānānañca cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ hetupaccayena paccayo. (3)

A non-clinging phenomenon is a condition for a clinging phenomenon by way of root condition: non-clinging roots are a condition for associated clingings by way of root condition. (The root-triad should be formulated.) Non-clinging roots are a condition for associated aggregates, for clingings, and for mind-originated matter by way of root condition.

19. Upādāno ca noupādāno ca dhammā upādānassa dhammassa hetupaccayena paccayo – upādānā ca noupādānā ca hetū sampayuttakānaṃ upādānānaṃ hetupaccayena paccayo. (Mūlaṃ kātabbaṃ) upādānā ca noupādānā ca hetū sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ hetupaccayena paccayo. (Mūlaṃ kātabbaṃ) upādānā ca noupādānā ca hetū sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ upādānānañca cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ hetupaccayena paccayo. (3)

19. Clinging and non-clinging phenomena are a condition for a clinging phenomenon by way of root condition: clinging and non-clinging roots are a condition for associated clingings by way of root condition. (The root-triad should be formulated.) Clinging and non-clinging roots are a condition for associated aggregates and for mind-originated matter by way of root condition. (The root-triad should be formulated.) Clinging and non-clinging roots are a condition for associated aggregates, for clingings, and for mind-originated matter by way of root condition.

Ārammaṇapaccayo

Object Condition

20. Upādāno [V 3.0697] dhammo upādānassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo – upādāne ārabbha upādānā uppajjanti… tīṇi (ārabbha kātabbā).

20. A clinging phenomenon is a condition for a clinging phenomenon by way of object condition: taking a clinging as object, clingings arise … three (to be formulated based on 'taking as object').

Noupādāno dhammo noupādānassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo – dānaṃ datvā sīlaṃ…pe… uposathakammaṃ katvā taṃ paccavekkhati assādeti abhinandati, taṃ ārabbha rāgo uppajjati, diṭṭhi uppajjati; vicikicchā…pe… uddhaccaṃ…pe… domanassaṃ uppajjati; pubbe suciṇṇāni…pe… jhānā vuṭṭhahitvā jhānaṃ paccavekkhati, ariyā maggā vuṭṭhahitvā maggaṃ paccavekkhanti, phalaṃ…pe… nibbānaṃ paccavekkhanti; nibbānaṃ gotrabhussa, vodānassa, maggassa, phalassa, āvajjanāya ārammaṇapaccayena [T 4.0242] paccayo. Ariyā noupādāne pahīne kilese [M 3.0567]…pe… vikkhambhite kilese paccavekkhanti, pubbe samudāciṇṇe…pe… cakkhuṃ…pe… vatthuṃ noupādāne khandhe aniccato…pe… domanassaṃ uppajjati; dibbena cakkhunā rūpaṃ passati, dibbāya sotadhātuyā saddaṃ suṇāti. Cetopariyañāṇena noupādānacittasamaṅgissa cittaṃ jānāti, ākāsānañcāyatanaṃ viññāṇañcāyatanassa…pe… ākiñcaññāyatanaṃ nevasaññānāsaññāyatanassa…pe… rūpāyatanaṃ cakkhuviññāṇassa…pe… phoṭṭhabbāyatanaṃ kāyaviññāṇassa…pe… noupādānā khandhā iddhividhañāṇassa, cetopariyañāṇassa, pubbenivāsānussatiñāṇassa, yathākammūpagañāṇassa, anāgataṃsañāṇassa, āvajjanāya ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo. (1)

A non-clinging phenomenon is a condition for a non-clinging phenomenon by way of object condition: having given a gift, undertaken the moral precepts …pe… having undertaken the Uposatha observance, one reflects on it, savors it, and delights in it; taking that as object, greed arises, wrong view arises; doubt …pe… restlessness …pe… displeasure arises. [Taking] previously performed good deeds as object …pe… having emerged from jhāna, one reflects on the jhāna; noble ones, having emerged from the path, reflect on the path, the fruit …pe… they reflect on Nibbāna. Nibbāna is a condition for change-of-lineage, for purification, for the path, for the fruit, and for adverting by way of object condition. Noble ones, without clinging, reflect on abandoned defilements …pe… on suppressed defilements, on what was previously accumulated …pe… the eye …pe… the base. One regards the non-clinging aggregates as impermanent …pe… displeasure arises. With the divine eye one sees a form; with the divine ear-element one hears a sound. With the knowledge of others’ minds one knows the mind of one endowed with non-clinging consciousness. The base of infinite space is a condition for the base of infinite consciousness …pe… the base of nothingness for the base of neither-perception-nor-non-perception …pe… the form base for eye-consciousness …pe… the tangible base for body-consciousness …pe… the non-clinging aggregates are a condition for the knowledge of spiritual powers, the knowledge of others’ minds, the knowledge of recollection of past lives, the knowledge of beings’ passing away and rebirth according to their kamma, the knowledge of the future, and for adverting by way of object condition.

Noupādāno dhammo upādānassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo – dānaṃ…pe… sīlaṃ…pe… uposathakammaṃ katvā taṃ assādeti abhinandati, taṃ ārabbha rāgo uppajjati, diṭṭhi uppajjati; pubbe suciṇṇāni…pe… jhānā…pe… cakkhuṃ…pe… vatthuṃ noupādāne khandhe assādeti abhinandati, taṃ ārabbha rāgo uppajjati, diṭṭhi uppajjati. (2)

A non-clinging phenomenon is a condition for a clinging phenomenon by way of object condition: having given a gift …pe… undertaken the moral precepts …pe… undertaken the Uposatha observance, one savors and delights in it; taking that as object, greed arises, wrong view arises. One savors and delights in previously performed good deeds …pe… jhānas …pe… the eye …pe… the base, the non-clinging aggregates; taking them as object, greed arises, wrong view arises.

Noupādāno dhammo upādānassa ca noupādānassa ca dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo – dānaṃ…pe… sīlaṃ…pe… uposathakammaṃ katvā…pe… pubbe suciṇṇāni [V 3.0698]…pe… jhānā vuṭṭhahitvā jhānaṃ…pe… cakkhuṃ…pe… vatthuṃ noupādāne khandhe assādeti abhinandati, taṃ ārabbha upādānā ca sampayuttakā ca khandhā uppajjanti. (3)

A non-clinging phenomenon is a condition for both a clinging phenomenon and a non-clinging phenomenon by way of object condition: having given a gift …pe… undertaken the moral precepts …pe… undertaken the Uposatha observance …pe… having previously performed good deeds …pe… having emerged from jhāna, one savors and delights in the jhāna …pe… the eye …pe… the base, the non-clinging aggregates; taking these as object, both clingings and their associated aggregates arise.

Upādāno ca noupādāno ca dhammā upādānassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo… tīṇi (ārabbha kātabbā).

Clinging and non-clinging phenomena are a condition for a clinging phenomenon by way of object condition … three (to be formulated based on 'taking as object').

Adhipatipaccayo

Dominance Condition

21. Upādāno [T 4.0243] dhammo upādānassa dhammassa adhipatipaccayena paccayo. Ārammaṇādhipati – upādāne garuṃ katvā upādānā uppajjanti… tīṇi (ārammaṇādhipatiyeva).

21. A clinging phenomenon is a condition for a clinging phenomenon by way of dominance condition. Object-dominance: having made clinging an object of esteem, clingings arise … three (only object-dominance).

22. Noupādāno dhammo noupādānassa dhammassa adhipatipaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇādhipati, sahajātādhipati. Ārammaṇādhipati – dānaṃ datvā sīlaṃ…pe… uposathakammaṃ…pe… pubbe…pe… jhānā vuṭṭhahitvā jhānaṃ garuṃ katvā paccavekkhati, assādeti abhinandati, ariyā maggā vuṭṭhahitvā [M 3.0568] maggaṃ garuṃ katvā paccavekkhanti…pe… phalassa adhipatipaccayena paccayo; cakkhuṃ…pe… vatthuṃ noupādāne khandhe garuṃ katvā assādeti abhinandati, taṃ garuṃ katvā rāgo uppajjati, diṭṭhi uppajjati. Sahajātādhipati – noupādānādhipati sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ adhipatipaccayena paccayo. (1)

22. A non-clinging phenomenon is a condition for a non-clinging phenomenon by way of dominance condition: by way of object-dominance and conascence-dominance. Object-dominance: having given a gift, undertaken the precepts …pe… performed the Uposatha observance …pe… having done good deeds previously …pe… having emerged from a jhāna, one makes that jhāna an object of esteem and reflects on it, savors it, and delights in it. Noble ones, having emerged from the path, make the path an object of esteem and reflect on it …pe… for the fruit it is a condition by way of dominance condition. One makes the eye …pe… the base, the non-clinging aggregates an object of esteem, and savors and delights in them. Having made that an object of esteem, greed arises, wrong view arises. Conascence-dominance: a non-clinging dominant factor is a condition for its associated aggregates and for mind-originated matter by way of dominance condition.

Noupādāno dhammo upādānassa dhammassa adhipatipaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇādhipati, sahajātādhipati. Ārammaṇādhipati – dānaṃ…pe… sīlaṃ…pe… uposathakammaṃ katvā taṃ garuṃ katvā assādeti abhinandati, taṃ garuṃ katvā rāgo uppajjati, diṭṭhi uppajjati; pubbe…pe… jhānā…pe… cakkhuṃ…pe… vatthuṃ noupādāne khandhe garuṃ katvā assādeti abhinandati, taṃ garuṃ katvā rāgo uppajjati, diṭṭhi uppajjati. Sahajātādhipati – noupādānādhipati sampayuttakānaṃ upādānānaṃ adhipatipaccayena paccayo. (2)

A non-clinging phenomenon is a condition for a clinging phenomenon by way of dominance condition: by way of object-dominance and conascence-dominance. Object-dominance: Having given a gift … undertaken the precepts … performed the Uposatha observance, one makes it an object of esteem, savors it, and delights in it. Having made it an object of esteem, lust arises, wrong view arises. Having done good deeds previously … having emerged from a jhāna … one makes the eye … the base, the non-clinging aggregates an object of esteem, and savors and delights in them. Having made them an object of esteem, lust arises, wrong view arises. Conascence-dominance: A non-clinging dominant factor is a condition for associated clingings by way of dominance condition. (2)

Noupādāno [V 3.0699] dhammo upādānassa ca noupādānassa ca dhammassa adhipatipaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇādhipati[T 4.0244], sahajātādhipati. Ārammaṇādhipati – dānaṃ…pe… sīlaṃ…pe… uposathakammaṃ…pe… pubbe…pe… jhānaṃ…pe… cakkhuṃ…pe… vatthuṃ noupādāne khandhe garuṃ katvā assādeti abhinandati, taṃ garuṃ katvā upādānā ca sampayuttakā ca khandhā uppajjanti. Sahajātādhipati – noupādānādhipati sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ upādānānañca cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ adhipatipaccayena paccayo. (3)

A non-clinging phenomenon is a condition for a clinging phenomenon and for a non-clinging phenomenon by way of dominance condition: by way of object-dominance and conascence-dominance. Object-dominance: Having given a gift … undertaken the precepts … performed the Uposatha observance … done good deeds previously … having emerged from a jhāna … one makes the eye … the base, the non-clinging aggregates an object of esteem, and savors and delights in them. Having made that an object of esteem, clingings and associated aggregates arise. Conascence-dominance: A non-clinging dominant factor is a condition for its associated aggregates, for the clingings, and for mind-originated matter by way of dominance condition. (3)

Upādāno ca noupādāno ca dhammā upādānassa dhammassa adhipatipaccayena paccayo… tīṇi… ārammaṇādhipati… tīṇi (ārabbha kātabbā, ārammaṇādhipatiyeva).

Clinging and non-clinging phenomena are a condition for a clinging phenomenon by way of dominance condition … three … object-dominance … three (To be worked out in relation to the object; only object-dominance).

Anantarapaccayādi

Proximity Condition, etc.

23. Upādāno dhammo upādānassa dhammassa anantarapaccayena paccayo – purimā purimā upādānā pacchimānaṃ pacchimānaṃ upādānānaṃ anantarapaccayena paccayo. (Mūlaṃ kātabbaṃ) purimā purimā upādānā pacchimānaṃ pacchimānaṃ noupādānānaṃ khandhānaṃ anantarapaccayena paccayo; upādānaṃ vuṭṭhānassa anantarapaccayena paccayo. (Mūlaṃ kātabbaṃ) purimā purimā upādānā pacchimānaṃ pacchimānaṃ upādānānaṃ sampayuttakānañca khandhānaṃ anantarapaccayena paccayo. (3)

23. A clinging phenomenon is a condition for a clinging phenomenon by way of proximity condition: Preceding, preceding clingings are a condition for succeeding, succeeding clingings by way of proximity condition. (The root section should be worked out.) Preceding, preceding clingings are a condition for succeeding, succeeding non-clinging aggregates by way of proximity condition. Clinging is a condition for emergence by way of proximity condition. (The root section should be worked out.) Preceding, preceding clingings are a condition for succeeding, succeeding clingings and their associated aggregates by way of proximity condition. (3)

24. Noupādāno [M 3.0569] dhammo noupādānassa dhammassa anantarapaccayena paccayo – purimā purimā noupādānā khandhā pacchimānaṃ pacchimānaṃ noupādānānaṃ khandhānaṃ anantarapaccayena paccayo; anulomaṃ gotrabhussa…pe… phalasamāpattiyā anantarapaccayena paccayo. (1)

24. A non-clinging phenomenon is a condition for a non-clinging phenomenon by way of proximity condition: Preceding, preceding non-clinging aggregates are a condition for succeeding, succeeding non-clinging aggregates by way of proximity condition. Conformity is a condition for change-of-lineage … for fruition attainment by way of proximity condition. (1)

Noupādāno dhammo upādānassa dhammassa anantarapaccayena paccayo – purimā purimā noupādānā khandhā [T 4.0245] pacchimānaṃ pacchimānaṃ upādānānaṃ khandhānaṃ anantarapaccayena paccayo; āvajjanā upādānānaṃ anantarapaccayena paccayo. (2)

A non-clinging phenomenon is a condition for a clinging phenomenon by way of proximity condition: Preceding, preceding non-clinging aggregates are a condition for succeeding, succeeding aggregates subject to clinging by way of proximity condition. Adverting is a condition for clingings by way of proximity condition. (2)

Noupādāno dhammo upādānassa ca noupādānassa ca dhammassa anantarapaccayena paccayo [V 3.0700] – purimā purimā noupādānā khandhā pacchimānaṃ pacchimānaṃ upādānānaṃ sampayuttakānañca khandhānaṃ anantarapaccayena paccayo; āvajjanā upādānānaṃ sampayuttakānañca khandhānaṃ anantarapaccayena paccayo. (3)

A non-clinging phenomenon is a condition for a clinging phenomenon and for a non-clinging phenomenon by way of proximity condition: Preceding, preceding non-clinging aggregates are a condition for succeeding, succeeding clingings and their associated aggregates by way of proximity condition. Adverting is a condition for clingings and their associated aggregates by way of proximity condition. (3)

25. Upādāno ca noupādāno ca dhammā upādānassa dhammassa anantarapaccayena paccayo – purimā purimā upādānā ca sampayuttakā ca khandhā pacchimānaṃ pacchimānaṃ upādānānaṃ anantarapaccayena paccayo. (Mūlaṃ kātabbaṃ) purimā purimā upādānā ca sampayuttakā ca khandhā pacchimānaṃ pacchimānaṃ noupādānānaṃ khandhānaṃ anantarapaccayena paccayo; upādānā ca sampayuttakā ca khandhā vuṭṭhānassa anantarapaccayena paccayo. (Mūlaṃ kātabbaṃ) purimā purimā upādānā ca sampayuttakā ca khandhā pacchimānaṃ pacchimānaṃ upādānānaṃ sampayuttakānañca khandhānaṃ anantarapaccayena paccayo. (3)

25. Clinging and non-clinging phenomena are a condition for a clinging phenomenon by way of proximity condition: Preceding, preceding clingings and their associated aggregates are a condition for succeeding, succeeding clingings by way of proximity condition. (The root section should be worked out.) Preceding, preceding clingings and their associated aggregates are a condition for succeeding, succeeding non-clinging aggregates by way of proximity condition. Clingings and their associated aggregates are a condition for emergence by way of proximity condition. (The root section should be worked out.) Preceding, preceding clingings and their associated aggregates are a condition for succeeding, succeeding clingings and their associated aggregates by way of proximity condition. (3)

Samanantarapaccayena paccayo… sahajātapaccayena paccayo (paṭiccasadisaṃ)… aññamaññapaccayena paccayo (paṭiccasadisaṃ)… nissayapaccayena paccayo (paccayasadisaṃ).

… by way of contiguity condition … by way of conascence condition (like the Dependent Origination section) … by way of mutuality condition (like the Dependent Origination section) … by way of support condition (like the Condition section).

Upanissayapaccayo

Decisive Support Condition

26. Upādāno dhammo upādānassa dhammassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇūpanissayo, anantarūpanissayo, pakatūpanissayo [T 4.0246] …pe…. Pakatūpanissayo – upādānā upādānānaṃ upanissayapaccayena paccayo… tīṇi.

26. A clinging phenomenon is a condition for a clinging phenomenon by way of decisive support condition: as object decisive support, as contiguity decisive support, as natural decisive support …pe…. As natural decisive support: clingings are a condition for clingings by way of decisive support condition… three.

27. Noupādāno [M 3.0570] dhammo noupādānassa dhammassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇūpanissayo, anantarūpanissayo, pakatūpanissayo…pe…. Pakatūpanissayo – saddhaṃ upanissāya dānaṃ deti…pe… samāpattiṃ uppādeti, mānaṃ jappeti, diṭṭhiṃ gaṇhāti; sīlaṃ…pe… paññaṃ… rāgaṃ…pe… patthanaṃ… kāyikaṃ sukhaṃ…pe… senāsanaṃ upanissāya dānaṃ deti…pe… samāpattiṃ uppādeti, mānaṃ jappeti, diṭṭhiṃ gaṇhāti; pāṇaṃ hanati…pe… saṅghaṃ bhindati, saddhā…pe… senāsanaṃ saddhāya…pe… phalasamāpattiyā upanissayapaccayena paccayo. (1)

27. A non-clinging phenomenon is a condition for a non-clinging phenomenon by way of decisive support condition: as object decisive support, as contiguity decisive support, as natural decisive support …pe…. As natural decisive support: relying on faith, one gives a gift …pe… generates an attainment, generates conceit, adopts a view; relying on virtue …pe… wisdom … lust … aspiration … bodily pleasure …pe… lodging, one gives a gift …pe… generates an attainment, generates conceit, adopts a view; one destroys life …pe… creates a schism in the Sangha. Faith …pe… lodging is a condition for faith …pe… for fruition attainment by way of decisive support condition. (1)

Noupādāno [V 3.0701] dhammo upādānassa dhammassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo. Pakatūpanissayo – saddhaṃ upanissāya mānaṃ jappeti, diṭṭhiṃ gaṇhāti; sīlaṃ…pe… senāsanaṃ upanissāya adinnaṃ…pe… musā…pe… pisuṇaṃ…pe… samphaṃ…pe… sandhiṃ…pe… nillopaṃ…pe… ekāgārikaṃ…pe… paripanthe…pe… paradāraṃ…pe… gāmaghātaṃ…pe… nigamaghātaṃ karoti; saddhā…pe… senāsanaṃ upādānānaṃ upanissayapaccayena paccayo. (Mūlaṃ kātabbaṃ) saddhaṃ upanissāya mānaṃ jappeti, diṭṭhiṃ gaṇhāti; sīlaṃ…pe… senāsanaṃ upanissāya adinnaṃ ādiyati, musā…pe… pisuṇaṃ…pe… samphaṃ…pe… sandhiṃ…pe… nillopaṃ…pe… ekāgārikaṃ…pe… paripanthe…pe… paradāraṃ…pe… gāmaghātaṃ…pe… nigamaghātaṃ karoti; saddhā…pe… senāsanaṃ upādānānaṃ sampayuttakānañca khandhānaṃ upanissayapaccayena paccayo. (3)

A non-clinging state is a condition for a clinging state by way of decisive support condition. As natural decisive support: relying on faith, one generates conceit, adopts a view; relying on virtue …pe… lodging, one takes what is not given …pe… speaks falsehood …pe… divisive speech …pe… idle chatter …pe… commits burglary …pe… plunders …pe… burglarizes a single house …pe… commits highway robbery …pe… commits adultery …pe… destroys a village …pe… destroys a town. Faith …pe… lodging is a condition for states of clinging by way of decisive support condition. (The root section should be done.) Relying on faith, one generates conceit, adopts a view; relying on virtue …pe… lodging, one takes what is not given, speaks falsehood …pe… divisive speech …pe… idle chatter …pe… commits burglary …pe… plunders …pe… burglarizes a single house …pe… commits highway robbery …pe… commits adultery …pe… destroys a village …pe… destroys a town. Faith …pe… lodging is a condition for states of clinging and their associated aggregates by way of decisive support condition. (3)

Upādāno ca noupādāno [T 4.0247] ca dhammā upādānassa dhammassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇūpanissayo, anantarūpanissayo, pakatūpanissayo…pe…. Pakatūpanissayo… tīṇi.

Clinging and non-clinging states are a condition for a clinging state by way of decisive support condition: as object decisive support, as contiguity decisive support, as natural decisive support …pe…. As natural decisive support… three.

Purejātapaccayo

Pre-nascence Condition

28. Noupādāno dhammo noupādānassa dhammassa purejātapaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇapurejātaṃ, vatthupurejātaṃ. Ārammaṇapurejātaṃ – cakkhuṃ…pe… vatthuṃ aniccato…pe… domanassaṃ uppajjati; dibbena cakkhunā rūpaṃ passati, dibbāya sotadhātuyā saddaṃ suṇāti. Rūpāyatanaṃ cakkhuviññāṇassa…pe… phoṭṭhabbāyatanaṃ kāyaviññāṇassa…pe…. Vatthupurejātaṃ – cakkhāyatanaṃ cakkhuviññāṇassa…pe… kāyāyatanaṃ kāyaviññāṇassa…pe… vatthu noupādānānaṃ khandhānaṃ purejātapaccayena paccayo. (1)

28. A non-clinging state is a condition for a non-clinging state by way of pre-nascence condition: as object pre-nascence, as base pre-nascence. As object pre-nascence: one regards the eye …pe… the physical basis as impermanent …pe… displeasure arises; with the divine eye one sees a form; with the divine ear element one hears a sound. The form base is a condition for eye-consciousness …pe… the tangible base for body-consciousness …pe…. As base pre-nascence: the eye base is a condition for eye-consciousness …pe… the body base for body-consciousness …pe… the physical basis is a condition for the non-clinging aggregates by way of pre-nascence condition. (1)

Noupādāno [M 3.0571] dhammo upādānassa dhammassa purejātapaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇapurejātaṃ, vatthupurejātaṃ. Ārammaṇapurejātaṃ – cakkhuṃ…pe… vatthuṃ assādeti abhinandati, taṃ ārabbha rāgo uppajjati, diṭṭhi uppajjati. Vatthupurejātaṃ – vatthu upādānānaṃ purejātapaccayena paccayo. (2)

A non-clinging state is a condition for a clinging state by way of pre-nascence condition: as object pre-nascence, as base pre-nascence. As object pre-nascence: one relishes and delights in the eye …pe… the physical basis; taking that as object, lust arises, a view arises. As base pre-nascence: the physical basis is a condition for states of clinging by way of pre-nascence condition. (2)

Noupādāno [V 3.0702] dhammo upādānassa ca noupādānassa ca dhammassa purejātapaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇapurejātaṃ, vatthupurejātaṃ. Ārammaṇapurejātaṃ – cakkhuṃ…pe… vatthuṃ assādeti abhinandati, taṃ ārabbha upādānā ca sampayuttakā ca khandhā uppajjanti. Vatthupurejātaṃ – vatthu upādānānaṃ sampayuttakānañca khandhānaṃ purejātapaccayena paccayo. (3)

A non-clinging state is a condition for both clinging and non-clinging states by way of pre-nascence condition: as object pre-nascence, as base pre-nascence. As object pre-nascence: one relishes and delights in the eye …pe… the physical basis; taking that as object, states of clinging and the associated aggregates arise. As base pre-nascence: the physical basis is a condition for states of clinging and their associated aggregates by way of pre-nascence condition. (3)

Pacchājātāsevanapaccayā

Post-nascence and Repetition Conditions

29. Upādāno dhammo noupādānassa dhammassa pacchājātapaccayena [T 4.0248] paccayo (saṃkhittaṃ). (1)

29. A clinging state is a condition for a non-clinging state by way of post-nascence condition (in brief). (1)

Noupādāno dhammo noupādānassa dhammassa pacchājātapaccayena paccayo (saṃkhittaṃ). (1)

A non-clinging state is a condition for a non-clinging state by way of post-nascence condition (in brief). (1)

Upādāno ca noupādāno ca dhammā noupādānassa dhammassa pacchājātapaccayena paccayo (saṃkhittaṃ). (1) …Āsevanapaccayena paccayo.

Clinging and non-clinging states are a condition for a non-clinging state by way of post-nascence condition (in brief). (1) … By way of repetition condition.

Kammapaccayo

Kamma Condition

30. Noupādāno dhammo noupādānassa dhammassa kammapaccayena paccayo – sahajātā, nānākkhaṇikā. Sahajātā – noupādānā cetanā sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ kammapaccayena paccayo; paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe…. Nānākkhaṇikā – noupādānā cetanā vipākānaṃ khandhānaṃ kaṭattā ca rūpānaṃ kammapaccayena paccayo. (1)

30. A non-clinging phenomenon is a condition for a non-clinging phenomenon by way of kamma condition: by co-nascence and at a different moment. By co-nascence: non-clinging volition is a condition for the associated aggregates and for mind-originated material phenomena by way of kamma condition; at the moment of rebirth-linking …pe…. At a different moment: non-clinging volition is a condition for the resultant aggregates and for kamma-originated material phenomena by way of kamma condition. (1)

Noupādāno dhammo upādānassa dhammassa kammapaccayena paccayo – noupādānā cetanā sampayuttakānaṃ upādānānaṃ kammapaccayena paccayo. (2)

A non-clinging phenomenon is a condition for a clinging phenomenon by way of kamma condition: non-clinging volition is a condition for the associated clingings by way of kamma condition. (2)

Noupādāno dhammo upādānassa ca noupādānassa ca dhammassa kammapaccayena paccayo – noupādānā cetanā sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ upādānānañca cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ kammapaccayena paccayo. (3)

A non-clinging phenomenon is a condition for a clinging phenomenon and for a non-clinging phenomenon by way of kamma condition: non-clinging volition is a condition for the associated aggregates, for the clingings, and for mind-originated material phenomena by way of kamma condition. (3)

Vipākapaccayādi

Result Condition, and so on

31. Noupādāno [M 3.0572][V 3.0703] dhammo noupādānassa dhammassa vipākapaccayena paccayo – vipāko noupādāno eko khandho…pe… ekaṃ.

31. A non-clinging phenomenon is a condition for a non-clinging phenomenon by way of result condition: a non-clinging resultant, one aggregate …pe… one.

Noupādāno dhammo noupādānassa dhammassa āhārapaccayena paccayo… tīṇi (ekoyeva kabaḷīkāro āhāro)… indriyapaccayena paccayo… tīṇi (rūpajīvitindriyaṃ ekaṃyeva)… jhānapaccayena paccayo… tīṇi.

A non-clinging phenomenon is a condition for a non-clinging phenomenon by way of nutriment condition … three (physical nutriment is only one) … by way of faculty condition … three (the material life-faculty is only one) … by way of jhāna condition … three.

Upādāno [T 4.0249] dhammo upādānassa dhammassa maggapaccayena paccayo – upādānāni maggaṅgāni sampayuttakānaṃ upādānānaṃ maggapaccayena paccayo (iminā kāraṇena nava pañhā kātabbā)… sampayuttapaccayena paccayo… nava.

A clinging phenomenon is a condition for a clinging phenomenon by way of path condition: clinging path factors are a condition for associated clingings by way of path condition (for this reason, nine questions should be formulated) … by way of association condition … nine.

Vippayuttapaccayo

Dissociation Condition

32. Upādāno dhammo noupādānassa dhammassa vippayuttapaccayena paccayo – sahajātaṃ, pacchājātaṃ. Sahajātā – upādānā cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ vippayuttapaccayena paccayo. Pacchājātaṃ – pacchājātā upādānā purejātassa imassa kāyassa vippayuttapaccayena paccayo. (1)

32. A clinging phenomenon is a condition for a non-clinging phenomenon by way of dissociation condition: by co-nascence and by post-nascence. By co-nascence: clingings are a condition for mind-originated material phenomena by way of dissociation condition. By post-nascence: post-nascent clingings are a condition for this pre-nascent body by way of dissociation condition. (1)

Noupādāno dhammo noupādānassa dhammassa vippayuttapaccayena paccayo – sahajātaṃ, purejātaṃ, pacchājātaṃ (saṃkhittaṃ). (1)

A non-clinging phenomenon is a condition for a non-clinging phenomenon by way of dissociation condition: by co-nascence, by pre-nascence, and by post-nascence (in brief). (1)

Noupādāno dhammo upādānassa dhammassa vippayuttapaccayena paccayo. Purejātaṃ – vatthu upādānānaṃ vippayuttapaccayena paccayo. (2)

A non-clinging phenomenon is a condition for a clinging phenomenon by way of dissociation condition. By pre-nascence: the physical base is a condition for clingings by way of dissociation condition. (2)

Noupādāno dhammo upādānassa ca noupādānassa ca dhammassa vippayuttapaccayena paccayo. Purejātaṃ – vatthu upādānānaṃ sampayuttakānañca khandhānaṃ vippayuttapaccayena paccayo. (3)

A non-clinging phenomenon is a condition for a clinging phenomenon and for a non-clinging phenomenon by way of dissociation condition. By pre-nascence: the physical base is a condition for the clingings and for the associated aggregates by way of dissociation condition. (3)

33. Upādāno [V 3.0704] ca noupādāno ca dhammā noupādānassa dhammassa vippayuttapaccayena paccayo – sahajātaṃ, pacchājātaṃ. Sahajātā – upādānā ca sampayuttakā ca khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ vippayuttapaccayena paccayo. Pacchājātā – upādānā ca sampayuttakā ca khandhā purejātassa imassa kāyassa vippayuttapaccayena paccayo. (1)

33. A clinging phenomenon and a non-clinging phenomenon are a condition for a non-clinging phenomenon by way of dissociation condition: by co-nascence and by post-nascence. By co-nascence: clingings and the associated aggregates are a condition for mind-originated material phenomena by way of dissociation condition. By post-nascence: clingings and the associated aggregates are a condition for this pre-nascent body by way of dissociation condition. (1)

Atthipaccayo

Presence Condition

34. Upādāno [T 4.0250][M 3.0573] dhammo upādānassa dhammassa atthipaccayena paccayo – diṭṭhupādānaṃ kāmupādānassa atthipaccayena paccayo (cakkaṃ). (1)

34. A clinging phenomenon is a condition for a clinging phenomenon by way of presence condition: clinging to views is a condition for clinging to sensual pleasures by way of presence condition (cyclical). (1)

Upādāno dhammo noupādānassa dhammassa atthipaccayena paccayo – sahajātaṃ, pacchājātaṃ. Sahajātā – upādānā sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo. Pacchājātā – upādānā purejātassa imassa kāyassa atthipaccayena paccayo. (2)

A clinging phenomenon is a condition for a non-clinging phenomenon by way of presence condition: by co-nascence and by post-nascence. By co-nascence: clingings are a condition for the associated aggregates and for mind-originated material phenomena by way of presence condition. By post-nascence: clingings are a condition for this pre-nascent body by way of presence condition. (2)

Upādāno dhammo upādānassa ca noupādānassa ca dhammassa atthipaccayena paccayo (saṃkhittaṃ, paṭiccasadisaṃ). (3)

A clinging phenomenon is a condition for a clinging phenomenon and for a non-clinging phenomenon by way of presence condition (in brief, similar to dependent origination). (3)

35. Noupādāno dhammo noupādānassa dhammassa atthipaccayena paccayo – sahajātaṃ, purejātaṃ, pacchājātaṃ, āhāraṃ, indriyaṃ (saṃkhittaṃ, vitthāretabbaṃ). (1)

35. A non-clinging phenomenon is a condition for a non-clinging phenomenon by way of presence condition: by co-nascence, pre-nascence, post-nascence, nutriment, and faculty (in brief, to be elaborated). (1)

Noupādāno dhammo upādānassa dhammassa atthipaccayena paccayo – sahajātaṃ, purejātaṃ. Sahajātaṃ (sahajātasadisaṃ). Purejātaṃ (purejātasadisaṃ). (2)

A non-clinging phenomenon is a condition for a clinging phenomenon by way of presence condition: by co-nascence and by pre-nascence. By co-nascence (similar to the co-nascence section). By pre-nascence (similar to the pre-nascence section). (2)

Noupādāno dhammo upādānassa ca noupādānassa ca dhammassa atthipaccayena paccayo – sahajātaṃ, purejātaṃ (saṃkhittaṃ, sahajātasadisaṃ sahajātaṃ vibhajitabbaṃ, purejātasadisaṃ purejātaṃ). (3)

A non-clinging phenomenon is a condition for a clinging phenomenon and for a non-clinging phenomenon by way of presence condition: by co-nascence and by pre-nascence (in brief; the co-nascent part should be analyzed similar to co-nascence, the pre-nascent part similar to pre-nascence). (3)

36. Upādāno [V 3.0705] ca noupādāno ca dhammā upādānassa dhammassa atthipaccayena paccayo – sahajātaṃ, purejātaṃ. Sahajātaṃ – diṭṭhupādānañca sampayuttakā ca khandhā kāmupādānassa atthipaccayena paccayo (cakkaṃ). Sahajātaṃ – diṭṭhupādānañca vatthu ca kāmupādānassa atthipaccayena paccayo (cakkaṃ). (1)

36. A clinging phenomenon and a non-clinging phenomenon are a condition for a clinging phenomenon by way of presence condition: by co-nascence and by pre-nascence. By co-nascence: clinging to views and the associated aggregates are a condition for clinging to sensual pleasures by way of presence condition (cyclical). By co-nascence: clinging to views and the physical base are a condition for clinging to sensual pleasures by way of presence condition (cyclical). (1)

Upādāno ca noupādāno ca dhammā noupādānassa dhammassa [T 4.0251] atthipaccayena paccayo – sahajātaṃ, purejātaṃ, pacchājātaṃ, āhāraṃ, indriyaṃ. Sahajāto – noupādāno eko khandho ca upādānā ca tiṇṇannaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo…pe… dve khandhā ca…pe…. Sahajātā – upādānā ca mahābhūtā ca cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ [M 3.0574] atthipaccayena paccayo. Sahajātā – upādānā ca vatthu ca noupādānānaṃ khandhānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo. Pacchājātā – upādānā ca sampayuttakā ca khandhā purejātassa imassa kāyassa atthipaccayena paccayo. Pacchājātā – upādānā ca sampayuttakā ca khandhā kabaḷīkāro āhāro ca imassa kāyassa atthipaccayena paccayo. Pacchājātā – upādānā ca sampayuttakā ca khandhā rūpajīvitindriyañca kaṭattārūpānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo. (2)

A clinging phenomenon and a non-clinging phenomenon are a condition for a non-clinging phenomenon by way of presence condition: by co-nascence, pre-nascence, post-nascence, nutriment, and faculty. By co-nascence: one non-clinging aggregate and clingings are a condition for the three aggregates and for mind-originated material phenomena by way of presence condition …and so on… two aggregates and …and so on…. By co-nascence: clingings and the great elements are a condition for mind-originated material phenomena by way of presence condition. By co-nascence: clingings and the physical base are a condition for the non-clinging aggregates by way of presence condition. By post-nascence: clingings and the associated aggregates are a condition for this pre-nascent body by way of presence condition. By post-nascence: clingings and the associated aggregates and physical nutriment are a condition for this body by way of presence condition. By post-nascence: clingings and the associated aggregates and the material life-faculty are a condition for kamma-originated material phenomena by way of presence condition. (2)

Upādāno ca noupādāno ca dhammā upādānassa ca noupādānassa ca dhammassa atthipaccayena paccayo – sahajātaṃ, purejātaṃ. Sahajāto – noupādāno eko khandho ca diṭṭhupādānañca tiṇṇannaṃ khandhānaṃ kāmupādānassa ca cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo…pe… dve khandhā ca…pe… (cakkaṃ). Sahajātaṃ – diṭṭhupādānañca vatthu ca kāmupādānassa sampayuttakānañca khandhānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo (cakkaṃ). (3)

A clinging phenomenon and a non-clinging phenomenon are a condition for a clinging phenomenon and for a non-clinging phenomenon by way of presence condition: by co-nascence and by pre-nascence. By co-nascence: one non-clinging aggregate and clinging to views are a condition for the three aggregates, for clinging to sensual pleasures, and for mind-originated material phenomena by way of presence condition …and so on… two aggregates and …and so on… (cyclical). By co-nascence: clinging to views and the physical base are a condition for clinging to sensual pleasures and for the associated aggregates by way of presence condition (cyclical). (3)

(3)

54. Upādānavippayuttaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca upādānavippayutto dhammo uppajjati napurejātapaccayā – arūpe upādānavippayuttaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca tayo khandhā…pe… dve khandhe…pe… upādānavippayutte khandhe paṭicca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ, diṭṭhigatavippayuttaṃ lobhaṃ paṭicca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ; paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe… (yāva asaññasattā). (1)

54. A state dissociated from clinging arises in dependence on a state dissociated from clinging, but not by way of prenascence condition: in the immaterial realm, in dependence on one aggregate dissociated from clinging, three aggregates arise...pe... two aggregates...pe...; in dependence on aggregates dissociated from clinging, mind-originated matter arises; in dependence on greed dissociated from wrong view, mind-originated matter arises; at the moment of rebirth-linking...pe... (as far as the non-percipient beings). (1)

Upādānavippayuttaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca upādānasampayutto dhammo uppajjati napurejātapaccayā [T 4.0259] – arūpe diṭṭhigatavippayuttaṃ lobhaṃ paṭicca sampayuttakā khandhā. (2)

A state associated with clinging arises in dependence on a state dissociated from clinging, but not by way of prenascence condition: in the immaterial realm, in dependence on greed dissociated from wrong view, the associated aggregates arise. (2)

Upādānasampayuttañca upādānavippayuttañca dhammaṃ paṭicca upādānasampayutto dhammo uppajjati napurejātapaccayā – arūpe diṭṭhigatavippayuttalobhasahagataṃ ekaṃ khandhañca lobhañca paṭicca tayo khandhā…pe… dve khandhe ca…pe…. (1)

A state associated with clinging arises in dependence on a state associated with clinging and a state dissociated from clinging, but not by way of prenascence condition: in the immaterial realm, in dependence on one aggregate accompanied by greed dissociated from wrong view and on that greed, three aggregates arise...pe... in dependence on two aggregates and that greed...pe.... (1)

Upādānasampayuttañca upādānavippayuttañca dhammaṃ paṭicca upādānavippayutto dhammo uppajjati napurejātapaccayā – upādānasampayutte khandhe ca mahābhūte ca paṭicca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ, diṭṭhigatavippayuttalobhasahagate khandhe ca lobhañca paṭicca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ. (2)

A state dissociated from clinging arises in dependence on a state associated with clinging and a state dissociated from clinging, but not by way of prenascence condition: in dependence on aggregates associated with clinging and the great elements, mind-originated matter arises; in dependence on aggregates accompanied by greed dissociated from wrong view and on that greed, mind-originated matter arises. (2)

Napacchājātapaccayā… naāsevanapaccayā.

Not by way of postnascence condition... not by way of repetition condition.

55. Upādānasampayuttaṃ [V 3.0714] dhammaṃ paṭicca upādānasampayutto dhammo uppajjati nakammapaccayā – upādānasampayutte khandhe paṭicca sampayuttakā cetanā. (1)

55. A phenomenon associated with clinging arises in dependence on a phenomenon associated with clinging by not-kamma condition—in dependence on aggregates associated with clinging, associated volition arises. (1)

A phenomenon dissociated from clinging arises in dependence on a phenomenon dissociated from clinging by not-kamma condition—in dependence on aggregates dissociated from clinging, associated volition arises; external… nutriment-originated… temperature-originated…pe…. (1)

Upādānavippayuttaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca upādānasampayutto dhammo uppajjati nakammapaccayā – diṭṭhigatavippayuttaṃ lobhaṃ paṭicca sampayuttakā cetanā. (2)

A phenomenon associated with clinging arises in dependence on a phenomenon dissociated from clinging by not-kamma condition—in dependence on greed dissociated from wrong view, associated volition arises. (2)

Upādānasampayuttañca [M 3.0581] upādānavippayuttañca dhammaṃ paṭicca upādānasampayutto dhammo uppajjati nakammapaccayā – diṭṭhigatavippayuttalobhasahagate khandhe ca lobhañca paṭicca sampayuttakā cetanā. (1) (Saṃkhittaṃ.)

A phenomenon associated with clinging arises in dependence on a phenomenon associated with clinging and a phenomenon dissociated from clinging by not-kamma condition—in dependence on aggregates accompanied by greed dissociated from wrong view and on that greed, associated volition arises. (1) (In brief.)

57. Upādānasampayuttaṃ dhammaṃ paccayā upādānasampayutto dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā… tīṇi (paṭiccasadisaṃ).

57. A phenomenon associated with clinging is a condition for a phenomenon associated with clinging by root condition… three (similar to the Dependence Section).

Upādānavippayuttaṃ dhammaṃ paccayā upādānavippayutto dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – upādānavippayuttaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paccayā…pe… (yāva ajjhattikā mahābhūtā) vatthuṃ paccayā upādānavippayuttā khandhā, vatthuṃ paccayā diṭṭhigatavippayutto lobho. (1)

A phenomenon dissociated from clinging is a condition for a phenomenon dissociated from clinging by root condition: one aggregate dissociated from clinging is a condition for…pe… (as far as the internal great elements); the physical basis is a condition for the aggregates dissociated from clinging; the physical basis is a condition for greed dissociated from wrong view. (1)

Upādānavippayuttaṃ dhammaṃ paccayā upādānasampayutto dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – vatthuṃ paccayā upādānasampayuttā khandhā, diṭṭhigatavippayuttaṃ lobhaṃ paccayā sampayuttakā khandhā. (2)

A phenomenon dissociated from clinging is a condition for a phenomenon associated with clinging by root condition: the physical basis is a condition for the aggregates associated with clinging; greed dissociated from wrong view is a condition for the associated aggregates. (2)

Upādānavippayuttaṃ [M 3.0582] dhammaṃ paccayā upādānasampayutto ca upādānavippayutto ca dhammā uppajjanti [V 3.0716] hetupaccayā – vatthuṃ paccayā upādānasampayuttakā khandhā, mahābhūte paccayā cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ; diṭṭhigatavippayuttaṃ lobhaṃ paccayā sampayuttakā [T 4.0261] khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ, vatthuṃ paccayā diṭṭhigatavippayuttalobhasahagatā khandhā ca lobho ca. (3)

A phenomenon dissociated from clinging is a condition for a phenomenon associated with clinging and a phenomenon dissociated from clinging by root condition: the physical basis is a condition for the aggregates associated with clinging; the great elements are a condition for mind-originated matter; greed dissociated from wrong view is a condition for the associated aggregates and mind-originated matter; the physical basis is a condition for the aggregates accompanied by greed dissociated from wrong view and for that greed. (3)

58. Upādānasampayuttañca upādānavippayuttañca dhammaṃ paccayā upādānasampayutto dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – upādānasampayuttaṃ ekaṃ khandhañca vatthuñca paccayā tayo khandhā…pe… dve khandhe ca…pe… diṭṭhigatavippayuttalobhasahagataṃ ekaṃ khandhañca lobhañca paccayā tayo khandhā…pe… dve khandhe ca…pe…. (1)

58. A phenomenon associated with clinging and a phenomenon dissociated from clinging are a condition for a phenomenon associated with clinging by root condition: one aggregate associated with clinging and the physical basis are a condition for the three aggregates…pe… and for the two aggregates…pe…; one aggregate that accompanies greed dissociated from wrong view and that greed are a condition for the three aggregates…pe… and for the two aggregates…pe…. (1)

Upādānasampayuttañca upādānavippayuttañca dhammaṃ paccayā upādānavippayutto dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – upādānasampayutte khandhe ca mahābhūte ca paccayā cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ, diṭṭhigatavippayuttalobhasahagate khandhe ca lobhañca paccayā cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ, diṭṭhigatavippayuttalobhasahagate khandhe ca vatthuñca paccayā lobho. (2)

A phenomenon associated with clinging and a phenomenon dissociated from clinging are a condition for a phenomenon dissociated from clinging by root condition: the aggregates associated with clinging and the great elements are a condition for mind-originated matter; the aggregates that accompany greed dissociated from wrong view and that greed are a condition for mind-originated matter; the aggregates that accompany greed dissociated from wrong view and the physical basis are a condition for that greed. (2)

Upādānasampayuttañca upādānavippayuttañca dhammaṃ paccayā upādānasampayutto ca upādānavippayutto ca dhammā uppajjanti hetupaccayā – upādānasampayuttaṃ ekaṃ khandhañca vatthuñca paccayā tayo khandhā…pe… dve khandhe ca…pe… upādānasampayutte khandhe ca mahābhūte ca paccayā cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ; diṭṭhigatavippayuttalobhasahagataṃ ekaṃ khandhañca vatthuñca paccayā tayo khandhā lobho ca…pe… dve khandhe ca…pe…. (3) (Saṃkhittaṃ. Ārammaṇapaccayamhi pañca viññāṇā kātabbā.)

A phenomenon associated with clinging and a phenomenon dissociated from clinging are related to a phenomenon associated with clinging and a phenomenon dissociated from clinging by root condition: one aggregate associated with clinging and the physical basis are a condition for the three aggregates… etc.… and for the two aggregates… etc.; the aggregates associated with clinging and the great elements are a condition for mind-originated matter; one aggregate that accompanies greed dissociated from views and the physical basis is a condition for the three aggregates and for that greed… etc.… and for the two aggregates… etc. (3) (In brief. In object condition, the five consciousnesses should be dealt with.)

62. Upādānasampayuttaṃ dhammaṃ saṃsaṭṭho upādānasampayutto dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – upādānasampayuttaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ saṃsaṭṭhā… tīṇi.

62. Combined with a phenomenon associated with clinging, a phenomenon associated with clinging arises by root condition: combined with one aggregate associated with clinging, the three other aggregates arise.

Upādānavippayuttaṃ dhammaṃ saṃsaṭṭho upādānavippayutto dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā (paṭiccasadisaṃ, arūpaṃyeva kātabbaṃ).

Combined with a phenomenon dissociated from clinging, a phenomenon dissociated from clinging arises by root condition (to be worked out similarly to the Paṭiccavāra, for the formless sphere only).

Upādānavippayuttaṃ [V 3.0718] dhammaṃ saṃsaṭṭho upādānasampayutto dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā (paṭiccasadisaṃ, arūpaṃyeva kātabbaṃ).

Combined with a phenomenon dissociated from clinging, a phenomenon associated with clinging arises by root condition (to be worked out similarly to the Paṭiccavāra, for the formless sphere only).

Upādānasampayuttañca upādānavippayuttañca dhammaṃ saṃsaṭṭho upādānasampayutto dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā (paṭiccasadisaṃ, arūpaṃyeva kātabbaṃ).

Combined with a phenomenon associated with clinging and a phenomenon dissociated from clinging, a phenomenon associated with clinging arises by root condition (to be worked out similarly to the Paṭiccavāra, for the formless sphere only).

Hetuyā cha, ārammaṇe cha, adhipatiyā cha (sabbattha cha), vipāke ekaṃ…pe… avigate cha.
