Hetupaccayo

Root Condition

63. Upādānasampayutto [V 3.0719] dhammo upādānasampayuttassa dhammassa hetupaccayena paccayo – upādānasampayuttā hetū sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ hetupaccayena paccayo. (1)

63. A dhamma associated with clinging is a condition for a dhamma associated with clinging by way of root condition: the roots associated with clinging are a condition for the associated aggregates by way of root condition. (1)

Upādānasampayutto dhammo upādānavippayuttassa dhammassa hetupaccayena paccayo – upādānasampayuttā hetū cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ hetupaccayena paccayo; diṭṭhigatavippayuttalobhasahagatā hetū diṭṭhigatavippayuttalobhassa cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ hetupaccayena paccayo. (Mūlaṃ kātabbaṃ) upādānasampayuttā hetū sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ hetupaccayena paccayo; diṭṭhigatavippayuttalobhasahagatā hetū sampayuttakānaṃ [T 4.0264] khandhānaṃ lobhassa ca cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ hetupaccayena paccayo. (3)

A dhamma associated with clinging is a condition for a dhamma dissociated from clinging by way of root condition: roots associated with clinging are a condition for mind-originated matter by way of root condition; roots accompanied by greed dissociated from wrong view are a condition for greed dissociated from wrong view and for mind-originated matter by way of root condition. (The full version should be stated:) Roots associated with clinging are a condition for the associated aggregates and for mind-originated matter by way of root condition; roots accompanied by greed dissociated from wrong view are a condition for the associated aggregates, for greed, and for mind-originated matter by way of root condition. (3)

64. Upādānavippayutto dhammo upādānavippayuttassa dhammassa hetupaccayena paccayo – upādānavippayuttā hetū sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ hetupaccayena paccayo; diṭṭhigatavippayutto lobho cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ hetupaccayena paccayo; paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe…. (Mūlaṃ kātabbaṃ) diṭṭhigatavippayutto lobho sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ hetupaccayena paccayo. (Mūlaṃ kātabbaṃ) diṭṭhigatavippayutto lobho [M 3.0585] sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ hetupaccayena paccayo. (3)

64. A dhamma dissociated from clinging is a condition for a dhamma dissociated from clinging by way of root condition: roots dissociated from clinging are a condition for the associated aggregates and for mind-originated matter by way of root condition; greed dissociated from wrong view is a condition for mind-originated matter by way of root condition; at the moment of relinking …pe… (The full version should be stated:) Greed dissociated from wrong view is a condition for the associated aggregates by way of root condition. (The full version should be stated:) Greed dissociated from wrong view is a condition for the associated aggregates and for mind-originated matter by way of root condition. (3)

65. Upādānasampayutto ca upādānavippayutto ca dhammā upādānasampayuttassa dhammassa hetupaccayena paccayo – diṭṭhigatavippayuttalobhasahagato moho ca lobho ca sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ hetupaccayena paccayo. (Mūlaṃ kātabbaṃ) diṭṭhigatavippayuttalobhasahagato moho ca lobho ca cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ hetupaccayena paccayo. (2)

65. Phenomena both associated with and dissociated from clinging are a condition for a phenomenon associated with clinging by way of root condition: delusion accompanied by greed dissociated from wrong view, and that greed itself, are a condition for the associated aggregates by way of root condition. (The full version should be stated:) Delusion accompanied by greed dissociated from wrong view, and that greed itself, are a condition for mind-originated matter by way of root condition. (2)

Upādānasampayutto [V 3.0720] ca upādānavippayutto ca dhammā upādānasampayuttassa ca upādānavippayuttassa ca dhammassa hetupaccayena paccayo – diṭṭhigatavippayuttalobhasahagato moho ca lobho ca sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ hetupaccayena paccayo. (3)

Phenomena both associated with and dissociated from clinging are a condition for phenomena both associated with and dissociated from clinging by way of root condition: delusion accompanied by greed dissociated from wrong view, and that greed itself, are a condition for the associated aggregates and for mind-originated matter by way of root condition. (3)

Ārammaṇapaccayo

Object Condition

66. Upādānasampayutto dhammo upādānasampayuttassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo – upādānasampayutte khandhe ārabbha upādānasampayuttā [T 4.0265] khandhā uppajjanti. (Mūlaṃ kātabbaṃ) upādānasampayutte khandhe ārabbha upādānavippayuttā khandhā ca lobho ca uppajjanti. (Mūlaṃ kātabbaṃ) upādānasampayutte khandhe ārabbha diṭṭhigatavippayuttalobhasahagatā khandhā ca lobho ca uppajjanti. (3)

66. A dhamma associated with clinging is a condition for a dhamma associated with clinging by way of object condition: dependent on aggregates associated with clinging, aggregates associated with clinging arise. (The root section is to be done.) Dependent on aggregates associated with clinging, aggregates dissociated from clinging and greed arise. (The root section is to be done.) Dependent on aggregates associated with clinging, aggregates accompanied by greed dissociated from wrong view, and greed, arise. (3)

67. Upādānavippayutto dhammo upādānavippayuttassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo – dānaṃ…pe… sīlaṃ…pe… uposathakammaṃ…pe… pubbe suciṇṇāni…pe… jhānā vuṭṭhahitvā jhānaṃ paccavekkhati, assādeti abhinandati, taṃ ārabbha diṭṭhigatavippayutto rāgo…pe… vicikicchā…pe… uddhaccaṃ uppajjati, jhāne parihīne vippaṭisārissa domanassaṃ uppajjati. Ariyā maggā vuṭṭhahitvā maggaṃ paccavekkhanti, phalaṃ…pe… nibbānaṃ paccavekkhanti. Nibbānaṃ gotrabhussa, vodānassa, maggassa, phalassa, āvajjanāya ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo. Ariyā upādānavippayutte pahīne kilese…pe… vikkhambhite kilese…pe… pubbe samudāciṇṇe kilese…pe… cakkhuṃ…pe… vatthuṃ upādānavippayutte khandhe [M 3.0586] ca lobhañca aniccato…pe… vipassati, assādeti abhinandati, taṃ ārabbha diṭṭhigatavippayutto rāgo…pe… vicikicchā…pe… uddhaccaṃ…pe… domanassaṃ uppajjati…pe… (sabbaṃ paripuṇṇaṃ), dibbena cakkhunā… (yāva kāyaviññāṇaṃ), upādānavippayuttā khandhā iddhividhañāṇassa, cetopariyañāṇassa, pubbenivāsānussatiñāṇassa, yathākammūpagañāṇassa, anāgataṃsañāṇassa, āvajjanāya ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo. (1)

67. A dhamma dissociated from clinging is a condition for a dhamma dissociated from clinging by way of object condition: giving… virtue… Uposatha observance… past good deeds… having emerged from jhāna, one reviews the jhāna, savors it, and delights in it. Taking that as object, greed dissociated from wrong view… doubt… restlessness arises. When one has fallen away from jhāna, regret and displeasure arise. Noble ones, having emerged from the path, review the path, the fruit… they review nibbāna. Nibbāna is a condition by way of object condition for change-of-lineage, for purification, for the path, for the fruit, and for advertence. Noble ones review the abandoned defilements dissociated from clinging… the suppressed defilements… the previously accumulated defilements… the eye… the base… they contemplate the aggregates dissociated from clinging, and greed, as impermanent… they savor them and delight in them. Taking that as object, greed dissociated from wrong view… doubt… restlessness… displeasure arises… (all should be filled in). With the divine eye… (as far as body-consciousness), aggregates dissociated from clinging are a condition by way of object condition for the knowledge of the kinds of psychic power, for the knowledge of others’ minds, for the knowledge of recollection of past lives, for the knowledge of the passing away and rebirth of beings according to their kamma, for the knowledge of the future, and for advertence. (1)

Upādānavippayutto dhammo upādānasampayuttassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena [T 4.0266] paccayo – dānaṃ [V 3.0721]…pe… jhānaṃ…pe… cakkhuṃ…pe… vatthuṃ upādānavippayutte khandhe ca lobhañca assādeti abhinandati, taṃ ārabbha rāgo uppajjati, diṭṭhi uppajjati. (2)

A dhamma dissociated from clinging is a condition for a dhamma associated with clinging by way of object condition: one savors and delights in giving… jhāna… the eye… the base… the aggregates dissociated from clinging, and greed. Taking that as object, greed arises, wrong view arises. (2)

Upādānavippayutto dhammo upādānasampayuttassa ca upādānavippayuttassa ca dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo – cakkhuṃ…pe… vatthuṃ upādānavippayutte khandhe ca lobhañca ārabbha diṭṭhigatavippayuttalobhasahagatā khandhā ca lobho ca uppajjanti. (3)

A dhamma dissociated from clinging is a condition for a dhamma associated with clinging and for a dhamma dissociated from clinging by way of object condition: dependent on the eye… the base… the aggregates dissociated from clinging, and greed, there arise aggregates accompanied by greed but dissociated from wrong view, and greed. (3)

68. Upādānasampayutto ca upādānavippayutto ca dhammā upādānasampayuttassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo – diṭṭhigatavippayuttalobhasahagate khandhe ca lobhañca ārabbha upādānasampayuttā khandhā uppajjanti. (Mūlaṃ kātabbaṃ) diṭṭhigatavippayuttalobhasahagate khandhe ca lobhañca ārabbha upādānavippayuttā khandhā ca lobho ca uppajjanti. (Mūlaṃ kātabbaṃ) diṭṭhigatavippayuttalobhasahagate khandhe ca lobhañca ārabbha diṭṭhigatavippayuttalobhasahagatā khandhā ca lobho ca uppajjanti. (3)

68. A state associated with clinging and a state dissociated from clinging are a condition for a state associated with clinging by way of object condition: dependent on aggregates accompanied by greed but dissociated from wrong view, and greed, aggregates associated with clinging arise. (The root section is to be done.) They are a condition for a state dissociated from clinging: dependent on the same object, aggregates dissociated from clinging and greed arise. (The root section is to be done.) They are a condition for a state associated with clinging and a state dissociated from clinging: dependent on the same object, aggregates accompanied by greed but dissociated from wrong view, and greed, arise. (3)

Adhipatipaccayo

Predominance Condition

69. Upādānasampayutto dhammo upādānasampayuttassa dhammassa adhipatipaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇādhipati, sahajātādhipati. Ārammaṇādhipati – upādānasampayutte khandhe garuṃ katvā upādānasampayuttā khandhā uppajjanti. Sahajātādhipati – upādānasampayuttādhipati sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ adhipatipaccayena [M 3.0587] paccayo. (Mūlaṃ kātabbaṃ) ārammaṇādhipati, sahajātādhipati. Ārammaṇādhipati – upādānasampayutte [T 4.0267] khandhe garuṃ katvā diṭṭhigatavippayutto lobho uppajjati. Sahajātādhipati – upādānasampayuttādhipati cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ adhipatipaccayena paccayo; diṭṭhigatavippayuttalobhasahagatādhipati lobhassa ca cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ adhipatipaccayena paccayo. (Mūlaṃ kātabbaṃ) ārammaṇādhipati, sahajātādhipati. Ārammaṇādhipati – upādānasampayutte khandhe garuṃ katvā diṭṭhigatavippayuttalobhasahagatā khandhā ca lobho ca uppajjanti. Sahajātādhipati – upādānasampayuttādhipati sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ adhipatipaccayena paccayo; diṭṭhigatavippayuttalobhasahagatādhipati sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ lobhassa ca cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ adhipatipaccayena paccayo. (3)

69. A state associated with clinging is a condition for a state associated with clinging by way of predominance condition—by object-predominance and conascence-predominance. Object-predominance: by giving weight to the aggregates associated with clinging, aggregates associated with clinging arise. Conascence-predominance: a predominance associated with clinging is a condition for its associated aggregates by way of predominance condition. (The root section is to be done.) It is a condition for a state dissociated from clinging by way of predominance condition. Object-predominance: by giving weight to the aggregates associated with clinging, greed dissociated from wrong view arises. Conascence-predominance: a predominance associated with clinging is a condition for mind-originated materiality by way of predominance condition; a predominance accompanied by greed but dissociated from wrong view is a condition for greed and for mind-originated materiality by way of predominance condition. (The root section is to be done.) It is a condition for a state associated with clinging and for a state dissociated from clinging by way of predominance condition. Object-predominance: by giving weight to the aggregates associated with clinging, aggregates accompanied by greed but dissociated from wrong view, and greed, arise. Conascence-predominance: a predominance associated with clinging is a condition for its associated aggregates and for mind-originated materiality by way of predominance condition; a predominance accompanied by greed but dissociated from wrong view is a condition for its associated aggregates, for greed, and for mind-originated materiality by way of predominance condition. (3)

70. Upādānavippayutto [V 3.0722] dhammo upādānavippayuttassa dhammassa adhipatipaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇādhipati, sahajātādhipati. Ārammaṇādhipati – dānaṃ…pe… sīlaṃ…pe… jhānā vuṭṭhahitvā jhānaṃ garuṃ katvā paccavekkhati, assādeti abhinandati, taṃ garuṃ katvā diṭṭhigatavippayutto rāgo uppajjati…pe… ariyā maggā vuṭṭhahitvā…pe… phalassa adhipatipaccayena paccayo; cakkhuṃ…pe… vatthuṃ upādānavippayutte khandhe ca lobhañca garuṃ katvā assādeti abhinandati, taṃ garuṃ katvā diṭṭhigatavippayutto rāgo uppajjati. Sahajātādhipati – upādānavippayuttādhipati sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ adhipatipaccayena paccayo. (1)

70. A state dissociated from clinging is a condition for a state dissociated from clinging by way of predominance condition—by object-predominance and conascence-predominance. Object-predominance: After giving… virtue… having emerged from jhāna, one reviews the jhāna, regards it highly, savors it, and rejoices in it. Regarding that as primary, greed dissociated from wrong view arises… The noble ones, having emerged from the path… it is a condition for the fruit by way of predominance condition. Regarding the eye… the base… the aggregates dissociated from clinging, and greed as primary, one savors them and rejoices in them. Regarding that as primary, greed dissociated from wrong view arises. Conascence-predominance: a predominance dissociated from clinging is a condition for its associated aggregates and for mind-originated materiality by way of predominance condition. (1)

Upādānavippayutto dhammo [T 4.0268] upādānasampayuttassa dhammassa adhipatipaccayena paccayo. Ārammaṇādhipati – dānaṃ…pe… jhānaṃ…pe… cakkhuṃ…pe… vatthuṃ upādānavippayutte khandhe ca lobhañca garuṃ katvā assādeti abhinandati, taṃ garuṃ katvā rāgo uppajjati, diṭṭhi uppajjati. (2)

A state dissociated from clinging is a condition for a state associated with clinging by way of predominance condition. By object-predominance: regarding as primary giving… jhāna… the eye… the base… the aggregates dissociated from clinging, and greed, one savors and delights in them. Regarding that as primary, greed arises, wrong view arises. (2)

Upādānavippayutto dhammo upādānasampayuttassa ca upādānavippayuttassa ca dhammassa adhipatipaccayena paccayo. Ārammaṇādhipati – cakkhuṃ…pe… vatthuṃ upādānavippayutte khandhe ca lobhañca garuṃ katvā diṭṭhigatavippayuttalobhasahagatā khandhā ca lobho ca uppajjanti. (3)

A state dissociated from clinging is a condition for a state associated with clinging and for a state dissociated from clinging by way of predominance condition. By object-predominance: regarding as important the eye… the base… the aggregates dissociated from clinging, and greed, aggregates accompanied by greed but dissociated from wrong view, and greed, arise. (3)

71. Upādānasampayutto [M 3.0588] ca upādānavippayutto ca dhammā upādānasampayuttassa dhammassa adhipatipaccayena paccayo. Ārammaṇādhipati – diṭṭhigatavippayuttalobhasahagate khandhe ca lobhañca garuṃ katvā upādānasampayuttā khandhā uppajjanti. (Mūlaṃ kātabbaṃ) diṭṭhigatavippayuttalobhasahagate khandhe ca lobhañca garuṃ katvā diṭṭhigatavippayutto lobho uppajjati. (Mūlaṃ kātabbaṃ) diṭṭhigatavippayuttalobhasahagate khandhe ca lobhañca garuṃ katvā diṭṭhigatavippayuttalobhasahagatā khandhā ca lobho ca uppajjanti. (3)

71. A state associated with clinging and a state dissociated from clinging are a condition for a state associated with clinging by way of predominance condition. By object-predominance: regarding as important the aggregates accompanied by greed but dissociated from wrong view, and greed, aggregates associated with clinging arise. (The root section is to be done.) Regarding as important the aggregates accompanied by greed but dissociated from wrong view, and greed, greed dissociated from wrong view arises. (The root section is to be done.) Regarding as important the aggregates accompanied by greed but dissociated from wrong view, and greed, aggregates accompanied by greed but dissociated from wrong view, and greed, arise. (3)

Anantarapaccayo

Immediacy Condition

72. Upādānasampayutto dhammo upādānasampayuttassa dhammassa anantarapaccayena paccayo – purimā [V 3.0723] purimā upādānasampayuttā khandhā pacchimānaṃ pacchimānaṃ upādānasampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ anantarapaccayena paccayo. (Mūlaṃ kātabbaṃ) purimā purimā diṭṭhigatavippayuttalobhasahagatā [T 4.0269] khandhā pacchimassa pacchimassa diṭṭhigatavippayuttassa lobhassa anantarapaccayena paccayo; upādānasampayuttā khandhā vuṭṭhānassa anantarapaccayena paccayo. (Mūlaṃ kātabbaṃ) purimā purimā diṭṭhigatavippayuttalobhasahagatā khandhā pacchimānaṃ pacchimānaṃ diṭṭhigatavippayuttalobhasahagatānaṃ khandhānaṃ lobhassa ca anantarapaccayena paccayo. (3)

72. A state associated with clinging is a condition for a state associated with clinging by way of immediacy condition: preceding aggregates associated with clinging are a condition for subsequent aggregates associated with clinging by way of immediacy condition. (The root section is to be done.) Preceding aggregates accompanied by greed dissociated from wrong view are a condition for subsequent greed dissociated from wrong view by way of immediacy condition; aggregates associated with clinging are a condition for emergence by way of immediacy condition. (The root section is to be done.) Preceding aggregates accompanied by greed dissociated from wrong view are a condition for subsequent aggregates accompanied by greed dissociated from wrong view and for greed by way of immediacy condition. (3)

73. Upādānavippayutto dhammo upādānavippayuttassa dhammassa anantarapaccayena paccayo – purimo purimo diṭṭhigatavippayutto lobho pacchimassa pacchimassa diṭṭhigatavippayuttassa lobhassa anantarapaccayena paccayo; purimā purimā upādānavippayuttā khandhā pacchimānaṃ pacchimānaṃ upādānavippayuttānaṃ khandhānaṃ anantarapaccayena paccayo; diṭṭhigatavippayutto lobho vuṭṭhānassa anantarapaccayena paccayo; anulomaṃ gotrabhussa…pe… phalasamāpattiyā anantarapaccayena paccayo. (Mūlaṃ kātabbaṃ) purimo purimo diṭṭhigatavippayutto lobho pacchimānaṃ pacchimānaṃ diṭṭhigatavippayuttalobhasahagatānaṃ khandhānaṃ anantarapaccayena paccayo. Āvajjanā upādānasampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ anantarapaccayena paccayo. (Mūlaṃ kātabbaṃ) purimo purimo diṭṭhigatavippayutto lobho pacchimānaṃ pacchimānaṃ diṭṭhigatavippayuttalobhasahagatānaṃ khandhānaṃ lobhassa ca anantarapaccayena paccayo; āvajjanā [M 3.0589] diṭṭhigatavippayuttalobhasahagatānaṃ khandhānaṃ lobhassa ca anantarapaccayena paccayo. (3)

73. A state dissociated from clinging is a condition for a state dissociated from clinging by way of immediacy condition: preceding greed dissociated from wrong view is a condition for subsequent greed dissociated from wrong view by way of immediacy condition; preceding aggregates dissociated from clinging are a condition for subsequent aggregates dissociated from clinging by way of immediacy condition; greed dissociated from wrong view is a condition for emergence by way of immediacy condition; conformity is a condition for change-of-lineage… for fruition attainment by way of immediacy condition. (The root section is to be worked out.) Preceding greed dissociated from wrong view is a condition for subsequent aggregates accompanied by greed dissociated from wrong view by way of immediacy condition. Adverting is a condition for aggregates associated with clinging by way of immediacy condition. (The root section is to be worked out.) Preceding greed dissociated from wrong view is a condition for subsequent aggregates accompanied by greed dissociated from wrong view and for greed by way of immediacy condition; adverting is a condition for aggregates accompanied by greed dissociated from wrong view and for greed by way of immediacy condition. (3)

74. Upādānasampayutto ca upādānavippayutto ca dhammā upādānasampayuttassa [T 4.0270] dhammassa anantarapaccayena paccayo – purimā purimā diṭṭhigatavippayuttalobhasahagatā khandhā ca lobho ca pacchimānaṃ pacchimānaṃ diṭṭhigatavippayuttalobhasahagatānaṃ khandhānaṃ anantarapaccayena paccayo. (Mūlaṃ kātabbaṃ) purimā purimā diṭṭhigatavippayuttalobhasahagatā khandhā ca lobho ca pacchimassa pacchimassa diṭṭhigatavippayuttassa lobhassa anantarapaccayena paccayo; diṭṭhigatavippayuttalobhasahagatā khandhā ca lobho ca vuṭṭhānassa anantarapaccayena paccayo. (Mūlaṃ kātabbaṃ) purimā purimā diṭṭhigatavippayuttalobhasahagatā khandhā ca lobho ca pacchimānaṃ pacchimānaṃ diṭṭhigatavippayuttalobhasahagatānaṃ khandhānaṃ lobhassa ca anantarapaccayena paccayo. (3)

74. A state associated with clinging and a state dissociated from clinging are a condition for a state associated with clinging by way of immediacy condition: preceding aggregates accompanied by greed dissociated from wrong view and greed are a condition for subsequent aggregates accompanied by greed dissociated from wrong view by way of immediacy condition. (The root section is to be worked out.) Preceding aggregates accompanied by greed dissociated from wrong view and greed are a condition for subsequent greed dissociated from wrong view by way of immediacy condition; aggregates accompanied by greed dissociated from wrong view and greed are a condition for emergence by way of immediacy condition. (The root section is to be worked out.) Preceding aggregates accompanied by greed dissociated from wrong view and greed are a condition for subsequent aggregates accompanied by greed dissociated from wrong view and for greed by way of immediacy condition. (3)

Samanantarapaccayādi

Contiguity Condition, etc.

75. Upādānasampayutto [V 3.0724] dhammo upādānasampayuttassa dhammassa samanantarapaccayena paccayo… sahajātapaccayena paccayo… (paṭiccasadisaṃ) nava… aññamaññapaccayena paccayo… (paṭiccasadisaṃ) cha… nissayapaccayena paccayo… (paccayavārasadisaṃ) nava.

75. A state associated with clinging is a condition for a state associated with clinging by way of contiguity condition… by way of conascence condition… (similar to the Dependent Origination section) nine… by way of mutuality condition… (similar to the Dependent Origination section) six… by way of dependence condition… (similar to the Condition Chapter) nine.

Upanissayapaccayo

Decisive Support Condition

76. Upādānasampayutto dhammo upādānasampayuttassa dhammassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇūpanissayo, anantarūpanissayo, pakatūpanissayo…pe…. Pakatūpanissayo – upādānasampayuttā khandhā upādānasampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ upanissayapaccayena paccayo. (Mūlaṃ kātabbaṃ) upādānasampayuttā khandhā upādānavippayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ lobhassa ca upanissayapaccayena paccayo. (Mūlaṃ kātabbaṃ) upādānasampayuttā [T 4.0271] khandhā diṭṭhigatavippayuttalobhasahagatānaṃ khandhānaṃ lobhassa ca upanissayapaccayena paccayo. (3)

76. A state associated with clinging is a condition for a state associated with clinging by way of decisive support condition: as object decisive support, immediacy decisive support, natural decisive support…. Natural decisive support: aggregates associated with clinging are a condition for aggregates associated with clinging by way of decisive support condition. (The root section is to be worked out.) Aggregates associated with clinging are a condition for aggregates dissociated from clinging and for greed by way of decisive support condition. (The root section is to be worked out.) Aggregates associated with clinging are a condition for aggregates accompanied by greed dissociated from wrong view and for greed by way of decisive support condition. (3)

77. Upādānavippayutto [M 3.0590] dhammo upādānavippayuttassa dhammassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇūpanissayo, anantarūpanissayo pakatūpanissayo…pe…. Pakatūpanissayo – saddhaṃ upanissāya dānaṃ deti…pe… samāpattiṃ uppādeti, mānaṃ jappeti, sīlaṃ…pe… paññaṃ… upādānavippayuttaṃ rāgaṃ… mānaṃ… patthanaṃ…pe… senāsanaṃ upanissāya dānaṃ deti…pe… saṅghaṃ bhindati; saddhā…pe… senāsanaṃ saddhāya…pe… paññāya upādānavippayuttassa rāgassa… mānassa… patthanāya… kāyikassa sukhassa…pe… phalasamāpattiyā upanissayapaccayena paccayo. (1)

77. A state dissociated from clinging is a condition for a state dissociated from clinging by way of decisive support condition: as object decisive support, immediacy decisive support, natural decisive support…. Natural decisive support: relying on faith, one gives a gift… produces an attainment, cherishes conceit; relying on virtue… wisdom… craving dissociated from clinging… conceit… aspiration… a lodging, one gives a gift… splits the Sangha. Faith… a lodging is a condition by way of decisive support condition for faith… for wisdom, for craving dissociated from clinging… for conceit… for aspiration… for bodily pleasure… for fruition attainment. (1)

Upādānavippayutto dhammo upādānasampayuttassa dhammassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo – (tīṇi upanissayā) saddhaṃ upanissāya mānaṃ jappeti, diṭṭhiṃ gaṇhāti, sīlaṃ…pe… paññaṃ… upādānavippayuttaṃ rāgaṃ… mānaṃ… patthanaṃ… senāsanaṃ upanissāya adinnaṃ…pe… musā…pe… pisuṇaṃ…pe… samphaṃ…pe… sandhiṃ…pe… nillopaṃ…pe… ekāgārikaṃ…pe… paripanthe…pe… paradāraṃ…pe… gāmaghātaṃ…pe… nigamaghātaṃ karoti[V 3.0725]. Saddhā…pe… senāsanaṃ upādānasampayuttassa rāgassa… mohassa… mānassa… diṭṭhiyā… patthanāya upanissayapaccayena paccayo. (2)

A state dissociated from clinging is a condition for a state associated with clinging by way of decisive support condition. (The three decisive supports.) Relying on faith, one cherishes conceit, grasps a wrong view; relying on virtue… wisdom… craving dissociated from clinging… conceit… aspiration… a lodging, one takes what is not given… speaks falsely… speaks slanderously… engages in frivolous talk… commits burglary… plunders… commits housebreaking… commits highway robbery… commits adultery… commits massacre in a village… commits massacre in a town. Faith… a lodging is a condition by way of decisive support condition for lust associated with clinging… for delusion… for conceit… for wrong view… for aspiration. (2)

Upādānavippayutto dhammo upādānasampayuttassa ca upādānavippayuttassa ca dhammassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇūpanissayo, anantarūpanissayo, pakatūpanissayo…pe…. Pakatūpanissayo – saddhaṃ upanissāya mānaṃ jappeti, sīlaṃ…pe… paññaṃ… upādānavippayuttaṃ [T 4.0272] rāgaṃ…pe… senāsanaṃ upanissāya adinnaṃ ādiyati…pe… gāmaghātaṃ karoti… nigamaghātaṃ karoti…. Saddhā…pe… senāsanaṃ diṭṭhigatavippayuttalobhasahagatānaṃ khandhānaṃ lobhassa ca upanissayapaccayena paccayo. (3)

A state dissociated from clinging is a condition for a state associated with clinging and for a state dissociated from clinging by way of decisive support condition: as object decisive support, immediacy decisive support, natural decisive support…. Natural decisive support: relying on faith, one cherishes conceit; relying on virtue… wisdom… craving dissociated from clinging… a lodging, one takes what is not given… commits massacre in a village… commits massacre in a town. Faith… a lodging is a condition for aggregates accompanied by greed dissociated from wrong view and for greed by way of decisive support condition. (3)

78. Upādānasampayutto ca upādānavippayutto ca dhammā upādānasampayuttassa dhammassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo – diṭṭhigatavippayuttalobhasahagatā khandhā ca lobho ca upādānasampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ upanissayapaccayena paccayo. (Mūlaṃ kātabbaṃ) diṭṭhigatavippayuttalobhasahagatā khandhā ca lobho ca upādānavippayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ lobhassa ca upanissayapaccayena paccayo. (Mūlaṃ kātabbaṃ) diṭṭhigatavippayuttalobhasahagatā khandhā ca lobho ca diṭṭhigatavippayuttalobhasahagatānaṃ khandhānaṃ lobhassa ca upanissayapaccayena paccayo. (3)

78. States associated with clinging and states dissociated from clinging are a condition for a state associated with clinging by way of decisive support condition: aggregates accompanied by greed dissociated from wrong view and greed are a condition for aggregates associated with clinging by way of decisive support condition. (The root section is to be worked out.) Aggregates accompanied by greed dissociated from wrong view and greed are a condition for aggregates dissociated from clinging and for greed by way of decisive support condition. (The root section is to be worked out.) Aggregates accompanied by greed dissociated from wrong view and greed are a condition for aggregates accompanied by greed dissociated from wrong view and for greed by way of decisive support condition. (3)

Purejātapaccayo

Prenascence Condition

79. Upādānavippayutto [M 3.0591] dhammo upādānavippayuttassa dhammassa purejātapaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇapurejātaṃ, vatthupurejātaṃ. Ārammaṇapurejātaṃ – cakkhuṃ…pe… vatthuṃ aniccato…pe… domanassaṃ uppajjati; dibbena cakkhunā rūpaṃ passati, dibbāya sotadhātuyā saddaṃ suṇāti. Rūpāyatanaṃ cakkhuviññāṇassa…pe… phoṭṭhabbāyatanaṃ…pe…. Vatthupurejātaṃ – cakkhāyatanaṃ cakkhuviññāṇassa…pe… kāyāyatanaṃ…pe… vatthu upādānavippayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ lobhassa ca purejātapaccayena paccayo. (1)

79. A state dissociated from clinging is a condition for a state dissociated from clinging by way of prenascence condition: by object-prenascence and by base-prenascence. By object-prenascence: one regards the eye… the physical basis as impermanent… and grief arises; with the divine eye one sees a form; with the divine ear-element one hears a sound. The form base is a condition for eye-consciousness… the tangible base…. By base-prenascence: the eye base is a condition for eye-consciousness… the body base… the physical basis is a condition for the aggregates dissociated from clinging and for greed by way of prenascence condition. (1)

Upādānavippayutto dhammo upādānasampayuttassa dhammassa purejātapaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇapurejātaṃ, vatthupurejātaṃ. Ārammaṇapurejātaṃ [T 4.0273] – cakkhuṃ…pe… vatthuṃ assādeti abhinandati[V 3.0726], taṃ ārabbha rāgo uppajjati, diṭṭhi uppajjati. Vatthupurejātaṃ – vatthu upādānasampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ purejātapaccayena paccayo. (2)

A state dissociated from clinging is a condition for a state associated with clinging by way of prenascence condition: by object-prenascence and by base-prenascence. By object-prenascence: one savors and delights in the eye… the physical basis; taking that as object, lust arises, wrong view arises. By base-prenascence: the physical basis is a condition for the aggregates associated with clinging by way of prenascence condition. (2)

Upādānavippayutto dhammo upādānasampayuttassa ca upādānavippayuttassa ca dhammassa purejātapaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇapurejātaṃ, vatthupurejātaṃ. Ārammaṇapurejātaṃ – cakkhuṃ…pe… vatthuṃ ārabbha diṭṭhigatavippayuttalobhasahagatā khandhā ca lobho ca uppajjanti. Vatthupurejātaṃ – vatthu diṭṭhigatavippayuttalobhasahagatānaṃ khandhānaṃ lobhassa ca purejātapaccayena paccayo. (3)

A state dissociated from clinging is a condition for a state associated with clinging and a state dissociated from clinging by way of prenascence condition: by object-prenascence and by base-prenascence. By object-prenascence: taking the eye… the physical basis as object, aggregates accompanied by greed dissociated from wrong view and greed arise. By base-prenascence: the physical basis is a condition for the aggregates accompanied by greed dissociated from wrong view and for greed by way of prenascence condition. (3)

Pacchājātāsevanapaccayā

Postnascence and Repetition Conditions

80. Upādānasampayutto dhammo upādānavippayuttassa dhammassa pacchājātapaccayena paccayo (saṃkhittaṃ). (1)

80. A state associated with clinging is a condition for a state dissociated from clinging by way of postnascence condition. (In brief.) (1)

Upādānavippayutto dhammo upādānavippayuttassa dhammassa pacchājātapaccayena paccayo (saṃkhittaṃ). (1)

A state dissociated from clinging is a condition for a state dissociated from clinging by way of postnascence condition. (In brief.) (1)

Upādānasampayutto ca upādānavippayutto ca dhammā upādānavippayuttassa dhammassa pacchājātapaccayena paccayo. (Saṃkhittaṃ.) (1) …Āsevanapaccayena paccayo.

States associated with clinging and states dissociated from clinging are a condition for a state dissociated from clinging by way of postnascence condition. (In brief.) (1) …by way of repetition condition.

Kamma-vipākapaccayā

Kamma and Result Conditions

81. Upādānasampayutto [M 3.0592] dhammo upādānasampayuttassa dhammassa kammapaccayena paccayo – upādānasampayuttā cetanā sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ kammapaccayena paccayo. (1)

81. A state associated with clinging is a condition for a state associated with clinging by way of kamma condition: volition associated with clinging is a condition for the associated aggregates by way of kamma condition. (1)

Upādānasampayutto dhammo upādānavippayuttassa dhammassa kammapaccayena paccayo – sahajātā, nānākkhaṇikā. Sahajātā – upādānasampayuttā cetanā cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ [T 4.0274] rūpānaṃ kammapaccayena paccayo; diṭṭhigatavippayuttalobhasahagatā cetanā lobhassa cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ kammapaccayena paccayo. Nānākkhaṇikā – upādānasampayuttā cetanā vipākānaṃ khandhānaṃ kaṭattā ca rūpānaṃ kammapaccayena paccayo. (2)

A state associated with clinging is a condition for a state dissociated from clinging by way of kamma condition: simultaneous and asynchronous. Simultaneous: volition associated with clinging is a condition for mind-originated matter by way of kamma condition; volition accompanied by greed dissociated from wrong view is a condition for greed and for mind-originated matter by way of kamma condition. Asynchronous: volition associated with clinging is a condition for resultant aggregates and for kamma-produced matter by way of kamma condition. (2)

Upādānasampayutto [V 3.0727] dhammo upādānasampayuttassa ca upādānavippayuttassa ca dhammassa kammapaccayena paccayo – upādānasampayuttā cetanā sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ kammapaccayena paccayo; diṭṭhigatavippayuttalobhasahagatā cetanā sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ lobhassa ca cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ kammapaccayena paccayo. (3)

A state associated with clinging is a condition for states associated with clinging and states dissociated from clinging by way of kamma condition: volition associated with clinging is a condition for the associated aggregates and for mind-originated matter by way of kamma condition; volition accompanied by greed dissociated from wrong view is a condition for the associated aggregates, for greed, and for mind-originated matter by way of kamma condition. (3)

82. Upādānavippayutto dhammo upādānavippayuttassa dhammassa kammapaccayena paccayo – sahajātā, nānākkhaṇikā. Sahajātā – upādānavippayuttā cetanā sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ kammapaccayena paccayo; paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe…. Nānākkhaṇikā – upādānavippayuttā cetanā vipākānaṃ khandhānaṃ kaṭattā ca rūpānaṃ kammapaccayena paccayo. (1)

82. A state dissociated from clinging is a condition for a state dissociated from clinging by way of kamma condition: simultaneous and asynchronous. Simultaneous: volition dissociated from clinging is a condition for associated aggregates and for mind-originated matter by way of kamma condition; at the moment of rebirth-linking…. Asynchronous: volition dissociated from clinging is a condition for resultant aggregates and for kamma-produced matter by way of kamma condition. (1)

Upādānavippayutto dhammo upādānavippayuttassa dhammassa vipākapaccayena paccayo – vipāko upādānavippayutto eko…pe… ekaṃ.

A state dissociated from clinging is a condition for a state dissociated from clinging by way of result condition: one resultant state dissociated from clinging is a condition for other such states... (and so on).

Āhārapaccayādi

Nutriment Condition, etc.

83. Upādānasampayutto dhammo upādānasampayuttassa dhammassa āhārapaccayena paccayo… indriyapaccayena paccayo… jhānapaccayena [T 4.0275] paccayo… maggapaccayena paccayo (imesu catūsupi yathā kammapaccaye diṭṭhigatavippayutto lobho dassito evaṃ dassetabbo. Cattāri cattāri pañhā)… sampayuttapaccayena paccayo… cha.

83. A state associated with clinging is a condition for a state associated with clinging by way of nutriment condition… by way of faculty condition… by way of jhāna condition… by way of path condition (in these four cases, it should be shown just as greed dissociated from wrong view was shown in the kamma condition; four questions each)… by way of association condition… six.

Vippayuttapaccayo

Dissociation Condition

84. Upādānasampayutto [M 3.0593] dhammo upādānavippayuttassa dhammassa vippayuttapaccayena paccayo – sahajātaṃ, pacchājātaṃ (saṃkhittaṃ). (1)

84. A state associated with clinging is a condition for a state dissociated from clinging by way of the dissociation condition: by conascence and postnascence (in brief). (1)

Upādānavippayutto dhammo upādānavippayuttassa dhammassa vippayuttapaccayena paccayo – sahajātaṃ, purejātaṃ, pacchājātaṃ (saṃkhittaṃ). (1)

A state dissociated from clinging is a condition for a state dissociated from clinging by way of dissociation condition: by conascence, prenascence, and postnascence (in brief). (1)

Upādānavippayutto [V 3.0728] dhammo upādānasampayuttassa dhammassa vippayuttapaccayena paccayo. Purejātaṃ – vatthu upādānasampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ vippayuttapaccayena paccayo. (2)

A state dissociated from clinging is a condition for a state associated with clinging by way of dissociation condition. By prenascence: the physical base is a condition for the aggregates associated with clinging by way of dissociation condition. (2)

Upādānavippayutto dhammo upādānasampayuttassa ca upādānavippayuttassa ca dhammassa vippayuttapaccayena paccayo. Purejātaṃ – vatthu diṭṭhigatavippayuttalobhasahagatānaṃ khandhānaṃ lobhassa ca vippayuttapaccayena paccayo. (3)

A state dissociated from clinging is a condition for a state associated with clinging and for a state dissociated from clinging by way of dissociation condition. By prenascence: the physical base is a condition for the aggregates accompanied by greed dissociated from wrong view, and for greed, by way of dissociation condition. (3)

Upādānasampayutto ca upādānavippayutto ca dhammā upādānavippayuttassa dhammassa vippayuttapaccayena paccayo – sahajātaṃ, pacchājātaṃ. Sahajātā – diṭṭhigatavippayuttalobhasahagatā khandhā ca lobho ca cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ vippayuttapaccayena paccayo. Pacchājātā…pe….

States associated with clinging and states dissociated from clinging are a condition for a state dissociated from clinging by way of dissociation condition: by conascence and postnascence. By conascence: the aggregates accompanied by greed dissociated from wrong view, and greed, are a condition for mind-originated materiality by way of dissociation condition. By postnascence: …etc.

Atthipaccayādi

Presence Condition, etc.

85. Upādānasampayutto dhammo upādānasampayuttassa dhammassa atthipaccayena paccayo… ekaṃ (paṭiccasadisaṃ). (1)

85. A state associated with clinging is a condition for a state associated with clinging by way of presence condition… one (similar to the Dependence Condition). (1)

Upādānasampayutto dhammo upādānavippayuttassa dhammassa atthipaccayena paccayo – sahajātaṃ[T 4.0276], pacchājātaṃ (saṃkhittaṃ). (2)

A state associated with clinging is a condition for a state dissociated from clinging by way of presence condition: by conascence and postnascence (in brief). (2)

Upādānasampayutto dhammo upādānasampayuttassa ca upādānavippayuttassa ca dhammassa atthipaccayena paccayo (paṭiccasadisaṃ). (3)

A state associated with clinging is a condition for a state associated with clinging and for a state dissociated from clinging by way of presence condition (similar to the Dependence Condition). (3)

86. Upādānavippayutto dhammo upādānavippayuttassa dhammassa atthipaccayena paccayo – sahajātaṃ, purejātaṃ, pacchājātaṃ, āhāraṃ, indriyaṃ (saṃkhittaṃ). (1)

86. A state dissociated from clinging is a condition for a state dissociated from clinging by way of presence condition: by conascence, prenascence, postnascence, nutriment, and faculty (in brief). (1)

Upādānavippayutto dhammo upādānasampayuttassa dhammassa atthipaccayena paccayo – sahajātaṃ, purejātaṃ (saṃkhittaṃ). (2)

A state dissociated from clinging is a condition for a state associated with clinging by way of presence condition: by conascence and prenascence (in brief). (2)

Upādānavippayutto [M 3.0594][V 3.0729] dhammo upādānasampayuttassa ca upādānavippayuttassa ca dhammassa atthipaccayena paccayo – sahajātaṃ, purejātaṃ (imesu sahajātaṃ sahajātasadisaṃ, purejātaṃ purejātasadisaṃ). (3)

A state dissociated from clinging is a condition for a state associated with clinging and for a state dissociated from clinging by way of presence condition: by conascence and prenascence (herein, conascence is like conascence, prenascence is like prenascence). (3)

87. Upādānasampayutto ca upādānavippayutto ca dhammā upādānasampayuttassa dhammassa atthipaccayena paccayo – sahajātaṃ, purejātaṃ. Sahajāto – upādānasampayutto eko khandho ca vatthu ca tiṇṇannaṃ khandhānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo…pe… dve khandhā ca…pe…. Sahajāto – diṭṭhigatavippayuttalobhasahagato eko khandho ca lobho ca tiṇṇannaṃ khandhānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo…pe… dve khandhā ca…pe…. (1)

87. States associated with clinging and states dissociated from clinging are a condition for a state associated with clinging by way of presence condition: by conascence and prenascence. By conascence: one aggregate associated with clinging and the physical base are a condition for the three aggregates by way of presence condition… etc.… and two aggregates… etc. By conascence: one aggregate accompanied by greed dissociated from wrong view, and greed, are a condition for the three aggregates by way of presence condition… etc.… and two aggregates… etc. (1)

Upādānasampayutto ca upādānavippayutto ca dhammā upādānavippayuttassa dhammassa atthipaccayena paccayo – sahajātaṃ, purejātaṃ, pacchājātaṃ, āhāraṃ, indriyaṃ. Sahajātā – upādānasampayuttā khandhā ca mahābhūtā ca cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo. Sahajātā – diṭṭhigatavippayuttalobhasahagatā khandhā ca lobho ca cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo. Sahajātā – diṭṭhigatavippayuttalobhasahagatā [T 4.0277] khandhā ca vatthu ca lobhassa atthipaccayena paccayo. Pacchājātā – diṭṭhigatavippayuttalobhasahagatā khandhā ca lobho ca purejātassa imassa kāyassa atthipaccayena paccayo. Pacchājātā – diṭṭhigatavippayuttalobhasahagatā khandhā ca lobho ca kabaḷīkāro āhāro ca imassa kāyassa atthipaccayena paccayo. Pacchājātā – diṭṭhigatavippayuttalobhasahagatā khandhā ca lobho ca rūpajīvitindriyañca kaṭattārūpānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo. (2)

States associated with clinging and states dissociated from clinging are a condition for a state dissociated from clinging by way of presence condition: by conascence, prenascence, postnascence, nutriment, and faculty. By conascence: the aggregates associated with clinging and the great elements are a condition for mind-originated materiality by way of presence condition. By conascence: the aggregates accompanied by greed dissociated from wrong view, and greed, are a condition for mind-originated materiality by way of presence condition. By conascence: the aggregates accompanied by greed dissociated from wrong view and the physical base are a condition for greed by way of presence condition. By postnascence: the aggregates accompanied by greed dissociated from wrong view, and greed, are a condition for this prenascent body by way of presence condition. By postnascence: the aggregates accompanied by greed dissociated from wrong view, greed, and physical nutriment are a condition for this body by way of presence condition. By postnascence: the aggregates accompanied by greed dissociated from wrong view, greed, and the material life faculty are a condition for kamma-born materiality by way of presence condition. (2)

Upādānasampayutto ca upādānavippayutto ca dhammā upādānasampayuttassa ca upādānavippayuttassa ca dhammassa atthipaccayena paccayo – sahajātaṃ, purejātaṃ. Sahajāto – diṭṭhigatavippayuttalobhasahagato eko khandho ca lobho ca tiṇṇannaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo…pe… dve khandhā ca…pe…. Sahajāto – diṭṭhigatavippayuttalobhasahagato eko khandho ca vatthu ca tiṇṇannaṃ khandhānaṃ lobhassa ca atthipaccayena paccayo…pe… dve khandhā ca…pe…. (3)

States associated with clinging and states dissociated from clinging are a condition for a state associated with clinging and for a state dissociated from clinging by way of presence condition: by conascence and prenascence. By conascence: one aggregate accompanied by greed dissociated from wrong view, and greed, are a condition for the three aggregates and for mind-originated materiality by way of presence condition… etc.… and two aggregates… etc. By conascence: one aggregate accompanied by greed dissociated from wrong view and the physical base are a condition for the three aggregates and for greed by way of presence condition… etc.… and two aggregates… etc. (3)

Natthipaccayena [M 3.0595][V 3.0730] paccayo… vigatapaccayena paccayo… avigatapaccayena paccayo.

By absence condition… by disappearance condition… by non-disappearance condition.

Suddhaṃ

Pure.

88. Hetuyā nava, ārammaṇe nava, adhipatiyā nava, anantare nava, samanantare nava, sahajāte nava, aññamaññe cha, nissaye nava, upanissaye nava, purejāte tīṇi, pacchājāte tīṇi, āsevane nava[T 4.0278], kamme cattāri, vipāke ekaṃ, āhāre cattāri, indriye cattāri, jhāne cattāri, magge cattāri, sampayutte cha, vippayutte pañca, atthiyā nava, natthiyā nava, vigate nava, avigate nava.

88. By root condition, nine; by object condition, nine; by dominance condition, nine; by contiguity condition, nine; by immediate contiguity condition, nine; by co-nascence condition, nine; by reciprocity condition, six; by support condition, nine; by decisive support condition, nine; by pre-nascence condition, three; by post-nascence condition, three; by repetition condition, nine; by kamma condition, four; by result condition, one; by nutriment condition, four; by faculty condition, four; by jhāna condition, four; by path condition, four; by association condition, six; by dissociation condition, five; by presence condition, nine; by absence condition, nine; by disappearance condition, nine; by non-disappearance condition, nine.

Paccanīyuddhāro

Negative Exposition

89. Upādānasampayutto dhammo upādānasampayuttassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo… sahajātapaccayena paccayo… upanissayapaccayena paccayo. (1)

89. A state associated with clinging is a condition for a state associated with clinging by object condition... by co-nascence condition... by decisive support condition. (1)

Upādānasampayutto dhammo upādānavippayuttassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo… sahajātapaccayena paccayo… upanissayapaccayena paccayo… pacchājātapaccayena paccayo… kammapaccayena paccayo. (2)

A state associated with clinging is a condition for a state dissociated from clinging by object condition, by co-nascence condition, by decisive support condition, by post-nascence condition, or by kamma condition. (2)

Upādānasampayutto dhammo upādānasampayuttassa ca upādānavippayuttassa ca dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo… sahajātapaccayena paccayo… upanissayapaccayena paccayo. (3)

A state associated with clinging is a condition for a state associated with clinging and for a state dissociated from clinging by object condition, by co-nascence condition, or by decisive support condition. (3)

90. Upādānavippayutto dhammo upādānavippayuttassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo… sahajātapaccayena paccayo… upanissayapaccayena paccayo… purejātapaccayena paccayo [V 3.0731]… pacchājātapaccayena paccayo… kammapaccayena paccayo… āhārapaccayena paccayo… indriyapaccayena paccayo. (1)

90. A state dissociated from clinging is a condition for a state dissociated from clinging by object condition, by co-nascence condition, by decisive support condition, by pre-nascence condition, by post-nascence condition, by kamma condition, by nutriment condition, or by faculty condition. (1)

Upādānavippayutto [M 3.0596] dhammo upādānasampayuttassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo… sahajātapaccayena paccayo… upanissayapaccayena paccayo… purejātapaccayena paccayo. (2)

A state dissociated from clinging is a condition for a state associated with clinging by object condition, by co-nascence condition, by decisive support condition, or by pre-nascence condition. (2)

Upādānavippayutto dhammo upādānasampayuttassa ca upādānavippayuttassa [T 4.0279] ca dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo… sahajātapaccayena paccayo… upanissayapaccayena paccayo… purejātapaccayena paccayo. (3)

A state dissociated from clinging is a condition for a state associated with clinging and for a state dissociated from clinging by object condition, by co-nascence condition, by decisive support condition, or by pre-nascence condition. (3)

91. Upādānasampayutto ca upādānavippayutto ca dhammā upādānasampayuttassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo… sahajātapaccayena paccayo… upanissayapaccayena paccayo. (1)

91. A state associated with clinging and a state dissociated from clinging are a condition for a state associated with clinging by object condition, by co-nascence condition, or by decisive support condition. (1)

Upādānasampayutto ca upādānavippayutto ca dhammā upādānavippayuttassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo… sahajātapaccayena paccayo… upanissayapaccayena paccayo… pacchājātapaccayena paccayo. (2)

A state associated with clinging and a state dissociated from clinging are a condition for a state dissociated from clinging by object condition, by co-nascence condition, by decisive support condition, or by post-nascence condition. (2)

Upādānasampayutto ca upādānavippayutto ca dhammā upādānasampayuttassa ca upādānavippayuttassa ca dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo… sahajātapaccayena paccayo… upanissayapaccayena paccayo. (3)

A state associated with clinging and a state dissociated from clinging are a condition for a state associated with clinging and for a state dissociated from clinging by object condition, by co-nascence condition, or by decisive support condition. (3)

2. Enumeration Section

92. Nahetuyā nava, naārammaṇe nava, naadhipatiyā nava (sabbattha nava), noavigate nava.

92. Not by root condition, nine; not by object condition, nine; not by dominance condition, nine (nine in every case); not by non-disappearance condition, nine.

3. Paccayānulomapaccanīyaṃ

3. Positive and Negative

93. Hetupaccayā [V 3.0732] naārammaṇe nava, naadhipatiyā nava, naanantare nava, nasamanantare nava, naaññamaññe tīṇi, naupanissaye nava (sabbattha nava), nasampayutte tīṇi, navippayutte cha, nonatthiyā nava, novigate nava.

93. By root condition but not by object condition, nine; not by dominance condition, nine; not by contiguity condition, nine; not by immediate contiguity condition, nine; not by reciprocity condition, three; not by decisive support condition, nine (nine in every case); not by association condition, three; not by dissociation condition, six; not by absence condition, nine; not by disappearance condition, nine.

4. Paccayapaccanīyānulomaṃ

4. Negative and Positive

94. Nahetupaccayā ārammaṇe nava, adhipatiyā nava (anulomamātikā)…pe… avigate nava.

94. Not by root condition but by object condition, nine; by dominance condition, nine (positive matrix)... and so on... by non-disappearance condition, nine.

Upādānasampayuttadukaṃ niṭṭhitaṃ.

The Duka on States Associated with Clinging is finished.

72. Upādānaupādāniyadukaṃ

72. The Duka on Clinging and What Can Be Clung To

1. Paṭiccavāro

1. Dependence Section

1. Paccayānulomaṃ

1. Positive

1. Vibhaṅgavāro

1. Exposition Section

Hetupaccayo

Root Condition

95. Upādānañceva [T 4.0280][M 3.0597][V 3.0733] upādāniyañca dhammaṃ paṭicca upādāno ceva upādāniyo ca dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – diṭṭhupādānaṃ paṭicca kāmupādānaṃ, kāmupādānaṃ paṭicca diṭṭhupādānaṃ (cakkaṃ). (1)

95. Depending on a state that is both a clinging and clingable, a state that is both a clinging and clingable arises by root condition. Depending on clinging to views, clinging to sensual pleasures arises; depending on clinging to sensual pleasures, clinging to views arises (in a cycle). (1)

Upādānañceva upādāniyañca dhammaṃ paṭicca upādāniyo ceva no ca upādāno dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – upādāne paṭicca sampayuttakā khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ. (1)

Depending on a state that is both a clinging and clingable, a state that is clingable but not a clinging arises by root condition. Depending on a clinging, the associated aggregates and mind-originated matter arise. (1)

Upādānañceva upādāniyañca dhammaṃ paṭicca upādāno ceva upādāniyo ca upādāniyo ceva no ca upādāno ca dhammā uppajjanti hetupaccayā – diṭṭhupādānaṃ paṭicca kāmupādānaṃ sampayuttakā ca khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpaṃ (cakkaṃ). (3)

Depending on a state that is both a clinging and clingable, states that are both a clinging and clingable and states that are clingable but not a clinging arise by root condition. Depending on clinging to views, there arise clinging to sensual pleasures, the associated aggregates, and mind-originated matter (in a cycle). (3)

96. Upādāniyañceva no ca upādānaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca upādāniyo ceva no ca upādāno dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – upādāniyañceva no ca upādānaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca [V 3.0734] tayo khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ…pe… dve khandhe…pe… paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe… (yāva ajjhattikā mahābhūtā). (1)

96. Depending on a state that is clingable but not a clinging, a state that is clingable but not a clinging arises by root condition. Depending on one clingable but not clinging aggregate, three aggregates and mind-originated matter arise... and so on... two aggregates... and so on... at the moment of rebirth-linking... and so on... (as far as the internal great elements). (1)

Upādāniyañceva no ca upādānaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca upādāno ceva upādāniyo ca dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – upādāniye ceva no ca upādāne khandhe paṭicca upādānā. (2)

Depending on a state that is clingable but not a clinging, a state that is both a clinging and clingable arises by root condition. Depending on the aggregates that are clingable but not a clinging, the clingings arise. (2)

Upādāniyañceva no ca upādānaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca upādāno ceva upādāniyo ca upādāniyo ceva no ca upādāno ca dhammā [T 4.0281] uppajjanti hetupaccayā – upādāniyañceva no ca upādānaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca tayo khandhā upādānā ca cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ…pe… dve khandhe…pe…. (3)

Depending on a state that is clingable but not a clinging, states that are both a clinging and clingable and states that are clingable but not a clinging arise by root condition. Depending on one aggregate that is clingable but not a clinging, three aggregates, the clingings, and mind-originated matter arise... and so on... two aggregates... and so on. (3)

97. Upādānañceva upādāniyañca upādāniyañceva no ca upādānañca dhammaṃ paṭicca upādāno ceva upādāniyo ca dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – diṭṭhupādānañca sampayuttake ca khandhe paṭicca kāmupādānaṃ (cakkaṃ). (1)

97. Depending on a state that is a clinging and clingable and on a state that is clingable but not a clinging, a state that is both a clinging and clingable arises by root condition. Depending on clinging to views and its associated aggregates, clinging to sensual pleasures arises (in a cycle). (1)

Upādānañceva [M 3.0598] upādāniyañca upādāniyañceva no ca upādānañca dhammaṃ paṭicca upādāniyo ceva no ca upādāno dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – upādāniyañceva no ca upādānaṃ ekaṃ khandhañca upādāne ca paṭicca tayo khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ…pe… dve khandhe ca…pe… upādāne ca mahābhūte ca paṭicca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ. (2)

Depending on a state that is a clinging and clingable and on a state that is clingable but not a clinging, a state that is clingable but not a clinging arises by root condition. Depending on one aggregate that is clingable but not a clinging and on a clinging, three aggregates and mind-originated matter arise... and so on... two aggregates... and so on... depending on a clinging and the great elements, mind-originated matter arises. (2)

Upādānañceva upādāniyañca upādāniyañceva no ca upādānañca dhammaṃ paṭicca upādāno ceva upādāniyo ca upādāniyo ceva no ca upādāno ca dhammā uppajjanti hetupaccayā – upādāniyañceva no ca upādānaṃ ekaṃ khandhañca diṭṭhupādānañca paṭicca tayo khandhā kāmupādānañca cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ…pe… dve khandhe ca…pe… (cakkaṃ). (3)

Depending on a state that is both clinging and clingable and on a state that is clingable but not a clinging, states that are both clinging and clingable and states that are clingable but not a clinging arise by root condition: depending on one aggregate that is clingable but not a clinging and on clinging to views, three aggregates, clinging to sensual pleasures, and mind-originated matter arise... and so on... two aggregates... and so on... (cycle). (3)

2-6. Sahajāta-paccaya-nissaya-saṃsaṭṭha-sampayuttavāro

2-6. The Section on Co-nascence, Condition, Dependence, Conjoined, and Associated

(Yathā upādānadukaṃ evaṃ paṭiccavāropi sahajātavāropi paccayavāropi nissayavāropi saṃsaṭṭhavāropi sampayuttavāropi kātabbā, ninnānākaraṇā, āmasanaṃ nānākaraṇaṃ.)

(Just as for the Clinging Dyad, so too the Conditionality Section, the Co-nascence Section, the Condition Section, the Dependence Section, the Conjoined Section, and the Associated Section should be worked out. The method is the same, but the application is different.)

7. Pañhāvāro

7. Question Section

1. Paccayānulomaṃ

1. Positive Permutation

1. Vibhaṅgavāro

1. Exposition Section

Hetupaccayo

Root Condition

98. Upādāno [T 4.0282][V 3.0735] ceva upādāniyo ca dhammo upādānassa ceva upādāniyassa ca dhammassa hetupaccayena paccayo – upādānā ceva upādāniyā ca hetū sampayuttakānaṃ upādānānaṃ hetupaccayena paccayo. (1)

98. A state that is both clinging and clingable is a condition for a state that is both clinging and clingable by way of root condition—the roots that are both clinging and clingable are a condition for associated clingings by way of root condition. (1)

Upādāno ceva upādāniyo ca dhammo upādāniyassa ceva no ca upādānassa dhammassa hetupaccayena paccayo – upādānā ceva upādāniyā ca hetū sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ hetupaccayena paccayo (upādānadukasadisā ninnānā, nava pañhā).

A state that is both clinging and clingable is a condition for a state that is clingable but not clinging by way of root condition—the roots that are both clinging and clingable are a condition for the associated aggregates and for mind-originated matter by way of root condition. (The nine questions are similar to those in the Clinging Dyad; the method is the same.)

Ārammaṇapaccayo

Object Condition

99. Upādāno [M 3.0599] ceva upādāniyo ca dhammo upādānassa ceva upādāniyassa ca dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo – upādāne ārabbha upādānā uppajjanti… tīṇi.

99. A state that is both clinging and clingable is a condition for a state that is both clinging and clingable by way of object condition—taking clingings as an object, clingings arise… three.

Upādāniyo ceva no ca upādāno dhammo upādāniyassa ceva no ca upādānassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo – dānaṃ…pe… jhānā vuṭṭhahitvā jhānaṃ paccavekkhati, assādeti abhinandati, taṃ ārabbha rāgo uppajjati, diṭṭhi uppajjati, vicikicchā uddhaccaṃ domanassaṃ uppajjati; ariyā gotrabhuṃ paccavekkhanti, vodānaṃ paccavekkhanti, pahīne kilese…pe… vikkhambhite kilese…pe… pubbe samudāciṇṇe…pe… cakkhuṃ…pe… vatthuṃ…pe… (saṃkhittaṃ) anāgataṃsañāṇassa āvajjanāya ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo. (1)

A state that is clingable but not clinging is a condition for a state that is clingable but not clinging by way of object condition—one gives a gift… and so on… having emerged from jhāna, one reviews the jhāna, enjoys it, and delights in it; taking that as an object, lust arises, wrong view arises, doubt, restlessness, and displeasure arise; noble ones review change-of-lineage, review purification, abandoned defilements… suppressed defilements… previously practiced things… the eye… the base… (abbreviated) is a condition for adverting to the knowledge of the future by way of object condition. (1)

Upādāniyo [V 3.0736] ceva no ca upādāno dhammo upādānassa ceva upādāniyassa ca dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo (saṃkhittaṃ, itare dve upādānadukasadisā). (3)

A state that is clingable but not clinging is a condition for a state that is both clinging and clingable by way of object condition. (Abbreviated. The other two are similar to the Clinging Dyad). (3)

Upādāno [T 4.0283] ceva upādāniyo ca upādāniyo ceva no ca upādāno ca dhammā upādānassa ceva upādāniyassa ca dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo… tīṇi (heṭṭhā adhipati tīṇi, upādānadukasadisā).

A state that is both clinging and clingable and a state that is clingable but not clinging are a condition for a state that is both clinging and clingable by way of object condition… three. (The three permutations for the Dominance condition below are similar to the Clinging Dyad.)

Adhipatipaccayo

Dominance Condition

100. Upādāniyo ceva no ca upādāno dhammo upādāniyassa ceva no ca upādānassa ca dhammassa adhipatipaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇādhipati, sahajātādhipati. Ārammaṇādhipati – dānaṃ…pe… jhānā vuṭṭhahitvā jhānaṃ garuṃ katvā paccavekkhati, assādeti abhinandati, taṃ garuṃ katvā rāgo uppajjati, diṭṭhi uppajjati; sekkhā gotrabhuṃ garuṃ katvā…pe… vodānaṃ…pe… cakkhuṃ…pe… vatthuṃ upādāniye ceva no ca upādāne khandhe garuṃ katvā upādāniyā ceva no ca upādānā khandhā uppajjanti. Sahajātādhipati – upādāniyā ceva no ca upādānādhipati sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ adhipatipaccayena paccayo (avasesā dvepi ārammaṇādhipati sahajātādhipatipi upādānadukasadisā). (3)

100. A state that is clingable but not clinging is a condition for a state that is clingable but not clinging by way of dominance condition: by object-dominance and co-nascence-dominance. Object-dominance: one gives a gift… and so on… having emerged from jhāna, one gives it weight, reviews it, enjoys it, and delights in it; giving it weight, lust arises, wrong view arises; trainees give weight to change-of-lineage… to purification… the eye… the base… giving weight to the aggregates that are clingable but not clinging, aggregates that are clingable but not clinging arise. Co-nascence-dominance: a dominant factor that is clingable but not clinging is a condition for its associated aggregates and for mind-originated matter by way of dominance condition. (The remaining two permutations, involving both object-dominance and co-nascence-dominance, are similar to the Clinging Dyad). (3)

(Ghaṭanā [M 3.0600] adhipati tīṇi, upādānadukasadisā. Sabbe paccayā upādānadukasadisā. Upādāniye lokuttaraṃ natthi, paccanīyampi itare dve gaṇanāpi upādānadukasadisaṃ.)

(The application for the three dominance permutations is similar to the Clinging Dyad. All conditions are to be treated similarly to the Clinging Dyad. There is no supramundane in the clingable. The Negative section, as well as the other two enumerations, are also similar to the Clinging Dyad.)

Upādānaupādāniyadukaṃ niṭṭhitaṃ.

The Dyad of Clinging and the Clingable is concluded.

Root Condition

101. Upādānañceva [T 4.0284][V 3.0737] upādānasampayuttañca dhammaṃ paṭicca upādāno ceva upādānasampayutto ca dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – diṭṭhupādānaṃ paṭicca kāmupādānaṃ (cakkaṃ kātabbaṃ). (1)

101. Dependent on a state that is both clinging and associated with clinging, a state that is both clinging and associated with clinging arises by way of root condition—dependent on clinging to views, clinging to sensual pleasures arises. (A cycle should be made.) (1)

Upādānañceva upādānasampayuttañca dhammaṃ paṭicca upādānasampayutto ceva no ca upādāno dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – upādāne paṭicca sampayuttakā khandhā. (2)

Dependent on a state that is both clinging and associated with clinging, a state that is associated with clinging but not clinging arises by way of root condition—dependent on a clinging, its associated aggregates arise. (2)

Upādānañceva upādānasampayuttañca dhammaṃ paṭicca upādāno ceva upādānasampayutto ca upādānasampayutto ceva no ca upādāno ca dhammā uppajjanti hetupaccayā – diṭṭhupādānaṃ paṭicca kāmupādānaṃ sampayuttakā ca khandhā (cakkaṃ). (3)

Dependent on a state that is both clinging and associated with clinging, states that are (i) both clinging and associated with clinging, and (ii) associated with clinging but not clinging, arise by way of root condition—dependent on clinging to views, clinging to sensual pleasures and its associated aggregates arise. (A cycle). (3)

2-6. Sahajāta-paccaya-nissaya-saṃsaṭṭha-sampayuttavāro

2-6. The Section on Co-nascence, Condition, Dependence, Conjoined, and Associated

Upādānasampayuttañceva no ca upādānaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca…pe…. (Saṃkhittaṃ. Āmasanaṃ nānākaraṇaṃ upādānadukasadisaṃ nava pañhā. Rūpaṃ natthi. Evaṃ sabbepi vārā vitthāretabbā. Arūpaṃyeva.)

Dependent on a state that is associated with clinging but is not clinging... (Abbreviated.) (The application is different, but similar to the Clinging Dyad; nine questions. There is no material form. Thus all sections are to be elaborated. Immaterial only.)

7. Pañhāvāro

Hetupaccayo

Root Condition

102. Upādāno [V 3.0738] ceva upādānasampayutto ca dhammo upādānassa ceva upādānasampayuttassa ca dhammassa hetupaccayena paccayo – upādānā ceva upādānasampayuttā [M 3.0601] ca hetū sampayuttakānaṃ upādānānaṃ hetupaccayena paccayo. (Mūlaṃ pucchitabbaṃ) upādānā ceva upādānasampayuttā [T 4.0285] ca hetū sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ hetupaccayena paccayo. (Mūlaṃ pucchitabbaṃ) upādānā ceva upādānasampayuttā ca hetū sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ upādānānañca hetupaccayena paccayo. (3)

102. A phenomenon that is both clinging and associated with clinging is a condition for a phenomenon that is both clinging and associated with clinging by root condition—roots that are both clinging and associated with clinging are a condition for associated clingings by root condition. (The root should be investigated.) Roots that are both clinging and associated with clinging are a condition for the associated aggregates by root condition. (The root should be investigated.) Roots that are both clinging and associated with clinging are a condition for the associated aggregates and the clingings by root condition. (3)

103. Upādānasampayutto ceva no ca upādāno dhammo upādānasampayuttassa ceva no ca upādānassa dhammassa hetupaccayena paccayo – upādānasampayuttā ceva no ca upādānā hetū sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ hetupaccayena paccayo. (Mūlaṃ pucchitabbaṃ) upādānasampayuttā ceva no ca upādānā hetū sampayuttakānaṃ upādānānaṃ hetupaccayena paccayo. (Mūlaṃ pucchitabbaṃ) upādānasampayuttā ceva no ca upādānā hetū sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ upādānānañca hetupaccayena paccayo. (3)

103. A phenomenon that is associated with clinging but is not clinging is a condition for a phenomenon that is associated with clinging but is not clinging by root condition—roots that are associated with clinging but are not clinging are a condition for the associated aggregates by root condition. (The root should be investigated.) Roots that are associated with clinging but are not clinging are a condition for the associated clingings by root condition. (The root should be investigated.) Roots that are associated with clinging but are not clinging are a condition for the associated aggregates and the clingings by root condition. (3)

104. Upādāno ceva upādānasampayutto ca upādānasampayutto ceva no ca upādāno ca dhammā upādānassa ceva upādānasampayuttassa ca dhammassa hetupaccayena paccayo – upādānā ceva upādānasampayuttā ca upādānasampayuttā ceva no ca upādānā ca hetū sampayuttakānaṃ upādānānaṃ hetupaccayena paccayo. (Mūlaṃ pucchitabbaṃ) upādānā ceva upādānasampayuttā ca upādānasampayuttā ceva no ca upādānā ca hetū sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ hetupaccayena paccayo. (Mūlaṃ pucchitabbaṃ) upādānā ceva upādānasampayuttā ca upādānasampayuttā ceva no ca upādānā ca hetū sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ upādānānañca hetupaccayena paccayo. (3)

104. Phenomena that are (i) both clinging and associated with clinging and (ii) associated with clinging but not clinging are a condition for a phenomenon that is both clinging and associated with clinging by root condition—roots that are (i) both clinging and associated with clinging and (ii) associated with clinging but not clinging are a condition for associated clingings by root condition. (The root should be investigated.) Roots that are (i) both clinging and associated with clinging and (ii) associated with clinging but not clinging are a condition for the associated aggregates by root condition. (The root should be investigated.) Roots that are (i) both clinging and associated with clinging and (ii) associated with clinging but not clinging are a condition for the associated aggregates and the clingings by root condition. (3)

Ārammaṇapaccayo

Object Condition

105. Upādāno [V 3.0739] ceva upādānasampayutto ca dhammo upādānassa ceva [T 4.0286] upādānasampayuttassa ca dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo – upādāne ārabbha upādānā uppajjanti. (Mūlaṃ pucchitabbaṃ) upādāne ārabbha upādānasampayuttā ceva no ca upādānā khandhā uppajjanti. (Mūlaṃ pucchitabbaṃ) upādāne ārabbha upādānā ca sampayuttakā ca khandhā uppajjanti. (3)

105. A phenomenon that is both clinging and associated with clinging is a condition for a phenomenon that is both clinging and associated with clinging by object condition—taking clinging as object, clingings arise. (The root should be investigated.) Taking clinging as object, aggregates that are associated with clinging but are not clinging arise. (The root should be investigated.) Taking clinging as object, both clingings and their associated aggregates arise. (3)

Upādānasampayutto [M 3.0602] ceva no ca upādāno dhammo upādānasampayuttassa ceva no ca upādānassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo – upādānasampayutte ceva no ca upādāne khandhe ārabbha upādānasampayuttā ceva no ca upādānā khandhā uppajjanti (tīṇipi kātabbā, ghaṭane tīṇipi kātabbā).

A phenomenon that is associated with clinging but is not clinging is a condition for a phenomenon that is associated with clinging but is not clinging by object condition—taking as object aggregates that are associated with clinging but are not clinging, aggregates that are associated with clinging but are not clinging arise. (All three cases should be stated; in combination, all three should be stated.)

Adhipatipaccayo

Dominance Condition

106. Upādāno ceva upādānasampayutto ca dhammo upādānassa ceva upādānasampayuttassa ca dhammassa adhipatipaccayena paccayo… tīṇi. (3)

106. A phenomenon that is both clinging and associated with clinging is a condition for a phenomenon that is both clinging and associated with clinging by dominance condition… three. (3)

Upādānasampayutto ceva no ca upādāno dhammo upādānasampayuttassa ceva no ca upādānassa dhammassa adhipatipaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇādhipati, sahajātādhipati (tīṇipi, tīsupi dvepi adhipati kātabbā, ghaṭanādhipatipi tīṇi).

A phenomenon that is associated with clinging but is not clinging is a condition for a phenomenon that is associated with clinging but is not clinging by dominance condition: by object-dominance and conascence-dominance. (All three cases are to be stated. In these three, both kinds of dominance are to be stated. In the combination by dominance also, three cases.)

Anantarapaccayo

Proximity Condition

107. Upādāno ceva upādānasampayutto ca dhammo upādānassa ceva upādānasampayuttassa ca dhammassa anantarapaccayena paccayo – purimā purimā upādānā ceva upādānasampayuttā ca khandhā pacchimānaṃ pacchimānaṃ upādānānaṃ anantarapaccayena paccayo (evaṃ navapi pañhā kātabbā, āvajjanāpi vuṭṭhānampi natthi).

107. A phenomenon that is both clinging and associated with clinging is a condition for a phenomenon that is both clinging and associated with clinging by proximity condition—preceding aggregates that are both clinging and associated with clinging are a condition for succeeding clingings by proximity condition. (Thus nine questions are to be made; there is neither adverting nor emergence.)

Samanantarapaccayādi

Contiguity Condition, etc.

108. Upādāno [T 4.0287][V 3.0740] ceva upādānasampayutto ca dhammo upādānassa ceva upādānasampayuttassa ca dhammassa samanantarapaccayena paccayo… nava… sahajātapaccayena paccayo… nava… aññamaññapaccayena paccayo… nava… nissayapaccayena paccayo… nava.

108. A phenomenon that is both clinging and associated with clinging is a condition for a phenomenon that is both clinging and associated with clinging by contiguity condition… nine… by conascence condition… nine… by mutuality condition… nine… by support condition… nine.

Upanissayapaccayo

Decisive Support Condition

109. Upādāno ceva upādānasampayutto ca dhammo upādānassa ceva upādānasampayuttassa ca dhammassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo…pe… tīṇi.

109. A phenomenon that is both clinging and associated with clinging is a condition for a phenomenon that is both clinging and associated with clinging by decisive support condition… three.

Upādānasampayutto [M 3.0603] ceva no ca upādāno dhammo upādānasampayuttassa ceva no ca upādānassa dhammassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇūpanissayo, anantarūpanissayo, pakatūpanissayo…pe…. Pakatūpanissayo – upādānasampayuttā ceva no ca upādānā khandhā upādānasampayuttakānañceva no ca upādānānaṃ khandhānaṃ upanissayapaccayena paccayo (tīṇi ghaṭanupanissayepi tīṇi)… āsevanapaccayena paccayo… nava.

A phenomenon that is associated with clinging but is not clinging is a condition for a phenomenon that is associated with clinging but is not clinging by decisive support condition—that is, by object-decisive support, proximity-decisive support, and natural decisive support…. Natural decisive support: aggregates that are associated with clinging but are not clinging are a condition for aggregates that are associated with clinging but are not clinging by decisive support condition (three; in combination-decisive support also three)… by repetition condition… nine.

Kammapaccayādi

Kamma Condition, and so on.

110. Upādānasampayutto ceva no ca upādāno dhammo upādānasampayuttassa ceva no ca upādānassa dhammassa kammapaccayena paccayo… tīṇi… āhārapaccayena paccayo… tīṇi… indriyapaccayena paccayo… tīṇi… jhānapaccayena paccayo… tīṇi… maggapaccayena paccayo… nava… sampayuttapaccayena paccayo… nava… atthipaccayena paccayo… nava… natthipaccayena paccayo… nava… vigatapaccayena paccayo… nava… avigatapaccayena paccayo… nava.

110. A state that is associated with clinging but is not clinging is a condition for a state that is associated with clinging but is not clinging by kamma condition… three… by nutriment condition… three… by faculty condition… three… by jhāna condition… three… by path condition… nine… by association condition… nine… by presence condition… nine… by absence condition… nine… by disappearance condition… nine… by non-disappearance condition… nine.

Hetuyā [T 4.0288][V 3.0741] nava, ārammaṇe nava, adhipatiyā nava, anantare nava, samanantare nava, sahajāte nava, aññamaññe nava, nissaye nava, upanissaye nava, āsevane nava, kamme tīṇi, āhāre tīṇi, indriye tīṇi, jhāne tīṇi, magge nava, sampayutte nava, atthiyā nava, natthiyā nava, vigate nava, avigate nava.

By root condition, nine; by object condition, nine; by dominance condition, nine; by contiguity condition, nine; by immediacy condition, nine; by co-nascence condition, nine; by mutuality condition, nine; by support condition, nine; by decisive support condition, nine; by repetition condition, nine; by kamma condition, three; by nutriment condition, three; by faculty condition, three; by jhāna condition, three; by path condition, nine; by association condition, nine; by presence condition, nine; by absence condition, nine; by disappearance condition, nine; by non-disappearance condition, nine.

Paccanīyuddhāro

Negative Exposition

112. Upādāno ceva upādānasampayutto ca dhammo upādānassa ceva upādānasampayuttassa ca dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo… sahajātapaccayena paccayo… upanissayapaccayena paccayo. (1)

112. A state that is both clinging and associated with clinging is a condition for a state that is both clinging and associated with clinging by object condition… by co-nascence condition… by decisive support condition. (1)

Upādāno [M 3.0604] ceva upādānasampayutto ca dhammo upādānasampayuttassa ceva no ca upādānassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo… sahajātapaccayena paccayo… upanissayapaccayena paccayo. (2)

A state that is both clinging and associated with clinging is a condition for a state that is associated with clinging but is not clinging by object condition… by co-nascence condition… by decisive support condition. (2)

Upādāno ceva upādānasampayutto ca dhammo upādānassa ceva upādānasampayuttassa ca upādānasampayuttassa ceva no ca upādānassa ca dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo… sahajātapaccayena paccayo… upanissayapaccayena paccayo (evaṃ navapi kātabbā, ekekassa mūle tīṇi tīṇi pañhā).

A state that is both clinging and associated with clinging is a condition for a state that is both clinging and associated with clinging and for a state that is associated with clinging but is not clinging by object condition… by co-nascence condition… by decisive support condition. (Thus all nine should be done, with three questions for each root.)

Hetupaccayo

Root Condition

116. Upādānavippayuttaṃ [V 3.0743] upādāniyaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca upādānavippayutto upādāniyo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – upādānavippayuttaṃ upādāniyaṃ ekaṃ [M 3.0605] khandhaṃ paṭicca tayo khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ…pe… dve khandhe…pe… paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe… ekaṃ mahābhūtaṃ…pe… mahābhūte paṭicca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ kaṭattārūpaṃ upādārūpaṃ. (1)

116. Depending on a state that is dissociated from clinging and subject to clinging, a state that is dissociated from clinging and subject to clinging arises by root condition. Depending on one aggregate that is dissociated from clinging and subject to clinging, three aggregates and mind-originated matter arise… two aggregates… at the moment of rebirth-linking… one great element… depending on the great elements, mind-originated matter, kamma-born matter, and derived matter arise. (1)

Upādānavippayuttaṃ anupādāniyaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca upādānavippayutto anupādāniyo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – upādānavippayuttaṃ anupādāniyaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca tayo khandhā…pe… dve khandhe…pe…. (1)

Depending on a state that is dissociated from clinging and not subject to clinging, a state that is dissociated from clinging and not subject to clinging arises by root condition. Depending on one aggregate that is dissociated from clinging and not subject to clinging, three aggregates arise… two aggregates…. (1)

Upādānavippayuttaṃ anupādāniyaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca upādānavippayutto upādāniyo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – upādānavippayutte anupādāniye khandhe paṭicca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ. (2)

Depending on a state that is dissociated from clinging and not subject to clinging, a state that is dissociated from clinging and subject to clinging arises by root condition. Depending on aggregates that are dissociated from clinging and not subject to clinging, mind-originated matter arises. (2)

Upādānavippayuttaṃ anupādāniyaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca upādānavippayutto upādāniyo ca upādānavippayutto anupādāniyo ca dhammā uppajjanti hetupaccayā – upādānavippayuttaṃ [T 4.0290] anupādāniyaṃ [V 3.0744] ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca tayo khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ…pe… dve khandhe…pe…. (3)

Depending on a state that is dissociated from clinging and not subject to clinging, a state that is dissociated from clinging and subject to clinging and a state that is dissociated from clinging and not subject to clinging arise by root condition. Depending on one aggregate that is dissociated from clinging and not subject to clinging, three aggregates and mind-originated matter arise… two aggregates…. (3)

Upādānavippayuttaṃ upādāniyañca upādānavippayuttaṃ anupādāniyañca dhammaṃ paṭicca upādānavippayutto upādāniyo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – upādānavippayutte anupādāniye khandhe ca mahābhūte ca paṭicca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ. (1)

Depending on a state that is dissociated from clinging and subject to clinging and a state that is dissociated from clinging and not subject to clinging, a state that is dissociated from clinging and subject to clinging arises by root condition. Depending on aggregates that are dissociated from clinging and not subject to clinging and on the great elements, mind-originated matter arises. (1)

Hetuyā pañca, ārammaṇe dve…pe… avigate pañca.

By root condition, five; by object condition, two… by non-disappearance condition, five.

(Imaṃ dukaṃ cūḷantaraduke lokiyadukasadisaṃ, ninnānākaraṇaṃ.)

(This dyad is similar to the worldly dyad in the Minor Intermediate Dyads; it is without variation.)

Upādānavippayuttaupādāniyadukaṃ niṭṭhitaṃ.

The Dyad on States Dissociated from Clinging and Subject to Clinging is finished.

Upādānagocchakaṃ niṭṭhitaṃ.

The Clinging Cluster is finished.

Tatiyo bhāgo niṭṭhito.

The Third Part is finished.
